Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Arthropoda
Subphylum: Crustacea/Chelicerata???
Class: Merostomata / Malacostraca / ???
Order: ???
Family: ???
Genus: ???

After going to enormous lengths to procure DNA samples of hypothesized forebears, we cannot explain why ancestry evidence is present from two vastly different creatures; the Limulus polyphemus (horseshoe crab) and the Callinectes sapidus (blue crab). It's obvious that a mutation occurred, giving this creature bipedal movement and massive growth, but I cannot explain the presence of multiple subphylum markers in DNA/RNA. Given their mystifying origins, I have decided the species deserves its own classification, and have thus dubbed them "Scylla Serrata Horrendus." They can often be found in sewers and caves and should be considered hostile and very dangerous, as their chitnous shell provides excellent resistance to both firearms and hand-held weapons. They are disgusting creatures, and I cannot fathom their popularity as a food source among the citizens of the Wasteland.
translation:
界： 动物界
门： 节肢动物门
亚门： 甲壳类/螯肢动物亚门？？？
纲： 肢口纲/ 软甲亚纲 / ？？？
目： ？？？
科： ？？？
属： ？？？

即便艰难的获取了这种动物假定祖先的DNA样本之后，我们仍然无法解释为什么他们祖先DNA的特征会出现在两种截然不懂的生物上。很明显变异使这种生物后具有了两足行走的能力，并且体型急剧的增加，但我无法解释为什么不同门的生物的DNA/RNA会同时出现在一种生物身上。鉴于它们谜一般的起源，我决定将它们列为一个新的物种，并且给它们起名为“恐怖锯齿青蟹”。它们在下水道与洞窟中很常见，极具攻击性而且十分的危险，因为它们天生的甲壳对于轻武器和手持武器有着极佳的防护力。它们是一种令人作呕的动物，令我不解的是对于废土居民来说，它们竟然能作为一种食物来源而大受欢迎。

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Chordata
Class: Mammalia
Order: Artiodactyla
Family: Bovidae
Genus: Bos

The Brahmin has been encountered both in domesticated and wild varieties. They are hardy animals, and their utility has made them valuable to humans, in turn allowing these animals to reproduce in quantities beyond what they would otherwise be likely to acheive. They are commonly employed as pack animals. In addition to having two heads, dissection has revealed that these creatures have eight stomachs, but otherwise do not differ significantly from their likely ancestors of the Bovidae Family. Typically docile in demeanor, these creatures are useful as both as beasts of burden and a food source for field operatives.
translation:
界： 动物界
门： 脊索动物门
纲： 哺乳动物纲
目： 偶蹄目
科： 牛科
属： Bos

双头牛很常见，野生的驯养的都有。它们是一种能吃苦耐劳的动物，对人类也有重要的作用，也使得它们的繁殖数量超出了它们应有的数量。双头牛一般被当作驮畜来使用。他们长了两个头，在解剖中还发现它们有8个胃。别的方面与它们的牛科祖先没什么很大的差别。它们的个性温。对于野外人员来说，它们是最好的驮畜和食物来源。

original:
Day 45: 

Jason found a terminal suitable to our needs in the nearby ruins. With some work, we may be able to move this workstation closer to where our research has been taking place. Must keep an eye out for a portable source of power. Must remember to translate my notes onto this thing when I have some time to do so.

While Jason was scavenging the ruins, I caught a glimpse of the group by the pool in the afternoon. Contrary to what most people think, they don't fear the daylight at all, but they do seem to prefer indoor habitats.
translation:
第45天：

杰森在附近的废墟里找到了一台电脑终端。或许我们能设法把它移动到我们的观测站附近。必须留意下附近是否有小型的发电装置。之后我会抽时间把我心得的都记录其中。

中午当杰森搜索废墟的时候，我瞥见了傍池而居的那个群体。与多数人的认知相反，他们毫不畏惧白天，但他们更喜欢在非露天的环境下生活。

original: Day 51:\n\nI've conducted an informal experiment this week. I've filled some heavy basins with water, each with different levels of radiation. Consistent with my predictions, they seem to prefer water with high rad content. Thanks to these radiation suits, I was able to irradiate one of the basins with a typically lethal level of radiation, and to my amazement, this has worked better than any of our attempts at constructing a lure to attract them into our research area. This is very exciting!
translation: 第51天：\n\n本周我进行了一次尝试性的试验。我在几个池子里加入不同辐射等级的水。如我所预测的一样，他们更喜欢辐射高水池。依靠防辐射装的帮忙，我将其中一处池水的辐射等级提升到了可以致命的程度，而让我吃惊的是，这比我们所有已尝试过的吸引他们进入研究范围的方法都更有效。真是太振奋人心了！

original: Day 58: \n\nAmazing! Today I was approached by one of them. I've decided to call her "Melinda." I'm not actually sure if there's a way to establish gender, but Melinda moved in a way that appeared very feminine to me. She caught me off guard while I was checking water levels in the experimental basins. For a moment there, I wished I had taken that damned pistol Jason insisted upon me carrying. She grasped my arm, but instead of attacking, she appeared to sniff my arm where some of the scavenged resin I've been using to irradiate the basins had spilled on my suit. Moments later, she was gone. Must consider some way of tagging them.
translation: 第58天：\n\n太刺激了！今天它们中的一个接近了我。我决定为她取名为“梅林达”。事实上它们并没有明显可供分辨的性特征，但梅林达的行动让我感觉充满了女人味。她在我测量试验池水的辐射程度时抓住了我。一刹那，我咒骂自己为什么不带上杰森曾坚持让我随身携带的那把手枪。她抓住了我的胳膊，但她并没有攻击我，而是使劲嗅着从试验池水溅到我外套上的充满腐臭的树脂。片刻之后，她离开了。必须想办法把他们吸引出来。

original:
Day 63: 

No sign of the group for days. Could Melinda have returned to the group with some news of our brief encounter? Perhaps they're scared of us?

Jason's beginning to get concerned, but I believe we're close to learning what we came here for. The poor man's been through Hell for me. I don't know if I could have achieved so much without him, but there's so much left to learn.
translation:
第63天：

连续几天都没有再看到那个群体。是因为我们与梅林达短暂的相遇被它传达给了它的群体吗？难道是因为他们害怕我们吗？

杰森越来越担心了，但我相信我们来这里的目的马上就要达到了。这个可怜的男人陪伴我走过了地狱般的旅程。没有他我无法想象能做到这种程度，但我们未知的仍有很多。

original: Day 67: \n\nI insisted on sleeping at the research site last night, much to Jason's protest. I'm sure I saw motion in the far ruins, but the moon had slid behind a cloud, so I couldn't make out for certain their shapes. I don't think mutants would have moved like that, and most people in the city know enough to hunker down at night. Could it have been our group, returning home?
translation: 第67天：\n\n我没有理睬杰森的抗议，坚持睡在调查点。我确信在远处的废墟中有生物的存在，由于云层阻断了月光，让我看不清他们的形态。我不认为那是变种人的行为方式，而这里的人们在夜晚都会隐藏起来。那它是否是那个群体中的一员而正在回家的路上呢？

original: Day 68:\n\nSlept outdoors again last night. Jason insisted on staying with me this time, and built a camouflage screen for us to sleep in. I irradiated the main body of water as heavily as I could to try and draw them out. My plan seems to have worked, because I saw few - I think Melinda was among them - come into the open at dusk and settle into the water. After dark, one I believe to be the alpha male - I've called him "Samuel" - emerged with the rest of the group. I had to switch my geiger counter off when he arrived to avoid being heard. I can't imagine the radiation levels the glowing ones must be infused with. I think that must be why he's the alpha - the others are so drawn to him because of his immense irradiation.
translation: 第68天：\n\n昨晚又一次露天而眠。这次杰森坚持要陪着我，并用具有伪装效果的遮蔽物做成我们临时的床。我尽可能把整个身体浸入水中试图以身上的树脂味把他们吸引出来。我的计划似乎奏效了，因为黄昏时我发现了一小群 — 梅林达似乎也在其中之一 — 穿过出口来到岸边。天黑后，雄性首领 — 我为它取名塞缪尔— 带领着其余的成员出现了。为了不让它听见我必须关掉我的盖革计数管。我无法想象那个发光者的受辐射程度。我认为这一定是它之所以成为首领的原因 — 他散发的庞大的射线量吸引着其他成员自然地听命于他。

original: Day 75:\n\nI need to make contact again. I've coated my suit in resin, and will try approaching the group tomorrow at dusk. Observation hasn't revealed anything new; direct contact is required if I'm going to continue to learn about them. I know Jason would never understand, but this won't work if his suit isn't also irradiated. I'll coat it while he's gone scavenging during the afternoon, and we'll set up camp tonight by the water before dusk.
translation: 第75天：\n\n我计划再去一次。把外套涂满树脂并在次日黄昏接近他们。远距离的观察并没有告诉我更多;如果要更深入了解他们那直接的交流是必须的。杰森也许不会理解，但如果他不穿上涂满树脂的外套一切就无济于事。我会利用他中午进行净化实验时给他的衣服涂上树脂，然后我们会赶在黄昏前在那条河边露营。

original:
S,

Here's that stuff you wanted. If anyone asks where you got it -- say it was a gift from your grandma.

Happy hunting!

E
translation:
S,

这就是你需要的东西。如果有人问你从哪得到的 — 就说是你祖母送给你的礼物。

狩猎快乐！

E

original: Nothing says “equality” like a fistful of caps. I think these Talon Company mercs are about the most cordial smoothies I've met, as long as their boss is getting paid. Luckily, money's no issue; I've hoarded plenty of it up since before these guys' parents were knee-high on a Brahmin.\n\nOf course, if I succeed in this, it won't matter how many caps any of these rat bastards have.
translation: 就像在一堆瓶盖里找"平等"是不可能的。我想这些鹰爪雇佣兵在他们的老板得到回报时是我遇到过最真诚恳切，举止优雅的人了。幸运的是， 钱不是问题; 我在这些家伙的父母还没双头牛高时就已经储备好了一批巨款。\n\n当然了，如果我在这方面成功了，这些混球究竟拥有多少瓶盖也不会是问题了。

original: Thanks to a little creative wiring, I was able to tap us into a power source. They're less common up here, but if you know where to look, there are still plenty of live power lines buried all over the Wasteland. For all their arrogance, they knew a thing or two about engineering before the bombs. I have to admit; it's remarkable that there's still power to be had after all these years.\n\nNow that we've got all the power we'd want, I can bring our defensive turret online and try to get the dish motors operational.
translation: 多亏了一根小小的富有创造性的电线，才得以使我们能够接进力量源。  在上面它们可不如此平凡， 只要你知道往哪找， 还是能发现许多生存能量线隐藏在整个废土的。  由于生性傲慢， 他们在轰炸前还是对工程学略知一二的。  我不得不承认; 有个事实很明显，那就是过了这么多年还依然存在能量。\n\n 现在，我们已经得到了所需的能量，  我可以连线防卫炮塔并且设法取得碟形发电机的操作权。

original: Finally got to begin on my work in earnest today. Dish motivators are offline, but I was able to input some basic coordinates and ping nearby satcom arrays to the southwest and east. There was some interference pinging the NN-03d array. Probably Radroaches or something making a nest in the dishes. It may be worth sending one or two of the mercs over there to clean it out in case I can use those towers to amplify my own signal.\n\nThere were dozens of military satellites in orbit, just from the old records I found in the ruins. There must have been hundreds before the war. If I can find just a few operational platforms...
translation: 最终在一个充满热情的日子里开始了我的工作。  碟形天线未连线，  但我可以输入些基本的坐标， 附近从西南至东面的卫星通讯阵列发出砰砰的声响。  卫星通讯阵列NN-03d还存在被干扰问题。  也许是Radroach或其他什么东西在碟形天线里做巢。  也许派一两个佣兵去把那清理干净很有必要，以便我可以使用那些塔楼来增强信号。\n\n我刚在从废墟里找到的旧时记录里发现，那儿曾经有数百万的军事卫星在绕轨道飞行。  不过那也肯定是大战前数百年的事了。   如果我只能找到一些操作平台。。。

original: First attempts at atmospheric pinging returned negative. Considering that the motivators are still non-functional, it's going to be difficult to catch much of anything that doesn't pass directly over us. Still, I cannot rule out other mechanical failure. I haven't got much astronomical reference material with me, but maybe I can find an old chart and wait until a celestial body passes over to confirm signal. Of course, that may take years. I'll have to keep working on the motivators.
translation: 起初在大气脉冲上所做的尝试无功而返.  考虑到操作机仍然不起作用, 这将给探索未直接经过我们的玩意带来困难.  我仍然不排出其它机械故障.  我还没有得到大量相关材料, 但也许我可以找一块旧图表,然后一直等到天上的物体失去了有效信号.  淡然, 那可要费些时日.  我不得不还继续在操作机上费点工夫.

original: What a lucky break! I pinged an orbiting body successfully today. Registration ID is USDOD-21TXH, callsign “Highwater Trouser”. I'll begin tracking it and cross-reference the registration information with the data I've got.
translation: 多幸运的一次突破!  我今天成功的接收到了一个绕轨道飞行物体的声纳脉冲信号.  注册ID是USDOD-21TXH, 呼号"Highwater Trouser".  我将开始对其展开追踪,并对其注册信息和我个人所得数据进行前后对照.

original: Turns out I don't have specific data on my satellite, but the registration format suggests that it's a stationary micro-nuclear weapons platform. Tracking data appears to confirm this; the thing hasn't moved in the week I've been tracking it. Without a targeting platform at my disposal, sending an activation code would only cause it to drop a payload directly on top of this area. Not exactly what I'm aiming for, but I'll keep the codes handy just in case.
translation: 结果证明我还在卫星上还没找到详细精确的数据, 但注册信息显示这是一座固定的微型核武器平台.  追踪数据证实了这点; 在我追踪它的这一周,它还未移动过.  如果装置中没有目标平台的话,  发送激活代码只能使它直接坠落.  我瞄准的也不一定准确, 但我会把代码放在手头边以防万一.

original: We were mobilized in the early evening. My security clearance isn't high enough to know this on an official level, but I have it on good authority that we're under threat of a Chinese attack. I don't dare to share this with the girls; most of them are a solid sort, but I can't trust that some won't desert to try and protect themselves or their families, and wind up spreading panic, especially on flimsy rumours based on flimsier intelligence from DoD.\n\nWe haven't been debriefed yet, but it's probably safe to assume we'll be on an evacuation detail in the rural areas. Our unit scored somewhat poorly in the last round of drills, and the high-flyers always get the urban details; we'll be stuck herding farmers and hermits in the hills.
translation: 我们在黄昏时被动员起来。我的安全级别还不足以了解情况，但是我有确实的根据说明我们正受到中国进攻的威胁。我不敢告诉女孩们这一情况；她们大部分是可靠的，但是我认为总有人会逃跑，放弃保护自己和家人的机会，四处散布恐慌。尤其是当谣传建立在DoD那些没信誉的情报人员上时。\n\n我们还没有被询问到，不过倒是可以假设我们将会撤到乡下地区。我们的单位在最后一次训练中表现得不好，而那些野心家们总是能得到城市的详细资料；我们会被骗去山沟里种地放羊。

original: This can't have happened. We don't even know if it was the Chinese, but DC was hit. My God, Andrea's unit was on evac detail right on the Belt Loop. \n\nDear God. More bombs. What's happening?
translation: 这不能够啊。我们甚至还不知道那到底是不是中国人干的，但是华盛顿已经被袭击了。我的天，安德烈的队伍还在环地进行干扰作业。\n\n亲爱的上帝啊。炸弹又来了。到底发生了什么？

original: Our unit has been assigned to a National Guard Detachment. They drove all night from Pennsylvania. We're doing our best to keep the survivors placated while these boys get their strength up. The looting gets worse every day, and it's a small town. There can't be much left, and there's already been one scuffle at the canteen. These Guardsmen arrived just in time, I fear.
translation: 我们的单位已经被指派去国民警卫分遣队。他们从宾夕法尼亚连夜赶路。我们正尽最大努力安抚幸存者。抢劫现象每天都在增加，而这只是个小镇。那里剩不下什么东西了，店里已经混乱一团。恐怕这些守卫来得正是时候。

original: Dolores and Rebecca deserted in the night. They had the goodness not to rob us blind on her way out; I had trusted Becky with the keys to the canteen and the artesian well we locked up on Day One.. Several of our survivors were talking rubbish about seeking refuge in a nearby Vault, the girls must have decided to go with them. Damned fools; if anybody made it into those things in time, they bloody well aren't letting any of us in now. I suppose I should just be glad we have a few less mouths to feed.
translation: 多洛雷斯和丽贝卡在夜里逃走了。他们还算有良心没有在走的时候打劫我们；我曾经那么信任贝基，给他店里和自流井的钥匙，那自流井还是我们在第一天就锁上的..我们的几个幸存者还在徒劳地讨论在附近的避难所里找个藏身处，那些女孩应该是已经决定跟他们一起去了。该死的白痴们；即使有人能及时赶到那里，他们也肯定不会放我们任何一个进去的。我猜我应该庆幸可以少喂几张嘴了。

original: I took the NCO's advice and set up a quarantine for the worst of the radiation victims. We know better than to think they're contagious, but most of our survivors don't, and it helps keep them calm. We also have an easier time smuggling the bodies out at night. It's not so much that people die; it's how they look when they go. They all think they'll just lose a bit of hair, maybe get a rash. It gets so much worse than that.
translation: 我接受了NCO的建议，安排了对严重辐射病患的隔离检疫。我们还没有白痴到以为他们会传染，但是大多数幸存者们并不懂，而这可以安抚他们。如此一来我们就可以在夜里更容易的悄悄运走尸体。人死了并没什么大不了的；关键是死的时候看起来是什么样子。他们都以为只不过是掉几根头发，或者再得几个疹子。实际情况远比他们想的糟。

original: We're low on Prussian Blue. Most of them don't know what that really means, for which I'm thankful. One of the local doctors in our camp knows about a cancer treatment facility not too far from here. We're sending some of the guardsmen out to investigate. If they can recover any filgrastim, we might be able to stave off widespread radiation sickness a little longer.
translation: 我们缺少普鲁士蓝。谢天谢地，他们大多不懂这是什么意思。一个我们营地里的本地医生知道附近有个癌症治疗设备。我们正派人前去调查。如果他们能带回点惠尔血，我们也许就可以拖延辐射病的蔓延。

original: These days I feel like more of a preacher than a nurse. We've lost hope that the reservists will be back. I can only hope they died with some scrap of honor and didn't abandon us. Without medication, people are succumbing to radiation sickness, for which there is no hope of treatment. We can do nothing more than make our patients comfortable as we await the end. When the painkillers and whiskey run out, prayer is all we can offer them. I've taken to wearing a headwrap; I don't want them to see how much of my own hair has fallen out.
translation: 这些天往我觉得自己更像是个牧师而不是护士。我们已经放弃了军队回来的希望。我只希望他们死的荣耀，没有丢下我们。没有药品，人们对辐射病没有任何抵抗力，毫无治愈希望。我们什么也做不了，最多让病人们在等死的时候舒服点。当止痛药和威士忌用完之后，我们只能帮他们祈祷了。我戴上了头袋；我可不想让他们看到我掉了多少头发。

original: I suppose it seems only right to say goodbye. I ought to know it's hopeless, but maybe one of my sisters is still out there, and I couldn't go without leaving some kind of farewell. Just know that I did everything I could. I tried, and I only wish that I could be the last to go, so I could have helped all the others before they met their own end.
translation: 我想现在正是说再见的时候。我应该清楚这是没希望的，但是也许我的一个妹妹还在那，我也不能连再见都不说就走了。我已经做了所有能做的。我试过了，我只希望我是最后一个走的，这样我就算是帮了其它所有人，在他们见到自己的归宿之前。

original: I finally got everyone to agree to let me set up some generators for power. I can understand their nerves, considering what technology did to us all, but not making use of every resource is wasteful, and a sure path to Hell in this situation. Coming out into the light has done wonders for everyone, but we all can get a little stir crazy, even out here. I'm setting this thing up for everyone to use.
translation: 最终，我让所有人都同意我建立一些发电机以获取能源。我能理解他们为什么神经过敏，想想看科技对我们每一个人做过的事情就明白了。但是，不能将每一样资源物尽其用，就是浪费，在现在这种情况下，这很明显，就是自寻死路。产生光对每一个人都有好处，但是我们每一个人都有一些疯狂，即使在这里。我要把这东西建立起来，让每一个人都能使用。

original: We set up an irrigation system! Thank God for Miles' experience on the farm - I never would have thought of this on my own, but what a great idea. I really thought this ground was useless, but the stuff he had us plant in the dirt we dug up is actually sprouting, and the little rivers keep it all nice and wet.
translation: 我们建立了一个灌溉系统！感谢上帝！感谢迈尔斯的农场经验！从没想过我们会搞这个，但真是个好主意。我曾以为这没有用，但它使植物萌芽，并令小河保持湿润。

original: My turn to be boss this month. Seems stupid to me, I don't want to be in charge. I'm just going to do whatever Jim tells me to.
translation: 这月轮到我作主。看起来很傻，我并不想掌权。我只想做吉姆叫我做的。

original: I want to remind everyone to come by my tent every day for your radiation screening. Even if you don't think you've been exposed to radiation, the test takes only minutes. Take my word for it; you'd much rather be inconvenienced in the morning than come down with a case of radiation sickness. I'm more than happy to give a detailed account of that scenario to the next person who misses an appointment.
translation: 我想提醒每个人，每天都要来我的帐篷领取你的防辐射罩。即使你认为你并没有暴露在放射线中，这个测试也只需要几分钟，记住我的话，即使每天早上过来一趟很不方便，也远胜于感染上辐射病。我很乐意为每一个错过了约定的人介绍情况细节。

original: Hey Rochelle, remind me what a big stupid head I am the next time you need me to repair you and Vu's distillers, okay? What gives, Edgar? Can't you put a password on this thing?
translation: 嘿，拉洛歇尔。下次当你要我修理你和酿酒炉的时候，提醒我一下，我是头蠢蛋，好吗？那是什么，埃德加？你不能给这玩意儿加个密码？

original: Been a good few months for us since the coming out. Going by the dosimeter tests, we're taking some exposure to radiation, but as long as Doc Johanson keeps folks on their meds, we don't seem to be having trouble with rad sickness. Irrigation and fertilization has been good, and though we lost the goats and chickens, the cows have done good. Those hardy beasts don't seem to mind this new world. Miles and Jacky are devoting some time to husbandry to keep the cows breeding and available.
translation: 我们外出来已经有好几个月了。通过辐射剂量器的测量，我们正部分暴露在辐射当中，但只要约翰森继续给大家放射药，我们就似乎不会惹上辐射病的麻烦。灌溉和施肥运行良好，而且虽然我们失去了山羊和鸡，但是牛仍然长得很好。这些坚强的动物看起来并不会介意这个新世界。迈尔斯和杰克正致力于农业，以保障牛的繁殖和存活。

original: I'm trying to fabricate a windmill for us. If anybody spots any long, flat sheets of metal, you let me know. I have most of the other parts I need, but haven't found good metal for the blades yet.
translation: 我想给我们建一个磨房。如果谁看到一些又长又平的金属板，告诉我一声。其他部分我已经准备好了，但还没找到适合做刀口的金属。

original: Nobody ought concern themselves too much with Miguel's scouting report. While he did spot some folk out past the valley, they rode by and weren't like to have noticed him or us. Let's all just keep to the homestead for a few days and avoid using open fires for a few days, just to be safe.
translation: 有了米格尔的侦查报告，就没有人需要过多担心什么了。当他看见村庄外一些居民正骑着坐骑经过，而且并没有打算通知他或者我们。来吧，我们仅仅要保护好农庄，避免动用武力，仅仅保持安全就行了。
悬赏通告：伦德斯·普朗基特

original:
Notice to all Good Men and Women seeking Lawful Bounties in the Capital Wastes:

Let it be known that the murderous person known as JUNDERS PLUNKETT, of fair complexion, average height, and missing one good eyeball, is offered for bounty, either DEAD OR ALIVE, in the sum of 1,000 caps or similar compensation of expended equipment and/or medical expense.

JUNDERS PLUNKETT was last seen committing theft and murder in the township of Canterbury Commons. The apprehending person should exercise special caution, as the bountied personage is noted for an uncommon aptitude with small, concealable blades.
translation:
谨此通告首府废墟中所有寻找合法赏金的先生和女士们：

我们悬赏捉拿一个名叫伦德斯·普朗基特的谋杀犯，白种人，中等身高，是个独眼龙，活要见人，死要见尸，总计1000个瓶盖的奖赏，或者等价的装备与药品物资的补偿。

伦德斯·普朗基特最后一次被发现在坎特伯雷社区，犯下了盗窃与谋杀的罪行。实施抓捕行动的人请务必格外小心，据称该赏金对象拥有一种罕见的本领，精通使用一把小而隐蔽的刀片。

original:
Dear Mr & Mrs Gomez: 

Congratulations on your family's recent inclusion in the Vault 101 community!

You will find outlined in your application materials a full review of rules and procedures related to preparing for shelter in a Vault-Tec facility, but we will outline a few key points here:

* Vault-Tec provides all clothing, bedding, and accommodations for residents. Personal belongings must be reviewed and approved of by an authorized Vault-Tec hermetics technician before such belongings can be delivered to your reserved quarters within the Vault. In the event of an emergency entrance to the Vault, no personal belongings will be permitted beyond the main door of the facility.
* All Vault residents must attend an orientation seminar. If you did not attend such a seminar as part of the application process, you must make an appointment with your Vault-Tec representative.
* In the event of a Vault activation, whether actual or drill, Vault-Tec will sound a siren audible in the immediate vicinity of the Vault facility entrance, and residents will be contacted via holotape message at the phone number provided in their resident profile records. Please report promptly to Vault 101 to await admittance and processing upon such a notification.

Vault-Tec looks forward to having you and your family as valued residents! Be sure to present this letter to your Vault-Tec representative to receive your special, commemorative Vault Boy bobble-head toy! Sincerely;

Vault-Tec 
Dept of Public Relations
Washington, DC
translation:
亲爱的戈麦斯先生和戈麦斯夫人：

祝贺您全家成为101号避难所这个大家庭的一部分！

在你的申请材料里，有完整的规章制度以及进入避难所科技公司设施避难前准备工作的相关程序，但我们在这里列出了几个关键点：

* 所有的服装，寝具以及居住设施均由避难所科技提供。你的私人物品在投递到避难所内预定的住处之前，必须先由避难所科技授权的内部技术人员进行检查与核准。  倘若在紧急状态下需要进入避难所， 则不允许携带私人物品进入避难所的大门。
* 所有避难所的住民必须参加一个定位研讨会。 这个研讨会是申请程序的一部分，如果你还未参加，请与避难所科技的代表进行预约。
*如果避难所的大门被打开， 无论是演习还是实战避难所科技都会拉响警报，在紧邻避难所设施入口处的地方就可以听见， 我们将会根据居民档案记录里的编号，经由电话上的全息通讯系统与居民联络。请立即前往101号避难所等待入所批准，并按照以上的注意事项进行下一步的程序。

尊敬的避难所居民，避难所科技期待你和你的家人的到来！请务必将这封信呈交给你在避难所科技的代表，你会收到一个别致而又有纪念意义的小玩具—避难所小子的摇头娃娃！您真诚的；

避难所科技公司 
公共事务部
华盛顿特区

original:
Dear Safety-Conscious Citizen - 

We are writing to inform you that your family was not selected for inclusion in your chosen Vault-Tec facility. Your deposit has been retained, and your application added to a waiting list for your preferred Vault. In the interest of your family's security in the event of a minor nuclear event, please consider relocating to one of these areas, where Vault-Tec facilities are available without a waiting list:

For a full list of Vault-Tec facilities with available accommodations, in exciting locales such as Oklahoma and newly-annexed Canada, contact your local Vault-Tec representative!

Vault-Tec wishes you and your family the best of luck in the uncertain future. Best regards; 

Vault-Tec
Public Relations Dept
Washington, DC
translation:
亲爱的富有安全意识的市民 - 

我们写这封信是想通知你，你和你的家人未能被选中进入你们当初所挑选的避难所设施。你们的定金将会保留，你们的申请被列入了等候名单，会有更好的避难所供你选择。为了你家人的安全，如果遭受了小规模的核武器打击，请考虑将家人安置在下面这些无需等待，可以立即进入的避难所科技公司设施：

这些避难所科技公司设施里都有可用的居住场所，建造在诸如俄克拉荷马州以及新被吞并的加拿大等等这样激动人心的地方，请与当地的避难所科技代表联系！

避难所科技公司祝你和你的家人在不可预知的未来里能有好运气。 真诚的问候； 

避难所科技公司
公共事务部
华盛顿特区

original: Finally done. Maggie wanted us to sign up at a Vault-Tec shelter, but I've never trusted those bastards. It took a lot of work, but Frank helped me get all the parts together and hauled out to the acreage to build this shelter. Air filtration, chemical toilets, artesian well, the whole nine yards. Frank's connections got us the generator cheap, too. And we don't have to worry about sharing quarters with whoever got their name on some waiting list when the day comes.\n\nWish I could say “if” the day comes, but it just seems like a matter of time now. How could it have come to this?<//end>
translation: 完工了。玛姬希望我们能加入某处避难所科技公司掩体，但我却信不过那些混蛋。花费了很多功夫，在富兰克的帮助下，终于把所有要用的东西搬到了我们准备建立住所的地方，并组装了起来。空气过滤系统，盥洗室，饮用水体统等等，一共是九大部分。因为富兰克的关系，我们买到了便宜的发电机。我们不必担心某天需要与名单上某个不速之客分享住所。\n\n我希望能一直维持这样的生活，但这似乎只是昙花一现。为什么会这样？

original: Robin wanted to play with the computer for Christmas, so I siphoned some juice from the fusion generator to power this old thing. I know she'd rather be playing outside in the snow, but she's a good kid. Knows that we can't go outside yet. I'll check the fallout levels again tomorrow while she's playing, but I doubt we'll be heading out anytime soon. Damn commies must have hit us hard.<//end>
translation: 圣诞节到了，罗宾提出想玩电脑，于是我从核融合发电机分流出一部分电力启动了那台旧电脑。我十分明白其实她更渴望能去户外玩雪，她真是个懂事的孩子。目前为止我们还不能出门。明天我会趁她玩电脑时再测试下户外的辐射浓度，我猜应该不久就能出门了。该死的共军真是把我们害惨了。
圣诞快乐！ \n\n可爱的孩子们，嗯？

original: I don't believe it. Frank showed up today. He was on a sales trip when the blast hit, selling generators to a mining operation in Pennsylvania. Being in those shafts probably saved his life, but the shock wave also knocked out every power line feeding them light and air. Falling debris killed the foreman standing right next to him. He doesn't even know how long he was crawling around those tunnels before he got outside, the poor bastard. \n\nSounds like the water's boiling. Some hot soup will do him good, even if it's that powdered crap we hauled in here last year.<//end>
translation: 难以置信。弗兰克还活着。在被核爆殃及之前，他一直以行商的身份，为宾夕法尼亚某处的矿坑开掘工程提供发电机。他躲在矿坑里虽逃得一命，但冲击波却摧毁了为他们供给电力和氧气的能源。震落的石块让他背后的一个工头死于非命。他已经述不清自己用了多久才穿过了一条条隧道而逃生，可怜的家伙。\n\n汤已经煮沸了。一些热汤应该对他有所帮助，即使是用去年捕获的早已成干粉的猎物煮的汤。

original: Frank's in bad shape, arms and face are all burned up. He's got a lot of blisters that look infected. He went through hell out there. Hardly anybody alive, and those he met almost did him in. He tried getting into a Vault near Burkittsville. They wouldn't open up and he was almost killed in an ambush on his way out of there. He said those folks wore skins of men. Cannibal bastards must just wait for their next meal to come looking for help at the Vault. Frank steered clear of them and headed straight here after that. He's been on his feet for weeks.<//end>
translation: 弗兰克的情况很糟，双臂和脸部都被严重灼伤了。被感染的部分长满了水泡。他从地狱般的地方逃命，侥幸地生还了。在那里他所遭遇的一切都能要了他的命。他试图进入博科思城附近的一处避难所。他不仅没能成功地说服他们开门，还差点死于归路上的一次伏击。他说伏击他的是人类。那群婊子养的食人族把向避难所求助的人们当成了下一顿肉宴。之后弗兰克设法避开了他们并最终回到了这里。他一直步行了数个星期。

original: His hair was falling out within a week of him showing up. I wanted to believe we could save him, but there's no way a few iodine tablets a day was going to reverse the radiation he must have been exposed to out there. He was a good man. He deserves better, but I can't go out there and give him a proper burial. Maggie's going to stay up with Robin and let her play some holotapes loud tonight. That's when I'll take Frank in the back and cremate him. I wish our furnace was big enough to hold him in one piece. God help us. How could it have come to this?<//end>
translation: 他从回来直到现在，整整一星期都在不停脱发。我祈祷他痊愈，但依靠每天少量的碘片却不可能去除他在那所受到的辐射。他是个好人。他的命运不应该如此悲惨，但我却连好好安葬他都做不到。把玛姬交由罗宾照看同时以大音量播放着一些全息磁带。我准备趁这时候把弗兰克背去火化。我祈祷我们的火炉足以容纳他的全尸。我的上帝啊。为什么会这样？

original: They're transferring away three more of my men. They tell me it's all to keep the situation at the Dam under control, but what about this place? The situation here has become dangerous for my men and I - I know it, my men know it, and the prisoners know it. It's only a matter of time before something happens.
translation: 他们又调走了我手下三个人。跟我说什么这都是为了维持大坝处于控制之下的现状，那这边怎么办？这鬼地方的现状变得对我和我的人越来越危险了——我知道，我的人也知道，而那些囚犯也心里有数。发生点什么只不过是时间问题了。

original:
Cooke,

This man has been useful to us down here at the prison, and he's been of great help keeping the NCR away. Since he's proven to be competent and trustworthy, I sent him in your direction. Maybe he can help.

If so, we're even.


Eddie
translation:
库克，

在监狱里，这家伙对我们很有用，而且他在不让NCR靠近这件事上帮了大忙。既然他的能力和可靠都被证明了，我把他送到你那边。或许他能帮上忙。

如果是这样的话，那我们扯平了。


艾迪

original: Brig. Gen. Scott Lowe of the U.S. Army will be visiting the facility starting next Monday and staying onsite indefinitely. When ARCHIMEDES goes live, he will be the only person here allowed to authorize its use for anything other than a test. Civilian employees are not required to salute, but it is expected of everyone that you observe thorough grooming and hygiene regimens and dress neatly while the general is with us. The general expects the best from all his men, and Poseidon men should be no different in the presence of such a fine and decorated soldier.
translation: 美国陆军的斯科特·路易准将将于下周一访问并将留在现场指导。当阿基米德开始启用时，他是唯一一个可以授权其用于实验以外用途的人。非军方雇员并不要求对其敬礼，但当准将面前，请大家穿着得体整洁。准将一向要求他的人做到最好，而我们海神公司的人在仪表上应该不输于这些优秀的士兵。

original: According to the radio, a Ghoul named Raul is being held captive on Black Mountain.
translation: 根据收音机里的说法，一个叫做劳尔的尸鬼被关在黑山。

original:
Excerpt from the deposition of the defendant Katherine Stone by Vault Attorney Gerard Miles

Q. Okay, let's pick up where we left off, Kate.
A. Katherine.
Q. Sorry, right. Katherine. I keep forgetting.
A. My husband calls me Kate.
Q. You were telling us of a discussion you allegedly had with Roy Gottlieb of the Justice Bloc.
A. Not allegedly. Had. We've been through this.
Q. It's still just your word against his, Ms. Stone. But please, the discussion.
A. [Sighs] He said my husband's name had come up in their meetings.
Q. The candidate endorsement meetings?
A. Yes. They were going to endorse him. He wouldn't say why, but I know my husband had a regular poker game with some of them, and he'd been on a winning streak lately.
Q. And according to you, what did Mr. Gottlieb offer?
A. He said he could sway his bloc. Prevent the endorsement. But only if I...
Q. Only if you what, Katherine? 
A. Only if I...
Q. Only if you performed sexual favors.
A. Yes. 
Q. Was this just for Mr. Gottlieb?
A. No. All the bloc leadership. Their friends. 
Q. And you agreed.
A. What else could I do? They had a majority. 
Q. How long did this go on before the endorsements came out?
A. I don't know. A month, maybe. 
Q. And when they came out, and your husband was endorsed despite your supposed agreement, was that when you decided to kill members of the bloc?
A. Yes. I thought, their majority is pretty slim. If I thinned things out a little, especially in the leadership, someone else might get elected.
Q. Assuming you weren't caught.
A. No, Mr. Miles. I expected to be caught. That was my best chance. Now they'll elect me.
Q. A confessed murderer? You think voters would be willing to risk putting you in charge?
A. They have to pick somebody and live with their reasons. 
Q. Yes, but-
A. Wait and see.
translation:
由避难所律师杰拉德·迈尔斯摘录的被告凯瑟琳·斯通的证词

Q. 好的，让我们从上次结束的地方继续，凯特。
A. 我叫凯瑟琳。
Q. 抱歉，是的。凯瑟琳。我又忘了。
A. 我丈夫才叫我凯特。
Q. 你上回提到了你似乎和正义联合体的罗伊·戈特利布有过一次谈话。
A. 不是似乎，是事实。我们确认过这点了。
Q. 这只是你的一面之词，斯通女士。不过还是说说谈话内容。
A. [叹气]他说我丈夫的名字在他们的会议上被提到了。
Q. 关于支持候选人的会议？
A. 是的，他们打算推举我丈夫。他没有说原因，但我知道我丈夫定期会跟他们打打扑克，而他最近节节胜利。
Q. 那么根据你的说法，戈特利布先生的条件是？
A. 他说他可以影响他的联合体。让他们不再推举我丈夫，只要我……
Q. 只要你怎样？凯瑟琳？ 
A. 只要我……
Q. 只要你满足其性需求。
A. 对。
Q. 戈特利布先生的？
A. 不。所有联合体的领导，他们的朋友。 
Q. 然后你就答应了。
A. 我还能怎么做？他们是多数派。 
Q. 在支持结果出现之前大概这样有多久？
A. 我不清楚，一个月，大概。
Q. 而当结果出现时，尽管有你所期望的协议你丈夫还是被他们推举了，是因为这个你才决定杀死联合体的成员么？
A. 我想是的，他们的多数派优势很微弱。如果我稍稍削弱了他们，尤其是领导层，或许其他人就会当选了。
Q. 假如你没被抓到。
A. 不，迈尔斯先生。我巴不得被抓到，这是我最好的机会。他们现在都会选我了。
Q. 一个认罪的谋杀犯？你认为那些选民甘愿冒险让你执政？
A. 他们得选出个人，然后想办法心安理得地活下去。
Q. 是的，可是——
A. 走着瞧。

original:
Dear Fellow Vault Dweller:

Congratulations! Your dedication to the democratic process is the bedrock upon which the continued stability of Vault 11 is based. Now, to help you make your decision for this year's election, the Coalition of Vault 11 Voting Blocs has put together this handy Dweller's Official Guide to Obtaining Overseers Democratically, or D.O. G.O.O.D., that contains a summary of the leading candidates for Overseer as well as their statements, key positions, and most importantly, endorsements. 

Sincerely,

Roy Gottlieb
Chairman, Coalition of Vault 11 Voting Blocs
President, Justice Bloc


Candidate: Henry Glover
Endorsements: Utilitarian Bloc, Divine Will Bloc, Allied Service Workers Bloc
I'm a devoted husband and father of six beautiful children. My oldest, Sam, was on the honor roll this quarter, and I couldn't be prouder of him. My youngest, Henry Jr., just said his first word, and it was "Da-da." We've got this bond already and he's still just a baby. Friends, when you go to the polls this election, I want you to think of your own children. Then I want you to think of Sam and Henry Jr. Picture their faces. Nate Stone should be overseer, not me. 

Candidate: Donna Haley
Endorsements: Human Dignity Bloc, United Vault Technicians Bloc
I'm aware of the rumors circulating about me. I want everyone to know that they are vicious lies being spread by the other candidates in a desperate smear campaign. I have never in my life done anything so depraved, let alone four such things. But even if I had, that still wouldn't mean you should vote for me. Consider the fact that I am grossly underqualified for the position, and that both of my opponents are far more deserving. I know nothing about governance. You would be hard pressed to find a worse candidate than me. I can promise you my administration would be a disaster.

Candidate: Nathan Stone
Endorsements: Justice Bloc
This is ridiculous. I shouldn't even be a candidate. And I wouldn't be if it weren't for all the dirty backroom politics going on around here. It's sickening. You should all be ashamed.
translation:
亲爱的各位避难所居民：

祝贺您！您对民主进程的奉献是11号避难所长久稳定的基石。现在，为了帮助您为今年的竞选作出决定，11号避难所投票委员会合力制作了这个方便的《避难所居民民主争取监督的官方手册》，或者叫做D.O. G.O.O.D.，它包含了监督的主要候选人的摘要以及他们的陈词、主要岗位，还有最重要的 —— 支持者。

诚挚的，

罗伊·戈特利布
11号避难所投票委员会主席
公正联合体主席


候选人：亨利·格洛弗
支持者：功利联合体、神之意愿联合体、联合服务工人联合体
我是一个忠实的丈夫以及6个可爱的孩子的父亲。我的长子萨姆曾经是此地令人自豪的一员，我十分为他感到骄傲。我最小的儿子亨利，刚刚学会了他第一个词“Da-da”。我们已经密不可分，而他还只是个娃娃。朋友们当你们要投下这宝贵的一票的时候，我希望你们想想你们自己的孩子。然后我希望你们想象一下萨姆和小亨利的面孔。内特·斯通应当成为监督，而不是我。 

候选人：唐纳·海利
支持者：人类尊严联合体、联合避难所技工联合体
我听说有很多关于我的流言蜚语。我希望每个人认识到它们不过是其他候选人在竞选的绝望中恶毒的谎言和诽谤。我这辈子从来没有做过任何不堪之事，更别提是四件了。就算我真的做了，这仍不意味着你们要投票给我。想想我是多么地不适合这个位置，而我的两个竞争对手都要更合适。我对统治支配什么的一无所知。你们很难找到一个比我更糟的候选人了。我可以向你们承诺，如果让我管理那将是一场杯具。

候选人：内特·斯通
支持者：正义联合体
真是荒诞。我甚至不应该是候选人，如果不是那些肮脏的上不得台面的政治我也不会成为。真让人作呕，你们都应为此感到羞耻。

original:
Project: Quantum Plasma Modulation Matter Injection Rifle

Version: 32
Status: Failure
Notes: While v.32 didn't have the power yield of the v.31 or v.30, we managed to increase the stabilization threshold by approximately 27.35%. This is promising, however we still have yet to come up with a solution for the matter inversion issues.

Version: 33
Status: Failure
Notes: Lab destroyed. Data Lost.

Version: 34
Status: Failure
Notes: Interesting. I'm not sure where we got this data from, it is a completely different direction from what we've been working on. We managed to cycle the matter inversion using a polarized quantum spin. I think that we solved the issue with the Compensation field, I have high hopes for the next weapon.

Version: 35
Status: Success
Notes: That data we received from Xuan did the trick. We managed to get a stable build model. I don't think this weapon is ready for mass production yet, but it should show that we have a working prototype. We should be able to get these issues resolved in a later build.

As you requested, here are the improvements when compared to a standard plasma rifle.

* Prototype materials not suitable for extended field use.
* On average the Q-35 has a higher refire rate, but the time between shots is more consistent.
* Increase in active bolt charge time, accurate at longer ranges.
* Plasma charge has a 30% increase in energy.
translation:
项目：量子等离子体调制物注入型步枪

版本号：32
状况：失败
备注：由于v.32并未出现v.31或是v.30的能量塌陷问题，我们成功地将稳定阈值提升了大约27.35%。这很有希望，然而我们仍要找出物质反转的解决方案。

版本号：33
状况：失败
备注：实验室全毁，资料丢失。

版本号：34
状况：失败
备注：有意思，我不确定这些资料是哪里得到的，这和我们目前研究的方向截然不同。我们成功地用极化量子自旋来循环物质反转。我想我们解决了补偿领域的问题，我对下一个样品的期望极高。

版本号：35
状况：成功
备注：我们从暄那里收到的资料发挥成效了。我们成功做出了一个稳定的模板。我不认为这个武器可以进行量产了，但它表现出我们有了一个能够使用的原型体。在之后的制作中我们应该能够解决这些问题。

如你所愿，这里是它与常规等离子步枪相比的改动之处。

* 原型物质不适合进行扩展领域使用。
* 在标准状态下Q-35拥有较高的重射机率，但两发之间更连贯。
* 增加活动栓的充能时间以及更远射程上的精度。
* 等离子弹药的能量增加30%。

original: Great news! A Ghoul entered our camp today who has experience fixing machines! He seems to really like it here, so I hope he can stay long enough to fix Rhonda.\n\nWeird, Rhonda just asked me why she would need fixing. She has a point. What was I thinking?
translation: 重大消息！今天有个尸鬼走进了我们的营地，他还会修机器！看起来他非常喜欢这里，所以我打算留他住下来，一直到朗达被修好。\n\n奇怪了，朗达刚才问我为什么还要修理她。她说得对啊，我在想什么呢？

original:
Isaac,

I need to increase the number of weapons and crates of ammunition from our previous arrangement. Things might heat up with Caesar's Legion again and we'd like to be prepared. We need to increase the number of weapons by 25% and ammunition by 50%.

-Contreras
translation:
艾萨克：

我需要在前次安排上再增加武器和弹药箱数量。和凯撒军团之间的矛盾再度加剧了，而我们希望能够做好准备。我们需要增加25%的武器数量以及50%的弹药。

——坎特雷拉斯

original:
Blake,

I need the usual package of medical supplies. You can trust the person with this note to get it to me in one piece. I know. I know. You'll need a payment for the next order. I'll take care of that in a few days.

-Contreras
translation:
布莱克：

和往常一样，我需要医疗物资。你可以信任把这个便条带给你的人并将东西交给他。我知道我知道。你要下次订货的付款，我这几天会弄妥的。

——坎特雷拉斯
霍斯泰特勒终端机记录3

I had an amazing time last night, Don. Aren't you glad you decided to stay late? :-) Can't wait to do it again.

xoxo

收件人：唐·霍斯泰特勒

唐，昨晚真是妙不可言。相信你也对晚点走的决定感到很开心吧？:-)我真忍不住想再做一次。

吻你，抱你

original: I've finally found some of the bodies of the scientists that lived here. They appear to be overgrown with some form of lichen. They blend in so well with the other growth that I walked right by several of them without even noticing them. I've taken the proper precautions, but the lichen doesn't seem to be contagious, at least to Ghouls.
translation: 我终于找到了一些曾经住在这里的科学家们的尸体。他们身上似乎长满了某种苔藓。尸体和其他植物完全融为一体，我经过的时候几乎都没注意到。我已经采取了适当的防护措施，但苔藓看起来不具备传染性，至少对尸鬼来说是这样。

original: I've established a temporary camp inside the entrance of the vault. Power inside is minimal, but still running, and I've managed to hack into one of their security terminals. The logs show that several people have entered the vault over the past few months, but none have left. It's getting late, so I'll resume the expedition in the morning. Keely out.
translation: 我在避难所入口处建立了一个临时的营地。这里的电力在最低限度，但仍然在运转，我试着破解了他们的一个安保终端。日志显示最近几个月有些人进入了避难所，但没有人出去。时候不早了，因此我明早再继续探索。以上。

I'm recommending that they be separated from the general populace.
translation: 病号：伊莉莎白·贝利，玛莎·贝利，艾米·海耶斯·加菲尔德，赫尔曼，维罗妮卡·杰金斯，詹姆斯·凯耶斯，罗伯特·科克帕契克，阿曼达·罗里，唐纳德·奥兰多，艾里斯·帕米诺，斯蒂芬·拉多，尤兰达·雷耶斯，凯莉·萨金，尼古拉斯·巴尔德兹。\n\n更新：又一群伤寒、发烧并且剧烈咳嗽的人。我建议将他们与其他人隔离。
为售卖机器人起的新名字

original: Seriously, can we stop calling the Vendortron a "Vendortron?" Let's give the thing a proper name, like Bob (we're not calling it Bob). We'll vote on it at the end of the week. Please, please, please come up with something decent.
translation: 说真的，我们能不能不要再把自动贩卖机器人称作“自动贩卖机器人”？让我们给这东西起个合适的名字，比如说鲍勃（打个比方而已，不是真的要叫鲍勃）。这周末我们投票。拜托，拜托，请拿点像样的东西出来。

original: There are a few different vendors who sell snacks and meat. You might try Fitz. He has a small shop with a couple other merchants. Ruby Nash in Primm has some interesting items. Lastly, Crimson Caravan should be able to handle a good amount of supply for us. Try and convince them to trade for some of our overstock if you can. We need to reserve caps if possible.

original:

Hello Everybody,
I'm looking for volunteers for the External Association Committee. We have enough core personnel, but we can always use the extra hands. Michelle
translation:
发件人：米歇尔·达利安
收件人：*全体居民*

大家好：
我在寻找对外合作委员会的志愿者。我们已经有足够的核心成员了，但如果有更多的帮手我们求之不得。欢迎各位居民前来报名，我们也希望能够照顾到每一位甘愿牺牲个人时间的人。如果有意，请不用客气，与我联系，我将给您发一份会员申请表。

original:
From: George Stault
To: Janet Kimper

Hi Janet,
How is the school year going so far? I've heard good things from your teachers. They say you are one of the top students in your class.
Your birthday is tomorrow, sweet 16 at last! Can you even believe it? It seems like yesterday my sister told me she was going to have a little girl. Do you have big plans for your birthday? I think if you are interested, I could talk to some folks and get the dining room reserved for a couple hours. Let me know if that sounds like fun and I'll start getting the ball moving.

Uncle George
translation:
发件人：乔治·斯塔尔特
收件人：珍妮特·吉姆帕

珍妮特：
这一学年过的怎样？我从你的老师那里听到了一些好消息，他们说你在班上名列前茅。
明天就是你的生日了，可爱的16岁！难以置信不是？感觉我姐姐告诉我她要有个女儿的事仿佛就是昨天刚发生的。你生日有没有什么大计划？我想如果你有兴趣的话，我可以让一些人预约餐厅用几个小时。如果这听起来不错的话，告诉我，我会去安排的。

乔治叔叔

original:
From: George Stault
To: *ALL RESIDENTS*

Greetings Everyone!
Thank you all for putting your trust in me. I am honored to serve as your Overseer for the next term, and hopefully beyond. I am going to do everything I can to get Michelle's committee outside as soon as possible. We'll get our water issues resolved, and form lasting bonds with our neighbors in the world outside.

Thanks again for putting your trust in me.
George Stault, Overseer
translation:
发件人：乔治·斯塔尔特
收件人：*全体居民*

大家好！
感谢大家对我抱有的信任。我很荣幸担任下一届的监督一职。我会做力所能及的每件事以让米歇尔的委员会尽快向外界发展。我们会解决我们的供水问题，并且和外界的邻居建立一个长久的联系。

再次感谢你们对我的信任。
监督乔治·斯塔尔特

original:
Incident: Broken Glass

Kevin dropped one of the glass tubes today while forming it. He ended up with a nasty cut on his hand from the broken glass. Fortunately no one else was hurt. I bandaged his hand and had him clean it up before sending him home. One more accident like that and I may have to let him go. Kid's too accident prone.

Incident: Elevator

One of the elevators to the upper loading dock broke down again. Unfortunately Johnathan was inside waiting to unload and the sudden stop caused one of the signs to slip of its pallet and it broke his leg. He'll be out for at least a month while it heals.
translation:
事件：碎玻璃

凯文今天在给一个玻璃试管成型时不慎将其掉落，碎玻璃在他的手上划了一个大口子。幸运的是没有其他人受伤，我给他手包扎了一下，然后让他先把东西收拾干净再回家。再来一次像这样的意外我估计就得让他离开了，孩子太容易惹祸了。

事件：电梯

通往上层装载码头的一个电梯又坏掉了。不幸的是乔纳森当时正在里面等待卸货，急停使得运货板上的一个招牌滑落了下来砸伤了他的腿。在腿伤痊愈前，他大概至少一个月都不能工作。

original: Not many patrols out here lately, which means not much loot. Our crew is thinking we should make a move soon. Follow the tracks up north; head towards the Strip. You in? Ain't on the chain gang anymore, but we still gotta stick together.
translation: 最近这里没什么巡逻的，也意味着没什么好抢的。我的人打算尽快动身。顺着小道北上；向赌城区进发。你来么？尽管我们不再是被捆在一起的囚犯了，但我们仍然要相互支持。
黑手党不和米克交易了

original: Mick from Mick & Ralph's says the Omertas stopped buying guns suddenly without giving a reason why. Maybe I should ask around and see if I can find out why.
translation: 米克和拉尔夫武器店的米克说黑手党无缘无故突然停止购买枪械了。或许我可以四处打听一下看是什么原因。

original: I'm having a competition to boost morale. Bring me an ear from every Legion you kill and I'll keep track at the mess hall. Only one ear per kill! \n\n-James Sexton
translation: 我正在参加一个举办来鼓舞士气的比赛。你每杀死一个军团成员都把耳朵割下来给我吧，我会在食堂等你的。记住每杀一个人只能割一只耳朵哦！\n\n——詹姆斯·塞克斯汀

original:
Here's what I need you to research.

1) Several casualty reports have come in saying that Alpha Station sustained heavy casualties and injuries in the vicinity of Hoover Dam - yet no new reinforcements have been sent in weeks. Speak with Senior Ranger Rebecca Lineholm, get an accurate casualty count and asses the situation, as several of us have been worried that something horrible is stalking the Hoover Dam area if it can claim NCR's elite Rangers.

2) Ranger Station Bravo hasn't requested a resupply in four months. While the Rangers I can reach on the radio say things are 'just fine' I need you to speak to Ranger Ericsen, the commanding officer, and find out how they've been running on no supplies for so long.

3) Charlie station received a substantial shipment of medical supplies despite having only a few serious injury reports. Check up on them and see if they have a surplus that could be redistributed to needed locations - I'm having a hard time getting anyone on the radio lately.

4) Delta station radioed in a report of an NCR Trooper cadre being murdered to the last man in a horrifying display of brutality. The report mentioned a squad of Super mutants wearing Caesar's colors. This report has unsettled NCR command I need you to speak to Senior Ranger Pason to confirm the report and get an accurate count of Super mutants spotted.

5) Echo Station has had a five-fold spike in reported enemy contacts, but NCR crews dispatched to follow up have a mere 10% success rate in intercepting these hostiles. The Ghouls I've reached by the radio insist everything is 'just fine' but the numbers disagree - so speak Senior Ranger Erasmus for me please. Perhaps they're short-handed and need more spotters.

6) Foxtrot station called in a report of an NCR Trooper patrol slaughtered by a Great Khan hunting team with trained Deathclaws. Senior Ranger Kudlow called in the report but I can't seem to contact her for a more detailed account of the incident - please to speak to her and confirm/deny this rather disturbing report.
translation:
我需要你帮忙调查以下几件事。

1) 最近有报告称游骑兵阿尔法驻站在胡佛大坝附近遭遇重大伤亡，但数星期过去仍没有得到增援。请你向高级游骑兵丽贝卡·莱霍姆了解具体伤亡数字，并且评估状况。如果NCR的精锐游骑兵都能遭到如此重大损失，我们担心胡佛大坝可能存在严重威胁。

2）游骑兵驻站布拉沃4个月来都没有申请物资补给。我通过电台联系到了该地的游骑兵，他们回答情况“还不错”，但我需要你和该驻站的指挥官埃里克森进行确认，弄清楚他们究竟是怎样在没有补给的情况下坚持那么长时间的。

3）游骑兵驻站查理最近只发生了几起重伤事故，却收到了大量的医疗物资。查一下他们的情况，看看他们有没有多余的药品可以重新分配给其他急需的地方——我最近很难通过无线电联系到他们。

4）游骑兵驻站德尔塔用无线电上报称有一支NCR精锐部队被残忍地全数歼灭。报告提到了一队身着凯撒军团服装的超级变种人。这份报告中还有未执行的NCR命令，我要你和高级游骑兵帕森谈谈，确定报告的真实性，并了解超级变种人部队的具体规模。

5）游骑兵驻站艾柯最近报告的遇敌数量多了整整五倍，但派出的NCR增援部队却只拦截到了10%左右的敌人。我用无线电联系了驻扎在那里的尸鬼，他们一口咬定情况“还不错”，但报告上的数字却存在出入。所以请替我向高级游骑兵伊拉斯谟了解情况。也许他们缺乏人手，需要更多的侦察人员。

6）游骑兵驻站狐步舞报告说有一支NCR巡逻队被驯养了死亡爪的大汗帮狩猎小队屠杀了。报告是高级游骑兵库德罗提供的，但我联系不到她，也无法确认袭击的具体细节。请务必向她求证这起令人不安的事件是否真实。

original:
Here's what I need you to research.

1) Several casualty reports have come in saying that Alpha Station sustained heavy casualties and injuries in the vicinity of Hoover Dam - yet no new reinforcements have been sent in weeks. Speak with Senior Ranger Rebecca Lineholm, get an accurate casualty count and asses the situation, as several of us have been worried that something horrible is stalking the Hoover Dam area if it can claim NCR's elite Rangers.

2) Ranger Station Bravo hasn't requested a resupply in four months. While the Rangers I can reach on the radio say things are 'just fine' I need you to speak to Ranger Ericsen, the commanding officer, and find out how they've been running on no supplies for so long.

3) Delta station radioed in a report of an NCR Trooper cadre being murdered to the last man in a horrifying display of brutality. The report mentioned a squad of Super mutants wearing Caesar's colors. This report has unsettled NCR command I need you to speak to Senior Ranger Pason to confirm the report and get an accurate count of Super mutants spotted.

4) Echo Station has had a five-fold spike in reported enemy contacts, but NCR crews dispatched to follow up have a mere 10% success rate in intercepting these hostiles. The Ghouls I've reached by the radio insist everything is 'just fine' but the numbers disagree - so speak Senior Ranger Erasmus for me please. Perhaps they're short-handed and need more spotters.

5) Foxtrot station called in a report of an NCR Trooper patrol slaughtered by a Great Khan hunting team with trained Deathclaws. Senior Ranger Kudlow called in the report but I can't seem to contact her for a more detailed account of the incident - please to speak to her and confirm/deny this rather disturbing report.
translation:
我需要你帮忙调查以下几件事。

1) 最近有报告称游骑兵阿尔法驻站在胡佛大坝附近遭遇重大伤亡，但数星期过去仍没有得到增援。请你向高级游骑兵丽贝卡·莱霍姆了解具体伤亡数字，并且评估状况。如果NCR的精锐游骑兵都能遭到如此重大损失，我们担心胡佛大坝可能存在严重威胁。

2）游骑兵驻站布拉沃4个月来都没有申请物资补给。我通过电台联系到了该地的游骑兵，他们回答情况“还不错”，但我需要你和该驻站的指挥官埃里克森进行确认，弄清楚他们究竟是怎样在没有补给的情况下坚持那么长时间的。

3）游骑兵驻站德尔塔用无线电上报称有一支NCR精锐部队被残忍地全数歼灭。报告提到了一队身着凯撒军团服装的超级变种人。这份报告中还有未执行的NCR命令，我要你和高级游骑兵帕森谈谈，确定报告的真实性，并了解超级变种人部队的具体规模。

4）游骑兵驻站艾柯最近报告的遇敌数量多了整整五倍，但派出的NCR增援部队却只拦截到了10%左右的敌人。我用无线电联系了驻扎在那里的尸鬼，他们一口咬定情况“还不错”，但报告上的数字却存在出入。所以请替我向高级游骑兵伊拉斯谟了解情况。也许他们缺乏人手，需要更多的侦察人员。

5）游骑兵驻站狐步舞报告说有一支NCR巡逻队被驯养了死亡爪的大汗帮狩猎小队屠杀了。报告是高级游骑兵库德罗提供的，但我联系不到她，也无法确认袭击的具体细节。请务必向她求证这起令人不安的事件是否真实。

original: The paperwork Aurelius of Phoenix gave me appears to list movement of troops, numbers of men in various strategic locations, and various communication with Caesar about raiding plans for the southern wastes of Nevada. Of course all of this information is outdated and prove counterproductive to the NCR's efforts to stop Legion raids in the region.

original:
I, Harry Collins, hereby declare sole proprietorship of vital essence and claim hereto all legitimate rights in defending said essence versus all comers, QED.

Town's been going to hell ever since Mayor Steyn waltzed in from out west saying he'd put Nipton on the map. Well, we know the real reasons he come to town. He come for my vital essence.

And then more come. The town's been growing by the day. All of them coming for my vital essence, as if I didn't know it.

And then more come. Asking questions like "Harry, why you spend all your time in that house of yours? You got something special in there?" Sniffing around for my essence is what they're doing.

I've had enough. I'm locking up my essence, and I'm setting up defenses. No one's going to get their hands on my vital essence except ol' Harry himself.

Come what may, 

Harry Collins
translation:
我，哈利·柯林斯，在此宣布对我的宝贝的独立占有权，并且我有权对觊觎我宝贝的混蛋采取任何必要的防御措施。

自从斯泰恩市长从西边游荡过来，号称自己可以让尼普顿天下扬名以来，镇上的事情就变得一团糟。当然了，我们都知道他过来的目的是什么。他来就是为了要我的宝贝的。

还没完呢。自从那天开始城镇就一直在扩张。他们都是为了我的宝贝来的，别以为我不知道。

然后还有很多人过来问“哈利，你干嘛一天到晚耗在屋子里呢？你那里有什么秘密吗？”他们这就是在到处打听关于我的宝贝的事情。

我已经受够了。我要把我的宝贝收起来，我还应该架起防御。除了伟大的哈利自己，没人可以染指我的宝贝。

有本事就来吧，

哈利·柯林斯

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sergeant Banner Reporting

Day 12

We managed to get the rest of the path cleared. Some Pre-War fencing was mostly intact, and we were able to set it up as a makeshift barrier, on the more dangerous cliffs. I hope none of these jarheads fall off. We found a few cave entrances, as we were clearing rubble. They lead back to each other, with just a single collapsed path which appears to lead down into the mountain. The damn survey team didn't mention any caves. I hope we don't find any more little surprises.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第十二天

我们把剩下的道路全都清理干净了。战前留下的围栏有一部分仍旧完好，我们把它们立了起来，在陡峭的悬崖边做了一些临时的屏障。希望这些士兵不会掉下去。我们在清理废墟的时候发现一些洞穴入口，它们是相互贯通的，只有一处崩塌的隧道似乎通往山里。该死的调查小组根本没有提到这儿还有个洞。希望不会再发现什么小惊喜。

original:
Camp Searchlight Comm Officer's Log 

After the radscorpion incident the night patrols were shifted again. This is the third time in the past month. I don't think they realize the problem isn't the patrols it's the troops. Every time their patrols get shifted they get confused and holes open up in the rotations for two or three days until they're used to the new schedules. I really hope the Legion doesn't figure it out and take advan...

SUDDEN TEMPERATURE INCREASE. EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN INITIATED.
translation:
探照灯营地通讯官日志

在辐射蝎事故之后巡逻的路线又再次改变了。这已经是这个月的第三次了。我想他们还是不明白问题不出在巡逻路线上，而是巡逻的人员身上。每次巡逻路线改变，他们好几天内都会因为不适应而留下很多疏漏。但愿军团的人不会发现并且利用这一点……

温度突然升高。紧急关闭启动。

original: Dear Diary,\n\nI took a chance today and left the animals alone to go look for Mom and Dad. I found them in that camp, they had become horrible Feral Ghouls! I didn't know what to do, they came at me so fast. Oh god what have I done...
translation: 亲爱的日记，\n\n我今天冒险丢下了动物，去找我的爸爸妈妈了。我在营地找到了他们，他们全部都变成了可怕的疯狂僵尸！我不知道我该怎么办，他们朝我扑过来得好快。天哪，我都干了些什么……

original: Dear Diary,\n\nI hate being all alone, I want my Mom and Dad back, but I can't have them back because I killed them. I didn't want to kill them but I had to kill them, otherwise they would have eaten me. I hope the animals don't eat me. Can animals become Ghouls?
translation: 亲爱的日记，\n\n我讨厌独自一个人，我想要爸爸妈妈回来，但是我又不能让他们回来，因为我已经把他们傻掉了。我并不想杀他们，但是我不得不这么做，要不然他们就会吃掉我的。我希望那些动物不会吃掉我。动物也会变成僵尸吗？

original: Dear Diary,\n\nThe animals, they are evil. They tried to eat me in my sleep. They want the farm for themselves. Now that Mom and Dad are gone they want the farm for themselves. They are plotting against me, plotting to eat me. They are becoming Ghouls like my parents and they want to eat me like my parents did. Too many of them to kill them all. I know what I'll do, I'll burn the house down around me, then the animals can't eat me because there will be nothing left for them to eat!
translation: 亲爱的日记，\n\n那些动物，它们好邪恶。它们想要在我睡觉时吃掉我。它们想要自己霸占农田。现在爸爸妈妈不在了，它们就想把农田据为己有。它们计划着要对付我，计划着要把我吃掉。它们就像爸爸妈妈那样快要变成僵尸了，它们会像我的邻居那样想要吃掉我的。它们数量太多了，根本杀不完。我知道我在做些什么，我要把我周围的房子全烧掉，这样那些动物就不会吃我了，因为它们根本就没东西可以吃了！

original:
TO GENERAL OLIVER (or highest-ranking survivor)

TO THE NCR PRESIDENT

TO THE NCR COUNCIL

FROM ROBERT EDWIN HOUSE

As Chief Executive of the Free Economic Zone of New Vegas, I hereby demand the IMMEDIATE WITHDRAWAL of all NCR military personnel from New Vegas and its surrounding territories.

a) Yes, "all military personnel" includes NCR Rangers.

b) "New Vegas and its surrounding territories" includes (but is not limited to) Hoover Dam, McCarran International Airport, HELIOS One, and the El Dorado Substation.

IT IS IMPORTANT TO NOTE that my vast army of heavily-armed Securitrons has been rather inflexibly programmed to respond to acts of aggression with overwhelming force. 

a) For examples of "heavily-armed" and "overwhelming force," I will refer you to the pitiless campaign of extermination my Securitrons will have visited upon Caesar's Legion by the time you are reading this document. 

b) Any NCR military personnel who do not withdraw from New Vegas and its territories will be seen as committing an "act of aggression."

NCR civilians are NOT subject to this order of withdrawal! They may visit New Vegas freely, enjoying all that the Vegas Strip has to offer!

So long as NCR military personnel comply with this order to withdraw, electricity and water will continue to flow from Hoover Dam to the NCR. 

a) Electricity: 5 caps per kilowatt hour.

b) Water: 5 caps per gallon

The NCR Council's Office of Budget will receive invoices bi-weekly. Prices are subject to change without notice.

Cordially, 

Robert Edwin House
Chief Executive
Free Economic Zone of New Vegas
translation:
致奥利弗将军（或是最高领导人）

致NCR总统

致NCR议会

罗伯特·埃德温·豪斯敬上

作为新维加斯自由经济区的首席执行官，我特此要求所有NCR军事人员从新维加斯及其周边地区撤出。

a)没错，“所有NCR军事人员”，包括NCR游骑兵在内。

b)“新维加斯及其周边地区”包括（但不限于）胡佛大坝、麦卡伦国际机场、太阳神一号、以及埃尔多拉多变电站。

请务必记住这一点，我庞大的重装机器保安军团是被设计来专门以强势的火力应对任何入侵行为的。

a)为了给我的“重装军团”和“强势火力”做一个示范，在你们阅读这份文件时，我将会在那些可怜的凯撒军团身上做一个小小的实验。

b)任何不从新维加斯极其领地撤出的NCR军事人员都被认为是“入侵行为”。

NCR平民不受此命令限制！他们可以自由出入新维加斯，享受新维加斯赌城区带来的一切服务！

只要NCR军事人员遵从这份撤出指令，水和电力就会源源不断地从胡佛大坝送到NCR。

a)电力：每千瓦时5瓶盖。

b)水：每加仑5瓶盖。

NCR议会的预算办公室每个星期都会收到一份账单。价格调整恕不另行通知。

真诚的，

罗比特.埃德温.豪斯
新维加斯自由经济区
首席执行官

original: Entry Two in the Die-ary of Trash
translation: 拉基的死亡笔记，第二篇

original: Dear Die-ary,\nI've been in this shack for almost a week now. Nothing is happening. I'm so bored. And this shack is so hot. And it's totally ruining my hair. It's like, so hard to find dye this color in the wasteland. This sucks, I want to be a Ghoul now. I hate all this waiting. Life, ugh, living is so overrated.
translation: 亲爱的日记，\n我在这个小屋中待了有一周了，结果什么事都没发生。我无聊透了，这个屋子也热得要命，我的头发算是彻底完了。在这荒郊野外很难找到染发的原料。糟透了，我想立刻变成一个尸鬼。我厌倦了等待。生活，呕，生活是如此无趣。

original: Entry Three in the Die-ary of Trash
translation: 拉基的死亡笔记，第三篇

original: Dear Die-ary,\nGood news Die-ary! I think it's finally starting to happen. Ok, so I do feel like, totally miserable (what else is new ha-ha-ha) and my skin is starting to peel off, but I'm pretty sure that is the first step. Oh, and my hair! I finally got it just the way I like it and now it starts coming out. Why does Ghoulification have to be so unfair?
translation: 亲爱的日记，\n好消息！我感觉变化终于开始了。好吧，我确实觉得，非常痛苦（反正也不新鲜了哈哈哈），我的皮肤开始剥落，但我非常肯定这是第一步。噢，还有我的头发！我终于如愿以偿，新生活很快就要来临了。为什么老天总是把他人变成尸鬼！

original: Entry One in the Die-ary of Trash
translation: 拉基的死亡笔记，第一篇

original: Dear Die-ary,\nI'm so done being confined in this human body. So, today I moved in to the shack at the abandoned test site. There should be enough radiation there to turn me into a Ghoul. All around me this world is bleak and dreadful; is it so wrong to want a body to match it? I wonder what color my skin will turn and if I'll be able to find a good shade of lipstick to go with it. Probably not. God, everything is so miserable.
translation: 亲爱的日记，\n我不愿继续被禁锢在这副人类的躯壳中，所以今天我搬到了这个废弃核试验场的小屋里，这里应该有足够的辐射可以把我变成尸鬼。我周围尽是凄凉和恐惧，难道想要一个与之相配的身体是错的吗？我想知道我的皮肤会变成什么颜色，或许我能找到一支口红来配它。大概是不能吧。天啊，一切都是如此悲惨。

original: I saw one of the guys in the mess hall pull a bottle cap off a Sunset Sarsaparilla and then run to his room. I knew he was hiding something so I broke into his room when he wasn't there and saw the bottle cap. It had a blue star underneath it. I think he's been marked for something but I can't figure out what. All I know is I want that bottle cap.
translation: 我在食堂看到一个家伙拿出一瓶夕阳沙士汽水接着跑回了他的房间。我知道他在藏什么东西，于是我趁他不在时闯进了他的房间并找到了一个瓶盖。瓶盖底有一个蓝色星星。我知道他一定是想要做什么但是我不知道具体的情况。我只知道我应该把那个瓶盖拿走。

original:
DELIVER STATION Camp Forlorn Hope
FOR Polatli, Joseph (Major) OR HIGHEST RANKING OFFICER

Major, 

This is to inform you that a small sniper nest has been successfully set up near Cottonwood Cove as requested. The nest should have some bedding and a small amount of supplies, but no weaponry.

The sniper should be forewarned that the position is close to the enemy camp and upon completing his or her objective, should get the fuck out of there as soon as flamingly possible. 

The coordinates are: 12, -22

Good luck and good hunting.

Signed,
De Leon, David
Field Preparations Division
translation:
递交给“一线生机”营地站
呈至波拉特里.约瑟夫（少校）或是最高指挥官

少校，

特此通知你我们需要在棉花丛湾附近设立一个狙击点。狙击点需要配备床位和少量的补给，不过不需要武器。

狙击手必须收到事先警告了解该位置距离敌人营地非常近，一旦完成任务就应该尽可能快的离开那里。

位置坐标是：12，-22

祝你好运，也祝你狩猎愉快。

署名，
德列翁.大卫
战地准备分部

original: A Tragedy Has Befallen All Mankind

Robert Edwin House, 261, President, CEO, and sole proprietor of the New Vegas Strip, industrialist and technologist, founder, President, and CEO of the multi-billion-dollar Pre-War robotics and software corporation, RobCo Industries, has died.

Generally recognized by Mr. House to be mankind's only hope of long-term survival, Mr. House's passing may well sound a death knell for the entire human race. 

Lost forever is his bounty of knowledge concerning human longevity, the depth and breadth of which could, as he was apt to say, "fill several text books." He was not exaggerating. Though he did not achieve his goal of functional immortality, let us not forget that he died at the age of 261. How many people do that? I mean, come on.

Also lost forever are House's singular personality, force of will, vision, and leadership ability. The probability of an equally capable figure emerging from the current human population to lead mankind to a future of equivalent quality is less than 0.000112% by objective measures too complex to detail in this obituary.

Personality and force of will: Born June 25th, 2020, House was orphaned at an early age when his parents died in a freak accident (auto gyro, lightning). Though cheated of his inheritance, House attended the prestigious Institute in Massachusetts and founded RobCo Industries on his 22nd birthday. Within five years, it was one of the most profitable corporations on Earth.

Vision: By 2065, House was certain that an atomic war would soon devastate the planet. At great personal expense, he developed technologies to ensure the structural integrity of the city of Las Vegas (as it was known at the time). On the day of the great war, 77 atomic warheads targeted the city. Mr. House defeated them all. Talk about vision!

Leadership: Mr. House survived the war, of course, and would later recruit the Three Families, negotiate the Treaty of New Vegas, and rebuild the Vegas Strip. While these achievements yielded many immediate benefits, they were all part of House's master plan to re-ignite mankind's quest for technological advancement, a plan without which the human race has nowhere to go, and nowhere to turn.

translation:
新维加斯长街总裁、首席执行官与全资所有人，实业家、科学家，总价值数十亿美元的战前机器人与软件研发公司罗科工业创始人、总裁与首席执行官，罗伯特·埃德温·豪斯，于今日不幸离世，享年261岁。

豪斯先生曾被视作人类文明延续的唯一希望，他的辞世也许是为全人类敲响了丧钟。

与他一同逝去的还有他在延续人类寿命方面取得的丰硕成果，以他本人说法，其内容之广博“足以写满好几本书。”他并非夸大其词，请不要忘记，尽管他未能实现永生的理想，但他活了261岁。有多少人能做到？得了吧，根本没有。

豪斯先生非凡的个性、坚韧的意志、他的远见卓识和领导能力也将后无来者。据客观分析，在当今世界中，只有不到0.000112%的概率才有可能再诞生一位与他能力相当、且能带领人类步入相同发展轨道的人物。由于测算方式过于复杂，在此不予详述。

个性和意志：豪斯出生于2020年6月25日，从小就是孤儿，他的父母在一场离奇的事故中丧生（旋翼机被闪电击中）。豪斯尽管继承了巨额遗产，但他还是考入了著名的麻省理工学院，并在自己的22岁生日那天创办了罗科工业。他仅用了五年时间就让罗科成了地球上最赚钱的公司。

远见：2065年时，豪斯预计核战争将会毁灭地球。于是他耗费大量资金开发出了能够保全拉斯维加斯（即现在的新维加斯）城市结构完整的科技。大战爆发时，有77枚核弹头瞄准了这座城市，但它们全都被豪斯先生拦截了下来。这便是他的高瞻远瞩！

领导力：豪斯先生自然从核战中幸存了下来，之后，他召集了三大家族，签订了《新维加斯协定》，并重建了维加斯长街。这些举措很快为他带来了大量利益，但它们只是豪斯先生实现人类科技复兴的庞大计划中的一部分。如果没有这个计划，人类文明就将失去未来、失去方向。

original: Chief Fire Officer Report No. F1-218\n\nThe local police department diverted several trucks from San Onofre carrying nuclear waste to Searchlight this morning. I didn't get all of the details but I heard something about bombs going off nearby and that the trucks were being diverted for safety reasons. Two of them were housed here at the Fire Station. The third had to continue on to somewhere else because we didn't have enough room to accommodate them all. For some odd reason it was headed toward Cottonwood Cove. I don't know what he's planning on doing with it down there.
translation: 消防总长报告No.F1-218\n\n当地警察部门今早拦下了几个从圣奥诺弗雷运送核废料到探照灯营地来的卡车。我没有获知全部详情，不过我听说附近遭到了轰炸，这些卡车因为安全考虑被转移了。其中两个被停在这个消防站里。由于我们没有足够的空间接待全部，因此第三辆卡车继续出发前往其他地点。奇怪的是它竟然驶向了棉花丛之谷。我不知道这其中有什么猫腻。

original: Johnson, I've come across a crate with a couple of suits made of a material I don't even recognize. Do you know what the hell this is? Looks like Pre-War tech to me. The eggheads we have down here are mostly glorified mechanics, so they just scratched their heads when I showed it to them.
translation: 约翰逊，我发现了一个箱子，里面装着几套衣服，是用一种我不知道的材料制成的。你知道是什么吗？我看它们像战前科技。这儿负责技术的家伙大多是徒有其名，我把这玩意拿给他们看，他们也只会挠头。
一级士官阿斯特的日志

original: First Sergeant Astor's Log\n\nEverything is upside down now, all of my superiors are gone and there's no one left but myself and a handful of soldiers. I've been following a strict patrol schedule since the incident, making sure to cover the roads leading into Camp Searchlight. I like to keep myself moving in order to catch any wayward travelers who may not know the dangers that now lurk within the town. I don't think I could forgive myself if someone got past me and went into that hell hole of a place. So far I've been able to maintain enough energy that I'm never away from any point on my patrol for long. I wonder how long before I can't keep going anymore?
translation: 阿斯特上士的日志\n\n现在大势已去了，我现在什么都没有了，只有一小部分士兵还在我身边。自事件发生之后我就一直严格遵守巡逻的时间安排，确保通往探照灯营地的道路安全。我必须一直行动才不会放走那些对潜伏在城镇中的危险一无所知的固执旅行者。如果有人从我这里通过径直走向地狱的话，我是没法原谅我自己的。到目前为止我还能保持精神饱满，确保巡逻路线上没一点都能照顾到。但是我怀疑自己到底还能坚持多久。

original: Got the weapons and the mines in today, along with the shotguns and the ammo, enough to defend the Villa if trouble breaks out. Sinclair's taking the world situation seriously, even all the way out here... maybe more so because we're out here. \n\nHate to think if someone got their hands on half the stuff we have stored here. Enough military ordnance here to turn the Villa into a mine field.
translation: 今天我收到了枪支和地雷，还有霰弹枪和弹药，足以在危机爆发时防御别墅区了.即使身在此处，辛克莱始终在密切关注世界局势，或许正因如此我们到这鸟不拉屎的地方来建什么赌场.\n\n我都不敢想，哪怕有人只是拿走了一半的武器储备，也足以将别墅区变为雷场了

original: One good thing about this assignment - no more writing parking tickets. Sinclair's laid out the streets so narrow, cars can't even come into the Villa. Resources being what they are, he may not want folks to waste gas coming here. Cuts down on traffic noise, too. Chief says it's more than that, says Sinclair wanted the Villa to be "reclusive." \n\nLong as I don't have to worry about double-parking snobs or Chryslus gas-hogs clogging the Villa, I couldn't care less. Wonder how he expects folks to get here, though. Seems extreme, even for privacy.
translation: 干这活有一个好处，就是不用再开停车罚单了。辛克莱把街道布置得很窄，车子根本开不进来。毕竟资源宝贵，他可能想让人们少浪费一点汽油，也可以减少一些交通噪音。警长说不仅如此，辛克莱还希望这个别墅区可以“遗世独立”。 \n\n只要不用操心那些乱停车的小市民以及大排量的克莱斯勒汽车堵塞街道，这些事情我都无所谓。可他要让客人怎么到这儿来呢？哪怕是为了与世隔绝，也做得有点过了吧。

original:
October 28th
Five days on foot, still can't sleep. 

Outside it's like nothing happened. Sky looks wrong, that's all.

Hike back to overturned NatGuard truck near Toquerville? After blisters heal, maybe.

Looks like USGS team was researching something here in cave. Cleared out when bombs fell, left equipment behind. Probably thought they had families to run back to.

October 29th
Char, must've said this out loud a thousand times walking here. Maybe writing it will feel more like you heard. 

You were right.

I was north of Spanish Fork. Took the 77 along Provo Bay to steer clear of town. Would've been home in an hour. Engine died, truck just stopped. So did a Chryslus in other lane. Knew right away. 

First nuke hit SLC inside a minute. I was looking South - Lucky Man! Flash behind me so bright world looked on fire. Old couple from the Chryslus starts screaming they can't see.

Didn't watch you die, Char. Saved my eyes. Counted 12 more flashes next 7 minutes. Ground shook each time, 18 seconds later. 

When nothing hit for half hour, took a look. Globe of fire where you and Alex died. Didn't kid myself. 

Didn't know what to do. Grabbed my pack and rifle. 

Saw to the old couple. Sat them up against car, let them hold and comfort each other. Told them I was going to get help, everything be okay. One bullet through both heads. Instant. 

Five day hike back to Zion. 

You told me. Stop running off to the wild. Man belongs with his family. 

You were right. You were right. You were right. You were right. Wasn't there to hold you and my boy. Died without me. Never touch you or him again.

Should shoot myself. What I deserve. 

Can't. Maybe soon.

October 31st
Black rain falling outside. Geiger jumping. Should let it kill me but bottling water from back of cave all the same.

November 2nd
Sounds dead outside, but can't look. Geiger goes lethal 15 feet from cave mouth. 

Do the math. Radiation goes down before water runs out or I never leave this cave.
translation:
10月28日
走了五天，始终无法入睡。

外面看起来很平静。天色有些不对劲，仅此而已。

返回托凯维尔附近那辆掀翻的国民卫队的货车那儿？水泡消了再考虑吧。

地质调查局的队伍似乎在洞穴里研究什么东西。核弹落下的时候里面的人已被疏散，只剩下一些装备。估计他们都回到自己家人那里去了。

10月29日
夏儿。一路走来我大概已经反复念了上千次。写下来，更觉得仿佛你能听见。

你说的对。

我沿着西班牙餐叉的北部，普若佛湾旁的77号公路驶离城镇。本来1小时内就可以到家。可引擎熄火了，无法发动。另一条巷子里，一辆克莱斯勒同样如此。我好像明白了什么。

没到一分钟，第一枚核弹落在盐湖城。当时我正望着南方。真是好运气！背后的光芒如此明亮，整个世界就好像被点着了。克莱斯勒里出来的老夫妇放声尖叫--他们看不见东西了。

夏尔，抱歉，我没有看着你死去，只有这样我才不会被强光刺瞎。7分钟内，12次闪光，也许更多。每次都伴着地面的摇晃，中间间隔18秒。

核弹攻击停止半小时后，我看了一眼。在你和艾利克斯死去的地方，只有一团熊熊烈火。我都没法骗自己什么了。

不知道该干什么。拿起包，掏出步枪。

看了一眼老夫妇。帮他们靠在车旁，让他们依靠在一起，相互慰籍。我告诉他们我去寻找帮助，别担心。随后一枪打爆了他俩的脑袋。

花了五天，徒步走回锡安。

你告诉过我。别再向往什么冒险了。人总是要回家的。

说的对。说的对。说的对。说的对啊。你们死的时候，我不在场，没能在那儿搂着你，搂着我的孩子。再也没有机会了。

应该毙了自己。活着，我不配。

无法下手。以后吧。

10月31号
外面下着黑色的雨。盖格计数器闪动着。本可能就这么死去。可是洞后面还有瓶装水。

11月2号
外面死般寂静。没办法出去看看。盖格计数器在离洞口15英尺远处就显示了致命程度的辐射。

算了算，如果水喝光之前辐射仍无法减弱，我就再别想离开这个山洞。

original:
June 14th
Just got back. Tired. Good scrounging along the way. Ended up dragging back a cart of stuff.

Write tomorrow. Sleep.

June 15th
Departed April 10th. Walk to SLC took 15 days. Would've been 7-9 back in the old days, but had to circle pockets of radiation and foraged along way.

Don't know what I was thinking. Imagined I'd find my house, dig through rubble, find - something. Your bones I hoped, and Little Nut's. Would've buried them. Here in Zion maybe.

SLC is mostly craters. Warped steel girders where highrises sat. Mounds of bricks.

Never found our house. Didn’t even find street. What wasn’t a crater was scorched clean. 

Want to believe it was fast, a flash, both of you vaporized. Lies to make me feel better. I'll never know. Which part of city got hit first? Northeast and you both died in a blink. Farther away and you burned alive screaming or the blast broken glass and bits of brick and wood splinters shredding you like hamburger. Look at it coward and listen don't turn away face it. If you'd been brave lucky man you would've found a spot and blown your brains out.

But not you. You took your time walking back, made a shopping trip of it. Scrounger.

The truck was still there on the 77 north of Spanish Fork. The Chryslus too, but no sign of the old couple's bones.

Outside Nephi I caught a trail. Three men, tracks heading toward Fountain Green. Thought about following but didn't. Stupid fantasy of friends, more likely cannibals.

June 20th
Took two days to build door and electrify it.

No soliciting, assholes. Home sweet fucking home.
translation:
6月14日
终于回来了。筋疲力尽。沿路好好地探查了一番，拉回来一大箱东西。

明天再写。睡了。

6月15日
4月10号出发。15天到盐湖城。以前的话7到9天就够了。如今必须避开辐射区，还得沿途找食充饥。

不知道一路都在想些什么，想象着当我回到家、在瓦砾中挖掘，试图……找到什么。希望是你的，或者小纳特的遗骨，我好埋起来。也许就埋在此地，锡安。

盐湖城一片坑坑洼洼。原先高楼林立的地方只剩下弯曲变形的钢梁。砖瓦成山。

压根找不到我们的房子。甚至连街道都找不到。那一片简直一个样：弹坑，烧得一干二净。

我试图说服自己，只是一瞬、光芒一闪，你们俩便消弭于人世。谎言多少使我好受了些。反正我永远也没法知道，核弹究竟最先在什么地方落下。如果是东北部，你们俩眨眼间便死去；更远些的话，你们不是尖叫着被活活烧死，便是被碎玻璃、破砖片和尖木屑搅碎身体，像牛肉糜一样。噢胆小鬼，你竟拒绝面对这一切。你要是勇敢些，就应该一枪打爆自己的脑袋！

但你不是。你悠然而归，收获满满。像个捡破烂的。

西班牙餐叉以北的77号公路上，那卡车还那辆克莱斯勒停在一起。但那对老夫妇的尸骨却没了踪影。

在尼法县外发现了有人活动的迹象：三个人，朝绿泉方向去了。本想跟踪，但放弃了。不大可能是朋友，那不过是天真的一厢情愿。食人族的可能性倒还更高。

6月20日
花了两天，弄了扇门，然后通上电。

混蛋们，这里闭门谢客。这里是我的家，温馨的狗窝。

original:
August 22nd
10 sets of tracks 1/2 mile NE of canyon entrance. Barefoot???

August 23rd
Saw them through scope. Corpses walking around. Finally gone crazy. Dementia maybe.

August 24th
I'm not crazy, they're real. Goddammit they are real. 

Rushed me the moment they saw me, snarling like animals. They look like corpses but don't smell rotted. 

I'll be putting them out of their misery. Doing for them what I never could for myself. 

September 3rd
The last of them. All gone.
translation:
8月22日
山谷入口东南方1/2英里处发现10对脚印。赤脚？？？

8月23日
在瞄准镜里看到了他们。到处都是行尸走肉。我终于疯了。老年痴呆了吧。

8月24日
我没疯。他们是真的。该死，他们是真的。

他们看到了我，然后冲了过来，像野兽一样咆哮。他们看起来就像尸体一样，却没有腐烂的味道。

我会帮助他们从痛苦中解脱出来——这是我永远无法对自己做的。

9月3日
最后一个了。都死了。

original:
January 2nd 
I've been leaving notes for them, and gifts. 

They like the books. Started with stories but moved on to weapons manuals, medical books, practical stuff. 

In the notes, well it's embarrassing, almost like those cards people used to give to each other, everything sweet and loving. I tell them to read and to learn and to make the most of their new home. I tell them that I'm giving them Zion as a gift to make up for all the sorrows of their lives so far and all the sorrows man has visited on man. I tell them to be kind to each other and modest. I tell them never to hurt each other but that if someone else comes along and tries to hurt them to strike back with righteous anger. Stuff like that. I sign every note "The Father," because well, just because. 

January 18th
Have I mentioned that I'm dying? 

Mind's still sharp. Lungs are the problem. Might be cancer. Cough's been getting worse for months, finally there's blood in it. Getting harder to visit my little friends, breath's so short. 

I've given away most of what I own. They'll find the rest in the caves when they get a little older.

I don't want them to find me though. “The Father" is a broke-down old man? Disappointment.

It's time. I don't want another birthday.

January 23rd 
It's cold enough that I won't last long on the high mound up next to Red Gate. I think I've got enough breath left in me to make it. I'll just lie down and stare at the sky. Feels right.

I hope they'll do well. I hope no harm comes to them, from within or without. Did my best to prepare them with the last few notes. Said something kind about each one of them, what makes each one special. Told them The Father was pleased by their kind natures and that it would be up to them to handle things on their own from now on, that I'd be silent but still watching and still caring. 

Lying, then. Oh yes.

Lied to you, Char. And Alex. And Sylvie. Told you I'd be with you forever. But I wouldn't go back and unsay it once if I could. 

What was the point of it all? So many failures. 

But I never forgot your face. Or Little Nut's. Or (sorry) Sylvie's. They used to say that happened after a while but it never did for me. 

Maybe the only point of all this living was to keep those pictures in my head going for as long as I could. It was the only life I could give you. Not a day went by without.

It wasn't choice. I chose to die again and again. Just never did. Body had its own drive.

Well, the little ones will need it. Species will need it if it's to continue. That blind drive onward. 

I wish them well. It's been a gift to me, at the end of it all, to behold innocence. 

Goodbye, Zion. 

Randall Dean Clark
Feb 5th, 2053 - Jan 2124
translation:
1月2日
我给他们留了纸条和礼物。

他们喜欢书。开始是故事书，可后来又喜欢上了武器手册、医疗常识一类的实用书。

关于那些纸条，说起来真有些尴尬，就像是人们用来表达爱意的那种卡片。我告诉他们，读书、学习，然后为了伙伴造一个新家。我告诉他们，我把锡安赠予他们，以补偿他们生命中的悲伤，补偿人们相互之间业已造成的悲伤。我告诉他们，要相爱，要虔诚。我告诉他们，永远不要兄弟阋墙；但是，若有人不怀好意，则必以正义之怒回击之。大致如此。每张纸条我都会署上“教父” 。因为……呃，事实嘛。

1月18日
我说过我快要死了么？

思路还算清晰。关键是肺。可能是癌症吧。咳嗽一天比一天严重，最后都咳出了血。呼吸越来越困难，很难再去见那些小伙伴了。

我基本上已经把自己的东西全部给了他们。等他们长大了，会在洞里找到剩下的。

可是不想让他们找到我。“教父”只是个风烛残年的家伙？多令人失望啊。

时候到了。我大概活不到下一个生日了。

1月23日
天很冷，我现在在红门旁边的土堆上待在，可我估计撑不了多久了。我也就剩这么一口气了——躺下来，看看蓝天白云。也还不错。

我希望他们能好好活下去。希望没有人——不管来自内部还是外部——去伤害他们。我已经尽力给他们写了几张纸条。我对他们中的每一个人都说了些安慰话，让每个人都觉得自己是特别的。我告诉他们，“教父”很高兴他们有善良的本性。我告诉他们，从今以后，他们要自己面对未来的一切。我告诉他们，我再也不能和他们谈心了，但我会一直注视着他们。

没错，骗人罢了。

夏儿，艾利克斯，西维尔，我骗了你们。我们说好要永远在一起。可是如果再给我一次机会，我还会这么说。

到头来，一切又有什么意义呢。太多的失败了。

我永远忘不了你的模样。还有小纳特的。哦，抱歉，还有西维尔的。有人说记忆会随着时间慢慢被冲淡。不过，我是绝不会忘记的。

或许，我活着的唯一意义就是让过去的场景在脑中一幕幕回放。我只能通过这种方法才能和你们“生活”在一起了。没有一天不是如此。

没有选择。有很多次我都想去死，可一次也没能成功。身体自有其意志吧。

大概，那些小朋友们会需要，物种的延续会需要，这种盲目的，却又一往无前的意志。

愿他们安康。对我来说，这是一份礼物，让我在人生的终点，得以窥见真正的纯真。

永别了，锡安。

Randall Dean Clark
2053年2月5日-2124年1月

original: BEWARE - A VENGEFUL SPIRIT STALKS THESE CANYONS
translation: 注意 - 一个复仇的灵魂在这片峡谷徘徊

original:
If you are reading this message then do yourself a favor and turn and run straight out of this canyon. 

For near 11 months my people have been engaged in daily battle with an evil spirit of this place. Arriving February of last year with a party 118 strong, we were attacked by primitives and forced to defend ourselves. Whereupon something began killing us in wide numbers. We have done our absolute best to find and kill this thing, thinking it was a man because it uses our firearms against us and traps of all kinds. But no man could defy our efforts as this thing has. It is more evil than any man could be.

We have been reduced to just 34 of our number. We have lost six overseers before me. Some have perished from the sickness in their lungs we carried out of the Vault, but that number is small next to the count of friends this thing has murdered. 

Now that I am finally made overseer, we are leaving straight away and will not return. If you have come to this seeming paradise seeking the fresh water, abundant game, and shelter you suppose you will find here, do not be deceived. You will find only death here. Leave at once and put miles between you and this place.

May God have mercy on us all,

J. Hendricks
Overseer
V22 Expedition
translation:
如果你读到这条消息，我劝你赶快转身就跑。

将近11个月了，我们每天都在和一个看不见的恶魔战斗。去年2月我们刚来时还有118人，但紧接着我们就遭到了攻击，不得不进行自卫。那个不知道是什么的东西已经害死了我们很多人。我们觉得他可能是个人，因为他用人类的武器对付我们，而且会布置大量陷阱。我们竭尽全力寻找他，试图干掉他，但始终徒劳无功。相信这个世界上没有人比他更邪恶了。

我们现在只剩下34人了。我们已经失去了6位避难所监督。有几位是从避难所里出来后患上肺病死的，但这和被那东西杀死的人比少得多了。

我现在终于成了监督，我们准备离开这个鬼地方，再也不回来。如果你来这个地方想寻找避难的天堂，那么我劝你别做梦了，这里没有新鲜的水源，没有灿烂的阳光，只有死亡，无尽的死亡。赶快离开这里，越远越好。

愿上帝保佑我们，

J. 亨德里克斯
避难所监督
22号避难所探险队

original: Day 4, still continuing research... found way to deactivate collar after some failures, just a few headless Ghouls. It's been hard to go fishing in the camp without one of them trying to run the gate and their heads exploding. Damn collars, twitchy.\n\n...need to ration the Mentats, giving me migraines.
translation: 第四天，研究仍在继续…在几次失败之后找到了关闭项圈的方法，代价不过是几只无头尸鬼。在营地里根本没法静下心来研究，那些尸鬼一有机会就想往门外跑，然后把自己的头炸掉。该死的项圈，真他妈烦。\n\n…曼他特得少吃点了，弄得我偏头痛。
二等兵福斯特的个人日记

original: Jesus, this place is a hellhole. I heard it was bad from some of the guys coming back, but... Jesus. Henriksen bought it when one of those unexploded warheads went off, and Jenkins... those things got him. I don't know what they were exactly - Ghouls, maybe, but nasty fuckers. LT thinks they were drawn by the explosion that killed Henriksen. I think we're all gonna die here.
translation: 天啊，这地方简直就是个地狱。我从一些回来的家伙那里听说情况很糟糕，但是...上帝啊。亨里克森被一颗未爆炸的核弹送了命，詹金斯...那些东西抓住了他。我不知道他们到底是什么，也许是尸鬼，但都是些混蛋。他们是被炸死亨里克森的爆炸吸引来的，我想我们都会死在这里。

original: Initial recon of the Divide has met with heavy resistance. These Ghouls - the troopers have started calling them "Marked Men" - are smarter than the typical ferals we're used to. Yesterday we found some old Pre-War cages they've used to capture Deathclaws - God knows what they were planning to do with them, but one of the things must have escaped, judging from the carnage. I've ordered double watches until we find it.
translation: 对大裂谷的初步侦察遭遇了严重的阻力。这些尸鬼...士兵们开始称他们为“烙印者”，比我们所习惯的典型的狂尸鬼更聪明。昨天我们发现了一些旧的战前笼子，他们用来抓死亡爪...天知道他们打算怎么处理它们，但从屠杀的场面来看，肯定有个家伙跑出来了。我已经安排了双倍警戒，直到找到为止。

original: If you find this, my name is James Rubinek. I'm a trader from the Hub - thought I'd found a new route to markets east. Guess now I know why no routes go through this Godforsaken place. Leg's broken, can't get out, and even if I could there's those crazed Ghouls and those digging things waiting for me.\n\nPlease, get this note to my ex-wife, Anna. Tell her what happened. Tell her how I died. And I guess you can tell that cheating bitch I hope she's happy with that limp-dick Rory Spencer.
translation: 如果你看到这个，我叫詹姆斯·鲁比内克。我是中枢市的商人，我以为我找到了一条通往东方市场的新路线，现在我知道为什么没有路线经过这该死的地方了。腿断了，出不去了，即使我能出去也有那些疯狂的尸鬼和挖洞的东西在等着我。\n\n求你了，把这张纸条给我前妻安娜。告诉她发生了什么，告诉她我是怎么死的。我猜你还可以告诉那个出轨的婊子我希望她和那个瘸子罗里·斯宾塞在一起会开心。

original: Somebody from the Political Office should keep an eye on those guys down at the water treatment plant. That's the third request for extra funds I've had to deny this month - do they think we're made of money? I swear, it's like they want the Communists to win...
translation: 政务处的人应该盯紧那些水处理厂的家伙。这是这个月我不得不拒绝的第三次额外资金申请了，他们认为我们有钱吗 ? 我发誓，他们好像是想让共产党赢...

original:
He threw me in here! I cant believe he did it but that boltbrain foreman psychopath locked me in a closet!

A goddamn 17 minute break!? That's why it threw me in here!?

…

Its been a day, and that stupid robot hasn't even checked on me! I cant wait until the next time he opens that door, I'm going to brain him with this auto-stapler and then escape. This story will be front page news so fast that he'll have been reassigned with toaster duty by the time he sees it!

…

Day 3 and I'm running out of what little edible supplies there are, they dragged another guy in here as well, says his name is Seth from R&D. Apparently its now against company policy to leave the toilet seat up in the unisex bathrooms. 

We've come up with a plan that wont fail! We’ll be out of here in no time... but for now we play the waiting game.
translation:
他把我扔在这里！我不相信他会这么做，但那个脑袋被门夹过的疯子把我锁在了厕所里！

休息了他妈的17分钟？那就是把我扔在这里的理由？

?

已经一天了，那白痴机器人还没来找我！我等不下去了，除非他下次来开门时我用自动订书机敲他的头之后再离开。这件事情会上报纸的头版，而当他看见这个头条的时候也就是他被分配去和烤面包机一起工作的时候！

?

第三天了，我这里仅剩的一点补给快吃完了，他们又拖了另一个家伙来这里，他是研发部的塞思。显然他是因为违法公司政策，没有放下男女公用盥洗室的马桶坐板。

我们有了一个保险的计划！我们马上就要离开这里了……但现在我们必须继续这个等待“游戏”。
