original:
From: Scribe Elizabeth Jameson
To: Elder Lyons

Elder,

I have read the recent reports on the number of Paladins and Knights that have not reported in when expected. I understand the chaotic nature of the situation in the field, but tradition demands that each Brother who falls in battle have their death recorded in the Scrolls. To not put forward our best effort to recover proof of who has fallen and who has lived is unthinkable.

I understand that every Brother is needed for the efforts here at the Citadel and in the city nearby. To that end, I intend to contract with outsiders in order to recover proof of which of our brethren have fallen to the enemy. I will ask that they recover dog tags from any fallen brother that the find. It is the least we can do without the resources for a full and honorable funeral for them.

You needn't worry about providing rewards for these contractors. I will pay them from my personal funds. It is well worth it to me to be able to both keep the tradition and not stress the resources for your mission.

Yours In Steel,

Scribe Elizabeth Jameson
Head Librarian
Order of the Quill
DC Bunker
translation:
发信人：伊丽莎白·简姆森文士
收信人：里昂斯长老

长老，

我读过了最近的报告，许多骑士和圣骑士没有按预期的那样返回报道。我理解这片区域现在混乱的形势，但根据我们的传统，每一位在战斗中牺牲的兄弟，在名册里都有他们的死亡记录。不尽我们最大的努力去查明那些牺牲和幸存下来的人，这是不可接受的。

我知道目前大本营这里和附近城区的工作需要每一位兄弟的力量。为此，我打算找一些外人签订合约，让他们去查明那些牺牲在敌人手下的兄弟们。我让他们找到牺牲的兄弟之后，就把遗体上的狗牌带回来给我。这是在不消耗资源的情况下，为他们举行的完整而光荣的葬礼，我们能做的也只有这样了。

你不用担心该如何慰劳这些合约人。我会用自己的钱来支付他们。这么做对我来说也很有意义，既延续了我们的传统，同时在你任务所需资金的问题上也不会有压力。

你的兄弟，

伊丽莎白·简姆森文士
图书管理员组长
羽毛勋位
特区地堡

It is complete with misleading tips about wasteland dangers, rambling notes about mutated creatures, and laughably naive suggestions about rebuilding humanity.

Although it suggests that it is written for the hardcore survivalists and "tough as nails" enthusiast, following its advice would be an invitation to a tragic end.

作者：莫伊拉·布朗
研究助理：&PCName;

这本多余的指南充斥着危险的对野外求生的误导信息。

它包括了许多对废土危险性的错误提示，对变种生物的记载零散不堪，并提出了重建人类的天真可笑的建议。

虽然这本书申明是写给铁杆活命主义粉丝，还有“坚韧如铁”的狂热份子们看的，但按照它的建议做，其下场会很悲惨。

Beloved,

I must beg your indulgence a little while longer. I am not yet able to send for you. Stay in Megaton. Once my business has concluded, I will send for you, and we will live happily as man and woman.

The memory of your beauty and sweet aroma lingers in my memory...

Have patience my love.

Soon. Soon we shall be together once again!

Your's very truly,

Burke
translation:
亲爱的，

我得恳请你再宽限一段时间。我现在还不能接你过来。呆在兆吨镇。等我的事情处理完后，我会去接你，然后我们将结为夫妻，幸福地生活在一起。

你的美貌与芬芳，始终萦绕在我心间……

请耐心等待，我的爱人。

很快。很快我们就能再次相聚！

你最真诚的，

伯克

original:
Beloved,

The pain of your absence is at times crippling. But I must persevere. I must! It is very important work I am doing for mankind.

Oh, but I wish I could sweep it all away to be with you now!

Be patient love. I will send for you soon.

Your's very truly,

Burke
translation:
亲爱的，

你不在身边的痛苦，有时几乎将我击溃。但我必须坚持下去。必须如此！我所从事的事业，对全人类而言至关重要。

哦，我多么希望能抛开这一切，此刻就与你相聚！

请耐心等待，亲爱的。我很快就会接你过来。

你最真诚的，

伯克

original: Dear Miranda,\n     I don't know if you'll ever get this letter. That job I took isn't going well. One of the mercs on the team is crazy. He talks like he's some sort of president in exile. I don't trust him. One of the others is a drunken lecher. He's always trying to make moves on the woman on the team. He almost got us killed yesterday because he was staring at her rather than watching the road.\n     If I don't make it back, take good care of Ted. Take him to Rivet City. The two of you will be safe there. I'll join you there if I survive.
translation: 亲爱的米兰达，\n我不知道你是否会收到这封信。工作进展并不顺利。我的队伍中有个佣兵是个疯子，他口口声声地说自己是个被放逐的总统一类的人物，我可不相信他的鬼话。另一个队友是个酒鬼，他一直在试图接近我们的女队员，昨天我们差点因为他送了命，原因就是他一直盯着那个女人看，而顾不上看前边的道路。\n如果我一去不返，请照顾好Ted。带他一起去铆钉城，你们两个在那里生活会很安全的。如果我活下来的话，我会去那里找你们。

original: If anyone finds this note, stay the hell away from this place. If the Feral Ghouls don't get you, the robots will. There's radiation everywhere. I think they used to make nukes here, or maybe they just kept them, I don't know.\n\nTara
translation: 如果有人看到这条信息，请离这个鬼地方远点。即使僵尸没有杀死你，机器人也会置你于死地。这里可能是从前制造核武器的地方，不过也可能是储存核武器的地方，我尚无法确定。\n\n塔拉

original:
Tuesday, don't know the date: This will look good on my war record. When I get back to the republic, my candidacy will be unstoppable.

Thursday, still don't know the date: Strayer needs to die. He refuses to use my title. I keep telling him that the election is a mere formality. He should start using my future title now to get in my good graces.

Sunday, I think: The disarmament treaty failed. I've got the Republic's treasure. The other ambassador's have all fled. It's time I returned to my people. I'm leaving this note to be found by future scholars. They will marvel at my accomplishments.
translation:
日期不详，星期二：继续我的战地记录。等我回到共和国，我将在选举中所向披靡。

日期仍不详，星期三：我要干掉斯崔尔，原因是他不肯用我给他的头衔。我一遍一遍又一遍地跟他说选举只是一个形式，但他就是不接受我的好意，使用我给他的头衔。

星期日：我认为裁军是错误的，回到我的人民身边的时刻到了，我把这篇记录留在这里，以便未来的学者们发现并敬仰我的造诣。

original: I'm trapped. Dukov betrayed me. I'm stuck down here with nothing but the Ghouls and the robots for company. The Ghouls ignore me because they think I'm one of them. The robots are easy to avoid.\n\nAll I've got is this stupid terminal to keep me company. Someday I'll get out of here. Then Tenpenny and the others will pay.
translation: 我被困住了。杜克夫背叛了我。我被骗来这里，身边有的只是僵尸和机器人。僵尸认为我是他们的一员，并没对我怎么样。机器人则可以轻松躲开。我在这个破终端上立下此誓，早晚有一天我会离开这里，叫特配尼他们为此付出代价。

original: I forgot about this terminal. I've been down here seven years now. A human would never have survived. Only a Ghoul can live in these conditions. Three years ago I stopped looking for a way out. There isn't one.
translation: 我之前遗忘了这台终端。现在我已经被困在这里七年了。人类不可能生存的这么久，只有僵尸才能活下来。在三年前我停止了寻找出口，因为这里根本没有出口。

translation:

Tenpenny will allow the Ghouls to move in, if I convince certain residents of the tower:
*Mr. & Mrs. Wellington
*Mr. Ling
*Ms. Montenegro
*Ms. Lancaster
translation:
特佩尼会让僵尸们搬进来，如果我说服这些塔里的居民:
*Mr. & 威灵顿先生
*凌先生
*黑山先生
*兰开斯特先生

original:
Congratulations on your purchase of the TASTEE CLEEN SANITIZER, another household health essential from Abraxodyne Chemical!

Using your TASTEE CLEEN SANITIZER is simple! Just carry the sanitizer with your food or beverages, and our patented ABRAXO-LUX BACTO-SCOUR process will remove any trace bacteria before you even take your first bite or drink!

Abraxo's dietary engineers have proven that using the TASTEE CLEEN SANITIZER unlocks additional nutritional health benefits! So enjoy your food again, free of filth and grime.

And remember: ABRAXO for all your cleaning needs!

Warning: Product is not guaranteed to sanitize all food and drink. 

Abraxodyne is not responsible for any sickness, paralyzation, blindness or death that may result from unauthorized use!
translation:
感谢您购买阿伯莱克杀菌剂 — 阿伯莱克化工出品的另一款家用卫生必需品！

阿伯莱克杀菌剂使用简单！只要把杀菌剂放入您的食物和饮料，我们的阿伯莱克化工独家秘方能在您动口之前为您把细菌清理得干干净净！

阿伯莱克的食品工程技术人员证实，使用阿伯莱克杀菌剂能带来更多营养保健方面的好处！所以尽情享受您的食物，轻松远离肮脏和污秽。

还有，请记住：阿伯莱克适合您所有的清洁！

警告：本产品不能保证清洁所有的食物和饮料。

\阿伯莱克公司对使用不当造成的任何疾病，瘫痪，失明或死亡不承担责任！

original:
Dear sir and/or madam,

Do you find yourself with an absence of moral fortitude? Is the notion of having a moral quandary alien to you? In your opinion, is a conscience inconceivable? Then you are the sort of person we're looking for at Littlehorn & Associates! 

Stop by our offices in the eastern side of the large Scrapyard in the Wasteland for details.

Yours sincerely,

Daniel Littlehorn
translation:
尊敬的先生/女士：

您是否自认缺乏道德操守？道德困境对您而言是否如同异域概念？在您的认知里，良知根本不存在？那么，您正是利特霍恩联合公司正在寻觅的人才！

请亲临废土大型废车场东侧的办事处详询。

您诚挚的，

丹尼尔·利特霍恩

original: Attention Lawbringers of the Capitol Wasteland: The Regulators require your aid in bringing the scum and pestilence that inhabit our home to justice. Report to Sonora Cruz at the Regulator Headquarters for details.
translation: 请注意首都废土的不法分子：赏金猎人在驱除我们家园的渣滓和顽疾方面需要你的帮助。向赏金猎人总部的索诺拉·克鲁兹报告以获取细节。

original: Okay, look. Here's how it is: I need some better stuff to trade or else I'm never going to get anything worthwhile in this place. Bring me some Chinese Assault Rifles. Say... about 20? I should be able to get some better stuff in to sell you after that.
translation: 好吧，看。事情是这样的：我需要搞一些更好的东西来做买卖，否则我这永远都是些破烂。给我弄些中式突击步枪。恩……差不多20支？到时候我就能换到一些更好的东西卖你了。

original: Take to the skies and soar above the clouds as you view our aircraft exhibits throughout the Museum of Technology. The original Wright Brothers Flyer, the vintage WWII P-51 Mustang and several other aircraft can be found hanging about the museum. Also, be sure and visit our Flight Experience Gallery where you can take a simulated airline flight on board a full-sized jetliner or step into the hair-raising, white-knuckle world of air traffic control in our Tower of Terror exhibit. Sponsored by Lockreed Industries.
translation: 当你在参观我们科技博物馆的飞行展时，犹如驰骋在蓝天白云之中。怀特兄弟的原型机，老式的二战P51野马和一系列其他的飞行器都被悬挂起来供欣赏。并且，可以肯定的是参观我们的飞行展会，你可以模拟一次飞行，无论是全尺寸的喷气式飞机，还是在我们的恐怖展塔上进入毛骨悚然的空中之旅世界。提供方Lockreed工业。

original: The Nuka-Cola Corporation is pleased to announce to all its employees that the first shipments of our Nuka-Cola Quantum(R) are on their way to retailers in the Washington D.C. area! This flagship test market program is the culmination of a three year research program to bring the refreshing taste of Quantum to market. Congratulations to all employees on a job well done!
translation: 核子可乐公司很高兴地向全体员工宣布，首批核子可乐量子版(R)正运往华盛顿特区的零售商！这次旗舰试销计划是历时三年的研究计划的最终成果，旨在将量子可乐的清新口感推向市场。祝贺所有员工的出色工作！

original: Part of our collection is a copy of the formal declaration of war made on Germany during World War II on December 11, 1941 by the government and endorsed by the President Franklin D. Roosevelt. While the document doesn't evoke the brilliance of other masterworks like the Emancipation Proclamation, it still served as a reminder to the world that the United States wasn't a power to be trifled with.
translation: 我们收藏品中，有一份第二次世界大战期间、福兰克林.D.罗斯福总统于1941年12月11日发表的对德宣战的宣言。尽管它不象《解放黑奴宣言》等名作那样耀眼，它仍然向世界宣布了美国不是个好惹的国家。

original:
Alright, listen up. This is the last time I'm going to say it: we might be immune to radiation, but we still gotta breathe. So, whoever has been taking the Spare Parts from the supply closet better stop it, right quick. If I don't have parts, I can't keep the air circulating. Got it?

We're out of parts, so I need everyone to bring me any of those Stimpaks or RadAway things that you find. I'm gonna see if I can't trade them to some smoothskin for some parts. And if those ones go missing, you zombies are on your own.

Winthrop.
translation:
好吧，都听好了。我再最后重复一遍：我们或许能辐射免疫，但我们仍要呼吸。所以，从补给里拿走备用零件的那个人，无论你是谁，立刻停止这种行为。如果没有零件，我就不能保证空气的流通了。懂了吗？

我们的零件已经用完了，所以我要你们每一个人都把找到的治疗针或者辐射药给我。如果找不到光皮肤购买零件，我会再想办法。反正如果再有零件丢失，你们这些僵尸们就等着自生自灭吧。

温思罗普。

original: I, Ahzhrukal (henceforth known as "seller") agree to pass possession of the property known as "Charon" (henceforth known as "PROPERTY") to &PCName; (henceforth known at BUYER") upon the death of the Ghoul known as Greta (henceforth "TARGET"). \n\nBy execution hereof, BUYER acknowledges that all tasks related to TARGET shall be completed in due haste. Afterfor PROPERTY shall be transferred to BUYER with equal due haste.
translation: 我，阿祖卡（后文中称作“卖家”）同意在一位名叫葛丽泰的僵尸（后文中称作“目标”）死亡后，向&PCName;（后文中称作“买家”）让出这份名为“卡伦”(后文中称作“财产”)的财产的所有权。\n\n关于履行此点，买家须知，所有和目标有关的任务一旦完成。 之后财产便会立刻转让给买家。

original:
Scribe Yearling,

Now that Scribe Warswick has been written into the scrolls, I pass his noble task onto you.

Journey into the ruins of the city, to the once great Arlington Library. There, you will continue to collect, archive, and catalog the written works of the ancients. You will have two Paladins sent with you and you shall be requisitioned an amount of currency in order to barter and trade with Outsiders for any books that they may present to you.

Depart immediately and make haste. We cannot afford to have this work interrupted.

Yours In Steel,

Scribe Rothchild
translation:
文员伊尔琳，

沃斯维克文员已经离我们而去了，他被载入了名册，现在我将这个崇高的任务交给了你。

请前往这个城市的废墟，找到战前的大图书馆—阿灵顿图书馆。在那里继续收集前人的书籍，将它们归档并编目。两位圣骑士会和你同行，已经给你拨了一大笔钱用于和外人进行交易，收购他们愿意出售的书籍。

请立即启程，抓紧赶路。我们不能让这项工作中断下来。

你的兄弟，

文员罗斯查德
来自联邦的任务 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nWe've a little assignment from the Commonwealth. A very important slave escaped into the Wasteland. Well, it’s not exactly a slave. It’s what they call an android. A kind of synthetic man. The important thing isn’t what this guy is. The important thing is the job pays more than you can imagine. He thinks the synthman might be looking to get in touch with a doctor and/or tech-head. If you want a cut, then get a move on.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n我们接到了一个来自联邦的小任务。一个很重要的奴隶逃进了废土。好吧，它并不完全是一个奴隶。它是他们所说的仿真人。一种合成人。重要的并不在于这家伙是什么。重要的是这任务的酬金超乎你的想象。他认为这仿真人会设法与医生和/或科技人员取得联系。要是你想分一杯羹，现在就行动吧。
异常仿真人 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nYou’ll never guess who just showed up at my place! That android catcher from the Commonwealth! At first I thought he was going to kill me. But it turns out he’s an android himself! And he’s gone rogue! I didn’t believe him at first, but I’m convinced he’s telling the truth. We need to find him a place to hide along the Railroad. He also insists that we help him locate a trusted doctor and techie.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n你绝对猜不到谁刚来了我这！那个来自联邦的仿真人捕捉者！起先我认为他要杀了我。但结果他自己就是个仿真人！并且他失常了！起初我不相信他，但我现在确信他说的是真的。我们得随着“铁路”给他找一个藏身之所。他还坚持要我们帮他找到一位可靠的医生和技术人员。
天呐！一个环状神经器！ - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nRemember that secret android project I told you about? Well, they got some serious Pre-War tech on their hands. They nabbed a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer for the facial reconstruction. Not sure where they’ll find a chopper with enough skills to use it without making him look like a freaking Ghoul. Oh, and get this. Can you believe they found a Circuit Neuralizer? That or someone built one! Word is that they're going to completely rewire the brain of one of those things. If you know who they got working on this, let me know. I want to meet the guy.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n还记得我和你说过的秘密仿真人计划么？好了，他们搞到手了一些严肃的战前科技。他们为了面部重建，弄到了一台脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。不确定他们会从哪找到有足够技术的“一把刀”来用这些设备，而不会让他变得像一个该死的尸鬼。哦，还有这个。你敢相信他们找到了一个环状神经器吗？或是某人做了一个！据说他们打算把其中一个的大脑完全重新接线。如果你知道他们找了谁来做这个，告诉我。我想见见这个家伙。

original: Okay, pass this on after you get it... gotta keep this crap off of the Intra-Vault mails. If you can hack the control panels, use their noise flush feature to spook the crazies. Works okay and its kept me alive these last two days, but they're starting to catch on. We need to get organized and make an attempt for the Vault door. It's our only chance.
translation: 好吧，既然你得到这个了，请把它传下去……别让这个进入内部邮件系统。如果你能黑了控制面板,可以用他们的噪声系统对付那些疯子。活儿还算顺利，这让我又多活了两天，不过他们快要明白过来了。我们必须组织起来搞定避难所的大门，这是我们唯一的机会。

original:
Journal Entry:

Nothing has meaning to me anymore.

Every time I'm in the outer tunnels I swear I can hear children's laughter. 

The Vault doctors say its just my mind compensating for the loss of Jason but I know I'm not crazy. They gave me new pills but pills are for crazy people! I refuse to take these pills!

I AM NOT CRAZY!

Why bring up kids in a hellhole like this? Why? This is a pointless existence.
translation:
日记：

对我而言生活已经没有任何意义了。

 我发誓，每次在外隧道都可以听到孩子们的欢声笑语。

避难所的医生说这只是我失去儿子之后，大脑产生幻觉反应。但我明白我的神智是清醒的。他们给我更多的药丸，但我知道药丸是给精神病人吃的！我不需要吃药！

我没有疯！

为什么要在这个永不见天日的地下室里抚养我的孩子？这个避难所的存在根本就毫无意义！

original: Once again, I've hit that damn wall. At fourteen days, all of the test subjects began to exhibit severe bouts of rage and anxiety. So much so that they were a danger to my team and to this facility. I had no choice once again but to order them to be destroyed. It pains me every time we do this. The same cycle has been repeated in every strain we test. We always see superior physical adaptations, but the mental changes are their downfall.
translation: 我又一次捶胸顿足了。在14天后，所有实验对象都变得不安和暴躁。甚至已经对我的研究小组和设备的安全构成威胁。我别无选择，只能再次毁灭他们。每次这样做的时候我都心痛不已。似乎每一个菌株实验都以这样的轮回结束。每一次实验我们都可以见到肉体的超强适应性改变，但同时精神上的崩溃亦是实验失败的罪魁祸首。

original: Attention ALL Lab Technicians\n\nThe A Level Storage Room has been restocked with rad suits and other radiation dampeners. We were able to bring these up from deep storage for immediate use. Please only take what is needed (there is no need to hoard the items, there is plenty to go around) and to lock the door after you are finished.
translation: 所有实验技术人员请注意：\n\n储藏室A层新近存放了一批防辐射服和其他的防辐射装备，我们可以立即拿出来投入使用。请只拿取需要的装备（储藏室里有足够的装备可用，无须囤积），完成后请锁门。

original:
Maintenance Code: RL04 Red
Issue: Reactor Spikes, Sectional Power Outages
Engineer: Daniel Koster

Fix Notes:
For the last five weeks, we've had periodic interruptions to the power grid. Entire sections will lose power for approximately 1-6 minutes, then return to normal. By installing monitoring meters, I traced the issue to sudden immense power spikes in the main reactor. My fear was the reactor was having a major malfunction, but turns out that it's due to a power draw that the experimental section is creating. Whatever they are using in there is WAY over the limit for acceptable power consumption. I've temporarily remedied the situation by having the backup reactor kick on when needed. I don't like to do this, but I have no choice until I figure out what they're up to.
translation:
维修代码：RL04 红色
事件：反应器峰值，电力中断
工程师：丹尼尔·寇斯德

维修记录：
在过去5个星期里，电网经常性的中断。整个区域将停电大约1至6分钟，通过监控系统检测，发现故障由主整流器电力峰值突然增大引起。我怀疑为整流器本身故障，在实验区开始供电时，电力消耗急剧增加，故障便显现出来。不管实验区的人员在使用何备设备，解决的办法只有限制电力消耗。我准备了一个备用的反应器以备不时之需，暂时改善了问题。我们其实很不情愿做这件事，但是在弄明白实验区的人在搞什么名堂之前，也只能这么做了。

original: The G.E.C.K. is, quite simply, the most advanced piece of technology ever developed by Vault-Tec -- a terra-forming module capability of creating life from complete lifelessness. After riding out the storm of nuclear Armageddon in a Vault-Tec patented vault, residents can then activate the G.E.C.K., and create a new earthen paradise - craters and dust will give way to rolling grasslands and sparkling clear water. Of course, due to time and monetary constraints, not every vault will be equipped with a G.E.C.K. module.
translation: 伊甸园创造器是…简单讲，避难所科技公司开发出的最先进的技术成果 — 1个能够将完全无生命的物质创造成生命体的模块。在避难所科技公司制造的避难所里平安度过那段末日核战之后，居民们可以使用伊甸园创造器来创造一个新的乐土。? 满目疮痍、尘埃蔽日的大地将重新裹上翠绿的草海和碧波荡漾的湖面。当然，由于时间仓促和资金限制，不可能使每个避难所都配备伊甸园创造器模块。

original: I'm quite sad to report that due to a direct hit from what I presume to be a nuclear weapon on the entry area of Vault 87, we will be unable to provide the Scouting Reports as outlined in Vault-Tec's Operations Manual. The main door to Vault 87 is damaged beyond repair and we are detecting extremely high levels of lethal radiation outside and in the entry tunnel.
translation: 我十分抱歉地报告，由于87避难所的入口区域可能被核武器直接击中，现在已不能按避难所科技公司操作手册的指示递交侦察报告了。87避难所正门严重损毁，已无法修复，同时我们检测到通往外界的隧道内外都布满了直接致命的极强辐射。
莱莉提到的游骑兵的位置

original: To get to the stranded Rangers, Reilly said I have to enter Our Lady of Hope Hospital and make my way to the second floor. From there, I have to take a fallen radio antenna bridge across the street into the Statesman Hotel's second floor and then work my way to the roof.
translation: 要想找到被困的游骑兵，莱莉说我必须进入玛利亚医院并上到二楼。在那儿，我可以用倒塌的天线架桥穿过街道进入政要酒店的二楼，然后再设法上到屋顶。

original:
Due to the tragic death of Paladin Reddin, Lyons' Pride now has one opening, effective immediately.

If you can't shoot an Ugly from 150 yards blindfolded, don't waste my time.
 -- Sentinel Lyons
translation:
由于新兵瑞丁悲剧性的死亡,“里昂斯的骄傲”马上出现了一个实质上的缺口。

如果你不能蒙着眼睛射中一个150码外的敌人，就不要浪费我的时间。
 — 莎拉·里昂斯

original: Squire Maxson’s training is proceeding well, and the boy certainly has an aptitude for small arms. But I often worry about his emotional state. He is a child surrounded by killers, being groomed to become a killer himself. \n\nMaybe I’ve become too cynical, too soft in my old age, but I wish I could give the boy a more normal childhood. Ironic, considering his upbringing is so much like my own. Maybe that’s what scares me.
translation: 扈从麦克森的训练进度很好，这孩子在轻武器方面简直是个天才。但我经常担心他的情绪状况，他是在我的杀手们中生存的孩子，自己也在逐渐变成一个杀手。\n\n也许我在晚年变得太多疑、太脆弱了，但我希望给这孩子一个更正常的童年。讽刺的是，他的成长经历和我的太像了，也许就这样吓到了我。

translation:
圣骑士布兰切特 — 在战斗中光荣牺牲

圣骑士詹宁斯 — 在战斗中光荣牺牲

圣骑士斯坦 — 在行动中失踪。(可能死亡/在战斗中光荣牺牲)

original:
Artillery Order #562
Talon Company Support Team Alpha
Location: Seward Square

Take position on the skybridge near Seward Square and protect the squad's right flank. Bring plenty of ammo because you're going to be there for awhile. A small team has been dispatched to secure the Capitol Building's south wing. We suspect minor resistance in that sector, but if need arises, we've locked in some artillery coordinates. Call in the strikes by using the switch we've provided for you.
translation:
562号炮兵队命令
鹰爪公司 第一支援组
位置：苏华德广场

占领苏华德广场附近的天桥保护广场右翼。多带点弹药因为你可能需要在那里呆上一阵。一个小队已被派往国会大厦的南翼以确保其安全，我们认为那里应该不会有什么大麻烦。如果不是这样的话，我们也做好了准备。配给你的这个终端用来召唤炮火攻击。

original: I've finally found a quiet place for my family. We've been running from one settlement to the next, just trying to keep out of sight. Now that I'm on the other coast, I feel much safer.\n\nThe family across the way from us seems pretty decent. Their kid, Bryan, likes to play with my son, which is great. It's hard for Will to make friends because we haven't stayed in one place long enough. Maybe we can finally put down some roots here in Grayditch.
translation: 我终于为家人找到了一处宁静的处所。我们已经躲躲藏藏地滇沛流离很久了。现在我在另一侧的海岸，终于感觉有了些许安全感。\n\n街对面那户人家看起来十分容易相处。他们家的孩子布赖恩喜欢和我儿子在一起玩，真是太好了。由于长期频繁地搬家，想交个朋友真是很困难，也许这次我们真的可以在格雷蒂奇扎根安顿了。

original:
If you're reading this, I'm dead.

I was running low on water, so I figured I'd go out and get some instead of waiting for fate to deliver it to me. Hell, I can't remember the last time it rained.

Looks like my plan backfired. I got slashed in the arm by some goddamn psychopath, barely escaped a Super Mutant, and then got shot in the hip by a crazy old woman.

I haven't been able to feel my legs for a full day, so there's not much I can do but sit here and write.

Here's hoping you have better luck out here than me.
translation:
你读到了这个字条时说明我已经死了。

我的水快没有了，我看我应该去外面找些水了，而不是在这干等着有人能给我水来了。见鬼，我都不知道上次下雨是什么时候的事了。

我的计划失败了。我的胳膊被一些狗娘养的疯子们砍伤了，勉强的从一个超级变种人的手里逃了出来，又被一个疯癫的老娘们开枪射中了屁股。

一整天我的腿都失去了知觉，我只能坐着等死了。

祝你在外面的时候能比我幸运点。

original:
The others left me! They fucking left me behind!

Okay, I can understand them getting angry because I wandered off. But I thought I saw someone trailing us, so I went to check it out.

Turns out I was wrong. But I was only gone for like ten minutes! They didn't have to leave me behind. I have no idea where they went, but I guess I'd better get off my ass and try to catch up.
translation:
其他的人丢下了我！他妈的他们就这样丢下了我！

好吧，我能理解他们生气是因为我迷了路。但我是看见了有人跟在了后面，所以我就去查看了一下。

后来没发现什么，可能是我看错了。可我就离开了几分钟而已！他们没必要丢下我啊！我也不知道他们去哪了，但眼下最好赶快抬起屁股动身，看看能不能追上他们。

original:
I'm so glad I did this. 

I've been telling Joshua for years that if you really want to live, you've got to get out there and LIVE! Wander, explore, interact with this crazy Capital Wasteland. 

I've met so many great people, done so many amazing things. I can't wait to get home and tell Joshua all about it. I may even combine my journals into a book!
translation:
我非常的高兴，因为我做到了。

我几年前就跟约书亚说过，如果你追求真正的生活，那你就要去废都，生存下去！漫游，探索，走进这个疯狂的首府废墟。

我曾经见过很多伟大的人，也做过许许多多不可思议的事情。我已经等不及的要回家了，我要把这一切讲给约书亚听。我甚至还把我的日记整理成了一本书！

original: It seems like I've been out here scavving forever. I'm ready to head home soon, though. I've got just enough to keep Paulina, Kress and me going for another week.
translation: 我看上去好像就是一直在这儿捡破烂的命。不过呢，我马上就要回家了。我准备的很充分，足够宝利娜、凯瑞斯还有自己走一个星期的路程。

original:
Fine. If the world doesn't care about me, I'm not going to care about the world.

I just took 23 hits of Psycho. Let the Wasteland gobble me up.

If you're reading this, feel free to take any of my shit that gets left behind.
translation:
很好。如果这个世界抛弃了我，那么我也要抛弃这个世界了。

我刚才打了23针疯狂药。让这废土吞噬我吧。

如果你读到了这个， 我留下来的那些破玩意随你挑，爱拿什么就拿什么。

original:
Hello, my sweet sister. 

I know it's been a long time since I've written, and for that I sincerely apologize. 

It's been three years since I left home to make my mark on the world. I've been places, Grace. I've seen things your eyes could scarcely imagine. 

But my odyssey is now complete. I'm ready to return home, and will begin the journey in just a few days. 

Here's hoping we can pick up right where we left off. You're the only person I have left in this world, Grace. I love you, and I want us to be a family again.
translation:
你好，我最亲爱的妹妹。

我知道已经很久没给你写信了，为此我真诚的表示歉意。

为了出人头地，我离开了家，已经整整三年了。格雷斯，我现在已经安定了下来。也见到过许多你从没见过的事情。

我的漂泊生涯结束了。已经做好了回家的准备，几天后就出发。

我只是希望我们能重新开始。格雷斯，你是我这世上唯一的亲人。我爱你，我也希望我们能重新成为一个家庭

original:
It's been a week, and I still haven't picked up Marko's trail.

Sitting here now, alone, I can be completely honest. With myself and anyone who might read this. I've never felt like such a failure in my life.

To let a man enter your home, and then watch helplessly as he murders your family in cold blood, is more than any person should have to bear. 

Now I can't even find the son-of-a-bitch to give him what he has coming. He kills my children in front of my eyes, and he gets to just walk away? No punishment, no justice? How is that fair?

I'd kill myself, but I'm sure I'd just screw that up too. I just wish I knew what to do. I just wish God, or someone, would give me some kind of sign.
translation:
已经一个星期了，我依然没有发现马可的踪迹。

此刻，我坐在这里，就我一个人，我可以做到绝对的坦诚。对给我自己和能读到这字条的人。我这一生中从没有感受过这样的失败。

让一个人进入了你的家，他冷血的杀害了你的家人，你却只能无能为力的看着。这远远超出了一般人的承受能力。

现在，我甚至都找不到这婊子养的，不能给他应得的惩罚。他就在我眼前杀死了我的孩子，然后就走掉了？没有惩罚吗？没有正义吗？这一切公平吗？

我曾经想过自杀，我只知道，这一切被我搞砸了。我只是希望自己知道该做什么。只希望神，或者其他人，能给我一些指引。

original:
Sweetie,

Listen, I just can't wait any longer. I'm sending this letter, via courier, and I'm begging you to respond as soon as possible.

Why should we wait any longer? Forget our parents! Every day I sit here and watch my brother Kevin whither away from Radiation Sickness. Am I next?

I don't want to waste another second of my life. Let's just get married, and make a future for ourselves. Megaton, Rivet City, maybe even Tenpenny Tower. Who knows?

When I'm with you, I feel like I can do anything!

So marry me, you fool!
translation:
宝贝，

听着，我再也无法等下去了。我经由快递送出了这封信，我恳求你能尽快的回复我。

我么为什么还要等下去？别管我们的父母了！每天我坐在这里，看着我的兄弟忍受着辐射疾病的折磨。我会是下一个他吗？

生命里的一秒钟我也不想再浪费了。就让我们结婚吧，创造我们自己的未来。兆吨镇，铆钉城，特佩尼大厦也行。谁会知道？

和你在一起时，我觉得自己无所不能！

所以嫁给我吧，你这个小糊涂虫！

original:
There are days I consider finally "pulling the plug," as it were, and putting a permanent end to both this simulation, and my life. 

That is the reason I requested installation of General Chase's Chinese invasion program, after all. By disabling the safety protocols, I have ensured that each subject in Vault 112 will physically die if their in-simulation avatars are killed. 

Real-world death. End of simulation. The perfect Failsafe.

At least it would have been, if not for my own misjudgment. I knew, when the simulation first went online, that the secondary safeties - those established for all Vault-Tec and military personnel - would prevent my own real-world demise in the event of a Failsafe execution. In the end, I would kill the subjects, and save myself. 

I wouldn’t want it any other way. Or so I thought.

It’s true the Failsafe would scare the living hell out of every resident in Tranquility Lane, and lead to their brutal deaths. But then - what about me? 

I have no ability to disable my own safety from within the simulation. And any other avatars I could create would be driven by the simulation’s A.I. routines - not actual living, thinking, human subjects. 

Where’s the fun in tormenting a machine?

And so, the release of the real-world subjects is more than they deserve, more that I could bear. They'd be dead, and I'd be left here in Tranquility Lane, alone and tragically bored for all eternity.

I can think of nothing more unacceptable.
translation:
有好几天，我真想干脆“拔掉插头”，一了百了，既结束这场模拟，也终结我的生命。

毕竟，这就是我请求安装蔡斯将军的中国入侵程序的原因。通过禁用安全协议，我确保了112号避难所里的每个人，如果他们在模拟中的化身被杀，那么在现实中也会死亡。

现实世界的死亡，模拟终结，完美的故障保险。

如果不是因为我自己的误判，这本来会是这样的。模拟初上线时我就知道，那些为所有避难所科技和军事人员设立的二级安全机制，会在故障保险启动时阻止我自己在现实世界中死亡。最终，我会杀死那些受试者，而我自己则能幸免。

我不希望有其他任何结果。或者，我曾是这样想的。

确实，故障保险会让宁静巷里的每个居民都吓得魂飞魄散，并导致他们惨死。但是——那我呢？

在模拟中，我无法解除自己的安全机制。而我能创造出的任何其他化身，全由模拟的AI驱动——不是真正活着、有思想的人类受试者。

折磨一台机器有什么乐趣呢？

因此，让这些现实世界中的受试者解脱，超出了他们应得的，也是我无法承受的。他们会死去，而我则会永远留在宁静巷，孤独而悲惨地无聊至死。

我想没有比这更让人无法接受的了。
塔科马公园 炮兵队记录

original:
Artillery Order #447
Talon Company Support Team Bravo
Location: Takoma Park

Establish position near the parking lot west of the factory and monitor enemy movement. Three squads will be dispatched once you are in position. Their objective is re-take our old positions in Takoma Park. Your directive is to provide artillery support when they arrive. The coordinates have been encoded on the switch provided. Call in the strikes once alpha squad established a base of fire outside of the blast range.
translation:
447号炮兵队命令
鹰爪公司第二支援组
位置：塔科马公园

占领工厂西边的停车场那个位置，注意敌人的动向。到达位置后3个小组会被派过去。他们的目标是重新夺回我们在塔科马公园的位置。你的任务是当他们到达的时候提供炮火支援，目标信息已经输入了配给你的终端。等第一小队在轰炸范围外建立火力据点后立即召唤炮火攻击。

original:
For Immediate Release: 

HUBRIS COMICS AND VAULT-TEC INCORPORATED UNVEIL "VAULT BOY MEETS HELL'S CHAIN GANG" LIMITED FIVE-PART MINISERIES

The very best in Invincible Entertainment and Inpenetrable Vaults team up to bring comic fans a gripping grimoire of greatness!

From their headquarters in Washington, DC, Hubris Comics announced today plans to bring a beloved American Icon into the Hubris Comics Universe - none other than the beloved Vault Boy Character.

"Vault Boy was the perfect choice for our new Hell's Chain gang series", says Hubris Comics Chief of Publishing Peter Shiner, "In which those Valiant Vigilantes take on Chairman Cheng's Commie Cyborg Corps - after all, Vault Boy knows a thing or two about going up against that Red Menace!"

The five-part miniseries will feature an alternate future in which Chinese Communists have invaded America. Vault Boy and Hell's Chain Gang are the last, best hope for America to break free from the shackles of Communism in this cautionary tale of vigilance.

"It has always been Vault-Tec's mission to educate and protect our Countrymen from the Communist threat", commented Vault-Tec Public Relations Executive Joanne Strausser, "This exciting project is a perfect opportunity to thrill young Americans while sending home an important message for us all: Every good American must help shoulder the burden of freedom, and always be wary of the Communist Threat".

The first issue of this miniseries will be available on newsstands everywhere this Holiday Season.

About Hubris Comics
Hubris Comics, a branch of Hubris Publishing, headquartered in Washington, DC, has been producing printed entertainment since 2021. Hubris Comics are known for such popular properties as Grognak the Barbarian, Hell's Chain Gang, and The Inspector.
translation:
即时发表：

虎不理漫画和避难所科技公司为五集迷你电视剧“避难所男孩碰见地狱锁链犯”揭开面纱

战无不胜的娱乐业巨头和神秘的避难所公司联合起来给广大的动画爱好者带来了一场魅力无比的视觉盛宴！

来自他们在华盛顿特区总部的消息，虎不理漫画今天宣布计划将一个广受喜爱的美国偶像带入狂漫连环画环球公司 - 没有人比避难所男孩再适合不过了。

“对于我们新的地狱锁链犯系列，避难所男孩是再完美不过的了。”，虎不理漫画的首席发行官彼得·希那说道，“通过和那些勇敢的民兵一起抵抗程主席的共产党电子人军团 - 最终，避难所男孩对如何抵抗红色威胁已经略知一二！”

这部迷你电视剧的五个部分会呈现一个交替的过程来表现共产党对美国的入侵。在这个具有告诫性的故事里，避难所男孩和地狱锁链犯是美国从共产主义的枷锁中夺得自由的最后也是最好的希望。

“培养和保护我们的同胞免受共产主义者的威胁是我们避难所科技公司一直以来的责任。”避难所科技公司公共关系专员乔那·斯特劳瑟说，“这个令人激动的计划是一个振奋年轻美国人的完美时机，为了我们所有人，我们将给我们的家园传递一个重要的消息：每一个美国人都肩负有自由的使命，都需要时刻提防共产主义的威胁。”。

本年度的节日季节您将会在全国各地的报摊上看到这个电视剧的首映。

关于虎不理漫画
虎不理漫画，虎不理出版社的一支，总部设在华盛顿特区，早在2021就开始致力于娱乐印刷品的制造。虎不理漫画以一些非常流行的元素著称，例如：野蛮人歌南，地狱锁链犯和调查员。

original:
The N99 10mm sidearm was standard issue military gear following the phase out of the N80 in 2051. The N99 was known for its ability to survive in the harshest of conditions and in many tests, the weapon was able to reliably be restored to working condition after an extended period of time exposed to hard elements and without maintenance. 

The N99 proved to stand up to its claims and as a result, is one of the most common weapons found in use in the Wasteland. While many civilian weapons were ruined beyond use in the exterior conditions following the war, the N99 is commonly able to be easily restored to working order by anyone with the most basic knowledge of firearm mechanics. 

However, an N99 in poor condition can often deliver low target and armor penetration, frequent jamming, and greatly reduced accuracy. Fortunately, the weapon was produced in great numbers and units are available for replacement parts.
translation:
10毫米N99手枪在2051年之后取代了N80，成为了军队随身武器的标准配置。N99以它可以适应最苛刻的环境而得名，而且经过很多次的测试，这款武器长时间暴露在恶劣的环境下并且没有保养，却依旧可以可靠的恢复工作。

N99可以像它描述的那样经得起各种考验，所以，它也是废土上被广泛使用的武器之一。战后，许多民用武器因为长期在外使用，早已锈损，而任何人只要有最基本的枪械知识，简单修理一下N99，它就可以恢复工作。

不过，一把N99的状况如果很糟，会导致其对目标以及装甲的穿透性降低，经常会卡克，射击精度也会大幅下降。幸运的是，这款武器曾经被大量的生产过，而且所有组件都可以替换。

original:
The R Series of combat assault rifles was used reliably following the discontinuation of the M series in the early 21st century. The R series, produced by civilian manufacturer Stent Security Solutions, was made in many models and variations. The variation most common to the DC Wasteland is the R91 full-auto urban assault rifle. 

This rifle was standard issue for the National Guard during urban pacification operations. Fortunately for our purposes, the Nation Guard had been fully deployed around the DC area during the time of the war. As a result, the R91 is readily available for those willing to search. Although nearly two centuries of scavenging has reduced the numbers of working units, the R91 remains a favorite of Slavers and Raiders. this rifle can also often be obtained from legitimate traders and arms dealers.

Like any firearm, the R91's effectiveness and accuracy can suffer without regular maintenance.
translation:
在M系列突击步枪停用之后，它的替代品R系列表现得十分可靠。在21世纪早期。这种R系列步枪，由民间制造商“安全方案扩展”生产，衍生出了许多版本和型号。整个特区废墟里最常见是R91全自动城市用突击步枪。

这种步枪是国民警卫队在城市治安行动时的标准装备。同我们期望的那样，在战争时期，特区附近已经全面部署了国民警卫队。由此，那些寻枪的人随处都可以找的到R91。经过了差不多两个世纪，这些枪被人们捡走了不少，还能使用的数量已经不多了，但R91依旧是奴贩们和匪徒们喜爱的武器。从合法的商人和军火贩那里也能容易的弄到这种步枪。

和其他传统武器一样，如果没有合理的保养和维护，R91的性能和命中率都会受到影响。

original:
The AEP7 Laser Pistol was put into service to replace the AEP5, a model which was notorious for its problems with overheating. The AEP7 features a new design in the photonic focusing chamber as well as an entirely redesigned focusing crystal pattern. The bulk and weight have both been reduced over previous models and it was likely that within the new few development cycles, the successor to the AEP7 would replace the N99 10mm as the standard issue sidearm for all forces.

The AEP7 took advantage of new manufacturing techniques developed shortly before the Great War. Although many were produced, most did not make it into field service because of logistics problems concerning their deployment during active wartime. 

The AEP7 can be a rare find in the Capital Wasteland, and any models that are produced should be returned to the Citadel for repair and recalibrating before field deployment.
translation:
AEP7激光手枪是AEP5的代替品，AEP5曾因为过热的问题而臭名远扬。AEP7的特征包括全新设计的光子聚焦枪膛，以及完全翻新的聚焦水晶块。体积和重量相比上一款型号都下降了不少，看来如果经历新一轮短暂的开发周期之后，AEP7的下一代产品将会替换掉n99 10毫米子弹成为所有部队的标配的辅助武器。

AEP7的优秀，得益于大战之前那成熟的新型制造工艺。尽管这款手枪曾经生产了许多，但是在战争的时候，由于后勤问题，影响了这款手枪的部署，大部分都没有在战场上服役过。

首府废墟内很难找到AEP7，在实际装备到战场前，所有该型号的手枪都要送回大本营，进行修理和重新校准。

original:
Unlike many of the weapons in use today, the AER9 is actually not the top laser rifle that was in service at the time of the Great War. The model line went up to the state-of-the-art AER12, which saw service in a handful of specialty units. The reason that the AER9 is much more commonly found is that it was much sturdier and more reliable than the models that followed.

The AER9 features a titanium housed crystal array which proved to withstand long years of exposure to the elements much better than the gold alloy housing of the later models. As a result, the crystal arrays stayed focused within operating parameters, rather than falling completely out of focus like the newer models. 

As with all energy weapons, the AER9 can suffer from poor performance if not properly maintained. The crystal arrays and non-mechanical components are delicate and if not properly serviced can lead to a loss of beam intensity, overheating, and energy regulation failure.
translation:
和现在使用的许多武器不同，在大战中使用的激光步枪里，AER9实际上并不是最好的。以它为模板又升级出了最新型的AER12，少量特种部队曾经使用过。AER9普及的原因是因为比起衍生的型号，它更耐用，更可靠。

AER9的特点是在水晶组上有一层钛覆盖物，经得起长年累月的暴露在外，远比使用黄金合金覆盖物的新型号要强。因此，水晶组在操作参数范围内保持聚焦，也比像新型号那样完全失去焦点要强。

和所有的能量武器一样，如果保养不当，AER9的性能就会变得很差。水晶组和非机械部件都非常精密，使用不当就会导致光束强度下降，武器过热，能量调控失败。

original: I'm not going to make it, Milly... I'm sorry. I knew everyone thought I could do it, but they don't know what's out here. It's not just Trogs... but others. The Wildmen. Kind of funny considering my nickname 'Wild Bill' back at the mill. Finding the ingots wasn't the hard part... they're everywhere. The problem was trying to make my way back to the mill. My trusty sidearm came in handy more than once, but I soon found myself in more trouble than I could handle. The gunfire alerted the Wildmen and I assume it's only a matter of time before they find me. I'm sorry for letting everyone down at the mill. Let everyone know I tried my hardest. ...Bye.
translation: 我撑不下去了，米莉……我很抱歉。我知道每个人都觉得我能够做到，但是他们不知道这里是怎么回事。这里不光有兽化人……还有别的东西，野蛮人！真是搞笑，我在工厂的时候外号就叫做狂野比尔。找到钢锭不是什么难事，它们到处都是。问题是我没法回到工厂。我可靠的防身武器不止一次地派上了用场，但是很快我就发现我陷入了更加糟糕的问题。枪声引来了野蛮人，我相信不久他们就会发现我。我很抱歉让大家失望了。让大家知道我尽了最大的努力。……再见。

original: In response to the increased number of Protectron related injuries, I've placed a bunch of generic employee IDs next to the Factory Protectron Pod. The thing doesn't know the difference anyway so, please, if you've forgot your ID, just use the ones on the table. Remember to return them before you leave for the day, I only have so many.\n\n- Management
translation: 鉴于由自动护卫造成的受伤事件不断增加，我放了几组普通员工的ID在工厂的自动护卫维护槽旁边。反正那些铁家伙分不清它们有什么不同，如果你忘记了你的ID，就用桌子上的这些吧。记得离开的时候把ID放回去，我只剩这么几个了。\n\n- 管理部

original:
Management made a surprise visit to the plant today. I guess they stopped believing what I've been telling them about the robots not performing to standards. They saw first hand the speed and efficiency of the robots. Unfortunately, they also caught two employees in the act of tearing apart a Protectron and smashing it with a sledgehammer. I was to blame of course. The men are starting to believe I'm working closely with the managers and helping them in every way possible to save my own skin.

Tom McMullin
Supply Plant Supervisor
translation:
管理部今天对工厂进行了突击检查。我猜他们开始怀疑我所告诉他们的关于机器人的表现没有达到标准的问题是假的。他们亲眼看到了机器人工作的速度和效率。很不幸地，他们还抓到了两个正用大锤破坏自动护卫的员工。当然，我受到了指责。工人们开始认为我跟管理层是一伙的，并且用尽手段帮助他们以求自保。

汤姆·麦克马林
供应厂监工

original:
News broke out today over the loud speakers that everyone needs to vacate the plant by 1 PM. "Due to budget cuts, this plant is shutting down." The men knew at once there was no budget cut. They ultimately decided I was to blame, having seniority in this section of the plant. As soon as I heard the news, I grabbed my pistol and made for the exit. It was quickly barricaded. I turned around and ran into this utility closet and locked the door behind me. I'll stay in here until the men go home.

Tom McMullin
Supply Plant Supervisor
translation:
今天一个大消息使整个工厂炸开了锅，所有人被要求在下午一点撤出工厂。“由于预算削减，工厂被关闭了。”工人们知道根本就没有什么预算削减。他们最后认为应该找资历最老的我算账。一听到这个说法，我就抓起了手枪奔向出口。但路很快被堵上了。我四处躲藏，最后跑进了这间公共储藏室并锁上了身后的门。我将呆在这里直到工人们都回家了。

汤姆·麦克马林
供应厂监工

original:
I begged them to leave before the robots got here. They laughed and said they'd take care of the robots, it's me they wanted. Then came the familiar rattle of a Protectron. That got their attention. I soon heard laughter, cursing, and screaming down the hall. I opened the door and stepped outside. A couple of the workers burst around the corner screaming for help. A red laser lashed out from down the hall and severed Tim's right arm in two. I panicked and ran back into the closet and shut the door. The men slammed into the door and begged me to open it. I didn't say a word, just sat stunned, listening to their screams of agony as the robot finished them off one by one. Then silence. I put my ear to the door and listened. I heard the clanking of Protectron feet down the hall. I grabbed my pistol and backed away from the door. No way am I opening this door for anyone or anything! Whoever reads this, let it be known that I did everything in my power to keep everyone's job at the plant. And let this be an example of how not to replace humans with machines.

Tom McMullin
Supply Plant Supervisor
translation:
我求工人们在机器人来到之前离开工厂，他们嘲笑我的请求还说他们能收拾那些机器人，他们想要的是我。接着传来了自动护卫那吱嘎作响的脚步声，这引起了工人们的注意。紧接着我听到了从下面的大厅传来了笑声，咒骂声，和尖叫声。我打开了门，走了出去。工人们四散躲在角落里，大声呼救。一术红色的光线从大厅射来把蒂姆的右臂切成了两段。我跑回了储藏室然后重新锁上了门，我吓坏了。工人们捶打着门求我把门打开。我一句话也没说，只是惊恐地坐在那里听着当机器人一个一个地杀掉他们时，他们痛苦的号叫。接着外面静了下来，我把耳朵贴在门上倾听，我听到了在下面的大厅，机器人的移动时发出的哐啷声。我紧握着手中的手枪，离门远远地。我绝对不会为任何人或者东西开门！不管是谁读到了这些，告诉人们我做了我所能做的一切来保住每一个人的工作。就当这是一个教训，告诉人们为什么不该用机器来代替人类。

汤姆·麦克马林
供应厂监工

original:
Incident Report 08-07-77

Reporting Officer: Harold Callahan

Fire alarm was sounded at approximately 10:05 A.M. in the vending area near Cafeteria B3. I immediately rushed to the location and encountered General Robert Dobbs kicking a Nuka-Cola machine repeatedly. General Dobbs ignored my order to stand down from his actions and drew his sidearm. He then proceeded to fire 7 shots into the machine, rupturing several bottles and piercing the coin box. After the coins began pouring to the floor, he picked up one of them and exclaimed "Stealing from a superior officer? Are you out of your MIND, soldier?" He holstered his sidearm and looked at me, then back at the machine and simply stated, "Well don't just stand there, I believe this soldier needs a medic, son."
The general was relieved of his sidearm and placed in our lockup facility until Metro D.C. Police arrived to pick him up.
translation:
事件报告08-07-77

报告警官：哈罗德·克拉汉

火警大约是在上午10:05响起的，地点在B3自助餐厅附近的外卖区。我马上赶赴事发地点，在那里正看到罗伯特·多博斯将军正在不停地踢一台核子可乐贩售机。多博斯将军无视我制止他的命令还拔出了随身武器。接着他连续向贩售机射了7枪，打碎了几个瓶子还射穿了投币箱。硬币倾泄了一地，他捡起了其中的一个大喊道：“敢偷高级军官的钱？你“疯了”么，士兵？”他收起他的佩枪并看着我，而后背对着贩售机轻描淡写的说，“别光在那站着，我认为这个士兵需要个医生，孩子。”
将军被缴械了佩枪并被安置在我们的紧闭室直到地铁特区警方到达并将其带走。

original:
Incident Report 08-16-77

Reporting Officer: Harold Callahan

Secretary Maybel Meyers from Accounting Division called us down here and reported an altercation between two other secretaries. Sergeant Deke DaSilva and I arrived at the scene to find two female secretaries, Carol Wallace and Isabelle Franks, scuffling on the floor. We broke up the altercation and took their statements. Ms. Wallace was accusing Ms. Franks of being a "...spy for those damn Red bastards!" and stating that she overheard "...secret conversations between Isabelle and her Chinese conspirators!" Ms. Franks simply stated she was "Speaking to her husband about weekend plans." Both ladies were given a warning and sent home for the day by their supervisors.

Tensions have been running high lately ever since the incidents in Alaska, and this is just one example of the effect it is having on everyone.
translation:
事件报告 08-16-77

报告警官：哈罗德·卡拉汉

会计部门的梅伯尔·迈尔斯秘书叫我们来这里，并报告了另外两个秘书之间的争吵事件。得克·德索瓦警官和我到达现在时发现两个女秘书，卡罗尔·华莱士和伊莎贝尔·弗兰克斯，正在地板上扭打。我们将她们拉开并停她们陈述。华莱士女士责难弗兰克斯女士说她是“该死的共匪特务！”并叙述了她偶然听到的“伊莎贝尔和她的中共阴谋家之间的秘密会谈。”弗兰克斯女士则反驳说她只是“在和她的丈夫讨论关于周末的计划。”两位女士都受到了警告并由他们的监督者送回了家。

自从发生军事冲突发生以来阿拉斯加的局势越来越紧张，这只是对所有人产生的影响中的一个例子而已。

Marcella -

Obadiah

original:
The New Plague and YOU
Copyright and Distributed by Presidential Fitness Program 2059

Know the Signs!
Safeguard yourself and your community by knowing how to identify a person suffering from the New Plague. Common symptoms include:
* Profuse Sweating
* Unexplained Contusions/Swelling
* Massive External Hemorrhaging
* New Ideals, such as socialism

When you believe you’ve come into contact with a person exhibiting one or more or these tell-tale signs, remember to C I R:

C - Confirm Symptoms.  
     Approach the person suffering from symptoms if no Civil or Medical professional is available to do so. Verify that the subject is exhibiting symptoms of New Plague.

I - Isolate!
     Once it’s been established that a case of New Plague may be present, separate yourself and the person exhibiting symptoms from the general population, as the New Plague is notoriously contagious.

R - Report! 
     Report directly to the nearest Federal Fitness Registry of Medical Center and let the professionals handle it from there!

Protect Yourself!
The New Plague is what’s commonly known as a “social disease”. This means that the New Plague is especially contagious and can be commonly caught in the course of social interactions such as:
* Ice Cream Socials
* Cruising Main Street
* Promiscuous Activity/Sodomy
* Attending Fairs or Festivals

So; what’s the best protection against social diseases? Why not stay home and enjoy a novel or home-cooked meal? Limiting your exposure to other individuals is the best and more surefire way to avoid contracting the New Plague.

Get Registered!
Did you know that your government can protect you from the New Plague and other biological dangers? It’s true, and all you need to do is visit your local Federal Fitness Registry. Friendly Federal Professionals will be on hand to take a few minor samples and enter you in the national registry.

Your compliance with the Federal Registry Program not only keeps medical professionals up-to-date on your medical history and status, but contributes to valuable research programs - and makes you eligible for special prizes, such as fuel rations or vacations to exotic domestic locales!

你与新瘟疫
版权与发布权属于2059总统健康计划

请了解这些标志！
学会如何辨别一个感染了新瘟疫的人，保卫你和你的社区，新瘟疫的常见的症状有：
* 过度流汗
* 无法解释的挫伤或是肿胀
* 大量的外部出血
* 出现新的意识形态，比如社会主义

一旦你确定你遇见了一个或更多具有以上症状的人，请记得“CIR”三个字母：

C - 确认症状。 
     如果没有医疗专家的情况下，亲自接近这该人，确定其表现出新瘟疫的症状。

I - 隔离！
     一旦确定可能出现新瘟疫，介于新瘟疫的高度传染性，将你自己和疑似瘟疫患者与公众隔离开。

R - 报告！ 
     直接向最近的联邦医疗中心健康登记处报告，并且让专家们去处理这一切。

保护好你自己！
众所周知，新瘟疫是一场社会性疾病。这就意味着它具有高度的传染性，而极易在日常生活交往中传播，比如：
* 结伴去冷饮店
* 逛街
* 滥交/鸡奸
* 参加节日等大型活动

既然如此，怎么样才是最好的对付社会性疾病的方法呢？为什么不呆在家里自娱自乐，读读小说做做饭呢？减少你与他人的接触是最好最有效地避免接触瘟疫的方法。

来登记吧！
你知道政府可以保护你免于遭受瘟疫或是其他生物疾病的威胁么？这是真的，你所需要做的就是去你当地的联邦健康登记处。热情的联邦专家们将会为你提取一些样本，并帮你成功登入国家信息系统。

您对于联邦注册计划的支持不仅可以让医疗专家时刻们对你的情况了如指掌，而且还可以为有价值研究项目起到巨大的贡献——你还可以获得特殊奖励，比如燃料补助，或是到别样风情的景区旅游哦！

original: Victoria was badly wounded today. She took a truck of supplies out to the Ark & Dove Cathedral beyond the river. Most of the locals we want to help are living in primitive dwellings in the wetlands. The Cathedral offered the closest public building to that area. translation: 你知道政府可以保护你免于遭受瘟疫或是其他生物疾病的威胁么？这是真的，你所需要做的就是去你当地的联邦健康登记处。热情的联邦专家们将会为你提取一些样本，并帮你成功登入国家信息系统。\n\n您对于联邦注册计划的支持不仅可以让医疗专家时刻们对你的情况了如指掌，而且还可以为有价值研究项目起到巨大的贡献——你还可以获得特殊奖励，比如燃料补助，或是到别样风情的景区旅游哦！

Task Details - Point Lookout Survey Expedition
Roach, Martin J.
<For Your Eyes Only>
Dr. Roach - 

On behalf of The Bysshe Company, thank you for accepting this contract. You will be posing as a research intern, reporting to Principal Geologist Caroline Saunders. Her experience with wetlands excavation makes her the only real suitable candidate. However; Saunders is a known liberal with academic ties.

We have only recently acquired excavation rights in the area. We believe that the mass burials of the American Civil War in this region have made the soil ripe for our purposes. This is the very same reason we are apprehensive about Saunders' liberal leanings

Your primary mission is to prevent Saunders from discovering the link between Point Lookout's bloody past and its probable richness in natural bio-gas resources. Code Blue protocols are authorized per your discretion. Saunders must be prevented from hampering this resource at every cost.

Hunter spent another session in interrogation room B with the surviving crew member from the Chinese spy sub the Navy is attempting recovery on. This guy's demonstrating extraordinary fortitude for a relatively low-ranking grunt. Can't say the Chinese don't make good soldiers out of their boys. I'm sure this one would have gone the same way as his skipper if the cyanide capsule in his molar hadn't been a dud.
 

Hunter requested method B interrogation clearance, so I'm putting through to Quantico for that in the morning.

亨特又在B审讯室跟那个幸存的艇员谈了一阵子，我们的人正试图恢复艇上的可用情报。作为一个低级步兵，他所表现得异乎寻常的不屈不挠。不得不说中国训练出的军人都是好样的。我相信如果他臼齿里的胶囊没有失效的话，他现在早就跟他的艇长一个下场了。
 

亨特要求许可进行方案B，所以我早晨得去趟匡蒂科 把这事儿搞定.

original:
Federal Agencies have added a new person of interest to our watch list. 

Doctor Jiang is a Chinese National defector. Naturalization agents in Norfolk processed his defection after jumping over from a merchant ship he was stowed away on. Jiang was apparently in communication with a US Naval Intelligence contact for some months prior. He's reportedly brokered an immunity deal in exchange for his help recovering intelligence from the downed submarine off our coast.
 
Jiang is staying in room 1D at the Homestead Motel off the boardwalk. We're explicitly forbidden from issuing a search warrant against this location, but are authorized to monitor his activities in public.
translation:
联邦局增列一个嫌疑目标。

江博士是一位中国叛逃者。他原先藏在一艘商船上，后来又跳了下去，被移民局的人发现。很显然江几个月前一直在和一位美国海军情报部门的人联系。据传他们之间有笔交易，他提出帮助我们复原坏在海岸线附近的那艘潜艇里面的情报，以此换取豁权。
 
江现在位于木板路的如家汽车旅馆1D房间。有严令禁止我们对这一地区发搜查令，但是我们可以公开监视他的活动。
美国海军国防情报局研究报告

Intelligence reports of Chinese activity in Maryland prompted local search efforts, which yielded an anonymous tip leading to Yang's capture and transfer to Turtledove Detention Camp. Demonstrates remarkable resistance to interrogation, but yielded **CLASSIFIED**, connecting the Chinese Intelligence community to **CLASSIFIED**. \n<Admin Notice: File altered by Intelligence Officer SN#182-129>
translation: 杨婉，可疑的中国特务。她先前也受过监禁，2062年在加拿大，被怀疑与尼亚加拉恐怖活动有关。杨在被押往纽约奥尔巴尼的时候逃跑了。有关中国人在马里兰活动的情报引起了当地有关部门的注意，最终一个匿名情报使杨落网并被扭送斑鸠拘留所。面对审讯表现强硬，但是产生了**机密**， 联系中国情报委员会以**机密**。

original: Brenner observed suspicious activity after lights out yesterday. Prisoners apparently snuck into morgue overnight. He had the good sense not to apprehend them before reporting the event. We've known for some time about a septic runoff access point in the basement which would be a good candidate for escapees. The runoff flows southwest of the camp about a quarter of a mile or so. \n\nWe'll keep a low profile about this and post guards in the area. They could make their break any night. Meanwhile I'll try and find an excuse to send somebody down there and check it out without arousing suspicion. I'd rather catch them in the act.
translation: 布伦纳昨天熄灯之后观察到了可疑的行为。囚犯们深夜偷偷爬进了太平间。他明智地选择了没有在报告之前逮捕他们。我们对于地下室中那条被腐蚀出来的径流已经了解了一段时间，而这很可能会成为逃犯们的首选。这条径流通往营地西南方向，距离大概是四分之一英里。\n\n我们会对此保持低调并派往这一区域加派安保。他们可能说不定哪天晚上就会逃走的。同时我会试着找个借口派人下去调查一下，而又不引起他们的怀疑。我想，最好是能将他们当场抓获。

original:
Project Name: MPLX (Military Plasma Experimental) "Novasurge"
Item: Prototype Plasma Pistol
Section: A61
Dept. Head: Doctor Aldwin Morley
Report Number: 040663-02

The Novasurge has proven to be a tough nut to crack. The output is still very high, causing massive injury to targets, but it's drawing far too much power from its energy cells. We also need to get the weight down on the weapon, as it's a bit heavy for a simple replacement sidearm. The problem still seems to be the coolant coils which are accounting for almost 50% of the weapon's weight. The good news is that the housing for the weapon has been approved, and this is likely the final design. Unfortunately, I need to increase our staff's hours to 7 days a week again so we can have the final prototype ready for testing by the end of the year.
translation:
项目名称：MPLX（军用等离子实验）“新星涌动”
物件：原型等离子手枪
部门：A61
部门负责人：奥尔德温·莫利博士
报告编号：040663-02

事实证明，新星涌动是一颗难处理的钉子。输出功率仍很高，能对目标造成重创，但从能量电池中汲取的能量过多。我们还需要减轻武器的重量，因为它作为一款简易替换副武器来说太重了。问题似乎仍出在冷却液线圈上，那几乎占据了武器重量的50%。好消息是，武器的外壳已经获批准，这很可能是最终设计。不幸的是，我又得增加我们人员的工作时间，一周工作7天，这样我们能在年底前准备好最终原型，以供测试。

I told Joey this was a bad idea. I told him it stunk like rotten meat, yeah, but he didn't like that. No one tells Joey what to do. Joey does what he wants, and we follow. 

Yeah, we all follow - except me. Haha! Motherfuckers. I saw them coming before everyone else. First watch and I got the fuck out of there. Slipped out before anyone even knew they were coming - saw my chance and I took it.

It's a goddamn shame, is what it is. A waste of fucking muscle. Way to go, Joey.

I watched them rip open your guts and spill your insides onto the pavement - what a smell that would have been. Fucking ripe. Nasty.
translation:
我告诉乔伊，这是一个坏主意。 我告诉他它像烂肉一样臭，是的，但他不喜欢那样。 没有人告诉乔伊该做什么。 乔伊做他想做的事，我们跟随着。

是的，我们都跟着 - 除了我。 哈哈！ 我先于其他人看到他们。 第一次看见，把我没吓死。 我赶在所有人发现他们之前溜了出来 - 我看到了机会，我抓住了它。

这算什么，这是一个该死的耻辱。 浪费他妈的表情。 爷要走了，乔伊。

我看着他们撕开你的内脏，把你的内脏洒到人行道上 - 那会是一个什么样的气味。 他妈的幼稚了。 讨厌。

original: The survivor population continues to become more agitated. A group of three men were caught trying to sneak inside of the perimeter last night. They were arrested and escorted away without further incident, except for waking up the rest of the camp. I think we will see them again.\n\nWe have to keep order. Just hold out until we can make contact with other units. Radiation sickness takes time. A woman was complaining of incessant itching all over her body. Her shirt had melted into the skin of her back. It was impossible to remove. There are so many bodies. We have to burn them to prevent disease from spreading.
translation: 幸存者人口继续变得更加激动。 昨晚三名男子被发现试图从外围向内部潜行。 他们被逮捕，并押送离开，没有进一步的事件，除了唤醒营地的其余人。 我想我们会再次见到他们。\n\n我们必须保持秩序。 坚持到我们可以与其他单位联系。 放射病需要时间。 一位女士抱怨她的身体不停地瘙痒。 她的衬衫融化在她背部的皮肤里。 这是不可能消除的。 身体太多了。 我们要烧掉他们，以防止疾病蔓延。

original:
We have not been able to make contact with any other units in this area.

The survivors have organized themselves and elected a leader. We negotiate with him now to distribute medicine and food. He understands that our supplies are nearly diminished. We all face dehydration and starvation. The first stages of radiation poisoning are showing now. Some are showing acute symptoms while others seem completely unaffected.

Most of the survivors had been inside. They had been lucky enough to be in buildings that didn't collapse in rooms without windows or basements that shielded against the firestorm. The air is sucked out of your lungs. The fires burn so hot, consuming so much oxygen that people are pulled into them with the rushing wind. Parts of the city are still burning, far off in the distance. 

Funny - it's completely silent.
translation:
我们无法与该地区的任何其他单位取得联系。

幸存者组织起来并推选领导人。 我们现在与他谈判分发药品和食品。 他知道我们的供应几乎没多少了。 我们都面临脱水和饥饿。 辐射中毒的第一阶段现在正在显现。 有些人表现出急性症状，而其他人似乎完全不受影响。

大多数幸存者都在里面。 他们很幸运能够进入没有倒塌的建筑物或地下室的房间里，这些房间可以防止风暴。 空气被吸出肺部。 火灾燃烧得如此之烈，消耗了大量的氧气，以至于人们和汹涌的狂风争夺氧气。 这个城市的部分区域仍然在燃烧。

滑稽的 - 这是完全沉默。

original:
Rumors started spreading that we were killing the sick and the old to save food for ourselves. The truth is we don't have any. Food - we ran out three days ago and just haven't told them, for fear this would happen. We have lost control.

They marched on us before nightfall and demanded to be let beyond the perimeter. Hunger is a strong motivator. I heard the shot, and then we returned fire. Corporal Bradley was killed defending his post. One of them had found a pistol. 

We killed two men and one woman. The rest were dispersed with tear-gas. It was the same man that had been caught sneaking into the camp before. He had lost all of his hair.

We are waiting now for them to come back. There is a national guard depot to the North. It may not be there anymore. We will try and make for this position in better hopes of making contact with other units.

How will they greet us? How will we greet them?
translation:
有谣言说我们为了节约粮食杀死病人和老人。 事实是我们没有。 食品 - 我们三天前跑了出来，只是没有告诉他们，就怕会发生这种事。 我们已经失去了控制。

他们在夜幕降临前向我们游行示威，并要求离开外围。 饥饿是一个强大的动力。 我听到枪声，然后我们还击。 布拉德利下士被杀，是因为有人要谋取他的职位。 在其中一人身上发现了一把手枪。

我们杀了两个男人和一个女人。 其余的用催泪瓦斯驱散。 其中被杀的男人和之前潜入营地是同一个男人。 他已经失去了所有的头发。

现在，我们正在等待他们回来。 北方有一个国家警卫站。 它现在可能不存在了。 我们将努力为这个职位做好准备，希望与其他地方取得联系。

他们将如何迎接我们？ 我们将如何迎接他们？

通知所有员工。 我们将于10月24日星期日举行有关安全系统和快速响应的演习。 正常轮班的所有人员都应该意识到这是一次演习！

安全负责人
佩里纽曼

original: Some senators just burst into my office here and said that the bombs have started to fall! They've demanded that I take them to shelter, so I'm taking them down into the fallout shelter on the emergency reactor sublevel for safety. If anyone finds this, come get us when this is all over!
translation: 一些参议员刚刚冲进我的办公室，并说炸弹已经开始下降！ 他们要求我带他们去避难所，所以为了安全起见，我带他们进入紧急反应堆分区的休息室。 如果有人发现了这一点，当这一切结束后来救我们！

original: That's great Tom, she'll be happy to hear that.
translation: 给伟大的汤姆，她会很高兴听到这个消息。

original: My husband is out of town next weekend. Can't wait to see you! XOXO
translation: 我的丈夫下周末不在城里。 迫不及待地想见到你！XOXO

original: The auto-start on the emergency reactor STILL doesn't work. This needs to be fixed ASAP! If the power goes out and that reactor doesn't kick on the station will go into security lockdown, and we do NOT want that to happen!
translation: 应急反应堆STILL上的自动启动不起作用。 这需要尽快修复！ 如果电源熄火且电抗器没有启动，电台将进入安全锁定状态，我们不希望这种情况发生！
图纸 - 生物气体手雷

original:
At a workbench, combine:
1 Box of Abraxo Cleaner
1 Piece of Human Flesh
1 Piece of Scrap Electronics
3 Tin Cans

Highly flammable gasses derived from the decomposition of human flesh via the use of lye, pressurized into a can. Throw at an area to leave a flammable cloud!
translation:
在工作台，组合以下零件：
1盒阿伯莱萨清洁剂
1 一块
1 一块电子废料
3个锡罐

使用碱液分解人肉产生的高度易燃气体，加压后装入罐中。向某一区域投掷时会留下易燃云雾！

original: Research Log - Reinforced Night Vision Goggles
translation: 研究日志－强化夜视眼镜

original:
~~~ Armor Research ~~~

Subject -> Reinforced Night Vision Goggles

Researcher -> R. Rockfowl

Analysis -> God damn formalities, anyways, these things are pretty damn sweet. They seem to be a series of prototype models that were made from some state-of-the-art alloy the US military was developing during the war. Never adopted, low availability - as in, you have to risk your ass to get your hands on any of these babies, always in armories and high security military installations.

Their benefits seem to be a huge boost in reliability, durability, and that they stop bullets pretty well - puts one hell of a strain on your neck though! Certainly worth it to look for these in future scavenging missions, scouts could benefit from being able to see at night and not worry about getting their brains blown out the backs of their heads.

P.S. To all you scribe nerds that WILL get on my case about "informalities" and "lack of academic literacy"; you can come on out to the surface for once in your career and kiss my shiny, power armored ass. I don't even know why the hell we keep these logs in separate text files, on individual terminals no less.
translation:
~~~ 装甲研究 ~~~

课题 -> 强化夜视眼镜

研究员 -> R. 洛克菲尔

分析 -> 该死的繁文缛节，不管怎么说，这些东西还真他妈不错。它们似乎是一系列原型模型，由美军在战争期间开发的某种最先进的合金制成。从未被采用，可用性低--也就是说，你必须冒着生命危险才能搞到这些宝贝，它们总是藏在军械库和戒备森严的军事设施里。

它们的优点似乎是可靠性和耐用性大大提高，而且能很好地阻挡子弹，不过会对脖子造成很大的负担！当然，在未来的搜救任务中值得一试，侦察兵们可以从夜间视物中获益，而不用担心脑浆从后脑勺喷出来。

附带一提，你们这些文士书呆子，要是再跟我说什么 “不拘小节 ”和 “缺乏学术素养”，那就在你们的职业生涯中到地表上来一次，亲亲我闪闪发光的装甲屁股吧。我甚至不知道我们为什么要把这些日志保存在不同的文本文件中，而且还是在不同的终端上。

original: Tamper with that, and we're going to have a problem.
translation: 碰那东西，我们会有麻烦。

original: I really hope you're not thinking of breaking into there.
translation: 我希望你不是打算破门而入。

original: It's locked for a reason. Don't get any ideas.
translation: 它被锁是有原因的。别打什么主意。

original: Yes, that's locked. And yes, I can see you eyeing it...
translation: 是的，那锁了。而且，我能看到你正盯着它……

original: Don't even think of breaking into that.

translation: 它被保护起来是有原因的。

original: Hey, now. That's my stuff. If you want something, you gotta buy it.
translation: 嗨。那是我的东西。如果你想要什么，你就得买下来。

original: Whoa, whoa, whoa, hands off the goods.
I don't think you should mess with that.
translation: 我想你不该去碰那东西。

original: What do you think you're doing?
You won't get away with that.
What the hell do you think you're doing?
What do you think you're doing?
Well, I guess you weren't such a jerk after all.
translation: 好吧，我想你不是一个蠢货。

original: Wow, you look like you've been through Hell.
translation: 哇，你看起来像刚从地狱里回来。

original: Welcome to the Chop Shop. I'm Nurse Graves, Doctor Barrows' assistant.
translation: 欢迎来到排骨店。我是格雷芙护士，巴罗斯医生的助手。

original: Don't let our place's name fool you. The Doctor is very good with injuries, dismemberments, and trauma.
translation: 别被我们这地方的名字吓到。医生对内伤、断肢和外伤都很在行。

original: If you require any Stimpaks or Bloodpacks, let me know.
translation: 如果你需要治疗针或血浆袋，就告诉我。

original: And how can we help you today?
translation: 今天我能为你做些什么？

original: Doctor Barrows at your service. What brings you to the Chop Shop?
translation: 巴罗斯医生为你服务，什么风把你吹到排骨店的？

original: Come to lend me a hand I hope. I can always use fresh human samples.
translation: 我希望你过来帮把手。新鲜人类标本对我来说总是有用。

original: Yes, what is it now? Please, be brief. I'm quite busy.
translation: 是的，什么事？请简要说明。我很忙。

original: Another human with a death wish... Welcome to the Mall, tourist.
translation: 又来个找死的……欢迎来到商业街，旅行者。

original: You did me a great favor with those keys. How do you like my new armor? Those keys led me right to it.
translation: 很感激你帮我拿到了钥匙，喜欢我的新装甲吗？那些钥匙让我得到了它。

original: Please! Don't shoot! Oh man, don't hurt me! I just work here!
translation: 噢老兄！别伤害我！我只是个在这儿干活的！

original: Well now, look who made it back.
I'll take those ingots, scab. You just get back in there and get about your business.
translation: 我会拿走那些钢锭，渣滓，你只是回到那边，干好你自己的事。

original: You got a real knack for this! Here, this might help you work a little harder. Original owner can't use it anymore, on account of decapitation.
translation: 你找到了真正的窍门！给，这可以帮你更卖力的干活。它原来的主人是用不上了，因为他被砍了头。

original: Well now, aren't you quite the scrapper? Congratulations.
translation: 你不就是个非常喜欢打架的人吗？恭喜。

original: You've done well. Ashur wishes to see you. The guards will be told to allow you to pass.
translation: 你做的很好，阿舒尔希望见你。守卫们将会接到通知，允许你通过。

original: You came to visit! You'll never guess what I found out in the Wastes, when I was supposed to be patrolling.
translation: 你来看看！你肯定想不到我在废土巡逻的时候发现了什么。

original: There you go! I hope you like it.
Good things, sweetie. Tonic's brewed and bottled.
translation: 做得好，亲爱的。药剂酿造好并且装满了。

original: Here's your pay and cut of the batch. Enjoy it!
translation: 这是你的报酬并且分给你一些。祝你愉快！

original: Y'ain't have the look of a local, son. Think you could help a sick woman get on the mend?
translation: 你还没有拜访过当地，孩子。你认为你可以帮助生病的女士痊愈吗？

original: Hey, I didn't know you were exploring, too! You don't know where we are, do you?
translation: 嘿，我不知道你也在探索呢！你不会知道我们在哪儿，对吧？

original: No students in Hall without Pass. Visitors must sign in at Administration.
translation: 没有学生可以不用通行证就进入天堂。来访者必须在管理处登记。

original: I have to get out of here!
Where could we go even if we did escape? We'd just die in the Wasteland.
translation: 即使我们逃了我们又能去哪呢？我们只能死在废土。

original: Got to hand it to you kid. That was a brave thing you did, risking your life to start the Purifier.
translation: 该把这个给你。你很勇敢，你冒着生命危险启动了净化器。

original: But, do you know you've made my life a living hell? I'm guessing not.
translation: 但是，你知道你把我的生活搞得一团糟了吗？我猜你不知道。

original: The hero of the Wasteland probably has more important things to worry about. Don't you?
translation: 看来我们的废土英雄还有更重要的是要担心。 不是吗？

original: Can't say I blame you kid-o. I wouldn't have risked it either. That Sarah on the other hand, she's got a bleeding heart like her old man.
translation: 到不能说我是在埋怨你。换作是我我也不会冒险。但是莎拉就不同了，他跟他家老爷子一样是个软心肠。

original: Oh, and bravo for giving her that code to the Purifer. Since then, my life's been a living hell.
translation: 噢，还给了她净化器的密码，。从那之后，我的生活就乱了套了。

original: And I have YOU to thank for that.
translation: 而这一切都是拜你所赐。

original: ...okay. You got all that? I think you know enough now to at least move around in Power Armor without killing yourself. That’s something, right?
translation: ……好，你都了解了？我看你已经清楚怎样穿着动力装甲才不会送命了。那不赖，对吧？

original: You will come to regret your actions.
translation: 你会为你的行为后悔的。

original: You'll live just long enough to regret your error in judgement.
translation: 你将来会有时间后悔你的判断失误的。

original: Good job taking care of our little problem.
translation: 帮我们处理了小问题，干得漂亮。现在，如果你不介意的话……

original: You should be proud of your accomplishment.
translation: 你该为自己的成就自豪。

original: Do not interfere with security operations.
I'm sorry, but I am not at liberty to chat right now.
translation: 很抱歉，我现在不方便聊天。

original: Do I look like I have time for idle chitchat?
translation: 我看上去像是有空和你闲聊的样子吗？

original: Do not interfere with security operations.
I'm sorry, but I am not at liberty to chat right now.
translation: 很抱歉，我现在不方便聊天。

original: So, it looks like you decided to do things their way huh. How come?
translation: 你看上去决定按他们的方式做。为什么？

original: I guess it's my turn to thank you.
Anyway, the area's secure, so you're free to talk to Three Dog if you need to.
translation: 总之，这区域是安全的。需要的话，你可以随意和三狗谈。

original: By the way, because you helped us I'm going to let you wear that Power Armor. But don't you ever forget where it came from.
translation: 顺便提一下，因为你救了我们，我准备让你穿上动力装甲，但是别忘了它是从哪里来的。

original: I guess it's my turn to thank you.
Anyway, the area's secure, so you're free to talk to Three Dog if you need to.
translation: 总之，这区域是安全的。需要的话，你可以随意和三狗谈。

original: Welcome to Rivet City. Please wait while the bridge extends.
translation: 欢迎来到铆钉城。请等待放好吊桥。

original: Salutations, Commander! Sergeant RL-3, Gutsy-class robotic soldier, reporting for duty!
translation: 敬礼，指挥官！RL-3中士，“勇敢”级机器人士兵，前来报到！

original: My name's Clover. I hear you're the new man in my life.
translation: 我叫可萝尔。我听说你是我人生中的新男人。

original: You're looking for a bodyguard, and I'm looking for a body. Sounds like we're going to have some fun times, lover.
translation: 你在找保镖，而我在找肉体。看来我们会有些开心的日子，亲爱的。

original: My name's Clover. I hear you're the new woman in my life.
translation: 我叫可萝尔。我听说你是我人生中的新女人。

original: You're looking for a bodyguard, and I'm looking for a body. Sounds like we're going to have some fun times, lover.
translation: 你在找保镖，而我在找肉体。看来我们会有些开心的日子，亲爱的。

original: Carry on. I've got this in hand.
If you're here to help, then help. If not... back off.
translation: 如果你来帮忙那就埋头帮忙。否则…就给我滚。

original: If you didn't notice, I'm busy. Get lost.
translation: 你没看到我在忙吗。走开。

original: Find someone else to bother, local.
I'm not looking for trouble, or conversation either.
translation: 我不想找麻烦，也不想和任何人交谈。

original: I've got nothing to say to you. Best move on.
translation: 我对你没什么好说的。最好继续走。

original: You don't seem to take a hint. Get out of my face.
translation: 你好像不明白我的意思，从我面前消失。

original: I'll mind my business, you mind yours.
translation: 我管好我的事，你管好你的。

original: I've got nothing to say to you. Best move on.
translation: 我对你没什么好说的。最好继续走。

original: Jesus, you really can't take a hint, can you?
translation: 天啊，你真的不能接受暗示，是吗？

original: Let me be blunt. Go away.
I don't know you, you don't know me. Let's keep it that way.
translation: 我不认识你，你也不认识我。让我们保持这种状态。

original: How about you just mind your own business, okay?
translation: 你就管好你自己的事吧，好吗？

original: Heard some more people got attacked last night.
translation: 听说昨晚又有人受袭击了。

original: Hey, I've been wanting to talk to you. Leo told me what you said to him. You know, about his problem.
translation: 嗨，我一直想和你说话。利奥告诉我你和他谈过，你知道，他的问题。

original: I just wanted to say thank you. I know I can be rough, but my little brother means the world to me and you may have saved his life.
translation: 我只是想说谢谢。我知道我可能比较失礼，但是我的弟弟对我来说就是整个世界，而你救了他的命。

original: If there's anything that I can ever help you with, just let me know.
translation: 如果还有什么事是我可以帮你的，请尽管告诉我。

original: Hey there, Leo's been doing a lot better. I think we have you to thank for that. How can I help you?
translation: 嗨，利奥现在做得好多了。我想我们该谢谢你。我能帮你什么忙吗？

original: Leo's tickets have stopped coming up short ever since he gave up the chems. Me and my wallet both thank you. What can we do for you?
translation: 自从利奥戒了毒，他不再缺钱。我和我的钱包都很谢谢你。我们能为你做什么？

original: Can't a man eat in peace? Go talk to Jenny or Leo if you need something.
translation: 不能让人安静吃饭吗？如果你需要什么去和珍妮或利奥说。

original: Look, I need to balance these books. If you'd like to order some food, please talk to Jenny or Leo.
translation: 听着，我需要对账。如果你要点吃的，去和珍妮或利奥说。

original: Yep. Still balancing the books. Is there something exciting about watching me? Look: Go talk to Jenny or Leo.
translation: 对。还在对账。你除了盯着我之外就没其他事可做了吗？听着：去和珍妮或利奥谈。

original: You again. Is there something exciting about watching me? Look: Go talk to Jenny or Leo.
translation: 又是你。你除了盯着我之外就没其他事可做了吗？听着：去和珍妮或利奥谈。

original: Hmm? Oh. I'm afraid I'm quite busy right now. If it's food you're after, talk to Jenny or Leo. Otherwise, I can't help you.
translation: 嗯？哦。我恐怕我现在很忙。如果你要些吃的，去和珍妮或利奥谈。否则我没什么可帮你的。

original: You again? Go Bother Jenny or Leo, will ya?
translation: 又是你？去找珍妮或利奥好吗？

original: Hooo weee! Look at you! Now I haven't seen one of those Vault jumpsuits in, wow, a LONG time. Pretty damn good condition, too!
translation: 哇~~！看看你！我多久不见这样的避难所工作服了。而且状况还真他妈不错！

original: Name's Billy Creel. You call me Billy, all right? I know Megaton looks more like a boneyard than a town, but it ain't all bad.
translation: 我是比利·克里，你叫我比利，好吗？我知道兆吨镇看起来更像是一个废车场而不是一个城镇，但是也不是都很糟。

original: Take me and Maggie, for instance. We make do just fine. I trade the stuff I scavenge, and she helps keep me on the straight and narrow. He he he.
translation: 拿我和玛姬举例。我们做得很好。我交易那些从废物中提取的东西，而她帮我保持循规蹈矩。呵呵呵。

original: Well hot damn! Someone new! Always a pleasure!
translation: 真是该死！新来的！太让人高兴了！

original: Name's Billy Creel. You call me Billy, all right? I know Megaton looks more like a boneyard than a town, but it ain't all bad.
translation: 我是比利·克里，你叫我比利，好吗？我知道兆吨镇看起来更像是一个废车场而不是一个城镇，但是也不是都很糟。

original: Take me and Maggie, for instance. We make do just fine. I trade the stuff I scavenge, and she helps keep me on the straight and narrow. He he he.
translation: 拿我和玛姬举例。我们做得很好。我交易那些从废物中提取的东西，而她帮我保持循规蹈矩。呵呵呵。

original: Look, bud. It'd be best if you just drift on by and leave us alone.
translation: 听着，伙计。你最好把自己挪开，让我们自己待着。

original: You again? Go Bother Jenny or Leo, will ya?
translation: 又是你？去烦珍妮或利奥，好吗？

original: Oh, baby! Let me get you something special. How about a Dukov surprise? Hah ha!
translation: 哦，宝贝！让我给你些什么特别的吧。杜克夫式的惊喜怎么样？哈哈！

original: Never mind. You need a drink. Cherry! Need some fucking booze over here!
translation: 没关系。你需要喝一杯。 雪莉！这边来些酒！

original: Hello sweet cheeks! What can old Dukov do for you?
translation: 你好，小甜心！老杜克夫能为你做点什么？

original: Never mind. You need a drink. Cherry! I'm thirsty over here!
translation: 没关系。你需要来杯喝的，雪莉！我渴死了！

original: Have you seen Cherry? I think the bitch ran out on me.
translation: 你看到雪莉了吗？我想这婊子在和我耍花样。

original: Never mind. You need a drink. Cherry! I'm thirsty over here!
translation: 没关系。你需要来杯喝的，雪莉！我渴死了！

original: Never mind. You need a drink. Fantasia! I'm thirsty over here!
translation: 没关系。你需要来杯喝的，凡塔纱！我渴死了！

original: Never mind. You need a drink. My women are gone, so help yourself.
translation: 没关系。你需要来杯喝的。我的女人走了，你自己动手吧。

original: Whatcha need? How about a drink? No? Suit yourself.
translation: 你要什么？来一杯？不？那你自己看着办。

original: Yeah, yeah, you're my hero. Don't let it go to your head. Seriously though, thank you for getting me away from Dukov.
translation: 嗯，嗯，你是我的英雄。不过不要自大。不过说真的，谢谢你帮我离开杜克夫。

original: So that prick Dukov is dead. Can't say I'll miss him.
translation: 这么说那讨厌的杜克夫死了。不能说我会想念他。

original: Even so, I'm going to need someone to protect me. A girl can't survive by herself in the Wasteland.
translation: 不过，我需要有人来保护我。一个女孩在废土是不能独自生存下去的。

original: Hey, good looking. I'm Cherry. Can I do anything for you?
translation: 嗨，帅哥。我是雪莉。有任何事可以帮你的吗？

original: Hi, sweetie. I'm Cherry. What can I do for you?
translation: 嘿，甜心。我是雪莉。我能为你做些什么吗？

original: Hi, sugar. I'm Cherry. Do yourself a favor. Watch yourself with Dukov. He's all hands.
translation: 嘿，甜心。我是雪莉。你自己动手做吧。小心杜克夫。他什么都做得出来。

original: He's dead! I'm going to miss the old lecher. We had some real fun times.
translation: 他死了！我会想念这色鬼的。有几次我们真的很尽兴。

original: Who's going to look after me now?
I uh... don't feel so good.
Am I drunk? I think I'm drunk... Do I seem drunk to you?
translation: 我醉了？我想我醉了……你看我醉了吗？

original: Whoa!!! Is it me, or is the world spinning?
translation: 哇！！！是我，还是这世界在转？

original: What is it? Can't you see that I'm watching the guards?
translation: 你要什么？快点说，你挡住我视线了。

original: What do you want? Make it quick, you're blocking my view!
translation: 哦……嗨！你想要什么，年轻的小伙？

original: Expulsion Protocol KL-001 in effect. Disengage voice parameters.
translation: 排除协议KL-001生效。脱离语音参数。

original: Yes, fellow employee? What can I do for you on this wonderful day?
translation: 怎么了，同事？在这美好的日子里我能帮你什么？

original: Hello there, fellow employee. I don't believe we've met. I'm your Factory Foreman, Milo. It's a pleasure to meet you.
translation: 你好，雇员。我不觉得我们见过面。我是你的工头，麦洛。很高兴认识你。

original: Please give me your job posting title and employee registration number for my permanent records.
translation: 请提供你的岗位名称和员工注册号，以便我永久记录。

original: Hello again, fellow employee. I still have no record of your posting or employee identification.
translation: 又见面了，同事。我仍然没有关于你的岗位或员工身份的记录。

original: Please give me your job posting title and employee registration number for my permanent records.
translation: 请提供你的岗位名称和员工注册号，以便我永久记录。

original: What do you want now? Come to make fun of me again?
translation: 这次你要什么？又来耍我？

original: No time to talk to your type, local.
translation: 没时间和你这种乡巴佬聊天。

original: Why don't you go bother the Brotherhood or something?
translation: 你咋不去纠缠兄弟会啥的？

original: Hey local, shouldn't you be banging rocks together, or something?
translation: 嗨，乡巴佬，你不是应该在和那些石块还是什么东西交欢嘛？

original: Don't push your luck out here.
Keep an eye out for those locals.
Oh, my head's still ringing from that explosion... What happened?
translation: 哦，爆炸以后我的头一直嗡嗡响……发生了什么？

original: Impressive, slave. I guess I shouldn't call you that anymore.
translation: 真犀利，奴隶。不过我想我不该再那样称呼你。

original: Not bad. Welcome to the club.
You do actually know how to plant mines, right?
translation: 你真的知道怎么埋设地雷，对吧？

original: The robots are over in the junkyard, in case you're wondering.
translation: 你想打听的话，机器人在废物堆积场那。

original: Are you going to show us how to fix the robots?
translation: 你准备让我们见识下怎样修理机器人？

original: So are you going to ever show us how to be sneaky so we can hide from the Super Mutants?
translation: 你是准备给我们演示怎么隐匿，让我们能躲开超级变种人吗？

original: I'm getting bored. I thought you were going to teach us something.
translation: 我开始无聊了。我还以为你会教我们些什么。

original: Go on, I'm watching. Show us what to do.
translation: 继续，我在看着。告诉我们做什么。

original: I'm confused. What am I supposed to be doing? Can you show me?
translation: 我糊涂了。我该做什么？你能给我演示下吗？

original: We're all watching you waiting to learn something. Well. Get on with it already!
translation: 我们都在看着你，等你教东西。来吧，准备好就开始吧。

original: Go on. I'm paying attention. Show us what to do.
translation: 来吧。我正在看着。告诉我们做什么。

original: Well, hotshot. Are you going to teach us something, or just stand there looking stupid?
translation: 自命不凡的家伙。你准备教我们些什么，还是像蠢货一样站着。

original: Oooh. I can't wait. Show us what to do!
translation: 哦，我等不下去了。教我们怎么做！

original: I'm watching. Go on. Teach us what to do.
translation: 我在看着，来吧，教我们怎么做。

original: Since you haven't pissed yourself I'll assume that you don't know who we are - next time I'll bring my sickle and wear my black cloak.
translation: 既然你没有被吓得尿裤子，那我估计你是还不认得我们，下次我会带上镰刀和黑披风的。

original: See, the NCR sends us when they want terrible things done to terrible people...
translation: 听着，当NCR希望恶人遭受恶运时，他们就会派我们登场……

original: HAHA! I love it. Another slave wandered back here, huh? What's wrong, couldn't get over the bridge? You're lucky I don't fuckin' paste you.
translation: 哼哼！我太高兴了，又搞回来一个奴隶，对吧？怎么啦，你连桥都过不来？算你走运，我他妈的没把你打成糨糊。

original: Why I should... wait... what the?
Now would you look at this? Where'd you get all this shit anyway? Whatever. Mine now. Thanks, Scab! I hit the jackpot today!
translation: 你要看看吗？不管咋说，你从哪搞到的这些狗屎？不管你愿不愿意，都是我的了。谢谢，渣滓！我今天赚大发了！

original: Now get back in there and get to work, or next time I'll just stake you out there for the Trogs.
translation: 现在回到那开始干活，要不然下次我会把你绑去喂兽化人。
走开！他们会瞧见我们的！

original: President Rosie? What's happening around here anyway?
translation: 萝丝总统？这附近到底发生什么事了？

original: Rosie? As President? You've got to be kidding me...
translation: 萝丝？做总统？你在开玩笑吧……

original: Well, now. President Bob. How do you like that? Boy, things are gonna change around here. First step: get rid of all this "Dave" shit.
translation: 好吧。鲍勃总统。你觉得那怎么样？孩子，这的一切都会改变的，第一步就是除去所有与“戴夫”相关的狗屎。

original: The Kingdom of Bob! Or maybe Bobtopia! I'll have to give it some thought.
translation: 鲍勃王国！要么就是鲍托邦！我会考虑下的。

original: But I guess you want something, don't you? Tell you what... Dave kept some old junk in that safe of his... I mean MY office. The code is 1138.
translation: 但是你需要什么，不是吗？告诉你吧……戴夫在他那保险箱放了些旧垃圾……我是说在“我的”办公室。密码1138。

original: Take whatever you want out of there. Consider it a gift from your kind and loving President Bob.
translation: 那的东西你尽管拿。就当是感谢你的对鲍勃总统的友善和热爱的回礼。

original: Maybe we need a flag? One with my picture on it. That could be pretty cool.
translation: 或许我们需要一面旗？上面有我的照片。那样可能很酷。

original: Maybe we need a flag? One with my picture on it. That could be pretty cool.
translation: 或许我们需要一面旗？上面有我的照片。那样可能很酷。

original: First things first, we're gonna have to open up the Museum of Bob.
translation: 当务之急，我们首先必须开放鲍勃博物馆。

original: Good work! That's one less Radroach to deal with.
translation: 干得好！又少了一只辐射蟑螂要操心了。

original: Let's get a picture together. Capture the moment.
translation: 让我们一起照张相。记住这瞬间。

original: You there. Hold it. Who the hell are you?
You're brave to keep bothering me. Or stupid.
translation: 你不停地打扰我真是很勇敢。或者说愚蠢。

original: You did it! You disarmed that thing!
translation: 干得好！你解除了那东西！

original: My dad... he... He would have been real happy about that. Thank you.
translation: 我父亲……他……他一定会为此感到很高兴的。谢谢。

original: He wanted you to have these... a key and the deed to an empty place up behind the Brass Lantern. You can move in there if you want.
translation: 他要你拿着这些……一把钥匙与黄铜灯后一间空房的地契。如果你愿意，可以去那住。

original: Oh, and talk to Moira at Craterside Supply. She can help you decorate the place.
translation: 哦，和坑边杂货店的莫伊拉谈谈。她能帮你装修那地方。

original: My dad told me about how you're going to disarm the bomb. He gave me some stuff for you for when you get it done...
translation: 我爸爸告诉了我你要解除那核弹。他让我在你完成后，把这些东西交给你。

original: You will come to regret your actions.
translation: 你会为你的行为后悔的。

original: You'll live just long enough to regret your error in judgement.
translation: 你将来会有时间后悔你的判断失误的。

original: I'll be damned! You did it, didn't you? You disarmed that thing!
translation: 该死！你做到了，对吧？你解除了那东西！

original: Hell, where's my manners? I'm Lucas Simms, mayor and sheriff. And I'm pleased to say, we've had a reward for fixing up that bomb. Here you go!
translation: 见鬼，失礼了！我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，镇长兼警长。我很荣幸的说，我们要给解除核弹的人报酬。拿着！

original: Y'know, we could use someone like you living in town. We've got an empty place up behind the Brass Lantern.
translation: 你知道，我们需要你这样的人留在镇里。我们在黄铜灯后有间空房。

original: And heck, Moira over at Craterside Supply can even sell you stuff to help fix the place up.
translation: 坑边杂货店的莫伊拉会卖给你家具去装修那地方。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，警长兼镇长，有需要时找我。

original: You got a weird look about you, boy. The kind that means trouble. I give everyone a fair shake. But if you do anything remotely stupid, you're dead.
translation: 你看起来很怪，孩子。通常这意味着麻烦。我对每个人一视同仁。但如果你干了什么蠢事，那你就死定了。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，警长兼镇长，有需要时找我。

original: You got a weird look about you, girl. The kind that means trouble. I give everyone a fair shake. But if you do anything remotely stupid, you're dead.
translation: 你看起来很怪，丫头。通常这意味着麻烦。我对每个人一视同仁。但如果你干了什么蠢事，那你就死定了。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，警长兼镇长，有需要时找我。

original: I don't know why, but I like you, boy! Something tells me you're all right. So welcome to Megaton! Just holler if you need something.
translation: 我不知道为什么，但我喜欢你，小子！我觉得你没问题。欢迎来到兆吨镇，需要什么尽管说。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，警长兼镇长，有需要时找我。

original: I don't know why, but I like you, girl! Something tells me you're all right. So welcome to Megaton! Just holler if you need something.
translation: 我不知道为什么，但我喜欢你，丫头！我觉得你没问题。欢迎来到兆吨镇，需要什么尽管说。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，警长兼镇长，有需要时找我。

original: I must be getting slow in my old age. Thanks for saving my hide, there.
translation: 我一定是老得迟钝了。谢谢你救了我。

original: Haven't disarmed the bomb yet? That's some serious Pre-War hardware. So go easy, okay?
