translation: 还没把那核弹解除？那可是一大块战前的五金产品，所以轻松些，好吗？

original: My, my. Just when I had all but given up hope. My dear boy, I am very happy to make your acquaintance. I am Mister Burke.
translation: 喔，喔。就在我失去所有希望的时候，我亲爱的孩子。认识你很高兴。我是伯克先生。

original: And you, well, you are not a resident of this putrescent cesspool. That makes you a rather valuable individual.
translation: 你，嗯，你不是这腐臭的污水池的居民。那让你更难能可贵。

original: My, my. Just when I had all but given up hope. My dear girl, I am very happy to make your acquaintance. I am Mister Burke.
translation: 喔，喔。就在我失去所有希望的时候，我亲爱的孩子。很高兴能认识你。我是伯克先生。

original: And you, well, you are not a resident of this putrescent cesspool. That makes you a rather valuable individual.
translation: 你，嗯，你不是这腐臭的污水池的居民。那让你更难能可贵。

original: You haven't rigged the bomb yet? If it's information you need, get to it. Time is wasting.
translation: 你还没有装配好核弹？如果有你需要的信息，就快点去了解。时不待人。

original: Back again, hmm? Perhaps you've reconsidered my offer?
translation: 又回来了，嗯？或许你已经再次考虑了我的提议？

original: Don't suppose you've disarmed that bomb?
translation: 你不是以为已经解除那核弹了吧？

original: I'll be damned! You did it, didn't you? You disarmed that thing!
translation: 该死！你做到了，对吧？你解除了那东西！

original: Here's your reward. Hell, why don't you move in? Could use someone like you. Got an empty place here you can use. Here's the key and deed.
translation: 这是你的报酬。见鬼，你干嘛不搬进来？我们需要你这样的人。有间空房你可以拿去用。这是钥匙和地契。

original: It ain't much to look at. But talk with Moira. She's got random odds and ends you might be able to spruce the place up with.
translation: 看起来不怎么样。但和莫伊拉谈谈，她有些零碎东西，你可以拿来装修下那地方。

original: I'll be damned! You did it, didn't you? You disarmed that thing!
translation: 该死！你做到了，对吧？你解除了那东西！

original: And all without asking for pay, too. Hell, why don't you move in?
translation: 完全不求回报。见鬼，你干嘛不搬进来？

original: Here's the key and the deed to an empty house. Consider yourself a Megaton citizen!
translation: 这是一间空房子的地契和钥匙。把你自己当成兆吨镇的镇民吧！

original: Oh and talk with Moira at Craterside Supply. She's got random odds and ends you might be able to spruce the place up with.
translation: 哦，还有去和坑边杂货店的莫伊拉谈谈。她有些零碎的东西，你可以拿来装修下那地方。

original: Get outta here! They see me talking to you, I'm dead!
translation: 滚出去！要是他们看到我和你在说话，我就死定了！

original: Thanks for helping us, mungo. You're not so bad for a mungo.
translation: 谢谢你对我们的帮助，毛人，作为一个毛人来说你真不错。

original: We're going home now. You watch out, okay?
translation: 我们现在得回家了。你小心，好吗？

original: Man, that sure was something. You're pretty brave, mungo!
translation: 伙计，真了不起，你真勇敢，毛人！

original: We can make it from here, no problem. But you watch your back. Those Slaver assholes aren't going to forget about you.
translation: 我们在这能搞定，没问题。但小心你的背后，那些混蛋奴隶贩子可不会忘了你。

original: Thanks for getting us out of there, mungo. We're gonna head back home now.
translation: 谢谢你帮我们逃出来，毛人。我们现在得回家了。

original: I'd think twice about coming back here if I were you. These guys aren't going to forget you, y'know?
translation: 如果我是你，就不会再想回到这。这些家伙不会忘了你的，你知道吗？

original: We'll meet you outside, if you can make it!
translation: 如果你搞定了，就到外面来找我们！

original: We'll meet you outside, if you can make it!
translation: 如果你搞定了，就到外面来找我们！

original: We'll meet you outside, if you can make it!
translation: 如果你搞定了，就到外面来找我们！

original: Oh geez, mungo! This is crazy!
We're gonna run for it. You come meet us outside if you make it!
translation: 我们该逃了。如果你搞定了就到外面来找我们！

original: Man, what a mess! Don't get yourself killed, mungo!
translation: 伙计，真是糟糕透了！别送了你的命，毛人！

original: I already shorted out the fence system so our collars won't blow. I bet they won't even notice.
translation: 我已经使栅栏系统短路，这样我们的项圈就不会爆炸。我打赌他们还没注意到。

original: You got the gate, huh? Okay, we're outta here!
translation: 你打开了门，呃？好，我们离开这！

original: Shoot a couple of those mungo ass-bag Slavers for me, will ya?
translation: 帮我打死那对混蛋毛人奴隶贩子，好吗？

original: Man, you've made a mess. Go get 'em, mungo! Get that key!
translation: 伙计，你搞砸了。干掉他们，毛人！拿到那钥匙！

original: You go take care of the bad guys. I'll just stay out here, and... stay out of the way.
translation: 你去干掉那些坏家伙。我待在这……不挡你的路。

original: I guess you decided to do this your own way, huh?
translation: 我想你决定按你的方式来，呃？

original: Well, now you've really done it. They're gonna kill you if they can, so you better kill them all first.
translation: 好，现在你已经搞定了。他们会竭尽所能杀死你，所以你最好先把他们都杀了。

original: Get the key for the slave pen gate off of the boss mungo, or that Forty asshole. If you can unlock the gate, we'll make a run for it.
translation: 从毛人老大或混蛋弗替那拿到奴隶栅栏门的钥匙。如果你能打开这门，我们就能逃出去。

original: Oh man, they're gonna be mad at you! These Slaver guys are mean!
translation: 哦 伙计，他们被你逼疯了！这些奴隶贩子很小气的！

original: Listen, you gotta help us. Me and my friends... We gotta get home. Can you help? Can you get us out of here?
translation: 听着，你得帮助我们，我和我的朋友……我们想回家。你能帮忙吗？你能帮我们逃出去吗？

original: You gonna help, or what? Squirrel and Penny are still in there.
translation: 你到底要不要帮忙？“松鼠”和佩尼还在里面呢。

original: Well, I guess that's it. Thanks for getting us out of there, mungo.
translation: 好了，我想就这样了。谢谢你帮我们逃出来，毛人。

original: We're going back home now. You ever come out that way, you stop and say hi. I'll tell Mayor not to shoot you okay?
translation: 我们现在得回家了。如果路过，你可以来打声招呼。我叫镇长不要开枪打你，好吗？

original: Well, I guess that's it. Thanks for getting us out of there, mungo.
translation: 好了，我想就这样了。谢谢你帮我们逃出来，毛人。

original: We're going back home now. You ever come out that way, you stop and say hi. I'll tell Mayor not to shoot you okay?
translation: 我们现在得回家了。如果路过，你可以来打声招呼。我叫镇长不要开枪打你，好吗？

original: Not bad, mungo. Not bad at all.
I told you I had a good plan. It sure worked, didn't it? You ever need anything, you go see MacCready in Lamplight. He'll help you out.
translation: 我告诉过你我有万全之策。它成功了，对吧？如果你有什么需要，去小灯镇找麦迪，他会帮你。

original: Thanks for getting us out of there. If you ever need anything, you come see us.
translation: 谢谢你帮我们逃出来，如果有什么需要，尽管来找我们。

original: Mayor will be nice to you. I'll make sure of it.
translation: 镇长会好好招待你的。我保证。

original: So you got us out of there, huh?
Not so bad for a mungo, I guess.
translation: 我想，作为一个毛人来说你真不错。

original: So, uhh. Thanks and stuff. We're gonna head home soon.
translation: 呃，太感谢了。我们得赶快回家。

original: So. You're the genius who disarmed the bomb. Weeks of waiting and watching, ruined!
translation: 你就是那解除核弹的天才。数周的观望，都白费了！

original: It's a pity you acted so hastily. In the future, best sleep with one eye open.
translation: 都是因为你草率的行动。以后，你睡觉最好都睁只眼睛。

original: You self-righteous little... Do you have any idea what you've done to my employer's development plan? A word of advice: watch your back.
translation: 你有点自以为是……你知道你对我们老板的开发计划都干了什么吗？给你个忠告：小心你背后。

original: What you did, it was a great thing. That place, those people... necessary sacrifices. Here's to a better future. Here's to Tenpenny Tower!
translation: 你做的事，是伟大的事。那地方，那些人……必须牺牲。为了更美好的未来，为了特佩尼大厦！

original: Well, hey! How's it going? You need something, you just ask. Disarming that bomb, well... that's something I'm not ever likely to forget.
translation: 嗨！怎么样了？有需要尽管说。解除了核弹，啊……我永远不会忘记。

original: Well, now... how's my favorite explosives expert doing?
translation: 现在……我最爱的拆弹专家在干嘛？

original: Yeah, you're pretty busted up, but you'll live. Stop by the clinic in the morning.
translation: 嗯，虽然你伤得很重的，但你会活下来。早上去诊所吧。

original: Hurry and seal that hole from the attic! If you don't have any grenades then see if there's something nearby you can shoot that will explode!
translation: 快！把阁楼那个洞密封起来，如果你没有手榴弹，那就看看附近有没有能射爆的东西！

original: Who the hell are you?! Where did you come from?! Did Moriarty send you?!
translation: 你他妈是谁？你从哪来？是莫里亚蒂派你来的？！

original: Here... you've done so much for us. I want you to have this. It's all I have to offer you...
translation: 拿好……你为我们做了很多。我希望你收下。我只有这些了……

original: All of us here thank you for everything you've done. For us... for the Wastes. We pooled together and got you this.
translation: 这里所有的人都感谢你为我们做的一切。为我们……为废土。我们凑了些东西给你。

original: It's the best we could do. Please take it, with our thanks.
translation: 这是我们能做的最好的了。请收下它，还有我们的谢意。

original: I wish there were more people like you in the world.
translation: 我希望这世界能有更多像你一样的人。

original: I want you to have this. I hope it helps keep you safe.
translation: 我要你拿着这。我希望它能帮助保护你。

original: I guess you'd better be on your way... Sorry for the uhh, for the interruption.
translation: 我想你最好出发。呃……抱歉打扰了你。

original: They're not who they say they are... Get out while you can, before they get you too!
translation: 他们不像他们说的那样……趁他们没抓住你，赶快抽身！

original: Well, hi there! Welcome to Andale! I'm Willy Wilson, though folks just call me Bill. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 你好！欢迎来到安戴尔！我是薇柳·威尔逊，不过人们都叫我比尔。有什么可以帮助你的吗？

original: Man, what the hell is this place? What do they want with all these people?
translation: 天哪，这到底是什么地方？他们要这些人干什么？

original: Hey, I thought you should know... Someone must've hit a button during the fight just now.
translation: 嗨，有件事得告诉你……刚才混战中肯定有人误触了按钮。

original: If I understood the display correctly, I think we sort of launched a homing beacon of some kind down to the surface. Landed just outside D.C.
translation: 要是我对显示屏的理解没错，我想我们好像朝地面发射了某种归航信标。落点就在特区外。

original: I wouldn't mention it, except that I think... Like I said, I'm not sure... I think it's a way to get back to earth.
translation: 本来不想说的，不过我觉得……就像我说的，不确定……但可能是返回地球的通道。

original: Seems like there's a teleporter in the Captain's quarters... I mean, I guess they're your quarters now.
translation: 舰长舱室里有台传送装置……现在应该说是你的舱室了。

original: So I guess you can go home if you want. Don't worry, I'll stick around up here and keep an eye on things.
translation: 所以如果你想的话，大概就能回家了。别担心，我会留在这儿留意情况。

original: Hito wo azakeru na. Onushi no monoii wa sappari wakaran.
translation: 别耍我，完全不知你说的啥。

original: Sessha wo tasuke takuba, sessha no ken wo sagashi dase!
translation: 想帮在下就把在下的剑找出来。

original: Here it is! This is the stuff I hid in here. You can have all of it, okay?
translation: 就在这儿！这就是我藏在这里的东西。你可以全拿走，好吗？

original: Come on, I'll show you where the stuff is!
translation: 来啊，我给你看看我藏了什么东西。

original: Nope, nope. Not real, none of it is real. It can't hurt me if it's not real.
translation: 不，不。不是真的，一切都不是真的。不是真的，就伤不到我。

original: I wasn't aware that we had anything else to say to each other.
translation: 我没发现咱们还有什么话可说。

original: What are you waiting for? DESTROY HIM!
Keep your distance. What are you doing in my house?
translation: 保持距离，你在我家干什么 ?

original: You said you'd mend the still, sweetie. When did you plan on getting' to that, exactly?
translation: 你说过你要修，亲爱的。到底什么时候计划开始呢?

original: Thanks for mending the still, Sweetie. For this fee, the tonic had better taste like honey, though.
translation: 亲爱的，谢谢你的修理。因为你的付出，药剂尝起来更像蜂蜜了。

original: Thanks for mending the still, Sweetie. You're a peach.
translation: 亲爱的，谢谢你的修理。你是个美人。

original: Thanks for mending the still, Sweetie. Here's your pay.
translation: 亲爱的，谢谢你的修理。这是你的报酬。

original: Oh, I hope you can find my Nadine.
translation: 噢，我希望你能找到我的娜丁。

original: You are welcome to our tribe.
Tremendous showing! I do hope the experience was worth every cap.
translation: 重大发现！我希望这次经历能够物超所值。

original: Let's commemorate your first safari with a token of our friendship, shall we?
translation: 让我们以此来纪念你第一次狩猎时我们的友谊。

original: This axe was, er, 'misplaced' by one of my other patrons. She won't be needing it anymore, and it's a weapon of gruesome distinction. Enjoy it.
translation: 这斧头是，呃，是我的一个顾客误放在这里的。她不再需要它了，这武器相当卓越。享受它吧！

original: Mr. Plik's really outdone himself this time.
translation: 水疱先生这次真正的克服了自己。

original: Well, hello there young traveler. The fates had told me that I would receive a visitor today.
translation: 好吧，你好年轻的旅行者。命运告诉我，今天我将会有一个来访者。

original: But I'm being rude! I am Madam Panada, and this is Madam Panada's House of Wares! For all things a traveler needs, I am here to provide!
translation: 但是我已经粗鲁了！我是帕娜达女士，这是帕娜达女生的仓库！我再这里提供旅行者所需的一些东西。

original: Bullets! Stimpaks! Armor! Weapons! Junk! If you need it, Madam Panada has already anticipated your need and procured it months ago!
translation: 子弹！治疗针！装甲！武器！垃圾！尽情挑选，帕娜达夫人已经在月前就预先采购好了你所需要的。

original: We've got this area locked down.
translation: 这区域已经被我们封锁了。

original: We've got this area locked down.
translation: 这区域已经被我们封锁了。

original: Not the most exciting job I ever had, but you gotta admit, it beats pulling the floaters out of the Basin. Ha ha ha.
translation: 我这工作说不上有意思，但是你得承认，把漂浮物从池子的水里弄出来可真恶心啊。哈哈哈。

original: Brotherhood assholes! They won't give us enough water to last until the next shipment!
translation: 兄弟会的混蛋！在下一批货之前他们不会提供我们水了！

original: We're not going to let them leave with that water though. We need it.
translation: 我们不会让他们带走水的。我们需要它。

original: What are they going to do, anyway? Kill us for stealing some free water?
translation: 他们想怎么样？为了得到些免费的水而把我们杀了？

original: This is what happens to people who fuck with the Brotherhood.
translation: 这就是跟兄弟会作对的下场。

original: If there's anything I can do to help, please just say so.
translation: 如果有什么我能帮到你的，请不要客气。

original: When I first saw you long ago, I thought you were just some trashy Wastelander. I'm glad I was wrong.
translation: 很久之前，我第一次见到你时，我还以为你是个一文不值的废土游民。但很高兴我错了。

original: My father thinks the world of you... and so do I. If things were different, maybe we could have had time to become friends...
translation: 我父亲很欣赏你……我也是。如果不是在这种环境下的话，也许我们能有时间交个朋友……

original: Anyway... I wish you the best of luck and I hope you stick around for a while. We need people like you to help us finish what we've started here!
translation: 不管怎么说啦……我还是希望你能平安无事，还有……我希望你能在这里多呆几天。我们需要你这样的人来帮助我们完成未尽的事业！

original: You must cleanse your tongue of unseemly speech by drinking deep of the holy water. Then we may speak.
translation: 你必须用圣水清洗掉你口中的无礼言辞。之后我们才能开始谈话。

original: Cleanse your tongue with the holy water. For we must speak with seemly tongues when we make mention of Atom's Light.
translation: 用圣水洗净你的喉舌。因为在我们谈论原子之光的时候必须言辞得体。

original: Our veins flow with Atom's Eternal Glow.
translation: 我们的血液中流淌着原子那永恒的光芒。

original: The water she gave me... it... there's something... wrong...
translation: 她给我的水……里面……有点……不对…劲……

original: Have you heard about that new cult? They took our water!
translation: 你听说那所谓的新兴的邪教了么？他们抢走了我们的水！

original: Here, read this. It's one of their pamphlets.
translation: 来，看看这个。这是他们的小册子。

original: Oh, I hadn't seen you in so long. I thought you died. Um... I stopped setting aside money for you.
translation: 噢，很久不见啊。我还以为你死啦。呃……所以我就没留你那份儿……

original: Um, here. Take this. It's all I have to spare.
translation: 嗯，给你。拿着这些。我只剩这些了。

original: Now get out of here before my customers take notice.
translation: 现在在我的顾客们发现之前快点离开吧。

original: Is it that time already? Fine. Here's your money.
translation: 这么快就到日子了？好吧。这是你的钱。

original: Now get out of here. I'm trying to earn some money.
translation: 现在快离开吧。我正在拼命挣钱呢。

original: Just can't stay away, can you?
translation: 你就离我远一点，行不行？

original: Well, I guess it's good you're not dead. And I guess I should say thanks for getting us running.
translation: 好吧，我想看到你没死我该高兴。而且我想我该谢谢你帮了我们大忙。

original: If there's anything you need, just let me know.
translation: 如果有什么需要，尽管说。

original: Look, I'm busy. Can we do this some other time?
translation: 听着，我现在很忙。我们能不能等会儿再管它？
你找到了一个特斯拉线圈？

original: Excellent. I'll see to it that this reaches the scribes immediately.
translation: 好极了。我会确保它立即被送达文员那。

original: Are you ready for your next assignment? We don't have time to spare.
translation: 你准备好接受下一个任务了么？我们时间紧迫。

original: What is that?? What the hell is going on?
translation: 那是什么？？到底发生什么事了？

original: We need to find out what the hell just happened.
translation: 我们需要弄明白到底他妈的发生什么事了。

original: There's no time to talk - get your ass inside that base, and help the troops locate the source of their transmission. Now soldier, NOW!
translation: 没时间多说了——麻溜进基地，帮助部队找到他们通讯源。现在，士兵。马上！

original: They knew we were coming... How did they know we were coming?
translation: 他们知道我们要来了……。可他们是怎么知道的 ?

original: Good work. You're one step away from Ashur... and our freedom.
translation: 干得不错。你离阿舒尔……和我们的自由只有一步之遥。

original: That fight was impressive. One more to go.
translation: 那场战斗很犀利，还剩一个对手。

original: Not bad, grinder. Not bad. The Bear Brothers were some pretty mean sons o' bitches.
translation: 不赖啊，苦力，不赖。贝尔兄弟是一对相当卑鄙的贱人。

original: One more fight and you're free. But I wouldn't plan on making it through the next one.
translation: 再打一场，你就自由了。不过我对下一场没什么指望。

original: Here's a shot for the rads. Come back when you're ready for your last fight.
translation: 给你去掉辐射，准备好了下一场就回来。

original: Wow. Impressive, slave. Those were some of the toughest scabs around here.
translation: 哇噢，真犀利，奴隶。那些可是这里本事最大的渣滓。

original: You've got some fight in you, it seems. But I wouldn't get too excited. I'm sure Ashur's got something special planned for your next fight.
translation: 你像是斩获不小，不过我高兴不起来，我肯定阿舒尔为你的下一场战斗安排了些压轴戏。

original: Here's something for the rads. Enjoy it while you can. Come back when you're ready for your next fight.
translation: 给你去掉辐射。尽情享用。准备好了下一场就回来。

original: And what're you doing down here, slave? Don't tell me that your pale ass is gonna throw down?
translation: 你到这下面来做什么，奴隶？别跟我说你苍白的屁股要掉地下了？

original: You again? Back for more, huh?
Unless you're looking to get killed, you'll get the fuck out of my Arena.
translation: 除非你找死，不然就他妈的从我的竞技场滚出去。

original: Haha! So you're the dumbass scab that signed up to fight in the Hole, huh?
translation: 哈哈！那么你就是那个签下生死状，要在角斗坑角斗的傻瓜渣滓，对吧？

original: Well, head on down! Faydra's waiting for you! HAHAHA!
translation: 直接下去！费德拉等着你！哈哈哈！

original: You can take weapons into the Hole.
translation: 你可以带着武器进入角斗坑。

original: Talk to Marco and get a weapon... if you haven't already.
translation: 跟马克谈，搞把武器……你要是还没有的话。

original: The first thing I'm going to do once I'm free is burn out Faydra's eyes. She's the worst of them.
translation: 一旦我自由了，我做的第一件事就是烧瞎费德拉的眼睛。她是最坏的一个。

original: I can't stand the fucking bosses. This is disgusting.
translation: 我受不了这些该死的老板，令人作呕。

original: Those bastards. It's bad enough they force us to work, but they expect us to fight for their amusement!
translation: 那些杂种很坏，他们强迫我们干活，却还指望我们为了逗他们开心去角斗！

original: We all knew this was coming but... I dunno... the Hole is terrible.
translation: 我们都知道就快开场了，不过……我不知道……角斗坑中很恐怖。

original: Midea is crazy. This'll never work.
translation: 美狄亚疯了，这绝没有用处。

original: You're fighting in the Hole? Well... good luck with that...
translation: 你要在角斗坑里角斗？那么……祝你好运……

original: At least they cure your radiation when you come out of the Hole.
translation: 当你从角斗坑里出来，至少他们会治疗你的辐射。

original: Oh, what a dear little orphaned child that is. I know a place where she can have a safe home.
translation: 我们是替兄弟会运水的商队，你还没听说？铆钉城正给废土带去净水！

original: And you can be about your business, far, far away from her.
translation: 管好你自己的事，离她远点。

original: What do you need? Make it fast.
It's not easy keeping these people from tearing each other apart. I don't know how Ashur did it.
translation: 阻止这些人自相残杀不容易，我不知道阿舒尔是怎么办到的。

original: Kind of busy trying to keep this place in one piece. And here I thought freedom would make things easier...
translation: 有点忙于保持这个地方团结一致。我想自由将是可以更容易的达成这一目标的手段……

original: Nice trophy from Ashur you got there. You sure earned it.
translation: 来自阿舒尔的美妙奖励，你肯定赚到了。
哦，太荣幸了，我们的英雄。

original: Looking sharp in that suit, pal! Glad I wasn't there when you pried it off old Ashur, though. Bet it smelled like a sack full of dog asses.
translation: 穿着那套衣服看起来很酷，伙计！很高兴当你把它从老阿舒尔身上扒下来的时候我不在场。我打赌它闻起来就像是装了一麻袋的狗屁。

original: Do you mind? I've got a lot to do.
translation: 你介意吗？我有许多活得干。

original: Oh. It's talking to me again.

translation: 还在忙？要不要来点提神的？

original: I got better things to do than talk with you.
translation: 比起跟你胡扯，我有更重要的事情要做。

original: I'm told that you might be looking for Marco. Am I right?
translation: 我听说你可能在寻找马可，我说的对吗？

original: All right. All better. But still...
translation: 很好，有所好转，不过还有……

original: You'd better get out of here. They might suspect something.
translation: 你最好离开，他们可能起了疑心。

original: Now, get out of here before the bosses suspect something. I'll be here if you get hurt again.
translation: 现在，在老板们起疑心之前离开这。你要是再受了伤，来这找我。

original: If you get hurt, come talk to me. I can help you out.
translation: 你要是受了伤，来这找我，我可以帮你。

original: No scabs near the gate. Back off.
translation: 渣滓们不许接近大门，回去。

original: Attacking the Listening Post as ordered, sir. I'll give you a new update when the objective is complete.
translation: 按计划进攻监听站，长官。当任务完成后我会向你报告最新进展。

original: You're the backup? Great. Just great.
translation: 你是来帮忙的？太好了，真是太好了。

original: All right, follow me. I'll take you to Protector McGraw.
translation: 好吧，跟着我。我会带你去见护卫麦格劳。

original: You're here to help? Fine, then put this on, get in the chair, and we'll run the simulation.
translation: 你是来帮忙的？好，那穿上这个，坐在那椅子上，我们来运行模拟程序。

original: Come on, let's move it. I ain't got all day.
translation: 快点啊。我可没那么多时间。

original: You getting in there, or what?
This is a Pre-War research facility. There's technology to be had, and I am determined to have it.
translation: 这是一座战前的研究设施。里面有种科技，我决心要得到它。

original: Unfortunately, it's locked up tight. As far as we can tell, it's linked into some kind of simulator.
translation: 不幸的是，它被牢牢锁上了。据我们所知，它被连接在某种模拟器上。

original: But we can't access the simulator, because we lack the proper interface. Your little computer there is exactly what we're looking for.
translation: 我们不能进入模拟器，因为我们缺少适当的操作界面。你那件小电脑正是我们要找的。

original: So, I'll make you a deal. You access the simulator and get us into the rest of this base, and I'll give you a cut of what we find.
translation: 那么，我们来做个交易。你进入模拟器，带我们进入这个基地，我就把找到的东西分一份给你。

original: "Payment for Services Rendered." You help us, and we'll help you.
translation: “交易达成。”你帮了我们，我们也会帮你。

original: I've said my piece. If you're interested in assisting, follow Sibley to the simulation pod. Olin will help get you jacked into the sim.
translation: 我说完了。如果你有兴趣帮忙的话，跟西布利去模拟舱。奥林会帮你进入模拟程序。

original: Nice work out there, soldier. Thanks for the back-up, but where's the rest of your detachment?
translation: 干得漂亮，士兵。谢谢你支援我，但你的其他队员哪去了？

original: Head on into the base and talk to McGraw. I'll let him know you're coming. Don't worry, they won't shoot you.
translation: 进基地去和麦格劳谈谈。我会告诉他你来了。别担心，他们不会向你开枪的。

original: Could you have been any more useless out there? You don't deserve to wear that armor after that display! Explain yourself, soldier!
translation: 你在那边没事干吗？从你之前的表现来看，你还不够资格穿那件装甲！好好解释一下，士兵！

original: All right, now who the hell are you, and what do you think you're doing wearing that armor?
translation: 好吧，你到底是谁，还有为什么穿着那件装甲？

original: Give me one good reason why I shouldn't put you down right now, outsider.
translation: 给我一个不杀你的理由，外来人。

original: Don't think for one second I didn't see what you're wearing. If you hadn't actually helped out here, I'd have put you down along with these mutants.
translation: 别以为我看不出你这身打扮是做什么的。如果你在这里碍手碍脚的，我就把你的尸体堆在变种人的上面。

original: You've got about three seconds to explain yourself, outsider.
translation: 你有3秒钟时间解释一下在做什么，外来人。

original: Damned guard detail! That sounded like a good ruckus.
translation: 该死的防卫细节！听起来像一堆废话。

original: You can go ahead and stop right there. Who the hell are you?
translation: 你可以向前走，在那里停下。你到底是谁？

original: Well? You headed down or not?
Stick with us until we make it through to the base!
translation: 紧跟着我们一起去基地！

original: Take that elevator and report in to Defender Sibley.
translation: 坐电梯去向守卫西布利报到。

original: I think Defender Sibley's going to want to talk with you. Take that elevator down into the base.
translation: 我想守卫西布利要和你谈谈。坐电梯到基地中去。

original: So... you're in charge of Patterson's Suicide Squad, huh?
translation: 那么…你是帕特森敢死队的头头，对吧？

original: Congratulations on making it to the HQ. It's pretty fierce out there.
translation: 恭喜你安全回到总部。外面战况很激烈啊。

original: Here's your chem ration. I'm doctor Adami. Come see me if you need patching up.
translation: 给你药品配给。我是奥达米医生。如果还需要包扎就回来找我。

original: Let's get you up to 100%, shall we? Uncle Sam needs you back in the fight! Hold still a moment.
translation: 让我们来治好你，好吗？山姆大叔需要你回到战斗中去！坚持一下。

original: What sort of scrape did you get yourself into, this time?
translation: 这次你又划伤到哪里了？

original: Oh hey, hi. You again, huh? I thought maybe you'd be blown up or shot or something by now, but I guess not. Not yet, anyway.
translation: 哦，嗨，你好，又是你，呃？我还想可能现在你已经被炸死、被射杀或其它什么，不过好像还没。现在还没。

original: Hey, hi! Hi, lady. Hey there. What's going on? Anything new? You have any good stories? What about Nuka-Cola, you have any of that? Huh, huh?
translation: 嗨，你好！嘿，女士。嗨。怎么了？有什么消息？你有什么好故事？核子可乐，你有吗？呃，呃？

original: Hey, hi! Hi, mister. Hey there. What's going on? Anything new? You have any good stories? What about Nuka-Cola, you have any of that? Huh, huh?
translation: 嗨，你好！嘿，先生。嗨。怎么了？有什么消息？你有什么好故事？核子可乐，你有吗？呃，呃？

original: Hey there. You have any Nuka-Cola? Even just a bit? Can I have some? Be your best friend. Honest. Totally. Not even kidding!
translation: 嗨。你有核子可乐吗？一点也好。我能来一些吗？我最好的朋友。真诚的。完全的。绝不是开玩笑！

original: Thanks again for saving me. You're the best!
translation: 再次感谢你救了我。你是最棒的！

original: Well, you and my brother are tied for the best, at least. But that's still really good!
translation: 好了，你和我兄弟并列最棒的，至少。但是那还是真的很棒！

original: We didn't need any mungo's help getting outta there, you know?
translation: 我们逃出那里不需要毛人帮，你懂吗？

original: But you did it, so, uh, thanks.
translation: 但是你帮了我们，所以，呃，谢谢。

original: But that means I gotta go back to guarding the back gate with Princess. Ugh.
translation: 不过这是指我要去后面和“公主”一起守后门。呃。

original: Okay, so you get in, but I got my eye on you.
translation: 好了，你进来吧，不过我会盯你。

original: You don't make any trouble in here, got it? I ain't having no shit-butts making trouble.
translation: 不准在这撒野，明白吗？我不准任何臭狗屎捣乱。

original: Okay, what the hell is wrong with you, mungo? This had better be important!
translation: 好，你到底怎么回事，毛人？这最好是重要事！

original: Oh, what now? You come to me to talk about how nice my damned cave is? Maybe a little small talk about local soil erosion or some bullshit?
translation: 现在又怎么了？你来找我，就是想说我该死的洞穴有多么多么好？或者聊聊当地的土壤侵蚀之类的屁事？

original: No, you know what? You can go take a hike, you insane mutant-fucker. Get out of my town!
translation: 不，你知道吗？你可以出去远足了，你这疯狂的变种人养的。滚出我的镇子！

original: Mayor said to let you in alive, but he didn't say you had to stay that way. Watch your step, mungo.
translation: 镇长说留你一条小命，但他可没说可以让你恣意妄为，你给我小心点，毛人！

original: Whoa, a mungo down here, just walking around!
translation: 哇，这有个毛人，正在到处游荡。

original: Hey, new kid! Try and catch me!
Stay away, mungo, I don't wanna catch old from you!
translation: 走开点，毛人。我不想碰到你变老！

original: Thanks for getting Penny and Squirrel back. And Sammy too, I guess.
translation: 谢谢你救回佩尼和“松鼠”，还有萨米，对吧？

original: Nice as the weather is out here, how about you bring me a kid, so I can get back to Paradise Falls?
translation: 外面天气不错，你给我带个孩子过来吧？这样我就可以回到堕落天堂了。

original: Just waiting for you to bring me a new friend.
translation: 就等你给我带个新朋友过来。

original: There you go, good as new.
I got a lot to thank you for... I don't know how to do it.
translation: 我得好好感谢你……我不知道怎么报答。

original: Here... take this. It's always given me good luck.
translation: 拿着这。它一直都给我带来好运。

original: Hey, don't mind the smoke. It's perfectly safe to breathe. Really!
translation: 嗨，别在意这烟。这气体很安全。真的！

original: What's up? Anything interesting out there in the wild Wasteland?
translation: 怎么了？在废土荒野有什么有趣的事吗？

original: Hey, someone who doesn't have a cart for me to fix or a brahmin to wash up. That's a nice change.
translation: 嗨，没人要我去修车，也没人叫我去给双头牛搓澡。真是个可喜的变化。

original: Hope you don't mind the smell of brahmin dung. It's been one of those days.
translation: 希望你不介意双头牛的粪便味。每间隔几天就有。

original: Hey. How's the wide, wild Wasteland out there?
translation: 嗨。外面的废土荒野怎么样？

original: You're bad. I don't think I should talk to you.
translation: 你是坏蛋。我不想和你说话。

original: Do you like being bad? Or is it just you can't help it?
translation: 你想当个坏蛋？还是你身不由己？

original: I bet you're so bad because your mom didn't love you.
translation: 我打赌你这么坏，是因为你妈妈不爱你。

original: I've heard of you. You're one of the good guys!
translation: 我听说过你。你是个好人！

original: It makes me feel safer knowing you're around.
translation: 你在这让我觉得更安全了。

original: You're my hero, mister. I want to be just like you when I grow up.
translation: 你是我的英雄，先生。我希望长大后像你一样。

original: You're my hero, ma'am. I want to be just like you when I grow up.
translation: 你是我的英雌，女士。我希望长大后像你一样。

original: Welcome back. Have you been successful in your search for books?
translation: 欢迎回来。你寻找书籍的任务成功了吗？

original: You've returned. Have you brought me any books?
translation: 你回来了。你给我带回些什么书？

original: Thank God someone's come! You have to help me! Please!
translation: 感谢上帝，有人来了！你得帮帮我！求求你！

original: You've saved my life. I am in your debt.
translation: 你救了我的命。我欠你的。

original: I am forever in your debt. Thank you.
We're almost to the door, don't stop now!
translation: 我们快到门口了，别停下！
继续前进，我们就快出去了！

original: Stay on point. We will back you up. It's the least we can offer you.
translation: 站那别动。我们会增援你。这是我们所能给你的帮助。

original: Good. He is safe. The Brotherhood are men of their word and so, here is your payment. Spend it well.
translation: 好极了，他安全了。兄弟会是守信用的，这是你的酬劳。好好拿去花吧。

original: Farewell, mercenary. May you find honor in your travels.
translation: 回见，佣兵。在你的旅途中找到你的荣誉吧。

original: You've got some serious stones walking through here by yourself.
translation: 你得有两下子才可以自己一个人通过这。

original: Just stumbled into town? You sure picked a fine day for it, with the crazies out there.
translation: 只是误撞到镇子的？你确实挑了个好日子，和外边的疯子一起。

original: Here, have a drink on the house. Welcome to Canterbury.
translation: 给，在屋里喝一杯。欢迎来到坎特伯雷。

original: I'm Joe Porter. I make sure folks around here can get a meal when they need it.
translation: 我是乔·波特。我要确保这的人们饿的时候能有东西吃。

original: I hear you're my mysterious investor! With your help, I've collected quite a few toys for myself. But what good are toys if they aren't played with?
translation: 听说你就是我那神秘的投资人！多亏你帮忙，我为自己收集了一些很好的小玩意。但是如果不拿出来玩玩，这些玩意又有什么价值？

original: Thanks to you I have so many, I could hardly play with them all.
translation: 太谢谢你了，这么多，我都快玩不过来了。

original: So, I present to you a prize of the collection, a micro-nuke. Enjoy it in safety!
translation: 所以。这微型核弹就作为你帮我收集这些东西的报酬。在确定安全的情况下尽情享用吧！

original: A wanderer without a weapon doesn't last long out there. Pick up the best now, while you still can!
translation: 一个手无寸铁的流浪者在这可是活不长的。换上最好的装备吧 — 趁你现在还能做到。

original: Here to shop? Have a look!
I hear you're the one who's so deeply invested in my junk. Not as deeply as me, of course, but who is, really?
translation: 我听说了，你就是那在我这杂货铺投资最多的人。当然，我还是最多的，舍我其谁呢，对吧？

original: I picked up some Stealth Boys the other day, and they seemed like just the way to thank you for your investment. Kudos!
translation: 前些天我偶然结识了几个隐身小子，他们好像要对你的投资表示感谢。令人称赞！

original: A friend with deep pockets is a friend indeed! Welcome to my shop!
translation: 俗话说得好：“皮夹鼓鼓的朋友才是真正的朋友”！欢迎光临我的小店！

original: My investor arrives at last. This line of work doesn't allow for much sentiment, but how could I not offer you some material token of my thanks?
translation: 我的投资商终于出现了。干我们这行的不能感情用事，但对于你的帮助又怎能没有实质性的回报呢？

original: In that case, here. The gift of health - rarely given in this day and age, but all too often taken...
translation: 如果是那样的话，拿好。以健康为礼物吧 — 这年头很少有人能给，相反，往往被剥夺……

original: Looking for your fix? You came to the right man.
translation: 想修东西？那你就找对人了。

original: Here to see the good doctor? Excellent.
And here you are! The spirits have blessed me with many gifts, but you have given the more marketable gift of monetary investment.
translation: 给你！神灵已经赐予了我诸多礼物，但是你给我带来的礼物更有市场价值的金融投资。

original: Please accept this offering - a mask and helmet made from the hide of the wisest spirits of the wind. May it benefit you as fully as it has myself.
translation: 请收下这份礼物 — 由风灵之皮制成的面具和头盔。希望它能像庇护我一样庇护你。

original: Searching for a friend out in the Wastes? No one is more reliable than a cold, hard skin of steel.
translation: 想要在这片废土中寻找一个朋友？一块冰冷、坚硬的钢铁皮肤比任何人都可靠。

original: Here to acquire a new mantle of metal or mesh? If you have the caps, I have the merchandise.
translation: 要不要来件崭新的金属或者网状的披风？一手交钱，一手交货。

original: Welcome! Welcome back! What do you have for us today?
translation: 欢迎！欢迎回来！今天给我们带来了什么？

original: Why look who it is! My favorite associate! Have you brought me what I need?
translation: 看是谁！我最爱的伙计！你带来我要的东西了吗？

original: It's you! We always have time for our favorite employee!
translation: 是你！我们总是有时间来接待我们最喜欢的职员。

original: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a ton of supplies, and now that it’s safe, I’m heading up there!
translation: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了成吨的补给，既然那安全了，我立刻就去！

original: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a bunch of high power explosives!
translation: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了好多高爆炸弹！

original: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a bunch of robot parts!
translation: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了好多机器人零件！

original: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a few Stealth Boys.
translation: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了一些隐身小子。

original: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a bunch of firepower.
translation: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了好多军火。

original: I'm heading up to Big Town to see what's left for the taking. I heard everyone up there was either killed or dragged off by Super Mutants.
translation: 我正准备去大镇，看看还有什么剩余东西可以拿。我听说那的人不是被杀就是被超级变种人拖走了。

original: Finders keepers, am I right? Ha Ha...
translation: 谁找到归谁，我说的对吧？哈哈……

original: That thing would have killed us all without your help. Thanks.
translation: 如果没有你的帮助，那东西会把我们都杀了的。谢谢。

original: Listen, you may as well take this map. That's where we were headed, but that Deathclaw cured me of my itch for Wasteland adventure.
translation: 听着，你最好也拿着这地图。那是我们要去的地方，但是死亡爪打消了我们去废土冒险的念头。

original: What can I do for you?
What can I do for you?
Quickly, let me have the ink and I will produce the copy of the Declaration of Independence!
translation: 快，给我墨水，我来做一张《独立宣言》的复制品。

original: Here you are... a perfect copy. That should give ol' George something to think about.
translation: 给你……一份完美的复制品。那可是老乔治想要的。

original: What are the next orders from the Congress?
translation: 国会的下个命令是什么？

original: I can't wait to add the Declaration to the Society's collection.
translation: 我等不及要将《独立宣言》纳入协会的收藏中了。

original: I'm expecting great things from you!
What wonderful artifacts have you brought me?
translation: 你有什么精美的文物带给我？

original: So, have you decided to become a part of history and triumphantly return with the Declaration of Independence in hand?
translation: 你决定永垂史册，拿着《独立宣言》荣耀而归了吗？

original: Quite an impressive collection, isn't it? Well don't be shy, have a look around.
translation: 很令人印象深刻的收藏品，不是吗？别客气，到处看看。

original: Abraham Washington's the name... curator of this little slice of American History.
translation: 我叫亚伯拉罕·华盛顿……这一小片美国历史的管理人。

original: Finally... freedom! True freedom! I cannot thank you enough for this gift.
translation: 终于……自由了！真正的自由了！我无以回报你的大礼。

original: You have no idea how long I've pictured this moment in my mind... and it feels far better than I'd imagined.
translation: 你无法知道我在脑中幻想了这刻多久……而这感觉远比我想象中的还要好。

original: Now, for my part of the bargain. Follow me.
translation: 现在，轮到我执行约定了。跟着我。

original: Finally... freedom! True freedom! I cannot thank you enough for this gift.
translation: 终于……自由了！真正的自由了！我无以回报你的大礼。

original: You have no idea how long I've pictured this moment in my mind... and it feels far better than I'd imagined.
translation: 你无法知道我在脑中幻想了这刻多久……而这感觉远比我想象中的还要好。

original: We both know you're here to obtain the G.E.C.K. Now, follow me. I'll retrieve the G.E.C.K. for you.
translation: 我们都知道你来这里是为了获得G.E.C.K.。现在，跟我来。我会为你取得G.E.C.K.。

original: Is there something amiss? The door still seems to be sealed.
translation: 有些不对劲？这门看来仍旧锁着。

original: Back so soon? What is it now? Come to gawk at the caged animal?
translation: 这么快就回来啦？现在干嘛？傻傻地看着笼中困兽？

original: Standing around all day chit-chatting isn't going to help you track down my android. Is it?
translation: 整天站在那说废话，是无法让你帮我追踪到我的人造人的，不是吗？

original: Thanks to you, we finally have that sniper, Arkansas, in a collar! You have no idea how many good men that prick put into the dirt.
translation: 谢谢你，我们终于抓住那阻击手阿肯色并给他戴上了项圈！你不知道有多少好手在他手里入了土。

original: I'm tempted not to sell him, just so we can torment him. Use him for target practice or something. Hehehe.
translation: 我真不想卖掉他，这样我们才能折磨他。用他来练习打靶或做其他事。呵呵呵。

original: Here's another collar. Keep those hoochies rolling in and you'll be rich in no time.
translation: 给你另一个项圈。继续努力让私货来得源源不断，很快你就会变得富有。

original: How the hell'd you get old queen Flak, into that collar?! I'm surprised you're still alive!
translation: 见鬼，你是怎么拿下“高炮”弗莱克，并给他戴上项圈的？我很惊讶你还活着！

original: We need to keep a close eye on that one, though. He knows our system too well.
translation: 可是我们要密切注意那家伙。他很了解我们的系统。

original: He sold us out to get into Rivet City. We'll never forget that. And now we'll make sure he never forgets it, either.
translation: 他出卖了我们才进入铆钉城。我们永远不会忘记。现在我们要让他也永远忘不了。

original: Here's another collar. Keep herding the swine in here and you'll have more bottle caps than you'll know what to do with.
translation: 这是另一个项圈。继续努力赶猪，瓶盖会多到你花不掉。

original: I've been wanting to get Red in here for a long time. I have a little something special planned for her.
translation: 我在这等着抓瑞德很久了，我对她有些特殊想法。

original: Take another collar, and keep those puppies coming!
translation: 拿着另一个项圈，继续努力抓那些狗崽！

original: Susan thought she could just up and leave, huh? We showed her different, didn't we?
translation: 苏珊认为她拍拍屁股就能走人？让她看看结果多么不同，对吧？

original: She'll think twice about slitting one of our throats now that she's collared! We'll need to come up with something extra special for her.
translation: 现在她被戴上了项圈，就会重新考虑是否要切开我们的喉咙了！我们得想出点特殊待遇招呼她。

original: Here's another collar. You're a welcome addition to our little operation here.
translation: 给你另一个项圈。欢迎加入我们的小买卖。

original: Hold it right there. Nobody's allowed into Paradise Falls except on Slaver business. And I get to decide what qualifies as Slaver business.
translation: 站住。堕落天堂只允许从事奴隶买卖的人进入。而我来决定什么是奴隶买卖。

original: You didn't really think you could just sneak into Paradise Falls did you?
translation: 你不是真的以为你能潜入堕落天堂，对吧？

original: Do I look like someone who wants to be your friend? Are you a moron? Why do you keep coming around? Piss off already!
translation: 我看上去像是想要成为你朋友的人吗？你是傻瓜吗？为什么还跟着来？你早就可以滚了！

original: Unless, have you changed your mind? Do you want to take me up on the offer of employment?
translation: 除非，你改变了主意？你想接受我提供的工作吗？

original: If you're here with some Quantum, I have caps with your name on them!
translation: 如果你有量子版核子可乐，我就有印有你名字的瓶盖！

original: Please, tell me you have some of the good stuff. I need that Quantum!
translation: 拜托，告诉我你有些好东西。我需要量子版核子可乐！

original: Oh! I hope you're here with some Quantum!
translation: 哦！我希望你有量子版核子可乐！

original: Oh my gosh oh my gosh oh my gosh! Did you find any Quantum?
translation: 天啊！天啊！天啊！天啊！你找到量子版核子可乐了吗？

original: Oh! Did you need something else?
Well? What do you think? Will you take my offer?
translation: 那你怎么看？你会接受我的提议吗？

original: As promised... here is a little pick-me-up. An Ice Cold Nuka-Cola! Just look at the frost on the bottle. So cold and delicious!
translation: 按照约定……这是一点提神小物。一瓶冰镇核子可乐！看看瓶子上的霜。真是冰凉可口！

original: Pardon me... I tend to lose myself when I hold onto a Nuka-Cola.
translation: 请原谅我……我一拿起核子可乐就容易忘我。

original: Before I get to the little proposition I have for you let me tell you a little bit about Nuka-Cola Quantum.
translation: 在我给你小提议之前，让我先稍微介绍下量子版核子可乐。

original: So, you ready to hear me out? I have a bit of a proposition for you.
translation: 你准备听我说了？我有个小提议。

original: But before I get to that, let me tell you a little bit about Nuka-Cola Quantum.
translation: 但在我开始前，让我先稍微介绍下量子版核子可乐。

original: Bringing me some Quantum I hope?
translation: 我想，给我带些量子版核子可乐？

original: Thanks for getting me out of there. I owe you one.
translation: 谢谢你把我从那里救出来，我欠你一个人情。

original: Now you get back in there and make sure Penny stays safe. I'll try and contact her sometime, if I can. I need to lay low for a while.
translation: 现在你回那去确认佩妮的安全。如果可以的话，过段时间我会试着联系她。我需要保持低调。

original: Thanks for getting me out of there. I owe you one.
translation: 谢谢你把我从那里救出来，我欠你一个人情。

original: Listen, there are kids in there. You've gotta get them out too, if you can. Just be careful.
translation: 听着，那还有些孩子。如果可以的话，你得帮他们也逃出来。但小心。

original: I'm gonna lay low for a while. As soon as they realize I'm gone, they're going to come looking for me. Thanks again.
translation: 我需要保持低调。当他们发现我跑掉后，会来找我的。再次谢谢你。

original: Thanks for getting me out of there. I owe you one.
translation: 谢谢你把我从那里救出来，我欠你一个人情。

original: I'm gonna lay low for a while. As soon as they realize I'm gone, they're going to come looking for me. Thanks again.
translation: 我需要保持低调。当他们发现我跑掉后，会来找我的。再次谢谢你。

original: Well, I guess this is one way to do it. We could've escaped, you know.
translation: 我想这能行。你知道，我们能逃出去。

original: If we're going to leave, then let's get it over with.
translation: 如果我们要走，那就先让我们搞定它。

original: So you gonna take care of that guard, or what?
translation: 你会把那些守卫收拾掉，对吧？

original: My hands are tied here. It's not like I want to be working with a mungo like you, but I got no choice. Come on.
translation: 我的人手不足。我可不想和你这样的毛人合作，不过我没得选择。来吧。

original: Oh God, mister. You gotta help us. You gotta get us out of here!
translation: 哦，天啊，先生！你要帮助我们，你得帮我们逃出这！

original: Oh God, lady. You gotta help us. You gotta get us out of here!
translation: 哦，天啊。小姐，你要帮助我们，你得帮我们逃出这！

original: This place is a whole lot quieter, now. Thanks, I guess.
translation: 现在这地方安静多了，大概要谢谢你。

original: I got nothing to say to you.
Well, whaddya know? It worked! I mean, I was pretty sure it would, obviously.
translation: 好啦，你知道什么？它工作了！我的意思是，我早就肯定它行，很明显。

original: Here, take a few radiation Chems with you. I'm sure you'll run into more in the future.
translation: 来，带些抗辐射药品。我肯定你以后会需要更多。

original: Well, you're alive... That's the good news. But there was a little side effect. A teeny, tiny, um, mutation. But it seems to be benign, at least.
translation: 你还活着……真是好消息。但有些副作用。小小的、极小的、呃……突变。但至少，看上去是良性的。

original: Here, take a few radiation Chems, as my little way of saying, "I'm sorry I twisted your DNA like a kitten with a ball of yarn."
translation: 来，带些抗辐射药品。这是说表示“很抱歉我把你的DNA像小猫玩毛线球一样弄糟了”的方法。

original: Okay, I even stitched a little smiley-face in you, to keep up your spirits. It's kind of hard to see from your side, though.
translation: 好了，我甚至在你身上缝了个小笑脸，来提起你的精神。虽然从你的角度很难看到。

original: Here, take this environment suit of mine. It will help with medical tasks, and it should help prevent the effects of exposure, too.
translation: 来，拿着我的野外套装。它会在医学任务里帮上忙，而且还能防止核泄漏的影响。

original: Oh, hey! Watch your step, I think one of my test subjects got loose. But don't worry, it's probably harmless.
translation: 哦，嗨！留神脚下，我好像丢了一个试验对象。但别担心，它应该没危险。

original: Oh, hey! Kinda busy here, but I guess I can talk for a bit. What's up?
translation: 哦，嗨！现在有点忙，不过我想还能聊会，什么事？

original: Hey, don't mind the smell. I was just testing a few chemicals, but it's perfectly safe to breathe. Really!
translation: 嗨，别在意臭味。我在试验一些新的化学药品，但这气体很安全。真的！

original: What's up? Anything interesting out there in the wild Wasteland?
translation: 怎么了？在废土荒野有什么有趣的事吗？

original: How's it going out there in the Wastes?
You can follow us as far as GNR. But keep your head down if you don't want it to get blown off.
translation: 你能跟我们一起去银河新闻电台。但如果你不想脑袋开花的话，就把头低下。

original: What's it to be? A few caps to find out where your father went? Or are you going to have a go of it on your own?
translation: 想干嘛？花几个瓶盖来打听你父亲的去处？还是你准备自己去找？

original: The Wasteland can be such an unforgiving place...
translation: 废土可是一片无情的地方...

original: You enjoy being a "recruiter" for Paradise Falls, eh?
translation: 看来你很乐意成为堕落天堂的“招募员”，对吧？

original: Here's another collar and some caps.
translation: 这是另一个项圈和一些瓶盖。

original: The slaves keep rolling in. Keep this up and you're going to be rich!
translation: 把奴隶源源不绝地带来。继续努力，你会变得富有！

original: Here's your caps and another collar.
translation: 这是你的瓶盖和另一个项圈。

original: Tallied the last slave you sent us. You're pretty good at the slaving thing. Keep it up!
translation: 算上了你交给我们的最后一个奴隶。你很擅长奴役嘛。继续努力！

original: Here's another collar and pile of caps.
translation: 这是另一个项圈和一堆瓶盖。

original: Keep it up. We all make a ton of caps on every slave you send to us.
translation: 继续努力！你交给我们的每个奴隶都让我们赚到大量瓶盖。

original: Here's your cut and another collar.
translation: 这是你那份和另一个项圈。

original: Please be seated in the nearest available Tranquility Lounger. Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: 请就座于附近空置的宁静巷催眠舱上。谢谢你的合作。

original: Please take a seat in the Tranquility Lounger.
translation: 请找个宁静巷催眠舱就座。

original: Welcome to Vault 112, Resident! According to sensors, you have arrived 202.3 years behind schedule.
translation: 欢迎来到112号避难所，居民！根据传感器，你比预计到达时间晚到了202.3年。

original: Please re-dress in your Vault-Tec issued Vault suit before proceeding.
translation: 行动前请重新穿戴你的基于避难所科技的避难所服装，如果你找不到你的服装，我有权给你再发套新的。

original: Once dressed, please proceed down the stairs to the main floor so that you may enter your assigned Tranquility Lounger.
translation: 穿戴完毕后，请由台阶下至主楼层，以便你进入分配给你的宁静巷催眠舱。

original: Please dress in your Vault 112 suit. Remove all other articles of clothing to prevent damage to the equipment.
translation: 请穿上你的112号避难所服装。脱掉所有其他服饰物品以免阻碍与损坏设备。

original: Please dress in your Vault 112 suit. Remove all other articles of clothing to prevent damage to the equipment.
translation: 请穿上你的112号避难所服装。脱掉所有其他服饰物品以免阻碍与损坏设备。

original: I guess you're wondering where I'm going. I'm off to annex Old Olney and forge the New Republic of Dave! Don't try to stop me!
translation: 你是在想我要去哪里吧。我要去吞并老奥尔尼，并成立新戴夫共和国！别想阻止我！

original: Out with it, Ambassador. This Republic isn't going to run itself.
translation: 别胡闹了，大使。这共和国是不会自己运作的。

original: Stop right there, mister! Whatcha think you're doing in the Republic of Dave?
translation: 站住，先生！你知道你都在戴夫共和国做了什么吗？

original: Stop right there, lady! Whatcha think you're doing in the Republic of Dave?
translation: 站住，小姐！你知道你都在戴夫共和国做了什么吗？

original: Hey, who are you? What do you want from the Republic of Dave?
translation: 嗨，你是谁？你想从戴夫共和国得到什么？

original: Did Dave say it was okay for you to be here?
translation: 戴夫说过你可以在这吗？

original: Well now... who could have ever thought? Me! President! Things are really going to be different around here.
translation: 现在……谁会想得到？我！总统！真的是变天了啊。

original: Listen, I can't thank you enough. You convinced me that I could do this, and you were right. I want you to have something.
translation: 听着，我对你无比感激。你让我确信自己有这能力，我因此才能成功。我想你能得到些什么。

original: Dave kept some big weapon or something locked up in the safe in his office. The code is 1138.
translation: 戴夫办公室的保险箱里存放着某种大型武器之类的东西。密码1138。

original: It's yours if you want it. We don't need it anymore.
translation: 你想要你就拿去吧。我们不再有用了。

original: I just can't thank you enough!
Things are going to be different around here!
Bob as president? I don't know how I feel about that...
translation: 鲍勃当总统？我不知道自己会有什么感觉……

original: President Bob. Well, that's a change. I don't know if it's a change for the better though...
translation: 鲍勃总统。好吧，是个转变。我不知道这是不是朝好方向转变……

original: I heard that Dave allowed you to stay. Well, welcome stranger. Just be mindful of the children.
translation: 听说戴夫允许你留下？那，欢迎你陌生人。留神孩子。

original: Who are you? Is it okay for you to be here?
translation: 你是谁？你可以在这出现吗？

original: So Dave gave you the okay, huh? Well, welcome then.
translation: 那么戴夫已经同意了，欢迎啊。

original: I run the Museum of Dave, where the children of the Republic can learn about their heritage.
translation: 我经营戴夫博物馆，共和国的孩子在这可以学到传统。

original: Dave doesn't like us talking to strangers.
translation: 戴夫不喜欢我们和陌生人谈话。

original: President Daddy says that people from outside the Republic are bad.
translation: 总统爸爸说共和国之外的人都是坏人。

original: Are you really from the Wasteland? Wooooow!
translation: 你真的是从废土来的吗？哇！

original: With the fuses in place, you should be able to access the mainframe. No need to come back to the control room; just head straight there.
translation: 接通保险丝后，你才能进入主机。不需要回控制室，直接去那边。

original: You're doing great out there. Keep it up.
So the pumps are working, and some of the doors are opened. We're making progress.
translation: 水泵工作了，一些门也打开了。我们进展不错。

original: Problem is that the water shorted out a few key fuse boxes.
translation: 问题在于水让一些关键的保险丝盒短路了。

original: Here, take these fuses and replace the ones that have burnt out.
translation: 给，拿这些保险丝去把烧掉的换掉。

original: We can't accomplish anything until we can get inside, but none of us are particularly capable fighters.
translation: 除非我们进到里面，不然我们什么都做不了，但是我们中没有能胜任战士工作的。

original: I hate to ask you to put yourself in harm's way, but you seem to have learned to handle yourself.
translation: 我讨厌将你推入危险的境地，但看上去你懂得怎么处理。

original: I need you to go in and make sure it's safe for Doctor Li and her crew.
translation: 我需要你进去确保李博士和她手下工作人员的安全。

original: Here we are. Where it all began. You remember your mother's favorite passage?
translation: 我们到了。一切开始的地方，你记得你妈妈最喜欢的那段吗？

original: Revelation 21:6. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life, freely.
translation: 启示录21：6。我是阿尔法，我是欧米伽，我是初，我是终。我要将生命泉的水，白白赐给那口渴的人喝。

original: Don't you see? This is what it all means. The water, the purifier. THIS is the water of life. Your mother's dream.
translation: 你看见了吗？这就是它的含义。这水，这净化器。这就是生命之水。你母亲的梦想。

original: No point in wasting time. Let's get to work. There's much to be done.
translation: 别浪费时间了。我们开始工作，还有很多事要做。

original: I'm not trying to put you off, but we need to get to Project Purity. Anything else can wait until later.
translation: 我不想让你失望，但我们要前往净水工程，其他事都得等等。

original: My goodness... You must be James' daughter. You look so much like him.
translation: 我的天……你一定是詹姆斯的女儿。你看起来很像他。

original: I'm surprised to see you here. He gave me the impression that you were... somewhere else, and that we wouldn't be seeing you again.
translation: 见到你在这我很惊讶。他给我的印象是：你在……某处，我们无法再次见到你。

original: If you're here to talk to him, I'm afraid he's come and gone. The last I knew, he was headed back to the lab.
translation: 如果你来着是想和他谈谈，我恐怕他已经走了。据我所知，他回实验室了。

original: My goodness... You must be James' son. You look so much like him.
translation: 我的天……你一定是詹姆斯的儿子。你看起来很像他。

original: I'm surprised to see you here. He gave me the impression that you were... somewhere else, and that we wouldn't be seeing you again.
translation: 见到你在这我很惊讶。他给我的印象是：你在……某处，我们无法再次见到你。

original: If you're here to talk to him, I'm afraid he's come and gone. The last I knew, he was headed back to the lab.
translation: 如果你来着是想和他谈谈，我恐怕他已经走了。据我所知，他回实验室了。

original: I need to reach Madison as soon as possible. Now I can make her see that Project Purity is worth finishing.
translation: 我要尽快见到麦迪逊。现在我能让她了解净水工程是否值得完成。

original: Good to see you again, sweetie.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，亲爱的。

original: Good to see you again, son.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，孩子。

original: Hello there, fellah! Good to meet you! Name's Smith, Jack Smith. Welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
translation: 你好，伙计！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。欢迎来到安戴尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子。

original: Hello there, young lady! Good to meet you! Name's Smith, Jack Smith. Welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
translation: 你好，女士！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。欢迎来到安戴尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子。

original: Hello there, stranger! Good to meet you! Name's Jack Smith. I hear you've already met my wife. Sweet lady, isn't she?
translation: 你好，陌生人！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。听说你已经见过我妻子了。温柔可人的淑女，对吧？

original: But anyway, welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
translation: 总之，欢迎来到安戴尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子！

original: Mr. Harris is nice to us, but he doesn't read the stories the same way that my daddy did.
translation: 海瑞斯先生对我们很好，但他讲故事的方式和我爸爸不同。

original: I'm not really sure what happened. Mr. Harris said that our parents went away, and they won't be back.
translation: 我不太确定发生了什么。海瑞斯先生说我父母已经离开了，而且不再回来了。

original: He says that he'll tell me more about it when I'm older but... I miss my mom and dad...
translation: 他说等我大些了再告诉我详细的事不过……我想念我爸和我妈……

original: Mr. Harris is a lot like my dad. I never knew he could be so nice.
translation: 海瑞斯先生就像我爸爸。我从来没想过他会对我这么好。

original: You're new here, aren't you? Wow! I never get a chance to talk to the new people! Dad always takes care of them before I get a chance.
translation: 你是新来的，对吧？哇！我从没机会和新来的人讲话！爸爸总是在我有机会之前就全关照好他们了。

original: Well, hello! Welcome to Andale! Winner of the best town in the USA contest!
translation: 你好！欢迎来到安戴尔！美利坚合众国最佳城镇竞赛冠军镇！

original: Why, hello there. I'd heard there was someone new coming. How can our little family help you?
translation: 噢，你好。我已经听说有个新来的。我们的小家可以帮你什么吗？

original: Busy busy busy, a wife's work is never done!
translation: 忙忙忙，主妇的事永远做不完！

original: I'm not sure why you'd come back here, but I'm glad to see you.
translation: 我不清楚为什么你回来这，但很高兴见到你。

original: Little by little, each day, I'm trying to clean up the mess my family left.
translation: 一点一点，日复一日，我在努力处理我的家人留下的麻烦。

original: Oh... hey! What do you need, young lady?
translation: 什么……呃？我？你和我讲话吗？啊？你需要什么？
告诉你真相，我很高兴那蠢货死了。

original: To tell you the truth, I'm glad that fool is dead.

translation: 什么？见到什么喜欢的了吗？

original: Look, nothing personal, but if you need something, talk to the clown in the hat.
You're a mess. I hope you brought a lot of money with you.
translation: 你是想把血都撒在我身上，还是想付钱给我来修好你？

original: Are you just going to bleed on me, or are you going to pay me to fix you?
translation: 我喜欢看到跛足废物。对我来说你就像一堆移动的瓶盖。

original: I love the sight of a limping Waster. You just look like a walking pile of caps to me.
translation: 看你跛成什么样了。你给“快刀”阿姨带瓶盖来了吗？

original: Well now, look at you limping in here like that. Did you bring some caps for Auntie Cutter?
translation: 你似乎过了几天好日子。几个瓶盖就可以把你修好。

original: You look like you've seen better days. A few caps'll fix that up for you.
translation: 我们经历了几次战斗，不是吗？那就是为何他们付给我这么多钱……

original: Been in a few fights, have we? Well, that's why they pay me the big bucks...
translation: 没什么能比带有超多瓶盖，并负了伤的奴隶贩子更能吸引我的。但愿你也是那种类型的。

original: Just let me know if you need anything, and I'll do whatever I can to procure it.
translation: 如果你是来谈生意的，我洗耳恭听。

original: <sighs> I'm sure that whatever you have to say is absolutely vital. So let's hear it.
translation: <叹气>我相信无论你要说什么都是至关重要的，说来听听。

original: Look. I told you. My name's Forty. I'm not inclined to change it, so unless you've got something good to say, you'd best make it fast.
Hey. Talk fast, they hate it when I talk to customers.
translation: 嗨。讲快点。他们不喜欢我和顾客聊天。

original: Hey sorry, man. Let me get out of your way!
translation: 嗨，不好意思，哥们。我给你让路！

original: Whoa there. Easy, killer. I'm movin', I'm movin'!
translation: 哇。别紧张，杀手。我走了，我走了！

original: Heard about you. You're some pretty slick shit.
You look like a damn fool in that Vault Suit.
translation: 你穿避难所套装太傻了。

original: Nice! Did you get that monkey suit from the Brotherhood?
translation: 不错！你是从兄弟会那搞到这猴子套装的？

original: Sorry, bro. Got nothin' to say to you.
translation: 不好意思，哥们。和你没什么好说的。

original: Sorry, chica. Got nothin' to say to you.
translation: 不好意思，小妞。和你没什么好说的。

original: I can't believe that Grouse let you in here.
translation: 不敢相信是那葛劳斯放你进来的。

original: Don't think I won't throw your ass in the pens with the rest of the meat.
translation: 别以为我不会把你和那帮菜鸟一起送进围栏。

original: You don't exactly look like you belong here.
translation: 你看上去不像是这里的。

original: What's it to be? A few caps to find out where your father went? Or are you going to have a go of it on your own?
translation: 想干嘛？想用些瓶盖来打听你父亲的去处？还是你准备自己去找？

original: The Wasteland can be such an unforgiving place...
translation: 废土可是一片无情的地方...

original: No luck finding dear old dad? Can't say it surprises me. Wasteland's a big place. Maybe you need a drink.
translation: 找不到你亲爱的爸爸？我一点都不惊讶。废土可是很大的地方，或许你要杯喝的。

original: You're still standing here, and I can't think why. You know where your father went. Seems to me you ought to be out searching the Wastes.
translation: 你还站在这，我不知道还有什么理由。你知道你爸爸去哪了，我想你该到废土去找他。

original: Looks like you went and got yourself irradiated. Too bad for you, I'm off duty. Stop by the clinic in the morning.
translation: 看来你受辐射污染了。太糟了，我下班了。明天早上再来吧。

original: The Doctor is off duty. Go away.
Boy, you're glowin' like a goddamn reactor core. You need help?
translation: 孩子，你身上发光像个该死的反应堆核心。需要帮助？

original: Girl, you're glowin' like a goddamn reactor core. You need help?
translation: 女孩，你身上发的光像个该死的反应堆核心。需要帮助？

original: What the hell are you standin' there bleedin' on my floor for? If you need help, then ask for it, dammit!
translation: 你他妈干嘛站在我的地板上流血？如果你要帮助就说，见鬼！

original: Don't shoot! Please! Just tell me what you want!
translation: 别开枪！求你！你说你要什么吧！

original: Oh, man... I'm glad to see you. Moriarty's been especially nasty lately and I need a friendly face.
translation: 哦，哥们……很高兴见到你。莫里亚蒂近来特别讨厌，我需要友善的面孔。

original: Dad used to say... oh, never mind...
Be careful, mister. My dad is right over there. Try anything, and I'll yell for him.
translation: 小心，先生。我爸爸就在那。你敢对我怎样我就叫他。

original: Be careful, lady. My dad is right over there. Try anything, and I'll yell for him.
translation: 小心，小姐。我爸爸就在那。你敢对我怎样我就叫他。

original: Dad usually doesn't like when I talk to strangers.
translation: 爸爸一般不喜欢我和陌生人说话。

original: Now I KNOW I've never seen you in Megaton before. Let me guess -- just passing through, right?
translation: 我知道我从未在兆吨镇见过你。让我猜猜 — 你只是路过，对吧？

original: We get people tryin' to settle down here all the time. Anyway, if you're hungry, you came to the right place. What can I get you?
translation: 一直有人想在这定居。总之，你要是饿了，就算来对地方了。你要点什么？

original: Hey. What can I get you?
So what'll it be today? We've got some noodles. And the Brahmin steak is pretty good, too.
translation: 今天怎么样啊？我们有些面条。双头牛肉排也相当不错。

original: So what's it going to be?
The noodle stand is closed right now. If you need something, talk to Leo.
translation: 面条摊现在关了。如果你要什么，和利奥说。

original: Oh, look. Another one of your pampered vault assholes. Look here, vault asshole -- I don't like you. Stay clear of me and we'll have no trouble.
translation: 哦，看。又是个暴饮暴食的避难所混蛋。听好，避难所混蛋 — 我不喜欢你。离我远点，我们就不会有麻烦。

original: Have you seen a radiphlange anywhere around here? I could really use one... ah, never mind. What can I get you?
translation: 你在这附近见过电台投射器吗？我真的要用一个……啊，别介意。你要什么？ ?

original: Well goddamn. You're new, right? I've got to admit, the outfit's a little weird, but that's okay, that's okay. Name's Leo Stahl. It's a pleasure!
translation: 该死，你是新来的，是吗？我得承认，这套装有点怪异，但是没关系，没关系。我是利奥·斯塔尔。很荣幸！

original: Well goddamn. You're new, right? Name's Leo Stahl. It's a pleasure! It's a pleasure! Yeah!
translation: 该死，你是新来的，是吗？我是利奥·斯塔尔。很高兴！真的很高兴！耶！

original: <sighs> It's you. I was hoping that you'd have moved on. What do you want?
translation: <叹气>是你。我还指望你走了。你要什么 ?

original: Hey hey! Nice to see you! Everything okay? You doing all right? You need something? Come on, talk to me!
translation: 嗨，嗨！很高兴见到你！都好吧？干得不错吧？你需要东西？来吧，和我谈谈！

original: Alright! Good to see you again! What's new? Feel like having a drink? C'mon, let's talk!
translation: 好吧！再次见到你？有什么新消息吗？感觉想要喝一杯？来吧，我们谈谈 !

original: Good to see you're staying out of trouble.
translation: 很高兴见到你没惹麻烦。

original: Got my eye on you. Don't do anything stupid.
Hi, I'm Maggie. I live with Billy. Billy Creel. Do you know him? He's not my dad or anything, but he takes care of me now.
translation: 嘿，我是玛姬。我和比利一起住。比利·克里。你知道他吗？他不是我爸爸或什么人，但是他现在照顾我。总之，我该走了，再见。

original: If you see Nathan, tell that man to get his ass back home.
translation: 如果你见到内森，告诉他滚回家来。

original: You seen Nathan anywhere around here?
translation: 你见到内森在附近什么地方吗？

original: Hi there. I'm Nova. New to Megaton, huh? Do yourself a favor and keep walking. Some of us stay for a few days... and then it's five years later...
translation: 你好，我是诺瓦。刚来兆吨镇，呃？为你自己好，继续赶路吧。我们当中一些人只想待几天……然后过去了五年……

original: Listen, I'm working right now. So make it quick, okay?
translation: 听着，我现在正在干活。因此动作快点，好吗？

original: I'm just here to guard the goods. That's all.
translation: 我只是来看守货物而已。

original: I'm here to watch over this stuff. Only touch what you've paid for, and we'll have no problem.
translation: 我在这看守。只碰你付过钱的东西，那我们就会相安无事。

original: I've got my eye on you.
This place is so much better than Moriarty's. That place is just filled with scum.
translation: 这比莫里亚蒂那好多了。那都是人渣。

original: Pull up a chair if you want.
translation: 如果需要就拉张椅子过来。

original: Hey there, stranger. Talk to Leo if you need something.
translation: 嗨，陌生人。如果有什么需要就和利奥说。

original: Always good to see a new face.
Leo's a nice guy, a bit twitchy, but nice.
translation: 利奥是个好人，他有点急躁，但是个好人。

original: Don't mind Andy, he's just a busy guy.
translation: 不用介意安迪，他只是有些忙。

original: So, you're back. We had feared both you and the G.E.C.K. were lost. Were you successful?
translation: 你回来了。我们还以为你和伊甸园创造器都完蛋了。你成功了吗？

original: You're supposed to be in that holding cell. You're not going anywhere!
translation: 你应该在传讯室里。你不能去任何地方！

original: There's a full complement of guards in the next room. As soon as I get them, you're going back to your cell. In a body bag, if necessary.
translation: 隔壁房间有一整队守卫。我一喊他们，你就只有回你的房间了。如果必要的话，用装尸袋拖回去。

original: Why do you insist on making things difficult?
translation: 你为什么坚持要把事情复杂化？

original: Maybe I should start shooting. How much blood you think you can afford to lose before you tell me what I want to know?
translation: 或许我该开始射击。你考虑过在你告诉我我想知道的东西前，有多少血能流吗？

original: Did you really think we would fall for that? I have had ENOUGH of your games.
translation: 你真的以为我们会上当？我受够你的把戏了。

original: I should have killed you right away. We have the G.E.C.K., we'll get the code. We don't need you.
translation: 我应该宰了你。我们拥有了伊甸园创造器，我们会得到密码。我们不需要你。

original: Let's keep this nice and simple. You're going to tell me the code for that Purifier, and you're going to tell me now.
translation: 我们文明点。告诉我净化器的密码，立刻告诉我。

original: I would surely have perished if it wasn't for Mister Tenpenny and his tower.
translation: 如果不是特佩尼先生和他的大厦，我肯定早就死了。

original: I would surely have perished if it wasn't for Roy Phillips and his tower.
translation: 如果不是罗伊·菲利普斯和他的大厦，我肯定早就死了。

original: Here's your pay. Now, don't spend it all in one place, unless that place is Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 这是你的酬劳。现在，别在一个地方花光它，除非那地方是特佩尼大厦。

original: Fancy that! A visitor. I seldom get visitors. Which is a tiresome shame because I'm usually relentlessly bored out of my right mind!
translation: 有趣！一个来访者。我很少接待来访者。那很烦人，我经常被无情地打乱正常思维。

original: All of these confounded people fluster about like I'm made of eggshells and about to fall to pieces at any moment. I'm surprised they even let you in.
translation: 所有这些糊涂蛋都很惊恐，好像我是蛋壳做的，随时都会掉在地上摔成碎片。我很惊讶他们居然让你进来。

original: So what do you think of my fine tower here? It's quite the jewel of the Wasteland isn't it? I daresay I'm quite proud of it myself.
translation: 你觉得我可爱的大厦怎么样？它真是废土上的一粒宝石，对吧？我为此感到自豪。

original: Welcome to New Urban Apparel. I carry the finest in Pre-War clothes. Hurry up, let's get you out of those old rags and into something fabulous!
translation: 欢迎来到新都市服装店。我有最好的战前衣服。快点，把这些破抹布脱了换上漂亮的新衣服！ !

original: Hurry up, let's get you out of those old rags and into something fabulous!
translation: 快，让我们把你这身旧抹布换掉，换身动人的！ !

original: I'm off duty. Come back when... ah, what the hell. Let's just get it over with. I'm Doctor Banfield, what do you need?
translation: 我下班了。等……啊，见鬼。让我们搞定它。我是班菲尔德医生。你需要什么？

original: You look hurt. It's a good thing you've come in.
translation: 看来你受伤了。你来对地方了。

original: I know you. You're that girl. You know, the one that... whatever.
translation: 我知道你，你是那女孩，你知道，就是那……随便是谁吧。

original: Happy Holidays! Care for a drink?
Ah yes. Mister Burke is expecting you. He is waiting for you on the balcony.
translation: 啊，是。伯克先生正期盼与你见面。他在阳台等你。

original: I'm on duty. Can't talk. Direct your security concerns to Chief Gustavo directly.
translation: 我在工作。别说话。你的安全问题直接去找古斯塔沃长官。

original: I'm not here for your entertainment.
It was so weird! All of a sudden the ants went nuts and started fighting each other.
translation: 太不可思议了！突然间，蚂蚁们发狂并开始厮打起来。

original: It was like they were totally crazy! It was really scary, but kinda cool at the same time, ya know what I mean?
translation: 就好像它们完全疯了！真的很吓人，不过同时也很酷，你懂我意思吧？

original: It was so weird! All of a sudden the ants went nuts and started fighting each other.
translation: 太不可思议了！突然间，蚂蚁们发狂并开始厮打起来。

original: It was like they were totally crazy! It was really scary, but kinda cool at the same time, ya know what I mean?
translation: 就好像它们完全疯了！真的很吓人，不过同时也很酷，你懂我意思吧？

original: Did you change your mind or something?
translation: 你改变了主意还是怎么？

original: Well, don't just stand there. You're distracting me. I must calculate the most efficient way to get to my equipment.
translation: 好了，别站在那，你在分散我注意力。我必须算出拿到我的设备的最佳方案。

original: Well, don't just stand there. You're distracting me. I must calculate the most efficient way to get to my equipment.
translation: 好了，别站在那，你在分散我注意力。我必须算出拿到我的设备的最佳方案。

original: One of us is going to have to go in there and turn the damned thing on. And whoever does it isn't coming back out.
translation: 我们其中一人必须进去打开那该死的东西。无论是谁，必定有去无回。

original: Not exactly how I imagined going out, you know?
translation: 其实我可不是这么想的，你懂吗？

original: So, what should we do? Draw straws?
translation: 那，我们应该怎么办？抽签？

original: Before we get started, I wanted to let you know that my father and I have been talking.
translation: 在我们开始前，我想让你知道我父亲和我曾谈论过。

original: The Pride and I have decided that after all you've survived, you've done enough to be an honorary member of Lyon's Pride.
translation: “里昂斯的骄傲”和我一致决定，你经历过这么多，有资格成为“里昂斯的骄傲”的荣誉成员。

original: So congratulations. Membership comes with some privileges, including our Power Armor. You want the full suit, or the Recon armor?
translation: 恭喜你。成员有些特权，包括我们的动力装甲。你要全套动力装甲，还是一套侦察装甲？

original: Thanks, friend. That was a narrow shave and no mistake. Probably would have eaten us or whatever those damned things do to people.
translation: 谢谢，朋友。那几乎是九死一生。或许我们会被吃或者被做些该死的事。

original: Listen, we got some water we can spare. Go ahead, you earned it.
translation: 听着，我们有一些备用的水。拿去，这是你应得的。

original: Whew. Thanks for the help. I thought I was a goner.
translation: 哟。谢谢帮助。我以为我死定了。

original: You probably saved my life. Here, take this. You look like you may need it more than I will.
translation: 或许你救了我的命。来，拿着。你看起来比我更需要这。

original: Where'd he come from? If you hadn't come along, that ugly brute probably would've eaten me, or dragged me off to wherever.
translation: 他从哪来的？如果不是你来了，这丑陋的畜生已经把我吃了或者把我拖到哪去了。

original: Here, take this. It's the least I can do.
translation: 来，拿着这。这是我唯一能做的。

original: Thanks, stranger. That thing would probably have killed me if it wasn't for you.
translation: 谢谢你，陌生人。如果不是你，这东西或许已经杀了我。

original: I wish I had more, but I want you to have this. And I won't take no for an answer.
translation: 我就这么点了，你都拿去吧。千万别拒绝。

original: Don't you look absolutely... miserable. Pull up a stool and lay down a few caps, tell Uncle Ahzrukhal all about it...
translation: 你看上去真……不幸。搬张椅子，扔几个瓶盖，把这些全告诉阿祖卡叔叔。

original: Yeah, what is it- Oh! Oh my! Someone new! I'm so sorry, you must think I'm terribly rude! Welcome! Welcome to Carol's Place! I'm Carol.
translation: 嗯，那什么 — 哦！天啊！新来的！对不起，你一定觉得我很无礼！欢迎！欢迎到卡洛尔的地盘！我是卡洛尔。

original: It's not much, I know, but it's mine! So, if you need anything, just let me know. Greta will get you any food you want, and I handle the rooms.
translation: 地方不大，我知道，但这是我的！那么，如果你需要什么东西，只要告诉我。想吃什么只管找葛丽泰，而我出租房间。

original: It's so good to have someone new here, even if it is an ugly ol' smoothskin! I'm kidding! I'm just kiddin! Don't make that face! You'll love it here.
translation: 在这能见到新人真好，即使是丑陋的光皮肤！我开玩笑！开玩笑的！别拉长着脸！你会喜欢这的。

original: Sorry. I'm on a break. I'll be back in a bit if you need some food.
translation: 对不起。我在休息。你如果需要食物我立刻回来。

original: Hey. I saw you over there talking to Carol. She's friendly, isn't she? But don't you get any ideas about her. Got it? Good.
translation: 嗨。我说你去那和卡洛尔谈了。她很友好，对吧？但是你不要打她任何主意。明白了？很好。

original: Now, do you want something to eat?
translation: 现在你需要什么吃的吗？

original: ... ... huh? ... Ah! Jesus Christ! Don't... don't sneak up on me like that, the last fella... the last fella to do that damn near lost my arm.
translation: ……呃？……啊！耶稣基督！别……别这样偷偷接近我，最后一次这么做的伙计……最后一次这么做的伙计该死的差点废了我的胳膊。

original: You're new here, yeah... you must be, since you're actually talking to... talking to me... I'm Patchwork... or just "Patches" if... if you like that.
translation: 你是新来这的，对……你肯定是，因为你现在正在和……和我说话……我是“拼盘”……或者就“补丁”，如果……如果你喜欢那样叫。

original: Oh, hello, my boy! You've come back for more stories from ol' Quinn, have you?
translation: 哦，你好，小子！你来是想从老奎因这听更多故事的，对吧？

original: Oh, hello, my girl! You've come back for more stories from ol' Quinn, have you?
translation: 哦，你好，女孩！你来是想从老奎因这听更多故事的，对吧？

original: Didn't you hear me? Leave us alone.
translation: 你没听到吗？离我们远点。

original: Well look who's back. What can I do you for, smoothskin?
translation: 看看谁回来了。我能为你做点什么，光皮肤？

original: Did you see that? Charon just shot Ahzrukhal!
translation: 看到了吗？卡戎刚向阿祖卡开枪！

original: It's so weird here without Ahzrukhal.
translation: 阿祖卡不在这太蹊跷了。

original: I still can't believe that Charon shot Ahzrukhal. I never saw that one coming.
translation: 我还是不敢相信卡戎向阿祖卡开枪了。我从未想到会发生这样的事。

original: You know, Ahzrukhal was a bastard, but I kind of miss him...
translation: 你要知道，阿祖卡是个杂种，但我有点想念他……

original: There are a lot more of us down here than there are of you, smoothskin. You just behave yourself.
translation: 在这下面，我们的人比你们多多了，光皮肤。放老实点。

original: Well done! You have defeated the vile AntAgonizer, and you've brought back her suit so that we may destroy the last taint of her villainy!
translation: 好极了！你打败了卑劣的痛苦蚁后，而且你拿回了她的套装，我们能毁掉她罪恶的最后一个污点。

original: Hand it to me, and I'll make sure that no one else can ever bear the mantle of the foul AntAgonizer!
translation: 把它给我，我保证再也没有人会再次受到这肮脏的痛苦蚁后的阴影笼罩。

original: You had best hand over the AntAgonizer suit. It's too dangerous to let it fall into the wrong hands.
translation: 你最好把痛苦蚁后的套装给我。让它落入别有用心之人手中就太危险了。

original: Oh man! Did you see it? Did you see it? The AntAgonizer was all like, "Fear me!" But the Mechanist was all, "Stop, evil-doer!"
translation: 哦，哥们！你看到了没！你看到了吗？痛苦蚁后都像在喊“怕我吧！”，但是机械侠好像都在喊“住手，恶棍！”。

original: Whew! You wouldn't believe how much trouble those two have caused in this town. We've been looking for someone to get rid of them for a long time.
translation: 哟！你不会相信那两个家伙在这镇上惹了多少麻烦。长久以来，我们一直期待有人出现除掉他们。

original: But you just walked in and cleaned up the town, easy as you please! We're in your debt, that's for sure.
translation: 但你就这么走进去，然后解决了镇子的麻烦，就像玩似的！我们欠你的，真的。

original: I'm mayor of Canterbury Commons, think of me as your own Uncle Roe.
translation: 我是坎特伯雷社区的镇长，把我当成你自己的罗伊大叔。

original: And take this, as our thanks for cleaning up the town.
translation: 然后拿着这，当作你解决镇子麻烦的酬谢。

original: Whew! You wouldn't believe how much trouble those two have caused in this town. We've been looking for someone to get rid of them for a long time.
translation: 哟！你不会相信那两个家伙在这镇上惹了多少麻烦。长久以来，我们一直期待有人出现除掉他们。

original: But you just walked in, downed one, and drove off the other, easy as you please! That'll be the last we see of them, you can be sure of that!
translation: 但你就这么进去，干掉一个，赶走另一个，跟玩似的！这是我们最后一次见到他们，肯定。

original: I'm mayor of Canterbury Commons, think of me as your own Uncle Roe.
translation: 我是坎特伯雷社区的镇长，把我当成你自己的罗伊大叔。

original: And take this, as our thanks for cleaning up the town.
translation: 然后拿着这，当作你解决镇子麻烦的酬谢。

original: Glad to see you're finally awake. I can't believe they made you do that stupid ceremony.
translation: 很高兴看到你终于醒了。我不敢相信他们居然要你参加那个愚蠢的仪式。

original: They listen when I talk, but they don't hear... you know what I mean?
translation: 我说话，他们听，但根本没听进去……你懂我意思吗？

original: By insulting the Tree Father, you've insulted us all. You are no longer a guest here. I'd advise you to leave immediately.
translation: 你侮辱“树之父”就是侮辱了我们所有人。你不再是这的客人。我劝你立刻离开。

original: Any chance the Wasteland had for recovery someday is now gone.
translation: 能让废土有朝一日恢复生机的唯一机会就这么消失了。

original: Please... I wish to be alone right now.
translation: 拜托，我现在想一个人待会。

original: Please, drink the sap from the basin.
What is it you wish to talk about, my friend?
translation: 你想聊些什么呢，我的朋友？

original: Do you realize what you’ve done? You’ve triggered the Failsafe! Ruined everything! The subjects will die, and I’ll be stuck here in this hell! Alone!
translation: 你意识到你干了什么吗？你触发了故障保险！毁了这的一切！实验对象会死！我会被孤独地困在这地狱里！

original: Remember what I told you. The Failsafe. You've got to find it!
translation: 记住我告诉你的。故障保险，你得去找到它！

original: What... What the hell is this?
Not quite what I had in mind. But you get a chance to try again. Go to it!
translation: 不如我想的那样。但是你有机会再试一次。去吧！

original: It's good to see you back. But you'd better get to the lab right away, and report to Elder Lyons.
translation: 很高兴见到你回来。但是你最好立刻赶去实验室，向里昂斯长老报到。

original: I'm sorry, but I really don't have time to talk right now. Perhaps Scribe Jameson could help you?
translation: 我很抱歉，但我真的没空聊天。或许詹姆森文士能帮你？

original: The Enclave seems to have developed advanced plasma-based weaponry. I need to analyze our Power Armor...
translation: 看来英克雷已经研发了进阶等离子武器。我需要分析我们的动力装甲……

original: What I wouldn't do to get my hands on one of those Enclave vertibirds...
translation: 我怎么都想逮到一架英克雷飞鸟……

original: All this time spent acquiring technology, and we look like cavemen next to the Enclave. That is not acceptable.
translation: 耗费了这么多时间来研发技术，但和英克雷比起来，我们看起来就像穴居人。这不能接受。

original: Super Mutants, Enclave -- they all bleed the same. No worries.
translation: 超级变种人，英克雷 — 他们一样会流血。别担心。

original: Welcome to the Citadel. Just remember -- you're a guest in our home. I expect you to behave yourself.
translation: 欢迎来到五角大本营。请记住 — 你是我们的客人。我希望你遵守规矩。

original: Welcome to the Citadel, friend of Steel.
translation: 欢迎来到五角大本营，钢铁兄弟会的朋友。

original: You ever seen a Super Mutant's head explode? Hell of a mess.
translation: 你见过一个超级变种人的脑袋爆炸吗？那真是恶心得一塌糊涂。

original: I hear those Enclave soldiers are equipped with Plasma weapons. Lucky bastards.
translation: 我听说那些英克雷士兵装备了等离子武器。幸运的杂种。

original: I will serve the Citadel and Elder Lyons until my dying breath. Is there any better life?
translation: 我会为五角大本营和里昂斯长老效忠至死。还有比这更好的人生吗？

original: Glad to see you and that egghead Li made it here in one piece. I heard what happened at that purifier. Hell of a thing.
translation: 很高兴见到你和书呆子李安全到了这。我听说净化器那的事。真是见鬼。

original: Initiate! You've got a lot of nerve to interrupt... Oh, my apologies, stranger. I thought you were one of these worthless Initiates.
translation: 新兵！你得鼓起勇气……哦，对不起。陌生人。我还以为你是那些没用的新兵。

original: I swear, these kids'd be lost without me here to powder their asses.
translation: 我保证，要是没有我照料的话，这些孩子早就完蛋了。

original: Hail. Name's Greg -- Greg Bear. Most of the guys just call me Kodiak.
translation: 你好。我叫格雷格 — 格雷·贝尔。大多数人都叫我科迪亚克。

original: Heard about that mess over at the purifier. Don't you worry -- you're safe here.
translation: 听说了在净化器那的混乱。但你不必担心 — 在这你很安全。

original: How may I serve you, friend of Steel?
translation: 我能怎么帮你，兄弟会的朋友。

original: "If we value the pursuit of knowledge, we must be free to follow wherever that search may lead us."
translation: “如果我们珍惜对知识的追寻，那我们必须任由研究引领我们前进。”

original: I found that in an ancient book. The words of wisdom of one of the greatest men of the former civilization.
translation: 我在一本古书里面发现这个的。出自以前文明的一位伟人的智慧语言。

original: The Elder sent word of your arrival. I am Scribe Peabody. Welcome, et. cetera...
translation: 长老说过你要来。我是文士博迪。欢迎，诸如此类……

original: Now, I'm really very busy. Is there something you needed?
translation: 现在我真的很忙。有什么你需要的吗？

original: I salute you, warrior. You walk among us, but apart from us. How may I aid you?
translation: 向你致敬，勇士。我们理想相同，却不得不分道而行。我能怎么帮你？

original: Here, take this mask. It'll keep you safe from the Ferals. Just don't get too close to them, or they'll sniff you out. Don't forget to PUT IT ON!
translation: 来，拿着这面具。这会保护你避免受到凶悍僵尸的攻击。只要别靠他们太近，就发现不了你。别忘了戴上它！

original: What's the status on those Tenpenny bigots?
translation: 那些特佩尼偏执狂现在怎样？

original: What's the word at Tenpenny, kid?
translation: 特佩尼那有什么消息，孩子？

original: I'm really not in the mood, so leave me alone.
translation: 我现在心情不好，所以离我远点。

original: Your constant need to chatter is pressing on my optic nerve.
translation: 我受不了你没完没了的唠叨了。

original: You have a curious look about you. I presume you have something interesting to tell me?
translation: 你的样子真奇怪。我想你有什么趣事要告诉我？

original: Leave me alone! Me and Bob have better things to do than speak to a murderer!
translation: 走开！我和鲍勃才不要和杀人凶手说话！

original: Now go away, never come back!
So what's the deal? You gonna get me some Sugar Bombs or what?
translation: 什么交易。你要给我一些糖麦弹还是什么？ ?

original: You're not... not here to try and steal my secrets are you?
translation: 你……你不会在想偷走我的秘密吧，对吧？

original: I like these guys, they let me play with their pucks.
translation: 我喜欢这些人，他们让我玩他们的冰球。

original: Hey, I may be just a Winger now, but I'll make Centre soon.
translation: 嗨，我或许现在只是个边锋。不过我不久就能成为中场。

original: Sorry, we've got practice. Maybe we'll cross sticks again one day.
translation: 抱歉，我们要训练。或许有朝一日我们会有机会切磋球技。

original: Oh my, it's you. I-I wasn't expecting visitors all the way out here.
translation: 哦，是你啊。我……我可没想到在这会有远道而来的来访者。

original: My name's Agatha. What brings you to my home?
translation: 我叫阿加莎，是什么风把你吹到我家来了？

original: My my my. You certainly do look a little bit worn out from your travels.
translation: 喔喔喔，看上去你的旅途很艰辛啊。

original: Oh, just look at my terrible manners! I'm Agatha. It's so nice to meet you.
translation: 哦，看我多没礼貌！我是阿加莎，很高兴见到你。

original: Now, what brings you all the way out here?
translation: 是什么风把你吹到我这来了？

original: Have you decided to find me a violin?
translation: 你决定帮我找小提琴了吗？

original: You've got to get this door unlocked!
We can talk back at Big Town. Let's get out of here!
translation: 我们回了大镇再说。我们快离开这！

original: I'll feel better once we're safe.
translation: 等安全了，我会觉得好些。

original: Thank God! Who are you? Never mind, I don't care right now. Let's go get Red and get out of here!
translation: 谢天谢地！你是谁？别在意，现在我不关心这。我们离开这去找瑞德！

original: Come on, you've got to untie me!
Thanks! Who are you? Never mind, I don't care right now. Let's go get Red and get out of here!
translation: 谢天谢地！你是谁？别在意，现在我不关心这。我们离开这去找瑞德！

original: You lead. I'll follow. Let's go! Move it!
translation: 你带路，我跟着。我们走！快点！

original: No more talking! Let's get out of here!
Thanks for helping us. I just hope we can survive another attack. Probably won't.
translation: 谢谢你帮助我们。我只是希望我们能在下次进攻中活下来。可能不会。

original: Guess we can try living with the Ghouls.
translation: 我想我们能试着和僵尸一起生活。

original: I hope those Ghouls try to get along with us civilized people.
translation: 我希望那些僵尸不要打扰我们这些文明人。

original: I'm mighty appreciative of your straightening things out. Perhaps next time I go on safari I'll take you along.
translation: 我非常感激你把事情妥善处理了。或许下次旅行我会把你带上。
有什么你需要的东西吗？

original: Thank you for dealing with those Ghouls. You're a real hero.
translation: 谢谢你帮我们处理了那些僵尸。你是个真正的英雄。

original: Thanks for helping those Ghouls. They really aren't so bad.
translation: 谢谢你帮助了那些僵尸。他们真的不坏。

original: Hey... you're the one with the Ghoul friends... well I guess they're our friends now, too.
translation: 嗨……你是那个僵尸的朋友……我想现在他们也是我们的朋友了。

original: Good job removing our little pest problem!
translation: 干得好，帮我们清理了害虫！

original: I have nothing to say to you. Except this: Watch your back!
translation: 我没话和你说，除了这句：小心！

original: You did it! You got rid of those vile creatures! Good show!
translation: 你做到了！你赶走了那些卑劣的生物！干掉漂亮！
很快你会得到你应得的。

original: Hello friend. Ghoul physiology is fascinating!
translation: 你好，朋友。僵尸的生理机能真令人着迷！

original: Those Ghouls won't be bothering us anymore, will they?
translation: 那些僵尸不会再打扰我们了，对吧？

original: Come to pour salt into the wound? Well, I won't stand for it!
translation: 想在伤口撒盐？我可受不了！

original: You think I want to talk to you?
