Hey comrade! Those Ghoul's seem like a real community, hey? Adversity must have made them strong.
translation: 嗨，同志！那些僵尸看起来是个真正的公社，对吧？曾经的不幸一定让他们变得很强。

original: Take a real good look, because you won't be getting any of this!
translation: 好好看一看，因为你不会得到任何东西。

original: Hah! I'm doing just fine, no thanks to you!
translation: 哈！我也能做得同样好，不用谢你！

original: Glad to see you were able to convince these people to open their minds a little. Those Ghouls will liven things up around here for a long time!
translation: 很高兴看到你能说服这些人稍微开放点他们的思想。那些僵尸会让这里很长时间都有生气的！

original: Well, it'll take a little elbow grease but then this place will be a true home!
translation: 这会费些体力，但之后这会变成一个真正的家！

original: Bastards. Could have done it the easy way and just let us live here with them. Oh well. Guess we better get started with the clean up.
translation: 杂种。可以让事情更简单的，让我们和他们一起生活。哦，算了。我想我们最好开始把这弄干净。

original: Don't know how you did it. I'd never allow those zombies room and board. But as long as Tenpenny keeps paying me I'll stay.
translation: 不知道你是怎么做到的，我是永远不会允许给那些丧尸提供食宿。但只要特佩尼继续付我钱，我会留下。
干得漂亮，处理了那些丧尸！

original: What's up? Kill any more zombies lately?
translation: 什么事？最近杀丧尸了吗？

original: Hey. We grabbed this on our last mission. Thought you might like it.
translation: 嗨。上次任务我们拿了这。我想你可能喜欢它。

original: A badass like you, you deserve a cut of everything around here.
translation: 你个混蛋，这里所有的东西都该有你一份。

original: Check this out. Me and a couple of the boys thought you could use a cut of the loot we picked up.
translation: 看看这。我和几个兄弟认为你该得到一些我们战利品的分成。

original: You have my condolences. Your father was a good man.
translation: 请接受我的哀悼，你父亲是个好人。

original: May I start by saying that I am sorry for your loss. I was acquainted with your father, many years ago.
translation: 对你的遭遇我非常难过，让我先说声抱歉。很多年前我就熟悉你的父亲了。

original: The world has lost one of its few remaining visionaries.
translation: 世界又失去了一位为数不多的梦想者。

original: Don't you have something to do?
How did you get past the guard? What do you want?
translation: 你怎么通过守卫的？你要什么？

original: I haven't heard anything about Mister Crowley recently. So what could you possibly want?
translation: 我目前还没有听到考利先生的任何消息。你又想知道些什么？

original: Here's the key. He never even noticed.
translation: 这是钥匙。他不会注意到的。

original: Don't worry, you'll get the hang of it.
translation: 别担心，你会掌握怎么使用它的。

original: If you're having trouble, try crouching to steady your aim.
translation: 如果有麻烦，试着弯腰瞄准你的目标。

original: Go ahead. Try out your new gun on those targets over there.
translation: 去吧。试试你的新枪，靶子在那。

original: I heard how you helped out Timebomb. I'm not sure why you did it, but thanks. I only hope that he lives long enough to appreciate your help.
translation: 我听说过你怎么帮助“定时炸弹”逃走。我不知道你为什么这么做，不过谢谢你。我只希望他能活到能感谢你的那天。

original: Wow. I can't believe that you were able to help Timebomb. And here I was sure that you were ready to just let him die. I guess I had you wrong.
translation: 哇。我不敢相信你能帮助“定时炸弹”。我本以为你一定会看着他死。看来我错看你了。

original: He still can't fight, but if we survive for a bit longer, he should be back into it soon enough.
translation: 他还不能战斗，但是如果我们能再坚持一段时间，他应该能很快恢复战斗力。

original: Look, you're a better doc than me, that's pretty obvious. But if you need healing, I'll do it for you no charge.
translation: 听着，很明显你的医术比我高超。但是如果你需要治疗，我可以免费提供。

original: Woah, looks like you've seen some action. Do you need help?
translation: 哇，看起来你见过些大场面。你要帮助吗？

original: Things are looking good here, bud.
Watch the Wastes. Keep track of movement. Uh, what? Did you need something?
translation: 看着废土。跟上节奏。什么？你需要什么吗？

original: Whew! I thought I was a goner. You saved my life.
translation: 哟！我还以为我死定了呢。你救了我的命。

original: Here, take this. It's the least I can do.
translation: 来，拿着这。这是我唯一能做的。

original: Hello, stranger. I'm Tinker Joe, premier supplier of robotic parts and service throughout the D.C. Wasteland.
translation: 你好，陌生人。我是廷克·乔，首都废土的机器人零件和服务的主要供应商。

original: Thank you! Whoever you are, thank you! The... things they talked about doing to me...
translation: 谢谢！不管你是谁，谢谢！他们正商量要干掉我……

original: Thank you, friend. We won't forget this.
translation: 谢谢你，我的朋友，我们是不会忘记的。

original: Shh. Not too loud. I don't really want people to know that we're doin' business.
translation: 嘘。轻点。我可不想让别人知道我们在做交易。

original: There rest of these guys around here might not want anything to do with you, but I got no problem with you... well, not with your caps at least.
translation: 其余那些家伙或许不愿和你打交道，但我可不介意……至少不介意和你的钱打交道。

original: Hey, good to see you again. What do you need?
translation: 嗨，很高兴见到你！需要些什么？

original: I hear that you decided to speak to Ian regardless of my warnings.
translation: 我听说你无视我的警告，决定要和伊恩谈谈。

original: Be that as it may, I am still interested in what you conversed about. Did he come to a decision?
translation: 无论如何，我仍旧对你们谈话的内容感兴趣。他做出决定了吗？

original: Thank God you came along when you did. I don't know what I might have done...
translation: 感谢上帝你赶来，我不知道自己会怎样做……

original: Here. Take the gun. I don't want to find out what I'd do if I still had the gun when my father comes looking for me.
translation: 来，拿着枪。我可不想我父亲来找我时，我手里还拿着枪。

original: You'd better get out of here. I'll try to meet you at the vault door. If I don't make it... good luck.
translation: 你最好离开这。我会设法在避难所大门和你碰头，如果我不行的话……祝你好运。

original: We did it! My mom's gonna be okay! You're the best friend I've ever had, man!
translation: 我们做到了！我妈妈安全了！你是我这辈子最好的朋友，伙计！

original: Hey, I know it isn't much, but I want you to have my Tunnel Snakes jacket. Go ahead, take it.
translation: 嗨，我知道这不算什么，但拿上我的穴蛇帮夹克吧，给。

original: RL-3 regrets to inform that you are obviously unfit to command, sir!
translation: RL-3很遗憾的通知您，先生，你无权命令我。

original: Changed your mind about the job, yet?
You did a good thing, delivering that component to Zimmer. Telling him the android was dead. For that, I'm going to entrust you with some information.
translation: 你做了好事，把零件给了齐默。告诉他人造人已经死了。为此，我会将一些信息委托给你。

original: The android's transformation was done by a man named Pinkerton, here in Rivet City. He's hidden down in the broken fore section of the ship.
translation: 人造人的改造是铆钉城一个叫做平克顿的人完成的。他藏在断裂的船头。

original: You'll need to swim to reach him, but if you're inclined, Pinkerton can perform a facial reconstruction on you as well.
translation: 你得游过去找到他，但是如果你被他看中，平克顿也会对你进行面部改造。

original: It won't disguise your identity, but you'll be able to experience life in a new skin, and truly understand... that we're all human on the inside.
translation: 那不会改变你的本质，但是你能用新面孔来体验生活，而且请理解……在我们内心，我们都是人类。

original: We'd best not be seen speaking with each other further. If you want a new face, see Pinkerton, down in the flooded fore section of the carrier.
translation: 我们最好不要被人看见互相交流。如果你要张新面孔，去见平克顿，在航母被淹掉的船体前部。

original: The android's transformation was done by a man named Pinkerton, here in Rivet City. He's hidden down in the broken fore section of the ship.
translation: 人造人的改造是铆钉城一个叫做平克顿的人完成的。他藏在断裂的船头。

original: You'll need to swim to reach him, but if you're inclined, Pinkerton can perform a facial reconstruction on you as well.
translation: 你得游过去找到他，但是如果你被他看中，平克顿也会对你进行面部改造。

original: It won't disguise your identity, but you'll be able to experience life in a new skin, and truly understand... that we're all human on the inside.
translation: 那不会改变你的本质，但是你能用新面孔来体验生活，而且请理解……在我们内心，我们都是人类。

original: Yeah! I made it to Big Town! Big Town! Hurray! Now I just need to find Red.
translation: 耶！我到大镇了！大镇！万岁！现在我需要找到瑞德。

original: Go away! Hannibal is waiting for you.
What are we going to do? Those Slavers have captured the Memorial.
translation: 我们现在要去干嘛？那些奴隶贩子占领了纪念馆。

original: What? Oh! I didn't see you there. I get that way sometimes when I'm thinking.
translation: 什么？哦！我没看见你在那。当我思考的时候我有时会过于专注。

original: Excuse me, sir. I can't talk now. Slavers could be here any moment.
translation: 对不起，先生。我现在不能聊天。奴隶贩子随时会打进来。

original: Excuse me, ma'am. I can't talk now. Slavers could be here any moment.
translation: 对不起，女士。我现在不能聊天。奴隶贩子随时会打进来。

original: I don't talk to strangers. You need to go talk to Hannibal.
translation: 我不和陌生人说话。你去和汉尼拔谈吧。

original: Please, sir. Help us get rid of all those Slavers in the Memorial.
translation: 求求你，先生。帮我们把那些占领纪念馆的奴隶贩子赶走吧。

original: Please, ma'am. Help us get rid of all those Slavers in the Memorial.
translation: 求求你，女士。帮我们把那些占领纪念馆的奴隶贩子赶走吧。

original: Not now. We can talk after the Slaver attack.
translation: 现在不行。等奴隶贩子攻击结束后我们再谈。

original: Don't you be stopping here, mister. You got to talk to Hannibal first.
translation: 别说了，先生。你先去和汉尼拔谈谈。

original: Don't you be stopping here, lady. You got to talk to Hannibal first.
translation: 别说了，小姐。你先去和汉尼拔谈谈。

original: We've got to get those Slavers cleared out of the Memorial.
translation: 我们必须把纪念堂里的奴隶贩子都消灭了。

original: I'm sure Hannibal is cooking up a plan.
translation: 我确信汉尼拔正在酝酿一个计划。

original: You have a picture! And such a large one, too.
translation: 你有张照片！好大的一张。

original: I'll have no problems restoring the Memorial with this. Thank you!
translation: 对我来说，用这来修复纪念堂一点问题都没有。谢谢！

original: Make it quick. I've got a lot of work to do.
translation: 快点。我还有很多工作要做。

original: Those Slavers are all dead. We must stay vigilant. There may be more of them.
translation: 那些奴隶贩子都死了。我们必须保持警惕。可能还会来更多的。

original: We got wind that the Slavers are going to attack. We could really use your help in the fight.
translation: 我们得到风声，奴隶贩子准备攻击。我们在这场战斗中确实需要你的帮助。

original: I hear you found a great picture for Caleb. Once the Memorial site is safe, we can move there.
translation: 我听说你帮卡勒布找到张很棒的照片。只要纪念堂遗址安全了，我们就能到那去了。

original: So the Super Mutants are dead? This is wonderful news!
translation: 超级变种人死了？真是个好消息！

original: Now all you have to do is get Caleb his picture and we can begin our journey.
translation: 现在你要做的就是帮卡勒布拿到他的照片，然后我们就能开始我们的旅程。

original: We made it! The Memorial is really ours! I cannot thank you enough.
translation: 我们成功了！纪念堂是我们的了！我真不知道该怎么感谢你。

original: Here, take this. It's a token of our thanks.
translation: 来，拿着这。这代表我们的谢意。

original: You have been good to your word. You are welcome at the Temple of the Union anytime.
translation: 你言而有信。欢迎你随时来到团结圣殿。

original: Take these schematics as a token of our gratitude.
translation: 拿着这些设计图，这是我们给你的谢礼。

original: Yeah, I killed them all after telling you not to.
translation: 嗯，在叫你别动手之后，我把他们都杀了。

original: I just couldn't trust anyone else to do it. I needed to see them dead with my own eyes.
translation: 我只是不能信任其他人去做。我要亲眼看他们死掉。

original: Anyway, the problem has been taken care of. I can go back to Paradise Falls now.
translation: 总之，问题解决了。我现在能回堕落天堂了。

original: I'll make sure they know you're our kind of people. You'll be welcome there any time.
translation: 我会让他们知道你是我们一伙的。那随时欢迎你。

original: You again. Don't dawdle. Get in here.
translation: 又是你。别浪费时间。快进来。

original: You ain't supposed to be looking at me, to say nothing of talking to me.
translation: 你不该找我，更别说和我谈话了。

original: Now, beat it! Hannibal is waiting for you.
translation: 现在，快去！汉尼拔在等你。
该死的奴隶贩子占领了纪念堂。

original: As soon as Hannibal gives the word, we're going to charge in there and take it from them.
translation: 只要汉尼拔一声令下，我们就去进攻那，把它从他们手里夺回来。

original: Stay sharp. The Wasteland is dangerous.
You don't look like much, stranger. Bet you run from Radroaches.
translation: 你看上去不是很像，陌生人。我打赌你看见蟑螂都会跑。

original: I'm Simone Cameron. Don't fuck with me. Hannibal says I can't shoot you, but I ain't trusting you with a gun to my back.
translation: 我是西蒙妮·卡梅隆。别和我对着干。汉尼拔告诉我不能对你开枪，但你在我身后拿着枪令我不舒服。

original: Are you trying to piss me off?
That's close enough. What the hell are you doing wandering around here?
translation: 真够悬的。见鬼，你在这游荡做什么？

original: I heard you're going to help us get those runaways.
translation: 我听说你准备帮我们抓住那些逃跑的家伙。

original: Hey! It's my favorite wanker! I am so fucking glad I talked you out of putting a bullet in my brain. Hah ha!
translation: 嗨！是我最喜欢的卑鄙家伙！我他妈的真高兴，打消了你要把子弹打进我脑袋的想法，哈哈！

original: Hey! It's my favorite bitch assassin! Hah ha! I am so fucking glad I talked you out of putting a bullet in my brain!
translation: 嗨！是我最喜欢的婊子刺客！哈哈！我他妈的真高兴，打消了你要把子弹打进我脑袋的想法！

original: I presume you are still honoring our previous arrangement? I enjoy being alive, at least for the moment.
translation: 我猜你还在为我们先前的安排而自豪？我很高兴还活着，至少现在是。

original: It's always good to see one of our number here. Have you brought tales and trophies of justice?
translation: 真高兴在这见到我们的一员，你带来了正义的传说和战利品吗？

original: We bring law to a lawless land.
translation: 我们把法律带到了无法无天的土地。

original: We are justice. We are the law.
translation: 我们就是正义，我们就是法律。

original: Stay true to yourself and to the law. This is the rule of the Regulator.
translation: 保持诚实，遵守法律。这是赏金猎人的宗旨。

original: Well, according to this, you're in line to be trained as a Laundry Cannon Operator. First time for everything, indeed.
translation: 根据结果，你接下来要受训成为一名洗衣机操作员。凡事总有第一次。

original: Looks like the diner's going to get a new Fry Cook. I'll just say this once: hold the mustard, extra pickles. Ha ha ha.
translation: 看来我们的餐厅要有一个新厨师了。我只说一次：去芥末，多腌汁。哈哈哈。

original: Huh. I wonder who will be brave enough to be your first customer as the vault's new Tattoo Artist? I promise it won't be me.
translation: 呃。我很怀疑谁够胆成为你这避难所的新纹身艺师的首个顾客。我保证那不会是我。

original: Look, I'm not looking to rumble with you. How about we just stay out of each other's business, like usual.
translation: 听着，我不想和你吵架。我们像往常那样井水不犯河水怎么样。
感谢上帝，你要走了。快出去。

original: I guess you can see how bad things are down here. Sorry, where were we going?
translation: 我想你能看到这下面发生了多糟的事。对不起，我们这是要去哪？

original: Hey, if it ain't a fellow Tunnel Snake, slumming it down here with the old crew?
translation: 嗨，如果他不是穴蛇帮一伙的，就用老规矩在这把他干掉？

original: I thought you'd be out there tearing up the Wasteland and raising Hell!
translation: 我以为你在外面把废土搅得一塌糊涂呢。

original: But if you've gotta be back, might as well make yourself useful. You gotta help us.
translation: 但是如果你必须回来，就得让自己有点用。你必须帮助我们。

original: I hope you're making progress with my father. I can't imagine anyone else who would convince him we should venture outside.
translation: 我希望你和我父亲之间有进展。我不能想象还有其他人能说服他让我们出去闯荡。

original: Ah, another patient! What's it to be, eh? Appendectomy? Tonsillectomy?
translation: 啊，又一个病人！想治疗什么，呃？阑尾切除？扁桃体切除？

original: Well, if it isn't my star pupil.
translation: 那不是我的明星学生嘛。

original: The pulse charge is rigged? Excellent! Excellent!
translation: 脉冲充电器安装好了？好极了！好极了！

original: Ah. The anticipation is palpable. Isn't it?
When you have finished savoring the moment, you may have the honor of pressing the button. Oh, and mind your eyes. It'll be brighter than bright.
translation: 品味完这瞬间，我把按动按钮的荣誉给你。哦，小心你的眼睛。这会非常刺眼。

original: The detonator is right over there. You may have the honor. Hit the switch!
translation: 按钮就在那里。这是你的荣誉。按下开关！

original: Do it! Detonate the bomb and together we'll usher in a new age of prosperity!
translation: 干吧！引爆这核弹，让我们一起进入一个繁荣新时代！

original: My God... what transcendent beauty... what purifying light...
translation: 我的天啊……多么超凡的美丽……多么纯洁的光芒...

original: Ahem... Allow me to collect myself, as I'm sure you're anxious to collect your payment.
translation: 嗯……允许我调整下自己的情绪。因为我想你肯定急着想拿到你的报酬。

original: I've been asked to extend to you an invitation to reside at Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 我收到要求邀请你在特佩尼大厦居住。

original: Here's the key, and deed, to your new master suite. It's on the top floor, first door on your right from the elevator. Enjoy your new accommodations.
translation: 这是钥匙还有地契，到你的新大套房吧。乘电梯至顶楼，右边第一扇门。好好享受你的新住处。

original: Oh, and if you wish to spruce the place up a bit, speak with Lydia Montenegro in the Boutique le Chic.
translation: 哦，还有，如果你想让那整洁，就和时尚精品店的莉迪亚·黑山谈谈。

original: My God... what transcendent beauty... what purifying light...
translation: 我的天啊……多么超凡的美丽……多么纯洁的光芒...

original: Ahem... Allow me to collect myself, as I'm sure you're anxious to collect your payment.
translation: 嗯……允许我调整下自己的情绪。因为我想你肯定急着想拿到你的报酬。

original: Here's the key, and deed, to your new master suite. It's on the top floor, first door on your right from the elevator. Enjoy your new accommodations.
translation: 这是钥匙还有地契，到你的新大套房吧。乘电梯至顶楼，右边第一扇门。好好享受你的新住处。

original: Get the hell out of my face.
If you're going to continue to irritate me, I'm not going to be so nice about it.
translation: 如果你还要继续激怒我的话，我就对你不客气了。

original: What... Where am I? What happened?
translation: 什么……我在哪？发生了什么 ?

original: How long have I been out?
Yeah? What is it? Ready to help?
I'm afraid she's going to be out for a while. She's not well at all.
translation: 恐怕她会晕倒一阵。她的情况不太好。

original: Don't worry though, I'm sure the rest of Reilly's Rangers will show up soon and take her home.
translation: 尽管放心，我肯定剩下的莱莉游骑兵会立刻出现并带她回家。

original: You sure know your shit. Ever consider joining the Rangers? I bet Reilly would love to have you on our team.
translation: 你还挺能啊。考虑过加入游骑兵吗？我打赌莱莉会很乐意让你加入我们的队伍。

original: Well, I suppose thanks are in order... and a little something extra for your trouble.
translation: 我想先谢谢你……然后还有一点额外的谢礼。

original: I'm going to head back to Ranger Compound and see if Reilly's back yet. If you make your way there, Reilly will pay you herself.
translation: 我准备回游骑兵营地，看看莱莉是不是回来了。如果你去那里的话，莱莉会亲自给你报酬的。

original: If I can ever be of medical assistance or you need some supplies or repairs, let me or Donovan know.
translation: 如果你需要药品援助、补给或修理，就告诉我或者多诺万。

original: Welcome to... uh... the Capital Preservation Society.
translation: 欢迎来到……呃……首都保护协会.

original: Hi. I'm Angela. My dad runs Gary's Galley. If you want anything to eat, let me know when you are ready to order.
translation: 嗨。我是安吉拉。我爸爸经营加里厨房。如果想吃什么，点餐的时候告诉我一声。

original: Hi. I'm Angela. I run Gary's Galley. Let me know when you are ready to order.
translation: 嗨，我是安吉拉。我经营加里厨房。准备点餐的话就告诉我。

original: Welcome to Gary's Galley. Can I take your order?
translation: 欢迎光临加里厨房。可以点菜了吗？

original: Lay a hand on Doctor Zimmer, and I'll snap your neck like a chicken bone.
translation: 你敢动齐默博士一根汗毛，我就像拧鸡骨一样拧断你的脖子。

original: That's close enough. Keep your hands where I can see them.
translation: 够近了。把你双手放在我能看见的地方。

original: The market is closing soon. You'd better make it quick.
translation: 市场很快就关门了。你最好动作快点。

original: Welcome to Potomac Attire. I am Bannon, proprietor and City Council member.
translation: 欢迎光临波托马克服装。我是班侬，这的经营人和城市议会成员。

original: I carry discriminating attire for discriminating customers.
translation: 我为不同客户准备不同的服饰。

original: I heard that Danvers found a letter from Slavers in Seagrave's room.
translation: 听说丹佛斯在西格雷夫的房间找到一份奴隶贩子寄来的信。

original: That will teach that bastard to mess with me.
translation: 看那杂种还敢不敢找我的麻烦。

original: I think you've earned a permanent discount here.
translation: 我想你已经获得了这的永久折扣。
欢迎光临波托马克服装。

original: I think I've seen you in here before. When you're ready to buy, just let me know.
translation: 我觉得之前有在这见过你。你什么时候想买了，就来找我。

original: Have you found anything you like?
I'm Belle Bonny, and this is the Muddy Rudder.
translation: 我是贝勒·邦尼，这是“泥舵”酒吧。

original: I'll tell you what I tell all the fresh meat. Don't start anything down here or I'll have Brock kick your ass.
translation: 我把丑话说在前面。别在这找麻烦，否则我让布洛克给你好看。

original: I'm Belle Bonny, and this is the Muddy Rudder.
translation: 我是贝勒·邦尼，这是“泥舵”酒吧。

original: I'll tell you what I tell all the fresh meat. Don't start anything down here or I'll have to kick your ass.
translation: 我把丑话说在前面。别在这找麻烦，否则我会给你好看。

original: You're a new one. I'm Belle Bonny of the Muddy Rudder. Make it quick.
translation: 你是新来的吧。我是“泥舵”酒吧的贝勒·邦尼。动作快点。

original: I'm Brock, the bouncer. I take care of the troublemakers. You aren't going to be a troublemaker, are you?
translation: 我是保镖布洛克。我负责处理找麻烦的人。你不想找麻烦，对吧？

original: This place won't clean itself. That's my job.
translation: 这不会自己干净起来的。是我打扫的。

original: This is A Quick Fix. I mean that's the name of our shop. Paulie and mine that is. My name is Cindy. Cindy Cantelli.
translation: 这是快速修复。我指的是这商店的名字。我和保利的商店。我叫辛迪，辛迪·坎特利。

original: This is A Quick Fix. I mean that's the name of the shop. My name is Cindy. Cindy Cantelli.
translation: 这是快速修复。我指的是这商店的名字。我叫辛迪，辛迪·坎特利。

original: Nice to see you again. Are you looking for a quick fix?
translation: 很高兴再见到你。你需要快速修复吗？

original: I'm not supposed to talk to strangers.
translation: 我不应该和陌生人说话。

original: Maybe you don't know who you're talking to. I'm Commander Danvers, assistant chief of security.
translation: 或许你不知道你正在和谁说话。我是丹佛斯指挥官，警卫助理长官。

original: Have you seen Angela? I need to ask her something about our wedding.
translation: 你见过安吉拉吗？我需要向她询问我们婚礼的事。

original: Oh... never mind. I just remembered. Sorry. I'm so scatterbrained these days. What was it you wanted again?
translation: 哦……没关系。我记得了。对不起。我最近记性不好。你又是要什么来着？ ?

original: You're wounded. Let me bandage that.
translation: 你受伤了。我来给你包扎一下。

original: It's almost closing time. I'd get out of here if I was you.
translation: 快关门了。如果我是你，我就离开这。

original: This here is Flak and Shrapnel's gun shop. Pretty catchy, huh? Take a look around. If you see anything you like, I'll be right over here.
translation: 这是“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的枪械店。很好记，呃？随便看看吧。如果看中什么，就去那找我。

original: Decided to check out the shop, eh? If you want any of this shit, just holler.
translation: 想要在店里看看是吗？如果想要什么东西，叫我一声就行了。

original: I'm Flak. If you want something better than that peashooter, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
translation: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果你想要比那玩具枪好的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

original: I'm Flak. If you want something better than that stick of yours, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
translation: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果想要比你那棍子好的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

original: I'm Flak. If you want a decent weapon, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
translation: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果你想要件像样的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

original: Let me introduce myself. I am Gary Staley gourmet chef and gourmand. I'll be preparing your meal.
translation: 我先介绍下自己。我是美食家兼厨师长加里·斯塔利。由我来为你准备用餐。

original: My specialty is Mirelurk Cakes. Although the iguana is very popular too.
translation: 我的招牌菜是蟹人饼。蜥蜴类的也很受欢迎。

original: Ah! I knew you wouldn't be able to stay away from my cuisine for long.
translation: 啊！我就知道你不久就会再来光临我的餐馆的。

original: I'm Gary. Gary Staley. If you ever get hungry, stop by Gary's Galley.
translation: 我是加里，加里·斯塔利。如果饿了，随时来加里厨房坐坐。

original: Make it quick. I'm on a tight schedule.
This isn't a good time. My daughter, C.J. is missing.
translation: 现在不合适。我女儿长江不见了。

original: If you hear anything, please let me know right away.
translation: 如果你打听到什么消息，请立刻告诉我。

original: This place could use a few more people willing to work. Everything is falling apart. I'm the only one willing to fix it.
translation: 这可以多招几个愿意做事的人。一切都崩溃了，而我是唯一想要修复的人。

original: I'm busy. I've got a lot of repairs to make.
translation: 我很忙。我有很多修理工作要做。

original: I'm scared. Will you take me home? Take me to my Mom.
translation: 我很害怕。你能带我回家吗？带我去见我妈妈。

original: I'm scared. Will you take me home?
translation: 我很害怕。你能带我回家吗。

original: I heard Sister is dead. Thank God!
I'd rather be alone just now.
translation: 现在还是让我一个人静一静吧。

original: I wish I had the courage to end it all.
translation: 我希望自己有勇气去结束这一切。

original: I'm just taking things one day at a time.
Haven't seen you in here before. Do you need a fix? I might have what you need. You can always come see Paulie to get what you need.
translation: 之前没见过你。需要修理吗？我说不定有你需要的。有什么需要随时都可以过来找保利。

original: Who are you? Got any Psycho? I could really use a fix, but I'm broke.
translation: 你是哪位？有疯狂药吗？我真想自己来一支，可我身无分文。

original: Ha ha! I run the chem shop, but I'm broke and can't buy chems!
translation: 哈哈！我经营药店，却穷得买不起药品！

original: Make it quick, will ya? I'm coming down and I gotta get my fix.
translation: 快点，好不好？我到这来就是让你修一下。

original: How the hell did you get in here? Hmph. I suppose you can't be all that bad if you made it this far without dying.
translation: 见鬼，你怎么进来的？哼。我觉得你既然能够活到现在，相信身手一定不错。

original: This is the part where you tell me what the hell you are doing bothering an old man who obviously wants to be left alone... Get on with it already!
translation: 该你说说为他妈什么来打搅一个显然想独处的老人了……快点啊！ !

original: You'd better get out of here. The guards are going to close up soon.
translation: 你最好立刻离开，守卫要包围这里了。

original: Howdy. I'm Seagrave. Seagrave Holmes. I have a little of just about everything here.
translation: 你好。我是西格雷夫，西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。我这什么都有点。

original: Hey! I heard that Bannon got caught trying to frame me.
translation: 嗨！听说班侬想要陷害我而被抓了。

original: I also heard you ratted him out. I think you've earned a true, blue friendship discount.
translation: 我还听说你出卖了他。我想你获得了一个真正的友情价。

original: You sneak into my room, steal my property, and then tell the world about it.
translation: 你潜入我的房间，偷走了我的财物，然后大肆宣扬。

original: I'd ban you from my shop if they'd let me. Instead I'll just have to settle for ripping you off.
translation: 如果他们同意，我会把你挡在门外。但我宁愿把你榨干。

original: Take a look around. I got all kinds of stuff in here.
translation: 好好看看吧。我这应有尽有。

original: We're going to close soon. You'd better get out of here.
translation: 我们就要关门了。你还是快点走吧。

original: They call me Shrapnel. I run this place. Got the best damn armament you'll ever see.
translation: 他们叫我“榴弹”小帅。我经营这地方。你在这可以见到最精良的装备。

original: If you want any of this shit, just say so. Otherwise keep your fingers the hell away from the triggers. I don't want no accidents.
translation: 想要哪件烂货就说出来。否则让你丫的手指离扳机远点。我不想出乱子。

original: Don't know you, don't care. Keep it short.
translation: 不认识你，也不想。有话快说。

original: I'm Tammy. Just leave me alone, okay.
translation: 好吧？你在等什么呢？赶快走，让我一个人静一静。

original: Hey, good lookin'. How come you haven't bought me a drink yet?
translation: 嗨，帅哥。为什么你不请我喝一杯？

original: Shit. Just what this hole needs. Another woman.
translation: 狗屎。想什么来什么，又来个女人。

original: Either buy me a drink, or take your skanky ass somewhere else.
translation: 给我买杯喝的，不然你就离我远点。

original: Welcome to the Weatherly Hotel. I'm your hostess, Vera Weatherly.
translation: 欢迎光临韦瑟利旅馆。我是女房主，薇拉·韦瑟利。
格雷蒂奇……它在燃烧……它在燃烧！

original: The slaves know their place now, thanks to you.
translation: 现在奴隶知道他们的地位了，感谢你。

original: {Keep low-key, this line will be heard a lot}Something else in you needing an answer?
translation: {Keep low-key, this line will be heard a lot}你还有什么需要答案的吗？

original: Ugh! It's bad enough the indignities you've put me through, must you continue to prattle on at me?
translation: 呸！你对我的无礼行为已经够过分了，你还要继续对我胡说八道么？

original: No time to waste! Go deal with the Think Tank!
translation: 没有时间给你浪费了！快去处理那些思想体！

original: I'll see you at the Sink. Good luck.
translation: 我们在汇聚节点再见。祝你好运。

original: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
{Sincere}Nice to see you back. I trust the adventuring is going well.
translation: {Sincere}很高兴看到你回来。我想探险一定非常顺利吧。

original: Well, well, look who finally dragged themselves in out of the Wasteland. And where have we been, hmm? Crawling through pits of radioactive muck again?
translation: 好吧，好吧，看来有人终于把自己从废土之外拽回到这里了。我们去过哪儿，嗯？屈身在充满辐射的泥潭里爬行？

original: Welcome home, Citizen! Find any seditious materials out there?
translation: 欢迎回家，公民！找到什么反动材料了吗？

original: {Groggy, just "waking up"}Ah! Good day, Citizen! Library Processing Unit 232.7 is on-line and ready to eradicate sedition!
translation: {Groggy, just "waking up"}啊！日安，公民们！图书处理单元232.7已启动，随时准备铲除反动！

original: You've been seeing the other light switch, haven't you? {Almost sobbing}Am I not enough for you any more?
translation: 你和另一个开关幽会去了是不是？{Almost sobbing}你有我还不够吗？

original: {I sense you. What's up?}{KAH-too Bee-oo. Nah-YOO?}Katu Veo. Nayoo?
translation: {I sense you. What's up?}{KAH-too Bee-oo. Nah-YOO?}我认识你。怎么了？

original: What can I do for you?
All better now, you big baby. Can I get back to work now?
translation: 全好了，你这大孩子。现在我能回去工作了吗？

original: Okay, you should be fine, and ready to run off and play.
translation: 好。你没事了，准备出去玩吧。

original: I'll say this; it's easier to work on a mungo, since you're a lot bigger. Easier to find a vein, at least.
translation: 我会这样说：对付毛人更简单，至少，更容易找到血管。

original: Now next time, try to be where the bullets aren't.
translation: 下次试着躲在子弹打不到的地方。

original: There you go. All better, you big baby. You need anything else?
translation: 可以了。全好了，你这大孩子，你还有什么其他需要？

original: That should keep you going for a bit longer.
translation: 那应该能使你多撑一阵了。

original: Feel better? You should, that was the good stuff. Need anything else?
translation: 感觉好点了吗？你应该知道，这才好东西。需要别的吗？

original: They never told us how expensive it was to get onto the Strip!
translation: 他们从来没说过去一趟长街要花这么多钱！

original: I never should have left California.
translation: 我就不该离开加利福尼亚。

original: That son of a bitch Keith cheated me! I know he did!
translation: 基斯那个狗娘养的骗了我！我就知道是他！

original: You lose all your money too?
Hey, you got a hit for me?
Don't you be touching Keith's stuff!
Keith takes good care of us. {Spaced out}Good care...
translation: 凯斯把我们照顾得很好。{Spaced out}照顾得很好...

original: You have any luck with the Ghouls? I'm counting on you.
translation: 你摆平那些尸鬼了吗？我全指望你了。

original: The salvage business has really slowed down since those Ghouls took over REPCONN.
translation: 自从那些尸鬼霸占了瑞普康以后，废品回收业务就大受影响。

original: House selling out to the NCR? Who woulda figured him for a fink?
translation: 豪斯把我们卖给NCR了？谁能想到他居然是叛徒？

original: Nice to see a human palling around with a Ghoul. I see a lot of people around here avoid them.
translation: 人类与尸鬼和睦相处，这场面真温馨。我们这儿的多数人对他们可是避之不及呢。

original: I don't want to join the Great Khans.
{Remnants helping Legion}Since Johnson won't be coming with us, you might as well take his suit of Power Armor. I'll teach you the basics of how to use it.
translation: {Remnants helping Legion}既然约翰逊不肯跟我们一起来，你把他那套动力装甲拿走吧。我会简单教你怎么用的。

original: {Moreno convinced to stay}I appreciate you keeping Orion in the group. Since I won't be needing my armor - makes the cockpit a bit cramped - you should take it.
translation: {Moreno convinced to stay}谢谢你让厄里翁留了下来。我不需要护甲了——座舱里已经够挤了，你拿去吧。

original: It'll take a few hours to show you how to use it properly, so let's get started.
translation: 不过要学会用这玩意可需要好几个小时，咱们马上开始吧。

original: I ain't got nothing for you to eat. If you're hungry, see Ruby Nash.
translation: 我这没有可以给你吃的东西。如果你饿了的话，就去找鲁比·纳什。

original: Now you freed Deputy Beagle, all Primm needs is a law man who can shoot a gun without wetting hisself.
translation: 既然你救出了副警长比格尔，那么接下来普瑞姆也该再找一个开枪时不会尿裤子的执法官了。

original: I hear you aim to bring rule of law back to our town. God knows we need the help.
translation: 听说你要帮助我们恢复秩序。我们确实需要帮忙啊。

original: Those soldiers you brought down on us is all business, stranger. Better than lawlessness, though. So you've got my thanks.
translation: 你带回来的那帮士兵管得可真宽，陌生人。不过总比无法无天要好。所以还是谢谢你。

original: This Sheriff Meyers you found for us is working out. Knows his business. We owe you a debt.
translation: 你帮我们找来的这个迈尔斯警长已经走马上任了。他很专业。我们欠你一个人情。

original: You'll probably want to talk to Hayes.
translation: 你可以去找海耶斯谈谈。

original: I heard Private Stone turned himself in for stealing medical supplies. We're all stressed out here, but stealing medical supplies is low.
translation: 听说列兵斯通自首了，就是他偷了医疗用品。我知道大家都有压力，但偷医疗用品就真的太缺德了。

original: {rocket launch failed}Knew those Ghouls were up to no good. Look where it got us.
translation: {rocket launch failed}就知道那帮尸鬼干不了好事。瞧瞧这都是些什么。

original: How about you just do nice things for us. We liked {emph}those.
translation: 你其实可以只干好事。我们比较喜欢{emph}那样。

original: I'm glad that I could start working here again, things were rough with those convicts in town.
translation: 我很高兴又能在这里工作了，自从那群逃犯流窜到这儿之后日子就很难过。

original: It's important that you're relaxed for this next test. Please, have a seat.
translation: 你只有保持放松，我们才能开始下一项测试。来吧，请坐。

original: All right. I'm gonna say a word. I want you to say the first thing that comes to mind.
translation: 好吧。我先说一个单词。然后你告诉我你脑海中闪现的第一印象是什么。

original: Here. These are yours. Was all you had on you when you was brought in.
translation: 给你。这些都是你的。你被送进来的时候，身上就带着这些东西。

original: I hope you don't mind but I gave the note a look. I thought it might help me find a next of kin. But it was just something about a platinum chip.
translation: 我看了一眼你的笔记，希望你别介意。我本来是想看看你有没有什么亲友，但上面只写了一则关于什么白金筹码的事。

original: Here. These are yours. Was all you had on you when you was brought in.
translation: 给你。这些都是你的。你被送进来的时候，身上就带着这些东西。

original: I hope you don't mind but I gave the note a look. I thought it might help me find a next of kin. But it was just something about a platinum chip.
translation: 我看了一眼你的笔记，希望你别介意。我本来是想看看你有没有什么亲友，但上面只写了一则关于什么白金筹码的事。

original: {Horrified}Why did you do that? They were going to let us walk away. Why did you attack them?
translation: {Horrified}你为什么要那样做？他们都要放我们走了。你为什么要攻击他们？

original: I don't care that they started it. What you did was inexcusable. You need to go.
translation: 不管是谁先动的手，你做的事都是无法原谅的。你走吧。

original: Clearly you're determined to fight the Brotherhood. Well, you can add my name to your hit list because you're on your own.
translation: 显然你是决定和兄弟会为敌了。很好，把我的名字也加进你的黑名单里吧，从今往后你就自己干。

original: {Radio transmission}Sorry, sir, that's all the support I can spare today.
translation: {Radio transmission}对不起，长官，那是我今天剩下的全部物资。

original: {Impressed}Wish more people had your kind of guts.
translation: {Impressed}如果大家都能像你这么勇敢就好了。

original: {Warning 3}You and me we're done traveling together. I want nothing more to do with you.
translation: {Warning 3}我不想再和你结伴旅行了。我不想再和你扯上更多关系了。

original: I thought there was a {emph}chance you'd change - {shakes head}not any longer, being a fucker is who you are.
translation: 我还以为你能改呢——但我不再这么想了，你就是个彻头彻尾的混蛋。

original: {Warning 2}Guess my last warning didn't sink in too well. Things don't change, and soon, I'm gone.
translation: {Warning 2}看来我上次的警告没起什么效果。什么都没改变，再这样我就要走了。

original: Look, maybe you were like this before I signed up with you, but if you keep acting this way, I'm not going to stick around much longer.
translation: 听着，或许你在遇到我之前就是这样一号人，但如果你继续这种表现，我是不会再和你一起走了。

original: Farber is doing the best with what he's got, but man could I go for a nice cut of brahmin steak.
translation: 条件艰苦，法伯已经尽力了，但我还是想尝尝双头牛肉排。

original: Paperwork, paperwork, paperwork... It just never ends.
translation: 文书工作，文书工作，文书工作……没完没了的文书工作。

original: Good thing I got stationed here and not at the Dam. I got connections because Major Dhatri's daughter married my nephew.
translation: 能在这儿呆着，不用被派到水坝上去，真是福气啊。全亏了我侄子娶了达特里少校的女儿，我才能有这样的门路。

original: We're fighting for the NCR now? I don't know about that...
translation: 我们现在给NCR卖命了？我都不知道...

original: What the fuck are you looking at?
Securitrons with faces like soldiers? Is this martial law or something? What the fuck?
translation: 电子保安怎么全换上大兵脸了？军事管制吗？到底怎么回事？

original: Your Ghoul wants to have some fun he can, we don't discriminate.
translation: 如果你的尸鬼也想找乐子，我们不会歧视的。

original: The Tops is a real snooze fest. I hope they get some new shows soon.
translation: 九重天实在是让人打瞌睡。希望他们能尽快推出些新节目。

original: Caesar's dead. So when do we go home?
translation: 凯撒已经死了。我们什么时候回家？

original: Legion just came out of nowhere.
translation: 军团不知从哪儿就冒出来了。

original: I like you! Will you take Barnabas Bear to New Vegas when you go?
translation: 我喜欢你！你去新维加斯的时候能带上先知小熊吗？

original: With Forlorn Hope's fall, our blades are at the NCR's throat.
translation: 既然攻陷了飘零希望营地，我们的利刃就架在NCR的脖子上了。

original: That we hold Nelson, that is {KAI-zar's}Caesar's will.
translation: 我们会守住纳尔逊，这是凯撒的意志。

original: {Companion Reaction - Raul}I'll never get used to the sight of Ghouls.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Raul}我就是不习惯见到尸鬼。

original: Move along, buddy. I have work to do.
translation: 让开，伙计。我有工作要做。

original: {Random}You're a woman, and yet you wander free?{sound of contemplation, "hmm," or similar}
translation: {Random}你一个女人居然还能四处乱逛？{sound of contemplation, "hmm," or similar}

original: {Self Justification}It's cramped in here, sure, but who really needs a fancy room, anyway?
translation: {Self Justification)这里空间很狭窄，的确如此，不过，谁需要那么花哨的房间呢 ?

original: Some of the slaves have been spreading stories about the Burned Man again.
translation: 又有奴隶在散布浴火者的故事了。

original: {Surprise mixed with disgust}They let Ghouls into the Strip, now?
translation: {Surprise mixed with disgust}长街现在还放尸鬼进来了？

original: Who would have thought a place like this would exist?
translation: 谁能想到世上居然还有这样的地方？

original: If you're looking to join up, head on by the Embassy.
translation: 如果你想加入我们，请去大使馆。

original: I've never heard of anyone breaking their contract and still getting their pay. Janet is damn lucky.
translation: 没想到违约的人还能拿到钱。珍妮特真他妈走运。

original: I'm not sure I'll ever learn everything there is to know about this place.
translation: 我不知道还会在这里学到什么。

original: Our victory was never in question.
Mike Lawson sure knows his way around the dam.
translation: 迈克·劳森当然对水坝周边情况很熟悉。

original: The NCR is going to be grateful to have us around when the shooting starts.
translation: NCR会庆幸这场战斗有我们帮忙。

original: Hanlon is pretty legendary. People talk about what he did at the first battle of Hoover Dam with awe and respect.
translation: 汉隆真是个传奇，大家说起他在第一次胡佛水坝之战中的表现时，都带着赞叹和尊重。

original: Private Watson sure seemed excited about meeting Kimball.
translation: 列兵沃森见到了金博尔，他肯定非常激动。

original: First Recon is holding Forlorn Hope now. What I wouldn't give for sniper support here.
translation: 第一侦察营正在防守飘零希望营地，所以我现在提供不了狙击支援。

original: We're supposed to be relieved any day. That's what they keep telling us. I don't think anyone's coming.
translation: 马上就有人来换班了，他们老是这么说。但我不觉得有谁会来。

original: It was only a matter of time before HELIOS fell to us.
translation: 我们重夺太阳神一号只是时间问题。

original: Under NCR control, this place was a gun in the hands of a child.
translation: 在NCR的控制下，这地方就像是小孩手里的枪。

original: {player trying to go to penthouse with companions}Sorry, pardner, if you're heading for the penthouse, you gotta go alone.
translation: {player trying to go to penthouse with companions}对不起，伙计，你要去顶楼的话，只能自己去。

original: I told you I wouldn't work against the NCR. I meant it.
translation: 我跟你说了我不会和NCR作对。我是认真的。

original: Still helping the Legion. You're gonna get what's coming to you. I promise you that.
translation: 你还在帮军团做事。我敢打包票，你不会落得什么好下场的。
我们不会再一起共事了。

original: I've never seen a Ghoul up close. Not sure I wanted to.
translation: 我从没近距离看过尸鬼。还是别看的好。

original: I can't believe Pearl let you stay with us.
translation: 真不敢相信珀尔居然让你和我们呆在一起。

original: I bet you'd make an awesome Boomer.
translation: 我打赌你会成为一个了不起的大炮族成员。

original: Yay! I love my new toy!
Just try pulling some of your Brahmin shit here at the Dorado and see what happens.
translation: 你要是敢在多拉多撒野，我就让你好看。

original: Look all you want, just don't mess with any of the equipment. The control room's off-limits, and so is the enclosure.
translation: 看可以随便看，但不要碰任何设备。控制室禁止进入，围场也一样。

original: You're not going to do anything crazy, are you? It's just, you know... the paperwork...
translation: 你应该不会也是来干苦差事的吧？比如……你懂的……文书工作...

original: You seem really... high-strung. You know, I'm sure some of what I make my chems out of was an antipsychotic at some point...
translation: 你看起来有点……压抑。你知道吗，刚好我做的药里含有一些镇静剂的成分...

original: {Furious}You've heard the news about President Kimball? If I got my hands on the traitor that killed him...
translation: {Furious}你听说金博尔总统的事了吗？要是让我抓到那个刺杀他的凶手...

original: Well howdy, pardner! You made it out of Goodsprings no worse for the wear. Good for you.
translation: 你好啊，伙计！你安全离开了清泉镇，真是太好了。

original: {Hushed, slightly awed and actually not sarcastic for once}I can't believe we're allowed inside the Lucky 38. That place has been a legend since before the War...
translation: {Hushed，slightly awed and actually not sarcastic for once}真不敢相信我们能获准进入幸运38。那地方在伟大战争以前就已经是个传奇了...

original: {Bewildered}You've beat Nightstalkers, right? We don't see that often down here.
translation: {Bewildered}你消灭了夜行兽，是不是？这种事可不常见。

original: {Suspicious}We tolerate Wasteland savages, as long as they respect our rule around here.
translation: {Suspicious}只要守我们这里的规矩，我们也可以容忍废土的野人。

original: I'm glad Mean Sonofabitch is on our side.
translation: 很高兴无耻杂种和我们站一边。

original: {Drunk rambling}Your Ghoul friend looks shifty. Watch your pockets, buddy!
translation: {Drunk rambling}你的尸鬼朋友看起来鬼鬼祟祟的。看好你的口袋，伙计！

original: The Strip ain't nothing but a monster. Chews folks up, sucks out their caps, and spits 'em back out.
translation: 长街就是个怪物。它把所有人都吞下去，吸干净了瓶盖再吐出来。

original: I can't wait to see the Strip. I hear it's so beautiful!
translation: 我都等不及去看看长街了。听说非常漂亮！

original: Don't make any trouble for us, we won't make any trouble for you.
translation: 你别给我们找麻烦，我们也不会给你找麻烦。

original: A friend of mine at the Dam says President Kimball might visit the troops out there. Imagine shaking the president's hand!
translation: 我有个在水坝的朋友说金博尔总统要去那里视察部队。想想和总统握手的感觉！

original: I only work for caravans, all right? Try someone else.
translation: 我只为商队工作，懂了？找别人吧。

original: Your pet Ghoul smells like ass.
translation: 你这宠物尸鬼闻起来跟屎一样。

original: People all scared of those robots on the Strip since they changed. Like who needs the Strip anyway?
translation: 自从长街那些机器人变了之后，人们就很怕它们。谁他妈稀罕长街啊？

original: That Ghoul with you looks like he's older than the war! My the things he must have seen.
translation: 跟你一起的那个尸鬼看起来像是战前出生的！他肯定见识过许多事。

original: Oh good, now I have to put up with the stench of rotting Ghoul as well. I hope the air filters are working.
translation: 妙极了，现在我还要忍受腐烂尸鬼身上的味道。希望空气净化器没出毛病。

original: The food here is to die for. No one cooks Brahmin like Philippe.
translation: 能尝到这里的佳肴，真是死了都不亏。菲利普做的双头牛肉无与伦比。

original: Any word as to our arrangement?
translation: 我们之间的交易进行得如何了？

original: How may I be of service, sir?
How may I be of service, madam?
Our executive chef Philippe is the toast of New Vegas. His Brahmin Wellington is absolutely sublime.
translation: 我们的行政主厨菲利普是新维加斯最棒的大厨。他做的惠灵顿牛排是人间一绝。

original: {Companion Reaction - Raul}Wouldn't want to live forever if I had to look like a Ghoul.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Raul}要是变成尸鬼那样，我宁愿不要长生不死。

original: {Hopeful}Our victory at Nelson's a worthy story to tell in my travels.
translation: {Hopeful}我们在纳尔逊取得了大捷，这下我在路上可有话聊了。

original: {Companion Reaction - Raul}{disgusted by Ghoul's appearance}What a revolting sight. {incredulous}To call that a friend?
translation: {Companion Reaction - Raul}{disgusted by ghoul's appearance}真恶心。{incredulous}你和那玩意做朋友？

original: You did a super job wrapping things up! And I'm not just saying that because I have to!
translation: 你为一切划上了圆满的句号，真是太精彩了！我是打心眼里这么认为的！

original: I didn't want to make a big deal about this until after we won, but, {draw out}well...
translation: 有件事，我本是打算等咱们胜利以后才告诉你的，不过，呃……

original: I found some code snippets in one of Mr. House's databanks that will let me, um, reprogram my personality! To be a little more assertive, basically!
translation: 我在豪斯先生的数据库里找到了一节代码片段，它们可以，呃，重塑我的人格！简单来说就是，让我变得更加自信！

original: So that's what I'm going to be doing, and it's going to take me a while, so it'll seem like I'm off-line. But don't worry, everything will be okay!
translation: 我决定部署这段代码，这要花上一段时间，期间我会一直处于离线状态。不过别担心，一切都会没事的！

original: I've updated the Securitrons' targeting parameters, so they know what to do! Vegas will be protected!
translation: 我已经升级了电子保安的目标参数，它们知道该做什么！维加斯会得到保护的！

original: So that's where I'll be, off making a few changes, and I... I guess I'll see you around!
translation: 那么，先失陪了，我要去离线升级了，祝……祝我们后会有期！

original: {bye-bye}We accomplished a lot together! It was fun! Take care!
translation: {bye-bye}我们在一起创造那么多丰功伟绩！真是太有趣了！保重！

original: {copy audio from Conversation VMQTopsYesManTransfer}I bet I'm going to like it in that mainframe!
translation: 我打赌那台主机里头一定会很有意思！

original: {copy audio from Conversation VMQTopsYesManTransfer}I have a good feeling about this! It's going to be great!
translation: {copyaudiofromConversationVMQTopsYesManTransfer}我感觉前途一片光明！我们肯定能干出一番大事！

original: Hi! Nice to see you again!
{singsong}Sooooo... we can blow up the dam's generators, {draw out}or I could route the dam's entire power output to the Fort.
translation: {singsong}那么……我们可以炸掉水坝的发电机，{drawout}或者我也可以把水坝的电力全部改送去城堡。

original: That'll activate a certain army of Securitrons and set them loose to ravage the Legion! What do you say?
translation: 这样就能启动一支电子保安大军，用它们一举摧毁军团！你怎么说？

original: You did a super job wrapping things up! And I'm not just saying that because I have to!
translation: 你为一切划上了圆满的句号，真是太精彩了！我是打心眼里这么认为的！

original: Some of the machinery's frozen up. Need someone to take a look at it.
translation: 有机器不能用了。得找个人过去看看是什么情况。

original: Unless you wanna slap leather with me you'll put that gun down, friend.
translation: 你如果不想和我对着干，就把枪放下，朋友。

original: The Kings say they're keeping the peace, but this place is as violent as ever.
translation: 猫王帮说他们会维护和平，但是这里一直暴力不断。

original: Hey there, you want to cruise Freeside in style, you'd do worse than hire a King to tag along. Only 100 caps.
translation: 嘿，你要是想风光地逛逛自由之城，没有一个猫王帮跟着效果可就差多了。只要100瓶盖。

original: {Mixed}Have you ever considered getting your head checked?
translation: {Mixed}你有没有想过自己的脑袋可能有病？

original: {Wild Child}We don't specialize in psychiatry in this camp.
translation: {WildChild}我们这个营地不研究神经病。

original: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER HAS STRIP REP}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}What in the goddamn...?
translation: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER BROKE UP OMERTAS}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}这他妈怎么……？

original: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}Let's keep this in the groove, hey? Smooth moves. {drawing it out}Smooth...
translation: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}咱们有话好商量，行吗？冷静一点，别冲动……

original: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}Hello! The gasser everyone's been talking about, making a splash on the Strip. That's been you? {gift of gab failing}Oh shit.
translation: {just dawning on you， keeping voice down}你好啊！大伙都在谈论你，那个近来在长街声名鹊起的家伙就是你吧？{gift of gab failing}哦，见鬼。

original: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER BROKE UP OMERTAS}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}What in the goddamn...?
translation: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER BROKE UP OMERTAS}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}这他妈怎么……？

original: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}Let's keep this in the groove, hey? Smooth moves. {drawing it out}Smooth...
translation: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}咱们有话好商量，行吗？冷静一点，别冲动……

original: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}Hello! It was you, smashed up the Omertas? You did that?{gift of gab failing} Shit.
translation: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}你好啊！就是你把黑手党一锅端了吧？{gift of gab failing}哦，见鬼。

original: Did you hear him? My god, you were right all along. I'm no Ghoul! They were just using me...
translation: 你听见他的话了吗？天啊，你一直都是对的。我不是尸鬼！他们利用了我...

original: Good job making it through that simulation. All you have to do now is open the Armory.
translation: 你能通过模拟，干得好。现在你要做的就是打开军火库。

original: And, as agreed, you get your share. Feel free to take whatever you want. If our records are right, there's plenty for all of us.
translation: 然后，根据我们的协议，你将得到你应得的报酬。想要什么就拿什么吧。如果我们的记录没错的话，里面的东西够我们所有人的了。

original: It's been an honor working with you. I don't think I've ever seen bravery like that on any battlefield.
translation: 与你并肩作战是我的荣幸。我在任何战场上都没见过像你这么勇敢的人。

original: Hopefully, after we mop up the mess in Anchorage, we can get together and have a couple of beers.
translation: 希望在安克雷奇行动结束后，我们可以聚聚，喝上一杯。

original: Thanks. Look, I've got to get back to HQ. I Found some papers before I got caught. Good hunting!
translation: 谢谢。听着，我得回到总部去。在我被抓之前我找到一些文件。祝你杀敌愉快！

original: Goddamn Commies caught me with my pants down. Don't tell anyone you found me like this, all right?
translation: 该死的中共在我睡觉的时候抓住了我。可别告诉别人你是这样找到我的，好吗？

original: They took us by surprise. I was the lucky one. Thanks for the rescue!
translation: 他们出奇不意地抓住了我们。我比较走运。感谢你们救了我！

original: Thank God! I thought I was a goner.
translation: 感谢上帝！我还以为我没命了。

original: Am I glad to see you!
Thank you for your help with those guys. They finally tracked me down... I thought I'd have more time.
translation: 谢谢你帮忙对付那些家伙。他们还是追到了我……我想我将有更多时间。

original: You've come about the broadcast, right? Risky, I know. But it had to be done. So you know who I am. Who are you?
translation: 你是听到电台赶过来的吧？我知道这很冒险，但总得有人做。那么你知道我是谁了。你又是谁呢 ?

original: You could have at least helped me with with those guys. They finally tracked me down... I thought I'd have more time.
translation: 你可能至少帮我对付了那些家伙们。他们还是追到了我……我想我将有更多时间。

original: You've come about the broadcast, right? Risky, I know. But it had to be done. So you know who I am. Who are you?
translation: 你是听到电台赶过来的吧？我知道这很冒险，但总得有人做。那么你知道我是谁了。你又是谁呢 ?

original: This is as far as I can go. It's up to you from here on out.
translation: 我只能走这么远了，现在开始，由你自己做主。

original: If you dress up like a slave, you should be able to get past the gates without a problem.
translation: 你要是穿得像个奴隶，过这些门应该是没什么问题。

original: Once you're inside, find a slave named Midea. She'll be able to help you.
translation: 一旦你进去了，就去找叫美狄亚的奴隶，她会帮你。

original: Remember: your goal is to get access to Ashur and find the cure. After you have it, I'll contact you.
translation: 记住：你的任务是想办法接近阿舒尔，找到解药。得手之后，我会跟你联络。

original: Before we go, there's one last thing.
translation: 我走之前，还有最后的一件事。

original: Head into The Pitt and find the cure. Remember: put the slave clothes on and stash your stuff if you can.
translation: 直接进入匹兹堡，找到解药。记住：穿上奴隶的衣服，尽可能把自己藏好。

original: Watch where you're swinging that, will you?
translation: 挥舞的时候一定要注意安全，听到没？

original: Why don't you go swing that somewhere else?
translation: 你为什么不找个其他地方挥舞你那东西？

original: Stop doing that so close to me.
I hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 我希望你知道自己在做什么。

original: You tryin' to get me killed?
Holster that. And be quick about it.

translation: 嗨！要开枪就去别的地方。
你要知道，买弹药是要花钱的！

original: Keep that shit away from me.
What the fuck do you think you're doing.
translation: 你他妈的以为你在干嘛。

original: Stop that! Someone could get hurt.
{irritated}{"Do not fire weapons!"}{no dis-CAR-gay AR-moose}No discarge armoos!
translation: {irritated}{"Do not fire weapons!"}{no dis-CAR-gay AR-moose}别凯枪！

original: I hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 我希望你知道自己在做什么。

original: Whoa now. Be careful with that thing.
You know what you're doing there?
Whoa now. Be careful with that thing.

translation: 不要把你自己炸飞了，好吧？

original: You sure that's a good idea?
I hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 我希望你知道自己在做什么。

original: I hope I don't forget that's there.
translation: 希望我能记得这儿埋了个地雷。

original: Hard for me to step lightly with a bum leg.
translation: 我腿脚不利索，想要蹑手蹑脚趟过雷区可不容易啊。

original: Now why in tarnation would you put one of those, there.
translation: 天杀的，你为什么要会把这东西放在那里。

original: Guess we best watch where we step.
translation: 看来我们走路得小心点了。

original: What was the point of that?
Um... why are you setting that there?
translation: 呃…你为什么把这东西放在那里？

original: Why the fuck you puttin' that there?
translation: 你他妈的把它放在那里干嘛？

original: Pick that back up or you'll be eatin' it.
translation: 把它捡回来，要不我就让你吃了它。

original: {explosive, bomb, yes?}Ah del tahi, bahm buh, ya?
{a warning for white legs! Heh he!}A bil he neh fuhr jahd thli gai! Heh he!
translation: {a warning for white legs! Heh he!}白腿的警告！呵呵！

original: I trust you know what you're doing.
translation: 我相信你知道自己在干嘛。

original: {concerned}{"Why are you putting there?"}{por kay KAH-tu PONE-gwaa ES-tee}Por ke katu pongwa estee?
translation: {concerned}{"Why are you putting there?"}{por kay KAH-tu PONE-gwaa ES-tee}尼为什么把它放在那里？

original: {player is dropping mines near Arcade}Can't wait to see where this is going.
translation: {playerisdroppingminesnearArcade}真想看到接下来会发生什么。

original: Careful. Someone could trip on that.
{challenging}You think that firecracker will be enough?
translation: {challenging}你觉得丢一把鞭炮就能搞出大动静了？

original: Oh come on. Cut it out.
Give it a rest, will you?
Are you having fun with that?
translation: 你是不是觉得很好玩啊？

original: Oh come on. Pay more attention to what you're doing.
translation: 哦，拜托，你就不能再小心点？

original: Why don't you look where you're going?
The molerat men! They've come for my beard at last! Oh. Never mind.
translation: 是鼹鼠人！他们最终还是来了。哦，好吧。

original: I'd put that weapon away if I were you.
translation: 要是我是你，我就会把家伙收起来。

original: {don't point weapons at me.}No tsaig tuh beh dah a hih jih gahni a meer.
translation: {don't point weapons at me.}别拿舞气纸着我。

original: Who the fuck do you think you are?
translation: 你他妈的认为自己是谁？

original: How about you line that up on a tin can instead?
translation: 要不你找一个罐头盒试试？

original: You're lookin' at a heap of trouble if you want it.
translation: 要是你想惹麻烦，那你尽管来。

original: If you think you want trouble, then let fly.
translation: 要是你想找事，那就放马过来吧。
这枪的保险最好打开了。

original: Quit it. You're making me nervous.

translation: 是不是觉得你自己很行，啊？

original: Don't point that thing at me.
What do you think you're doing?
You're drawing on me, clown shoes? I don't think so!
You're drawing on me, bitch? I don't think so!
Now's not really the time for that, is it?
translation: 现在可不是做那事的时候，对吧？

original: {stop that please}{SOO-bye thaah, saah}Subai thah, tsahh.
{offended}{"Lower your weapon."}{BAH-jay KAH AR-moo}Baje ka armoo.
translation: {offended}{"Lower your weapon."}{BAH-jay KAH AR-moo}把舞气放下。

original: Hey, I can almost see right down the barrel!
translation: 嘿，我几乎可以直接看到桶里的东西了！

original: What do you think you're doing?

translation: 你是世界上最好的……毛人？

original: I just want Rory to be safe...
translation: 我只希望罗瑞平安无事……

original: Hey, stranger. C'mon over here, I'd like to talk to you about something.
translation: 嗨，陌生人，到这来。我想和你谈些事。

original: Why are you still here? Go!
Are you crazy? Get out of here!
It's a fine day, isn't it?

translation: 令人愉快的一天，你说呢？

original: The good Lord made Andale for days like today.
translation: 是善良的主让安戴尔能够有今天这样的生活。

original: Don't you have a component to deliver?
translation: 你不是有什么东西要递送？
这该死的地方到底在哪？

original: I swear it was this way!
translation: 我发誓肯定是这条路没错。

original: What's going on in here, Midea? Who is this scab?
translation: 发生了什么事，美狄亚？这个渣滓是谁？

original: How may I serve you, master?
translation: 主人，我该如何为你服务？

original: How may I serve you, mistress?
Another glorious day in this man's army!
translation: 这人的军队又迎来了辉煌的一天！

original: Oh, great. Just what we need.
translation: 哦，太好了。这正是我们需要的。

original: Glad you could join the party!
Nice to see a friendly faceplate.
Don't think I recognize your unit. Must be a new convert from old man Lyons.
translation: 别以为我不知道你哪来的。肯定是刚从里昂斯老头那边投靠过来的。

original: If you're here to help, fine. Otherwise, out of my way.
translation: 如果你是来帮忙的，那就好。否则给我滚开。

original: Shouldn't you be huddling in a cave somewhere?
translation: 你是不是应该躲在某个洞里？
太棒了，又来一个本地人。

original: Keep your distance, mutt. No knowing what you've got breeding on you.
translation: 离我远点，混球。和你没什么好说的。

original: I've got the best whores in the Wasteland. The two of them are going to break my bed springs some day. Hah ha!
translation: 我在废土上碰到两个最棒的妓女。她们两个会把我的床折腾地粉碎，哈哈哈！

original: Aren't my party girls sweet? I just want to eat them like candy. Ha ha!
translation: 我的那些女人很甜吧？我真想把她们像吃糖一样吃下去，哈哈哈！

original: I don't have my Cherry pie any more. That bitch ran away.
translation: 我再也见不到雪莉了。那贱人跑了。

original: My women are dead. I'm gonna have to get me some new ones.
translation: 我的女人死了。我准备再找一个。

original: Stay on the right side of the law.
Always good to see a new face in the fight.
translation: 在战斗中看见新面孔是件开心的事。

original: Great, here's some of the local wildlife.
You're not involved in this. You want to keep it that way.
translation: 你不该掺和进去。你应该让它顺其自然。

original: Good to see you're holding up alright.
translation: 很高兴见到你又振作起来。

original: Watch your back and keep your batteries dry out there.
translation: 小心背后，保持电池干燥。

original: Tsk. To think you could have been rich. And now all you'll be is sorry. VERY sorry.
translation: 啧啧。想想原本你应该已经身缠万贯了。而现在你将拥有的只有你的悔恨。真是太遗憾了。

original: I would advise staying clear of me for awhile. A LONG while.
translation: 我建议你让我一个人静一会。一大会。

original: Tell me. Do you have a death wish?
translation: 告诉我，你可曾有过想死的念头？

original: It was a wonderful thing you did. Inspirational. Truly.
translation: 你做的真是太棒了。灵气十足，真的。

original: Yes friend? Is there something I can assist you with?
translation: 什么事，朋友？有什么需要我协助的？

original: Thanks again for you part in paving the way towards progress.
translation: 再次对你为我们铺平前进的道路而表示感谢。

original: Boy do I breathe a lot easier knowing that thing is truly dead!
translation: 知道那东西真的死了，可让我松了一口气！

original: Mighty fine thing you did for this town.
translation: 你为这座镇子做了伟大的事。

original: Old games are no match for us Outcasts, huh?
translation: 老把戏难不倒我们放逐者，对吧？

original: You did us proud in there.
translation: 你在那所做的让我们感到骄傲。
就本地人而言，你做得好。

original: Never would have thought a savage could do it.
translation: 从没想过一个野蛮人可以做到这个地步。

original: The U.S. Army needs more soldiers like you. Carry on.
translation: 美国陆军需要像你这样的士兵。加油。

original: Let's wrap this thing up, soldier. We're cold, we're tired and we want our goddamn oil back!
translation: 我们来把这个包起来吧，士兵。我们现在饿寒交迫，一定要把我们该死的原油抢回来！

original: Damn Chinese Communists are stomping all over us. Time for us to pay them back.
translation: 该死的共军的铁蹄一直在我们周围践踏。是时候算总账了。

original: I think it's time to show those Red bastards what the U.S. Army is all about.
translation: 我想是时候让那些杂种共军尝尝美军的厉害了。

original: Those targets can't secure themselves. You've got a job to do, soldier... now snap to it.
translation: 那些目标很容易搞定。你有活干了，士兵…现在去干掉他们。

original: You're doing a man's job, soldier. Keep it up!
translation: 你正在做一件男人的工作，士兵。坚持下去。

original: You are in the presence of ant royalty!
Hello there, Junior, sweetheart. It's a lovely day, isn't it?
translation: 你好，新人，甜心。今天天气不错，对吧？

original: Welcome to the Capital Preservation Society!
translation: 欢迎来到首都保护协会！

original: Stay in line, and you'll be okay.
Don't start anything and you'll be fine. Um, probably.
translation: 如果你不惹事你就不会有事。嗯，这也是相对而言。

original: Keep that tech coming, and we'll make it worth your while.
translation: 多带些高科技产品来，我们会酬谢你的。

original: You'll, uh, um, need help with the barricades soon, right Pappy?
translation: 你，呃，嗯，是不是需要人手帮你搭建防御工事，帕匹？

original: Kimba, um, I heard you helped bandage me up when I was on the table. Uh, thank you.
translation: 金巴，嗯，听说我躺在台子上不省人事的时候是你帮我包扎绷带。呃，谢谢。

original: I was thinking of hitting patrol again soon, Flash.
translation: 我计划迟点再去巡逻一遍，福莱斯。

original: Hey Sticky, um, uh, what do you think of Big Town?
translation: 嗨，斯蒂奇，嗯，呃，你觉得大镇怎么样？

original: I wonder if someone should work on the barricades again.
translation: 我不知道是不是该找个人加固防御工事。

original: Hey, Red, can I stop by the clinic later? You know, just in case?
translation: 嗨，瑞德，等下我能不能去下诊所？你知道的，以防万一。

original: Timebomb, I heard you got hurt. Wow... What does it feel like?
translation: “定时炸弹”，我听说你受伤了。喔哦……那是什么样的感受？

original: Hey, Flash. Patrolling sounds like a lot of fun. Maybe I could come out with you.
translation: 嗨，福莱斯。巡逻听起来挺有意思，能不能带上我？

original: Do you have any idea of what I can do in town, Shorty?
translation: 我想做些事，你有什么建议吗，“矮子”？

original: Hey there, Pappy. I was out trying to gather food. Did you know there's not much food out here in the Wastes?
translation: 嗨，帕匹。我刚出去想找点食物。你知不知道这片废土很难找到吃的？

original: Hey there, Kimba. Is there anything I can do around town?
translation: 嗨，金巴。镇里有什么需要我做的？

original: Hey, Red. Is there anything I can do around town to help out?
translation: 嗨，瑞德。有什么我能帮的上忙的？

original: Sticky, it's about time you learned that I'm in charge here.
translation: 斯蒂奇，是时候该让你知道了，我，是这的领袖。

original: I think I should be mayor of this town, Kimba...
translation: 我想我应该做这镇的镇长，金巴……

original: I don't like the looks of the barricades, Pappy. Why don't you redo them?
translation: 我不太喜欢这防御工事，帕匹。你为什么不重新搭建？

original: Timebomb, since you insist on staying alive, why don't you make yourself useful and help me reset the barricades.
translation: “定时炸弹”，既然你坚持活着，为什么你就不能让自己变得有点用处呢？至少能帮帮我搭建防御工事啊？

original: You don't go far out enough on your patrol, Flash. A real patrol would cover a solid half-mile radius.
translation: 你的巡逻范围还不够大，福莱斯。最起码覆盖半径半英里的区域才称得上是真正的巡逻。

original: I'm telling you, Red, just let me run everything. I'll get those barricades twice as high!
translation: 给我听好，瑞德，你应该让我来管理一切。我会把这些防御工事加高两倍！

original: Bittercup, make sure you're paying attention out on patrol. There are dangerous people out there.
translation: “苦杯”，你应该更认真地巡逻，到处都是危险的家伙。

original: Hey, Flash. How are you feeling? Any calluses from stroking that new gun of yours?
translation: 嗨，福莱斯。感觉怎么样？摸你的新枪有没有让手出老茧？

original: How are you feeling, Timebomb? Are those stitches holding together?
translation: 你感觉怎么样，“定时炸弹”？那些缝线伤口愈合了吗？

original: There's my Sticky! How are you doing?
translation: 亲爱的斯蒂奇！你过得怎么样？

original: Hey, Pappy. How's that wound on your arm?
translation: 嗨，帕匹。你胳膊上的伤口怎么样了？

original: Shorty, I want to gather everyone together soon about setting up the barricades higher. I'd really appreciate your, uh, expertise.
translation: “矮子”,我想要尽快聚集所有人来加高防御工事。我真感谢你的帮助，哦，专家。

original: Looks like something's on your mind, Lucy.
translation: 看上去你想到什么了，露西。

original: Finding your way about all right?
I'll train these marshmallows if it kills me...
translation: 要训练这些菜鸟，这简直要了我的命……

original: Presence detected. This unit has activated.
translation: 发现物件。该单位已被激活。

original: Outsiders in the Citadel. Such a pleasure...
translation: 五角大本营里的外来人。幸会……

original: Ahzrukhal, boy, I want to talk to you.
translation: 阿祖卡，孩子，我想和你谈谈。

original: We owe you so much. The Memorial will be a beacon for slaves everywhere.
translation: 我们欠你很多。无论在何地，纪念堂将会成为奴隶贩子的信标。

original: Everyone is grateful for what you've done for us.
translation: 我们所有人都感激你为我们所做的事。

original: The Slavers will have some goddamn respect for now, huh?
translation: 奴隶贩子现在他妈的会放尊重点了，嗯？

original: It's going to take a lot of work to repair the Memorial. Thanks to you, I'll get to do it.
translation: 看来要花上一段时间来修复纪念堂。谢谢你，我现在就要开始工作了。

original: You're a hero to everyone here, sir.
translation: 你是这的所有人的英雄，先生。

original: You're a hero to everyone here, ma'am.
translation: 你是这的所有人的英雌，女士。

original: Hello, dear. Hope you're not spending all your time working.
translation: 喂，亲爱的，希望你别把所有时间都花在工作上。

original: We never seem to have any alone time anymore.
translation: 我们好像再也没有过独处的时间了。

original: Well, if it isn't our fearless champion.
translation: 这不就是我们不怕死的冠军。

original: What is it? I'm a little busy right now.
translation: 有什么事？我现在有点忙。

original: Nice work cleaning up the town.
translation: 那镇子的扫荡工作做得不错。

original: Town's a lot safer now. Thanks.
translation: 镇子现在安全多了，多谢。

original: Aw, you made this place get so boring.
translation: 啊，你让这地方变得无聊起来了。

original: Sir, people are mostly staying quiet.
I suppose the dog's coming with us, yes?
translation: 让我猜猜。狗也跟着我们来了，是吗？

original: Father and son, side by side. This is the way it should be.
My God, can you believe the devastation out here? That's why our work is so important.
translation: 我的天啊，你能相信外面的这一切吗？那就说明了为什么我们的工作如此重要。

original: I'm glad I've got you watching my back. I'm not quite sure I'm cut out for all this excitement. Not anymore.
translation: 很高兴有你协助我。我都不确信我能不能承受这兴奋。

original: Not much farther. We'll be at Rivet City before you know it.
translation: 不是很远。我们会在你知道前抵达铆钉城。

original: What a sight we must be! If only your mother could see us now...
translation: 我们一定是一道壮丽的景观！如果你妈妈现在能看见我们……

original: Don't do this. Please tell me the code.
Stay away from me! I don't want whatever you smoothskins are infecting us with!
translation: 离我远点！我不想被你们光皮肤给传染了！

original: You have my vote, Mister President.
That election is getting pretty close, huh?
translation: 大选很快就要开始了，呃？

original: Who are you going to vote for, Bob?
Hey Jessica, you excited about the election?
translation: 嗨，杰西卡，要选举了，你激动吗？

original: Hey Shawna, did you do the early voting?
Isn't election time so much fun, Mary?
translation: 选举并不有趣，你说呢，玛丽？

original: Rachael, can you believe you're almost old enough to vote?
translation: 拉克尔，你相信吗？你都差不多到能投票的年纪了？

original: Who would you vote for if you were old enough, Flower?
translation: 如果你能投票你会投谁，福劳尔？

original: Don't you just love election time, Ralph?
translation: 你不喜欢选举吗，拉尔夫？

original: How's my first lady doing today?
translation: 我的第一夫人今天过得怎么样？

original: Hi Mary. I mean Flower. Rachael!
translation: 嗨，玛丽。我是说福劳尔。拉克尔！
拉克尔，来和我一起玩吧！

original: Lookin's free, the rest will cost ya.
translation: 看看不要钱，再来就要收费了。

original: Don't look at me like that.

translation: 欢迎来到莫里亚蒂的酒吧。

original: Looking for a drink? You've come to the right place.
translation: 想来一杯？你来对地方了。

original: S'matter? Never seen a Ghoul before?
Yeah, what the hell do you want?
You want something or you just looking to get your ass beat?
translation: 你是有事找我还是屁股痒了找打？

original: This better be important. I'm a busy man.
translation: 你要说的最好是重要的事，我是大忙人。

original: If you need something from me, spill it.
Information I got... but it'll cost you.
translation: 你要的消息我有……但是你要为此破费。

original: I owe you Follower people a beer for patching me up a while back.
translation: 前阵子你们替我包扎，我欠你们这些天启追随者一杯啤酒。

original: Hey, isn't that the King's dog?
Trading caps for crap, step right up!
Got some junk to unload? I'm buying!
translation: 有什么不需要的垃圾吗？我要！

original: Welcome, friend. Looking for more appropriate attire?
translation: 欢迎，朋友。想买套合适的漂亮衣服吗？

original: The spirits told me you'd be coming. And that you're looking to buy.
translation: 第六感告诉我你会来，没想到你真的来买东西了。

original: If you've got the caps, I've got your fix.
translation: 如果你有瓶盖，我就给你修。

original: Here to pick up a few of my marvelous toys?
translation: 想从我这买点惊人的小玩具吗？

original: Fear not, for Lucky Harith is here to offer you protection for a price!
translation: 不用害怕，幸运哈里斯在这为你提供有偿保护！
早上好，小懒虫！睡得好吗，孩子？

original: Rise and shine! How was your night, my boy?
translation: 快起床！晚上怎么样，我的孩子？

original: I've never seen a Ghoul up close. Not sure I wanted to.
translation: 我从没近距离看过尸鬼。还是别看的好。

original: Whatever you're selling, we have plenty.
translation: 不管你要推销什么，我们都已经有了。

original: Once a republican, always a republican.
translation: 生是共和国的人，死是共和国的鬼。

original: You aren't stealing our medicine, are you, doc?
translation: 你没偷我们的药吧，没有吧，医生？

original: I can take care of that robot problem for you. Just saying.
translation: 你那个机器人有什么问题我都可以修好。尽管开口。

original: If you can't keep that thing under control, I will.
translation: 如果你不能控制好那东西，就让我来。

original: Thanks for talking us out of our evil ways. I'm starting on that novel soon. Pauline is so happy. You are a nice person! Hurray!
translation: 谢谢你把我们带出邪道。我很快就会开始写那本小说了。宝琳非常高兴。你真是个好人！万岁！

original: Sammy and I are grateful. We are going to follow our dreams.
translation: 我和萨米都很感激。我们会继续追逐梦想。

original: Nice to see you. Doing well, I hope?
translation: 很高兴见到你。但愿过得不错？

original: And how are you this fine day?
Oasis is no longer a refuge for you, Outsider.
translation: 绿洲不再是你的避难所了，外来人。

original: I don't know why RJ's letting you back in, but if you touch any of my kids, I'll make sure you never have any of your own.
translation: 我不明白为什么镇长让你回来，但是你要是敢动孩子们一根汗毛，我就让你好看！

original: Remember my offer, Outsider: cash for Pre-War books.
translation: 记住我的任务：寻找战前书籍，我会给你报酬。

original: If you have any Pre-War books, I'll take them.
translation: 只要你有战前的书籍，我照单全收。

original: Sentinel. What can I do for you?
translation: 莎拉。我能为你做些什么？

original: We've gotta get out of here.
I sure hope we don't get caught!
translation: 我真的希望我们不会被抓住。

original: I can't get off this ship fast enough.
translation: 我没有足够的时间下船。

original: At least I'm still in one piece...

translation: 放松。她没事…现在是这样…

original: Our business is at an end. Leave this place.
translation: 我们的交易结束了。离开这地方。

original: You should have seen this place thirty years ago.
translation: 你三十年前就该看看这地方。

original: Did you want to talk? I won't bite.
translation: 想谈谈吗？我不会吃了你。

original: Hail Mary, full of Grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women and blessed is the fruit of your womb, Jesus.
translation: 万福玛利亚，你充满圣宠。主与你同在。你在妇女中受赞颂，你的亲子耶稣同受赞颂…

original: You findin' your way around, sweetie?

translation: 我的东西有帮助，如果你拿去的话。

original: The physical world holds nothing for us. Release any lingering connections to it.
Embrace the simple things in life.
Submerge your will in the depths of the astral sea!
translation: 让你的意识湮灭在星海的深渊中！

original: New girl, you try too hard. Be calm.
translation: 新来的女孩，你太卖力了。冷静些。

original: Good to see you still here, my child.
translation: 很高兴你还在这儿，孩子。

original: Have you seen the Chop Shop? Full of sick Ghouls... I wonder who's next?
translation: 你看见排骨店了吗？全都是生病的僵尸……我不知道下一个会是谁？

original: No offense, but I don't want whatever's going around. So just keep your distance, okay?
translation: 没有冒犯你的意思，但是我不想让任何人靠近。所以请保持你的距离,好吗？

original: You better stay away from me. I think I may be sick. It's like a... burning in my guts. Damn, it hurts!
translation: 你最好离我远点。我想我病了。就好像……我的内脏在着火。该死，真疼！

original: If you feel you're getting sick, quarantine yourself at the clinic, immediately.
translation: 如果你觉得你病了，立刻到门诊来进行隔离，一刻也不要耽搁。

original: Everything should be in place by now. Even if they know we're coming, it won't matter.
translation: 这会儿一切都应该就位了。就算他们知道我们要来了，也没关系。

original: It's good to see you again.
Scribe Rothchild is going to need an update on your progress. Have you sent a report recently?
translation: 文员罗斯查德想要知道你的工作进度。你最近发过报告了么？

original: Bigsley could really cut us some slack.
translation: 比格斯利能给咱们点好处。

original: What the hell are we doing here, really? We have better things to do.
translation: 说真的，我们他妈的到底在这儿干什么？我们有更有用的事情要做。

original: The mercenary caravan has returned. They ran into some trouble - Sir? Scribe Bigsley? Is everything alright, sir?
translation: 雇佣商队回来了。他们遇到麻烦了- 长官？比格斯利文员？一切都还好吧，长官？

original: I don't know why they don't just build a pipeline. Schlepping bottles of water back and forth is the worst kind of stupid.
translation: 我真搞不明白为什么他们不直接建根水管呢。装在瓶子里一车一车地运来运去简直是我见过的最蠢的主意了。

original: Shh. If you spook the lurks I'll never get out of here.
translation: 嘘。如果你惊吓了蟹人，那我就再也出不去了。

original: The lurks get real shy when they're sick. You gotta wait for 'em to poke their noses up.
translation: 蟹人生病的时候会非常的胆小。你得等他们浮出水面。

original: Are you really going to fight in the Hole?
translation: 你真的要去角斗坑里角斗？

original: Ashur's looking forward to meeting you, champ.
translation: 阿舒尔正盼望跟你会面，冠军。

original: Off to talk with Ashur? Lucky you.
translation: 去跟阿舒尔谈话？你真走运。

original: It's about time we had a talk.
You got a funny look on your face. You got something you wanna say?
translation: 你的表情很滑稽，你有什么要说的吗？

original: Scram, before I mess your face up bad as mine.
translation: 在我把你的脸蛋弄得跟我的一样稀巴烂之前，赶紧滚。

original: Do I look like your personal assistant?
translation: 我长得像你的私人助理吗？

original: Another fine day in The Pitt, huh?
translation: 在匹兹堡度过的又一个好日子，对吧？

original: Can't seem to get enough sleep, these days.
Don't you have something you should be doing?
translation: 你难道没有该做的事吗？

original: That's one way to get out of work, isn't it? Ha!
translation: 那是一个逃避干活的办法，对吗？哈！

original: Aww, such a sweet face. Get back to work.
translation: 噢，瞧瞧这张脸多么可爱啊。回去干活。

original: Man, the scabs ain't half as feisty as that last batch. At least when they fight back I get some fuckin' exercise.
translation: 老兄，这些渣滓不像最后的那一批争强斗狠。至少，当他们反击的时候，我他妈的能练习一下枪法。

original: Hey... Um... Ah, never mind... It's nothing...

translation: 这不是我的超级助手吗！什么事？

original: Did you hear about those newbies? The ones who went up north lookin' for raids?
translation: 你听说那些新人了吗？他们要去北方寻找歹徒？

original: The Mirelurks have been quiet lately.
translation: 最近蟹人好像安分很多。

original: I'll have two Mirelurk Cakes, carrots and wine, if you have it, beer if you don't.
translation: 我要两个蟹人饼，胡萝卜和红酒，如果没有红酒，那就来啤酒。
欢迎光临波托马克服装。

original: This is the Muddy Rudder. Cause any trouble, and you'll have to deal with me.
translation: 这是“泥舵”酒吧。如果你惹了什么麻烦，就必须给我个交代。
哦！你好，你是不是迷路了？

original: You're hurt. Fortunately, this is a medical clinic. Why don't you let me take a look at that.
translation: 你受伤了。幸运的是，这就是诊所。为什么你不让我瞧瞧呢？

original: Welcome to Flak and Shrapnel's. Best god damn weapons anywhere.
translation: 欢迎来到“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅。这该死的到处都是上好的武器。

original: Have a seat anywhere. Someone will be with you in a minute.
translation: 随便坐，立刻会有人来招待你。

original: This is A Quick Fix. We sell all kinds of chems.
translation: 这是快速修复。我们这出售所有种类的药品。

original: Hello, Bannon. Anything interesting happen in the last council meeting?
translation: 你好，班侬。最近的那次议会会议上有没有发生什么有趣的事？

original: Hello, Henry. I just got in some new torque wrench and some electrical test equipment. You should take a look at them when you're done eating.
translation: 你好，亨利。我新进了一批扳手和电子测试设备。你吃完饭之后不妨来我店里看看。

original: Welcome to Rivet City Supply. I've got a little bit of everything here.
translation: 欢迎来到铆钉城补给点。我们这应有尽有。

original: Hey, girlie. This ain't a god damn dress shop. There's nothing in here you oughta be buyin'.
translation: 嗨，女孩。这可不是什么该死的服装店，不会有你想要的东西。

original: If you want a gun, you've come to the right place.
translation: 如果你想买把枪，你可算来对地方了。

original: Have you seen my good-for-nothing son, James?
translation: 你有没有看见我那一无是处的孩子，詹姆斯？

original: Hey stranger. Wanna buy a girl a drink?
translation: 嗨，陌生人，不想请女孩喝一杯吗？

original: Can you spare enough for a drink? I could really use one.
translation: 你能不能多留些酒？我真想来一杯。

original: I'm looking for troublemakers. Have you seen any?
translation: 我在找制造麻烦的家伙。你看见没？

original: Out of the way you rust bucket.
translation: 闪开点，你这生锈的铁桶。

original: I heard that the City Council is debating putting railings on the flight deck.
translation: 我听说城议会在讨论在甲板上装置栏杆。

original: Chief Harkness has vanished. Nobody knows what happened to him.
translation: 哈克尼斯长官失踪了。没人知道他出了什么事。

original: Hey Kimba, thanks for offering to help me in the clinic.
translation: 嗨，金巴。感谢你为我的诊所提供帮助。
你感觉怎么样，“定时炸弹”？

original: How are the patrols going, Flash? Are we still safe?
translation: 巡逻进行得怎么样了，福莱斯？看看我们是否依旧安全？

original: I wonder how the Lamplighters are doing...
translation: 我想知道现在小灯镇怎么样了……

original: Hey, Red. Do you need any help washing bandages later?
translation: 嗨，瑞德。你迟点需要人帮你洗绷带吗？

original: Hey Shorty. How's our favorite little guy doing?
translation: 嗨，“矮子”。我们至爱的小家伙过得怎么样？

original: Hey, Sticky. Keep your stickiness away from me and my new gun. This is a Sticky-free zone!
translation: 嗨，斯蒂奇。让你的口水离我和我的新枪远点。谢绝斯蒂奇靠近！

original: Timebomb! How're you doing? I thought you were dead for sure!
translation: “定时炸弹”！你怎么样？我以为你死定了！

original: Hey Shorty, you should come with me on patrol. The Raiders will never see you coming.
translation: 嗨，“矮子”。你应该和我一起巡逻。歹徒根本看不到你。

original: Hey Red, can I stop by the clinic later? I feel a bit sick.
translation: 嗨，瑞德，迟点我能去诊所看看吗？我感觉有点难受。

original: Wow, you should have seen me on patrol, Kimba, I was all "bang-bang-bang." I must have killed a hundred Raiders!
translation: 哇，你真该来看我巡逻，金巴，我刚才一直在“嘣-嘣-嘣”。我肯定已经杀了100个歹徒了！

original: Red, have you got a sec? It’s about this wound on my arm.
translation: 瑞德，你有时间吗？看看我胳膊上的伤口。

original: We're all going to die here. There's no way we can survive out here in this mess.
translation: 我们都会死在这。我们没法从这堆垃圾中活着出来。

original: What do you think of the barricades, Shorty?
translation: 你觉得防御工事怎么样，“矮子”？

original: Hey, Timebomb. You look like you're going to fall over dead.
translation: 嗨，“定时炸弹”。你看上去像要立刻倒地而死似的。

original: Never thought you'd make it, Sticky. Out of everyone who died trying to get here from Lamplight, we get you.
translation: 没人觉得你会成功，斯蒂奇。有很多人试着从小灯镇来这儿却死了，但是你成功了。

original: Anything out there, Flash? The Super Mutants and Raiders are coming back soon, aren't they?
translation: 外边有动静吗，福莱斯？超级变种人和歹徒不久就会回来，对吧？

original: Are you planning on moving in, or what?
translation: 你是打算进来还是怎样？

original: I wish he'd get us some regular clothes. It's cold out here dressed like this.
translation: 我希望他会给我们带点正常的衣服。在这穿成这样很冷。

original: Please don't take Ian away from us.
translation: 请不要把伊恩从我们身边带走。

original: Hey hey, mungo! We're getting' outta here, right?
translation: 嗨，嗨！毛人！我们是要逃出这地方是吗？

original: Leave us and never look back, Outsider.
translation: 不准回头，离我们远点，外来人。

original: We'll begin as soon as the rest of the Treeminders have taken their places.
translation: 我们等其他树启者一休息就开始行动。

original: Gob. These people aren't nearly drunk enough. Fix it.
translation: 盖博，这些人还没喝够呢，继续上酒。

original: I want a word with you, zombie.
Oh, oh! Mr. Ahzrukhal, I want to ask you something.
translation: 哦，哦！阿祖卡先生，我有些事要问你。

original: Oh, hey... Mr. <coughs> ... Mr. Ahzrukhal... hi.
translation: 哦，嗨……阿……<咳嗽>阿祖卡先生……嗨。

original: Hey, robot, have you seen any toes laying around here?
translation: 嗨，机器人，你有没有看见放在这的脚趾？

original: Cerberus! How are you? Programming holding up?
translation: 地狱犬！你好吗？程序运行得怎么样？

original: Heya, Patches. You alright, buddy? You're not lookin' so good.
translation: 你好，“拼盘”。你还好吧，老兄？你看上去不太妙啊。

original: Quinn, no one told me you were back!
translation: 奎因，没人告诉我你回来了！
嗨，温思罗普，近来怎么样？

original: Hey, I wanted to tell you, Patchwork got drunk last week and left his booze in the air filter...
translation: 嗨，我想告诉你，“拼盘”昨天喝多了，把他的酒落在空气过滤器里了……

original: Winthrop, I was wondering if you could take a look at the generator down in the common area...
translation: 温思罗普，我想你是不是能去查看下工作间的发电机……

original: Heya, Winthrop. You got a second?

translation: 一切顺利？喝得还满意吗？

original: Yes, yes, how is everyone doing? Everything alright? Do you need anything else?
translation: 是的，是的，所有人都好吗？一切都好？你还有什么其他需要？

original: The air is off in the common house again. It stinks of sweaty death down there. I swear, every day it's something new.
translation: 工作间的空气又不流通了。臭气熏天。我保证，每天都会出现新麻烦。

original: What the hell is that smell? I mean, it's not bad, it's just... I don't know... do you smell that?
translation: 那到底是什么味道？我说，其实味道还不赖，就是有点……我说不清楚……你没闻到？
嗯……晚餐闻起来真不错，亲爱的！

original: My room is all clean, Mommy!
translation: 我的房间都收拾好了，妈妈！

original: Mommy says that it's almost time for dinner!
translation: 妈妈说差不多该吃晚餐了！

original: You're going to love what I'm cooking tonight, dear!
translation: 你一定会喜欢我今晚烧的菜，亲爱的！

original: Uh oh, Jenny. Look at you. The boys better watch out!
translation: 哦，珍妮。看看你自己。男孩们得小心了！

original: Hey there, Jenny, sweetheart. Looking gorgeous as usual.
translation: 嗨，珍妮，甜心。你总是那么美丽。

original: Hi there, honey. Don't you look precious today?
translation: 你好，亲爱的。你今天看上去非同寻常。

original: Jenny, you look beautiful today! You're like a little doll!
translation: 珍妮，你今天看上去真漂亮，就像个洋娃娃！

original: Jenny, honey, you look so cute in that dress.
translation: 珍妮，亲爱的，你穿那衣服看上去真可爱。

original: Evening! Get a lot of work done today, boy?
translation: 晚上好！今天一定干了很多事，孩子？

original: How're you doing, boy? Is everything all right?
translation: 你最近怎么样，孩子？一切都好吗？
你好，多米。每个人都在岗位上吗？

original: Dom. Any news I should be worried about?
translation: 多米。有什么需要我担心的吗？

original: Umm... Hi, miss. I mean, Machete. Things okay with the, umm, guarding?
translation: 唔……嘿，小姐。我是说，玛切蒂。这一切都好吧，嗯，在站岗？

original: Hey, Machete. You on guard? I mean, of course you are. I mean, umm, never mind.
translation: 嗨，玛切蒂。你在站岗？我的意思，当然你是。我的意思，哦，算了。

original: Hey, Derek. You did some fine work out there with those Brahmin.
translation: 嗨，德里克。你在那把这些双头牛照顾得很好。

original: Derek, been hearing good things about your work with the traders. Way to go, man.
translation: 德里克，听说你和那些商人处得不错。干得好，哥们。

original: No need to look so nervous... right?
translation: 不需要这么紧张……对不对？

original: I got my eye on you.
Hey, Machete. Report in. You see anything odd out there?
translation: 嗨，玛切蒂。向我报告。你看到那边有什么异样吗？

original: Machete, what's the word from your watch?
translation: 玛切蒂，你观察到什么了吗？

original: Just bring me a nice kid to meet, and I'll take care of the rest.
translation: 你只要带个漂亮的孩子来见我，剩下的事我会料理。

original: Hey, heard the latest tales of the Wastes?
translation: 嗨，听说了废土最新发生的事吗？

original: So, bro, any luck trading today?
So, sis, crack anybody up today?
So, sis, made any good jokes today?
translation: 姐妹，今天有没有什么有趣的事？

original: Mind if I follow you around for a bit? I promise not to bug you! It'll be fun!
translation: 介意我在你后面跟着你吗？我保证不烦你！那一定很有趣！

original: Somebody said you wanted to see me, E?
Joseph, what happens when a person grows up?
translation: 约瑟夫，在一个人成长的过程中会发生什么事？

original: Tell me more about shooting, Joseph.
translation: 再告诉我些射击的知识，约瑟夫。

original: Look alive, you mopey motherfucker, you've got a mayor talking to you!
translation: 快点，你这无精打采的混蛋，那可是镇长要和你谈话！

original: Hey, Princess, give the squirt a fucking break and answer a few questions.
translation: 嗨，公主，让这废人他妈的休息一下再回答问题。

original: Hey, Princess, if you aren't busy daydreaming about me, how about answering a few questions?
translation: 嗨，公主，如果你不是忙于对我想入非非，那么就回答我一些问题怎么样？
