original: Eclair, stop trying to make crap taste like sugar and tell me what's going on.
translation: “夹心奶条”，别弄你那些吃起来屎一样的糖了，告诉我发生了什么事？
有没有人打碎重要的东西，露西？

original: Knock, what's up? And if you say "the sky" I swear I'm gonna kick you in the junk.
translation: 敲门，发生了什么事？如果你敢说“天晓得”我就把你的屁股踢下来。

original: Knick, anything new and fancy in your magic junkpile full of crap?
translation: 敲门，你那神奇的垃圾堆里有什么新奇别致的东西吗？

original: Joe, anything useful you can teach me about how the classes are going?
translation: 乔，你能教我点上课的技巧吗？

original: Well, if it isn't my favorite girl.
translation: 好吧，这不是我最喜欢的女孩吗？

original: Lucy, can you take a look at this?
George, have you spoken to your son about Old Lady Dithers?
translation: 乔治，你有没有和你的儿子谈谈迪瑟大妈的事？

original: So, heard anything good from Mabel lately?
translation: 最近从梅布尔那得到过什么好消息吗？

original: You gonna stare, or are you gonna order?
translation: 你是准备就这样盯着我，还是有什么吩咐？

original: Bugger off, ye bastards bugger off... ye'll get nae more this evenin'... how's it go?
translation: 走开，你这杂种给我走开……今晚你别想再得到什么……然后怎么唱来着？ ?

original: Do you want to hear a story about the Wastes?
translation: 你想听听一个废土里发生的故事吗？

original: You here to buy, or just looking around?
translation: 你是来买东西的，还是只是来看看的？

original: I got work to do, so if you need something, spit it out.
translation: 我有事情要做，如果你有什么事，快点说！

original: Don't mess with us, we won't mess with you.
translation: 不要打扰我们，我们也不会打扰你。

original: If you have any questions about the exhibits, please let me know.
translation: 如果你对这些展品有什么疑问，请告诉我。

original: Do have a look around, but don't touch anything.
translation: 你可以四处看看，但请勿动手。

original: We have the most complete archive of U.S. historical documents in the Wasteland.
translation: 在这片废土上要找美国历史的文件，那就属我们拥有的资料最完整了。

original: We should get out of here, don't you think?
translation: 我们该立刻离开这，你认为呢？

original: Overseer's glad to see everyone staying so calm down here.
translation: 监督者看见大家情绪稳定很高兴，

original: Still representing the gang? Good to see, man.
translation: 仍是帮派？很高兴见到你，伙计。

original: Good to see you here. Please keep quiet, you never know who's listening.
translation: 在这见到你很高兴。不过要保持安静，隔墙有耳。

original: Hi, Chrissie. Any stories from the weirdo dorm?
translation: 嘿，克里斯。有什么那古怪宿舍的故事吗？

original: Well, Stanley, how's everything going down in the reactor?
translation: 斯坦利，反应堆那目前怎么样？

original: Man, I sure wish we could blow this joint.
translation: 听我说，我当然希望能离开这地方。

original: You've got to change the Overseer's mind.
translation: 你必须要让监督者改变想法。

original: Why won't you just leave us alone? You've done enough damage.
translation: 为什么你就不能放过我们？你已经给我们带来了那么多伤害。

original: It's good to see you again.
Go ahead and start something, I dare you.
translation: 想继续惹事？谅你也不敢！

original: You're not going to ask me to hold your hand through this are you?
translation: 你没打算让我手把手教你怎么做吧？

original: Yes? Are you having trouble with your little assignment? Do I need to find someone else?
translation: 怎么了？布置给你的小任务出问题了？是不是我应该另外找个人来做？

original: Whatever you can do to help our town, we'd appreciate it.
translation: 任何事，只要能帮助我们的镇子，我们都会对你心存感激。

original: We appreciate you taking care of our town's little problem.
translation: 我们感谢你帮我们的镇子解决了点小问题。

original: Any luck finding those two troublemakers, yet?
translation: 有没有找到那两个惹事的家伙？

original: When you find those two costumed idiots, put a bullet in their heads for me.
translation: 你要是看见那两个穿着戏服的白痴，帮我朝他们的头上开一枪。

original: If you're here to give blood, we're always willing to accept... Just kidding!
translation: 如果你来这是想“无偿献血”，我们的大门始终向你打开…哈哈，开个玩笑 !

original: Looks like the Muties missed one.
translation: 看上去变种人漏过了一个。

original: Welcome to my clinic. If you're hurt, then you're in the right place.
translation: 欢迎来到我的诊所。如果你受伤了，那你真是来对地方了。

original: Here to help me out again?
Dinner was... well... I was able to finish it.
Four Score! Who's a good boy? Who's a good boy?
translation: 四分位！谁是好孩子？谁是好孩子？

original: Good dog, Four Score. You love Bill just as he is, don't you? You don't go judging a man like them others.
translation: 乖狗，四分位。你爱比尔，就因为他是比尔，是吗？你不像其他人那样判断一个人。

original: Hey, Four Score. I don't have time to play fetch today. Go bother Bill.
translation: 嗨，四分位。我今天没空和你玩。去找比尔。

original: Come, boy. If you're good today, I'll give you a treat.
translation: 来吧，孩子。如果你今天表现好，我就给你奖励。

original: Hey, clown shoes. I hope that key was worth it.
translation: 嗨，乡巴佬。我希望那钥匙是有价值的。

original: Too bad about Crowley. I heard Tenpenny put out a contract on him.
translation: 这下考利糟糕了。我听说特佩尼与他签订了一份协议。

original: Come on Mary, let's go play!
translation: 来吧，玛丽，让我们去玩吧！

original: Hey, go clean up after the Brahmin. It's your turn.
translation: 嗨，去清扫下双头牛那儿，该你了。

original: Man, the Brahmin smell awful today.
translation: 伙计，双头牛的味道可真重。

original: I'm Dave's wife, so don't even think about trying anything...
translation: 我是戴夫的妻子，所以请你不要轻举妄动……

original: Have you heard about Dave, lady?
translation: 你有没有听说过戴夫，女士？

original: Have you heard about Dave, mister?
translation: 你有没有听说过戴夫，先生？

original: You're almost as big as Dave.
translation: 你差不多和戴夫一样大。

original: Hi there, honey. Have you spoken to Dave?
translation: 你好，亲爱的，你和戴夫说过了吗？
新兵随时汇报，达斯科长官！

original: Damn robot. Worst bedside manner ever.
translation: 该死的机器人。这是我见过最差的态度。

original: Scribe Bowditch, I trust you are well. I'm here for your progress report on the modified Recon Armor.
translation: 文士鲍蒂奇，我相信你能行。我是为了你那改良型侦查装甲的进度报告而来的。

original: Hail, Scribe Bowditch. All is well with your work?
translation: 你好，文士鲍蒂奇。你的工作顺利吗？

original: Hail, Scribe Peabody. I trust that your research goes well.
translation: 你好，文士博迪。我相信你的研究一定有进展。
星骑士 克罗丝，长官！

original: Yeah, I guess I gotta find my own way.
translation: 嗯，我猜我找到自己的办法了。

original: Whoa, sorry! I'll get out of your way!
We should grab a drink sometime.
translation: 我们应该找时间一起喝一杯。

original: You're not so bad from what I've heard.
Heh. I've heard a few things about you.
translation: 嘿。我听说了一些你的事。

original: Get your business done and go.
One wrong move, and you're going in the meat pen.
translation: 要是你干错一件事，就把你剁成肉酱。

original: You don't look like you belong here.
Looks like one of those Brotherhood assholes...
translation: 看上去像是兄弟会的混蛋……

original: Nice outfit. You raid a vault or something?
translation: 不错的外套。你洗劫了避难所还是别的什么？

original: Nice to see you. Carry on.
Now's not the best time. Perhaps we could parlay sometime later? Thank you.
translation: 现在还不是时候，我看下次吧。谢谢。

original: I bet you exercise a lot, huh?
translation: 我猜你一定经常锻炼，呃？

original: Hi there! That's quite some ordnance you're packing, isn't it!
translation: 你好！你带着不少军用品啊，是吗？

original: If you're tired of sleeping in those barracks, let me know.
translation: 如果你厌倦了在兵营里睡觉，告诉我。

original: I made it just like you like it. Enjoy!
translation: 我按你的口味做的，慢用！

original: Chief. I'm concerned some of your men have been sleeping on the job. Well not literally, I just mean, they don't seem that alert.
translation: 长官。你的手下在工作时间睡着了，这让我很难办。可能我言重了，我是想说，他们似乎不那么警惕了。

original: I'm afraid I can't stop and chit chat.
translation: 恐怕我没空停下来闲谈。

original: I'm afraid I can't stop and chit chat.
translation: 恐怕我没空停下来闲谈。

original: Sigh. This is a long way from the Statesman Hotel. Why are you still here?
translation: 唉。去政要酒店的路途很遥远。为什么你还在这？

original: Why are you just standing around here? My men might be dying!
translation: 为什么你还在这站着？我的人都快死了！

original: Please, don't hang around here... just get out to the Statesman Hotel and rescue my men.
translation: 求你了，不要再在这游荡了……快去政要酒店救出我的人。

original: Janice, I have something for you.
Crime doesn't pay, it just pisses people off.
translation: 犯罪不能给你带来任何好处，只会激起民愤。

original: Next time you want to talk to someone, stay away from me.
translation: 下次要是你想找个人说话，拜托你不要找我。

original: Just make this fast. I don't like talking to criminals.
translation: 有屁快放。我可不喜欢和罪犯说话。

original: There's a fine line between badass and dumbass, and you crossed it.
translation: 愚蠢和邪恶之间是有明显的界限的，而你已经越界了。

original: Make no mistake. Try something and I drop your ass.
translation: 别做傻事。你敢乱动我就割下你的屁股！

original: We may be alike, but don't take me for stupid. I got my eyes on you.
translation: 我们或许很像，但你别以为我是蠢货。我自己有眼睛。

original: Keep acting the way you've been acting and they'll catch you, lock you up and throw away the key.
translation: 你要是继续这样，他们就会抓住你，把你永远的关起来。

original: I'm not sure I should even be seen talking to you.
translation: 我在想我该不该被人看到和你说话。

original: Oh, it's you. Up to the same old crap, huh?
translation: 哦，是你啊！你就像个老垃圾，呃？

original: Sometimes being bad feels pretty damn good, eh?
translation: 偶尔使点坏感觉真他妈爽，你说呢？

original: You should be ashamed of yourself.
translation: 你真应为你自己感到羞愧。

original: Next time, use your brains... I know you have it in you.
translation: 拜托你下次动动脑子好吗？你那圆脑袋里装的该不会是草吧？

original: What's the matter with you? You can't get away with crap like this.
translation: 我说你是怎么了？你总不至于要带着这样的垃圾离开吧？

original: The way you're acting surprises me.
translation: 你的所作所为让我感到惊讶。

original: Everyone makes mistakes... just don't do it often.
translation: 每个人都会犯错……但你不能老犯同样的错。

original: Your bad deeds surprise me, they really do.
translation: 你的恶行让我感到惊讶，真的。

original: Don't act like you didn't enjoy what you did.
translation: 不要装出一副对你所做的事丝毫不感兴趣的样子。

original: You're as guilty as the rest of us.
translation: 你，还有我们，都是有罪之人。

original: We need more people like you.
translation: 像你这样的人再多点就好了。

original: You're an example to us all.
It's not easy to be good in this world. I'm glad that someone is.
translation: 在现在这社会做个好人实属不易。但我很高兴还有这样的人存在。

original: I've heard about you. Let it never be said that there aren't some good people left in the world.
translation: 我听说你的事迹了。你让人们相信这世上还是有好人存在的。

original: There's never been anyone like you.
translation: 从没见过像你这样的人！

original: Is everyone from the Vault as kind as you?
translation: 是不是从避难所出来的人都和你一个样？

original: Ah, young madam! Very good to see you again. I do suppose you’re looking for your father the doctor.
translation: 啊，年轻的女士！很高兴又见到你。我猜你是来找你的医生父亲吧。

original: Just hold still. Your left stabilizer's been knocked loose.
translation: 别动，你左面的稳定器已经被敲松了。

original: Don't be such an old woman. Just a few more adjustments and you'll be as good as new.
translation: 别像个老太婆一样。再调试两下你就和新的没两样了。

original: Go ahead and take a seat so we can start.
Time for the G.O.A.T. Find a seat and wait for instructions.
translation: 该开始G.O.A.T.了。找个座位，等着听说明。

original: You did fine. You should celebrate with your friends.
translation: 你做得很好，你可以和你的朋友们好好庆祝一番。

original: Show us how smart you are, Wally. What should we call ourselves?
translation: 这是你最擅长了，瓦利。我们应该给我们自己弄个什么名号呢？

original: Hey, Paul, your hobby's open. Whoa, that's your hobby? Ha ha ha ha! Now quick, give me an idea for what to name our gang.
translation: 嗨，保罗，你的兴趣最广泛了。哇，那就是你的兴趣？哈哈哈哈！快点，告诉我你觉得我们的帮派叫什么名字。

original: Ah man, you got a Pip-Boy. I wish I was ten.
translation: 哇，你有哔哔小子了。我希望我也已经10岁了。

original: Sorry about Butch... Your Dad said we had to invite him.
translation: 我为布奇向你道歉……你爸爸说我们必须要邀请他。

original: Thanks for coming. Are you having fun?
translation: 感谢你的光临，过得还愉快吗？

original: Thanks for coming. It means a lot to both of us.
translation: 感谢你来参加这聚会。对我们来说你的光临真是意义重大。

original: Are you having a nice time?
Have you heard about Freddie Gomez?
translation: 你听说过弗雷迪·戈麦斯吗？

original: You're a lowlife, but if you keep your nose clean, we'll let you stay.
translation: 虽然你是个下等人，但如果你能不惹是生非，我们还能愿意让你留下来。

original: You watch yourself. You cause any more trouble and you'll be dead.
translation: 你小心点，你再惹麻烦就死定了。

original: Those Temple Union slaves got what they deserved.
translation: 那些联邦神殿的奴隶是自作自受。

original: Umm... hello there. Right! Uh, don't mind me then. I'm uh... just practicing my hunting skills. Keeps me young and all that. Right. Goodbye now!
translation: 唔……你好！呃，不要在意我。我，呃……只是在练习我的打猎技巧。这样让我保持年轻。再见！

original: Dashwood. What the hell are you skulking about for?
translation: 达什伍德。你鬼鬼祟祟地到底是要干嘛？

original: Hey! What are you up to old man?
Ahem. Dashwood. Don't do anything stupid.
You feeling alright, Daring? You having a flash back or something?
translation: 亲爱的，你觉得怎样？你是突然想起什么还是怎么了？

original: You're behaving rather oddly, Mister Dashwood. Perhaps you should go lie down for awhile.
translation: 你的举止很古怪，达什伍德先生。恐怕要请你到一边冷静一会。

original: Daring! What on earth are you up to?
translation: 亲爱的！你到底在忙什么？

original: You're up to something. I can tell.
Daring! What the bloody hell are you up to this time?
translation: 亲爱的！现在你到底还在忙什么？

original: Mr. Dashwood. Perhaps you should go take a nap, dear. You're acting rather peculiar.
translation: 达什伍德先生。恐怕要请你去小睡一会，亲爱的。你的行为实在太“特别”了。

original: Daring... you're up to no good, aren't you? Naughty, naughty old man!
translation: 亲爱的……你在做坏事，对吧？顽皮，顽皮的老小孩！
有什么我能帮你的，警长？

original: Dad says not to talk to strangers.
translation: 爸爸说不要和陌生人说话。

original: Billy says not to talk to you.
translation: 比利让我不要和你说话。

original: I got nothin' to say to you.
...now where has that man got to?
Mr. Eulogy... uhm... can I talk to you for a second? If, if you're not busy, I mean.
translation: 尤勒基先生…嗯……我能不能占用你点时间？如果，我的意思是，如果你不是很忙的话。

original: If you're not busy, Mr. Eulogy... I... I wanted to talk to you for a second.
translation: 如果你不是很忙，尤勒基先生……我…我想和你谈谈。

original: Hey, you're back. You get anything good?
translation: 嗨，你回来了，有什么好消息？

original: Hey, how'd it go with that blonde thing you brought in here?
translation: 嗨，会怎么处置你在这抓的金发小妞？

original: You went out with Ymir last week, didn't you? Catch anything good?
translation: 你上周和伊米尔出去了，对吧？抓到什么好东西？
最近有没有抓到好东西？

original: Things are quiet around here. We haven't had any good roundups in a while.
translation: 最近这很平静，我们有段日子没活动了。

original: THE ONE WHO DEFENDED US FROM MOBIUS. {Beat}HELLO.
translation: 那个帮助我们抵御莫比乌斯的人。{Beat}你好啊。

original: {Proud}If it isn't the beautiful ping of my radar-scan picking up a heroic Lobotomite.
translation: {Proud}叮，看我的雷达扫描到了谁，这不是英勇的小无脑人么。

original: -The ONE who SAVED us! To you, I bestow a hello. {Quieter}Hello.-
translation: -是救了我们的那个人！让我授予你问候。{Quieter}你好啊。-

original: *Thanks for helping us. Don't get a big head or anything, even if I am insanely jealous.*
translation: *谢谢你帮了我们。尽管我发疯一样嫉妒，也请不要介意。*

original: So nice seeing you again - for perhaps the first time.
translation: 再次见到你太好了，或许是第一次见到你。

original: It appears you've been wounded, sir. May I suggest you utilize your infirmary?
translation: 先生，看起来您受伤了，我建议您使用您的医务台。

original: You appear to have been wounded, madam. May I suggest you utilize your infirmary?
translation: 看来你受伤了，女士。允许我向你建议使用你的医务台？

original: It appears you've been wounded, madam. May I suggest you seek medical attention as soon as possible?
translation: 你好像受伤了，女士。允许我向你建议尽快寻找医疗援助？

original: I hope things are going well for you today, madam.
translation: 我希望你今天过得愉快，女士。

original: It's good to see you alive and well, madam.
translation: 很高兴见到你还活得不错，女士。

original: Run faster or I will throw you off the side.
translation: 快点跑，不然我就把你扔到一边去。

original: We've got stuff you never realized you needed.
translation: 我们这儿卖的东西绝对能让你眼前一亮。

original: We've got competitive prices and a good inventory.
translation: 我们有最低的价格，还有最好的存货。

original: Just try pulling some of your Brahmin shit here at the Dorado and see what happens.
translation: 你要是敢在多拉多胡作非为，那就不妨试试看。

original: Look all you want, just don't mess with any of the equipment. The control room's off-limits, and so is the enclosure.
translation: 看可以随便看，但不要碰任何装备。控制室禁止进入，围场也一样。

original: Hey Rexie, who's a good dog?
translation: 嘿，小雷克斯，今天乖不乖啊？

original: What's a pretty girl like you doing with someone like this?
translation: 你这么漂亮的女孩和这家伙在一起干嘛？
你需要个男朋友吧，宝贝儿？

original: You want to have some fun with a real man, baby?
translation: 要不要找个真汉子来陪陪你啊，宝贝？

original: Want a massage, cutie? No charge.
translation: 想要按摩吗，小可爱？免费的哦。
啊，又一个该死的机器人。

original: Um, er, excuse me. I'll just get out of your way.
Things are tense on the Strip right now. The head of one of Mr. House's Families was killed. Time to lay low, you ask me.
translation: 长街现在局势紧张。豪斯手下一个家族的老大都被杀了。要我说，还是低调点好。

original: Hey baby. Wanna get wild tonight?
translation: 嘿，宝贝，晚上要不要一起疯一把啊？

original: Hey, baby. I know a quiet place we can be alone. Or a loud place if you're one of those.
translation: 嘿，宝贝。我知道个独处的好地方。或者你喜欢的话，我带你去个热闹的地方也行。

original: You got something you want to say?
Look who it is. Freeside's favorite son.
translation: 瞧瞧是谁来了。自由城的宠儿。

original: Look who it is. Freeside's leading lady.
translation: 瞧瞧是谁来了。自由城的大姐大。

original: Hey, it's good to see you.
Hey there. You're the King's friend, right?
translation: 你好。你是猫王的朋友，对吧？
你觉得自己来对地方了吗？

original: I'd keep moving, if I were you.
translation: 如果我是你，我就会走开。

original: You know, I was just talking about trash, and here you are.
translation: 知道吗，我刚说到垃圾，你就来了。

original: Be advised, visitors will be held responsible for the behavior of any {disapproving}non-human sapients accompanying them.
translation: 提醒您一句，游客们需要为随行的{disapproving}非人智慧生物的行为承担相应责任。

original: I am so happy to see you!
{Celebratory}Without leadership, the Fiends are as good as dead!
translation: {Celebratory}没了首领，恶魔帮已经和死了没区别了！

original: Who would have thought a place like this would exist?
translation: 谁能想到世上居然还有这样的地方？

original: With Caesar dead, maybe they'll stop attacking us.
translation: 凯撒死了，或许他们会停止攻击了吧。

original: {Worried}People are whispering, everywhere, about the massive Legion army gathering past the Colorado.
translation: {Worried}人们都在窃窃私语，大批军团部队正在科罗拉多峡谷一侧集结。

original: Your pet Ghoul smells like ass.
translation: 你这宠物尸鬼闻起来跟屎一样。

original: Your pet Ghoul smells like ass.
translation: 你这宠物尸鬼闻起来跟屎一样。

original: {Drunk ramble}Dixon's hooch may be cheap, but it tastes like it was filtered through a dirty sock.
translation: {Drunk ramble}迪克森的酒便宜归便宜，但尝起来像是用臭袜子滤出来的。

original: {Drunk cat call}Hey baby, I got what you need right here! {disgusting burb}<Burp>
translation: {Drunk cat call}嘿，宝贝儿，我有你想要的东西！{disgusting burb}<嗝儿>

original: {Beaten Resignation}Smells like shit all the time, but at least we're safer than in the Wastes.
translation: {Beaten Resignation}闻起来永远都是屎味，但至少我们比待在废土安全。

original: If we lose Hoover Dam, we can kiss Nevada goodbye.
translation: 如果我们丢了胡佛水坝，那就只能和内华达说再见了。

original: {Neutral - doesn't care that the player killed the President, but impressed that the player walked into a casino full of people who do}Ain't that the bird that tried to ice the President? Gutsy dame, showing her face in here.
translation: {Neutral - doesn't care that the player killed the President, but impressed that the player walked into a casino full of people who do}那不就是想要做掉总统的小鸟吗？这娘们够有种的啊，还敢在这里露脸。

original: I still can't believe we came to terms with the NCR.
translation: 我还是无法相信我们居然和NCR签署了和平协议。

original: Your Ghoul wants to have some fun he can, we don't discriminate.
translation: 你的尸鬼在这儿可以随便逛，我们不会歧视它的。

original: Your Ghoul wants to have some fun he can, we don't discriminate.
translation: 你的尸鬼在这儿可以随便逛，我们不会歧视它的。

original: What the fuck are you looking at?
translation: 你他妈东张西望看什么呢？

original: Don't walk away, let me show you the time of your life.
translation: 别走开，我会让你享受这一生最美好的时刻。

original: The Tops is a real snooze fest. I hope they get some new shows soon.
translation: 九重天实在是让人想打瞌睡。我希望他们能尽快推出些新节目。

original: You know you want a piece of this, give me some sugar.
translation: 你想要吧，来和我一起快活吧。

original: I don't think that's what they mean by doggy style.
translation: 我觉得他们说的“小狗式”不是那个意思。

original: Mmm, I haven't had a Ghoul before. Do I get to keep the tip?
translation: 呃，我没和尸鬼打过交道。是不是可以留着小费？

original: Ooo, the big one looks like fun. Let me know if you want a good time.
translation: 喔，这大块头看上去很有趣。如果你想爽一番的话，记得来找我。

original: Gomorrah has the loosest slots on the Strip.
translation: 蛾摩拉的老虎机是长街最黑的。

original: Hot damn do I love this place.
Thanks. Hopefully, it'll just be skinned knees and bloody noses, today.
translation: 谢谢。但愿今天只是磕破膝盖或鼻子流血。

original: I'll let you get back to work.
translation: 我还是让你回去工作吧。

original: Don't get too hurt out there.
You know what you need to do.
You have lots of work to do!
I look forward to seeing how you deal with this.
translation: 我来看看你是怎么解决这事的。

original: The Citadel is our only chance now. We have to make it there.
translation: 五角大本营是我们现在唯一的机会。我们必须去那。

original: Come back later. I mean, don't come back later. See if I care.
translation: 回头见。我的意思，回头别见。我不在乎。

original: Watch out for Muties and Raiders.
I'll let you and gun have some alone time...
translation: 我还是让你和枪独处吧……

original: If you see anyone from Lamplight, tell them to be careful.
translation: 如果你看到任何从小灯镇来的人，告诉他们小心。

original: I'm going to go look around town.
We're doomed and so are you if you stick around.
translation: 我们是完了，如果你在这待着，也一样。

original: I'm going to go look around town.
Don't get yourself hurt. I have enough red on my clothes already.
translation: 别再把自己弄伤了。我的衣服已经够红了。

original: Stay clear of mutants. Especially the big, hungry ones.
translation: 离变种人远点。尤其是那种又大又饿的。

original: All right, I'll just be here doing grown-up stuff.
translation: 好吧，我只是在这做些大人的事。

original: Be careful out there. You don't want to end up on that table in Red's clinic.
translation: 出门小心。你不想最后又躺在瑞德的手术台上吧。

original: Don't be distracted by the size. Stay calm; shoot straight.
translation: 别被体型吓到。冷静；瞄准打。

original: All right. I'm going to get going.
Yessir, Mr. Moriarty. More drunk customers, coming up!
translation: 遵命，莫里亚蒂先生。好多喝醉的顾客，来吧！

original: Of course, of course! Don't let me keep you!
translation: 当然，当然！别让我耽误你了！

original: Please... God... I just need water.
translation: 求你...上帝啊...我只需要水。

original: Have a wonderful and productive day.
translation: 祝你今天过得高效且充实。

original: Remember that the Department of Tourist Rights only guarantees your safety for 24 hours. After that time, you will be executed.
translation: 记住旅游者权益部门只能保护你二十四小时。之后，就要靠你自己了。

original: Come back if you need something. Not like I'm going anywhere.
translation: 如果你有需要就回来。我会一直在这的。

original: Wha... huh? I don't get it.
I'll tell Mr. Eulogy that we talked.
translation: 我会告诉尤勒基先生我们聊过了。

original: You'd better go before he sees you.
Yeah. Come back when you've got more injuries. And some more caps.
translation: 嗯。你受伤的时候可以回来。别忘了多带点瓶盖。

original: Paradise Falls is here if you need it.
translation: 如果你想回来，堕落天堂就在这。

original: Yeah, just behave yourself. The boys up there don't fuck around.
translation: 嗯，老实点。那边那群家伙可不是吃素的。

original: Please... if you get to Underworld, let them know that I'm okay.
translation: 如果你去地下城，请让他们知道我一切都好。

original: Hey, man. Come back any time.
Told you: there's nothing exciting down here.
translation: 已经告诉过你：在那没有什么好玩的东西。

original: It's only a matter of time now.
Come back when you are ready to drink, little man.
translation: 当你想喝点什么的时候就回来，小伙子。

original: Come back when you are ready to drink, little girl.
translation: 当你想喝点什么的时候就回来，小女孩。

original: Ah, never mind! Talk with you is... stupid.
translation: 啊，算了！和你说话真是……太蠢了。

original: Hope you find what you're looking for.
translation: 希望你找到你要找的东西。

original: Yes! They're all dead! And I have the keys. The keys to the... are you still here? Get lost. I have a trip to plan.
translation: 嗯！他们都死了！我得到了钥匙。这钥匙是开……你在听吗？滚。我还要安排旅行。

original: Finally, I have the keys. Your job is done and you've been paid, so move along. I have a trip to plan.
translation: 最后，我得到了钥匙。你的活已经干完并且得到了报酬，走吧。我还要安排旅行。

original: Well, they may not all be dead, but I have the keys. I should have hired a better mercenary. Run along. I have a trip to plan.
translation: 好吧，他们或许没都死，但我还是得到钥匙了。我应该雇个更好的佣兵。走开。我还要安排旅行。

original: Good luck in the Museum. Bring me back something and I'll let you get a closer look at the Memorial.
translation: 在博物馆里好运。给我带回点东西的话，我会让你仔细看看纪念堂。

original: Sure. Silas will tell them you're allowed up there.
translation: 当然。西拉斯会告诉他们你可以上来了。

original: So... Can I take a peek at the Memorial now?
translation: 那么……我能现在看看纪念碑吗？

original: Whatever. I need to get back to work.
translation: 不管怎样。我要回去工作了。

original: You're doing a great job. Really.
All right, I'll make sure they don't cut us off.
translation: 好的，我确保它们不会把我们隔断的。

original: First aliens, now Death Rays. This is like a crazy TV show.
translation: 先是外星人，现在是死光。就像一个疯狂的电视节目。

original: You know where to find me.
translation: 你知道在哪里能找到我。

original: Come back any time, them swampfolk types are always bringin' me new stuff.
translation: 随时恭候，那些沼泽居民常给我带新玩意来。

original: Hey, before you go. If you ever want to get rid of that scar on your head, just come and see me, okay?
translation: 嗨，你走之前。如果你想去除头上的疤痕，就来找我，好吗？

original: Come back again soon! Marie and I will be waiting!
translation: 快点回来！玛丽和我等着！

original: Sounds like Ashur's working you pretty hard. Must be so tough for you.
translation: 听起来阿舒尔像是在你身上下了大功夫，你想必很有本事。

original: Wow, okay, I'm sorry. I was just... kidding...
translation: 哇，好吧，对不起。我只是…开个玩笑…

original: Stay away from Dave. He's mine.
You're safe as long as Dave says so.
translation: 戴夫说你安全，你便是安全的。

original: Come back and visit the museum anytime!
I'll leave you to the kids.
translation: 我还是让你和孩子们在一起吧。

original: Just don't bother me. I've got stuff to do for Dave.
translation: 别烦我。我正在为戴夫做事。

original: I have to go practice my Dave impression, anyway.
translation: 无论如何，我都得让戴夫对我有所印象。
就像戴夫一直挂在嘴边的那样。

original: I think I'd rather just stay broken than submit to any further indignity.
translation: 我觉得我什么都不做，也比受到更多的侮辱强。

original: Good luck. Careful around that bomb.
Come back if you need something.
translation: 如果你需要什么就回来吧。

original: I'll expect to see you in class, Freddie. No excuses. Run along now, son.
translation: 我等你来上课哦，弗雷迪。别找借口。现在走开，孩子。

original: Let me know if you have any of that Scrap Metal to sell!
translation: 你有废金属的话，告诉我一声！

original: Let me know if you need something.

translation: 对不起，我现在就要走了。

original: That's right. And don't come back!

translation: 对不起，我现在就要走了。

original: Why won't you just take me to Big Town?
translation: 不如你不把我带到大镇吧？

original: I'll wait over here for you. When you're done playing with the children we'll go to Big Town.
translation: 我会在这等你。等你跟这些孩子玩够了，我们再去大镇。

original: Okay, yeah. Thanks for asking. I'll catch up with you later.
translation: 好吧，嗯。谢谢你的邀请。我迟点来找你。

original: No way. Not on my watch. GUARDS!
translation: 没门。在我当班的时候不行。守卫！

original: May the Great One bless you.
May you remain under the canopy of His protection.
translation: 愿你始终处在祂的庇护之下。

original: Be back soon! And bring more caps!
I suppose there's no chance for a nice conversation today, is there.
translation: 我猜今天没机会好好聊天了，对吧。

original: Well... Good talking with you, boy, as always.
translation: 好吧……很高兴和你谈，小子，一如既往。

original: I'll, umm... I'll just be over here.
Great! I'll see you later, Machete!
No problem, Machete. See you later.
If you insist, Derek. If you wanna talk later, I'm around.
translation: 如果你坚持，德里克。如果你愿意，我们回头聊。

original: You're the boss, man. We can talk about it later, if you want.
translation: 听你的，哥们。我们回头再聊，如果你想谈的话。

original: You know you can rely on me for that.
translation: 你知道在那方面你能信任我。

original: Umm... Yes, sir. I mean, Dominic.
translation: 唔……是的，先生。我的意思是，多米尼克。

original: Good. See you later. And you better show up!
You're welcome, you testy old fool. I swear, Nathan, one of these days you're going to give yourself a heart attack, just like Doc Church said...
translation: 欢迎，你这暴躁的老混蛋。我发誓，内森，总有一天你会突发心脏病，就像丘奇医生说的那样...

original: Remember, bring me back anything interesting you find.
translation: 记住，给我带回你找到的任何有趣的东西。

original: Get that fission battery then double time it back here!
translation: 拿到把那核裂变电池，然后跑回来！

original: I really don't want to die down here.
Bah! I'm going back to doin'... what I was doin'...
translation: 呸！我要回去做……我本该做的事……

original: Forget it! You too dumb to talk to.
translation: 算了吧！我不要和你这样的笨蛋说话了。

original: I'll just be on my way, then.
Come on, cheer up. Paul wouldn't want you moping around like that.
translation: 加油，振作起来。保罗可不想看见你整天闷闷不乐的。

original: I have no doubt that we shall. No doubt at all.
translation: 我不怀疑我们会的。毫不怀疑。

original: We certainly shall. In time, everything will be solved.
translation: 我想会的。所有的事迟早都会解决。

original: He's not listening to me. But there's someone else who might be able to convince him. We'll see.
translation: 他不听我的。但有人能让他明白。我们走着瞧。

original: Sure you will, Butch. Sure you will.
translation: 你当然会。布奇。你当然会。

original: I'll keep myself safe if you do the same, Amata.
translation: 我会注意的，你也是哦，阿玛塔。

original: All right, dear. Just don't get into any trouble.
translation: 好的，亲爱的。只是别惹麻烦。

original: We're not naming ourselves after you. Drop it, all right?
translation: 我们又没跟你混。放弃吧，好吗？

original: I never said I didn't like it. I just haven't made up my mind yet, okay?
translation: 我从没有说过我不喜欢它。我只是还没想好，好吗？

original: Go ahead and punk out if you want. Me and Wally will find somebody else to be in our gang.
translation: 除非你想退出，否则就继续。我和瓦利会找到其他人加入我们的帮会的。

original: I said I'd think about it. Come on, we need some new ones.
translation: 我说过我会考虑的。得了吧，我们需要些新的。

original: If you see Junior, tell him that I said hi!
translation: 如果你看见“小子”，代我向他问好！

original: I really look forward to preparing you for dinner sometime!
translation: 我真希望能有机会和你共进晚餐！

original: Okay, see you next time, bye bye!
I'm going away. You stay here. Away from me.
translation: 我要走了。你留在这。离我远点。

original: Not for a while, I hope.
If you'll excuse me, I need to go show these fish how to shoot straight.
translation: 请你原谅，我还要向那些新手展示一下怎么瞄准。

original: I'm afraid I can't stop and chit chat.
translation: 恐怕我没空停下来闲谈。

original: Don't do anything I wouldn't do!

translation: 离别是这样甜蜜的凄楚。

original: A little bit of caps for so much information... think about it.
translation: 一点瓶盖就能换那么多消息……好好想想吧。

original: Careful in D.C. now. Those Super-Mutants can be a prickly bunch. Heh heh heh heh heh.
translation: 在特区小心。那些超级变种人可是块烫手的山芋。呵呵呵呵呵。

original: Now, get the fuck out of me face.
translation: 赶紧的，别在老子面前晃荡。

original: Remember us if you need something!
translation: 如果有需要的话可以找我们！

original: You have yourself a fine day, madam.
If there's anything you require further feel free to ask, madam.
translation: 如果你还有什么需要，请尽管开口，女士。

original: I'll be sure and tidy up while you're away, madam.
translation: 你不在的时候，我一定会收拾好的，女士。

original: Suit yourself. Gambling's thirsty work - I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 请您自便。赌博是容易口渴的，如果你改变主意，可以随时来找我。

original: Come on back if you get lonely, sweet thing.
translation: 要是寂寞了就回来找我，甜心。

original: Come on back if you want a game.
translation: 想来一局的话可记得回来找我。

original: Enjoy your stay at the Atomic Wrangler.
translation: 祝您在原子牛仔过得愉快。

original: ...could have sworn I saw some movement back there.
translation: ……我发誓看到那后面有东西在动。

original: One two... got a bullet for you...
Let's go, you hairy fucks. I ain't got all day.
translation: 来呀，你这长毛杂种。我都闲了一天了。

original: Get out here, 'Guai. I got a present for you.
translation: 滚到这来，妖怪。我有礼物给你。

original: Come on out, you smelly bastards.
I thought I heard something over here...
translation: 我好像听到了什么声音……

original: Wish a buckethead would show up... I'd rip his legs clean off...
translation: 希望一个水桶脑袋能出现……我要连根扯下他的腿……

original: Don't get me wrong, I love to cause trouble, but you go too far.
translation: 别误会，我确实喜欢惹麻烦，但是你太夸张了。

original: You've changed. I mean, bad is one thing. Evil is another.
translation: 你已经变了。我的意思，坏是一回事。邪恶是另一回事。

original: Did you really have to kill all of those people back there? They didn't seem so bad.
translation: 你真的要回去杀光那里的所有人？他们看起来并不坏。

original: I always knew that you were a teacher's pet.
translation: 我一直知道你是老师的最爱。

original: This do-gooder crap is for the birds.
translation: 这些不切实际的大道理只能骗骗小孩。

original: Man, you're just a little goody two-shoes, aren't you?
translation: 哥们，你真是个伪君子，不是吗？

original: I need some shades or something...
translation: 我需要找个太阳镜之类的……

original: Man, it stinks. The vault never smelled like this.
translation: 哥们，真臭。避难所从没臭成这样。

original: I wonder what Eulogy is doing...
Goddamn cigarettes are getting' harder to find.
translation: 该死的香烟，真他妈难找。

original: Man... am I out of smokes again?
translation: 不是吧……我又没烟抽了吗？

original: Goddamn collar on this armor is too tight...
translation: 妈的，装甲的领子太紧了……

original: Sir, I am on the lookout.
I knew we should've never let him in. Said so at the time.
translation: 我觉得我们就不应该让他进来。那时候就该这么说。

original: Head voices know smelly Ghoul. He old and good with guns.
translation: 脑袋里的声音认识一个发臭的尸鬼。虽然很老，但是会耍枪。

original: Book girl has hard decision to make.
translation: 文书女孩要做艰难的决定。

original: What's the word? Heard anything interesting?
translation: 最近大家都在聊什么？有什么有意思的事吗？

original: Nothing like the smell of apple pie, is there? I can't get enough of it.
translation: 没有什么能比得上苹果派的味道，是吗？我总是吃不够。

original: I'm gonna ring your bell, creep!
translation: 我会亲手把你送进坟里！

original: I'm gonna ring your bell, creep!
I forgot how much fun it was to shoot Ferals!
translation: 我都忘了开枪射击凶悍僵尸是多么有趣！

original: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!

translation: 杀了他们！杀了他们所有人！

original: You die now, human! Ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 你现在该死了，人类！哈哈哈哈哈！

original: I'll eat your brain and drink your blood!
translation: 我要吃你的脑，喝你的血！

original: I'm going to eat your arms when you're dead, human!
translation: 我等你死后就会来吃你的胳膊，人类！

original: I'm going to eat your arms when you're dead, human!
translation: 我等你死后就会来吃你的胳膊，人类！

original: You are weak! I am stroooonng!
Oh ho ho ho! Little baby scared?
translation: 哦，呵，呵！小孩子被吓坏了？

original: Scream! Scream for your worthless life!
translation: 尖叫！为你的贱命尖叫吧！

original: Why... you... stupid... humans... always... fight?!
translation: 为什么……你这……愚蠢的……人类……总要……战斗？！ ?!

original: Hurry up and die! I'm hungry! Ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 快点去死吧！我饿了！哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Now you went and got me mad!
{I'm playing with you!}Nah ash ne wit deer!
translation: {I'm playing with you!}窝来跟尼玩玩！

original: {Think you can fight me?!}Glahb ni kahn meer dah ah?!
translation: {Think you can fight me?!}尼以为尼打得过窝？！

original: I'm gonna clip your sorry ass.
You like the sight of your own blood?
translation: 你是许久不见红，浑身难受了吗？

original: Need some help with this one!
Yeah?! Yeah?! You want some of this?
What's the matter, huh? Can't stand the sight of your own blood?
translation: 怎么了，呃？看到自己流血就受不了了？

original: There's more where that came from.

translation: 你喜欢那样吗，你这杂种？
尤勒基想要这家伙的脑袋！

original: You see? This is why I took you to that Vault in the first place...
translation: 你明白了？这就是我为什么先带你去避难所……

original: You think I'm going to let YOU stop me? After all I've been through?
translation: 你觉得我会让你阻止我吗？尤其是在我经历了这么多事之后？

original: I'll kill you before I let anyone harm my child!
translation: 我会在你伤到我孩子之前杀了你！

original: First that crazy simulation, now this. Has the entire world taken leave of its senses?
translation: 先是那疯狂的模拟，现在又是这。整个世界都发了疯吗？

original: Traveling the Wasteland, shooting guns! By God, I'm getting too old for this sort of thing!
translation: 在废土上，旅旅行开开枪！的确，对于这些事来说我太老了！

original: Just like shooting that old BB Gun! You remember?
translation: 就像使用旧BB枪那样！你记得吗？

original: If you won't give us the water, we'll just have to take it!
translation: 你要是不给我们水，那我们只能抢了！

original: Thought you could get away, huh?
Don't let them keep us down!
You got to shoot them in the head!
You need to learn some manners!
I'm going to teach you a lesson you won't forget!
translation: 我会教你一堂不会忘记的课！

original: How do you like that, huh?
I'm getting hungry just looking at you!
translation: 光是看你就让我觉得开胃！

original: That's it, I'm officially coming out of retirement!
translation: 没错，我已经正式退休了！

original: You're messin' with the best, asshole!
translation: 你在和最好的过招，混蛋！

original: Eyes open and heads down, people!
translation: 眼睛睁大点，头放低点，大家伙！

original: You ain't so super now, huh?
The Overseer's going to hear about this.
The Overseer won't tolerate this kind of behavior.
translation: 监督者不会容许这种背叛。

original: Tactical assessment: Red Chinese victory... impossible.
translation: 作战评估: 中国红军胜利……不可能。

original: Democracy is truth. Communism is death.
translation: 民主是真理。共产主义是死亡。

original: Weapons free. Non-combatants are advised to stand clear.
translation: 没有武器。建议非战斗人员不要靠近。

original: Status report: green. All systems within acceptable operating parameters.
translation: 状态报告：绿色。所有系统都在可接受的运行参数之内。

original: Status report: yellow. Primary systems have sustained significant damage. Reinforcement recommended.
translation: 状态报告：黄色。主要系统遭受严重破坏。建议进行加固。

original: Status report: yellow and falling. Perimeter security can no longer be guaranteed.
translation: 状态报告：黄色，正在下降。周边安全不能再得到保证。

original: Status report: red. Primary system failure imminent. Repair or reinforcement recommended.
translation: 状态报告：红色。主要系统即将发生故障。建议维修或加固。
警告! 系统故障迫在眉睫。

original: Threat assessment: primary target is at large and undamaged. Full perimeter alert recommended.
translation: 威胁评估：主要目标在逃，未受损害。建议进行全面的周边警戒。

original: Threat assessment: primary target has been engaged, but continues to exhibit hostile intent.
translation: 威胁评估：主要目标已经交战，但继续表现出敌对的意图。

original: Threat assessment: primary target heavily damaged. Continuing to engage.
translation: 威胁评估：主要目标严重受损。继续进行交战。

original: Threat assessment: primary target has suffered critical damage. Neutralization imminent.
translation: 威胁评估：主要目标已遭受严重损害。中止行动迫在眉睫。

original: Threat assessment: primary target almost neutralized. Stand by.
translation: 威胁评估：主要目标几乎被消灭。准备就绪。

original: Be advised. Hostiles in area. Threat neutralization in progress.
translation: 请注意，敌人在该地区。威胁正在解除中。

original: Non-combatants are advised to stand clear of weapons discharge.
translation: 非战斗人员应远离武器发射。

original: Alert. Security operation in progress. Stand clear of security perimeter.
translation: 警报。正在进行安全操作。远离安全区域。

original: Alert. Use of lethal force in progress. Non-combatant safety cannot be guaranteed.
translation: 警报。正在使用致命武力。不能保证非战斗人员的安全。

original: Tsk. I really thought we could be friends.
translation: 啧啧，我真的以为我们可以成为朋友。

original: Please, lower your weapon and submit.
I'm a much better tactician than you. It's all in the brain, you see.
translation: 我是一个比你强得多的战术家。这一切都在大脑中，你看。

original: Please don't take this the wrong way.
Which do you like better -- the psionic beam or the laser?
translation: 你更喜欢哪一种 -- 幻象光束还是激光？

original: You could run? I am trying to kill you, after all.
translation: 你能跑吗？毕竟我是想杀了你。

original: I hope this unpleasantness will be over soon.
translation: 我希望这种不愉快会很快结束。

original: Hold still please. It's harder to hit you if you keep running around like that.
translation: 请不要动。如果你一直这样跑来跑去，就更难打到你。

original: I hope we can still be friends when this is all over.
translation: 我希望这一切结束后，我们还能成为朋友。

original: Please believe me when I say I'm not enjoying this.
translation: 请相信我，当我说我不喜欢这样的时候。

original: I wish there was some other way we could have worked this out.
translation: 我希望我们当时能以其他方式把这件事解决掉。

original: I'm afraid I'm a very lethal killing machine.
translation: 我担心我是个致命的杀人机器。

original: Running away is probably your only hope.
translation: 逃走可能是你唯一的希望。

original: My programming requires that I keep trying to kill you.
translation: 我的程序设计指使我继续尝试杀死你。

original: Don't feel bad if you don't defeat me. I am one of the most advanced military robots available.
translation: 如果你被我打败请不要感到气馁，我是现存最先进的军用机器人之一。

original: I'm not programmed to fail. Just so you know.
translation: 我没有被编程为失败，只是让你知道。

original: They could have programmed me to love. To forgive. But nnoooo...
translation: 他们原本可以把我设计来去爱，去宽恕，但是没有....

original: I don't mean to be insensitive, but you really can't win.
translation: 不是我不友好，你真没法赢我。

original: I calculate your chance of success as... well, no need to be morbid.
translation: 我算了一下你成功的概率....  哎呀，完全不用紧张。

original: Law abiding citizens, please leave the area.
translation: 守法的市民，请离开这片区域。

original: Please take cover until the danger has been eliminated.
translation: 在危险消除之前，请躲藏起来。

original: Put down your weapons and submit to authority.
Warning. Continued operation cannot be guaranteed. Please contact an authorized repair representative immediately.
translation: 警告。无法保证继续运行。请立即联系许可的维修人员

original: Calculating chance of success... less than 5%. Your safety can no longer be guaranteed.
translation: 计算胜利概率中....  小于5%。 无法继续保证你的安全。

original: Do not be alarmed. Order will be restored soon. Please stand by.
translation: 请不要担心。 秩序很快就会恢复。请等待。
警报。区域中出现敌意目标。

original: Multiple hostile targets detected. Requesting backup.
translation: 发现多个敌意目标。请求支援。
与多个敌意目标交战中。

original: Engagement with multiple hostiles in progress. Please stand clear of the combat area.
translation: 与多个敌意目标的交战正在进行。请离开战斗区域。

original: Do not be alarmed. Law and order will be restored shortly.
translation: 请不要担心。 法律和秩序不久就会恢复。请等待。

original: For your safety, please take cover until the lawbreaker is dealt with.
translation: 为了您的安全，在解决违法者之前，请先躲起来。

original: This is a lawful use of deadly force. Please direct complaints to your local law enforcement authorities.
translation: 这是合法性的使用致命武力，如有不满请直接与地方法律机构联系。

original: Please clear the area until order has been restored.
translation: 请离开这片区域直到秩序恢复为止。

original: A lawful use of deadly force is in progress. Citizens are advised to clear the area.
translation: 合法性的致命武力使用中，建议市民离开这片区域。

original: Eat hot lead, you commie bastard!
translation: 天打雷劈， 你这个混蛋共匪！

original: Ready to die for your country?
Pain is just weakness leaving the body!
Today's a hell of day to die, commie!
translation: 今天就是你的忌日，共产党！

original: How do you like that, you mother-loving commie!
Is that the best you can do?
I'm just getting warmed up! Hoo-ah!
translation: 我刚刚热完身！ 呼-啊！

original: There's nothing I like better than the smell of plasma in the morning!
translation: 没有比一大早上闻到等离子的味道更让人兴奋的！

original: What's the matter, you pansy ass pinko? Getting tired?
We are lean! We are mean!
I have a personal message for you from Uncle Sam!
translation: 山姆大叔让我给你带个口信！

original: Running will only make the pain last longer!
translation: 逃跑只会让你痛苦更久！

original: Kill them all! God will understand.
translation: 把他们都杀了！ 上帝会理解的。

original: There's nothing I like better than making some other poor bastard die for his country.
translation: 没有什么事比让卑微的蠢蛋为他的国家献身更让我感到兴奋的了。

original: Now you're starting to piss me off.
translation: 现在你开始让我生气了。

original: *Sigh.* Why must you humans always resort to violence?
translation: *叹气*为什么你们人类总会使用暴力呢？

original: And who gets to clean up all this blood? Me, that's who...
translation: 然后谁去清理这些血？ 那个人就是，我....

original: Oohh. Yesss... Let's all beat up on the robot...
translation: "噢，好啊……让我们一起暴打机器人吧……"

original: By God, if I had hands I would strangle the life out of you!
translation: 以上帝之名，如果我有手我一定会掐死你！"

original: You have insulted my honor, and for that, you must die!
translation: 你侮辱了我的荣耀，于是乎，你一定要死！

original: Ooohh! I love when they fight back!
You wanna be my new boyfriend? Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 你想成为我的新男友吗？哈哈哈哈哈！

original: I want his head on a platter!
translation: 我想把他的头盛在盘子里！

original: Keep firing! They bleed just like anything else!
translation: 继续开火！他们就像其他东西一样流血！

original: Least I'm not stuck being a barber anymore.
translation: 至少我不再留在那做一个理发师了。

original: Man, sure beats living in the Vault, huh?
translation: 哥们，你在避难所里打过架，呃？

original: We are so the baddest gang in the Wastes.
translation: 我们是废土上最坏的帮派。

original: You don't even know how screwed you are!
translation: 你甚至不知道你有多么失败！

original: Any moment now, you'll be dead. Are you excited to see what that's like?
translation: 你现在随时会死。是不是很期待看看这将会是什么景象啊？
穴蛇帮主宰一切，废物们流口水！

original: How do you like that, Poindexter?
translation: 你怎么喜欢那样，波因德克斯特？

original: Maybe this time the lesson will stick.
Did you see that, Butch? I nailed him a good one!
translation: 你见过吗，布奇？我狠狠地抓了他一下！

original: I can't believe I'm hitting a girl.
translation: 我不能相信我正打一个女孩。

original: I'll see you dead or in chains!
Come and get it if you want it!
You should have followed Burke's orders!
translation: 你应该遵从伯克的命令！

original: You shouldn't have tried to run.

translation: 你的父亲背叛了我们所有人！！

original: The punishment for treason is death.
Don't make this more difficult than it has to be.
Jonas cried while we beat him, did you know that?
translation: 我们修理乔纳斯的时候他哭了，你知道吗？

original: Come and get it, you dirty traitor!
translation: 过来比划比划，你这肮脏的叛徒！

original: You don't have to do this.
You're no better than that mutie scum...
translation: 你比变种人人渣好不到哪去……

original: Let's call this one a mercy killin'.
translation: 让我们管这叫一次仁慈的杀戮。

original: Are you afraid, girl? I can smell it.
translation: 你害怕了吗，女孩？我能嗅出恐惧的味道。

original: Andy! Help! We've got another one!
You think you're fast enough, stranger?
translation: 你觉得你够快吗，陌生人？

original: Colin! We need help over here!
This old man's still got some fight in him!
Your corpse is just a fat bonus to me.
translation: 你的尸体对我而言就是一张中奖彩票。

original: {You can't fight me!}{YOO-can no ni-KUM-pah mee}Yoocan no nikumpa me!
translation: {You can't fight me!}{YOO-can no ni-KUM-pah mee}尼打不过窝的！
{Fall down and die!}{oo-WAY-kah moo-WEAR-nah!}躺下受史！

original: Son, I brought you into this world. I think you know the rest.
translation: 儿子，我把你带到这世界来。我想接下来的你都知道。

original: Honey, I brought you into this world. I think you know the rest.
translation: 亲爱的，我把你带到这世界来。我觉得你应该知道停下。

original: Oh my God, someone help me!
Aggh! It's called Power Armor for a reason, freak!
translation: 啊！这就是被称为动力装甲的原因，畸形！

original: I just had this suit tailored!
This is your last warning before I kill you.
translation: 这是我杀你之前的最后一次警告。

original: Once more and I'm going to have to kill you.
Battle cattle! Run for your lives!
Fuck this! I'm out of here!
Oh my God, I don't wanna die!
Please, I'm sorry! I was just playin', I swear!
translation: 求求你，我很抱歉！我不过是玩玩，我发誓！

original: There's got to be someplace safe!
No way I'm sticking around here.
I didn't mean it, don't kill me.
Gotta get out while the getting's good.
translation: 赶紧走，否则就来不及了。

original: I best be on my way.
I've got a bar to tend!
translation: 我还得回去照看酒吧呢！

original: We can't handle this ourselves, son! Run!
translation: 我们自己解决不了，孩子！快跑！

original: I've underestimated you. Let's continue this another time!
translation: 我低估了你。让我们下次再继续吧！

original: Let me go! Let me go!
{I'm out of here!}{may no KAH-day AH-kee}Me no kaade akee!
translation: {I'm out of here!}{may no KAH-day AH-kee}我要离开哲里！

original: I'm gettin' the fuck outta here.
Crime detected. Judicial circuits recommend immediate application of capital punishment.
translation: 发现到犯罪行为，司法回路建议立即给予致命性惩治。

original: Crime detected. Application of death sentence commencing.
translation: 发现犯罪行为，正在执行致命性惩治。

original: Crime detected. Consulting judicial circuits... offender sentenced to death.
translation: 发现犯罪行为。咨询司法程序中……宣判犯罪者为死刑。

original: I wish you hadn't done that.
I'm sorry. I've been programmed to protect private property at all costs.
translation: 很抱歉，程序指令要求我不惜一切代价保护个人财产。

original: I wish I could look the other way, but I'm afraid my programming is very strict.
translation: 我希望我能装作视而不见，但是我的程序指令十分严格。
侦测到未授权的物资征用行为。

original: Please put your hands in the air and prepare for disciplinary action.
translation: 请将您的双手举高，并准备接受惩戒处分。

original: That is stealing. Stealing is prohibited.
translation: 这是盗窃行为，该行为被严令禁止。

original: The class of people I'm forced to associate with these days just keeps falling.
translation: 我最近被迫协助的那批人还是那么堕落。

original: Why do I get all the hoodlums?
translation: 为什么我老是遇见流氓呢？

original: I thought I had seen every species of moronic petty bullshit, but you've just topped the list. Congratulations.
translation: 我原以为自己见识过这世上各种低能无脑儿，但现在你在这名单上独占鳌头，恭喜你。

original: Do you have no respect for private property, you slimy little commie bastard?
translation: 你难道对私人财产一点尊重之情都没有吗？你这矮小、虚伪的共产主义混蛋。

original: Did you not realize that I have eyes in the back of my head?
translation: 你难道不知道我脑袋后面也长了对眼睛么？

original: You're going to be in trouble if you don't put that back!
translation: 你要是不把东西还给我，你会有麻烦的！

original: Now hand that back, you low-down thief!
translation: 放回去，你这个下流的贼！

original: Why you low-down nibbler, I'll have that back!
translation: 你这个下流胚子，给我还回来！

original: I'll thank you not to touch my plunder.
translation: 谢谢你还没碰我的赃物。

original: Don't think I didn't see that!
I don't know who you think you're fooling.
Hey! I need that for stuff!
Come on. At least steal from a mean person.
translation: 拜托，要偷东西也找个守财奴下手吧。

original: <Sigh> Boss, if you just ask, I'll hand it to you. Probably.
translation: <Sigh>老大，要的话你就说一声嘛，我亲自给你就是了。

original: Boss, why do my pants suddenly feel lighter?
translation: 老大，为什么我觉得裤子突然变轻了？

original: Look, boss, I appreciate you not making me carry that, but come on.
translation: 说实在的，老大，我很感谢你不让我带着这东西，可你这又是何必呢。

original: Good way to lose a hand.
translation: 你这样迟早会被剁手的。

original: Sweetie, if you want something, just ask {gramma}grandma politely.
translation: 甜心，如果你想要什么东西，好好和{gramma}奶奶说就行了。

original: Stealing isn't very nice, is it Leo?
translation: 偷东西可不怎么好，对吧，利奥？

original: {Just caught the player stealing}Is someone looking for a paddling?
translation: {Just caught the player stealing}Is someone }有人想打架是吗？
{annoyed}我们在这一带的麻烦已经够多了！

original: {confused, not sure what to say}Uh... that doesn't belong to you.
Hey! That don't belong to you, so keep your grubby mitts off it!
translation: 嘿！那不是你的东西，把你的脏手拿开！

original: I reckon that don't belong to you.
Hey! That don't belong to you, so keep your grubby mitts off it!
translation: 嘿！那不是你的东西，把你的脏手拿开！

original: Thought no one was looking, did you?
translation: 你以为没人盯着你，是吗？

original: That does not belong to you.
Theft is not a victimless crime.
If you want it, take it!
If you see something you like, it's yours!
translation: 如果有什么东西你看得上，那就归你了！

original: Stay the fuck away from that.
Fucking rat, don't touch that shit.
translation: 该死的小贼，别碰那东西。
我就知道你手脚不干净。

original: {Sarcastic}If you find a place to pawn that, go right ahead.
translation: {Sarcastic}如果你能找到典当它的地方，那就偷吧。

original: {Cold, knowing}Greed took the others - go on, keep it. {Low, threatening}I'll get it back eventually.
translation: {Cold, knowing}贪婪已经吞噬了其他人，你留着吧。{Low, threatening}反正我最后会拿回来的。

original: [Christine narrows her eyes, then shakes her head and waves you off.]
translation: [克莉丝汀眯起了双眼，摇摇头，向你挥手告别。]
{Curious, then low, defensive growl}哼嗯？啊呜呜呜嗯嗯…

original: Take from me again, and I'll leave you for the Sierra Madre.
translation: 你要是再敢从我这里偷东西，我就把你丢给马德雷山脉。

original: {Awkward, the player just stole from him}Um... you know I'll share if you ask, right?
translation: {Awkward, the player just stole from him}呃...你不说我怎么知道你想要？你说了我肯定给你。

original: Is... is this some kind of civilized ritual I just don't get?
translation: 这...这难道是某种我没见过的文明礼仪？

original: Is thievery not considered wrong where you come from?
translation: 偷窃这种行为，难道在你来的地方一点也不可耻吗？

original: Is your need for possessions truly so great?
We're a tolerant community, but don't overstep the limits of our generosity.
translation: 我们本来很宽容，可你简直就是在挑战我们的底线！

original: This isn't a New Vegas back alley. Watch what you grab.
{"You, put that back!"}{KAH-too! PONE-gwaa day noo-AY-bu}Katu! Pongwa de nuevu!
translation: {"You, put that back!"}{KAH-too! PONE-gwaa day noo-AY-bu}尼！把那各放回去！

original: {misfortune comes to a thief}{Wah day-sa-for-TOO-ba YAY-gwee ah la-WAHT-ba!}Wa desafortuba yegwi a lawatba.
translation: {misfortune comes to a thief}{Wah day-sa-for-TOO-ba YAY-gwee ah la-WAHT-ba!}做贼妹有好下厂的。

original: {No! Thieving raccoon.}No! Shtay len tahbah mah ee.
Your mother would be ashamed of you.
There is nothing that comes free in this life, friend.
translation: 生活中没有免费的午餐，朋友。
别这样！你正在毁掉我的实验！

original: Don't take that! You'll ruin everything!
translation: 别碰那！你会毁掉一切的！

original: You there. Keep your hands off other people's property!
translation: 说你呐！别动别人的东西！

original: Are you daft? That doesn't belong to you.
translation: 你是蠢货吗？那不是你的东西。

original: Put that back, you big smelly mungo!
translation: 拿回来，你这难闻的大毛人！

original: Here's how we deal with robbers in Little Lamplight.
translation: 这是我们小灯镇处理抢劫者的方法。

original: You got a lot of nerve, coming in here and trying to rob us.
translation: 你真有胆量，敢进来抢劫我们。

original: You'd better run, you damn thief.
translation: 你最好快跑，你这该死的小偷。

original: Hey! What do you think you're doin'?
That's not yours, now is it?
Hey. What's the big idea? I don't mess with your stuff. Don't mess with mine.
translation: 嘿。想干什么？我没碰你的东西。你也别碰我的。

original: Fine. I'll kill you next time.
I accept. Do it again, and you're a corpse.
translation: 我接受。下次你再这么做就死定了。
威胁分析……绿色等级，解除。

original: I'm so relieved we can put that unpleasantness behind us.
translation: 我们能放下已经过去的不愉快真是让我松了一口气。
恭喜，那都是过去的旧账了。

original: Do that again and I'll put my foot so far up your ass you'll cough up boot polish!
translation: 你下次要还敢这么做我踢爆你的屁股！

original: Okay, okay. Let's just calm down...
translation: 好的，好的。让我们冷静一下……

original: Good. Perhaps there's some semblance of civility left in you, after all.
translation: 好。无论如何，或许你还有点文明人的痕迹。
下次就不会再这么走运了。

original: {confused - never had anyone surrender}Huh. I guess it's all right, then.
All right, but don't let it happen again!
You best not do that again.
All right, but don't let it happen again!
{annoyed}You're lucky we Followers tend to be forgiving.
translation: {annoyed}算你走运，我们天启追随者向来宽宏大量。

original: Hey! Keep your hands to yourself!
Try that again, you draw back a stump.
translation: 再试一次吧，你惹来麻烦了。

original: Keep your hands we're I can see 'em!
translation: 把你的手放在我能看到的地方！

original: Get your hands out of there!
What do you think you're doing?

translation: 找到什么你喜欢的了吗？

original: Get your hands out of my pockets.
translation: 把你的臭手从我口袋里拿开。

original: Wha? You out of your mind?
Are you out of your fucking mind?
You have a death wish or something?
Just like every other thieving mungo.
translation: 跟所有的毛人小偷一样。

original: There's a reason why we don't let mungos in here.
translation: 不让毛人来这，是有原因的。

original: Thought I wouldn't notice your fat fingers going through my pockets?
translation: 你以为我没察觉到你的肥手指插进了我的口袋里？

original: You think you can just come in here and take my stuff?
translation: 你以为能偷走我的东西吗？

original: You dirty sneak! Give me that back!
translation: 你这肮脏的小偷！把东西还给我！

original: You must think I'm pretty stupid.
Keep that up, you're gonna end up wearin' a collar.
translation: 继续，你终究会被戴上项圈的。

original: Really now. What are you thinking?
Are you stupid, you big shit-butt?
translation: 你是蠢货吗，你这大屎球？

original: What do you think you're doing? Stop that!
Hey! Only my bitches are allowed in my pants!
translation: 嗨！只有我的妞才能碰我的裤子！

original: You find anything you like in those pockets? Huh?
translation: 你在口袋里找到喜欢的东西了吗？呃？

original: Get your fuckin' hands out of my pockets.
Please keep your hands to yourself.
Damnit. Keep your hands to yourself!
If you wish to keep all your fingers, you'll keep them to yourself.
translation: 如果你还想保住手指，就老实点。

original: Kindly remove your grubby hands from my pockets.
translation: 请把你肮脏的爪子拿出我的口袋。

original: Get your fucking hands out of my stuff.
translation: 把你的爪子从我的东西上拿走。

original: Aw, baby. A little to the right. Hey, that's not my...why you little thief!
translation: 啊，宝贝。向右一点。嗨，那不是我的……你这该死的小偷！

original: What in God's name has gotten into you?
Did you just try to... pick my pocket? My God, son...
translation: 你刚刚想……偷我的东西？我的天啊，儿子……

original: Did you just try to... pick my pocket? My God...
translation: 你刚刚想……偷我的东西？我的天啊...

original: Is this how I raised you? To steal from me?
translation: 难道这就是我养育你的回报？从我这偷东西？

original: You want something? I'll give you something!
translation: 你想要？那我就给你点颜色看看！

original: Stealing from a King is a capital offense in Freeside.
translation: 在自由城偷猫王帮的东西可是重罪。

original: I thought I smelled a rat.
Crime detected. Death sentence authorized by judicial circuits.
translation: 发现犯罪行为，司法回路已授权执行致死性惩治。

original: It's a shame that you had to do that.
translation: 真遗憾你不得不这么做了。
侦测到未授权的物资征用行为。

original: The class of people I'm forced to associate with these days just keeps falling.
translation: 我最近被迫协助的那批人还是那么堕落。

original: Please tell me that you did not just do what I think you did!
translation: 请告诉我，其实你没有做坏事，一切都是我的想像！

original: Get the fuck away from me!
Hurt an old man, will ya?
Eh, you tryin' to drygulch me?
Tryin' to kick up a row, is ya?
Are you out of your mind?
Now there was no call for that!
translation: 现在这再也没有对于那些的要求了！

original: I'm sorry that you had to act that way.
translation: 我很抱歉你必须有这种下场。

original: I'm afraid that kind of behavior can't be tolerated.
translation: 很遗憾那种行为是不能被容忍的。

original: Antisocial behavior will not be tolerated.
That's hardly Marquess of Queensberry rules, now is it?
You'll pay for that, you cheeky bastard!
translation: 你要为此付出代价！你这个狗杂种！

original: What is your major malfunction, maggot?
You make me sick, you worthless scumbag.
{I've been hit!}{Wah GOAL-peh may}Wa golpe me!
translation: {I've been hit!}{Wah GOAL-peh may}窝被打中叻！

original: {I've been attacked!}{Wah ah-tah-CO may!}Wa ataco me!
translation: {I've been attacked!}{Wah ah-tah-CO may!}窝被袭鸡叻！

original: Are you out of your fuckin' mind?!
You dare assault a Brother of Steel?
translation: 你敢袭击一个钢铁兄弟会的成员？

original: Tangle with the Gun Runners and it's the last thing you'll do.
translation: 惹怒军火贩子，是你这辈子做的最后一件错事。

original: {irritated, angry, confused}What the hell are you doing?
You want to rock? Let's rock.
Get the fuck away from me.
You're not going to get away with that!

translation: 我们在那边发现了一个！

original: What the hell have you done?
Holy shit! Someone got themselves whacked.
I can't believe you'd do that!
translation: 我简直不能相信你做的一切！

original: Holy shit! You just killed them! Like, dead!
translation: 他妈的！你杀了他们！明白？死了！

original: What the? Damnit! You're going to pay for that!
translation: 什么？该死！你会为此付出代价的！

original: You won't get away with that!
We got ourselves a psychopath! Everyone stand clear!
translation: 我们抓到一个精神病患者！所有人都给我站好！

original: What?! Okay, you're ass is mine.
Hmm. Some people have no respect for the sanctity of life.
translation: 嗯，有些人根本不尊重生命。

original: What the hell? No one gets away with murder in my town!
translation: 这他妈是怎么了？没有凶手能从我的镇子里逃走！

original: My word. Was that truly necessary?
translation: 要我说的话。那真的是必须做的吗？

original: I think I'm going to be a trifle sick.
Ah! What did you have to go and do that for? Such a fucking waste.
translation: 啊！你做这些到底是为了什么？就为这他妈的垃圾。

original: You... you killed him. In cold blood...
You... you killed her. In cold blood...
{You killed him!}{KAH-too mah-TAH-na OOHD[rhymes with "dude"}Katu matanna ud!
translation: {You killed him!}{KAH-too mah-TAH-na OOHD[rhymes with "dude"}尼把他撒了！
{Oh no! A murder!}{NO-nah! Ah-seh-KEY-noo-na!}喔不！一个撒人犯！

original: Are you sick in the head or something?
What demon would possess you to do such a thing?
Are you suffering a brain fever? I have herbs that can curb such... violent tendencies.
translation: 你是不是头脑发热？我有些药膏...可以帮你治一下。
你会尝到苦头的，外来者！

original: Oh shit! Oh shit! Oh shit!
Dammit, that is going to stink.
Oh damn, that's going to leave a stain.
You think you'll just get away with that?

translation: 你会为此付出代价的，人渣！

original: I'm not gonna stand for that!
translation: 我可不会忍受这种暴行！

original: You're gonna get us in some serious shit.
Whoa! Whoa, whoa, whoa, boss, what the hell?
translation: 哇！哇，哇，哇，老大，搞什么啊？

original: Boss, you really think that's a good idea?
translation: 老大，你真觉得这是个好主意？

original: Oh, good, the boss is murdering people now. Excellent.
translation: 噢，很好，老大在滥杀无辜。太好了。

original: Going to run out of friends at the rate you're going.
translation: 你这么干会闹得众叛亲离的。
有时候，你真的是{emph}一个混蛋。

original: {Slight shock}Did you do that on purpose?
You shouldn't be so naughty, pumpkin!
translation: 你不该这么淘气，小南瓜！

original: No, no, no! Leo does the chopping, not you, dearie!
translation: 不，不，不！砍人让利奥来，你别这样，亲爱的！

original: That wasn't a nice thing to do!
What the hell is wrong with you?!
What in the hell are you doing?
You ain't getting away with that.
What in tarnation was you thinkin'?
You won't get away with that.
Hey! Why would you do that?
You're going to pay for that!
Crime detected. Judicial circuits recommend immediate application of capital punishment.
translation: 罪名成立。审判程序要求立刻执行死刑。

original: Crime detected. Application of death sentence commencing.
translation: 罪名成立。开始执行死刑。

original: Crime detected. Consulting judicial circuits... offender sentenced to death.
translation: 罪名成立。根据审判程序判决，罪犯判处死刑。

original: Even I know that was not a nice thing to do.
translation: 即使是我，也知道这不是一件好事。

original: Now I'm going to have to do the same to you.
translation: 现在我也要对你做同样的事了。

original: You'll understand that now I have no choice but to employ deadly force.
translation: 你要明白现在我别无选择，只能使用致命武器。

original: You are sentenced to death for the crime of murder.
Halt, lawbreaker! You are hereby sentenced to death for felony murder.
translation: 肃静！罪犯！你以谋杀重罪判处死刑！

original: Commencing judicial sanction for felony murder.
Dear me, how unsporting of you.
translation: 我亲爱的，你坏了规矩了。

original: I suppose I'm going to have to do something about that.
translation: 我想我得对此采取一些措施了。

original: You are the lowest form of commie scumbag I've ever had the misfortune to lay eyes on!
translation: 你是我不幸遇见过的最烂的垃圾共党！

original: You seem to need an object lesson in democracy!
translation: 你看起来需要好好上一节民主课！

original: I have a personal message for you from Uncle Sam!
translation: 山姆大叔让我给你带个口信！

original: I'm gonna eat your heart, you piece of shit!
translation: 我要挖出你的心肝吃掉，你这狗屎！

original: I'm staying out of this one.
Now that just wasn't called for.
I've seen worse things happen to better people.
translation: 好人没好报，我见的多了。
我可不想去扫这烂摊子。
没有人会惦记那家伙的。

original: You did what you had to do, son.
You did what you had to do, honey.
{Death comes when it wants.}{Wah moo-WEAR-nah YAY-gwee QUA-do wa KAH-day}Wa muerna yegwi cuado wa kaade.
translation: {Death comes when it wants.}{Wah moo-WEAR-nah YAY-gwee QUA-do wa KAH-day}史亡想来就来。

original: {a little annoyed}Strange how dead bodies appear wherever you go.
translation: {a little annoyed}奇怪啊，你到哪里，哪里就死人。

original: Honey. If you wanted it that badly, you could have just asked.
translation: 亲爱的。如果你那么想要，告诉我就行了。

original: Son. If you wanted it that badly, you could have just asked.
translation: 儿子。如果你那么想要，告诉我就行了。

original: You're not supposed to be here, are you?
translation: 你不该出现在这个地方，对吧？
{Fire in the hole!}{en-fee-AIR-noo AH-kee!}小心守雷！
{Take this grenade!}{TOO-noo grah-NAH-hoo}试试哲个手榴蛋！

original: {Rhonda voice}This one's for all my listeners!
translation: {Rhonda voice}把这献给我所有的听众！
{throwing grenade}<在你扔掷的时候嘟哝着。>小心，兄弟们！

original: Hot potato! Ha ha ha ha ha!
Cover your eyes, pumpkin, or you'll go blind!
translation: 快蒙住你的眼睛，小南瓜，要不然会瞎的！

original: You want to rock? Let's rock.
Oh crap, oh crap, oh crap, crap, crap!
translation: 哦，该死，哦，该死，哦，该死，该死，该死！

original: Yikes! The proximity of that was alarming!
{Under his breath}Kill this one before they call others.
translation: {Under his breath}把它干掉！不然它会召集更多同伴过来。
{Irritated}我说这地方怎么这么安静呢。
[克莉丝汀眯起双眼，改变了姿势。]

original: I'll fight you if I must!
Firing brainial beams and my spectral array of dissection lasers.
translation: 发射脑波射线以及我的切割激光！

original: We can do this if we all stick together!
translation: 只要我们齐心协力就能成功！

original: Here they come! Come on, let's kill them!
translation: 它们来了！上吧，杀了它们！

original: Oh shit. They're bigger than I remember.
translation: 哦，见鬼。他们比我记忆中还要大！

original: This is exactly how I always expected it to end.
translation: 这恰恰是我一直以来希望的结果。

original: Maybe we'd better run for it.

translation: {starting combat}又一个死人要记在我的名下了！

original: Get 'em, boss! I mean, if that fits with your schedule.
translation: 干掉他们，老大！我是说，如果您合适动手的话。

original: Don't worry, boss, with my cataracts you only sort of look like the bad guys.
translation: 别担心，老大，就算我老眼昏花，也不至于把你和敌人弄混。

original: Yeah, yeah, time for more fighting, I know.
translation: 好的，好的，又要战斗了，我知道。

original: {Irritated at fighting}Don't need this right now.
{Entering combat}I won't let you hurt my babies!
translation: {Entering combat}我不会让你伤害我的宝贝的。

original: I won't mess up this time.
I didn't want to do this!
You done ticked me off now.
You messed with the wrong bartender.
translation: 你不该招惹我这个酒保。

original: No respect for the elderly these days.
translation: 如今的人们都太不尊重长者了。

original: Looks like I'll have to fight!

translation: 噢，是吗？你他妈的死定了！

original: Hostile detected. Non-combatant safety can no longer be guaranteed.
translation: 发现敌人。非战斗人员生命安全将无法保证。

original: Threat analysis: red. Engaging hostile target.
translation: 威胁分析：高。敌对目标接近中。

original: I'm afraid my programming requires that I try to kill you now.
translation: 恐怕我的程序要求我现在要杀了你。
请不要认为这是针对你。

original: I'm sorry, sir, but you've forced me to utilize deadly force.
translation: 我很抱歉，先生，但是你的行为已经驱使我对你使用致命武力。

original: I'm sorry, ma'am, but you've forced me to utilize deadly force.
translation: 我很抱歉，女士，但是你的行为已经驱使我对你使用致命武力。

original: Attention. This is now a combat zone. You may suffer harm up to and including death if you remain in the area. This notice required by law.
translation: 请注意。这里现在是战区。如果你留在这个地方，你可能会受到伤害，甚至死亡。本通知为法律所要求。

original: Do not attempt to flee. Justice will be administered swiftly and fairly.
translation: 不要尝试逃跑。对你的审判将会被执行得既利落又公平。

original: Please stand clear. This is now a free fire zone.
translation: 请让开，这里现在是自由开火区。

original: Commencing lawful use of deadly force.
translation: 开始启动合法致命武力。

original: Ready to die for your country, you commie son of a bitch?
translation: 准备为你的国家送死吧，你们这些婊子养的共产党员？

original: Kill them all and let God sort them out!
translation: 把他们都杀了，让上帝做评判！

original: Every day is a good day to die!

translation: 准备战斗！兄弟们！准备战斗！

original: Ha ha ha ha! Let's play, little human!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！渺小的人类，来玩玩吧！

original: I'll wear your bones around my neck!
translation: 我要把你的骨头做成项链！

original: And now I will have my vengeance!
Now the prisoner is the executioner!
I'll kill every last one of you!
You're going to pay dearly for what you did to me!
translation: 你这样对我，我会让你为此付出沉重的代价的！

original: Prepare to be attacked by Dr. Mobius!
translation: 准备承受莫比乌斯博士的攻击吧！
{aggressive}{"Go to sleep now!"}{oo-WAY-ka doo-WEAR-may}快点碎觉吧！

original: {aggressive}{"Death comes for you!"}{moo-WEAR-nah YAY-gwee ah KAH-tu}Muerna yegwi a katu!
translation: {aggressive}{"Death comes for you!"}{moo-WEAR-nah YAY-gwee ah KAH-tu}史神为尼而来！

original: {aggressive}{"I am your killer!"}{may kah ah-seh-KEY-nay!}Me ka asekene!
translation: {aggressive}{"I am your killer!"}{may kah ah-seh-KEY-nay!}窝是尼的终结者！

original: *Blast it with our brainial beams already!*
translation: *已经用我们的脑波射线轰爆了它！*

original: Use of force has been authorized.
How many of those things are in here?
translation: 这里面有多少那种东西？

original: I'm gonna tear your fuckin' throat out!
translation: 我要扯开你那该死的喉咙！

original: Well now! This should be fun!
And here I thought I was going to have a boring day.
translation: 我还以为今天会过的很无趣呢。

original: Do you know who I am?
What luck! I was hoping I'd get to shoot an idiot today.
translation: 多幸运啊！我早盼着今天能打死个白痴。

original: If that's the way you want it...
translation: 如果这就是你所希望的……...

original: I didn't want to have to do this...
translation: 我一点也不希望这么做……...

original: No one fucks with the Stahl family!
translation: 没人能和斯塔尔家族作对！

original: You picked the wrong town to mess with, stranger.
translation: 要是想捣乱你可找错地方了，陌生人。

original: No quarter will be given, my friend.
translation: 我可不会手下留情，我的朋友。

original: I implore you, do not resort to violence!
translation: 我恳求你，不要诉诸武力。

original: I ain't gonna sew you back together.
I'm gonna fuck your shit up, kid.
translation: 我会把你干得屁滚尿流，小子。

original: Andy! I need help over here!

translation: 那是你最后的一次机会。

original: I knew you were trouble the second I laid eyes on you.
translation: 我从看见你那刻起，就知道你是个麻烦。
警报！警报！我们被袭击了！
兄弟们，那个女人是我的了！

original: Tell my mama I've done my best.
translation: 告诉我妈妈,我已经尽力了.

original: Pin my medals upon my chest.
Box me up and ship me home.
translation: 把我装进棺材用船运回家。

original: I just need to sit down for a second...
You're treading on dangerous ground. I suggest you split.
translation: 你试图进入危险地带。我建议你立刻离开。

original: You'd better get out of here if you know what's good for you.
translation: 如果你知道什么对你有好处，你最好离开这里。

original: You'd better get out of here.
I'm not warning you again. Leave now.
translation: 我最后一次警告你。快点离开。

original: Last warning. Get out of here.
You'd better get out of here.
I told you to leave. You'd better listen.
translation: 我叫你离开。你最好听劝。

original: You'd better get out of here if you know what's good for you.
translation: 如果你知道什么对你有好处，你最好离开这里。

original: Warning. Use of lethal force is authorized.
translation: 警告。已获得致命武器使用授权。

original: Warning. You are in violation of a security zone. Use of lethal force is imminent.
translation: 警告。你已侵犯安全区域。致命武力即将实施。

original: Warning. You have entered a security zone. Lethal force may be used without further warning.
translation: 警告。你进入了受保护的区域。再往前走，不经警告，就会对你使用致命武器。

original: Warning. Leave the security zone immediately or you may be fired upon without further warning.
translation: 警告。马上离开受保护的区域，否则你将在不经警告的情况下受到攻击.

original: I don't mean to be rude, but you're not allowed here. You'd better leave before I'm forced to take preventive measures.
translation: 我无意冒犯，但你不能进来。在我不得不采取预防措施之前，你最好离开。

original: You're still within the restricted area. I really do advise you to leave immediately.
translation: 你仍处在受限区域内. 我很郑重议你马上离开.

original: Perhaps you didn't hear me the first time. This is a restricted area. Please leave immediately.
translation: 或许你没听清我刚才说什么. 这是首先区域.请立刻离开.

original: I'm sorry, but you're not allowed here. I hope you won't turn this into an unpleasant situation.
translation: 很抱歉。但是你没有被允许来这里. 我不希望你让这转化成不愉快的结局.

original: I'm sorry. You've entered a restricted area. I may have to use deadly force if you don't leave immediately.
translation: 很抱歉。你已经进入了受限区域.如果你不马上离开的话,我将不得不使用致命武器.

original: Excuse me, sir, but this is a restricted area. Please leave immediately so we can remain friends.
translation: 对不起，先生，但这里是受限区域。如果你能立刻离开,我们将仍是朋友.

original: Excuse me, ma'am, but this is a restricted area. Please leave immediately so we can remain friends.
translation: 对不起，女士，但这里是受限区域。如果你能立刻离开,我们将仍是朋友.

original: Trespasser, be advised that deadly force will be used against you without further warning.
translation: 入侵者，现在告诉你，在不经警告的情况下,我们随时都会对你使用致命武器.

original: Leave the restricted area immediately. No further warning is required.
translation: 立刻离开受限区域。不会再一次警告你了.

original: This is a restricted area. You will be sanctioned with deadly force if you do not leave immediately.
translation: 这是受限区域。如果你不马上离开,你将受到致命武器的攻击.

original: You are now trespassing. Be advised that deadly force may be used against you.
translation: 你现在是非法侵入。请注意，可能会对你使用致命武力。

original: Warning. You are trespassing. You must leave immediately.
translation: 警告。你未经许可进入私人土地. 你必须立刻离开.
这里是不对外开放区域.

original: You had better remove yourself from this area before I am forced to declare you an enemy of the U.S. of A.
translation: 在我宣布你成为美军的敌人之前,你最好从这里消失.

original: This area is under the protection of the U.S. army. Remove yourself or be prepared to defend yourself.
translation: 这个区域受到美军的保护. 从这里消失或者准备迎接攻击

original: You're not allowed in here. Don't give me an excuse to use my weapon on you.
translation: 你没有被允许来这里. 不要给我一个攻击你的理由.

original: Do not push your luck any further.
I'll advise you again to leave immediately or I cannot be responsible for the consequences.
translation: 我再次建议你马上离开否则我将不会为后果负责.

original: You're taking your life into your own hands.
translation: 你的小命掌控在自己的手中。

original: You'd best git or I'll be in a pucker.
translation: 你最好快滚，不然我动手了。

original: Best be off right quick, pardner.
translation: 你最好马上转身离开，伙计。

original: Why don't you mosey along, pardner.
translation: 为什么你不到别处去晃悠呢，伙计。

original: You're not supposed to be here.
Stay the fuck away from here.
You'd better get out of here if you know what's good for you.
translation: 你自己心里清楚我找到你的后果！

original: You'd better get out of here.
That's close enough. The memorial is off limits.
translation: 离得太近了。纪念堂是禁止进入的。

original: No-one is allowed in the memorial.
Back off smooth-skin, unless you're looking for a fight.
translation: 退下，光皮肤。除非你自讨没趣。

original: We'd be more than happy to kill you smoothskin!
translation: 我们会非常乐意杀死你，光皮肤！

original: This area is under Outcast control. Back off now, or I'll be forced to open fire.
translation: 这区域受放逐者控制。退后，否则我将被迫开火。

original: Get out of here. You're not allowed.
Son, we should NOT be in here.
Honey, we should NOT be in here.
Them spoils is mine! You can't have 'em!
{suspicious}You're not really supposed to be here.
Uh uh. I don't think so.
This area is off limits, Outsider.
Get the fuck out of here.
This is where the road ends.
Guess you're not so good at hiding, huh?
translation: 我猜你不是捉迷藏的好手吧？
我就知道我会找到你的！

original: {"I knew it!"}{may sa-BA-loo ES-tee}Me sabaloo estee!
translation: {"I knew it!"}{may sa-BA-loo ES-tee}窝就知道！

original: The eye of Mobius sees you!
translation: 莫比乌斯之眼看到你了！

original: I'm gonna make mincemeat outta you.
Didn't get far enough, did ya?

translation: 发现敌人. 启动和谐处理机制.

original: Alert. Hostile detected. Lethal force authorized for all units.
translation: 警报. 发现敌人. 已授权针对任何单位使用致命武器.

original: I'm afraid I'm quite good at killing things. You may want to run now.
translation: 恐怕我很擅长杀人，你现在可能想跑了。

original: There you are! Were you trying to hide from me?
translation: 原来你在这儿呀! 你在尝试躲避我吗？

original: Didn't you hear me coming? Now I have to fight you. Bloody fantastic.
translation: 你没听到我来了吗？现在我得跟你打了，血腥味十足。

original: You must be bloody stupid if you can't hide from me.
translation: 如果你不能避开我,那就说明你是个大傻逼。

original: You're gonna learn how Uncle Sam deals with commie maggots!
translation: 让你知道我们美国人是怎么干死你们这些共产主义蛆虫的!

original: You are about to be introduced to the U.S. army!
Kill that son of a bitch!
You just made my day! Opening fire!
translation: 你只是我的垫脚石! 开火!

original: Looks like this is my lucky day.
translation: 看起来今天是我的幸运日.

original: Since you don't seem willing to do the world a favor and kill yourself, I guess I'm going to have to do it for you.
translation: 既然你不愿意以自杀作为献给世界的礼物, 我想我不得不帮你这么做.
啊，自投罗网的家伙在这呢。

original: AIGHH! THERE IT IS! KILL IT!
Think you could hide from me? Uh, again?
translation: 你以为可以躲过我？啊，又一次？
{Howl on the hunt}啊呜呜呜呜呜呜！

original: Just couldn't mind your own business...
translation: 你要是乖乖待着不就没事了吗…
[克莉丝汀做了个招呼你的手势，指向了某个地方]

original: Guess my eyes weren't playing tricks after all!
translation: 看样子我的眼睛还没坏！

original: Zombie, over there. I see you!
translation: 丧尸，在那边。我看到你了！
拿起武器！兄弟们！拿起武器！
已重新探测到敌人！红色警报！

original: I have positive ID on target.
So are you going to let me kill you now, or are you going to run away again?
translation: 你是等着现在被我杀掉，抑或要再次撒腿就跑？
我嗅到了你的恐惧，人类！

original: Threat analysis: yellow. Potential perimeter breach. Beginning sweep.
translation: 威胁等级分析：黄色。周围有潜在的侵害。正开始清除。

original: Alert. Hostiles may be in area. Non-combatants are advised to seek secure location until perimeter is secured.
translation: 警报。敌人可能在区域内。建议非战斗人员寻找安全位置直到周边已被确保安全。

original: Threat analysis: yellow. Beginning lethal force neutralization operation.
translation: 威胁等级分析：黄色。正开始破坏性武装压制工作。

original: Hello? Please step forward and introduce yourself.
translation: 你好？请上前自我介绍一下。

original: Is there someone there? I'd love to make your acquaintance.
translation: 有人吗？我很愿意成为你们的朋友。

original: Don't be shy. I'm always happy to make a new friend.
translation: 别害羞了。我总是乐于结交朋友。
探测到未经确认的入侵者。开始搜寻。

original: Approach and identify yourself. Law-abiding citizens will not be harmed.
translation: 过来表明你自己的身份。守法居民将不会受到伤害。

original: Is that someone who needs me to kick their ass?
translation: 有没有人要我去踢他们的屁股？

original: Move it out, people. I want this place searched top to bottom.
translation: 出发，各位。我要从头到脚搜索这个地方。

original: Who's ready to have their ass kicked?
translation: 谁准备好去踢他们的屁股了？

original: I'm going to go check it out.
Is there an outlaw skulking about?
translation: 是不是有掠夺者藏在那儿？
有什么不太安分的东西。
是谁躲在那儿？给我现身！

original: Hm? Thought I heard a sound...
translation: 呃？感觉刚才听到了什么声音……

original: Where the fuck did that come from?
translation: 那个声音他妈的是从哪里传来的？

original: Ah you think you can sneak up on ol' Roy Phillips, do you?
translation: 你以为能算计老罗伊·菲利普斯，对吧？

original: I'm going to go check it out.
What's that? It's a fucking zombie, isn't it.
translation: 那是什么？一只该死的丧尸，对吧？

original: This isn't happening. I'm dreaming. I must be dreaming!
translation: 这不可能会发生。我肯定在做梦。我肯定在做梦！

original: You can't hide forever. I'll get you sooner or later.
translation: 你躲不了一世。我迟早会找到你。

original: Who's there? Don't make me come find you, now!
translation: 谁在那？别逼我把你揪出来，现在就滚出来！

original: Whoa, whoa. Shut the fuck up a second. I hear something.
translation: 哇，哇。把你这臭嘴闭上一分钟。我听见了什么。

original: {slight concern}{"What was that?"}{Kay ES-tee nah?}Ke estee-na?
translation: {slight concern}{"What was that?"}{Kay ES-tee nah?}辣是甚么？

original: Who the fuck is out there?

translation: 威胁等级分析：绿色。保持原状。

original: Threat analysis: green. Resuming standard patrol pattern.
translation: 威胁等级分析：绿色。重新开始标准巡逻模式。

original: Threat analysis: green. Security sweep canceled.
translation: 威胁等级分析：绿色。取消安全清扫。

original: Oh well. Maybe next time you'll introduce yourself.
translation: 哦，好的。可能下次你会自我介绍。

original: Why did you run away? I'm really not as scary as I look.
translation: 你为什么逃跑？我真的不象看起来那么可怕。

original: You shouldn't tease me like that.
Back to the usual daily tedium.
translation: 回到习以为常的乏味日志。

original: Thought as much. Nothing there after all.
translation: 仔细想想。那里根本没有什么东西。

original: Beastly nuisance. Glad that's done with.
translation: 很恶劣的事。真高兴已经搞定了。

original: Another glorious day in the U.S. army.
translation: 美军又一个辉煌的日子。

original: Nothing I like better than a little R&R on Uncle Sam's dime.
translation: 没有什么比山姆大叔摇骰子更让我开心的了。

original: Ah, just getting jumpy I guess.
Whatever it was, I guess it's gone now.
translation: 不管刚才是什么，我想现在它都走了。

original: Whatever. I've got better things to do.
translation: 随便吧。我有更重要的事要做。

original: Seems my ears is playin' tricks on me.
translation: 好像是我的耳朵骗了我。

original: Well I'm confounded. Must've been the wind.
translation: 好吧，我搞错了。肯定是风吹的。

original: Well I'm stumped. Guess it was nothin'.
translation: 是我搞错了，看来什么都没有。

original: I've got better things to do.
Need to stop jumping at shadows.
translation: 还是别一惊一乍的好了。

original: Whatever it was, it's gone now.
translation: 不管是什么，现在应该都走了。

original: Scared me there for a second.
God dammit... I guess it's nothin'.
Fine. I'll catch you next time.
translation: 很好。下次我会逮到你的。

original: Yeah that's right, I'd run away, too.
Whatever. I've got better things to do.
translation: 随便吧。我有更重要的事要做。

original: Ah, just getting jumpy I guess.
I must be going as crazy as ol' Rex.
translation: 我肯定是和老雷克斯一样疯了。

original: I think it's gone somewhere else!
translation: 我想它到其他地方去了！

original: This can't be happening. This just can't be happening.
translation: 这不可能发生。这绝不可能发生。

original: Ears play tricks on me again.
translation: 我的耳朵又在瞎折腾了。

original: {confused}{"I guess I'm hearing things."}{es-COO-choo NAH-na, may su-PON-goo.}Escuchu nana, me supongoo.
translation: {confused}{"I guess I'm hearing things."}{es-COO-choo NAH-na, may su-PON-goo.}窝感觉挺到了什么。

original: Huh. Maybe I need some glasses that aren't two hundred years old.
translation: 呵。估计我得找一副不那么古老的眼镜来戴戴了。

original: {Giving up, didn't see anything after all}Leo's playing tricks again.
translation: {Giving up, didn't see anything after all}利奥又在拿我们开涮了。

original: Guess it was just in my head.
translation: 估计只是脑海里的幻觉。

original: Oh my God. I can't believe that just happened.
translation: 哦，我的天啊。我不敢相信会发生这种事。
哎呀，我很高兴一切都结束了。
哎呀，我很高兴一切都结束了。

original: {Good kill, my friend}Goot keel, ahk iss.
translation: {Good kill, my friend}打得嚎啊，朋油。

original: I didn't think you had it in you.
translation: 我觉得你根本不够没那个胆。

original: Looks like I run them off.
Guess they threw up the sponge.
Fucked you up, bitch! And you know it!
translation: 干死你，贱人！这下你知道厉害了！

original: Teach you to mess with me.
Well, that's the end of that.
Threat analysis: green. Neutralization operation complete.
translation: 威胁等级分析：绿色。清除工作完成。

original: Threat analysis: green. Security operation successful. Resuming normal operation.
translation: 威胁等级分析：绿色。安全工作成功。继续正常工作。

original: Hostiles neutralized. Recommend immediate repairs to primary systems to ensure continued operation.
translation: 敌人已清除。建议立刻维修主要系统以保证后续工作。

original: I'm sorry it had to end this way.
translation: 我很抱歉它必须以这种方式结束.

original: I'll always remember you. My memory circuits have almost unlimited capacity.
