original: It won't be easy. My father sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from following your dad.
translation: 这不容易。我父亲把大门关闭了，以阻止其他人效仿你父亲。

original: Well, when you put it that way... maybe I could use your help.
translation: 嗯，如果你这么说的话……或许我可以接受你的帮助。

original: Good. Now will you shut up and listen to me for a second?
translation: 很好。你现在是否可以闭上嘴，安静地听我说话了？

original: There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这个密码进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。

original: Not another one of your "plans," Amata...
translation: 我不需要你的什么所谓的“计划”，阿玛塔……

original: I don't have time to explain everything. You're just going to have to trust me this time.
translation: 我没时间跟你解释了，这次你必须要相信我。

original: Listen. There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。就像我经常干的。

original: I just have to break into the most heavily guarded place in the Vault? That it?
translation: 我必须要突破避难所里防守最为严密的地方？就这样？

original: If you have a better plan, let's hear it! Look, I know for a fact that the office isn't guarded -- everyone's out looking for you.
translation: 如果你有更好的办法，我洗耳恭听！你看，我知道办公室肯定没人，因为所有守卫都出去找你了。

original: Here, you'll probably need these to pick the lock on the office door. They've always worked for me.
translation: 给，你很有可能需要他来撬开办公室的门锁。以前我都是这么干的。

original: Access his computer to open the door to the tunnel -- you'll either have to hack it or find his password. I know he hides it in his office somewhere.
translation: 用他的电脑打开通往地道的门 — 你要么破解电脑，要么找到密码。密码肯定藏在办公室的某个地方。

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: So while I'm doing all this breaking and entering, you're helping me... how?
translation: 那么在我撬门闯入办公室时，你……怎么帮我？

original: I'll be keeping my father from catching you hacking into his computer.
translation: 我会拖住我的父亲，这样你就可以有足够的时间入侵电脑了。

original: Here, you'll probably need these to pick the lock on the office door. They've always worked for me.
translation: 给，你很有可能需要他来撬开办公室的门锁。以前我都是这么干的。

original: Access his computer to open the door to the tunnel -- you'll either have to hack it or find his password. I know he hides it in his office somewhere.
translation: 用他的电脑打开通往地道的门 — 你要么破解电脑，要么找到密码。密码肯定藏在办公室的某个地方。

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: Sure am. Stopped in to find something to do.
I hope by "something to do" you mean a job, otherwise you want to talk with Nova.
translation: 我希望你所谓的“找事做”是指工作，否则你还是去找诺瓦吧。

original: I'm looking for someone to make a delivery. Interested?
translation: 我正好需要找个人帮我捎个东西，感兴趣吗？

original: We hope you've enjoyed our tour today. If you have any further questions, please take a brochure from our helpful Vault-Tec guides.
translation: 我们希望你对今天的参观感到愉快。如果你还有什么其他问题，请向避难所科技向导索取指南手册

original: Should the unlikely event arise that the planet is laid to waste, you'll feel happy knowing your family will be safe in a Vault-Tec Vault.
translation: 如果有什么不幸的事使这星球变成废墟，你将会感到很高兴避难所科技的避难所将会庇护你和你的家人。

original: Concerns about security? Our Eye-On-You Cameras enable the Vault's leader to watch your every move. You'll never be alone again!
translation: 担心安全问题？避难所的领导会通过监视牌摄影机注视你的一举一动，你将永不孤单。

original: Bored? Don't be! Step into our Entertainotron Room and watch the latest holotapes or perhaps listen to a symphony. Another Vault-Tec innovation!
translation: 无聊？不会的！去我们的娱乐室看最新的全息录影带，也可以听听交响乐。另一项避难所科技的革新！

original: Moms will love how our Culinator 3000 Kitchen System makes cooking a breeze. Mmmmm, I can smell the muffins baking now!
translation: 母亲们肯定会爱上这烹调3000厨房系统，它可以让做饭变得十分简单。嗯……，我都已经可以闻到烤甜饼的香味了！

original: The living sections make use of our revolutionary Floorsuck Autocleaner System for those darned messy kids. Never sweep again!
translation: 我们的生活区将使用革命性的楼层自动清洁系统，这系统是为那些可恨肮脏的孩子们而设计的。从此再不用打扫卫生了！

original: Being underground got you down? Smile! Our SimuSun Lighting mimics the feeling of being outside with only a fraction of the sunburn potential.
translation: 在地下待着感觉很糟？呵呵！我们的微阳灯让你仅有少量晒伤的情况下拥有在户外的感觉。

original: Sleep in quiet comfort knowing that our impenetrable vault doors can withstand a direct hit by an atomic bomb with only a projected 2% failure rate.
translation: 安心的睡吧，我们的避难所大门可以承受住核弹的直接冲击，而且失败率只有2%。

original: Triple-S Technology is Vault-Tec's convergence of the three most important parts of apocalyptic endurance: Safety, Survivability and Sanitation!
translation: 三重科技是避难所科技三项最重要的科技的集中体现，这三项科技是：安全性，生存性和卫生性！

original: Vault-Tec welcomes you to our new line of subterranean vaults featuring our patented Triple-S Technology.
translation: 避难所科技欢迎你到地下来体验我们的三重科技。

original: Haven't we been through this already?
translation: 我们之间的问题难道还没解决吗？

original: Nope. No one knows his name, where he comes from -- nothin'. He's a mean little bastard for sure.
translation: 没有。他叫什么，从哪来，没人知道。但我肯定他是个混蛋。

original: He'd be a Paladin by now for sure, except that he ain't got no interest in leadin'. Only killin'. I'm just glad he's on our side.
translation: 以表现而论他已经能成为圣骑士了，只不过他只喜欢杀戮，对带队不感兴趣。我很高兴他和我们是一路的。

original: Oh man, there's something wrong with that boy. Ain't nobody around here that even knows his real name.
translation: 哦，老兄，那家伙肯定有病。这的人没人知道他到底叫什么。

original: We got a betting pool in the pride, whole pot goes to the first person who can find out his real name.
translation: “里昂斯的骄傲”有一个赌约，谁先知道他的真名谁就可以拿走所有的钱。

original: I don't talk to most of them. Billy says that I have to be careful, even when people seem nice. And I'm especially not allowed to talk to Mr. Jericho.
translation: 我跟他们绝大部分人都不怎么说话。比利告诉我说要小心点，即使那些人看上去是好人。并且别人跟我说绝对不要和耶利哥先生说话。

original: I usually play with Harden most days, when his dad isn't taking him out to learn to shoot or something.
translation: 我一般跟哈登在一起玩，通常他爸爸总是让他学习射击什么的。

original: Billy says that he's going to teach me to shoot one day too!
translation: 比利告诉我，他也会找个时间教我怎么射击！

original: There's the Stahls. They run the Brass Lantern. I go there to eat with my dad sometimes. Doc Church runs the clinic.
translation: 有斯塔尔一家。他们经营黄铜灯。我有时候和我爸爸在那吃饭。丘奇医生经营一家诊所。

original: The Confessor is a little weird. But him and mother Maya are always nice to me.
translation: 忏悔者那人有点怪。但是他和玛雅修女总是对我很好。

original: There's also Moriarty, but dad says that I'm not allowed to talk to him.
translation: 这还一个叫莫里亚蒂的人，但是爸爸不让我跟他讲话。

original: What do you think of Megaton?
It's great! My dad says that one day, I'm gonna get to be sheriff, just like him!
translation: 这儿棒极了！我爸爸说过，总有一天我也会成为这儿的警长，就像他那样！

original: A long, long time ago, he saved me from Raiders!
translation: 很久很久以前，他把我从掠夺者手中救了出来！

original: They... killed my real parents. But Billy showed up before they got me, and now he's like my daddy... sort of...
translation: 他们……杀了我的亲生父母。但是比利在他们杀我之前出现了。现在，他就像是我父亲一样……

original: My dad, of course. He teaches me to shoot, and about the law, and keeping people safe. When he's not busy protecting the town, that is.
translation: 当然是我父亲照顾我。他教我怎么射击，还教我法律，怎么保护他人。只要他不忙着保护镇子，总是在教我。

original: Well... with my dad gone, I don't really know... dad always said that I'd have to learn to watch out for myself one day...
translation: 嗯……在我父亲死以后，我真不知道谁能照顾我……爸爸以前总是对我说总有一天我要学会怎么照顾自己……

original: *Sigh* It's one thing after another in this place, isn't it? Anyway, I should get going.
translation: *叹气*在这地方事总是没完没了，对吧？不管怎样，我得走了。

original: You know, I thought about moving once. Setting myself up in Rivet City or one of the smaller settlements. But hey, this place is home.
translation: 你知道，我一直想要搬家的。想去铆钉城或一些小型定居点。但是，嗨，这是我的家。

original: Megaton needs a stronger defense force. Okay, there's Simms and Steel, and the town militia, but half of us can't even aim straight.
translation: 兆吨镇需要一个强力的防御力量。好吧，这有西姆斯和斯蒂尔，还有镇兵，可是半数人都不会瞄准。

original: I was rooting around in Springvale the other day and guess what I found: a book! An actual book! Can you believe it?
translation: 我有一次跑到春之谷，你猜我发现什么了：一本书！一本真正的书！你能相信吗？

original: Do you ever question the wisdom in hanging around an atomic bomb all day? I mean, if it was going to blow, it probably would have by now. But still.
translation: 你曾怀疑过这种整天围着一个核弹的行为吗？我的意思是，如果要炸的话早就炸了。

original: God, that Jericho guy gives me the creeps. He's such a nutjob.
translation: 天啊，那叫耶利哥的家伙让我觉得恶心。他就是一个白痴。

original: I swear to God, if Nathan starts babbling about the Enclave to me one more time... everyone knows that the Enclave is just a story for kids.
translation: 我向天发誓，如果内森再和我胡说一些关于英克雷的事的话……每个人都知道英克雷不过是个谣传而已。

original: Nathan and his damn Enclave, I tell you... What, does he think, that George Washington is going to ride out of the Wasteland to save everyone?
translation: 内森还有他那该死的英克雷，我跟你说……他在想些什么，乔治·华盛顿要拯救废土所有人？

original: You ever hear of the Enclave? Nathan tells me that they'll be riding in here any day to help us...
translation: 你听说过英克雷吗？内森说他们很可能会过来帮助我们……

original: Did you hear about the Enclave? Nathan said they're really the U.S. government. He says that they're coming to help us.
translation: 你听说过英克雷吗？内森说他们是真正的美国政府。他说他们要来这帮助我们。

original: Walter sure is a grumpy old bastard. But he keeps that crusty old plant running, so I guess we have no choice but to put up with him.
translation: 沃尔特确实是一个脾气暴躁的老混蛋。但是他是照看着那些老水管，所以我们不得不忍。

original: Busted up my knee the other day, so I went to see Doc Church. He needs to work on his bedside manner -- my own mother never chewed me out like that!
translation: 那天我把膝盖摔坏了，所以我就去找丘奇医生。他需要改善一下对待患者的态度 — 就连我的母亲都没有像他那样严厉的训斥我！

original: I swear to God, Moira's crazy. She sold me this thing the other day, I didn't even know what the hell it was. Damn good saleswoman though. Damn good.
translation: 我发誓，莫伊拉是个疯子。她有一天把这卖给我，我甚至都不知道那东西是什么。该死的女人。真该死。

original: What is with those Church of the Atom lunatics anyway? They're all fucked in the head... drinking the bomb water, praying for another war?
translation: 原子教堂是怎么回事？里面的人是不是都疯了……估计是喝核弹旁的水太多了，居然祈祷另一场战争？

original: Manya and Nathan are both gone... what's happening around here?
translation: 曼雅和内森都走了……这地方出了什么事？

original: With Walter dead, we're screwed. No one else can keep that treatment plant running.
translation: 沃尔特死后，我们就完蛋了。没人能继续经营这。

original: Can't say that there's much going on.
Look, I told you people: I'm busy. Leave me alone.
translation: 听着，我跟你们说过：我正在忙，离我远点。

original: I'm bored. Let's see if I can lighten things up around here.
translation: 我很无聊。我看看这周围有什么能让大家激动一下的不。

original: What happened to the other kids from the Pitt?
translation: 那其他从匹兹堡来的孩子怎么样了？

original: All of 'em became Initiates. Most of them went on to become Brothers. A lot fell in action.
translation: 都成了新兵。大部分加入了兄弟会。很多倒在了战斗中。

original: I'm the only survivor of the Scourge of the Pitt still stationed at the Citadel.
translation: 我是唯一一名来自匹兹堡天谴、现在仍然在五角大本营驻守的人了。

original: That was before I knew how boring it was.
translation: 那是在我知道这有多无聊之前。

original: Then you don't have to hear it. The hell with you.
translation: 你可以不听，该死的家伙。

original: Huh? I'm sorry, are you still talking?
Hey, you wanted to hear it.

translation: 他们到底有什么可怕的？

original: The rivers. Even after the war, they were still flowing, but irradiated, and filled with God knows what else.
translation: 那些河流。战后，它们仍流动着，但都被辐射了，而且鬼知道里面还有些什么。

original: I saw things there I can't even begin to describe. I was only... what... eight years old when I left? Hell of a thing for a kid to go through.
translation: 我看到过一些东西，不知道该怎样形容。我离开时只有……大概……八岁左右？让孩子经历这些，真是见鬼。
我正在找一个逃跑的奴隶。

original: We've got slavers! Grab your guns!
Let's make it 300 caps and you have a deal.
translation: 加到300个瓶盖，我们就成交。

original: Well, it would bring more people in here if I had it on display I suppose.
translation: 嗯，我想如果把它作为展品，将会吸引更多的人到这来。

original: All right. You got it. 300 caps.
translation: 好吧。你得到它了。300个瓶盖。

original: Well, it would bring more people in here if I had it on display I suppose.
translation: 嗯，我想如果把它作为展品，将会吸引更多的人到这来。

original: All right. You got it. 300 caps.
translation: 好吧。你得到它了。300个瓶盖。
当然，200个瓶盖听起来不错。

original: This is the most I ever paid for a hunk of wood and strings, but what the hell.
translation: 这是我为一块木头和几根弦而付出最多的一次，但这该死的算什么。

original: This is the most I ever paid for a hunk of wood and strings, but what the hell.
translation: 这是我为一块木头和几根弦而付出最多的一次，但这该死的算什么。

original: That's Lincoln. Hannibal found it. He wants to put it back. I don't really understand why.
translation: 那是林肯，先生。汉尼拔找到了它，他想再把它物归原位，先生。我并不清楚这是为什么。

original: That's Lincoln, ma'am. Hannibal found it. He wants to put it back, ma'am. I don't really understand why.
translation: 那是林肯，女士。汉尼拔找到了它，他想再把它物归原位，女士。我并不清楚这是为什么。

original: That's Abraham Lincoln, the Great Emancipator. We don't know how it came to be here, but it's fitting, don't you think?
translation: 那是亚伯拉罕·林肯，伟大的奴隶制废除者。我们不知道它是怎么到这来的，但这非常合适，你觉得呢？

original: Haven't you been listening? That's Abraham Lincoln, the Great Emancipator.
translation: 你没有在听吗？那是亚伯拉罕·林肯，伟大的奴隶制废除者。

original: God damn rookie. That's Lincoln. He freed some slaves a long time ago.
translation: 该死的新人，那是林肯。他在很久以前解放了奴隶。

original: If you want to know more, come listen to Hannibal give his speech. He does it right after the noon meal.
translation: 如果你想知道得更多，来听听汉尼拔的演讲吧。午餐后演讲就开始。

original: What are a bunch of escaped slaves doing holed up here?
translation: 一群逃亡的奴隶躲在这做什么？

original: We are the only hope for runaway slaves everywhere.
translation: 我们是流落各地的逃亡奴隶的唯一希望。

original: Rivet City, and the Citadel can't be bothered with helping slaves. They turn a blind eye.
translation: 铆钉城和五角大本营也懒得帮助奴隶。他们对此视而不见。

original: We are the only ones willing to stand against Paradise Falls and slavery.
translation: 唯有我们想要与堕落天堂和奴隶贩子抗争。

original: Why do you stay here? Why not keep running?
translation: 你们为什么留在这？为什么不继续逃跑？

original: I could get rid of the Super Mutants, if there are any.
translation: 如果有超级变种人的话,我可以帮你搞定他们。

original: What!? They must have found out our plans somehow.
translation: 什么！他们一定已经知道我们的计划了。

original: We are truly grateful for your intervention.
translation: 我们衷心感谢你的介入。

original: Talk to Caleb. He'll need your help. We can't leave unless he's ready too.
translation: 和卡勒布谈谈。他需要你的帮助。在他准备好之前我们不能离开。

original: I found Slavers guarding the Memorial. They're all gone now.
translation: 我发现一些奴隶贩子守卫着纪念堂，现在他们都不在了。

original: Slavers? Dear God. They must know about our plans.
translation: 奴隶贩子？上帝。他们一定知道了我们的计划。

original: Do whatever you have to do to make the Memorial site safe for my people.
translation: 为了我的人，请你一定要尽力保障纪念堂的安全。

original: Before you leave, speak with Caleb. He'll need your help too.
translation: 在你走前和卡勒布谈谈，他需要你的帮助。

original: Don't worry about the Super Mutants. Slavers are in control of the Memorial.
translation: 不用担心超级变种人，奴隶贩子已经控制了纪念堂。

original: Soldiers? Slavers more likely. Dear God. They must know about our plans.
translation: 士兵？更像是奴隶贩子，上帝。他们一定知道我们的计划了。

original: Do whatever you have to do to make the Memorial site safe for my people.
translation: 为了我的人，请你一定要尽力保障纪念堂的安全。

original: Before you leave, speak with Caleb. He'll need your help too.
translation: 在你走前和卡勒布谈谈，他需要你的帮助。

original: Don't worry about the Super Mutants. Soldiers are in control of the Memorial.
translation: 不用担心超级变种人，士兵已经控制了纪念堂。

original: I was hoping you would help us. The Memorial is easy to find. Good luck.
translation: 但愿你可以帮我们，纪念堂很容易找到。祝你好运。

original: One other thing. Talk to Caleb. He'll need your help. We can't leave unless he's ready too.
translation: 还有件事，和卡勒布谈谈。他需要你的帮助。在他准备好之前我们不能离开。

original: I solemnly swear to protect the Temple of the Union.
translation: 我庄严宣誓会保护联合圣殿。

original: Welcome, brother, to the Temple of the Union!
translation: 欢迎兄弟，欢迎来到团结圣殿！

original: Our home is your home. Your past is your own affair, so long as you serve our common good.
translation: 我们的家就是你的家。你的过去是你自己的隐私，你只需要好好为我们服务就行了。

original: As a symbol of our trust, here is a key to the gate.
translation: 作为赢得我们信任的标志，赐予你大门的钥匙。

original: Welcome, sister, to the Temple of the Union!
translation: 欢迎，姐妹，欢迎来到团结圣殿！

original: Our home is your home. Your past is your own affair, so long as you serve our common good.
translation: 我们的家就是你的家。你的过去是你自己的隐私，你只需要好好为我们服务就行了。

original: As a symbol of our trust, here is a key to the gate.
translation: 作为赢得我们信任的标志，赐予你大门的钥匙。

original: Reilly's Rangers, huh? Never heard of you.
translation: 莱莉的游骑兵，呃？从没听说过。

original: You been stuck living in a vault the last decade or something?
translation: 你过去十年都窝在避难所里还是怎么？

original: We're guns for hire; the best merc group in the Capital Wasteland. If you need something done in there, you seek us out.
translation: 我们是能雇佣的利器。首都废土上最好的佣兵团。如果你有需要的话，来找我们好了。

original: I don't cut anyone slack. Deal with it.
translation: 我不会替人收拾烂摊子的，再见。

original: Nice that you pick on bed-ridden people. That how you get your jollies? Does it make you feel tough?
translation: 选上手无缚鸡之力的人，真不错。这就是你找乐子的方式吗？这会让你感觉自己很强吗？

original: If you want to hear me out, then shut the hell up. If not, get out of my face.
translation: 你要是想听我说话，见鬼，先闭上你的嘴。如果你做不到，那就给我滚。

original: If time wasn't so precious right now, I wouldn't be so on edge either. I need to get help for the rest of the Rangers, and fast.
translation: 如果不是事态紧急，我也不会这么焦躁。我要为剩下的游骑兵寻求帮助，赶快。

original: My apologies. I didn't know who you were.
translation: 我道歉。我不知道你究竟是谁。

original: That's okay, kid. Don't sweat it. The Wasteland's a big place.
translation: 好的，孩子。别担心，废土的确广阔。

original: We're guns for hire; the best merc group in the Capital Wasteland. If you need something done in there, you seek us out.
translation: 我们是能雇佣的利器。首都废土上最好的佣兵团。如果你有需要的话，来找我们好了。

original: Whoa, whoa. Calm down! Who are you?
I'm sorry. The name's Reilly. Yeah, THE Reilly as in Reilly's Rangers.
translation: 我很抱歉。我的名字叫莱莉。嗯，莱莉的游骑兵里的莱莉。

original: So this is the Lincoln Memorial?
I can't wait to see the Great Emancipator turn into a smoking pile of rubble.
translation: 我简直等不及了，我要看着伟大的解放者变成一堆冒烟的废渣。

original: It's the Lincoln Memorial. This Lincoln guy supposedly freed all the slaves before the bombs dropped.
translation: 那是林肯纪念堂。这叫林肯的家伙理应在核弹落下前解放所有的奴隶。

original: So the pussies built a Memorial to him.
translation: 所以这娘娘腔为他建了个纪念堂。

original: It's got our slaves thinking that they can be free too.
translation: 这搞得我们的奴隶们也妄想能获得自由。

original: Please, sit back, relax and free yourself from the bonds of our planet as we take off for the stars! [bzzzzt!]
translation: 坐下，放松。把自己的精神从肉体的禁锢中解脱出来，好像飘然升天一样！[扑哧！]

original: To understand why man is so interested in this unknown expanse of space around our little world, we must take a journey.
translation: 要了解人类为什么会对环绕我们小小世界的广阔宇宙如此感兴趣，我们需要踏上旅程。

original: For as long as history has been recorded, man has had an insatiable hunger for knowledge regarding the universe.
translation: 从有史可溯开始，人类对探索宇宙的渴求就永无穷尽。

original: Air feels all fucked up tonight. I think a storm's comin'.
translation: 今晚的天气真是糟透了，我猜可能风暴要来。

original: These rookies kill me sometimes. Monsters... heh...
translation: 这帮新人有时真是让我想死。怪物……呃……

original: That's what I said! After a couple hours, we just put a cap in him to get him to shut up.
translation: 那就是我说的！几小时后我们用一颗子弹堵了他的嘴，看他还怎么喊。

original: Monsters? They probably got their asses handed to 'em by some Wastelanders and ran home like a bunch of pussies.
translation: 怪物？他们恐怕早就被那些废土游民打怕了，像娘们一样滚回窝里去了吧。

original: Those fuckin' morons... they ran into some kind of trouble up there. One of 'em came back last night, screamin' about monsters or some shit.
translation: 那群该死的白痴……他们在那遇到了麻烦。其中的一个昨晚回来了，嚷嚷着什么怪物之类的，见鬼。

original: No, but this sounds like it'll be good.
Yeah, yeah. Keep runnin' your mouth, asshole. Keep fuckin' with me, and I'll be your worst nightmare.
translation: 嗯，嗯。继续胡说吧，混蛋。如果你再对我胡说，我他妈就会是你做过最可怕的噩梦。

original: Get back here, you fucking coward!

translation: 嗨！不要把我一个人留下来！

original: I'm just looking for a place to rest, and maybe do some trading.
translation: 我只想找个地儿歇脚，或者做点交易。

original: Hannibal says I gotta let folks like you in, but that don't mean I have to like it.
translation: 汉尼拔说我应该允许像你这样的人进来，但那不意味着我就会喜欢这么做。

original: Keep your hands in sight and don't make any sudden moves.
translation: 把你的手放在我能看见的地方，别做出任何突然的举动。

original: I'm coming down to open the gate.
Maybe. How much is it worth to find these slaves for you?
translation: 可能。为你找到这些奴隶能得到多少钱？

original: I'm only interested in the leader, Hannibal Hamlin. You find him, and I'll pay you 100 caps.
translation: 我只对领导者感兴趣，汉尼拔·哈姆林。找到他，我会付给你100个瓶盖。

original: His trail leads east from Paradise Falls. He's going to try and claim this memorial, so this is the one place I know I can find him.
translation: 迹象表明他跑到堕落天堂东面去了。他会试图夺取这纪念馆，所以我知道在这能找到他。

original: Don't kill him yourself. Just find out where he's holed up, and I won't have to wait for him.
translation: 别杀了他。找出他躲在哪就好，这样我就不必干等了。

original: Not around here, but there is a group of them up north near Old Olney.
translation: 不在这，但他们中有一群跑到老奥尔尼北面去了。

original: Now, that's just wrong, isn't it? We're from Paradise Falls, and we've been looking for those runaways.
translation: 那是错的，对吧？我们是从堕落天堂来的，我们一直在找那些逃跑的家伙们。

original: We'll have to go and take care of that little group of rebels. You can come watch if you want.
translation: 我们得走了，我们得看着这一小股反叛者。如果你想的话也可以来看看。

original: Whether you do or don't, I'm looking to hire a wastelander for a small job.
translation: 不管你干不干，我都得找个废土游民来干。

original: I need someone to bring me some items from a nearby ruin. Are you interested?
translation: 我需要有人到附近的废墟去弄点战利品。你有兴趣吗？

original: I put a bullet right between Ted Strayer's eyes. <Lie.>
translation: 我把一颗子弹射入了泰德·斯崔尔的眉心。<撒谎>

original: So, the Ghoul hater got what was coming to him. Good riddance.
translation: 那僵尸仇视者得到了他的报应。干得漂亮。

original: Here's your caps. I'll take that key.
translation: 这是你的瓶盖。钥匙归我了。

original: Excellent! That will be a lesson for all the Ghoul haters out there.
translation: 真精彩！那会为所有僵尸仇视者上一课。

original: Here's your payment for the key.
translation: 这是你取回钥匙的报酬。

original: Dukov is dead. I blew his brains out. <Lie>
translation: 杜克夫死了。我把他头盖骨都打飞了。 <撒谎>

original: Serves him right. He won't be spreading lies about Ghouls any more.
translation: 他活该。他不会再散布那些关于僵尸的谎言了。

original: I'll take that key, and here are your caps.
translation: 钥匙归我了，而这些瓶盖是属于你的。

original: Dave's head popped like a zit. <Lie>
translation: 戴夫的脑袋就像一颗青春痘一样炸开了。 <撒谎>

original: Have you got what I want?
Marvelous! My list is growing shorter.
translation: 真不可思议！我的名单越来越短了。

original: Here's Strayer's key. Shot in the head, just like you asked.
translation: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。一枪爆头，像你要求的那样。

original: Not much of a shot, eh? I couldn't kill Jeff, but I got his son. That will have to do.
translation: 没能爆头，嗯？我杀不了杰斐，但是我干掉了他儿子。这就够了。

original: Here's your caps. I'll just take that key.
translation: 这是你的瓶盖。钥匙归我了。

original: Here's Strayer's key. He's dead, but not from a shot to the head.
translation: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。他已经死了，不过不是爆头。

original: That wasn't the plan. I suppose I have to pay for the key anyway though.
translation: 计划可不是这样的。但我想我仍要为这钥匙付钱。

original: Here's Strayer's key. But I'm afraid he's still alive.
translation: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。但是我恐怕他还活着。

original: So long as I get that key, I don't care.
translation: 只要我拿到了钥匙，其他的我不在乎。

original: Here's Strayer's key. But I'm afraid he's still alive.
translation: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。但是我恐怕他还活着。

original: May his soul rot! This is great news.
translation: 愿他的灵魂腐烂！这真是好消息。

original: I'll take that key as a memento. Here, take your caps.
translation: 我会把这钥匙留作纪念。给，拿走你的瓶盖。

original: Dukov is dead, with a head shot, and here's his key.
translation: 杜克夫死了，一枪爆头，这是他的钥匙。

original: Well, better dead than alive I suppose.
Take your caps. I'll take that key.
translation: 拿着你的瓶盖。钥匙归我了。

original: Here's Dukov's key. He's dead, but not from a shot to the head.
translation: 这是杜克夫的钥匙。他已经死了，不过不是爆头。

original: I thought I told you to kill him? That rat bastard is still alive!
translation: 我想我告诉过你要杀了他？那混蛋还活蹦乱跳着呢！

original: I'll pay for the key, but you really screwed up!
translation: 我会为了钥匙付你钱，但你把事搞砸了！

original: Here's Dukov's key. I got it without killing him.
translation: 这是杜克夫的钥匙。我没杀他就拿到了。

original: Who cares? I've got his key. That's all I really want.
translation: 谁在乎？我拿到了他的钥匙。那才是我想要的。

original: Here's Dukov's key. I got it without killing him.
translation: 这是杜克夫的钥匙。我没杀他就拿到了。

original: Yes, yes, yes! Another bigot bites the dust.
translation: 好，好，好！又一个偏执狂玩完了。

original: I'll just take that key, and you can take these caps.
translation: 钥匙交给我，这些瓶盖你拿着。

original: Here's Dave's key. One shot, right through the brain.
translation: 这是戴夫的钥匙。一枪，直接穿过脑袋。

original: I suppose I have to pay you anyway since you brought back that key.
translation: 我想，怎么说我也得为你拿回了钥匙而付钱。

original: Here's Dave's key. He's dead, but not from a shot to the head.
translation: 这是戴夫的钥匙。他已经死了，不过不是爆头。

original: I'll pay you for the key, but I'm very disappointed.
translation: 我会给你钥匙当作报酬，但我很失望。

original: Here's Dave's key, but he's not dead.
translation: 这是戴夫的钥匙，不过他还没死。

original: All I care about is the key... which I'll take now.
translation: 我唯一在乎的只有钥匙……它现在归我了。

original: Here's Dave's key, but he's not dead.
translation: 这是戴夫的钥匙，不过他还没死。

original: I'll get someone to burn this.
translation: 我会找个人来把它烧了。

original: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
translation: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

original: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
translation: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

original: I'll get this burned right away.
We will enshrine this right away.
translation: 我们会立刻把它悬挂起来。

original: You've got a deal. Here you go.

translation: 我找到汉尼拔·哈姆林了。

original: I guess I owe you some caps.
I'll gather up the boys and we'll go collect him. You can meet us there if you want.
translation: 我会把兄弟们集中起来去抓住他。如果你愿意的话，你可以在那和我们碰头。

original: Actually, I already know he's up north, near Old Olney.
translation: 事实上，我知道他，就在北面，该死的老奥尔尼那。

original: Very clever. Well, I guess I owe you some caps.
translation: 很机灵。好吧，我想我欠你瓶盖了。

original: Scanning for valid ticket... verified. Thank you for riding with Metro.
translation: 扫描票的有效性……核实。欢迎你乘坐地铁。

original: I know! No one understands me either!
translation: 我知道！也没人能理解我！

original: God! It's so nice to have someone who understands! I mean, sure, when I left Little Lamplight, I was happy to be out of there.
translation: 天啊！能得到别人的理解可真好！我是说，当然，当我走出小灯镇时，我非常开心能够离开那里。

original: I was dating Pappy then, you know. I got here and he was like "Big Town will be safe", but it wasn't! This place is always under attack!
translation: 那时我正在和帕匹约会，你知道。我到这时他一副“大镇很安全”的样子，但根本不是！这里一直遭到攻击！

original: But I don't date liars, so I dumped his ass and got with Flash. But that didn't last very long. Me and Timebomb were a thing for a while, too.
translation: 但我不会和一个骗子约会的，所以我甩了他跟福莱斯一起走了。但那并没有持续很久。我又和“定时炸弹”好过一阵。

original: Oh! You... you... ... ...no one understands me... *sniff*
translation: 噢！你……你……没人能理解我……*气呼呼的*

original: I'm sorry... erm... Bittercup. What were you saying?
translation: 对不起……喔……“苦杯”。你说什么？

original: Finally! Someone who doesn't judge me! You know, the people here are just so quick to assume that they know everything about you.
translation: 终于！来了个不评判我的人！要知道，这里的人总是飞快地认定他们已经了解了你的一切。

original: I mean, like, just because I look different doesn't mean that I'm some sort of freak, you know? It's like, hello, this world sucks!
translation: 我是说，就像，我看上去不一样并不意味着我就是个怪物，你懂吗？就好象，这世界疯了！

original: No one gets that, they're all like "blah blah blah blah blah, what's wrong with that girl?".
translation: 没人会理解，他们只会觉得“哎哎哎，那女孩又怎么了”。

original: Finally! Someone who doesn't judge me! You know, the people here are just so quick to assume that they know everything about you.
translation: 终于！来了个不评判我的人！要知道，这里的人总是飞快地认定他们已经了解了你的一切。

original: I mean, like, just because I'm different doesn't mean that I'm some sort of freak, you know? It's like, hello, this world sucks!
translation: 我是说，就像，我看上去不一样并不意味着我就是个怪物，你懂吗？就好象，这世界疯了！

original: No one gets that, they're all like "blah blah blah blah blah, what's wrong with that girl?".
translation: 没人会理解，他们只会觉得“哎哎哎，那女孩又怎么了”。

original: Bittercup? That's the dumbest name I've ever heard!
translation: “苦杯”？这是我听过的最蠢的名字！

original: No one understands me. You're just like all the others around here.
translation: 没人能理解我。你和这里其他人一样。

original: I've got a game you can play. It's called "Hide and Go Fuck Yourself."
translation: 你可以玩玩我这游戏。它叫“自己他妈的躲起来。”

original: Shut up! Shut up! Shut up!
Once upon a time, there was this robot...
translation: 很久很久以前，有一个机器人……

original: His name was Joking Joe, and he went all around making everyone laugh really hard at all his funny jokes...
translation: 他名叫玩笑乔，他游历四方，用他那有趣的笑话来给所有人带来欢乐……

original: And one day a giant ant came up to him and started talking like he wasn't some dumb ant, but a person of some kind! It said, "Prepare to die!"
translation: 一天，巨蚁来到他面前开始讲话，不像不会说话的蚂蚁，倒像个人类。它说，“准备去死吧！”

original: And was our brave hero scared? No. Not at all, he laughed in the face of danger... "Ha ha ha!" He beat up the monster and everyone cheered!
translation: 我们勇敢的英雄害怕了吗？不。完全没有，他笑对威胁……“哈哈哈！” 他打倒了怪兽，所有人都在为他欢呼！

original: And what did our hero do, you wonder. He came up with the most cleverest of clever plans... and it worked! And everyone called him a genius!
translation: 我们的英雄做了什么，你根本想不到。他在所有聪明的办法里挑出了最聪明的那……而且很有效！所有人都称他为天才！

original: Um... yeah... I got lots of caps! But they, um, they're at Big Town, so I can give them to you when we get there. Yeah!
translation: 嗯……是的……我有很多钱！但它们，嗯，它们在大镇，所以只要我们到了那，我就能付你钱了。耶！

original: Take me to Big Town and you'll get your reward. My girlfriend Red has lots of caps.
translation: 带我到大镇你就会得到你的报酬。我的女朋友瑞德有很多钱。

original: I'll wait for you outside, unless you want to go now?
translation: 我会在外面等你，除非你现在就想走？

original: You got any caps? I'll escort you to Big Town, but it'll cost you.
translation: 你有盖子吗？我能送你去大镇，不过你要付报酬。

original: Well, I guess you can have this. It's the money I was saving to buy medicine for the town's people.
translation: 嗯，我想你可以拿走这些。这是我用来为镇里的人们买药的钱。

original: I know you've already risked your life once already, but I heard the Mutants talking about another attack. They'll probably be here soon...
translation: 我知道你已经冒过一次生命危险了，但我听说变种人正在策划另一次攻击。他们可能很快就会到这来……

original: I saved your life. This is all I get? Surely you can spare a little more.
translation: 我救了你的命。你就给我这么点？你还是再拿多点来吧。

original: I'm not allowed in Little Lamplight anymore.
Only people under 18 get to live in Little Lamplight.
translation: 只有18岁以下的人才能住在小灯镇里。

original: So, when you're done with those little kids, we can go to Big Town together! I'll wait outside for you.
translation: 那么，当你搞定这帮小鬼的事后，我们就能一起到大镇去了！我会在外面等你。

original: Fine. I'll take you to Big Town. But first I need to visit Little Lamplight.
translation: 好的。我会带你去大镇。但我要先在小灯镇周围看看。

original: Right. Of course. Rescuing me was a job to you, and you're a real professional.
translation: 好吧。当然了。援救我是你的工作，而你是个真正的专家。

original: Well, here you go. I wish I had more I could give you.
translation: 好吧，给你。我希望可以给你更多。

original: You are planning on giving me a reward for rescuing you, right?
translation: 我救了你会有报酬的，对吧？

original: Hey you. Yeah you! Don't bother with the children at Little Lamplight. Let's go to Big Town instead!
translation: 嗨，你。就是你！别跟这帮小灯镇的小鬼混了。我们还是到大镇去吧！

original: Please refrain from disturbing our other residents.
translation: 请不要干扰到其他居民。

original: Please do not disturb the other residents. Take your seat.
translation: 请不要打扰其他的居民，请就座。

original: Please take a seat in the nearest available Tranquility Lounger. Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: 请就座于最近的宁静巷催眠舱。谢谢你的合作。

original: Here, take my BB Gun. You don't need to be scared of the Roaches now.
translation: 给，拿着我的BB枪。这样你就不用怕那些蟑螂了。

original: Wow, where'd you get that? Okay, okay. Maybe I can do this.
translation: 哇喔，你从哪弄到的？好的，好的。或许我能办到。

original: Alright. I'm gonna go back in there and kill those damn roaches. Thanks!
translation: 好吧。我要回去干掉那些该死的蟑螂了。谢谢！

original: This would squish those little buggers real nice. Okay, okay. Maybe I can do this.
translation: 这会把那些小虫子打扁的。好的，好的。或许我能做到。

original: Alright. I'm gonna go back in there and kill those damn roaches. Thanks!
translation: 好吧。我要回去干掉那些该死的蟑螂了。谢谢！

original: Here, take my Baseball Bat. Now you can handle the Roaches on your own.
translation: 给，把我的棒球棒拿去。现在你可以自己对付那些辐射蟑螂了。

original: Good morning? What the hell is wrong with you?
translation: 早上好？该死的你怎么了？

original: Come again, come again. Any truckers on this wave?
translation: 重复，重复。这波段上有人吗？

original: I read you, buddy. Y'all see those clouds? Over.
translation: 我收到了，伙计。你们都看到那些云了吗？完毕。

original: 10-4, it's the commies. Let's circle the wagons, meet us at the state line on Route Seven.
translation: 10-4，是共党。提高戒备，我们在州际线的第七站上见。

original: You got a deal -- I'll pass the word along on my way. Over and out.
translation: 好的 — 我会把这些话沿途转告的。完毕。

original: I read you, buddy. Y'all see those clouds? Over.
translation: 我收到了，伙计。你们都看到那些云了吗？完毕。

original: 10-4, it's the commies. Let's circle the wagons, meet us at the state line on Route Seven.
translation: 10-4，是共党。提高戒备，我们在州际线的第七站上见。

original: You got a deal -- I'll pass the word along on my way. Over and out.
translation: 好的 — 我会把这些话沿途转告的。完毕。

original: You would do well to side with my employer in this little matter. Life could otherwise become quite unbearable for you.
translation: 在这次事件中，你最好站在我老板这边。如果你不这么做，会有大麻烦。

original: I told Simms I'd disarm it. Maybe some extra caps would change my mind...
translation: 我告诉了西姆斯我会解除它。或许一些额外的瓶盖会令我改变心意……

original: Indeed. A man's word is worth his weight in caps. I suppose I could arrange for a bonus of say, 500 caps in addition to the base fee.
translation: 确实如此。一诺千金。我想我可以安排一些奖励，比如，在原价上再加500个瓶盖。

original: When it's done, meet me at Tenpenny Tower. It's southwest of here, well out of harm's way. You can't miss it. Any questions?
translation: 搞定后来特佩尼大厦见我。它在这的西南方，一个很安全的地方，你不会找不到的。还有问题吗？

original: Have you thought about disarming the bomb?
translation: 你有想过去解除核弹吗？

original: Oh, I couldn’t do that! It’d be a real blow to those nice folks in the Church.
translation: 哦，我不能那么做！那可是会把教堂里的那些好人气疯的。

original: Besides, it’s not like that bomb ever hurt anyone. Live and let live, right?
translation: 还有，那核弹看上去并没有伤害到任何人。我们相互忍让，不是吗？

original: Righto. And be quick about it! I haven't been dry in years. I'd hate to start now.
translation: 好的。动作快点！我近年来都没有这么口干过。现在我开始讨厌了。

original: I've never seen any place like this.
translation: 我从没有见过像这样的地方。

original: I'm not going to just take your word for it. I want that key.
translation: 我可不信空口无凭的话。我要那钥匙。

original: I'm not going to just take your word for it. I want something of his as proof.
translation: 我可不信空口无凭的话。我需要一些他的东西来证明。

original: Um... I didn't bring back any proof.
translation: 呃……我没有带回来什么证据。

original: Sure. Take it. I don't have any use for it.
translation: 当然。拿着它吧。它对我没用了。

original: Ah! My trophy. You've earned your reward.
translation: 啊！我的战利品。你赢得了你的报酬。

original: Hmm. I guess you were telling me the truth.
translation: 嗯。我想你告诉我的是真的。

original: Okay. I believe you. Here's your money.

translation: 奥利斯特·特佩尼已经死了。

original: Damn! He's the one I most wanted to die by my hand. At least he's dead somehow.
translation: 该死！他是我最想亲手杀死的家伙。至少他已经死了。

original: Here. I'll give you 25 caps for the news, but I'm not going to pay you to kill a dead man.
translation: 给，为这消息我给你25个瓶盖，但我不会为杀了一个死人而付你报酬的。

original: I don't care. All I want is that damn key. No key, no caps.
translation: 与我无关。我想要的只有那该死的钥匙。没钥匙，没瓶盖。

original: I've got bad news. Ted Strayer is already dead.
translation: 我有个坏消息。泰德·斯崔尔死了。

original: I don't believe you. Give me some proof, a ring, a key, something.
translation: 我不相信你。给我点证据，一枚戒指，一把钥匙，或者其他的什么。

original: I've got bad news. Ted Strayer is already dead.
translation: 我有个坏消息。泰德·斯崔尔死了。

original: I shouldn't be surprised. The way he lived it was bound to happen sooner or later.
translation: 我不感到惊讶。他迟早要会那样。

original: All you have to do now is bring me his key. No key, no caps.
translation: 你现在要做的只是把他的钥匙给我带来。没钥匙，没瓶盖。

original: I hate to admit this, but Dukov is already dead.
translation: 我不得不承认，杜克夫死了。

original: I shouldn't be surprised. The way he lived it was bound to happen sooner or later.
translation: 我不感到惊讶。他迟早要会那样。

original: Wait. How do I know you aren't lying? I want proof. Some personal object of his. No proof, no caps.
translation: 等一下。我怎么知道你不是在撒谎？我要证据。一些他的私人物品。没证据，就没钱。

original: I hate to admit this, but Dukov is already dead.
translation: 我不得不承认，杜克夫死了。

original: Really? That bastard finally bit it?
Such is life. Do you have his key? No key, no caps.
translation: 这就是生命。你拿到他的钥匙了吗？没钥匙，没瓶盖。

original: Um... Dave is kind of... Well, he's dead.
translation: 呃…… 戴夫已经…… 好吧，他死了。

original: Really? That bastard finally bit it?
Wait a minute. You could be lying. You got something of his as proof? No proof, no caps.
translation: 等一下。你可能是在撒谎。你拿到什么关于他的东西做证据？没证据，就没钱。

original: Um... Dave is kind of... Well, he's dead.
translation: 呃…… 戴夫已经…… 好吧，他死了。

original: Janet snapped. She killed Martha in cold blood. Look at this rolling pin.
translation: 珍妮特崩溃了。她冷血地杀害了玛莎。看看这擀面杖。

original: Oh my God, what is that? Is that blood? And... brains?
translation: 噢，上帝啊！那是什么？是血吗？还有……脑浆？

original: Janet did this to Martha? She really did snap, didn't she?
translation: 珍妮特对玛莎做了这种事？她真的疯了，对吗？

original: Look at this. It's her rolling pin, covered in blood. Martha's blood.
translation: 看看这。这是她的擀面杖，上面全是血。玛莎的血。

original: My God... Did she really kill Martha? She's lost her mind!
translation: 我的天……她真的杀了玛莎？她疯了！

original: Martha Simpson is dead, and Janet killed her! Look, here's her rolling pin...
translation: 玛莎·辛普森死了，是珍妮特杀了她！看，这是她的擀面杖……

original: I mean, I know she was upset, but I thought she was over it. How could she do this?
translation: 我是说，我知道她很生气，但我以为她已经放下了。她怎么会这么做？

original: What's this... Women's clothing? Down here?
translation: 这是什么……女人的衣服？在下面？

original: It's your basement, lady. You tell me.
translation: 这是你的地下室，女士。这得你来说。

original: This isn't mine. Why would Roger have this down here?
translation: 这不是我的。罗杰怎么会把这东西放在下面？

original: You freak! You're going to eat me, aren't you?
translation: 你这怪物！你要吃了我，不是吗？

original: There's plenty of body parts laying around, why don't you eat those instead?
translation: 这地方丢着那么多的尸块，你为什么不吃它们呢？

original: Not fresh! Not warm! Taste old.
translation: 不新鲜！不够热！尝起来很老。

original: I hope you choke on my bones!
translation: 但愿你被我的骨头梗死！

original: Hahaha! Not your tiny bones, little man! Grrrraaaahhhh!
translation: 哈哈哈！你那小细骨是没用的，小人！嗷~~~！

original: Oh God. Kill me quickly, I beg you!
translation: 噢，上帝啊。快点杀了我吧，求求你了！

original: We'll stick with you, don't worry!
translation: 我们会紧跟着你，别担心！

original: I'll just hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 我希望你知道自己在做什么。

original: There it is! We're almost there! Come on! Yiiipppiiieee!
translation: 就是那！我们就快到了！加油！呀~~~~！

original: What's in it for me if I risk my neck for you?
translation: 为了你去拼命，我能得到什么好处？

original: Spoken like a merc. You sound like me when I was just a kid starting out in the business.
translation: 你的口气像个佣兵。你说话的口气真像我小时侯刚刚出道时的样子。

original: Okay hotshot, how about a full suit of Ranger Armor? It's the best combat armor in the Wasteland.
translation: 好吧，硬汉，一整套的游骑兵装甲怎样？那可是全废土最棒的战斗装甲。

original: Or if that doesn't do it for you I'll set you up with a minigun from our armory. Either way, you walk away with something.
translation: 如果你不喜欢那个，我会给你从我们军火库里弄一把多管机枪。无论如何，我们不会亏待你的。

original: I don't know, Reilly. This sounds like suicide.
translation: 我不知道，莱莉。这听起来简直像自杀。

original: Look, I don't know where else to go. In the shape I'm in, I'll be lucky to get ten feet.
translation: 听着，我不知道还能去哪。就我这样，运气好的话我还能走出10英尺。

original: I'll sweeten the deal for you, maybe it'll help. How about I set you up with a suit of Ranger Armor if you get them back?
translation: 我会给你点优惠，这可能对你有帮助。如果你把他们救回来，我就为你一整套的游骑兵装甲怎么样？

original: If that doesn't do it for you I'll set you up with a minigun from our armory. Either way, you walk away with something.
translation: 如果你不喜欢那个，我会给你从我们军火库里弄一把多管机枪。无论如何，我们不会亏待你的。

original: So that leaves them up there. How come you're here?
translation: 既然留下了他们。你是怎么到这来的？

original: My bad idea I'm afraid. I had a Stealth Boy which allowed me to slip off the roof unnoticed. The plan was to get back to get some help.
translation: 我恐怕这不是一个好主意。我有隐身小子可以让我偷偷溜下楼顶。计划就是由我回去求援。

original: I was almost at the street when a Super Mutant jumped me. Damn near ripped my arm off in the process.
translation: 当我就要跑到街上时，一个超级变种人拦住了我。该死的差点轰飞了我的胳膊。

original: Last thing I remember was falling into a culvert. Now I'm here. Some rescue attempt, huh?
translation: 我最后记得的事是我掉进了一个管道里。现在我在这了。有人救了我，呃？

original: What did you need from me?
Get the Rangers home. Please. That's all I want. I don't care how you do it.
translation: 把游骑兵带回家。拜托。那就是所有我想要的。我不在乎你怎么完成。

original: Look, I couldn't care less about your stories.
translation: 听着，我对你的故事毫无兴趣。

original: Fine. Since you're all business and obviously don't give a damn about human life, I got a proposal for you.
translation: 好吧。既然你明显只关心你的生意，而他妈的对人命毫不在意，我有个建议。

original: You want to hear it, or you gonna keep flapping your lips?
translation: 你是准备听听看，还是继续胡说八道？

original: Last stand? Well, we hoped not. We figured we'd get up there and get a better signal to radio the Brotherhood of Steel for help.
translation: 最后一搏？嗯，但愿不是。我们希望能够到上面找到一个无线电信号相对更好的位置，好联络钢铁兄弟会来寻求援助。

original: Problem is, help never arrived. Vernon Square is so thick with the Super Mutants, I don't think they could slip through.
translation: 问题是，援助始终没有来。弗农广场上到处都是超级变种人，我不认为他们能够通过那。

original: Trapped yourself at the top of a tall building. Brilliant.
translation: 把自己困在了高楼顶上。你可真是个天才。

original: Look, I don't know what your problem is, but I got three guys alone out there with an army of Super Mutants around them.
translation: 听着，我不知道你有什么问题，但我有三个兄弟被一支超级变种人的部队困在外面。

original: Either help me by listening, or get the hell out of my sight. I'm not here to be judged by you or anyone else.
translation: 你要么听我说，要么给我滚蛋。我来这可不是为了让你或任何人评论的。

original: Now, like I was saying, we had to fight our way up towards the roof of the Statesman.
translation: 就像我说的，我们得杀到政要酒店的楼顶。

original: Very bad move, but we had no choice.
translation: 确实是错着，但我们没得选了。

original: On the way we lost Theo, one of my guys. We were unable to get the ammo case off of his body as we were pushed onwards.
translation: 在途中我们失去了一个兄弟，西奥。在那种极端情况下，我们没办法把弹药箱从他身上取下来。

original: So, guns almost dry, we hit the roof of the Statesman.
translation: 就这样，弹尽粮绝，我们终于杀到了政要酒店的楼顶。
这跟求援有什么关系？告诉我整件事的经过。

original: Do you mind if I try and revive her?
translation: 你介意让我来尝试一下把她救活吗？

original: Unless you're an expert at medicine, I wouldn't recommend it. You may end up doing more harm than good.
translation: 除非你是个医学专家，否则我可不推荐这么做。你最终可能会把事情弄得更糟。

original: However, I'm all for helping my patients, so if you think you have the ability, be my guest.
translation: 无论如何，我所希望的只是能对病人有所帮助，所以如果你认为自己有那能力，请自便吧。

original: Do you think there's any way to revive her?
translation: 你认为有什么把她救活的途径吗？

original: Well, I wouldn't recommend it. She's in some sort of coma. It's dangerous to force someone out of one.
translation: 嗯，我不推荐这么做。她正陷于某种程度上的昏迷。强行把她弄醒是很危险的。

original: There's no telling when she'll come out of it I'm afraid.
translation: 她什么时候能醒恐怕我也不知道

original: How did she end up in the Chop Shop?
translation: 她是怎么跑到排骨店来的？

original: She was just brought in by a few others. They found her bleeding to death at the entrance to the city here.
translation: 她是被其他人带来的。他们在这城市的入口处发现了几乎失血致死的她。

original: If she'd been out in the tunnels any longer, she'd have been someone's meal by now.
translation: 如果她在外面的隧道里再耽搁一会儿，她现在早就变成什么东西的大餐了。

original: She had multiple lacerations, contusions, broken leg, some internal bleeding and blunt force trauma.
translation: 她身上有多处撕裂和挫伤，腿也断了，而且还有内出血和严重的瘀伤。

original: She hasn't been conscious since they brought her in a few days ago.
translation: 自从几天前他们把她带回来后她就一直昏迷不醒。

original: I'd say she tangled with some Super Mutants and lost. It's a miracle she isn't dead.
translation: 我估计她一定是遇到了一些超级变种人，而且打输了。她没有死可真是个奇迹。

original: Oh, you must be new around here.
They're a mercenary company that bases itself out of the D.C. Ruins. I'm assuming she's their leader, Reilly.
translation: 他们是一支扎根在特区废墟的佣兵团。我猜她就是他们的领袖，莱莉。

original: What was left of her armor had her name stenciled on it. She was in a pretty bad way when they found her outside Underworld.
translation: 她护甲左边刻着她的名字。他们在地下城外发现她时，她可真是糟透了。

original: Yeah, she's fine. They patched her up and she's resting in Underworld.
translation: 嗯，她很好。他们为她做了包扎，而她现在则在地下城休息。

original: That's a relief. I told her she was nuts when she decided to try to sneak out of here. Guess I was wrong. Now, let's talk about getting out of here.
translation: 真是令人宽心的好消息。当她决定要逃出这的时候，我告诉她这简直是疯了。我猜是我错了。现在，我们来谈谈我们怎么离开这吧。

original: I would have proposed going back the way you came, but apparently it's impossible now.
translation: 我得到的建议是，从你来的那条路回去，但很显然，现在这不可能了。

original: So, the express elevator is our only solution.
translation: 高速电梯就是我们唯一的途径。

original: No time for chatter. I'm here to get you guys out.
translation: 没时间闲聊了。我来这是把你们这帮家伙救出去的。

original: Hang on there. First, I need to know if Reilly is okay. I assume she made it somewhere if you're here.
translation: 等一下。首先，我得知道莱莉怎么样了。我猜如果你在这的话，她应该也活下来了。

original: No time for chatter. Let's get out of here.
translation: 没时间闲聊了。我们离开这。

original: Hang on there. First, I need to know if Reilly is okay. I assume she made it somewhere if you're here.
translation: 等一下。首先，我得知道莱莉怎么样了。我猜如果你在这的话，她应该也活下来了。

original: Just you? You made it up here alone?
translation: 只有你？你完全是孤身一人到达了这？

original: Ok, I'm impressed. Reilly must have sent the right person for the job... as usual. Hey, is she okay?
translation: 好的，我确实印象深刻。莱莉真是派对了人……就像往常一样。嗨，她还好吗？

original: Hmmm, and you made it all the way up here alive?
translation: 唔，这一路你竟然活下来了？

original: Ok, I'm impressed. Reilly must have sent the right person for the job... as usual. Hey, is she okay?
translation: 好的，我确实印象深刻。莱莉真是派对了人……就像往常一样。嗨，她还好吗？

original: How do I know they're still alive?
translation: 我怎么知道他们还活着？

original: Before I left I gave them an order to keep broadcasting for help over their radio.
translation: 在我离开前，我下令让他们持续通过无线电来寻求帮助。

original: Hopefully, when you get near their location, you'll pick it up.
translation: 如果顺利的话，当你到达接近他们的位置时，你会收到讯号。

original: How can I get there from Underworld?
translation: 我怎么从地下城到那去？

original: Your best bet is to stay with the Metro tunnels. Head north from here to Metro Central. Then look for the tunnels to the Dupont Circle Station.
translation: 最好的办法是通过地铁隧道过去。从这往北走到地铁中心去。然后再找到去杜邦环岛地铁站的隧道。

original: Exit from Dupont Circle Station into what we call the Dry Sewers and eventually you'll wind up in Our Lady of Hope Hospital.
translation: 从杜邦环岛地铁站出来就到了我们称为干燥的下水道的地方，而最终你将到达玛利亚医院。

original: Can you think of anything that will help me get there?
translation: 你有什么办法帮我到达那儿吗？

original: We have a headquarters not far from here.
translation: 我们在离这不远的地方有个指挥部。

original: If you can make it there, you are welcome to anything you need inside. Just punch in Reilly0247 at the gate.
translation: 如果你能到那，里面的东西任你拿。只要输入Reilly0247就能进入。

original: We have ammo, supplies, you name it.
translation: 我们有子弹，补给，随便你怎么称呼。

original: What can you tell me about Vernon Square?
translation: 你能和我说说弗农广场吗？

original: If I wasn't asking for your help, I'd tell you to stay away. It's thick with Super Mutants. I don't know why.
translation: 如果不是我需要你的帮助，我会让你离我远点。那到处都是超级变种人。我也不知道为什么。

original: Butcher, our team medic, has always suspected something's in the area they are looking for or being attracted to.
translation: 我们的医生布彻，一直认为他们在这区域寻找某样东西，或是被什么所吸引。

original: The only place worse I can think of is the Mall.
translation: 我唯一能想到比那更糟的地方就是商业区。

original: There's something about this area. I can't put my finger on it, but just like the Mall, there's an unusually high concentration of Super Mutants.
translation: 这区域很古怪。我没办法说得再清楚了，但就像商业区一样，那里超级变种人的数量多得不寻常。

original: If I had the time and resources, I'd investigate. All I care about now is getting the hell off this damn roof.
translation: 如果我有时间和资源，我会去进行调查。但现在我所关心的就只有怎么离开这该死的楼顶。

original: The other guys hate mappin' this zone, but hey, I love it. I love turning the 'Muties into a fine, red mist with my gun.
translation: 其他人讨厌来绘制这区域的地图，可是，嗨，我非常喜欢。我简直爱死了用枪把变种人变成一团红色血雾了。
你的桌子摆得下200个瓶盖吗？

original: Now that's what I'm talking about!
You just bought yourself a motherfucking key.
translation: 你刚给自己买了把他妈的钥匙。

original: Now take it and get the hell out of here.
translation: 现在，拿着它该死的给我滚。

original: Now that's what I'm talking about!
You don't even know what's going on, do you clown shoes? Ha! You just bought yourself a motherfucking key.
translation: 你甚至不知道怎么回事，小丑？哈！你刚给自己买了他妈把钥匙。

original: Now take it and get the hell out of here.
Here's 200 caps. Give me something to "prove" I killed you.
translation: 给你200个瓶盖。给我一些“证据”来证明我杀了你。

original: You can give me the key, or I can take it. Your choice.
translation: 你可以把钥匙交出来，或者让我动手。你自己选。

original: You got some big brass ones, you know that. And fuck me if I don't think you could do it.
translation: 你真够无耻，你知道的。如果我不把你当回事，我就他妈的是个傻瓜。

original: Here. Take it. Now go fuck yourself before I change my mind.
translation: 给。拿着。现在，趁着我还没改变主意赶快滚吧。

original: You got some big brass ones, you know that. And fuck me if I don't think you could do it.
translation: 你真够无耻，你知道的。如果我不把你当回事，我他妈就是个傻瓜。

original: Here. Take this key. It's all he really wants anyway. Now go fuck yourself before I change my mind.
translation: 给。拿着这钥匙。这才是他真正想要的。现在，趁着我还没改变主意赶快滚吧。

original: Give me something I can use as proof that I killed you. Or else.
translation: 给我些东西来证明我已经杀了你。或者让我杀了你。

original: I don't think I need to hear any more.
translation: 我不认为我需要再听下去了。

original: Good. I'm getting tired of flapping jaw with you, clown shoes.
translation: 不错。我也厌倦了和你浪费唇舌了，小丑。

original: I think I'll flap my balls against Cherry's ass instead! Oh, yeah!
translation: 我想我还是去和雪莉合体吧！哦，耶！

original: Actually, Crowley is alive. He wants some sort of security key you have.
translation: 事实上，考利还活着。他想要你那把安保系统的钥匙。

original: So the meatbag is alive, huh? Fine with me. Just show me the money. Put your fucking caps on the table and you can have it.
translation: 那饭桶还活着，呃？好吧。只要给我钱。把该死的瓶盖放在桌子上，你就可以拿走它了。

original: Fine with me. Just show me the money. Put your fucking caps on the table and you can have it.
translation: 好吧。只要给我钱。把该死的瓶盖放在桌子上，你就可以拿走它了。

original: He wants some sort of security key you have.
translation: 他要你手上的一把安保系统钥匙。

original: So the meatbag is alive, huh? And I bet I know what he wants.
translation: 那饭桶还活着，呃？我打赌我知道他想要什么。

original: But I don't know what you want. What's your angle, clown shoes?
translation: 但我不知道你要什么。你说呢，小丑？

original: Actually, Crowley is alive. I'm supposed to kill you and bring him proof.
translation: 实际上，考利先生还活着。我应该杀了你再给他带去证据。

original: Crowley is alive, and he paid me to kill you because you hate Ghouls.
translation: 考利还活着，而且他雇我来杀了你，因为你仇视尸鬼。

original: What? Fuck me sideways! No, better yet, fuck him. I swear, I'll jam a grenade so far up his ass...
translation: 什么？有没有搞错！不，应该说，去他妈的。我发誓，我会把手榴弹塞进他屁股……

original: I've got nothing against Ghouls. Ha! I even had a Ghoul party girl once, to see what it was like!
translation: 我根本没有针对僵尸。哈！我甚至曾经有过一个僵尸女伴，就为试试那是什么感觉！

original: This is about the key, isn't it? The goddamn key. If you want it, I'd better see some fucking caps on the table, clown shoes.
translation: 这跟钥匙有关，对吧？该死的钥匙。如果你想要它，你最好拿出些该死的瓶盖来，小丑。

original: I'll give you 25 caps for that key.
translation: 我会为那钥匙付给你25个瓶盖。

original: Oh, yeah! I'm gonna be flying high tonight.
translation: 哦，耶！我今晚乐得合不拢嘴。

original: Oh, yeah! I'm gonna be flying high tonight.
translation: 哦，耶！我今晚乐得合不拢嘴。

original: I'll give you 25 caps for something I can bring to Crowley, to "prove" you died.
translation: 我用25个瓶盖换你身上的东西带给考利先生，好“证明”你已经死了。

original: Give me that key. I'd hate to see you bleed to death.
translation: 给我钥匙。我不想看着你流血至死。

original: Uh... sure, dude. I don't know what it's for anyway. Don't need to get all thug like.
translation: 喔……当然，伙计。反正我不知道它是用来干嘛的。没必要表现得像个恶棍。

original: Mister Crowley wants your father's security key.
translation: 考利先生想要你父亲的安保系统钥匙。

original: Whoa! Is it, like, worth caps? Cause I got needs, man.
translation: 哇！这会不会值点钱？因为我需要钱，伙计。

original: Whoa! Is this, like, worth caps? Cause I got needs, man.
translation: 哇！这会不会值点钱？因为我需要钱，伙计。

original: I'm guessing Crowley wants your father's key. Just a hunch.
translation: 我猜考利先生想要你父亲的钥匙。只是直觉。

original: Whoa! Is this, like, worth caps? Cause I got needs, man.
translation: 哇！这会不会值点钱？因为我需要钱，伙计。

original: If you give me something personal of yours as proof, I'll lie to Crowley.
translation: 给我点你身上的东西做证据，我就能骗倒考利先生。
听起来像个没事人一样。

original: You're too nosy for your own good. It can be a dangerous habit.
translation: 你太爱管闲事了。这可是个危险的毛病。

original: I don't give away anything for free. Besides, it's obviously worth something to you.
translation: 我从不免费给予任何东西。更何况，这明显值得你付出。

original: Why should I have to pay for gossip?
translation: 为什么我要为流言付钱？

original: Oh look! I dropped these 50 caps in your pocket...
translation: 哦，看！我会把这50个瓶盖放进你的口袋里……

original: A whole bottle? You got a deal. All I know is that he keeps trying to hire outsiders to do some killing.
translation: 整整一瓶？成交。我所知道的就是他一直在雇佣外来人做一些杀人的勾当。

original: I heard him mumble something about a Fort too.
translation: 我还听到他在嘀咕一个要塞的事。

original: How about a whole bottle? Here's 10 caps.
translation: 一整瓶怎么样？给你10个瓶盖。

original: Crowley has some scam going where he's going to get rich.
translation: 考利的发迹史里可有不少阴暗的小故事。

original: He tried to get me to kill these three guys, but I wouldn't do it. I've met Dave, and he's no more of a Ghoul bigot than I am.
translation: 他试图让我去杀掉这三个人，但我不会去做。我遇到了戴夫，而他不会比我对僵尸更偏执。

original: Come on. You can tell me. Ahzrukhal said so. <Lie.>
translation: 得了吧。你可以告诉我。阿祖卡是这么说的。<撒谎。>

original: You're the third human he's tried to get to kill those guys.
translation: 你是他派去试图杀死这些人的第三个杀手了。

original: He won't ask me, or anyone else in Underworld. It's kind of weird.
translation: 他不会找我，或者地下城的任何人。这很怪。

original: Deal. All I know is that he keeps trying to hire outsiders to do some killing.
translation: 成交。我所知道的就是他一直在雇佣外来人做一些杀人的勾当。

original: Here's 3 caps for a drink, but you've got to tell me what you know.
translation: 给你3个瓶盖买杯饮料，但是你要告诉我你知道的东西。

original: Well, it's better than nothing. Crowley has been outfitting himself for some big expedition.
translation: 嗯，聊胜于无。考利在筹备一次大冒险。

original: He's up to something, but he isn't saying what.
translation: 他有所行动，但从不说在干什么。

original: What... oh! A bribe. Why didn't you just say so. Here's 20 caps.
translation: 什么…… 噢！贿赂。你怎么不直说。给你20个瓶盖。

original: What can you tell me about Mister Crowley?
translation: 你能和我说说考利先生吗？

original: Whoa! That's a blast from the past.
translation: 哇！这可真唤醒了我的回忆。

original: My dad knew a dude named Crowley. I never met him though.
translation: 我爸爸认识一个叫考利的家伙。不过我从来没有见过他。

original: I think Dad said he died when they were checking out some old fort.
translation: 我想我爸爸说过，在他们一起探索某个旧堡垒时，他死了。

original: Do you know a Mister Crowley?
The Ghoul? He's dead. Died twenty years ago.
translation: 那个僵尸？他死了。二十年前就死了。

original: Good riddance too. I hate those shufflers.
translation: 死得好。我讨厌那些瘸子。

original: Do you remember a Mister Crowley?
translation: 你还记不记得考利先生？

original: Sure. People like that don't deserve to live.
translation: 当然。那样的人根本不应该活下去。

original: Excellent! Take this sniper rifle. You'll need it.
translation: 太好了！带上这把狙击步枪。你会需要它的。

original: Here's a list of the guys and their last known locations. Word will get around if Tenpenny is killed, but I'll need proof for the others.
translation: 这有一份那些家伙的名单和他们最后出现的地点。特佩尼一死自然会有消息传开，但我需要你杀死其他人的证据。

original: Bring me back something personal from each of them as proof. Like a key or ring or something.
translation: 给我带回他们每人的一件私人物品作为证据。比如钥匙或戒指这类的东西。
嗨，那是你的损失，光皮肤。

original: Not everyone is as sympathetic to Ghouls as you are. In fact some humans are downright bigots.
translation: 不是每个人都像你一样对僵尸有同情心。事实上，有些人类是彻头彻尾的偏执狂。

original: They treat us like zombies, calling us brain eaters and shufflers.
translation: 他们像对丧尸一样对待我们，他们称我们食脑者和瘸子。

original: Well, I'm going to make them pay. Uh... before I get into the details, you don't have anything against killing do you?
translation: 嗯，我会让他们付出代价的。呃……在我开始讲述细节之前，我得确定你不会对杀人感到反感，是吧？ ?

original: Hey! I'm just looking to trade a drink for some gossip.
translation: 嗨！我想用杯喝的来换点消息。

original: Humph. Not sure I know anything of use, but I'll take that drink.
translation: 哼。我不确定我知道任何有用的消息，但我会收下这杯酒。

original: That will cost you two caps.
Easy now. I've got nothing against Ghouls.
translation: 冷静下来。我并没有任何针对尸鬼的意思。

original: Is that so? Even if I call you a milk-sucking, mutant-loving, water-stealing whore?
translation: 真的？即便我称你为吸奶虫、变种狂、偷水贼？

original: Is that so? Even if I call you a milk-sucking, mutant-loving, water-stealing son of a whore?
translation: 真的？即便我称你为吸奶虫、变种狂、偷水贼？

original: Do you have any traders in town? Any doctors?
Well, you've seen the clinic. Red's the smart one in Big Town. I'd ask her.
translation: 你去过诊所了。瑞德是大镇里最聪明的人。我宁愿去问她。

original: This place looks like a ghost town.
translation: 这地方看上去像个鬼镇。

original: Nah, no way. Big Town is a great place to be! I bet I could live over there, in that building with all the bullet holes and burn marks. Cool!
translation: 得了吧，不可能。大镇是个了不起的地方！我打赌我可以住在那里，就在那满是弹痕和燃迹的建筑里。酷！ !

original: Just ask everyone else in town. I'm sure they'll tell you how great it is to be here, all grownup!
translation: 去问问镇上的其他人吧。我确定他们会告诉你这有多么伟大的，全部是大人！

original: You've seen those Super Mutants and their ... appetite. There's no way Big Town will survive with them around.
translation: 你也见过那些超级变种人和他们的……胃口。如果被它们围着，大镇不可能幸存。

original: What do you think will happen to Big Town?
translation: 你觉得大镇将来会怎么样？

original: Where did you people come from, anyway?
translation: 顺便问问，你们这些人从哪里来的？

original: Oh, Little Lamplight is where most of us came from. Red and Pappy and Flash and Bittercup. We used to play together, when we were kids.
translation: 噢，我们中的大多数来自小灯镇 。瑞德，帕匹和福莱斯还有“苦杯”，当我们还是孩子的时候，总在一起玩。

original: Then we got old, and we had to leave. Those were the rules. So we packed up and headed here, like we were supposed to.
translation: 然后我们长大了，所以我们必须离开。那是规则。所以我们背起行囊来到这边，就像我们应该要做的那样。

original: No one told us it would be like this. We never have fun anymore, and most of us... most of us are dead.
translation: 从没有人告诉过我们会是这样。我们再也没有得到过快乐，而且我们中的大多数……我们中的大多数人都死了。

original: We all used to live in a place called Little Lamplight, but they have a rule about age. You reach sixteen, and you're out.
translation: 我们曾经都住在一个叫做小灯镇的地方，但他们有一个关于年龄的规定。当你16岁时就必须离开。

original: Didn't matter, though, because you'd just pack your things and head to Big Town. All the adults go there, and there's plenty to eat.
translation: 不过也没什么，因为你要收拾好自己的东西起程到大镇去。所有的大人都去那里，而且那里有充足的食物。

original: "Plenty to eat" alright, if you like eating bullets. I've lost count of how many times I've been shot at.
translation: “充足的食物”是没错，如果你喜欢吃子弹的话。我已经数不清自己当过多少次靶子了。

original: Big Town? A fairy-tale really. The Lamplighters who turn sixteen aren't allowed to stay in the caves, but they have to go somewhere.
translation: 大镇？一个真正的童话。长到16岁的小灯镇居民不再允许待在洞穴里，他们必须到别的地方去。

original: And to encourage people to leave, they invented Big Town: the "great grownup place" that you got to go to when you became an adult.
translation: 为了鼓励人们离开，他们创造了大镇：“了不起的大人之地”，那就是当你成年后要去的地方。

original: I think you can see how true those stories were.
translation: 我想你也看到这些故事有多么真实了。

original: Give me the history of this place.
From the look of things, I'd say a Super Mutant sat down in a ditch one day and shat out this town.
translation: 照目前的情形看，我要说迟早会有个超级变种人坐在沟上，把镇子里的人都拉出来。

original: I dragged myself here from Lamplight. I didn't believe all the stories about Big Town, but I wasn't about to let everyone else go there without me.
translation: 我自己从小灯镇挪到了这边。我不太相信那些大镇的故事，但我也不能让其他人自己跑来。

original: A few dozen attacks on the town later, and here I am. Almost an ingredient in a Super Mutant chilli cook-off.
translation: 几十个变种人不久之后就攻击了我们的镇子，我就混成这样了。几乎变成超级变种人的一味菜肴了。

original: Do you know how Big Town got started?
translation: 你知道大镇是怎么建立的吗？

original: Whoa, take it easy. I was just asking.
I'm sorry, it's just been hard. When I managed to save him, I thought there might be a chance...
translation: 对不起，这太难了。当我试图救他时，我以为还有机会……

original: But now, it just looks like he's going to die like the others. And... I just can't bring myself to deal with it.
translation: 但现在，看上去他就要像其他人一样死去了。而我……实在看不下去。

original: Maybe you can. Feel free to take a look at him. But don't get in over your head. He's got some pretty nasty injuries.
translation: 或许你能。随意检查他吧。但别抱太大期望。他伤得很惨。

original: Who's that guy in the clinic?
translation: 在诊所里的那家伙是谁？

original: I told you, that's Timebomb. And if it were up to you, he'd be dead. Just stay away from him.
translation: 我告诉过你，那是“定时炸弹”。要是换了你的话，他早死了。你给我离他远点。

original: That's Timebomb. He got lucky. During the last raid, the mutant shot him down in the street.
translation: 那是“定时炸弹”。他很幸运。上次遭到劫掠的时候，变种人在街头击中了他。

original: Normally, they go for the kill, but I managed to drag Timebomb away before they could get the killing blow in.
translation: 一般来说，他们会杀了他，但我在他们来得及下手之前就把“定时炸弹”拖走了。

original: I dragged him back to the clinic, but his injuries are way beyond what I can deal with. Honestly, there's not much hope for him.
translation: 我把他拖回了诊所，但他所受到的创伤已超出了我的能力范围。坦白说，他没什么希望了。

original: That's Timebomb. He got lucky. During the last raid, the mutant shot him down in the street.
translation: 那是“定时炸弹”。他很幸运。上次遭到劫掠的时候，变种人在街头击中了他。

original: Normally, they go for the kill, but I managed to drag Timebomb away before they could get the killing blow in.
translation: 一般来说，他们会杀了他，但我在他们来得及下手之前就把“定时炸弹”拖走了。

original: I dragged him back to the clinic, but his injuries are way beyond what I can deal with. Honestly, there's not much hope for him.
translation: 我把他拖回了诊所，但他所受到的创伤已超出了我的能力范围。坦白说，他没什么希望了。

original: Who's that guy over there? Is he hurt?
translation: 那个家伙是谁？他受伤了吗？

original: I have a Fission Battery that will fix that express elevator.
translation: 我有一块能用于高速电梯的核聚变合电池。

original: Let me have that thing. Give me a few minutes, and I'll have the elevator up and running.
translation: 把那东西给我。我需要一些时间，我会修好电梯，让它恢复运作。

original: As soon as I get it online, we'll get out of here.
translation: 只要我让它联线，我们就可以离开这了。

original: Well, what the fuck you bringin' it to me for? Give to Donovan. Sheesh.
translation: 你他妈的把它给我干嘛？把它给多诺万。他妈的。

original: Are there any other ways off this roof?
translation: 还有其他离开楼顶的路吗？

original: Well, I can think of a faster way, but I doubt you'd survive the fall.
translation: 嗯，还有一条更快的路，但我不知道你跳下去能否活着。

original: Seriously, the elevator is our only chance now that the radio tower is gone.
translation: 说真的，现在无线电塔已经消失，电梯是我们唯一的机会。

original: We'll chat about stuff later. We have to get out of here, right now!
translation: 我们迟些再聊。现在我们得离开这了，现在！

original: Listen. I don't know who you are. I don't even know why Reilly sent you. One thing I do know is that you're beginning to piss me off.
translation: 听着。我不知道你是谁。我甚至不知道为什么莱莉派你来。我唯一知道的事是你开始让我生气了。

original: Now, stop being an asshole and work with me, will ya?
translation: 现在，如果你想和我一起，就别再像个混蛋似的，好吗？

original: Reilly did. I'm the second in command of the Rangers. Now, can you just answer the question?
translation: 莱莉的命令。我是游骑兵的第二把手。现在，你可以回答问题了吗？

original: Any clue where I can find a Fission Battery?
translation: 有什么关于核聚变合电池位置的线索吗？

original: Hmmmm. Not really. All I remember is passing that maintenance office on the third floor.
translation: 唔。不完全是这样。我能记得的就是在三楼曾经过那件间保全室。

original: Sorry, we were under fire the whole time. Otherwise, I would have cleaned the place out.
translation: 抱歉，我们一直都在火力压制之下。另外，我还得扫荡这地区。

original: When we passed the maintenance room, I spied a deactivated Protectron inside. Just wrench open its access panel and you'll find it.
translation: 当我们路过保全室的时候，我在里面藏了一个未激活的自动护卫。打开它的检修门你就能找到。

original: All I remember is mowing down Super Mutants with Eugene here.
translation: 我所记得的只有在这和尤金一起绞碎那些超级变种人。

original: Ask the eggheads, they're runnin' the show. I just point and shoot... then stuff dies.
translation: 问那些书呆子去，他们才是头。我只要发现目标然后开火……接着那些东西就死了。

original: Who are those girls? And where are their clothes?
translation: 那些女孩是谁？她们的衣服在哪？

original: Ha ha! They're my party girls.
I'm too much man for just one woman, so I need two! I wear them out every night.
translation: 只有一个女人对男人来说太不够了，所以我要两个！我每天晚上都把她们扒光。

original: Why should they bother getting dressed when I'm just going to take it off?
translation: 如果我要把衣服脱下来的话，为什么她们还要费神穿上呢？

original: Ha ha! Cherry is my play toy.
I love my Cherry pie! Love it all night long!
translation: 我喜欢我的雪莉派！我会整夜地爱她！

original: I like her half naked. I like her all naked, but she says she gets cold.
translation: 我喜欢她半裸的样子。我更喜欢她全裸的样子，但是她说她冷。

original: Who's that girl? And why isn't she dressed?
translation: 那女孩是谁？她为什么不多穿点？

original: Ha ha! Fantasia is my girl Friday... and Monday, and Wednesday...
translation: 哈哈！凡塔纱是我星期五的女孩……还有星期一，还有星期三……

original: She makes all my fantasies come true. Ha ha!
translation: 她把我所有的幻想都变成了现实。哈哈！

original: That's my favorite outfit. If she gets cold, old Dukov knows how to warm her up!
translation: 那是我最喜欢的外套。如果她觉得冷，老杜克夫知道怎么让她暖起来！

original: That girl looks cold. Why isn't she dressed?
translation: 那女孩看上去很冷。她为什么不多穿点？

original: Hey! Watch your language, clown shoes.
I don't pay them. They take care of me, so I take care of them. We rub each other wrong all night long! Ha, ha!
translation: 我不付她们钱。她们照顾我，我也同样照顾她们。我们整晚都在互补长短！哈，哈！

original: So those girls are just your... whores?
translation: 这么说那些女孩只不过是你的……妓女？

original: Hey! Watch your language, clown shoes.
I take care of her, so she takes care of me. Ha, ha! She rubs me wrong all night long. Ha, ha!
translation: 我不付她们钱。她们照顾我，我也同样照顾她们。我们整晚都在互补长短！哈，哈！

original: So that girl is just your... whore?
translation: 这么说那个女孩只不过是你的……妓女？

original: Allistair Tenpenny is dead. One shot, right through the brain.
translation: 奥利斯特·特佩尼死了。一枪正中头部。

original: Yes, yes, yes! Another bigot bites the dust.
translation: 好，好，好！又一个偏执狂玩完了。

original: Good riddance. The wasteland is better off without him.
translation: 死得好。废土没有他会变得更好。

original: Allistair Tenpenny is dead, but not from a shot to the head.
translation: 奥利斯特·特佩尼已经死了，不过没爆他的头。

original: "Old Lady Dithers"? I thought you were the one who said we should be nice, and refer to her as "Ms. Dithers".
translation: “迪瑟大妈”？我想是你告诉我们要变好一点，并称她为“迪瑟女士”。

original: George, honestly. You know I don't like talking to her.
translation: 乔治，坦白说。你知道我不喜欢和她说话。

original: Oh, Mabel. Did you want to look for a new robot? I know you're not comfortable with yours.
translation: 噢，梅布尔。你想找台新机器人吗？我知道你对你那台不太满意。

original: Oh, I... It's not really my place to say. I'm sure they're fine.
translation: 噢，我……这真的不该这么说的。我肯定他们都很好。

original: How could you... Roger, no. This is not the time for that discussion. Please.
translation: 你怎么……罗杰，不。这不是商量的时候。拜托。

original: Right. Sorry. I just thought that maybe... Oh, never mind.
translation: 是的。抱歉。我只是想那可能……噢，算了吧。

original: All right... I'll talk to him about it. She's harmless, anyway. Just old and senile.
translation: 好吧……我会跟他谈谈的。无论如何，她没有危险。她只是个老态龙钟的女人而已。

original: Here, I brought you some ammo.
Whew. That makes me feel a whole lot better. Thanks.
translation: 哟。这让我感觉好多了。谢谢。

original: Thanks. I was starting to feel a little naked without it.
translation: 谢谢。没有这的话，我开始感觉自己有点像光着身子。

original: That would be great. Maybe I'll speak to Reilly about it.
translation: 这太棒了。或许我会跟莱莉谈谈这的。

original: You should. Now that our group is smaller, I'm sure she'll be into adding another Ranger to our ranks.
translation: 你应该这样。我们的队伍规模比以前小了，我敢肯定她一定会补充一个新的游骑兵。

original: Nah. I've got things to do. But thanks for the compliment.
translation: 不。我还有事要做。但是谢谢你的恭维。

original: Okay, just wanted you to know that I got your back if we ever end up in a firefight again.
translation: 好吧，我只是想让你知道，如果你再卷进一场交火的话，我会在后面支援你。

original: Sure did. And now you're all alone.
translation: 确实。现在就剩你一个人了。

original: Alone... What will I do now? I have no one. Nothing. You've destroyed everything that mattered to me.
translation: 一个人……我现在该怎么办？我无依无靠。一无所有。你毁了我所有重要的东西。

original: I want more than that to spare your miserable life. 300 caps.
translation: 想要保住你那可怜的小命，我要更多的报酬。300个瓶盖。

original: You mercenaries are so reliably predictable.
translation: 你们佣兵处事的方式总在人预料之中。

original: 100 now, 200 when the job is done.
translation: 现在先给你100个，等你搞定了，再来拿剩下的200个。

original: Mister Crowley is alive. I'm here to kill you because you hate Ghouls.
translation: 考利先生还活着。我则是来杀你的，因为你仇视尸鬼。

original: He's alive? I should have known. It's hard to kill those zombies. You gotta shoot 'em in the head.
translation: 他还活着？我早该知道。杀掉这些丧尸确实不容易。你得一枪打爆他们脑袋。

original: Whatever he's paying you, I'll double it.
translation: 不管他付你多少钱，我都会出双倍的。

original: More caps? You've got a deal.
Good. Oh, and I still want Tenpenny dead. That bastard really does hate Ghouls.
translation: 好的。噢，我还希望特佩尼能死掉。那杂种真的仇视僵尸。

original: Good. Just get me those keys.
translation: 很好。给我那些钥匙就好。

original: Those people you sent me to kill aren't Ghoul haters...
translation: 这些你派我去杀掉的人并不是尸鬼仇视者...

original: Your Republic is forfeit. Prepare to be reclaimed by the Wasteland!
translation: 你们的共和国被取缔了。准备好重归废土吧！

original: Let's see what the Army of Dave has to say about that, invader!
translation: 入侵者，让你见识下戴夫军队的厉害！
去找戴夫爸爸！入侵者！入侵者！

original: Communist! She's a Communist! Everyone come quick!
translation: 共产党！她是个共产党！大家快来！

original: Communist! He's a Communist! Everyone come quick!
translation: 共产党！他是个共产党！大家快来！

original: I'm not here to hurt anyone. What is this place?
translation: 我不是来这伤害任何人的。这是什么地方？

original: We're the Republic of Dave. Or we used to be anyway. You have to go now. Dave isn't here anymore to talk to you.
translation: 我们是戴夫共和国，或者说，以前是。你现在该离开了。戴夫不在这里，不会和你谈了。

original: A gift of the key would be a strategic diplomatic move, Mister President.
translation: 总统先生，将这把钥匙当作礼物会成为一次战略上的外交行动。

original: Hmm. Of course it would. I knew that. I was just testing you to see if you would realize it.
translation: 嗯。当然是的。我完全清楚。我只是想试试你能否意识到这点。

original: Here, take the key. It is a gift from the Republic of Dave to the Wasteland.
translation: 拿着这把钥匙吧。这是戴夫共和国赠送给废土的礼物。

original: Hmm. Of course it would. I knew that. I was just testing you to see if you would realize it.
translation: 嗯。当然是的。我完全清楚。我只是想试试你能否意识到这点。

original: Here, take this key. It is a gift from the Republic of Dave to the Wasteland.
translation: 拿着这把钥匙吧。这是戴夫共和国赠送给废土的礼物。

original: A gift would be a strategic diplomatic move, Mr. President. Something personal.
translation: 送一份礼物将能成为一次战略上的外交行动，总统先生。一些私人的东西。

original: Mister Crowley is alive. He sent me to kill you because you hate Ghouls.
translation: 考利先生依然活着。他让我宰了你，因为你仇视尸鬼。

original: Wait. You said you're here to kill me? I'm going to have to recind your diplomatic immunity.
translation: 等等。你说你是来杀我的？看来我必须废除你的外交豁免权了。

original: Then I'm going to execute you.
Wait. I've changed my mind. You have one hour to leave the Republic. Then I'll execute you.
translation: 等等，我改主意了。你有一小时离开共和国。过后我会处死你。

original: Crowley is alive, Mister President. I'm supposed to bring him the key.
translation: 总统先生，考利依然活着。他要我把那把钥匙带给他。

original: Alive? I always wondered. He was locked in with a bunch of Feral Ghouls. They won't attack Ghouls, you see.
translation: 活着？我一直有所怀疑。他和一堆凶悍僵尸锁在一起。他们从不攻击僵尸，你知道的。

original: The key is part of the Republic of Dave treasury. I couldn't possibly part with it.
translation: 这把钥匙是戴夫共和国宝藏的一部分。我难以割舍它。

original: Alive? I always wondered. He was locked in with a bunch of Feral Ghouls. They won't attack Ghouls, you see.
translation: 活着？我一直有所怀疑。他和一堆凶悍僵尸锁在一起。他们从不攻击僵尸，你知道的。

original: Would you consider taking him a personal item, like this key, and just telling him you killed me?
translation: 你会考虑给他带一件我的私人物品，比如这把钥匙，然后就告诉他你已经杀了我吗？

original: Crowley is alive, Mr. President. I'm supposed to bring back proof of your death.
translation: 考利先生还活着，总统先生。我要带给他一些你已死的证据。

original: I seek citizenship in the Republic of Dave.
translation: 我希望成为戴夫共和国的公民。

original: First off, you will address me as Mister President. Always. No exceptions.
translation: 首先，你要尊我为总统。永远如此。绝无例外。

original: Secondly, after careful consideration, the Office of Immigrant Affairs reports that we've already exceeded our quota for immigration this year.
translation: 其次，在仔细的考量后，移民事务办公室报告说我们今年已经超额移民了。

original: Application denied. You have 24 hours to leave the Republic, or face deportation.
translation: 申请否决。你有24小时离开共和国，否则就会被遣送出境。

original: I'm sorry we lost Butcher and Donovan.
translation: 很遗憾我们失去了布彻和多诺万。

original: I'm sorry we lost Brick and Donovan.
translation: 很遗憾我们失去了布瑞克和多诺万。

original: You're a goddamn liar. You told me we were going to Rivet City but we've been out here for over five days! I've had it. I'm going back.
translation: 你这该死的骗子。你说过我们要去铆钉城的，但我们在外面已经晃了5天了！我受够了，我要回去。

original: Let me pack my bags. Oh, wait, I don't have any. Let's get out of here.
translation: 我去收拾行李。噢，等等，我什么都没有。那我们出发吧。

original: If he's that bad, come with me. I'll protect you.
translation: 既然他那么糟糕，那就跟着我吧。我会保护你的。

original: Okay. Rivet City has got to be better than this.
translation: 好吧，铆钉城比这好多了。

original: I have my hands in his pants all the time. He probably won't even notice it's gone.
translation: 我总是把手插在他裤子里。他都不会注意到它不见了。

original: Dukov has a special key. Get it for me and I'll take you to Rivet City.
translation: 杜克夫有一把特殊的钥匙。把它拿给我，我就可以带你去铆钉城。

original: Only if you take me to Rivet City.
Anywhere else and I'll just end up being someone else's property.
translation: 其他任何地方也行，我只是不想再成为别人的财产。

original: You should come with me. You can't survive here by yourself.
translation: 你该跟我走。你一个人在这不可能活下去。

original: Right. Because I've got all kinds of survival skills.
translation: 是啊。因为我学会了所有的“生存技能”。

original: I've only got one skill, and it won't do me any fucking good here.
translation: 我只会一件事，而且这件事现在对我来说他妈的一点好处都没。

original: Go on. Get out of here.
I'm sure you can find a way to survive here.
translation: 我相信你有办法在这活下去。

original: Does he pay you for this?
Of course. Why else would I stay with the old fart? You don't think I actually love that bastard, do you?
translation: 当然，不然我为什么和这老头待在一起？你不会真的认为我喜欢那混蛋吧？

original: He gives me some caps, but it's not what you think. He can be a nice guy.
translation: 他给我一些钱，但不是你想象的那样。他也能很棒。

original: And when the lights go out, he's real fun!
translation: 而且当灯关上时，他真的很棒！

original: Dukov likes to keep it hot. Ain't no need for nothin' else.
translation: 杜克夫喜欢保持火辣。再没其他需求了。

original: Dukov liked to keep it hot. He always said there ain't no need for nothin' else.
translation: 杜克夫喜欢保持火辣。他总是说再无其他需求了。

original: Dukey didn't like me to wear a lot. He said it slowed things down.
translation: 杜克夫不喜欢我穿很多，他说那样很费事。

original: Who are you? And why are you dressed like that?
translation: 你是谁？为什么你穿成那样？

original: So what's the deal with Dukov?
He's a lecherous old man. The only reason I put up with him and his "needs" is because I'm safe here.
translation: 他是个好色的老男人。我唯一能够容忍他和他的“需求”的原因就是我在这很安全。

original: He tends to shoot first and ask questions later. Don't pull out a weapon near him. He's likely to shoot you.
translation: 他总是喜欢先开枪再问话。别拿着武器靠近他。他很可能会攻击你。

original: Hold on. I need to know more before I agree to anything.
translation: 等等。我在同意前需要了解更多。

original: Well, it's a dangerous place out there in the Wastes, right? People could really use a compilation of good advice. Like a Wasteland survival guide!
translation: 好吧，废土是危险的地方，对吧？人们很需要一本为他们提供好的建议的书。像是一本《废土生存指南》！

original: For that, I need an assistant to test my theories. I wouldn't want anyone to get hurt because of a mistake. Nobody's ever happy when that happens.
translation: 因此，我需要一个助手来测试我的理论。我不希望任何人因为一个小错误而受伤。发生那样的事，不会有人高兴的。

original: No... Then they just yell a lot. At me. With mean, mean words.
translation: 不……他们会对我吼出很多……很多脏话。

original: Wait. How? I mean, how many people even read anymore?
translation: 等等。怎样？我的意思是，多少人读过？

original: Anyone who wants to learn from my Wasteland survival guide, that's who! And for that, I need a research assistant who can test my ideas for the book.
translation: 所有想从我的废土生存指南里学习的人，就是那些人！因此，我需要一个助手来帮我测试书里的意见。

original: I mean, if our research is off, it could lead to horrific misinformation that causes the grisly and needless deaths of uncountable innocents.
translation: 我是说，如果我们的研究中止了，就会导致极其可怕的误导，会造成无数无辜的人可怕而无谓的死亡。

original: But, you know, no pressure. So, will you help?
translation: 不过，你知道的，没有压力。你乐意帮忙吗？

original: My very own landmine! Just what I've always wanted. Well, always since I sent you out on this, anyway.
translation: 我的地雷！就是我一直想得到的。嗯，至少是我派你去拿之后我一直想得到的。

original: Now, tell me all about it. What was it like going through there? What's it like disarming a landmine?
translation: 现在，和我谈谈。经历怎么样？解除地雷的感觉是什么样的？

original: I got through Minefield alive, and I even brought you a present.
translation: 我从雷区活着回来了，还给你带了个礼物。

original: Really? A whole library's worth of data, right there? That's great news!
translation: 真的？满满一图书馆的资料，就在那？太棒了！

original: So, what did you find? Tell me about it!
The library's still standing, and I've got the archives right here.
translation: 图书馆依旧挺立着，我还在那找到了一些档案。

original: Guess I wasn't the first to think of checking out a food store for storing food. Huh?
translation: 看来我不是第一个想到去食品店检查库存的，呃？

original: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
translation: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。

original: Here, take a bit, my treat - taste kind of grates after a while.
translation: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。

original: I encountered some Raiders, but they were easily outsmarted.
translation: 我遇上了一些歹徒，不过他们很容易就被我智取了。

original: Oh, I never get to discuss semantics with anyone anymore! People are always like, "No time to debate linguistic constructs, we need to get food."
translation: 喔，我从没和其他人讨论过语义学！人们总是喜欢说，“没时间去探究语言结构了，我们要的是食物。”

original: But you're right, of course. And that sort of attention to detail must help when avoiding landmines.
translation: 不过你是对的。这些细节一定可以帮助别人避开地雷。

original: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them.
translation: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。

original: Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine.
Technically, it's the landmines that blow up, not me. And no, I didn't.
translation: 技术上说，是地雷炸，不是我炸。而且你看，我没炸。

original: Explosive, you say? That's kind of impressive, actually. In a horrible sort of way, at least.
translation: 爆炸？真令人印象深刻。至少是一种糟糕的方法。

original: I guess it's back to the drawing board for that repellent. I wonder if I can make it into some sort of fuel. Anyway, I'll just take that.
translation: 我想我必须要重新设计这些驱鼠剂。我想知道能否能把它做成一种燃料。总之，就这样吧。

original: Oh, but for your trouble, umm... Here, have the leftover chems from working on the repellent. I'm sure you can find some use for them.
translation: 哦，为了补偿你遇到的麻烦，唔……拿着这些造驱鼠剂剩下的药品吧，我确定你会找到用处的。

original: You added too much chemical stimulant. The result was rather explosive.
translation: 你加了太多的化学刺激剂。结果是毁灭性的。

original: Interesting... I wonder if the toxicity of the water caused their mutations and forced them to adapt to the ground as well?
translation: 有趣……我想知道是否是那些有毒的水源让它们发生突变，并强迫它们适应陆地？

original: I wish we could have gotten more information, but this'll have to do for the book.
translation: 我希望我们得到更多的信息，但这对写书就够了。

original: Here's your pay. Maybe they'll help you be sneakier next time.
translation: 这是你的报酬，希望日后会助你潜行更隐秘。

original: Their lairs are partially aquatic, so the radiation must not bother them.
