original: What?! This is terrible! The vault will become uninhabitable!
translation: 什么？！这太可怕了！避难所将变得不能居住！

original: How the hell can this be happening?
The Vault's life support systems have failed. We need to evacuate immediately.
translation: 避难所的生命维持系统崩溃了。我们得马上撤离。

original: Oh my god. The Vault's doomed. Everyone has to evacuate, and there's no way most of them will survive out there.
translation: 我的上帝啊，避难所完蛋了，所有人都必须撤离，而出去之后大多数人都无法生存。

original: The Vault's life support systems have failed. We need to evacuate immediately.
translation: 避难所的生命维持系统崩溃了。我们得马上撤离。

original: What in the world? This is insane! We've got to get people to safety! But where can we go?
translation: 到底怎么回事？这太疯狂了！我们要让大家去一个安全的地方！但是我们能到哪去？

original: Oh my god... There's only one solution, isn't there? Outside.
translation: 我的上帝……只有一条出路，不是吗？去外面。

original: You're gonna make sure we're okay out there, right?
translation: 你将确保我们出去都会平安无事，对吗？

original: The Vault's life support systems have failed. We need to evacuate immediately.
translation: 避难所的生命维持系统崩溃了。我们得马上撤离。

original: Goodbye, hellhole! I'm off to a new life!
translation: 再见，破地方！我要开始新生活了！

original: The Vault's life support systems have failed. We need to evacuate immediately.
translation: 避难所的生命维持系统崩溃了。我们得马上撤离。

original: Congratulations, young man! I don’t have to tell you how special this day is, do I?
translation: 祝贺你！小伙子！我不用说今天有多么特别了吧？

original: Congratulations, young lady! I don’t have to tell you how special this day is, do I?
translation: 祝贺你！小姑娘！我不用说今天有多么特别了吧？

original: Down here in Vault 101, when you turn 10, well, you’re ready to take on your first official Vault responsibilities.
translation: 在101号避难所里，一旦10岁，就要承担第一份正式的避难所的职责了。

original: So here you are. As Overseer, I hereby present to you your very own Pip-Boy 3000! Get used to it.
translation: 给你。作为监督者，我将授予你哔哔小子3000！好好使用它。

original: I hope you brought me something better than last year.
translation: 我希望你今年的礼物比去年的更好。

original: Well now! Young people were more polite back in my day. Respected their elders. Of course, we had a real Overseer back then. Worthy of respect.
translation: 这样啊！在我们那年代，年轻人更有礼貌，更懂得尊敬长辈。当然，那时我们也有一个货真价实的监督者，值得尊敬。

original: Not like that one over there, with his rules and his secrets. Why, I have half a mind to just up and tell you...
translation: 不像那边那家伙，有一堆自以为是的规定和见不得人的秘密。噢，我只是随口说说而已……

original: Oh my, there I go again with my old lady talk and you still waiting patiently for your present.
translation: 天啊，我又犯喜欢唠叨的老毛病了，而你还是如此耐心。

original: I suppose you could have asked more politely, but it is still your birthday, so here you go: a nice sweetroll I baked just for you.
translation: 我想你愿该更加礼貌些，但这是你的生日，好吧，给你：我刚给你烤好的甜面包卷。

original: Oh, you didn't have to bring me a present, Mrs. Palmer.
translation: 哦，你用不着送我礼物的，帕尔默夫人。
胡说！哪有不喜欢礼物的10岁孩子。

original: I was 10 once, believe it or not! My goodness, the Vault was practically crowded back then.
translation: 我也曾有过10岁，信不信由你！天啊，那时候避难所里好多人啊。

original: Not like today. So few young people now... But here I am rambling on again, and you listening so politely.
translation: 不像现在。只有很少年轻人……我怎么又开始唠叨了，你倒一直很有礼貌的听着……

original: Here you go, a nice sweetroll that I baked for you just this morning. And it's all for you -- no sharing required today!
translation: 给你，我今天早上刚细心烤好的甜面包卷。而且这是给你的 — 今天用不着分给别人！

original: Such a nice polite young man you are! Don't ever lose your gift of speaking your mind so directly. We could use more of that down here.
translation: 真是个懂礼貌的年轻人！不要丢掉你直言不讳的性格，在这我们需要像你这样的。

original: Here you go, a nice sweetroll that I baked for you just this morning. And it's all for you -- you're the birthday boy, no sharing required today!
translation: 给你，我今天早上刚细心烤好的甜面包卷。而且这是给你的 — 今天用不着分给别人！

original: Such a nice polite young lady you are! Don't ever lose your gift of speaking your mind so directly. We could use more of that down here.
translation: 真是个懂礼貌的年轻人！不要丢掉你直言不讳的性格，在这我们需要像你这样的。

original: Here you go, a nice sweetroll that I baked for you just this morning. And it's all for you -- you're the birthday girl, no sharing required today!
translation: 给你，我今天早上刚细心烤好的甜面包卷。而且这是给你的 — 今天用不着分给别人！

original: Ha ha ha! You told her, Butch!
translation: 哈哈哈！你跟她说了，布奇！

original: Or else what? Yeah, thought so.
Crazy how it sneaks up on you, y'know?
translation: 那些东西悄悄地靠近你，这太疯狂了，你懂吗？

original: Was I supposed to do it? I didn't hear Dave saying we had to!
translation: 我一定要这么做吗？我没听戴夫说过我们要这样！

original: Yeah, but it'd be better if I could vote.
translation: 嗯，但是如果我能投票的话更好。

original: Ugh why can't I just vote now?
translation: 呃，为什么我不能现在就投票？

original: I can't believe it's only a couple of days away.
translation: 难以置信才过去这么几天。

original: It's not a betrayal. This is a free, um, nation... right?
translation: 这不是叛国。这是个自由的……呃，国度……对吗？

original: It could be pretty tough, I guess.
Hmm, maybe you're right. More trouble than it's worth.
translation: 呃，或许你说的对。它带来的麻烦更甚于它的价值。

original: Have you considered running for the presidency?
translation: 你考虑过参加总统竞选吗？

original: I'm too young! I can't even vote yet.
translation: 我太年轻了！我连投票权都没有。

original: No way! You'd have to be crazy to run against him.
translation: 没门！你和他竞选简直就是疯了。

original: Believe it or not, I used to lead a group bigger than this one on an old caravan route.
translation: 信不信由你，以前我曾领导过一个比这还大的商队。

original: I did it for years... and we did pretty well for ourselves.
translation: 我干了好几年……而且我们干得很出色。

original: But what am I talking about? Running against Dave would be like betraying him.
translation: 但是我在说什么啊？跟戴夫竞选不就等于是背叛他吗？

original: Man, I'd love to be the president. Everybody would have to listen to me or I could just exile them to the Wasteland.
translation: 天啊，我好想当总统。所有人都得听我的，要不我就把他们流放到外头去。

original: And the first thing I'd do is make myself the permanent leader so they couldn't vote me out in some other election.
translation: 而且首先我要让自己成为永远的领袖，这样他们就不能靠选举让我下台。

original: But there's no need for me to run. One year Dave is just going to make me the leader, just like my Grandpa Tom did for him.
translation: 但是我没必要参选。总有一天戴夫就会让我成为领袖，就像我的爷爷汤姆当年做的那样。

original: I'd like to throw my hat into the ring and run for the presidency.
translation: 我想参与其中，参加总统竞选。

original: I'm sorry, but the president must be a citizen of the Republic to run for office. So you do not qualify.
translation: 我很遗憾，但是总统必须由共和国公民来担当。因此你不具备资格。

original: Um, did Dave say you could do that?
translation: 啊，戴夫允许你那样做了？

original: An opponent? Seriously? But... but... Wait. No, this is a free republic.
translation: 竞争对手？真的？但是……但是……等等。不，这是个自由的共和国。

original: Let the people make their choice. I am confident that they will recognize me as their true and proper leader.
translation: 让人民做出自己的选择。我自信他们会知道我才是他们真正的领袖。

original: Looks like you might have an opponent in the race, Mister President.
translation: 总统先生，看来你似乎遇到竞争对手了。

original: Wow, really? I've always said that she'd make a great leader, and we've never had a woman lead us before...
translation: 哇，真的么？我总是说她会成为一个好领袖，而且我们还从没有过一个女领袖。

original: You know, Rosie is running for president now.
He is? Wow... Dave must be upset.
translation: 是吗？哇……戴夫这下一定要紧张了。

original: You know, Bob is running for president now.
Wow, this is the first time we've had so many choices!
translation: 哇，这是第一次我们有这么多的选择！

original: Have you heard that both Bob and Rosie are running in the election?
translation: 你知道鲍勃和萝丝在竞选总统吗？

original: Hmm, I don't know that he stands much of a chance against Dave.
translation: 嗯……我不觉得他对戴夫有什么胜算。

original: You know, Bob is running for president.
Isn't he a bit young? I mean, Dave's been running the Republic since before Bob was born...
translation: 他不会太年轻了么？我的意思是，在鲍勃出生之前戴夫就已经是总统了……

original: You know, Bob is running for president now.
Well then, there you go. An election is what separates a president like myself from a monarch like my father.
translation: 那好，随你。正是选举将我这样的总统和我父亲那样的国王区分开来。

original: I don't consider myself a spy so much as... your assassin.
translation: 我不认为自己是个间谍……我是来刺杀你的。

original: Assassin? And you really thought you could succeed against the Army of Dave?
translation: 刺客？你真的觉得你能对付戴夫的军队？

original: Thought you'd get out of here, did you? You little shit. Get back inside, now.
translation: 你以为你能从这跑了？你这小混蛋！滚进去，快！

original: You're fuckin' dead, you hear me? Dead!
translation: 你他妈的死定了。你听见了没？你死定了！

original: Run Sammy, run! We can make it!
translation: 萨米快跑，快跑啊！我们能做到！

original: You can have it. I don't even like sweetrolls.
translation: 你拿去吧。我根本不喜欢甜面包卷。

original: Yeah, right. Thanks, loser. Oh, and happy birthday, ha ha ha ha!
translation: 嗯，对了。谢谢你，废物。哦，生日快乐，哈哈哈哈！

original: Mrs. Palmer said I didn't have to share. Since it's my birthday...
translation: 帕尔默大妈说我不用和别人分享。因为今天我生日……

original: "Mrs. Palmer said I didn't have to share"... Who's talking about sharing, moron? I want the whole thing.
translation: “帕尔默夫人说我不用和别人分享”……谁说要分享了？白痴，我要全部。

original: Now are you going to give me that sweetroll, or am I going to have to give you a knuckle sandwich?
translation: 现在你把甜面包圈给我？否则我给你个大耳光尝尝。

original: Sure, Butch. <Spit on the sweetroll and give it to him.>
translation: 好吧，布奇。<拿出甜面包卷啐了口然后给他>

original: Gah! I don't want your nerd-cooties! You're going to be sorry you did that. We'll see how tough you are later when the grownups aren't around.
translation: 恶！我不要你这恶心的东西！你会为你做的后悔的。等旁边没有大人，我们就走着瞧！

original: I'm doin' fine... fine indeed. How are you? ... I said how are you? What? Are you ignoring me? Stupid asshole robot...
translation: 我很好……真的很好。你呢？……我说你好？什么？你无视我？蠢货机器人……

original: She's dead, you know that. Lousy old data tapes...
translation: 她已经死了，你知道的。惹人厌的老古董……

original: Oh, it's great. Everything is perfect. Greta takes good care of us.
translation: 哦，一切正常，所有事情都很完美。葛丽泰将我们照顾的很好。

original: And a hello to you, ma'am.
Scanning... target identified as "Patchwork". Hello, Patchwork. I trust that all is well with you.
translation: 扫描…… 对象确认：“拼盘”。您好，“拼盘”。我相信你一切都好。

original: Scanning... target identified as "Patchwork". Hello, Patchwork. How are you?
translation: 扫描…… 对象确认：“拼盘”。您好，“拼盘”。你好吗？

original: Stop by the clinic, Patchwork. Greta found one of your fingers over in Carol's Place.
translation: 到诊断室来下，“拼盘”。葛丽泰在卡洛尔旅馆发现了你的一节拇指。

original: Come by the clinic some time, you're overdue for a sewing.
translation: 有空到诊所来下，你早该缝几针了。

original: Yes, yes, hello. We covered that already.
translation: 是，是，你好。我们已经搞定那些了。

original: Haven't lost anything permanently. Not yet.
translation: 还没有永久性地丢过任何东西，目前为止。

original: Hey there, long time, no see! I've got some good stories to tell you later!
translation: 嗨，很久不见了啊！我有一些很棒的故事等会跟你说！

original: Hey there, you should check out the new stuff I have at the store.
translation: 嗨，你应该看看我们商店的新货。

original: Hey, do you know how to reroute a fan belt? You know, never mind. I'll do it myself.
translation: 嗨，你知道怎么换风扇皮带？嗯……没关系，我自己来吧。

original: Yeah... kinda like onions... that's so strange...
Actually, I haven't noticed. At all.
translation: 老实说，我没注意。根本没在意。

original: I've forgotten the taste of good liquor.
translation: 我已经不记得好酒的味道了。

original: Dude. Harshing the buzz. Minus five points.
Well, aren't you a ray of sunshine?
translation: 嗯，你难道不是一缕阳光吗？

original: Ah, yes! Of course, of course, my friend. See me later tonight. We'll make sure that you have all the pick-me-ups that you need.
translation: 啊，没错！当然，当然，我的朋友。晚上见。我保证给你你所需要的提神剂。

original: Shhh, say no more. See me later, I'll make sure that you want for nothing.
translation: 嘘，别说了，待会见，我保证你到时会别无所求。

original: No need to be shy, my friend. I'll make sure that you have everything that you ever need, so long as you have the caps to pay for it, that is.
translation: 别不好意思，我的朋友，我能满足你的一切需求，只要你身上的瓶盖够多，就是这样。

original: I was wondering if I could get... you know... one of the special drinks.
translation: 不知我能不能得到……你知道……一杯特别的饮料。

original: I'm all out of the stuff you sold me yesterday. I need more. Fast.
translation: 你昨天卖我的东西已经用光了。我需要更多。赶快！

original: 2000 is a bit steep. 1200 for all three is a more reasonable offer.
translation: 2000个太离谱了。三个一共1200个倒是个合适的总价。

original: I suppose I can accept that. It's a deal; the kids are yours. I'll have them delivered to the front gate for you.
translation: 我想我能接受。成交，这些小孩都是你的了。我会把他们送到前门等你。

original: If I may, you might want to keep a close eye on them. They can be willful at times. Good luck.
translation: 我建议，你可能得盯着他们。他们有时会很任性，祝你好运。

original: That sounds like a good deal. I'll take it.
Fair enough. It's a pleasure to do business with you again.
translation: 很公平，与你做生意是件愉快的事。

original: I'll have the kids delivered to the front gate. And, may I recommend keeping a close eye on them? They're clever little bastards.
translation: 我会把孩子送到前门。同时，我能建议你看紧些吗？他们可是群聪明的小杂种。

original: A wise decision. It's a pleasure to do business with you.
translation: 明智的抉择。跟你做生意真是很愉快。

original: I'll have the kids delivered to the front gate. And, may I recommend keeping a close eye on them? They're clever little bastards.
translation: 我会把孩子送到前门。同时，我能建议你看紧些吗？他们可是群聪明的小杂种。

original: The little shits are your problem now. I see 'em around here again, I'm gonna shoot 'em. We clear?
translation: 那些小混蛋交给你了。要是我再看见他们在附近游荡，就朝他们开枪，明白了吗？

original: Look, kid. There's no such thing as monsters.
translation: 听着，孩子。那里没有什么所谓的怪物。

original: Then you can make these things go away!
Is there any special way to hurt them?
translation: 有什么特别办法来对付它们？

original: My pappa had a gun, and he said it hurt those things, but he said they were the dumbest Fuckin' Ants he ever saw.
translation: 我爸有枪，他说管用。但他还说那他妈的是他见过的最难缠的蚂蚁。

original: He kept telling everyone to "shoot for their antenner" whatever that means.
translation: 他总是不断地对大家说“打它们的触须”，不知道那是什么意思。

original: Naw. Those things started coming around only in the last few months.
translation: 不是。那些东西只是最近几个月才开始出现的。

original: At first they just crawled around outside our town, but later they came into town and... well, you know the rest.
translation: 一开始它们只是在镇子外面活动，但是最近它们开始在镇子里……嗯，就如你先前所见的。

original: Okay kid, I said I'd do it. Now scram!
translation: 好啦，孩子，我会帮你的。别哭啦！

original: Humph... you don't gotta be such a jerk about it.
There's an old portashelter next to the diner near my house. I'll be waiting inside for you to come back.
translation: 在我家与餐厅旁有一个圆形遮蔽所。我在那等你回来。

original: And don't you dare leave me alone!
translation: 还有你别想把我一个人扔在这。

original: Is there anywhere you can hide while I search?
translation: 我去找你爸爸的时候你不应该找个地方躲起来吗？

original: Well, there is the personal shelter next to the old diner.
translation: 嗯，有一个圆形遮蔽所就在餐厅旁。

original: Pappa always said to stay away from it... but, I guess it's supposed to be safe.
translation: 爸爸总是让我离那远点……但我觉得那里面很安全。

original: I'll head over there and wait inside. Hurry back!
translation: 我会躲在那里面。快点回来！

original: Okay. I'll go look for your father.
You will? Really? Thanks a whole lot!
translation: 你要帮我找爸爸？真的？太谢谢了！

original: My house is the one closest to the huge sign and the old diner.
translation: 我家是离那大标记和旧餐厅最近的那间。

original: Please... find my pappa and make him come back!
translation: 拜托……找到我爸爸并带他回来！

original: I can't imagine why she'd be more popular. Even assuming this is all true.
translation: 即使这是真的，我也无法想象她为什么会更受欢迎。

original: What're you suggesting, you little brat? I may not be on the science team anymore, but I still know how to keep records!
translation: 小杂种，你想说什么？我或许不再是科学团队的人，但我仍知道怎么保存记录！

original: Here! They probably don't even remember, but I kept the records of that first council meeting. Take them, if it'll put them in their place!
translation: 给！他们可能早就忘了，但我还保存着一些首次会议的记录。拿着，如果可以的话就请物尽其用吧！

original: Do you have any hard evidence of all this?
translation: 关于这些事，你能拿出什么确凿的证据吗？

original: Of course I do! A good scientist always keeps track of their data!
translation: 当然有！一个优秀的科学家总是保存着所有的数据资料。

original: Here! They probably don't even remember, but I kept the records of that first council meeting. Take them, if it'll put them in their place!
translation: 给！他们可能早就忘了，但我还保存着一些首次会议的记录。拿着，如果可以的话就请物尽其用吧！

original: So, you used to be in charge? How did you end up here?
translation: 你以前是掌权的？为何会落到今天这般田地？

original: That lasted until about 18 years ago, when those ambitious backbiters like Li and her little team showed up.
translation: 大概是在18年前，当像李和她的团队那样的野心团体萌芽时。

original: She came in with her big "Purity Project" pipe dream, and my whole staff started working with her, those traitors!
translation: 她带着宏伟的“净水工程”管道梦想而来，我的所有人都开始为她工作，那帮叛徒！

original: She even took my seat on the council. By then, I was glad to leave it behind. But hell if I'm leaving the city I made great!
translation: 她连我在议会的职位都抢了。那时，我也既往不咎了。但要我离开这个我一手创造的城市，见鬼去吧！

original: I'd like to discuss the election with you.
translation: 我想跟你谈谈关于选举的事情。

original: Are you kidding? Dave is dead. How can there be an election with a dead candidate?
translation: 你开什么玩笑？戴夫都已经死了。难道死人还能进行选举？

original: The election is still going on. What do you want to know?
translation: 选举还会继续举行。你还想知道些什么？

original: Me? I'm not sure if I can help you...
translation: 我？我不知道能不能帮上你……

original: I'll help you if I can.
Election time is always exciting around here.
translation: 选举的时刻总是激动人心。

original: Hmm. I suppose voting for Dave is the patriotic thing to do.
translation: 嗯。我想投戴夫的票是爱国行为。

original: All done! Dave is the best!
Good luck, Dave. You have my vote.
translation: 好运，戴夫。我投了你一票。

original: Ah, Dave. Lead our Republic to glory!
translation: 啊，戴夫。领导我们迈向荣耀！

original: Let's see what we have here.
Wait a minute, has somebody tampered with the ballot box?
translation: 等等，有人在投票箱上动过手脚吗？

original: Hmm... after counting the votes, the president is...
translation: 嗯……统计投票完毕，选出的总统是……

original: Well, looks like another triumphant victory for myself.
translation: 嗯，看起来我又一次胜利了。

original: Well, despite the hiccup, it looks like I am still declared the winner.
translation: 嗯，尽管有些小问题，但我最终还是顺利当选。

original: Well, despite the hiccup, it looks like I am still declared the winner.
translation: 嗯，尽管有些小问题，但我最终还是顺利当选。

original: ROSIE? Rosie can't be president! NO! This is unfair! This can't be! FINE! I'm LEAVING! See how you people do without me! Enjoy your new president!
translation: 萝丝？萝丝不可能当上总统的！不！这不公平！这不可能！好吧！我走！看没有我你们怎么活！为你们的新总统高兴吧！

original: BOB? Bob can't be president! NO! This is unfair! This can't be! FINE! I'm LEAVING! See how you people do without me! Enjoy your new president!
translation: 鲍勃？鲍勃不可能当上总统的！不！这不公平！这不可能！好吧！我走！看没有我你们怎么活！为你们的新总统高兴吧！

original: Hey! Leave that alone. If I wanted it off, I'd turn it off.
translation: 嗨！离那远点。是不是把它关掉得由我说了算。

original: You too, stranger. I know a lot of people around here don't take kindly to humans wandering around, but I've met a lot of your people in my travels.
translation: 我也很高兴，陌生人。我们这的多数人都对来这的人类不太友好，但是我在旅途中遇到过很多像你这样的人类。

original: What? You're not going to tell me how rare it is to see a human in Underworld?
translation: 什么？你别告诉我在地下城很少能见到人类。

original: Me? No, not at all. I'm used to your people. Truth is, I spend most of my time away from Underworld.
translation: 我？不，没关系。我习惯和你们在一起了。老实说，其实我很少待在地下城里。

original: Who, me? Yeah... yeah... I'm fine. I guess. No... Yeah. I'll be okay. I just... I just need to try not to lose any more of my parts this time...
translation: 谁？我？嗯……嗯……我很好。我想。不……是的……我会没事的。我只是……只是想这回不要再掉些什么零件出来了。

original: Doc Barrows says that he's... he's getting' tired of puttin' 'em back on... me. So, you know... if you see any, just bring 'em back.
translation: 巴罗斯医生说他……他试着把我掉下来的那些身件零件再装回去……所以……你看……如果你找到我身上的东西，就拿来给我。

original: I think I can help you out.
Be careful with these. They're not toys, you know.
translation: 小心使用。你要明白，它们可不是玩具。

original: Very well. What do you require?
This place is coming down around our ears.
It a miracle that some of this shit works in the first place. I guess it's just a matter of time...
translation: 想让这堆垃圾运作起来简直就是奇迹。我想这迟早会……

original: Sorry, kid. Your old man is ant food.
translation: 我很抱歉，孩子。你老爸已经成了蚂蚁的晚餐了。

original: You... you know what you are? You're a big asshole! That's right... an asshole! My pappa said never to say that word, but you deserve it!
translation: 你……你知道你这算什么？你这大混蛋！没错……混蛋！爸爸告诉我不要说脏话，但是这词对你正合适！

original: Now what am I going to do? My pappa's dead... poor pappa...
translation: 现在我该怎么办？爸爸死了……可怜的爸爸……

original: I guess I already knew. Besides, I'm too tired to cry anymore.
translation: 我想我已经猜到了。还有，我太累了，已经不想再哭了。

original: Bryan, I'm sorry, but your father is dead.
translation: 布赖恩，我很抱歉，但是你的父亲已经不在了。

original: I guess I already knew. Besides, I'm too tired to cry anymore.
translation: 我想我已经猜到了。还有，我太累了，已经不想再哭了。

original: Looks like all the votes are in, Mister President.
translation: 似乎投票已经完成了，总统先生。

original: Not yet. Rosie still hasn't voted.
Are the votes in, Mister President?
translation: 总统先生，投票完成了吗？

original: Good, the votes are in. If you'll excuse me, I'll be getting started on tallying the numbers.
translation: 好的，所有人都投票了。失陪，我要开始统计票数了。

original: Oh yes, I almost forgot. Here's your caps. Keep this up and I may deign to make you a citizen, in a few years.
translation: 哦，对了，我几乎忘了。这是你的瓶盖。拿着吧，过几年或许我会让你也成为这的公民。

original: Rosie somehow came up with the most votes.
translation: 萝丝不知何故获得了最多选票。

original: There must be some kind of bug in the voting system.
translation: 投票系统肯定出了问题。
总统先生，票选结果如何？
鲍勃居然在选举中胜出。

original: I should have known the little bastard was conspiring against me.
translation: 我就应该知道那小杂种要密谋造反。
总统先生，票选结果如何？

original: It was kind of my fault. You know how easy it is to make Butch mad...
translation: 这好像是我的错。你知道要把布奇搞得发狂有多容易……

original: You never learn, do you? You can't help shooting your mouth off even when you know it's going to get you a bloody nose.
translation: 你还是记不住，管好你的嘴，明知会被揍还这么多废话。

original: Uh oh, your dad is giving me a look. I'd better let everybody else have a turn with the birthday boy.
translation: 哦，你爸爸正盯着我呢。我想我最好让所有人都有和小寿星说话的机会。

original: Have you heard the election results?
Dave won again? Well, he's the best choice.
translation: 戴夫又赢了？嗯，他的确是最佳选择。

original: Did you hear that Dave won the election?
He did? Wow, I'd of never guessed that possible.
translation: 是吗？哇，我从没想过还有那种可能。

original: Did you hear Bob won the election?
Yes, but it's still quite a shock.
Can you believe that Bob won the election?
Did you hear that Dave won the election?
Why, did Dave get too old?
Did you hear that Dave lost the election?
translation: 你知道吗？戴夫没能当选。

original: Did Dave win it again? I'd have voted for him if they'd let me.
translation: 戴夫又赢了吗？如果他们让我投票，我也会投他。

original: Did Dave win it again? I voted for him you know.
translation: 戴夫又赢了吗？你知道我又投给他了。

original: Rosie's going to be the new leader? What will Dave do?
translation: 萝丝是新领袖？那戴夫怎么办？

original: Have you heard that Rosie won the election?
Have you heard that Bob won the election?
I won it? Are you sure?
Oh man, I can't believe it. I won't let the voters down, I promise!
translation: 天啊，我不敢相信……我不会让选民们失望的，我保证！
我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

original: Can you believe that you won the election?
Rosie won, huh? She better not try and boss me around, that's for damn sure.
translation: 萝丝赢了，呃？她最好不要想来命令我，决不！

original: Did you hear Rosie won the election?
Now I just got to name this place after me.
translation: 现在我要将这地方改成我的名字。

original: Looks like you'll be the new leader, Bob.
translation: 鲍勃，看来你是新的领导人了。

original: Sure, I can spare some water. <Give 1 water.>
translation: 当然，我能匀出一些水。<给予1瓶水>

original: You just saved my life. I won't forget it.
translation: 你刚刚救了我一命。我不会忘记的。

original: <sighs> I was saying that you need to get some rest, Carol. You hardly ever sleep at night, don't think that I haven't noticed.
translation: <叹息>我的意思是你得休息，卡洛尔。你经常睡眠不足吧，别以为我不知道。

original: Hrm? Oh, hey Greta... what were you saying?
translation: 嗯？哦……你好，葛丽泰……你说什么了？

original: Good. I'm glad we're clear on that.
translation: 好的。很高兴我们在这点上澄清了。

original: Are you blind? Never mind, don't bother grunting a response. You need to watch these assholes better. Some stuff has turned up missing.
translation: 你瞎了还是怎么？算了，别想借口了。你盯紧这些混蛋，店里已经开始丢东西了。

original: What... what do you mean? I'm not... I'm not... I'm not even drunk right now!
translation: 你……你什么意思？我……我还……我还没醉呢！

original: I... I can't talk about it. Not yet.
translation: 我……我不能谈这事。还不行。

original: I... I can't talk about it. Not yet.
translation: 我……我不能谈这事。还不行。

original: Sounds like you need some of Ahzrukhal's special cough medicine.
translation: 看来你需要阿祖卡的特效咳嗽药。

original: Poor doc Barrows, you people are falling apart without him, aren't you?
translation: 可怜的巴罗斯医生，没了他，你们这帮人就不行了，不是吗？

original: You really suck at conversation, robot.
translation: 你说的话真难听，机器人。

original: Command not parsed. Please restate command.
translation: 命令无法分析，请重新输入……

original: Well, that's good. That's good to hear, Cerberus. Anything else going on?
translation: 嗯，好的。听起来很好，地狱犬。还发生了什么？

original: Threat level alpha. Disturbance level zero.
Dammit. I thought I fixed that. No time now, resume your patrol Cerberus. I'll deal with it later.
translation: 真该死，我以为我修好了。现在没时间了，继续巡逻，地狱犬。我迟点再来处理。

original: Damn worthless... it never ends with you, does it? Just resume your patrol, I'll take you offline for service later.
translation: 该死，这没用……它从来就没好用过，不是吗？继续巡逻，迟点我让你离线服务器。

original: For Christ's sake, that's the fourth time this month. Just go back on patrol, I'm sure you'll be fine.
translation: 老天，这月第四次了。继续巡逻，我确信你一定会好的。

original: Unit weapon system 2B ammunition level low. Please service at earliest convenience.
translation: 单位武器系统2B弹药量低。请尽快补充。

original: Unit cognition system experiencing fluctuating contact. Unable to determine source of failure.
translation: 单位认知系统发现接触波动。无法确认错误来源。

original: Unit target recognition system contains failure of an unknown class. Advise immediate unit service for repair.
translation: 单位目标识别系统包含未知等级错误。建议单位立即维护送修。

original: Unit locomotion system contains a class two failure. Currently operable. Failure will escalate to class one with a 47% probability.
translation: 单位动力系统包含一个2级错误。正在执行，错误上升至1级的可能性：47%。

original: Well, give the report, you old bucket of bolts. I haven't got all day.
translation: 嗯，给我报告，你这堆废铁。我可没太多闲工夫。

original: Well? Do you think I asked just out of curiosity? Give me the report, dammit.
translation: 嗯？你认为我只是好奇才问的？该死，给我报告。

original: Unit diagnostics system compiling... diagnostics system ready. Running level 2 diagnostics... complete. Report prepared.
translation: 单位诊断系统编译中……诊断系统就绪。运行2级诊断……完毕。报告就绪。

original: Unit diagnostics... running... running... complete. Report prepared.
translation: 单位诊断……运行……运行……完毕。报告就绪。

original: Wow. Well, okay. I'll go have a look.
I could go for some noodles. You got any?
No refunds if you don't keep it down this time. Now, what can I get you?
translation: 这次不小声点可不退款，你需要什么？

original: I'll just be here sobering up until you get back.
translation: 在你回来前，我在这儿清醒一下。

original: Sure, if you don't mind waiting a few minutes.
translation: 当然，如果你不介意等一会。

original: I don't care, really. Whatever takes the pain away.
translation: 我不在乎，真的。任何能止痛的东西都行。

original: <sigh> Fine. I'll have the... squirrel. Cooked, please.
translation: <叹息>好吧。我就来……松鼠吧。请煮熟。

original: Well then, what are you complaining about? Oh, I forgot, you're a bitter bastard. Just tell me what you want to eat.
translation: 那个，你在抱怨什么？哦，我忘了，你是个该死的混蛋。就直说你想吃什么吧。

original: Very funny, Greta. I'd happily prepare my own meals if I could ever get anything was wasn't moldy, rotten, or still squirming.
translation: 很有趣，葛丽泰。如果能搞到任何没有发霉、发臭或腐烂的东西，我很高兴自己做了吃。

original: If you don't like what we have, Crowley, you can always go hunt rats in the tunnels with the ferals.
translation: 如果你不喜欢我们的菜，考利，你可以自己去满是野兽的隧道里抓老鼠。

original: Excellent. I'll have another task for you soon.
translation: 棒极了。我很快就会有第二个任务给你。

original: I've got something on my mind, Charon. I had asked you to do something and you never reported back to me. You did it, didn't you?
translation: 我突然想起来了，卡戎。我让你做些事情，可你从来没向我报告。你搞定了，对吧？

original: You know that I can't stop worrying about you. Just think about it, okay?
translation: 你知道我没办法不担心你。好好想想，好吗？

original: They don't need to worry about me, Greta, and neither do you. I'll be okay.
translation: 他们不必担心我，葛丽泰，你也一样，我会没事的。

original: C'mon, Carol. It's me, I can see through you. It's gotten so bad that the customers have started to notice.
translation: 别这样，卡洛尔。是我，我太了解你了。你状况太糟，连顾客都注意到了。

original: Oh, Greta, baby. You don't need to worry about me, I was just lost in my thoughts. You know how it is.
translation: 哦，葛丽泰，孩子，你用不着为我担心，我只是想得有些入神了，你知道的。

original: Oh, you'd be surprised. I may be old, but this place'd shut down without me. Just think about what I said, we'll talk later.
translation: 哦，估计会让你感觉惊讶。我可能已经老了，但这地方没了我恐怕就要关门了。想想我说的话，我们可以迟点再说。

original: Don't you threaten me. You wouldn't dare do that, these people would have your head.
translation: 你别想来威胁我，你不敢的，这些人立刻就能要了你的脑袋。

original: Sure, sure, you're here to make money, and I fix all of your crap so that you can keep right on making that money. What would happen if I stopped?
translation: 好吧，好吧，你是来赚钱的，而我得先修好你那堆废物，你才能继续赚钱。如果没有我，你会怎样？

original: Stop serving him? This is a bar. How am I supposed to make money if I'm not serving booze? If he's got money, I'll give him whatever he asks for.
translation: 不卖东西给他？这是酒吧。我不卖酒怎么赚钱？如果他有钱，他要什么我就卖他什么。

original: It's about Patchwork. You need to stop feeding him booze, Ahzrukhal. The boy can barely stand most of the time, and you just keep serving him.
translation: 是关于“拼盘”的。你别再继续卖酒给他了，阿祖卡，那孩子已经站立不稳，你却还不停地卖酒给他。

original: I want you to stop giving Patchwork booze when he's already drunk. You're gonna kill the boy.
translation: “拼盘”已经醉了，你别再卖酒给他了。你是想杀了这孩子吧。

original: No time to talk right now, Winthrop. Come back later.
translation: 现在没空聊天，温思罗普。我们迟点再见。
好，好极了。接下来怎么办？

original: Well, with the terminal, I can turn off the collars and open up the gate. But they're not gonna just let us walk out of here, you know?
translation: 嗯，有了终端，我就能关闭项圈，并把门打开。但他们也不会就这么让我们随便走出去，你懂吗？

original: There's always at least one guard near the pen, and someone's gotta get rid of him.
translation: 围栏旁总是至少有一个守卫，得有人收拾他。

original: Since we can't just walk around like we own the place, you're gonna have to do it. You get me?
translation: 在这我们可不能像在家里一样随意走动，得靠你去解决，明白吗？

original: Could I help with the election, Mister President?
translation: 总统阁下，我能为选举效劳吗？

original: Alright sure, why not. The people have a tendency to wait until the last minute to vote, but I'd like just to get it over with.
translation: 当然，为什么不呢。人们倾向于到了最后的时刻才投票，而我希望能尽快。

original: I'll spare a few caps if you just tell each of the adults to get over to the voting booth sometime today so I cinch the victory.
translation: 如果你让其它的成年选民来投票，让我顺利当选，我就给你报酬。

original: Not that I have anything to worry about. The people know who their leader is in this Republic.
translation: 不是说我在担心。大家都知道谁才是这个共和国的领袖。

original: So who can tell me how Dave saved the people from the wrath of Tom?
translation: 谁能告诉我戴夫是怎样从汤姆的魔爪下拯救人民的。

original: Somebody name three things Tom did wrong before Dave became the president.
translation: 谁能给出戴夫当总统之前，汤姆做的三件错事。

original: Anybody know what year Dave took back the government for the people?
translation: 谁知道戴夫是在哪一年为人民带来了民主共和制度？

original: I hope you're paying attention, Rachael. I'll give another pop quiz. I'll do it.
translation: 我希望你留神，拉克尔。我会再问你问题的。我会的。

original: Remember your homework is to prepare a speech on the "Merits of Dave."
translation: 记住你的作业就是准备一次“戴夫的伟大功绩”的演讲。

original: All right, all right. I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好的，好的。我看看我能做些什么。

original: That name is not to be spoken within this Citadel. Do you understand? I wish it were not so, truly I do, but he is Outcast. He has been judged.
translation: 那名字不应该在五角大本营内提起。明白吗？我希望不是那个样子，我真的希望，但他是放逐者。他被判决了。

original: You'll make do, Bowditch. You always do.
translation: 你能行的，鲍蒂奇。你一直很行。

original: If only we were all so lucky. I have work to do.
translation: 要是大伙都那么走运就好了。我还有工作要做。

original: You know me, Dusk. I was born ready for anything!
translation: 达斯科，你是了解我的。我一生下来就准备好了！

original: For someone who should be preparing for an assault, you seem to have a lot of time to be social.
translation: 对于一个应该时刻准备突袭的人来说，你还差远了。

original: A few people. But I don't get tired of hearing it.
translation: 有几个。但是我还没听够呢。

original: You're really scary, Dusk. Has anyone ever told you that?
translation: 你真疯狂，达斯科。有人告诉过你吗？

original: You're a frightening woman, Dusk. Anyone ever tell you that?
translation: 你是个好斗的女人，达斯科。有人这么跟你说过吗？

original: I care. If I were aiming for his nose, that'd be fine. But I wasn't. I was going for the eye. Sloppy...
translation: 我在乎。如果我当时瞄准的是他的鼻子就好了。但我瞄的是眼睛。晕……

original: A couple of inches? So you'd have taken out his nose instead of his eye? So what!
translation: 几英寸？你宁愿打下他的鼻子而不是眼睛？那又怎样！

original: Bullshit. That third shot dropped by a couple of inches.
translation: 胡说。第三枪打偏了几英寸。

original: I haven't heard a damn thing.
Oh, don't worry about me. You just go enjoy your drink.
translation: 哦，别担心我。你好好品尝美酒吧。

original: I'm fine, I'm just fine. Thank you for your concern. I'm fine.
translation: 我很好，我真的很好。多谢关心。我很好。

original: Sorry, I don't mean to pry. It just seems like you should be doing more than this.
translation: 对不起，我无意催促你。只是你似乎应该做得更多。

original: Well... I mean, yeah. I ain't exactly in charge here, but I'm Eulogy's right-hand man.
translation: 嗯……我是说，是的。我并不是这里的主管，但是我是尤勒基的得力助手。

original: Some other jackass should be pulling nighttime guard duty. Maybe I'll go have a little chat with Eulogy about that.
translation: 该让别的家伙来值夜岗。或许我应该和尤勒基谈谈这事。

original: It just seems like you do most of the work around here.
translation: 看来你在这做了大部分的工作。

original: Yeah, so maybe I get a raw deal sometimes. Everybody does out here. That's the way shit goes.
translation: 嗯，或许有时我受到一些不公平待遇。但是这的每个人都这样。在这就是这样。

original: But maybe it's time that changed. Maybe I go see Eulogy about that right now, in fact.
translation: 或许是时候要改变了。事实上我得立刻去找尤勒基谈谈。

original: I was just wondering, really. I figure you must make more than the others.
translation: 事实上我刚才一直在想。我想你肯定比别人赚得多。

original: Maybe... And maybe it's time to see Eulogy about a raise.
translation: 或许……是的，或许是时候找尤勒基谈谈加薪的问题了。

original: Oh, dear. Well, I guess the dangers around those old supplies keeps it from being smooth sailing. Otherwise, they'd already have been looted, huh?
translation: 哦，亲爱的。嗯，我想因为这些补给品还在这里就是因为周围充满了危险。要不然它们早就被洗劫一空了，呃？

original: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
translation: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。

original: Here, take a bit, my treat - taste kind of grates after a while.
translation: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。

original: Oh, and take this! It's an old Food Sanitizer. Just carry it with you, and it should automatically make most food and drink more, um... better.
translation: 噢，拿着这个。这是一台旧食品净化器。带上它，能自动让大部分食物和饮料都更，呃……好。

original: It's very hard to talk my way past that many people shooting at me...
translation: 我都不愿跟你提起我以前被人拿着枪追杀的日子……

original: That's a pretty good way of putting it. I think I'll use that in the book. Maybe I should credit you as a co-author, instead of just a researcher?
translation: 把这记下来非常有价值。我想把这些写进那本书里。在那本书里我或许该把你作为合著者，而不仅仅是一名研究员。

original: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them.
translation: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。

original: Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine. And looking at this landmine, it gives me an idea. It's a terrible device that does terrible things, of course. But it's easy to make your own, too.
translation: 拿几件我的应急玩具吧。看看这地雷，它给了我一个灵感。当然，这可怕的装置会造成可怕的后果。但是这东西制作简单，连你也能做。

original: Fast hands and faster wits can get you an awful lot. Including landmines.
translation: 手快，脑子好也会让你倒霉。比如碰到地雷。

original: Oh my, Raiders had set up camp there? I'm guessing you didn't just negotiate with them, did you?
translation: 哦，天啊，歹徒在那建了个营地？我想你没有和他们谈判，对吧？

original: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
translation: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。

original: Here, take a bit, my treat -- taste kind of grates after a while.
translation: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。

original: Those big, shadowy stores can be great for hiding out.
translation: 这些昏暗的大仓库用来藏身是再好不过了。

original: Oh, that isn't what I want at all. People already have all sorts of ways to kill them. We don't need a more lethal Mole Rat trap. Just a better one.
translation: 哦，那不是我想要的。人们已经知道了所有杀死它们的方法。我们不需要更致命的地鼠陷阱。我们只需要更好的。

original: I guess it's back to the drawing board for that repellent. I wonder if I can make it into some sort of fuel. Anyway, I'll just take that.
translation: 我想我必须要重新设计这些驱鼠剂。我想知道能否能把它做成一种燃料。总之，就这样吧。

original: Oh, but for your trouble, umm... Here, have the leftover chems from working on the repellent. I'm sure you can find some use for them.
translation: 哦，为了补偿你遇到的麻烦，唔……拿着这些造驱鼠剂剩下的药品吧，我确定你会找到用处的。

original: Well, at least it's non-lethal for people. For Mole Rats... not so much.
translation: 至少这对人来说不是致命的。对地鼠来说…就不然了。

original: Hrm. Well, I knew that. But I guess it does raise the question of whether or not they have a language. Maybe I should study that later.
translation: 嗯，我早就知道。但我认为他们到底有没有自己的语言还是个疑问。或许我应该迟点再去研究。

original: I wish we could have gotten more information, but this'll have to do for the book.
translation: 我希望我们得到更多的信息，但这对写书就够了。

original: Here's your pay. Maybe they'll help you be sneakier next time.
translation: 这是你的报酬，希望日后会助你潜行更隐秘。

original: They're savages with big claws and absolutely no interest in small talk.
translation: 他们是长着巨爪的野人，对谈话毫无兴趣。

original: That'd hardly be ethical, really. But if there's nothing more factual to go on...
translation: 这可不合情理。但如果没有更实际的方法了……

original: Oh well. Still, for your help, have a few of these. They may help out next time you need to talk to a few folks.
translation: 好吧，为了感谢你的帮助，拿着这些，它们在你下次与人交谈时会有点帮助的。

original: I suppose it wouldn't hurt to add a nice story to it. And it'd be a nice little reward for your hard work to include you as a hero.
translation: 我想加一个动听的故事进去不会有什么坏处。而且我会把你作为一个英雄编进去，作为你努力工作的报酬。

original: None of them agree on a story. So let's just say I set the whole place up.
translation: 他们莫衷一是。干脆就是说那个地方是我建造的吧。

original: Oh, I don't know about that. But I guess you do. And it's a good enough example for the book, I suppose.
translation: 哦，我说不好，但你肯定清楚。我认为这作为书中一个案例还是不错的。

original: It helps to have the right tool for the job. Failing that, go with the right tool to cheat at the job. Like a pulse grenade.
translation: 工欲善其事，必先利其器。失败的话，就得拿正确的工具去完成它，比如脉冲手榴弹。

original: Make the right connection, and robots do what you want. Just like people.
translation: 只要连接正确，机器人就能做你想做的事，就像真人一样。

original: Well, maybe the Raiders will try reading a few of the books. Maybe it'll open their eyes to a few things.
translation: 嗯，或许歹徒会读书。或许他们的眼界会变得开阔。

original: Still, it's good to know it's standing. Maybe I'll inspire someone to take care of the place.
translation: 不过，还是很高兴知道它还在。或许我该鼓励其他人去保护那。

original: Have some caps as payment for that little bit of hope.
translation: 给你些瓶盖作为这一线希望的报酬。

original: Oh, it's still there, but it's full of Raiders. The place is a death trap.
translation: 哦，它还在那，不过周围都是歹徒。那是个死亡陷阱。

original: I'm taking a break from the research.
Don't take too long. The sooner the book's done, the more people we can save with it!
translation: 别太久。这书尽快写完，我们就可以拯救更多的人！

original: No, Carol. I'd love to hear your story.
translation: 不，卡洛尔。我愿意听你的故事。

original: Well, okay... but it's nothing special.
translation: 嗯，好吧……不过没什么特别。

original: I was born in 2051, so yes, that makes me a Pre-War Ghoul.
translation: 我生于2051年，是的，我是战前僵尸。

original: How did you end up working for...
Not going to talk about it. Don't ask.
Let me see the real goods.
I must ask that you speak to no one about our transactions.
translation: 我必须要求你不要把这次交易告诉任何人。

original: He doesn't say much, does he?
His company is rather refreshing, isn't it? But don't mistake his brevity for stupidity. That would be very unwise.
translation: 身边有他会非常令人愉快，不是吗？不过不要将他的寡言少语当作愚笨。那非常不明智。

original: Underestimating an opponent has been the last mistake of far too many individuals throughout history.
translation: 历史上太多人所犯的最后一个错误就是低估他们的对手。

original: Fine, in a little bit. Geez.
I bet Ralph isn't doing anything, why don't you ask him?
translation: 我敢说拉尔夫现在没事，为什么你不去问问他呢？

original: Why don't you ask Rachael if she can play?
translation: 为什么你不问问拉克尔能否和你玩呢？

original: You're on your own, pal. I've got more important things to do.
translation: 你得靠你自己了，伙计。我有其他更重要的事。

original: That's it, huh? Just toss me out of the box and into the meat grinder?
translation: 就这样，呃？刚把我从“盒子”里救出来，又把我扔进绞肉机？
谢谢你什么也没干，混蛋。

original: We'll have to run for it.
Okay, if you say so. I'll be right behind you. If you can get me to the front gate, I can take it from there.
translation: 好吧，既然你这样说。我会跟在你后面。如果你能把我带到前门，在那我就能自己走了。

original: We need to be careful. Stay low and stay quiet.
translation: 我们得小心点。悄悄地低身行走。

original: You got it. I'll stay right with you. Get me to the front gate, and I can make a run for it from there.
translation: 好吧。我会紧跟着你。把我带到前门，我就可以自己走了。
间谍来调查什么？你的拖车屋？

original: If the Capitol Building does not meet your incredible standards, feel free to escort yourself out. In fact, just leave now.
translation: 如果国会大厦不符合你那超高的标准，那你就把自己送出去吧。实际上，你快走吧。

original: "A slice of melon may be divine, but lest you spoil the meal, mind the rind"
translation: “一小片甜瓜味道不错，但小心瓜皮，会破坏肉香”

original: Stand clear, vagabonds, rapscallions and Ne'erdowells.
translation: 流浪汉、恶棍和饭桶站开。

original: Time for your walk, family pet.
Do you remember the day the war started?
translation: 你还记得战争开始的那天是怎样的吗？

original: I do... I was in a shelter with my father when the bombs hit. In D.C., we had the luxury of getting a warning after the west coast was... gone...
translation: 是的……我记得当核弹落下时我正和父亲藏在躲避处。我们在华盛顿特区，当美国西海岸……消失……后我们幸运地得到了警报。

original: I was just a little girl then. We couldn't afford a space in one of the Vaults. I remember filing down into that shelter, my father rushing me in.
translation: 那时我还只是个小女孩。我们承担不起在居住到避难所的花费。我记得我父亲把我推进那躲避处。

original: He stopped to help this one family, and I looked up and called his name... there was a flash of light, brighter than anything you can imagine.
translation: 他再也无法帮助唯一的家人了，我向上望并呼喊着他的名字……一道亮光闪过，比你能想象的一切都亮。

original: I woke up a few hours later. The first thing I did was run up to where my father had been. He... he was gone. But the strangest thing...
translation: 几小时后，我醒过来。我第一时间跑到我父亲之前站的地方。他……他不见了。但最意想不到的是……

original: There was his shadow, burned into the wall, so crisp and clear like he was standing next to me. The heat had burned it into the concrete...
translation: 那有他的影子，在墙上烧出的印记，那么诡异却又那么清晰，好像他就站在我身边。那热量把它烧进了墙里……

original: Oh, great! And you look like it went fine! So, how was it?
translation: 哦，好极了！看上去很顺利！办得怎么样？

original: I got through Minefield alive, and I even brought you a present. <Lie.>
translation: 我活着穿过了雷区，还给你带回来个礼物。<撒谎>

original: My very own landmine! Just what I've always wanted. Well, always since I sent you out on this, anyway.
translation: 我的地雷！就是我一直想得到的。嗯，至少是我派你去拿之后我一直想得到的。

original: Now, tell me all about it. What was it like going through there? What's it like disarming a landmine?
translation: 现在，和我谈谈。经历怎么样？解除地雷的感觉是什么样的？

original: I got through Minefield alive, and I even brought you a present. <Lie.>
translation: 我活着穿过了雷区，还给你带回来个礼物。<撒谎>

original: Oh, come on. You barely even left! I can't imagine you tested it on a reasonable number of subjects so quickly. It can't have been a good sample size.
translation: 哦，拜托。你几乎就没离开过！我无法想象你能这么快地做了一系列实验。这试验结果没意义。

original: I tested it out, and it works just fine. <Lie.>
translation: 我测试过了，没问题。<撒谎>

original: There's 100 caps in it for you.
Now that I think about it, Forty has been lookin' mighty fine lately. Workin' out extra.
translation: 现在回想起来，弗替最近变强壮了。他加强了锻炼。

original: Maybe I'll go see if there's anything I can do for him. You keep this between me and you. Clear?
translation: 或许我会到那看看有什么能帮他的。你不能把这事告诉别人。明白吗？

original: Well, I'll be damned... That little so-and-so... why didn't I think of that when I was sixteen?
translation: 嗯，真想不到……这些细节……我16岁的时候怎么没考虑过那些问题？

original: Yes, he's safe. Now get moving!
translation: 是的，他安全了。现在快走吧！

original: Don't follow me. You go out the normal way, and meet Sammy and me outside.
translation: 别跟着我。你不动声色地出去，然后再和我、萨米会合。

original: I got him out, all right. Now it's your turn.
translation: 我把他救出去了，没问题。现在该你了。

original: Thank you so much. I'll make it up to you somehow, I promise.
translation: 非常感谢你。我保证我会报答你的。

original: Now I have to get out. Don't follow me; you go out the normal way. We'll meet outside.
translation: 现在我得走了。别跟着我；你不动声色地出去。我们在外面会合。

original: Did you hear anyone mention anything about an Ant Queen?
translation: 你听到过什么人提过蚁后的事吗？

original: Well... yeah. I think I heard Doc Lesko mention something like a queen or something.
translation: 呃……是的。我想莱斯科医生提过蚁后。

original: Something about "laying eggs" whatever that means.
He said the queen would never be above ground. That he'd have to find her. Weird huh?
translation: 他说过蚁后是不会出现在地表上的。所以他必须找到她。挺奇怪，不是吗？

original: Ah, you've managed to sniff the trail! Good job. Keep me informed on your progress...
translation: 啊，你嗅到了他的踪迹！干得好。有新的进展立刻告诉我……

original: Well? Why are you still standing there?
I'm tracking down the location and equipment used to perform the face job.
translation: 我在追踪整容手术地点和使用的设备。

original: Can I have some time to think about it?
translation: 能给我点时间考虑一下吗？

original: Of course. I know this is an unusual request, but hey, I'm an unusual tree huh?. Well, Bob is anyway...
translation: 当然。我知道这是不寻常的要求，但是，嗨，我也不是一棵寻常的树。嗯，也许鲍勃才是那树……

original: We'll just keep it an open invitation then. I don't want to wait until the next person visits, it could be years... you're all I've got.
translation: 那我们就把这事当长期有效的邀请吧。我可不想等到下一个人来访，那可能得好几年……现在就指望你了。

original: Look, I really don't want to kill you...
translation: 听着，我真的不想杀了你……

original: Of all the Wastelanders I had to bump into it has to be one with a conscience.
translation: 那么多废土客中，我偏偏碰到了个有良心的人。

original: Let's keep it an open invitation then. I don't want to wait until the next person visits, it could be years.
translation: 那就算是长期有效的邀请吧。我可不想等到下一个人来访，那可能是好几年后了。

original: Just, just, think about it, okay?
You will? Oh, oh! You've... you've made us so happy! Isn't that right Bob?
translation: 你愿意？哦，哦！你……你让我们太开心了！对吧，鲍勃？

original: Just give me a little time to say goodbye to good old Bob and then I'll be ready.
translation: 给我点时间跟老伙计鲍勃道个别，然后我就准备好了。

original: You've been in a coma... chances are the Rangers are already dead.
translation: 你一直昏迷着……很可能游骑兵都已经死了。

original: No! There is no way my guys are dead!
If there's even the slimmest chance of surviving, they'll do it.
translation: 即使只有一线生机，他们也会去尝试的。

original: If you won't go, stop wasting my fucking time and find me someone who will!
translation: 如果你不愿意去，就别他妈浪费我的时间，找个愿意去的人！

original: Why don't you attempt a rescue? Your legs broken or something?
translation: 你为什么不试试去救他们呢？你腿瘸了还是怎么？

original: I can barely walk right now, let alone climb a skyscraper. If I could even hold a pistol, I would go get my guys right now!
translation: 现在我几乎无法行走，更别提爬上摩天大楼。如果我现在能拿起手枪的话，我会立刻救回我的人！

original: I'm using everything I've got just standing here talking to you. Get the point?
translation: 我正在用所有力量为了在这和你说话。懂了吗？

original: You look terrible. Maybe I shouldn't have woken you up so quickly.
translation: 你看上去很糟。或许我不该这么快弄醒你。

original: Heh, I feel worse than I look, but that doesn't even matter to me. I'm just worried about the rest of the Rangers.
translation: 呃，我的感觉比外表还糟，但我不在乎。我只是担心其他的游骑兵。

original: I don't even know if they're still alive.
translation: 我甚至不知道他们是死是活。

original: Why do you want this code so badly?
translation: 为什么你这么急切地想知道密码？

original: You know why. We can't start the purifier without it. The longer the purifier isn't running, the more people suffer.
translation: 你知道为什么吗？没有密码我们就无法启动净化器。净化器停止运作的时间越长，就会有更多的人受苦。

original: Now I'm running out of patience. I want that code, and I want it now.
translation: 孩子，我快没耐性了。我现在就要知道密码。

original: Fine, but what am I supposed to do here? Work on my needlepoint or something?
translation: 好吧，但是我在这该干嘛？刺绣还是怎么？

original: I shall wait here until you return for me.
translation: 我会等着，直到你来找我。

original: But it's so boring all alone!
translation: 但一个人在这等太孤单了！

original: Don't piss around, I don't want to be standing here with my thumb up my ass all day.
translation: 别胡闹。我不想整天在这。

original: I will keep this location secure!
If you insist. But do be careful - I can hardly repay your kindness while waiting back here.
translation: 如果你坚持。但是务必小心 — 在这干等的话,我可还不了你人情。

original: I shall reflect on the battles past and the battles to come until your return.
translation: 我会在你回来前，反省已经结束的战斗，并且准备好即将到来的战斗。

original: If this means more stuff for Butch, I'm all for it.
translation: 如果这东西对布奇很重要，我全力支持。

original: You're always welcome to take whatever you want, lover.
translation: 你要拿什么都随便，亲爱的。

original: RL-3 comes equipped with everything a good soldier needs! But your RL-3 can assist in carrying equipment, if needed.
translation: RL-3配备了全套的士兵装备！而在需要时，你的RL-3还可以帮你携带物品。

original: In the words of Elder Theis: "A Brother well equipped is a Brother keeping to his duty."
translation: 泰斯长老说过：“只有装备优良的兄弟会才能做好本职工作。”
战术方面就聊到这儿吧。

original: Keep your distance. Try to flank them.
translation: 保持距离。设法从侧翼包抄他们。

original: It was my goal to continue doing so until you told me otherwise.
translation: 我的任务就是一直这么做，直到你改变命令。

original: Very well. I will seek out better positions to cover you while you forge ahead.
translation: 很好。你前进的时候，我会找一些更好的地点掩护你。

original: That's what I'm doing. Why do you think I'm standing back here in East Bumfuck?
translation: 那正是我在做的。否则你认为我为什么站在后面这么远？

original: Ha! Good plan. I'll try to get around behind 'em. I like how you think, kid.
translation: 哈！好主意。我会试着绕到他们后面。我喜欢你的想法，孩子。

original: I've had no compelling reason to do anything different from what you asked.
translation: 我对你的要求没有疑问。

original: Ha! Good plan. I'll try to get around behind 'em. I like how you think, kid.
translation: 哈！好主意。我会试着绕到他们后面。我喜欢你的想法，孩子。

original: I get any farther, I might as well be back in the bar. And that's sounding like a better idea all the time, trust me.
translation: 再远些的话，我还不如回酒吧去。那无论何时听起来都是个好主意，相信我。

original: What, don't you like my aftershave?
translation: 怎么，不喜欢我用的须后水的气味吗？

original: Yeah, got it. Flanking and tactics and stuff. Right.
translation: 嗯，明白了。侧面进攻和战术什么的。了解。

original: If you insist, sir, but RL-3 functions best when closer to the fight!
translation: 如果你坚持，长官。不过RL-3型在近战中可以发挥最大作用！
潜行侧翼包抄模式启动！

original: By all means. I simply hope I'm not too far in reserve, in case of unforeseen trouble.
translation: 尽我所能。只是希望不会太靠后，以免遭遇一些不可预期的麻烦。

original: A sound plan. I trust this isn't simply to avoid being seen with a Super Mutant?
translation: 好主意。我相信这不仅是为了不被超级变种人发现这么简单？

original: Eulogy used to like me to stay ten steps behind him. Usually.
translation: 尤勒基通常喜欢我与他保持十步距离。

original: As you wish, but I'm not letting you out of my sight.
translation: 如你所愿，但我不会让你超出我的视线的。

original: All right, you're good. Let's get out of here.
Your distance is good. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 你的距离把控得不错。我们来谈点别的。

original: I am happy if you are happy.
You're damn right I'm good, kid.
translation: 你该死的说对了，孩子，我是很棒。
没问题，孩子，你说什么都行。

original: It allows for flexibility. A wise choice on your part.
translation: 这增加了灵活性。明智的选择。

original: Good? Screw that noise - I'm downright awesome!
translation: 棒？去你的 — 那我就是神奇的了！

original: So... Near? Far? Come on, make up your mind!
translation: 那么……近？远？来吧，作出你的决定！
明白，长官。如平常一样的战术！

original: RL-3 will maintain a tactical distance!
Let's talk about how close you're following me.
translation: 我们来讨论下你我之间的距离。

original: If you wanna get closer to me, that's all you gotta say, girl.
translation: 如果你想靠近我，就对我说，小妞。

original: You mean how close you're following me, right? Sure, what's up?
translation: 你是说跟随我的距离是吗？是的，怎么了？

original: Is there something that you wish me to change?
Yeah... okay. You got a better idea?
translation: 是的……好的。你有更好的主意吗？

original: As you wish. What about it?
I am open to your suggestions.
Give me my marching orders, sir.
Just tell me where you want me.
translation: 你想我站在哪儿，只管告诉我。

original: I want you to use ranged weapons.
translation: 我希望你使用远距攻击武器。

original: Very well. I shall cover your approach.
You're not bad with a ranged weapon. Keep it up.
translation: 你远程武器用得不错。继续保持。

original: <whimper>[Dogmeat is incapable of ranged attacks and will continue using melee attacks.]
translation: <whimper>[狗肉无法进行远程攻击，将继续使用近身攻击.]

original: They shall know the power of my steel!
translation: 他们应当知道我铁棍的威力！

original: I like what you're doing. Stick with the melee.
translation: 我喜欢你这样战斗。专注于肉搏吧。

original: I like what you're doing. Stick with the melee.
translation: 我喜欢你这样战斗。专注于肉搏吧。

original: I want you to change your combat style.
translation: 我希望你改变你的战斗风格。

original: What do you think would be best?
A member of the Brotherhood is trained in all weapons as an Initiate. What do you wish?
translation: 兄弟会的新兵最初就会参加所有武器的训练。你想训练什么？

original: I can stab, I can shoot, I can do lots of things. What's your pleasure?
translation: 我可以用刀，我可以用枪，我可以做很多事。你喜欢那种？

original: What would you like? I think you'll find I'm quite flexible.
translation: 你喜欢什么？我想你会发现我什么都会。

original: I just wanted to make sure you were still here. Goodbye.
translation: 我只想确认你还在这。再见。

original: Yeah, well the Snakes don't need you, anyway! We don't need nothing but liquor and guns! Yeah!
translation: 嗯，蛇反正也不需要你！我们除了酒和枪不需要别的！耶！

original: What the fu... you think that's funny?
If there's one thing I've learned, it's patience. I can wait.
translation: 我所学到的就是耐心。我可以等。

original: Old war-bots never die! We just rust away.
translation: 机器人是永不会死的！我们最多只是会生锈。

original: As I am a "man of my word", there is nowhere else that I could possibly be.
translation: 作为一名言而有信的人，我不会到别的地方去。

original: Not just yet. I wanted to talk to you about something.
Oh, make it quick. I'm getting bored. I hate being bored.
translation: 哦，快点。我开始感到无聊了。我讨厌无聊的感觉。

original: Yeah? What do you want now?
Yes, best to formulate a plan. What is it?
translation: 是的，最好想个计划。什么事？

original: No time to dilly-dally, sir! What is it?
What do you wish to speak to me about?
Right on. I'm ready for more action.
Very well. I stand by your side.
It's time for us to part ways.
Are you certain that this is what you wish?
translation: 你确定这就是你想要的？

original: Leave me alone, Clover. You're fired.
translation: 别来烦我，可萝尔，你被解雇了。

original: It's too dangerous here, pup. Go wait for me at Vault 101.
translation: 狗肉，这太危险了。去101号避难所等我。

original: Get out of here, Jericho. You're fired.
translation: 耶利哥，滚出去，你被解雇了。

original: You're fired, Fawkes. Stop following me around.
translation: 福克斯，你被解雇了。不要再跟着我了。

original: I think I may have misheard that order.

translation: RL-3，你被解雇了，立刻滚出去。

original: We must part ways, Paladin Cross.
translation: 我们得分开了，星骑士克罗丝。

original: It's too dangerous here, Dogmeat. Go wait for me at Vault 101.
translation: 狗肉，这太危险了。去101号避难所等我。

original: It's too dangerous here, pup. Go wait for me at Gibson Scrapyard.
translation: 这里太危险了，小狗。去吉布森垃圾场等我。

original: It's too dangerous here, Dogmeat. Go wait for me at Gibson Scrapyard.
translation: 这里太危险了，狗肉。去吉布森垃圾场等我。

original: I think we should travel together.
Sorry man. I don't know what's gotten into you but you're just a little too intense for me. Maybe come back after you've chilled out and we'll see.
translation: 对不起。哥们。我不知道你怎么了，但是你对我太热情了。或许你该冷静一下再来见我。

original: Want to head back outside, Butch?
translation: 布奇，想重返自由自在的日子吗？

original: Sorry man. I don't know what's gotten into you but you're just a little too intense for me. Maybe come back after you've chilled out and we'll see.
translation: 对不起。哥们。我不知道你怎么了，但是你对我太热情了。或许你该冷静一下再来见我。

original: Want to head back outside, Butch?
translation: 布奇，想重返自由自在的日子吗？

original: Nah, I'm good. I only roll with Tunnel Snakes. Come back when you're on your own.
translation: 不，我很好。我只和穴蛇帮一起。你独自一人时再回来。

original: Want to head back outside, Butch?
translation: 布奇，想重返自由自在的日子吗？

original: I guess I can let you back into the gang. Once a Snake, always a Snake, huh? Let's roll!
translation: 我想我可以让你再重新加入蛇。一旦为蛇，终生为蛇，呃？我们一起！

original: Want to head back outside, Butch?
translation: 布奇，想重返自由自在的日子吗？

original: I regret that I cannot join you at this time. You seem to already have someone in your employ.
translation: 很遗憾我无法加入。看上去你已经雇了人。

original: I want you to come with me, Charon.
translation: 卡戎，我希望你能加入我。

original: You are my employer and I will do as you command.
translation: 你是我的雇主，我会听从你的命令。

original: I want you to come with me, Charon.
translation: 卡戎，我希望你能加入我。

original: Sorry, honey. Three's a crowd. Come back when I can have you all to myself.
translation: 对不起，亲爱的。三个人一起就太拥挤了，等我需要你的时候再回来。

original: How would you like to come with me, Clover?
translation: 可萝尔，你愿意和我一起走吗？

original: Absolutely, lover. Let's go have some fun.
translation: 没问题，亲爱的。我们去找乐子吧。

original: How would you like to come with me, Clover?
translation: 可萝尔，你愿意和我一起走吗？

original: Sorry, kid. I just can't roll with someone like you.
translation: 对不起，孩子。我不能和你一起。

original: If you pick up a few bad habits, maybe I'll change my mind.
translation: 如果你养成一些坏习惯，或许我会改变主意。

original: Let's get back out there, Jericho.
Sorry, kid. I'd love to, but there just ain't enough supplies to go around. Ditch the loser and then we'll talk.
translation: 对不起，孩子，我愿意，但是我们没有足够的补给。抛弃失败者后再来和我们谈。

original: Let's get back out there, Jericho.
Thank Christ. I really didn't want to go back to Megaton after what happened to that place.
translation: 感谢天主。我真的不想在发生那事后回兆吨镇。

original: Let's get back out there, Jericho.
Thank Christ. I thought I was gonna grow a fourth arm sitting next to all this fucking radiation.
translation: 感谢天主。我原本以为我一直会坐在这堆他妈的辐射旁直到自己长出第四只手臂。

original: Let's get back out there, Jericho.
Now that's what I like to hear! I'll be right behind you!
translation: 这就是我想听的！我会紧跟着你！

original: Let's get back out there, Jericho.
My friend, I am saddened to hear that you have turned away from a noble path.
translation: 我的朋友，我很难过听到你背离了光明之道。

original: Return to me when you have learned to take right action, and I will walk with you.
translation: 当你学会做出正确的选择后再回来找我，那时我会和你谈谈。

original: Care to join me, Fawkes? I would appreciate your assistance.
translation: 福克斯，加入我怎么样。我会感激你的帮助。

original: My friend, I would love to join you, but I fear that your traveling companion would not accept me.
translation: 我的朋友，我愿意加入你，但我担心你的同伴不会接受我。

original: Return to me when you are alone, and I will join you.
translation: 你独自一人时再回来找我，我就能加入了。

original: Care to join me, Fawkes? I would appreciate your assistance.
translation: 福克斯，加入我怎么样。我会感激你的帮助。

original: I owe you no less than my life. How could I refuse?
translation: 我的命是你的。怎么会拒绝呢？

original: Care to join me, Fawkes? I would appreciate your assistance.
translation: 福克斯，加入我怎么样。我会感激你的帮助。

original: Sir, I regret to inform you that this unit cannot accept orders from an officer under a Court Martial!
translation: 长官，我很遗憾地向您报告，由于您正等候军法处置，我不能接受您的命令！

original: Time to head back into the fight, RL-3.
Sir, I regret to inform you that this unit cannot accept orders from an irresponsible officer!
translation: 长官，遗憾地告诉你这个小队不会接受一个不负责人的军官的命令的。

original: It is a soldier's duty to soldier, not to play hero!
translation: 士兵的天职就是做一名士兵，而不是做英雄！

original: Time to head back into the fight, RL-3.
Sir, I apologize, but a squad is less effective when it is over crowded.
translation: 可是，长官，行动区域太狭窄的话，一个小队所发挥的作用就会大打折扣了。

original: Time to head back into the fight, RL-3.
I should definitely say so! Time to roll out!
translation: 我应该直接这么说！该出发了！

original: Time to head back into the fight, RL-3.
It is regrettable, but I cannot follow one such as you. Restore your good name, and perhaps I shall reconsider.
translation: 虽然这很抱歉，但我不会听从你这样的人的指挥。如果你恢复了名誉，或许我会重新考虑。

original: I would like your assistance once again, Paladin Cross.
translation: 星骑士 克罗丝，我需要你的帮助。

original: It is my sincere wish to join you, but so long as you travel with one who is not of the Brotherhood, I simply cannot risk myself.
translation: 我非常期望能加入你的队伍，但只要你和一名非兄弟会的成员在一起，我就不会加入。

original: I would like your assistance once again, Paladin Cross.
translation: 星骑士 克罗丝，我需要你的帮助。

original: And it is my duty to offer it, as I have sworn. I shall follow and protect you.
translation: 正如我之前宣誓时所说，我会履行自己的义务。我会跟随并保护你。

original: I would like your assistance once again, Paladin Cross.
translation: 星骑士 克罗丝，我需要你的帮助。

original: [Dogmeat's pup growls at Sergeant RL-3's presence.]
translation: [狗肉的幼仔在中士RL-3面前咆哮。]
[狗肉的幼仔在雷克斯3面前咆哮。]
{happy beep}<开心的哔哔声> {No Sound file}
我准备好了，随时可以动身。

original: There's something about that robot that doesn't seem... all right to me. I'm not saying we shouldn't take it with us.
translation: 关于那个机器人，我总觉得…不怎么对劲。我不是说我们不能带它一起走。

original: I'm just saying that if it were to "fall" into Lake Mead and be irreparably damaged... and if you threw an EMP grenade in after it...
translation: 我只是说如果万一它"掉进了"米德湖，发生严重损坏……而之后你又之往湖里丢了一颗EMP手雷的话……

original: Well, there are worse things happening in the world, right?
translation: 好吧，反正这世上什么倒霉事都有，对吧？

original: After spending thirty years of my life hiding my association with the Enclave, I'd {emph}love to stroll the wasteland with a twitchy Eyebot.
translation: 我隐瞒了自己和英克雷的联系三十年，现在居然能{emph}和一只古怪的眼球机器人在废土上流浪，也算是不错了。

original: Back in your good graces again? I knew you'd see the light.
translation: 怎么突然又变得如此礼貌了？我就知道你会开窍的。

original: A courier, doctor, and a cybernetic dog. After we deal with the whole "imminent conquest of New Vegas" problem, we should open an act at the Tops.
translation: 邮差，医生外加一条机器狗。等咱们完成"征服新维加斯"的大业，这故事能在九重天当戏演了。

original: Words cannot contain my excitement at the chance to throw myself headlong into danger with you again, boss.
translation: 能够再次与你一道出生入死，这激动的心情已经无法用言语来表达了，老大。
来吧，劳尔，冒险在等着我们！
咱们去闹个天翻地覆吧。

original: Can't be any worse than here.
All right then, let's get the train rolling.
You got one too many by my count.
translation: 在我看来，你身边的人手似乎太多了。

original: What, you teasing me? Lose one, then ask me again.
translation: 什么，你是在耍我吗？等你炒掉一个人，再来找我吧。

original: Not in the mood for a threesome. {Beat, under her breath}Today.
translation: 我可没兴趣玩三人行。{Beat，under her breath}至少今天没有。

original: Sounds good. Let's get out of here.
translation: 听起来不错。我们离开这。

original: Would that I could. Although you are now my employer, traveling in such a large crowd would be foolish.
translation: 你是我的雇主，我也希望跟你走，但跟随如此人满为患的队伍是不明智的。

original: I shall wait here until your party is smaller.
translation: 在你的队伍减员前，我会在这等待。

original: Whoa! What the fuck was that?
Ahzrukhal was an evil bastard. So long as he held my contract, I was honor bound to do as he commanded.
translation: 阿祖卡是个邪恶的杂种。只要他还持有我的合同，我就得听从他的命令。

original: But now you are my employer, which freed me to rid the world of that disgusting rat. And now, for good or ill, I serve you.
translation: 现在你是我的雇主了，你把我从那满是恶心的老鼠的世界里救了出来。所以无论你是善是恶，我都会听命于你。

original: But I cannot come with you. Although you are now my employer, traveling in such a large crowd would be foolish.
translation: 你是我的雇主，我也希望跟你走，但跟随如此人满为患的队伍是不明智的。

original: I shall wait here until your party is smaller.
translation: 在你的队伍减员前，我会在这等待。

original: Ahzrukhal was an evil bastard. So long as he held my contract, I was honor bound to do as he commanded.
translation: 阿祖卡是个邪恶的杂种。只要他还持有我的合同，我就得听从他的命令。

original: But now you are my employer, which freed me to rid the world of that disgusting rat. And now, for good or ill, I serve you.
translation: 现在你是我的雇主了，你把我从那满是恶心的老鼠的世界里救了出来。所以无论你是善是恶，我都会听命于你。

original: That's right, Charon. Have you come to say goodbye?
Ahzrukhal. I am told that I am no longer in your service.
translation: 阿祖卡，我被告知不用再为你服务了。

original: Slow down, there. I have good news. I'm your new employer.
translation: 等等。我有个好消息。我是你的新雇主。

original: You purchased my contract from Ahzrukhal? So, I am no longer in his service. That is good to know.
translation: 你从阿祖卡那买走了我的合同？我不再为他服务了。太好了。

original: Please, wait here. I must take care of something.
translation: 请等在这。我必须处理一些事。

original: Oh no. None of that. You belong to me now.
translation: 哦，不。那可不行。你现在是我的人。

original: I belong to no one. If you are my new employer, then I will serve you. But first, I must take care of something. Wait here.
translation: 我不属于任何人。如果你是我的新雇主，那么我会听命于你。但首先，我必须处理一些事，等在这。

original: Sure. Greta is nothing to me. I'll do it.
translation: 没问题。葛丽泰对我来说不算什么。我会搞定。

original: I'm glad to hear it. Come back to me when she's dead and Charon's contract is all yours.
translation: 很高兴听到你这么说。她死后回来见我，卡戎的合同就是你的了。

original: A word of advice: be subtle. Open gunplay will only get the town to turn on you, and I will not be able to help you.
translation: 一个小建议：小心行事。公然开枪的话，全镇的人都会对付你，我也不会帮你。

original: Couldn't we work out some sort of deal?
translation: 我们就不能想出什么办法吗？

original: Is she now? Well, it seems that this arrangement worked out well for both of us.
translation: 她死了？好的，看来我们之间的协议完成得很顺利。

original: With the new profit I'll make from Greta's customers, I'll be able to hire a replacement for Charon with plenty left over for myself.
translation: 有了葛丽泰的顾客带来的新收益，我就能找人顶替卡戎，还能得到丰厚的利润。

original: And you held up your end of the deal, my friend. And I am a man of his word. Charon's contract is yours. You are his new employer. Congratulations.
translation: 我的朋友，你履行了协议。我是个讲信用的人，给你卡戎的合同，恭喜你成为他的新雇主。

original: I'll give you the pleasure of informing him yourself.
translation: 我把通知他的乐趣留给你。

original: About that deal we had: Greta is dead as promised.
translation: 有关我们的交易……就像我承诺过的，葛丽泰已经死了。

original: I'll give you 5,000 caps for it.
I suppose that could work... yes. Yes.
Here's the contract. And I'll take my payment in full.
translation: 给你合同。我要全额付款。

original: I'll give you the pleasure of informing Charon yourself.
translation: 我把通知他的乐趣留给你。

original: You're kidding, right? Come back when you have a serious offer.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？等你真正想交易时再回来找我。

original: I'll give you 4,000 caps for it.
[SUCCEEDED] I suppose that could work... yes. Yes... here's the contract. And I'll take my payment in full.
translation: 我想那能行……是的。是的……给你合同。而我会赚大钱。

original: Here's the contract. And I'll take my payment in full.
translation: 给你合同。我要全额付款。

original: I'll give you the pleasure of informing Charon yourself.
translation: 我想让你通知他这个好消息。

original: [FAILED] You're kidding, right? Come back when you have a serious offer.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？等你真正想交易时再回来找我。

original: I'll give you 3,000 caps for it.
[SUCCEEDED] I suppose that could work... yes. Yes... here's the contract. And I'll take my payment in full.
translation: 我想那能行……是的。是的……给你合同。而我会赚大钱。

translation: 给你合同。我要全额付款。

[SUCCEEDED] I suppose that could work... yes. Yes... here's the contract. And I'll take my payment in full.

translation: 给你合同。我要全额付款。

original: [FAILED] You're kidding, right? Come back when you have a serious offer.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？等你真正想交易时再回来找我。

[SUCCEEDED] I suppose that could work... yes. Yes... here's the contract. And I'll take my payment in full.
translation: 我想那能行……是的。是的……给你合同。而我会赚大钱。

translation: 给你合同。我要全额付款。

original: I'll give you the pleasure of informing Charon yourself.
translation: 我把通知他的乐趣留给你。

original: [FAILED] You're kidding, right? Come back when you have a serious offer.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？等你真正想交易时再回来找我。

original: I want to talk to you about Charon's contract.
translation: 我想和你谈谈卡戎的合同。

original: Is she now? Well, it seems that this arrangement worked out well for both of us.
translation: 她死了？好的，看来我们之间的协议完成得很顺利。

original: With the new profit I'll make from Greta's customers, I'll be able to hire a replacement for Charon with plenty left over for myself.
translation: 有了葛丽泰的顾客带来的新收益，我就能找人顶替卡戎，还能得到丰厚的利润。

original: And you held up your end of the deal, my friend. And I am a man of his word. Charon's contract is yours. You are his new employer. Congratulations.
translation: 我的朋友，你履行了协议。我是个讲信用的人，给你卡戎的合同，恭喜你成为他的新雇主。

original: I'll give you the pleasure of informing him yourself.
translation: 我想让你通知他这个好消息。

original: About that deal we had: Greta is dead as promised.
translation: 有关我们的交易……就像我承诺过的，葛丽泰已经死了。

original: I knew you'd change your mind. Just remember, Charon is a valuable asset to me and he doesn't come cheap. Are you ready to deal?
translation: 我就知道你会改变主意。记住，卡戎对我来说有很大的价值，而且他不便宜。你准备要交易了吗？

original: Oh? Would you, now? He is a highly valuable asset to me and to the Ninth Circle. What did you have in mind?
translation: 哦？你同意了？他对我和第九环很重要。你怎么想？

original: One for you, five for me. Use it in good health.
translation: 1个归你，5个归我。用它们保持健康。

original: Two for you, ten for me. Use 'em in good health.
translation: 2个归你，10个归我。用它们保持健康。

original: Three for you, fifteen for me. Use 'em in good health.
translation: 3个归你，15个归我。用它们保持健康。

original: Four for you, twenty for me. Use 'em in good health.
translation: 4个归你，20个归我。用它们保持健康。

original: Five for you, twenty-five for me. Use 'em in good health.
translation: 5个归你，25个归我。用它们保持健康。

original: Alright, ten bits of Scrap Metal for two doses of RadAway. That's a done deal.
translation: 好，10块废金属换2包辐特宁。交易完成。

original: Alright, fifteen bits of Scrap Metal for three doses of RadAway. That's a done deal.
translation: 好，15块废金属换3包辐特宁。交易完成。

original: Alright, twenty bits of Scrap Metal for four doses of RadAway. That's a done deal.
translation: 好，20块废金属换4包辐特宁。交易完成。

original: Alright, twenty-five bits of Scrap Metal for five doses of RadAway. That's a done deal.
translation: 好，25块废金属换5包辐特宁。交易完成。

original: Five bits of Scrap Metal for me, one Stimpak for you -- it's been a pleasure doing business.
translation: 给我5块废金属，给你1支治疗针。交易愉快。

original: Ten bits of Scrap Metal for me, two Stimpaks for you -- it's been a pleasure doing business.
translation: 给我10块废金属，给你2支治疗针。交易愉快。

original: Fifteen bits of Scrap Metal for me, three Stimpaks for you -- it's been a pleasure doing business.
translation: 给我15块废金属，给你3支治疗针。交易愉快。

original: Twenty bits of Scrap Metal for me, four Stimpaks for you -- it's been a pleasure doing business.
translation: 给我20块废金属，给你4支治疗针。交易愉快。

original: Twenty-Five bits of Scrap Metal for me, five Stimpaks for you -- it's been a pleasure doing business.
translation: 给我25块废金属，给你5支治疗针。交易愉快。

original: What were you offering to trade?
I'll trade you five bits of Scrap Metal for a Stimpak, a pack of RadAway, or a dose of Rad-X. Easy deal.
translation: 我会卖你5块废金属来换1支治疗针、或1包辐特宁、或者1剂抗辐剂-X。

original: I have some scrap metal for you.
Really? Great! I can finally get around to patching up the heaters.
translation: 真的？好极了！我终于能去修理加热器了。

original: You'll be dead long before help gets here.
translation: 等有人来救你时，你都死了。

original: Fine, fine, you asshole. I offered you a fair trade, and this is how it is?
translation: 好吧，好吧，你这混蛋。我给你个公平交易，怎么样？

original: Here, take it. Take it all and get the fuck out. I never want to lay my eyes on you again, you miserable bastard.
translation: 给，拿着。全部拿着然后给我滚。我再也不要见到你，你这可怜的杂种。

original: Yes. As in: I won't cut your throat and watch you die gasping for air.
translation: 是的。就好像：我不会切开你的喉管，然后看着你慢慢咽气。

original: You... you wouldn't dare. I've got... I mean... I'll call for help.
translation: 你……你不敢胡来的。我有……我的意思是……我会叫人来的。

original: Yes. As in, "I won't make a five egg omelet out of your face."
translation: 是的。就好像：“我不用你的脸来做鸡蛋饼。”

original: Sure, Winthrop. I think I can help you out.
translation: 当然，温思罗普。我想我能帮你的忙。

original: Well, alright. That's good to hear, stranger. Just come on back to me when you've gathered some Scrap Metal.
translation: 那好吧，很高兴听到你这么说，陌生人。收集到一些废金属就来找我。

original: You'll find it just about anywhere -- on junked robots, in old buildings, you name it.
translation: 你可以在任何地方找到它 — 废弃的机器人身上，旧房子里，到处有。

original: What do you do around here, Winthrop?
Me? I keep every hunk of old rusted Pre-War garbage around here in operating condition.
translation: 我？我维护生锈的战前废物，让它们还能运作。

original: We've got lights, water, and ventilation all running off the old crap they used to keep this place going for the tourists.
translation: 曾为游客而准备的光线，水分和空气正流失殆尽。

original: I've managed to keep it going so far, but... well, I'm not sure how long I can keep it up.
translation: 我一直设法维持机器运作，但……嗯，我不确定还可以维持多久。

original: Me? I keep every hunk of old rusted Pre-War garbage around here in operating condition.
translation: 我？我维护生锈的战前废物，让它们还能运作。

original: We've got lights, water, and ventilation all running off the old crap they used to keep this place going for the tourists.
translation: 曾为游客而准备的光线，水分和空气正流失殆尽。

original: I've managed to keep it going so far, but... well, I'm not sure how long I can keep it up.
translation: 我一直设法维持机器运作，但……嗯，我不确定还可以维持多久。

original: We used to have two guards here. Me and an older girl named Caps.
translation: 我们曾有两个守卫，我和一个叫“帽子”的年长女孩。

original: But since the last time Raiders attacked, it's just been me.
translation: 但自从上次歹徒袭击后，就只剩下我了。

original: Are you the only guard on the front gate?
Now I am, yeah. But I'm a good guard, and no one's getting by me, now.
translation: 现在只有我了。不过我是个好守卫，没有人可以从我这过去。

original: Are you the only guard on the front gate?
Yeah. Right now, we don't even have anyone to cover me when I'm asleep.
translation: 嗯。现在我睡觉时，没人能保护我。

original: Now leave me alone, I've got to be ready for duty soon.
translation: 现在离我远点，我要准备上岗了。

original: Don't you guard the front gate?
You brought back Penny and Sammy and Squirrel? Well, I guess that does make you a pretty big hero. Thanks!
translation: 你把佩尼，萨米和“松鼠”带回来了？太好了，我猜那会让你成为一个超级大英雄。谢谢！

original: I'm Lucy, and I'm pretty much the mom around here. And that means I spend a lot of time kissing boo-boos and making things all better.
translation: 我是露西，我几乎成了这地方的妈妈。这也意味着我要花很多时间来照顾伤患，这样他们才能好起来。

original: So, if you ever get any scrapes or bruises - or if you get shot, stabbed, or radiated - stop by and I'll do what I can, big hero.
translation: 哦，如果你被擦伤或撞伤 — 或者被射伤、刺伤，辐射 — 就到我这来，我会尽我所能为你疗伤，大英雄。

original: I rescued those captured kids. I'm a big hero.
translation: 我救了那些被抓的孩子。我是个大英雄。

original: Well, if you brought them back, then I guess that explains why RJ let you in. So, I guess that does make you a big hero.
translation: 好极了，你把他们带回来了，我就说为什么镇长会让你进来。看来你要成大英雄了。

original: I'm Lucy, and I'm pretty much mommy to the folks here. I try to keep them safe, and when that's not enough I patch up their cuts and bruises.
translation: 我是露西，我几乎成了这群家伙的妈妈了。我尽力保护他们，并且还得帮他们包扎被割伤和撞伤的伤口。

original: And when that's not enough, I make sure they get a funeral. Thanks for making sure I didn't have to do that for three more of mine.
translation: 但那还没完，我还得安葬不幸死去的人。谢谢你，让我不用多做三次。

original: I rescued those captured kids. I'm a big hero.
translation: 我救了那些被抓的孩子。我是个大英雄。

original: That was you? Well, you brought my sister Penny back, so sure, I'll call you a big hero. Thank you very much.
translation: 是你？嗯，你把我的妹妹佩尼带回来了，你是我的大英雄。非常感谢你。

original: I'm Joseph, and as the oldest kid in Lamplight, I'm pretty much a teacher by default. I also try to keep the kids clean and fresh-faced.
translation: 我是约瑟夫，作为小灯镇里年龄最大的小孩，我几乎是默认的老师。我也会让他们保持清洁和精神饱满。

original: I'm not sure if there's anything I can teach you, but if you need a haircut or the like, just say the word. And thanks again.
translation: 我不能确定还能教你什么，但如果你想理发或类似的事，和我说下就行。还有再次谢谢你。

original: I'm the big hero who saved those kidnapped kids.
translation: 我是救出那些被绑架的孩子的大英雄。

original: Oh, really? So you're saying you brought back three more hungry mouths, too? Great, you're just making my day better and better!
translation: 哦，真的？你是说你还带回了三张饥饿的嘴？太好了，你让我的日子更好过了！

original: Look, I'm Eclair, and I'm in charge of the crap we call food down here. And we've got precious little enough to go around as it is.
translation: 听着，我是“夹心奶条”，我管理着我们称为食物的垃圾。我们很珍惜这些恰好足以维持生命的垃圾。

original: So, yeah, thanks for bringing those folks back alive, but don't expect me to throw you a big party over it.
translation: 嗯，感谢你把那些人活着带回来，但别指望我为你开一个大的庆功宴。

original: Hey, I rescued those kids from the Slavers. You owe me some respect, kid.
translation: 嘿，我从奴隶贩子手中救出了这些孩子。小子，你该尊重我一点。

original: You saved Penny and Sammy and Squirrel? I can see why RJ let you in! Thanks, for all of us!
translation: 你救了佩尼、萨米和“松鼠”？我明白为什么麦迪让你进来了！谢谢，代表我们所有人！

original: I'm Lucy, and I pretty much spend my days playing mommy around here. I spend a lot of time kissing boo-boos and making things better.
translation: 我是露西，我大部分时间都在扮演妈妈的角色。花费大量时间来亲亲伤口，让一切都好起来。

original: If you get a scraped knee or stubbed toe, come see me. Same if you get shot in the face or burns all over, but I can only promise so much.
translation: 如果你擦伤了膝盖或被踩伤了脚趾，就来找我。如果你脸部被射伤或全身烧伤，你也可以来找我，但我可能什么也做不了。

original: I'm a guest in town. Mayor MacCready let me in for rescuing your friends.
translation: 我是镇里的客人。是麦迪市长让我进来救你的朋友。

original: That was you? Well, my most sincere thanks, then. You brought my sister Penny back to me, and I couldn't ask more than that.
translation: 那是你？嗯，请接受我最诚挚的感谢。你把我的妹妹佩尼带回来了，我无法要求你做得更多。

original: I'm Joseph, and if there's ever anything I can do for you here, just name it!
translation: 我是约瑟夫，如果有什么是我能为你做的，尽管开口！

original: As the oldest kid in town, I spend most of my time teaching, but I do what I can to keep the kids clean and fresh-faced.
translation: 作为镇里最年长的孩子，我花费大部分时间用于教学，不过我也尽可能地确保孩子的卫生和健康。

original: Say, if you're ever looking for a haircut, I'd be glad to offer my services. You only have to ask!
translation: 如果你想理发，我很乐于为你服务。尽管开口！

original: Mayor MacCready let me in for rescuing those kids.
translation: 麦迪市长让我进来解救那些孩子。

original: Oh, you think Sammy and the rest wouldn't have gotten back on their own eventually? I taught him better than that.
translation: 哦，你觉得萨米和其他人最终没法自己回来？我的徒弟可比你想象的要强。

original: Well, if you're sticking around, you ought to know that I'm Princess, and I call the shots around here.
translation: 嗯，如果你老在这里转悠，你该知道我是公主，还有在这我说了算。

original: The Mayor let me in because I rescued some of your friends.
translation: 是镇长让我进来的，因为我救了你的朋友。

original: That's good, they don't like me having my gun in town, so I gotta turn it in first, so if I had to shoot you you'd have to wait a bit.
translation: 那很好，他们不喜欢我在镇里携枪，因此我事先上交了，所以如果我不得不向你开枪，你还得在这等我一会儿。

original: My name's Zip. I don't think that's short for anything, because I don't know what it'd be short for. Zippy? Zipperick? Ziptholomew?
translation: 我的名字叫拉链，我觉得我的名字不是缩写，因为我不知道它是什么的缩写。吉帕？吉帕瑞克？吉帕多罗买？

original: So yeah, it's good to meet you, big kid, and maybe you've got big stuff on top of you. Do you have any Nuka-Cola, maybe? Yes? Please?
translation: 嗯，很高兴见到你，大孩子，或许你在上面拿到了一些大孩子用的东西。有核子可乐吗？有吗？

original: No, you don't need to shoot me. Just think of me as a big kid.
translation: 不，你用不着开枪打我。你就把我当成一个大孩子好了。

original: Oh, that's good because Mayor MacCready says I can't have my gun in town anymore, not since last time, but that was totally an accident anyway!
translation: 哦，那很好，因为自从那次以后，麦迪镇长说我不能再在镇里携枪了，可那纯粹是场意外啊！

original: That reminds me, got any Nuka-Cola? 'Cause if I'm not gonna have a gun in town, then it must be okay for me to have more Nuka, right?
translation: 那提醒了我，有核子可乐吗？因为既然我不能再在镇里携枪，那么我应该可以拿更多核子可乐，对吧？

original: Anyway, everyone calls me Zip, you know, like a zipper, only not really like that because I'm not made of metal, but I do go up and down, I guess.
translation: 总之，每个人都叫我拉链，你知道，像一条拉链。我猜他们之所以这样叫我，是因为虽然我不是用铁做的，但我总是像拉链一样上下走动。

original: No, no, I'm not here to cause any problems! You don't need your gun!
translation: 不，不，我不是来惹麻烦的！你不用拿枪！

original: Really? Because I heard from the mayor about the sorts of deals you make when you trade. None for you.
translation: 真的？因为我听镇长说过你做交易时的事情。没你份。

original: Sure thing, pal! Special deals for us kids!
translation: 当然，伙计！对我们这些孩子来次特别交易！

original: I hope you brought me some cool stuff!
translation: 我希望你会带给我一些很酷的东西！

original: Yeah, I heard about the sorts of things you'd do for this fungus. Well, you're cut off. Go scrounge your own food.
translation: 嗯，我听说你为了蘑菇所做的事。嗯，这不欢迎你。自己去找食物吧。

original: Sure thing, mungo. We don't have much to spare, so get ready to pay.
translation: 当然，毛人。我们剩得不多，所以准备付钱吧。

original: Enjoy, if you've got the caps.
translation: 好好享受，如果你有瓶盖的话。

original: Can you give me a haircut?
Certainly. How would you like to look?
Can you give me a haircut?
I don't need to explain myself to you, mungo. Shut up and get lost.
translation: 我不需要向你解释，毛人。闭嘴，消失。
