translation: 知道你和你的手下把这里守得固若金汤，我们都倍感安全。谢谢你们！

original: I don't scrounge for anything. I run a high class Boutique, doctor, as you know. However, I can check with my supplier about holodisks for you.
translation: 我不是什么都收。我经营一家高级精品店，你知道的，医生。不过，我可以向我的供应商查询是否有全息光盘。

original: Don't worry about them. Just be yourself dear. You've had a hard life. You deserve some happiness. Hell, we all do.
translation: 不用担心他们。你随意就好了，亲爱的。你受苦了，应该享受一下。见鬼，我们都该享受一下。

original: What a question! I don't know. I supposed it is. But, it can't always be helped. We can't help who we fall in love with, can we?
translation: 你这问的！我不知道。我想是的。但是，这没办法。我们控制不了自己会爱上谁，是吧？

original: Yeah. I know. It's just... Well, I've been busy.
translation: 是的，我知道。只是……唔，我一直很忙。

original: Raiders? Again? Well, I'll have to make do. Thank you for the heads up, Chief. And thank your men for us. We are all grateful of your presence here.
translation: 歹徒？又来了？那，就这样了。多谢你的提点，长官。也请你替我们谢谢你的手下。有你们在，我们太感激了。

original: Shoo! Away with you. Leave me alone!
translation: 嘘！走远点，让我自己待着！

original: It's okay, really. I prefer to stay busy.
translation: 真的没问题。我宁愿过得忙碌些。

original: Really? He orders that every day. I prefer making more creative dishes. Choose something else, I beg you!
translation: 真的吗？他每天都点那个。我喜欢做更有创造力的菜。选个别的吧，求求你！

original: Something I picked up from my mom. She wasn't always the best mother... but she always showed her love for us in her cooking. I miss her sometimes.
translation: 有一些我从我妈那学来的。她不是最棒的母亲……但她做的饭里总是充满了对我们的爱。我有时候会想念她。

original: A sophisticated lady like you slaving over the stove? Don't trouble yourself with that, dear. You kick back and enjoy. I'm here to cook for you.
translation: 像你这样的高雅女士要亲手下厨？别给自己添麻烦了，亲爱的。你该享受一下。我来为你做饭。

original: Sure! I could always use another pair of hands in the kitchen.
translation: 是啊！厨房里多个帮手当然好了。

original: Oh that? It was nothing. A one time indiscretion, I assure you. Won't happen again, ol' chap. Scouts honor and all that. Care for a drink?
translation: 哦，那个？那没什么。小问题罢了，我向你保证，绝不会再发生了，老朋友。为了尊严及其他。来一杯？

original: What? Very funny old man! Well, I hear she's also running low on dried up old raisins, you cheeky bastard! Leave a gent to his drink already!
translation: 什么？好有趣的老头！嗯，我听说她的陈年葡萄干也不多了，你这无礼的混蛋！让那位绅士安静地喝酒！

original: Amen. I'll drink to that sister. Cheers!
translation: 阿门。我要为那姐妹喝一杯。干杯！

original: Why do you think I spend so much time getting smashed in the lounge?
translation: 那你说我整天泡在休息室里喝得烂醉是为什么？

original: Indeed, Mrs. Cheng. Indeed! Sometimes it helps wash away a lot more than just one day.
translation: 没错，程太太，没错！有时候它不只是消磨了一天时间。

original: Thank you for looking into that situation for me. I'm embarrassed it turned out to be nothing. Well, one can never be too careful.
translation: 感谢你让我了解情况。结果那没什么大不了的，我真难堪。不过，小心没大错。

original: Don't be silly. I know enough about them to make being friendly... awkward at best. Besides, I much prefer spending all my time with you!
translation: 别傻了。我知道怎样和他们打交道……最多有些棘手而已。不过，我更喜欢和你在一块打发时光！

original: Why thank you, dear! How charming of you to say so. Perhaps you and I should start spending some time together? Eh? Ahahah.
translation: 要谢谢你，亲爱的！你这么说真好。我们不妨在一起共度些时光吧？嗯？哈哈哈！

original: It hasn't been that long since my last "check up." So you know EXACTLY how I'm feeling, doctor.
translation: 离我上次“检查”的时间没多久啊。所以，你肯定了解我的感受，医生。

original: Nonsense Edgar! I always find your manners to be quite "up to the task." if you know what I mean! He he he he. See you later, MISTER Wellington.
translation: 埃德加，你胡说！我一直觉得你的礼貌是“应付差事”，你知道我的意思吧！呵呵呵呵，回见，威灵顿先生。

original: Eww! Banish the thought, old man! Seriously though, if you're still around in a decade or two, I might take you up on the offer.
translation: 呃！别再这么想了，老头！说真的，如果过十年或二十年你还在，我兴许会接受你的建议。

original: Why do I intimidate you so? You weren't intimated the other night! Aha! See you around, Don Juan.
translation: 为什么我这么吓唬你？因为那天夜里你没被吓到！啊哈！回见，唐璜。

original: Don't they all, dear? Don't they all!
translation: 他们不也是吗，亲爱的？他们不也是吗！

original: What? Are you kidding me?! Mind your own damn business. I don't go turning lights on in your closet, do I? Jeez!
translation: 什么？你在耍我吗？少管他妈的闲事！我又没在你家厕所里点灯，对吧？天啊！

original: I'm just great, if you don't count the fact that I'm married to the biggest idiot on the planet!
translation: 我很好，如果和这星球上最大的傻瓜结婚那事不算的话！

original: If you mean day dreaming about killing Mr. Cheng and knocking a few back in the lounge, then yeah, I'm able to relax once in a while.
translation: 如果你的意思是杀死程先生，再去休息室聊两句的白日梦，那么好，我可以去先放松一阵子了。

original: It breaks all the time! Does he take that as a sign to spend time with me? No. Stupid man! He spends hours retyping everything. He's such a loser!
translation: 它老是坏掉！难道他认为那是和我一起浪费时间的信号吗？不，蠢男人！他把所有的时间都用在改错字上。他是个大废物！

original: I'd be happy to have you help sometime, Mrs. Cheng. Cooking can be very therapeutic.
translation: 我非常高兴能不时得到您的帮助，程太太。烹饪有益身心健康。

original: Who you calling frumpy?! At least my ass isn't shaped like a pear.
translation: 你恶狠狠地喊什么？至少我的屁股长得不像只梨。

original: The usual, dear. And please, be sure to remember to measure the salt precisely. We don't a repeat of last weeks debacle.
translation: 老样子，亲爱的。拜托，放盐的时候注意些。别再出上周的错了。

original: Umm... er... why yes, Ms. Lancaster. You are quite the "conversationalist." I await with anticipation our next opportunity for chit chat. Indeed!
translation: 嗯……呃……是的，兰卡斯特女士。你绝对是个“健谈的人”。老实说，我非常希望有机会再好好聊聊。

original: Ewwww! Labcoats are so last century. I have a better idea, Doc. Why don't you come to New Urban Apparel, and I'll give you a complete make-over!
translation: 呃…！实验室的外套实在是太古董了。我有个更好的主意，医生。你为什么不来新都市服装店，我会给你好好改改！

original: Yes! But the key to being fabulous, is that it comes from within. What you wear is only half the equation. BELIEVE you ARE already fabulous!
translation: 是的！但是变漂亮的关键来自内心。你的穿着只是公式的一半。要相信你已经变漂亮了！

original: Whatever, you old hag. I'm just swelling with fabulous.
translation: 随便，你这老太婆。我已经漂亮得光彩四射了。

original: Those things are so tacky. How about you swing by New Urban Apparel, and I fit you into a cute Sunday dress? You need to spruce up your look dear.
translation: 那些东西太寒酸了。要不要试试新都市服装店？我会让你穿起可爱而合身的周日晚装。你需要把自己打扮得整齐些。

original: Of course! Shopping is wonderful therapy, isn't it? Better than any old pill Doc Banfield prescribes.
translation: 当然啦！购物是很好的疗法，对吧？比班菲尔德医生的药片管用多了。

original: Thank you for your concern, Doctor. But things've been tense is all, and my men are just blowing off steam. Don't worry. They'll be fine.
translation: 谢谢你的关心，医生。不过事情已经变得很紧张，我的人也都吵吵嚷嚷的。别着急，他们会好的。

original: And I envy your retirement, Dashwood. Though it's true. There's something satisfying about bagging a Rad-Scorpion at 100 yards with a single shot.
translation: 退休真让人羡慕啊，达什伍德。尽管如此，在100码外一枪打死一只辐射蝎还是很带劲的。

original: Cheng. Damn it. Call me "Chief." Chief Gustavo! All that "comrade" nonsense is really getting on my nerves.
translation: 程，他妈的。叫我“长官”。古斯塔沃长官！所有这些“同志”之类的东西真是让我过敏。

original: That's kind of you, Ms. Primrose. But it's better if they don't cozy up with the residents. Helps retain discipline and remind them why they're here.
translation: 您太客气了，普利洛斯女士。但那总比让居民不舒服要好。能保持秩序，并能提醒他们为什么他们在这。

original: I'm on duty. You alright Hawthorne? Don't want a repeat of that little stunt you pulled.
translation: 我在执勤。你还好吧，霍桑？别耍小花招。

original: It was very... thorough, Mrs. Wellington. Do the other residents know you have catalogued all their habits and daily routines like that?
translation: 这非常……彻底，威灵顿太太。其他居民知道你已经把他们的生活习惯和日常行为归档了吗？

original: I'd have to say that would be extremely unlikely, Mrs. Cheng.
translation: 我得说那不大可能，程太太。

original: I'm afraid the lab coat never goes out of style for me. But I appreciate your concern.
translation: 我穿实验室外套恐怕永远不会落伍的。不过非常感谢你的关心。

original: Yes, of course. There's nothing to worry about. Though, it's been awhile since I've seen you. We should schedule a checkup soon.
translation: 是的，当然，没有必要担心。不过，我确实有一阵没见过你了。我们应该尽快安排一次检查。

original: Absolutely not. All Wasteland meat MUST be thoroughly cooked. Disease and parasites are killed by the heat. I'm surprised I have to tell you this.
translation: 绝不。所有废土上的肉类必须经过彻底烹煮。高温可以杀灭病菌与寄生虫。我很惊讶于必须告知你这些。

original: Ahem. Yes. It has been too long since you've been properly examined.
translation: 嗯。是的，离上次给你做全面检查已经很久了。

original: Oh... well... umm... Thank you Susan... er, I mean, Ms. Lancaster. A pleasant day to you.
translation: 哦……这个……唔……谢谢你，苏珊……呃，我是说，兰卡斯特女士。愿你度过快乐的一天。

original: I know a little bit about technology. I've picked up a few tricks in my adventures. Why, what seems to be the problem?
translation: 我懂一点技术。我在冒险时学到的。怎么样，有什么问题？

original: Hawthorne. Go easy on those remaining brain cells, alright?
translation: 霍桑。别白费心思了，好吗？

original: You should count yourself very lucky. I do. Most people die a horrible death out there in the Wastes. Excitement and danger often go hand in hand.
translation: 你应该认为自己非常幸运。我就这么看。许多人在废土上死得很惨。刺激与危险经常并肩而至。

original: I've had too kill far to many men... listen, Mrs. Cheng... have you tried talking to your husband about things? I think he really cares about you.
translation: 我也杀过很多人……听着，程太太.……你曾试过与你的丈夫谈论这些事吗？我看他很关心你的。

original: Oh, I don't know. Not so good I guess... Women. Can't live with them. Can't live without them. Know what I mean, Comrade?
translation: 哦，我不知道。我想不太好吧……女人。不能跟她们一起过日子，又不能没有她们。了解我的意思吗，同志？

original: Well, Comrade. My computer keeps breaking, and I have to start over each day. Not to worry though. I've got it practically memorized by now!
translation: 同志。我的电脑老是坏，我不得不每天重头开始。但是别着急。我现在实际上都能记住它了！

original: Because, while it's true, some of us are better suited to lead the community, by calling you all comrades, I'm helping you not feel envy or sadness.
translation: 因为，一方面我们中的某些人的确更适合领导社群，通过称呼大家为同志，我可以帮你不感到嫉妒或悲伤。

original: Antique shop? Really, Anthony, you need some new material! And I'm not just talking about your jokes either, darling. Those threads are atrocious!
translation: 古董店？说真的，安东尼，你需要一些新材料！我不光是指你的笑话，亲爱的。那些线头都朽了！

original: Yeah, I pop a couple, then have a Martini. Does wonders. Thanks Doc.
translation: 是啊，哼上两曲，再来杯马蒂尼酒。太棒了。谢了，医生。

original: Mr. Cheng. Shouldn't YOU know what your wife would like? Why don't you go find out what she wants, and I'll see about ordering it for you.
translation: 程先生，难道你不知道你妻子喜欢什么吗？干嘛不去问问她想要什么，我来帮你订货。

original: Let's just say it's high time for a glass of wine. Putting on a happy face for all my customers all the time can be a bit tiresome.
translation: 看来我该来上一杯了。随时随地对所有的顾客奉上微笑还真是累人啊。

original: Yes, Mrs. Cheng. It's not easy though, is it?
translation: 是的，程太太。尽管这不容易，对吧？

original: Thank you for saying so, sir. It's always my great pleasure. If you'd ever like to try another dish, I have an extensive menu of delicacies.
translation: 谢谢你这么说，先生。这是我的荣幸。不如你尝尝另一道菜吧，我有精选菜单。

original: Things are alright, I guess. I'm thinking I should stop by sometime and get some new clothes. I just can't seem to find the time.
translation: 还好，我觉得。我在想或许有时间我也该来逛逛，添些新衣服。我只是抽不出时间。

original: Nonsense. I'm fine. I enjoy making food and keeping the residents happy. A vacation from this would only make me anxious.
translation: 胡说，我很好。我热衷于烹饪，让居民过得开心。给我假期反而会使我焦虑。

original: Oh, I'm alright, I suppose. Though, apparently raiders have been attacking the caravans again. Missed a shipment. I'll just have to be creative!
translation: 哦，我觉得我没问题。显然，歹徒又开始袭击商队了。损失了一批货物，看来我得想想办法了！

original: Thank you for saying so! It's always been my dream to own my own restaurant. Supplies have been running low, but it just makes me more creative!
translation: 谢谢你能这么说！拥有我自己的餐馆一直是我的梦想。或许补给来得很少，但这却激发了我的创意！

original: Thank you. It's always my pleasure to serve you Mr. Cheng. If you'd like, I could prepare a special candle light dinner for you and Mrs. Cheng.
translation: 谢谢你。为您服务是我的荣幸，程先生。如果您愿意，我会为您和程太太安排一次烛光晚餐。

original: Yes, well. There've been shortages of certain things, so I've had to get creative. I hope everything is to your liking Ms. Montenegro.
translation: 是的，嗯。有些东西是缺货，所以我不得不想出新办法。我希望你满意这一切，黑山女士。

original: Don't worry about me. I'm fine. Besides, if I didn't cook for all of you, you'd starve to death! Heaven knows none of you can fend for yourselves!
translation: 别为我担心，我没事。而且，如果我不为你们做饭的话，你们就会饿死！天知道你们怎么照顾自己！

original: Why, yes. I believe so. Fairly happy, anyway. I really enjoy what I do. Cooking and preparing meals for the residents makes me happy.
translation: 啊，是的。我也相信。无论如何，非常开心。我真的喜欢所做的事。为居民烹饪和准备食物让我很快乐。

original: What? Oh right. Hah! That's a good one, Daring. I'm fine really. I've been drinking since I was a toddler. I can hold my liquor. What's new with you?
translation: 什么？哦，好吧。哈！那个好，亲爱的。我真的没事。我在学走路的时候就开始喝了。我知道自己的酒量。你有什么新闻？

original: My secret to what? Oh right. The ladies. Always start off with a few drinks to loosen up, then move onto the hard liquor to get the party rolling!
translation: 我的什么秘密？哦，好吧。女士们。总要先喝几杯才开口，然后换成烈酒聚会才会达到高潮。

original: Indeed! And at the beginning of a long day! Though, I prefer the stiffer stuff myself. So how're you holding up these days? How's that shop of yours?
translation: 是啊！还是在漫长的一天刚开始的时候！不过，我自己喜欢更带劲的东西。那你这些天怎么样。你的店还好吗？

original: I wouldn't pay you so much to hang out with me if I thought you were ugly! I'm just kidding. Stop fishing for compliments. You know you're beautiful.
translation: 要是我觉得你很丑，干嘛花那么多钱让你陪我！我是开玩笑的。别再找人恭维你了，你知道自己很漂亮的。

original: Just goes to show you: It's always darker on the other side of the fence.
translation: 只是想告诉你：事情的另一面往往更黑暗。

original: EDGAR! I do believe you are trying to shake me off! The fire has finally died away, has it, Edgar? You fancy someone else these days, do you?
translation: 埃德加！我确信你是想甩掉我！激情终于熄灭了，对吧，埃德加？这几天你迷上别人了，是不是？

original: Why thank you Allistair love. Er, I mean: MISTER Tenpenny!
translation: 多谢你，亲爱的奥利斯特。呃，我的意思是：特佩尼先生！

original: Doctor Banfield! Have you lost your appointment book? I thought we've made a regular appointment. A "house call" I do believe!
translation: 班菲尔德医生！你是不是丢了你的预约表？我想我们有定期约见。我记得是“上门服务”。

original: Yes Edgar dear, I'm quite fine. Thanks for asking! Maybe I'll "see you" around later, then? When you get out for an "evening stroll," perhaps?
translation: 是的，亲爱的埃德加，我非常好。多谢关心！要不要我过一阵来“见见你”？在你“晚上遛弯”的时候吧，怎么样？

original: Whatever. I know your type, Daring. You want me all to yourself. Well, I'm not some trophy animal you can just bag and hang on your wall!
translation: 随便。我知道你是什么人，亲爱的。你想要完全拥有我。不过，我可不是什么你能挂在墙上的猎物标本！

original: Don't be scared Irving, dear! I won't bite. Well, not unless you ask me to! Hahahaha!
translation: 别害怕，亲爱的艾尔文！我不咬人。唔，除非你让我咬！哈哈哈哈！

original: Don't be silly, Michael. It's because you pay me to be nice to you!
translation: 别傻了，迈克尔。那是因为你付钱让我对你好。

original: Why? You haven't seen him have you?!
Ha! Well, doc. If you got a pill that will make my husband disappear, I'll gladly take it.
translation: 哈！大夫。如果你有能让我丈夫消失的药丸，我会非常高兴的。

original: Yeah. He's so stupid! I don't actually need to sneak out. I just tell him to piss off, and then I leave. If he was smart, he'd try to stop me. Men!
translation: 是啊，他傻透了！我没必要溜出去。我只是让他滚，然后自己离开。他要是聪明点，就该试着拦住我的。男人！

original: Oh no! I'm not going to make it that easy for you. If you can't figure it out, then I'm not going to help you. Why are you so stupid?!
translation: 哦，不！我不会这么容易就让你得到的。如果你搞不定，我才不帮你。你为什么那么蠢？！

original: You mean other than the fact that he is an idiot? Or that he's always busy with stupid meetings, or writing stupid books, that NO ONE cares about?
translation: 你是说除了他是个大白痴之外？还是他一直忙于开些愚蠢的会，或者写些蠢透了的、没人在乎的书？

original: No amount of drink is going to make my husband less stupid. But, it'll certainly help me forget about him, won't it.
translation: 喝再多的酒也不能让我丈夫少点傻气。不过，这倒是能帮助我忘记他，是吧。

original: I've never heard Dad talk about you. Why is that?
translation: 我从未听父亲提到过你，为什么？

original: I'm quite sure I don't know. Why don't you ask him that?
translation: 我真的不知道，为什么你不去问问他？

original: Where can I find Ted Strayer?
translation: 我在哪能找到泰德·斯崔尔？

original: Have you tried the common room? That's where he sleeps.
translation: 你去过公用休息室了吗？他就在那里睡觉。

original: Otherwise... hmmm. You can probably find him on the flight deck some days, if it isn't raining.
translation: 否则……唔，有时候你可能会在飞行甲板上找到他，如果没下雨的话。

original: He usually goes to the Muddy Rudder on Sundays. Beyond that, who knows.
translation: 他通常在礼拜天去“泥舵”酒吧。除此之外，天晓得。

original: Can you tell me more about my parents?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于我父母的事吗？

original: I suppose so. I worked with them for several years until... Until your mother died, and your father decided it was time to leave.
translation: 可以。我和他们在一起工作了几年，直到……直到你母亲去世，你父亲也因此觉得，是时候该离开了。

original: What else do you want to know?
translation: 你还想知道其他什么事吗？

original: What do you want to know?
Any help you can provide would be appreciated.
translation: 如果你能提供任何帮助，我将感激不尽。

original: Why, yes. Let me give you one of my old fashioned chocolate chip cookies! Enjoy!
translation: 啊，是的。让我给你做个我拿手的碎巧克力甜饼吧！好好享受！

original: I've been saving up stuff for emergencies in case things with Arefu got tremendously bad.
translation: 我已经为紧急事态储备了足够的东西，以免断桥镇的形势更加恶化。

original: You're welcome to some of it if you like.
I have a message for the West family from their daughter.
translation: 我有维斯特家的女儿捎给他们的一封信。

original: I can't take that. You're just going to have to bring it back to Lucy or to Ian if you can find him.
translation: 我不能收。你必须把它带回给露西，如果你能找到伊恩，交给他也行。

original: I can't take that. You're just going to have to bring it to the Wests yourself.
translation: 我不能收。你自己去交给维斯特一家吧。

original: Well, I have this letter for the West Family.
translation: 唔，我有一封给维斯特家的信。

original: That's great, but I got bigger problems than being the town post office right now.
translation: 那很好，但是我眼下有比当镇上的邮局大得多的麻烦。

original: The shit's about to hit the fan in this cesspool, and I don't think I can stop them.
translation: 麻烦一大堆，而我却束手无策。

original: I don't have time for games, Vance.
translation: 万斯，我没时间跟你玩游戏。

original: That is where you are mistaken, my friend. Time is a commodity more abundant than any other in this world.
translation: 这你就错了，我的朋友。时间是这个世界上最丰富的资源。

original: In ceremony, each member of the Family must speak one of the Laws... it is theirs to remember and to enforce.
translation: 每当举行典礼的时候，我们当中的每个人都要说出法则中的一条。……那是他们必须记住和坚持执行的法则。

original: Perhaps from these Laws you can discover what we are. Return to me when you are ready.
translation: 可能从这些法则之中，你能发现我们是什么样的人。若你准备好就回来找我。

original: Yes well. I'm a visionary, that's true. But I'm also a creature of habit. I like my Iguana Bits sandwich just the way I always get it. Thank you.
translation: 是啊。我是个空想家，没错。但我同样是个有习惯的生物。我喜欢老样子的蜥蜴肉丁三明治。谢谢你。

original: Well... I'm glad to know you are getting along. I'll, umm... expect a visit at the usual time. Run along dear. And do be careful.
translation: 这个……很高兴你和大家都熟了。我更……希望你在通常的时间来。走开吧，亲爱的，小心。

original: Looks like someone woke up on the wrong side of the bed. I bet I could help you end up on the right side! Haha! Have good day, dear.
translation: 看来有人早上吃错药了。我敢保证能帮你作出正确的选择！哈哈哈！日安，亲爱的。

original: Fine. Keep wearing those rags. But when you're ready for fabulous, you come see me; I've got just the thing!
translation: 好啊。继续穿那些破布吧。但是当你打算变漂亮时，来找我吧，我有最合适的！

original: No. Can't say that I do.
Why, you old hag! You're just jealous. My fabulousity pains you, doesn't it? You can't help feel smaller standing before my greatness, can you dear?
translation: 怎么啦，你这老太婆！妒忌了吧。我的美貌刺痛了你，是不是？在我的伟岸面前，你不可避免地变得渺小，对吧？

original: You need to MAKE time, dear! You'll never be fabulous just moping around a kitchen all day. You need to relax, go out, get done up, have some fun!
translation: 你需要“找”些时间，亲爱的！你整天在厨房里闷闷不乐是漂亮不起来的。你需要放松，出门，打扮，找找乐子！

original: And I thought I hated MY life!
Well, that's more than I had in mind. Maybe I'll just order a new labcoat instead.
translation: 比我想像得要贵。要不然我还是定一件新的实验室外套吧。

original: Alright. They're your men. I just don't want to have to sew anything back on because one of your guys got a little carried away.
translation: 好吧。他们是你的人。我也不想因为你的一个人有点激动就把所有的东西缝起来。

original: That's good to hear... only, you should stick to the suggested dosage, and avoid alcohol for at least two hours after taking it. Come see me soon.
translation: 好消息……只不过，你应该保持服用建议的剂量，而且服药后至少两小时内不要喝酒。有需要再来我这。

original: Fine. For now. I got my eye on you. If you seem to be getting exhausted, I'm prescribing that vacation!
translation: 目前还行。我会盯着你。如果你看起来变得很疲惫，我就会让你病假！

original: Ah! I remember now. Yes of course. I'll be sure to bring my medicine bag with me.
translation: 啊！我想起来了。是啊，当然。我一定会带上我的医药包。

original: No. I'm afraid you'll need to take care of that one on your own. But I might have something that'll help you cope. Come see me for a prescription.
translation: 不，恐怕你需要自己应付了。但我或许有些帮你应付的方法。到我这来，我会给你开处方。

original: Yes, well. You'll think of something I'm sure. Good luck.
translation: 是的，没错。我肯定会想出办法的。祝好运。

original: No, no. Of course not you silly woman. It's just that I... well... I think spending time with the other ladies in the Tower might do you some good.
translation: 不，不。当然不是了，你个蠢女人。只不过……这个……我想与大厦里的其他女孩共度夜晚或许会对你好些。

original: Um... Yes. Right. Of course. Okay then. See you around Ms. Lancaster.
translation: 嗯…是的。没错。当然。那好吧。回见，兰卡斯特女士。

original: I once killed a Yao Guai with my bare hands! Almost lost an arm. But I got the bastard in the end. Ah... Those were the days.
translation: 我曾经赤手空拳宰了一只妖怪！几乎丢了一只胳膊。不过最后我还是把那玩意给弄死了。啊……往事如烟……

original: Hehe. I'm sorry to hear that, Irving. Maybe I should take a look at your computer sometime. Heheh.
translation: 呵呵。很抱歉听到这消息，艾尔文。要不找时间我帮你看看你的电脑吧。呵呵。

original: That's the spirit, girl! Every seeming setback is actually just a chance for your genius to shine!
translation: 就该是这种态度，女孩！每次表面上的受挫都是让你的才华闪耀的机会！

original: Just trying to keep busy, I guess. I'm not sure I'm really cut out for the whole retirement thing. Just can't seem to sit still.
translation: 我想，只是要找些事情做吧。我还不知道自己是否适合这退休生活。好像就是坐不住啊。

original: We'll just have to see about that! You watch out! I can be a very stealthy hunter!
translation: 我们等着瞧！你小心！我可是个善于隐蔽自己的猎人！

original: Some men just don't have the hunting instinct, dear. You should try talking to him about your needs.
translation: 一些人就是没有当猎人的天分，亲爱的。你不如先找他聊聊你的需求。

original: Right, comrade! I see. The fabulous comes from the inside out. I will have to remember that. Thank you!
translation: 好的，同志！我明白。美丽是由内而外的。我一定要记住这个。谢谢你！

original: Oh. I'm sorry Comraaa - err, CHIEF Gustavo!
translation: 哦，实在抱歉，同 — 呃，古斯塔沃长官!

original: Every day it erases everything. Each day I have to start over again. But it's not the end of the world. I have everything memorized. Never mind.
translation: 每天它都会清空。每天我都要重来。但这并不是世界末日。我把一切都记住了，不要紧。

original: Yes, you are right, comrade. But I'm afraid I've done something to upset her, and now she isn't talking to me. Never mind. I'll figure something out.
translation: 对，你没错，同志。但恐怕我已经做了一些让她不高兴的事，现在她不肯和我说话了。不要紧，我会有办法的。

original: That's an excellent idea, comrade! I have to get her to stop and listen to me for a moment to even ask her if she'd like that. But thank you though.
translation: 那是个非常棒的主意，同志！我一定让她停下来听我说说，甚至会问问她是否喜欢。但还是多谢你了。

original: Oh, I see. Well, maybe you're right. Mrs. Cheng spends a lot of time drinking in the lounge, doesn't she.
translation: 哦，我明白了。或许你是对的。程太太老是泡在休息室里喝酒，对吧？

original: Oh... oh. Alright Susan. I'll see you later then?
translation: 哦……哦。好了，苏珊。那我们待会见？

original: I don't know why I'm so stupid. Never mind. I'll go work on my projects.
translation: 我不知道我为什么这么蠢。不要紧，我会继续我的计划。

original: Do you realize how often you use that word? You be careful, darling, or you'll wear it out like you've worn out your sense of style.
translation: 你意识到你自己对这个词的使用频率了吗？小心，亲爱的，否则你就对它没感觉了，就像你对时装没感觉一样。

original: Yes, of course, child! Your dishes are always superb!
translation: 是啊，当然了，孩子！你做的饭总是特别棒！

original: That shop is my pride and joy. I like to be surrounded by fine things - a little beauty in all this ugliness.
translation: 那个店是我的骄傲和乐趣。我喜欢被精致的东西包围着 — 在这个无所不在的丑陋中的一点美丽。

original: Have you tried distracting him, dear? You know, get his "attention" every now and then? Some men are just clueless when it comes to a woman's needs.
translation: 你试过分散他的注意力么，亲爱的？你知道，不时地吸引他的“注意力”？当涉及女人的需要的时候，有些男人简直笨透了。

original: Thank you, but I'm always so busy serving everyone. Maybe you can just pick something out for me and send it along with the hairnets.
translation: 谢谢你，但我一直忙于为每个人服务。不如你帮我拣出一些东西来，和发网一起送走吧。

original: Right, of course. Well, maybe I'll send a special desert over there today, to let them know we appreciate their keeping us safe and sound.
translation: 是的，当然了。或许我今天应该送点特别甜点，让他们知道，我们感激他们保护我们平安。

original: I found this old cook book for something called "sushi." Um... well, you might want to check up on a few residents I already served it to. Whoopsie.
translation: 我发现了关于“寿司”的旧烹饪书。嗯……不如你去找几个曾经尝过这的居民来问问。

original: Indeed! I'll drink to that! Cheers!
translation: 没错！我要畅饮一番！干杯！

original: Huh... sure. I'll drink to that Comrade!
translation: 呃……好哇。我要和那位同志喝一杯！

original: I always have my happy face on! I mean, just look at it! Are you looking? See how happy it is! The key, you see, is not to give a damn about anything
translation: 我总是带着开心的面容！我的意思是，一望即知！你在看吗？看我多开心！你看，关键是，他妈的什么都别在乎！

original: I just thought it might be helpful for the security team to know where everyone is and what they are doing. You know, in case of emergency.
translation: 我只是想，如果警卫了解每个人都在哪里和在做什么，会有帮助的。你知道，以防不测。

original: Hehe. Of course, love. Until then. Be good boy now! Hahaha.
translation: 呵呵。当然了，爱人。到时候见吧。现在做个好小伙吧！哈哈哈。

original: Call me Susan. And if you like, we can be on even more "familiar" terms! Hahah!
translation: 叫我苏珊。如果你喜欢，我们可以有更“亲热”的称呼！哈哈哈！

original: A house call, perhaps? I'll be waiting! Hahah!
translation: 或者，上门服务？那我等着！哈哈哈！

original: Trust me. I know all about it... You're right, of course. Being bored out of your mind and surrounded by morons ain't all that bad. Even still...
translation: 相信我。我知道它的一切……你是对的，当然。无聊至极和被蠢货包围也不算太糟。甚至……

original: That wife of yours has you terrified, doesn't she? Don't worry. I can help you relax.
translation: 你那老婆吓着你了，对吧？别担心，我会帮你放松下来。

original: Haha. Perhap's you're right, dear. But you could always set out a few meals in advance and take a nap once in a while.
translation: 哈哈。或许你是对的，亲爱的。但你可以事先准备好几份饭，然后抽时间打个盹。

original: I'm not sure whether to be hurt or flattered by all that.
translation: 我不清楚是该生气还是高兴。

original: I was afraid you'd say that.
I shouldn't have to talk to him. Why make it easy for him? He doesn't make it easy for me! If he can't see the problem, then he's just stupid.
translation: 我不该和他说话。为什么饶了他？他可没饶过我！如果他看不到问题所在，那他就是个大傻瓜。

original: I guess maybe I should figure out what I want to do with MY life.
translation: 我想或许我该弄明白我要拿自己的生活怎么办。

original: Can you teach me the ways of the Vampire?
translation: 你能教我成为血族的方法吗？

original: To be a vampire is a life commitment. It is not achieved by my words, it is something you earn by your own will and sincere meditation.
translation: 变成血族是要献身的。它不是通过我的语言实现的，而是要通过你自己的意志和冥想去赢得。

original: Sadly, I cannot fully make you one of us, but I can teach you how the life blood of others brings us regenerative powers.
translation: 很遗憾，我无法让你完全变成我们中的一员，但我能教你别人的生命之血如何带给我们重生的力量。

original: Since your body lacks the way to extract blood as we do, you must find alternative sources for your nourishment.
translation: 鉴于你的躯体缺乏像我们那样抽取血液的能力，你必须另想办法获取营养。

original: Drink deep of the blood, allow not a drop to spill. Feel the warmth as it spreads inside you.
translation: 大口饮下血液，不要漏出一滴。感受它的温暖在你体内蔓延。

original: You are becoming one with the life force of another. They lend a part of themselves to you. For a brief moment, you are two entities becoming one.
translation: 你会变成拥有别人生命力的人。他们将自己的一部分借给了你。在短时间内，你是两个实体融合为一。

original: Allow the feelings to course through your body as you partake of the blood... feel it empower you and make you stronger.
translation: 当你享用血液时，让这感觉穿越你的身体……体验它给你带来的力量，并使你更强壮。

original: Once you have done this deed, only then will you know what it is like to be a vampire.
translation: 只有做到这一点，你才能了解血族是个什么样。

original: There is no more I can teach you.
translation: 我没法再教你更多东西了。

original: Use what little I have given you well, and carry that knowledge with honor.
translation: 好好地运用我的这点浅见，珍视这些学识。

original: And, well, yes... the Enclave is me, as well. Ha ha ha. As your President, it's my responsibility to preside over our great democracy.
translation: 而且，是啊……英克雷也就是我。哈哈哈。作为你们的总统，我有责任统帅我们伟大的民主。

original: So let me ask you, America. How many of your children can say the same? How many of this nation's youth are truly happy, truly carefree?
translation: 那让我问问你，美利坚。你们有多少孩子可以这么说？这个国家有多少青少年真正开心，真正无忧无虑？

original: What about the Slavers of Paradise falls? The frighteningly irradiated Ghouls of Underworld?
translation: 堕落天堂的奴隶贩子怎样？地下城那些可怕的辐射僵尸呢？

original: You obviously know all about the G.E.C.K., so let's help each other out.
translation: 你显然很了解伊甸园创造器，那么让我们互相帮个忙吧。

original: Indeed. Your powers of deduction are quite impressive. I do indeed know where it is and how to get it.
translation: 确实，你的逻辑十分清晰。我确实知道它在哪，还有怎么得到它。

original: The device is surrounded by a lethal field of radiation; lethal to humans that is.
translation: 那装置被致命的辐射包围着，就是说，对人类很致命。

original: Without insulting your intelligence, I think you can see where this is going.
translation: 我没有取笑你的意思，但我认为你知道那样的下场。

original: Sometimes I get the feeling I'm talking to myself.
translation: 有时候我觉得就像在自言自语。

original: Sorry dear... must have dozed off there for a moment.
translation: 对不起，亲爱的……我想是打了个瞌睡。

original: That Mister Burke is a shady character, isn't he? I've heard some positively awful things about him. But Tenpenny trusts him. So he can't be all bad.
translation: 伯克先生是个阴险的角色，对吧？我听过一些有关他特别可怕的传言。但是特佩尼先生信任他。所以他也应该不是很坏。

original: Ms. Montenegro's quite full of herself, isn't she? Puffed up like a souffle, she is! Ha! That was a good one, wasn't it? I'm quite funny today!
translation: 黑山女士自我膨胀，对不对？她胀得像要爆掉了，哈哈！那个笑话还不错，对吧？我今天很开心！

original: Very well. If you insist on remaining a social hermit, by all means continue to follow me around all day.
translation: 很好。如果你坚持要成为一个遁世者，不妨整天都跟着我好了。

original: You're wasting your time. I don't want to have to tell you again. This gun is loaded. I'd hate for it to accidentally go off in your direction.
translation: 你在浪费时间。我不打算再跟你说了。这把枪已经上膛。我可不想它冲着你的时候走火。

original: At least I'm not some dried up tart, prancing around like the queen of America, carelessly spouting grotesque phrases. "Fabulousity?" Really now!
translation: 至少我不是那种无聊的轻佻女人，弄得自己好像“美利坚皇后”似的，还拿腔捏调地：“难-以-置-信~”就像现在这样！

original: You know the other ladies and I don't get along famously. They're quite jealous of me, naturally.
translation: 你知道我和其他女孩相处得并不融洽。当然，她们都很嫉妒我。

original: Whatever. He loves those damn meetings, and that stupid "Community Manifesto" of his more than me. He hardly knows I exist!
translation: 无论如何，他爱那些讨厌的会议，还有他那愚蠢的“共产党宣言”更胜于我。他几乎不知道我的存在！

original: Ha! You'll drink to ANYTHING! Cheers!
translation: 哈！为什么干杯都行！干杯！

original: Ha! He's so stupid, he wouldn't know what do to even if I did manage to get his attention!
translation: 哈！他太蠢了，即使我引起了他的注意，他也不知道该怎么办！

original: Ohhh. Well, comrade. I don't think I'll ever be able to do that.
translation: 哦。同志。我不认为我能做到。

original: Ha! See?! That's what I'm talking about! Stupid. Stupid man!
translation: 哈！看到了？这就是我所说的！愚蠢的，愚蠢的男人！

original: Okay, enough with the addict routine. Tell me what you want already!
translation: 好了，别再说什么瘾君子日常了。直接告诉我你想要什么吧！

original: "Can you resist the taste that'll blow up in your face?!" like Ronald always says. He thinks of the best Nuka-Cola jingles!
translation: “你能抗拒那扑面而来的美味吗？！”就像罗纳德常说的那样。他总能想出最棒的核子可乐广告语！

original: Anyway, for every bottle you bring me I'll pay you some caps. You know, for expenses.
translation: 总之，每带来一瓶，我就会付给你一些瓶盖。你知道的，作为开销。

original: But if you're super cool and find like enough bottles to fill my Nuka-Cola machine, 30 in all, I got a super secret cool prize for you!
translation: 但如果你超厉害，能找到足够多的瓶子来装满我的核子可乐机，一共30瓶，我有一个超级秘密酷大奖给你！

original: Protector Casdin, sir! We've got a local interested in the job!
translation: 守护者卡斯丁，长官！我们找到一个有兴趣做这任务的原住民！

original: Nope. Sorry. Protector Casdin says the locals around here are barely smarter than the Mole Rats.
translation: 不行，抱歉。守护者卡斯丁说，这的原住民未必比地鼠更聪明。

original: But Morgan said we might have some work for an outsider. Talk with her, if you're really interested.
translation: 不过摩根说我们或许可以给外来者一些工作。跟她谈谈，如果你真有兴趣的话。

original: Nope. Sorry. Protector Casdin says the locals around here are barely smarter than the Mole Rats.
translation: 不行，抱歉。守护者卡斯丁说，这的原住民未必比地鼠更聪明。

original: But Morgan said we might have some work for an outsider. Talk with her, if you're really interested.
translation: 不过摩根说我们或许可以给外来者一些工作。跟她谈谈，如果你真有兴趣的话。

original: We aren't recruiting, kid. Old sap Lyons might trust walk-ins, but we don't.
translation: 我们不征兵，孩子。老白痴里昂斯或许会信任那些不请自来的人，但我们可不一样。

original: But if you want to help out... well, we might be able to work out a deal.
translation: 但如果你想要帮忙……我们或许能做个交易。

original: You bring in technological devices, and we'll pay you a finder's fee, based on the device. But Protector Casdin would have to okay it, first.
translation: 你给我们带来科技装置，我们就会付你酬劳，当然，以质定价。不过首先要得到守护者卡斯丁的允许。

original: You collect technology? How do I sign up?
translation: 你们收集技术？要不要我帮忙？

original: I want a new opening speech. One that acknowledges me as King.
translation: 我要一场全新的公开演说。承认我是国王。

original: Don't think you'll scare anyone here. You could shoot down everyone in town, and I wouldn't flinch.
translation: 别以为你能吓唬谁。这镇上的人你随便杀，而我不会退缩的。

original: You live in Big Town; you learn to accept death.
translation: 住在大镇，你就得学会接受死亡。

original: I want a new opening speech. One that acknowledges me as King.
translation: 我要一场全新的公开演说。承认我是国王。

original: Don't think you'll scare anyone here. You could shoot down everyone in town, and I wouldn't flinch.
translation: 别以为你能吓唬谁。这镇上的人你随便杀，而我不会退缩的。

original: You live in Big Town; you learn to accept death.
translation: 住在大镇，你就得学会接受死亡。

original: I want a new opening speech. One that acknowledges me as Queen.
translation: 我要一场全新的公开演说。承认我是女王。

original: What happened to our deal, Sierra?
Ohhhh... Ronald is SUCH a sweetheart! Do you know he went out like you did and found me 30 bottles of Quantum?
translation: 哦~~~……罗纳德真是太贴心了！你知道他像你一样出去，却给我找回了30瓶量子版吗？

original: He loves me! He really loves me! Now I bet he'll ask me to get married.
translation: 他爱我！他真的真的爱我！我打赌他会向我求婚的。

original: Oh! For my wedding present I'm giving him the super secret prize too!
translation: 哦！为了我的结婚礼物，我也要给他超级秘密奖品！

original: Oh great. I thought I was rid of you.
translation: 哦，天啦，我还以为已经甩掉你了。

original: No such luck, sucker! Life ain't worth living without Butch around, and you can't keep a Tunnel Snake down.
translation: 没那么幸运，小毛孩！如果没有布奇伴你左右，你活着毫无意义，而且你也搞不定一个穴蛇帮。

original: But if you're lucky, you can hold my empties. Here.
translation: 但如果你幸运的话，你可以为我拿着空瓶。接住。

original: How did you get all the way down here?
translation: 你是怎么一路到这来的？

original: Ah, you know you can't keep a Tunnel Snake cooped up forever! We gotta be free, and your little visit was just the inspiration I needed!
translation: 啊，你知道没人能永远困住穴蛇帮的！我们必将获得自由，你的小小拜访正好激发了我！

original: So here's to sweet, glorious freedom! Cheers!
translation: 所以，为了梦寐以求的自由，干杯！

original: I thought the Overseer closed the Vault. How did you get out?
translation: 我以为监督者把避难所给关闭了，你是怎么跑出来的？

original: Same way anyone does. By being too cool to stop anywhere else! I didn't see a thing in the wasteland that was a match for a bona fide Tunnel Snake!
translation: 和别人的办法一样。酷到不能在其它地方逗留！我从未见过废土上有谁能与真正的穴蛇帮匹敌！

original: So, here's to freedom and rocking the Wasteland! Drink up!
translation: 为享受自由，颠覆废土，干杯！

original: Sounds like a deal. Good to see you on the outside, Butch!
translation: 听上去不错。很高兴在外面能见到你，布奇！

original: Here's to raising hell and living the good life out here! Cheers!
translation: 为杀出地狱，享受外面的美好生活，干杯！

original: Now all we need is a gang, and we could take over this whole Wasteland!
translation: 现在，我们只需要成立一个帮派，就能接管废土了！

original: Can I see what you have for sale?
translation: 我能看看你出售的东西吗？

original: If your caps are good, you can buy whatever you like. Beats standing there drooling all over the merchandise.
translation: 如果你有足够的瓶盖，你可以随便买你想要的任何东西，不用站在那对着货品流口水。

original: Drinking that stuff can't be good for you if it contains radiation.
translation: 如果它含有放射性的话，喝下它对你可没什么好处。

original: Well, I guess so. I heard that sometimes the radiation would remain in people's systems, but only in a few test cases.
translation: 我想也是。我听说有时候辐射会影响到人体的系统，但只是少数的试验中。

original: All you'd need is a little RadAway and poof, the isotope is gone.
translation: 你需要的东西就是一包辐特宁，噗的一声，同位素就没了。

original: What if there are others that don't share your opinion?
translation: 万一有其他人不同意你的意见呢？

original: Oh, you mean Harold? He's really nice. Sometimes when I get really lonely, I go into the Grove and talk to him.
translation: 哦，你说的是哈罗德吧？他真的很好。有时候我觉得很孤单，就会去小树林里跟他聊聊天。

original: Sometimes I even curl up all cozy like and sleep next to his roots after I have a bad dream.
translation: 有时候在我做噩梦后，我甚至会舒坦地蜷缩在他的树根旁睡觉。

original: I tell him what I'm scared of and he tells me what he's scared of. It makes me feel better knowing I'm not the only one.
translation: 我跟他讲我怕些什么，他也跟我讲他怕些什么。知道我不是唯一害怕的人，让我感觉好多了。

original: It wasn't free. Doctor's fees are expensive. Understand?
translation: 这可不是义务治疗，医生的收费是很高的，明白？

original: What can you tell me about Nuka-Cola Cocktails?
translation: 你能跟我说说核子可乐鸡尾酒吗？

original: I don't know a whole lot about weapons, but I do know that it's more powerful than the Molotov Cocktail.
translation: 我对武器不是很懂，但我知道它比莫洛托夫鸡尾酒的威力大多了。

original: It explodes in a huge blue flame too! How cool is that?
translation: 它还会爆发蓝色的火焰！那不是很酷？

original: Tell me more about the Nuka Cocktail.
translation: 告诉我更多关于核子可乐手榴弹的事。

original: Oh, don't worry. No one ever goes there because they say it's a ghost town. And since ghosts don't exist, you can just focus on the landmines.
translation: 哦，别担心。从来没有人去那里，因为他们说那是个鬼城。既然鬼不存在，那么你就专注于地雷吧。

original: I hear there's a playground in the middle of the town. Reach that point and come back, and I'm sure you'll have some stories to tell!
translation: 我听说在镇子中央有一块操场。到那个地点然后回来，我能肯定你有许多故事要讲！

original: I suppose, for the sake of proper research, I can go back into Minefield.
translation: 我想，为了研究的正确性，我能回到雷区。

original: Oh, don't worry. No one ever goes there because they say it's a ghost town. And since ghosts don't exist, you can just focus on the landmines.
translation: 哦，别担心。从来没有人去那里，因为他们说那是个鬼城。既然鬼不存在，那么你就专注于地雷吧。

original: I hear there's a playground in the middle of the town. Reach that point and come back, and I'm sure you'll have some stories to tell!
translation: 我听说在镇子中央有一块操场。到那个地点然后回来，我能肯定你有许多故事要讲！

original: I'll head into Minefield. Wish me luck.
translation: 我会闯入雷区的，祝我好运吧。

original: Great! The library should be in old Arlington, not far from downtown. See if you can download the archives from its computer.
translation: 好！图书馆应该位于阿灵顿，离市区不远。看你能否从那里的电脑上把档案下载回来。

original: If you can't get those, then even the card catalog would be useful. Any little piece of information could help the book. And thus, humanity!
translation: 如果你拿不到那些的话，那么卡片目录也是很有用的。任何一点情报都会有助于这本书，从而帮助人类！

original: Okay, I'll check out my local library.
translation: 好吧，我会检查当地的图书馆。

original: That's great. I recommend the nest at the Anchorage War Memorial. I knew a trader who talked about the Mirelurks down there.
translation: 太棒了。我推荐位于安克雷奇战争纪念馆的巢穴。我听一个商人说有蟹人盘踞在那。

original: Just go inside and find one of their spawning pods, probably down near the water.
translation: 只要进去，找到一个它们的卵囊就行了，或许会在水面附近。

original: Put this observer inside, and get out quietly. And be sure not to kill any Mirelurks inside their nest! If you do, it could ruin the validity of the study!
translation: 把这个观察器放进去，然后偷偷溜出来。而且别在他们的巢里杀掉任何泥沼蟹！如果你这么做了，就可能破坏实验的效果！

original: Yeah, you should just be able to plug it into the mainframe at the RobCo production facility. It'll give you access to the robots and terminals.
translation: 是呀，你要把它插进RobCo公司生产设施的电脑主机里，然后就能取得使用机器人和终端的权限。

original: Okay, here. And be sure to keep an eye peeled for any other examples of how to make old technology work for you out there!
translation: 好吧，给。还有，多注意下其他可利用的古老科技！

original: Just go in and connect the widget to the mainframe? I can do that.
translation: 也就是进去把这个小物件连接到主机？我能办到。

original: Wait, what? Did you just hit on me?
translation: 住手，干嘛？你刚刚打了我吧？

original: Oh, um, well. I need to get going, but come back and visit me sometime, okay?
translation: 哦，嗯，我必须走了，不过你以后再来看我吧，好吗？

original: I'm not even going to tell you what's wrong with that question...
translation: 我甚至不想告诉你刚才的问题有什么不对的……

original: Oh, um, well. I need to get going, but come back and visit me sometime, okay?
translation: 哦，嗯，这个。我必须走了，不过你以后再来看我吧，好吗？

original: Why, no. I'm not in any sort of relationship. Are you?
translation: 啊呀，没。我没有什么牵挂。你呢？

original: Oh, um, well. I need to get going, but come back and visit me sometime, okay?
translation: 哦，嗯，这个。我必须走了，不过你以后再来看我吧，好吗？

original: Why - I do believe you've lost your mind! Ghouls, living here? You're serious?
translation: 为什么 — 我想你一定是疯了吧！僵尸？住在这？你认真的？

original: There are some Ghouls who want to live here. What do you think about that?
translation: 有一些僵尸想要住在这里，你怎么看？

original: Do you ever dream about monsters? I do.
translation: 你有没有梦见过怪兽？我梦见过。

translation: 我在寻找工厂的货运清单。

original: That information is in the Shipping Computer Terminal. The pass code for the terminal is NC-C1864.
translation: 该信息在货运电脑终端中。终端的密码是NC-C1864。

original: Any information you could give me on the caves below Oasis would be helpful.
translation: 关于绿洲下方的洞穴，你能提供的任何信息都将对我有所帮助。

original: Sure. Here you go. Good luck to you!
May I have the key to the caves?
translation: 可以给我进入洞穴的钥匙吗？

original: Yeah, leave it to good old Bob to get me stuck above some caves. Now my dang feet are cold!
translation: 唉，都怪老鲍勃，害我被困在这些洞穴上。现在我那倒霉的脚好冷！

original: I have some quick questions about those caves.
translation: 对于那洞穴，我有些小问题。

original: You say you saw me coming to Oasis. And you call the Treeminders crazy...
translation: 你说你看到我朝绿洲走来。并且你说那些护树人疯了……

original: Yeah, yeah you have a point there. Maybe I'm just losing my marbles from all this boredom.
translation: 嗯，你这话有道理。也许是因为太过无聊，我都有点神志不清了。

original: I swear if I try real hard, I can see all around me like my eyes are in every leaf on every tree.
translation: 我发誓，只要我使劲儿集中注意力，我就能看见周围的一切，仿佛我的眼睛在每一棵树的每一片叶子上。

original: I think it's making Bob kind of jealous, cause he was the first tree in my life and all that.
translation: 我想这让鲍勃有点嫉妒，因为他是我生命中的第一棵树，诸如此类的原因吧。

original: If people thought I was a god, I'd exploit it for all it's worth!
translation: 要是人们把我当成神，我肯定会充分利用这一点，榨取所有价值！

original: Hey, hey, hey, I thought that too... at first.
translation: 嘿，嘿，嘿，一开始我也这么想……

original: I had them sing me songs, I made them do stupid dances and things like that. Bob even told me to make Maple stand on his head for a whole day!
translation: 我让他们给我唱歌，让他们跳些愚蠢的舞蹈之类的。鲍勃甚至还让我命令梅坡倒立一整天！

original: After a while though, it just gets boring. Then it becomes a nuisance and now it's completely driving me nuts!
translation: 但过了一阵子，就觉得无聊了。接着就成了一种烦扰，而现在，这简直要把我逼疯了！

original: When I saw you coming towards Oasis, I thought I felt that you'd understand me. I guess I was wrong.
translation: 当我看到你朝绿洲走来时，我原以为你能理解我。看来是我想错了。

original: You don't actually seem that sad. Why do you want to die?
translation: 你看上去其实没那么哀伤。为什么想要去死呢？

original: I've been literally rooted to this spot thanks to Bob for maybe twenty or thirty years... I can't even remember anymore.
translation: 因为鲍勃，我已经在这里扎扎实实待了二三十年了……我甚至都记不清多久了。

original: Can you imagine being stuck in one place for that long not being able to eat or to read or to sleep or anything?
translation: 你能想像被困在一个地方那么久，没法吃饭、没法读书、没法睡觉，什么都做不了吗？

original: In the meantime, I have these Treeminders bothering me every day about things I don't even care about, and I can't stand it anymore!
translation: 与此同时，那些护树人每天都拿些我根本不在乎的事情来烦我，我实在是忍无可忍了！

original: How did this all happen, Reilly?
We were mapping the Vernon Square part of the downtown ruins and got jumped by a Super Mutant ambush party.
translation: 我们当时正在前往市区废墟的弗农广场部分，结果遭遇了一群埋伏在那的超级变种人。

original: Usually it isn't a problem, but this group was bigger than usual. We fought our way into Our Lady of Hope Hospital, hoping to find cover.
translation: 通常来说，这不算什么，但这次的队伍比通常庞大。我们杀出了一条通往玛利亚医院的路来，希望能够找到掩护。

original: Eventually the fight spilled into the Statesman Hotel and we ran all the way to the roof.
translation: 最后战斗打到了政要酒店，我们就一路跑到了楼顶。

original: I left my guys up there and tried to stealth out but got caught by a Mutie ambush patrol. That was the last thing I remember.
translation: 我把我的人留在那里，并且试图溜出来，但被一支变种人巡逻队逮住了。那就是我所记得的最后一件事。

original: Oh, it's been centuries. The planet is a lush, green paradise once again.
translation: 哦，都几个世纪了。这个星球将再次变成了繁华的绿色天堂。

original: Huh? What the hell are you talking about? That isn't very funny.
translation: 呃？你他妈在说什么？这一点都不好笑。

original: If my guys were here, they'd kick your...
translation: 如果我的人在这，他们会踢你的…

original: Oh shit! My team! What the hell happened?
translation: 该死！我的队伍！他妈的发生了什么事？

My men... my team! What happened to them?
translation: 我的人……我的队伍！他们怎么样了？

translation: 对……想不起来我当时正在做些什么。

original: That kind of talk is uncalled for. I was, am and always will be a doctor of medicine.
translation: 这种说法是不当的。我曾经，并且永远都是医学博士。

original: I don't care if she was a Super Mutant. I'd still help her.
translation: 我不在乎她是否是个超级变种人，我仍然会帮助她。

original: If they hauled your sorry, shot-up body into my clinic, I'd try and save you too.
translation: 如果他们把你那可怜而伤痕累累的身体拖到我的诊所里来，我也同样会试着救你命的。

original: Tara's dead. Crowley fucked up and got her killed. Fucking Ghoul. When I'm done, he'll sniff butts with the ferals for the rest of his life.
translation: 塔拉死了。考利闯了祸，害死了她。那混蛋僵尸。等我事成后，他这辈子就跟那些凶悍僵尸待在一起吧。

original: You ain't allowed up there, you hear me? Go any farther and you're a dead man. I ain't warning you twice.
translation: 你不准上去，听见没？多走一步，你就死定了。我不会再警告你第二次。

original: You ain't allowed up there, you hear me? Take one more step and they'll be scraping you off the pavement. Ain't gonna warn you again.
translation: 你不准上去，听见没？再迈一步他们就会把你拽下来。不会再次警告你的。

original: I think it would be good for the Republic, Mister President.
translation: 我认为这有益于共和国，总统先生。

original: Of course it would. I knew that. You heard me say that before, didn't you. It was my idea after all.
translation: 当然会，我知道。之前你也听我说过，对吧？毕竟那是我的主意。

original: Here, take it. Your audience is over.
translation: 给，拿去吧。你的晋见时间结束了。

original: Are you sure I can't just have that key, handsome? You know, as a present?
translation: 我真的不能得到那把钥匙吗，帅哥？就当作是礼物好吗？

original: For you, sweet cheeks? Sure thing!
Now, how about I show you how I keep my two bitches happy all night long?
translation: 现在，不如我让你体验一下我让那两个婊子快活一夜的绝活吧？

original: How about I let you live, and you give me something so I can lie to Crowley?
translation: 我会让你活着，你给我一些东西，好让我去向考利交差？

original: Just give me the key. Don't ask why.
Okay, dude, Don't have a cow.
Okay, dude, Don't have a cow.
Just give me all your stuff. And don't ask any questions.
translation: 把你所有的东西都给我，别问为什么。

original: Maybe. I don't know if I trust you.
translation: 可能吧，我不知道自己是否信任你。

original: The feeling's mutual, smoothskin. But that never stopped a business deal.
translation: 这种感觉是相互的，光皮肤。但是那从来没有阻断过商业交易。

original: A lot of you humans are bigots. You don't like Ghouls and treat us like zombies, calling us brain eaters and shufflers.
translation: 很多人类都是偏执狂。你们讨厌僵尸，像对待丧尸一样对待我们，还把我们叫作食脑者和瘸子。

original: Well, they're going to pay. Uh... before I get into the details, you don't have anything against killing do you?
translation: 他们将会付出代价。喔……在我谈论细节之前，我先问问，你对杀人没什么异议吧？ ?

original: A talking Super Mutant? What's next, a dog on a bicycle?
translation: 一个会说话的超级变种人？接下来会是什么？一只骑着自行车的狗？

original: Who are you? I've never met a friendly Super Mutant before.
translation: 你是谁？我之前从未见过友善的超级变种人。

original: I was driven out by my brothers.
translation: 我被我的兄弟驱逐出来了。

original: I tried to get them to understand that there was more to life than fighting and killing, but they wouldn't listen.
translation: 我设法使他们了解生活不仅仅是打斗和杀戮，但是他们不听。

original: Now I wander the Wasteland, hoping to find some meaning to life before I die.
translation: 现在，我在废土流浪着，希望能在有生之年发现一些生命的真缔。

original: How about we make it 300 caps?
Well, that's wonderful. Here are your caps. Thanks very much!
translation: 嗯，真不错。这是你的瓶盖。非常感谢你！

translation: 嗯，真不错。这是你的瓶盖。非常感谢你！

original: Look, granny... Talk is cheap, but getting stuff isn't.
translation: 嗯，老婆婆……谈话是廉价的，但换东西却不是。

original: You have a lot to learn about dealing with people, young man. However, you're right. I need to think of your needs too.
translation: 对于处理人际关系，你还有很多东西要学，小伙子。不过你提的也对，我是该考虑下你的需要。

original: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
translation: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。

original: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
translation: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。

original: You have a lot to learn about dealing with people, young lady. However, you're right. I need to think of your needs too.
translation: 对于处理人际关系，你还有很多东西要学，小女孩。不过你提的也对，我是该考虑下你的需要。

translation: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。

original: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
translation: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。

original: I want to help you, but that type of search could cost me greatly.
translation: 我很想帮你，但那种搜寻可会花费我大量的时间和精力。

original: You have a point. Perhaps I've been neglecting needs that you might have and being selfish.
translation: 你说得对。或许是我忽略了你可能的需求以及你的自私。

original: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
translation: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。

original: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
translation: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。

original: I guess a homemade violin is never quite in tune...
translation: 我看这把自制的小提琴音不太准……

original: Yes, that's exactly the problem that I have with it. It doesn't quite play all of the notes correctly and I have to constantly tinker with it.
translation: 是的，那正是我的麻烦所在。它总是不能正确地演奏音符，而我不得不经常修补它。

original: Wow, Reilly. You look like shit.
translation: 哇哦，莱莉。你看起来真狼狈。

original: You got a lot of class, kid.
translation: 你还有很多的课要上，孩子。

original: I feel worse than I look, but that doesn't even matter to me. I'm just worried about the rest of the Rangers.
translation: 呃，我的感觉比外表还糟，但我不在乎。我只是担心其他的游骑兵。

original: I don't even know if they're still alive.
translation: 我甚至不知道他们是死是活。

original: Forget it. I may as well shoot myself in the head and save the trouble.
translation: 算了。我不如朝自己头上开一枪来摆脱这些麻烦。

original: Wow. You really are an asshole. Fine. I hope their deaths sit well on your conscience.
translation: 哇哦。你真是一个混蛋。好吧，我希望他们的死能唤起你的良知。

original: Did you set any kinds of traps or mines?
translation: 你有没有设陷阱或是埋地雷？

original: Actually, we did lay down a bunch of countermeasures. I don't know how many of them have already gone off though.
translation: 实际上，我们的确制订了一堆对策。但我不知道它们有多少已经失效了。

original: When I slipped out with my Stealth Boy, I think I almost tripped one or two of them.
translation: 当我使用隐身小子溜出来的时侯, 我想我差点就触动了其中的一两个。

original: Damn near didn't make it out of there at all, come to think of it.
translation: 回想一下，我差点就没从那里逃出来。

original: I've heard of you guys. You pack some serious firepower.
translation: 我听说过你们。你们有一些可怕的武器。

original: We pack plenty of firepower, but that didn't help us from getting our asses into serious trouble.
translation: 我们装备有大量武器，不过这他妈的并没有帮助我们远离那些大麻烦。

original: I didn't expect to make it out of there alive.
Let's skip all the story and get to the point.
translation: 我们跳过所有的故事来谈谈重点吧。你需要些什么？

original: So you're that eager to jump in headfirst, eh? You remind me a lot of some crazy mercs I knew back in the day.
translation: 你就真的这么迫不及待吗，嗯？你倒是让我回想起了过去认识的许多疯狂的佣兵。

original: They're all dead now because they were stupid, but suit yourself.
translation: 他们这些愚蠢的家伙都死了，随便你吧。

original: My team is trapped on the roof of the Statesman Hotel in Vernon Square and completely surrounded by Super Mutants.
translation: 我的队伍被一群超级变种人团团围困在弗农广场的政要酒店楼顶上了。

original: Their ammo is almost gone, and I have no idea how much longer they have to live.
translation: 他们的弹药快用完了，我不知道他们还能撑多久。
事实上，我明白你的意思了。

original: I don't think you're in any condition to be up and about.
translation: 我认为你的情况不适宜上去。

original: That's not the way I do things.
Do you have any idea what it would do to my reputation if word got around that Reilly of Reilly's Rangers was laid up in a hospital bed?
translation: 你觉得如果“莱莉的游骑兵的莱莉躺到了病床上”这样的话传出去，对我的声誉会有什么影响？

original: Your boss. So you'd better let me past before you get in trouble.
translation: 你决定。不过你不想惹麻烦的话，最好让我过去。

original: Colonel Autumn is the only one authorized to see the President.
translation: 奥托姆上校是唯一一个被授权能见总统的人。

original: Don't move. I'm going to find out what's going on here.
translation: 别动。我去看看发生了什么事。

original: The shit's about to hit the fan up here, and you're asking questions?
translation: 那些该死的都打到这了，你还在问东问西？

original: Look, Reilly once told me all we got in this shitty world is each other. I buy into that theory quite a bit.
translation: 听着，莱莉告诉过我，我们在这个烂世界里，唯一拥有的就是彼此。我相当赞同这种观点。

original: We watch each other's backs and that's what keeps us alive.
translation: 我们相互掩护并互相照顾，这也是我们能活着的原因。

original: If she's dead and you just followed our transmission, I want to know about it!
translation: 如果她死了，而你只是来捎个口信，我一定要知道怎么回事！

original: Well, looks like you got yourselves into a mess. Nice work.
translation: 好吧，看来你把自己弄得一团糟。干得好。

original: I don't give a shit what you think about us. I just want to get the hell out of here.
translation: 我才他妈的不在乎你对我们有什么看法。我只想要离开这该死的地方。

original: Now, what happened to Reilly? Is she okay?
translation: 莱莉发生了什么事 ？她还好吗？

original: I don't give a shit what you think about us. I just want to get the hell out of here.
translation: 我才他妈的不在乎你对我们有什么看法。我只想要离开这该死的地方。

original: Now, what happened to Reilly? Is she okay?
translation: 莱莉发生什么事了？她还好吗？

original: A medic, huh? Can you patch me up?
translation: 医生，呃？你能否给我包扎下吗？

original: Sorry, no can do. I used the last of my supplies on us when we got to the roof.
translation: 抱歉，做不到。我们上到楼顶时，我就用掉了最后的补给。

original: I can still put a bullet through a Super Mutant skull though!
translation: 我仍然可以一枪射穿超级变种人的脑袋！

original: Now, what's up with Reilly? She okay?
translation: 莱莉发生了什么事 ？她还好吗？

original: Sorry, no can do. I used the last of my supplies on us when we got to the roof.
translation: 抱歉，做不到。我们上到楼顶时，我就用掉了最后的补给。

original: I can still put a bullet through a Super Mutant skull though!
translation: 我仍然可以一枪射穿超级变种人的脑袋！

original: Now, what's up with Reilly? She okay?
translation: 莱莉发生了什么事 ？她还好吗？

original: Look, here are the caps. Let's just pretend we never saw each other.
translation: 听着，拿着这些瓶盖。让我们假装从未见过对方吧。

original: Tell your crazy stories to someone who cares.
translation: 把你疯狂的故事说给那些乐意听的人吧。

original: We always need bullets. Takes damn near a hundred of 'em to kill a 'Guai.
translation: 子弹对于我们来说永远都是必需品。居然他妈的近百发子弹才能干掉一个妖怪。

original: Always good ta hear. Lesse what ya got.
translation: 听起来不错，看看你都有什么。

original: Oh, come on. He'll listen to reason. Go talk to him.
translation: 哦，拜托。他会听你劝告的。去和他谈谈吧。

original: Oh... uhm... well... you look like someone who's pretty smart... so if you say so. I'll give it a try.
translation: 哦…喔喔，好吧…看起来你像个聪明人…如果真如你所说的那样。我会去试试的。

original: Okay. <takes a deep breath> Here I go...
Try new BLAMMO! Soap! Blasts stains out! Blasts the whole world out! We've all been BLAMMO'd!
translation: 试试新的轮回！宛如香皂！洗刷污点！洁净全世界！我们都需要轮回！

original: Admit it. You're just a whore.
translation: 承认吧。你就是一个妓女。

original: Up yours! It's not like I've got a lot of other options.
translation: 去你的！好像我有得其它选择似的。

original: The only survival skill I've got is the one I'm using here.
translation: 我唯一的“生存技能”就是我在这干的事。

original: I'd rather be a whore than dead.
translation: 我宁愿做一个妓女也不想死。

original: So basically, you're just a whore?
Damn! I wish I had a setup like this.
translation: 该死！我真希望我也能遇上这种事。

original: You're a pig, you know that?
I'm only doing this because he can keep me safe. He's a lot tougher than he looks.
translation: 我这样做只是因为他能保护我的安全。他比他的外表更厉害。

original: I'm not sure how much longer that will be enough though.
translation: 我不确定这样子还能坚持多久。

original: I'm just along for the ride. He's good with a gun and knows where to get booze.
translation: 我只是跟着他凑热闹。他枪法很好，而且知道在哪能弄到酒。

original: Lucky bastard. He's got a sweet setup here.
translation: 走运的杂种。他在这找到了甜蜜的归宿。

original: So... What exactly is this place?
translation: 那么…这到底是什么地方？

original: It's my hidey hole. Nobody can fuck with me here.
translation: 这是我的藏身洞。在这里没人能动我一根毫毛。

original: I got my women and my booze. What the hell else is there?
translation: 我得到了我的女人和酒。他妈的还需要什么？

original: It's my hidey hole. Nobody can fuck with me here.
translation: 这是我的藏身洞。在这里没人能动我一根毫毛。

original: My women are gone, but I've got my booze. That's enough.
translation: 我的女人都走了，但我得到了我的酒。这就足够了。

original: It's... well, it's Dukov's place. He lives here.
translation: 这是…这是杜克夫的淫窝。他住在这。

original: Pretty much he just does a lot of drinking and partying.
translation: 通常他也就是喝喝酒、搞搞聚会。

original: It's... well, it's Dukov's place. He used to live here. Lots of drinking and... you know. Now he's dead.
translation: 这是…嗯，这是杜克夫的淫窝。他曾住在这。喝喝酒，还有……你知道的。现在他玩儿不转了。

original: You're obviously crazier than they are. Why would I listen to you?
translation: 你显然比他们更加疯狂。我为什么要听你的？

original: I can't say I blame you. It's my mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place I guess.
translation: 我不能怪你。我想一开始让你去做你不想做的事是我的错。

original: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
translation: 不过，或许这一切就是最好的安排。我是说，我和伯奇聊过了，他们似乎真的很需要我。

original: What do you say Herbert, should I give them another chance?
translation: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我该再给他们一次机会吗？

original: Fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
translation: 好，好吧……我是说鲍勃。我每次叫他赫伯特都觉得很好玩。
我不是那种会杀人的人。

original: No, I suppose you aren't. My mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place I guess.
translation: 是啊，我想你也不是。是我的错，不该让你做一开始就不想做的事。

original: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
translation: 不过，或许这一切就是最好的安排。我是说，我和伯奇聊过了，他们似乎真的很需要我。

original: What do you say Herbert, should I give em' another chance?
translation: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我该再给他们一次机会吗？

original: Fine, fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
translation: 好，好，好吧……我是说鲍勃。我每次叫他赫伯特都觉得很好玩。

original: You've become an important part of their life. Without you, they're lost.
translation: 你已经成为他们生活中重要的一部分。没有你，他们会不知所措。

original: So, they really need me that badly, huh? I guess I never thought of it that way. That's awfully selfish of me.
translation: 这么说，他们真的那么需要我，哈？我想我从来没这么想过。我太自私了。

original: Should we give em' another chance, Herbert?
translation: 我们再给他们一次机会怎么样，赫伯特？

original: Fine, fine, fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert... I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
translation: 好，好，好，好的……我是说鲍勃。我每次叫他赫伯特都觉得很好玩……我道歉，我道歉。

original: Now we're talking! What do you need?
translation: 这才对嘛！你要什么发型呢？

original: Are you serious? Well alright! Let me get my knives!
translation: 真的？好极了！让我去拿刀具！

original: Alright! A full head of hair to work with! What should I do?
translation: 真好！有满满一头的头发要处理！我该做什么呢？

original: I couldn't care less about your problems. I'm out of here.
translation: 我不关心你的问题。我要走了。

original: Welcome back to the Wasteland, asshole.
Your words sting, Outsider. Normally I'd have you cast from this place for such a statement, but my eyes have been opened.
translation: 你的话很伤人，外来者。通常情况下，你说出这样的话，我会把你从这个地方赶走，但我已经醒悟了。

original: Before you reached His heart, He imparted his last words to me. He told me about his will to die and how I mistook this for some mystical sign.
translation: 在你触及祂的心脏之前，祂向我传达了祂的遗言。祂对我说了求死的意愿，而我却错以为这是某种神秘征兆。

original: How could I have been so blind? How could I have mislead all these people?
translation: 我怎么会如此盲目？我怎么能误导了这么多人？

original: Perhaps if I would have spent more time getting to know Him, things would have turned out different.
translation: 或许，如果我能花更多的时间去了解祂，事情就会是不同的结果了。

original: How is it you're causing all of these things to grow around you?
translation: 你是怎么让周围长出这么多东西的？

original: In what we call the Harvest Month, the Great One creates seeds among His branches within seed pods.
translation: 在我们所说的收获之月，圣贤在枝头的种荚里播撒种子。

original: At the end of this time, the pods open and the seeds are carried quite easily upon the wind. It's quite beautiful.
translation: 到这个时期末尾，种荚裂开，种子很容易就随风飘散。那场景好美啊。

original: Wherever the seeds take purchase, they grow into trees, plants, grass or all manner of wonderful things.
translation: 无论种子落到哪里，都会长成树、灌木、草，或是各种各样奇妙的东西。

original: What's causing this place to grow?
translation: 是什么促使这个地方枝繁叶茂？

original: It's kinda... embarrassing really. Once a year, Bob decides he's going to go ahead and start growing these weird pods filled with tiny seeds.
translation: 这真有些……尴尬。每年有那么一次，鲍勃会自顾自地长出这些古怪的荚果，里面满是小小的种子。

original: Well, all it takes is a good wind and the seeds just fly everywhere.
translation: 只需要一阵清风，种子就飘得到处都是。

original: I call them Herbert's Seeds. He hates that!
translation: 我称呼它们为“赫伯特的种”。他恨死这叫法了！

original: Oh, you said violin? I thought you needed something else. Never mind.
translation: 哦，你说小提琴？我还以为你需要别的什么东西。没关系。

original: Well then, you interested in helping me or am I just wasting your time?
translation: 你有兴趣吗？还是我在浪费自己的时间？

original: Maybe. You gonna give me something for it?
translation: 或许。你有什么东西给我用来交换它？

original: Oh very well. I suppose I should have expected that from a Wastelander.
translation: 哦，非常好。我应该知道废土游民会这样的。

original: Here's the key to my husband's ammo crate; take whatever you like.
translation: 这是我丈夫的弹药箱的钥匙，想拿什么随便。

original: It's like holding a chunk of history in the palm of my hands. Amazing, simply amazing.
translation: 就像是把一段历史握在了手中一样，这太妙了，实在太美妙了！

original: I can't thank you enough. I wish I had something to give you, a more suitable reward for all your efforts.
translation: 我无法表达我的谢意。我想我可以给你些什么，相对你的辛劳更适合的报酬。

original: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
translation: 我所能给你的就是一个电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老妇人的小提琴演奏。

original: Yes, take this Stradivarius Violin I found in Vault 92.
translation: 是的，拿着这把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴吧，我从92号避难所里找到的。

original: Oh my goodness! I must see it... please!
translation: 天啊！我一定要看一看……拜托！

original: It's like holding a chunk of history in the palm of my hands. Amazing, simply amazing.
translation: 就像是把一段历史握在了手中一样，这太妙了，实在太美妙了！

original: I can't thank you enough. I wish I had something to give you, a more suitable reward for all your efforts.
translation: 我无法表达我的谢意。我想我可以给你些什么，相对你的辛劳更适合的报酬。

original: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
translation: 我所能给你的就是一个电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老妇人的小提琴演奏。

original: Tell me about this project you worked on with my father.
translation: 说说这个你和我父亲为之奋斗的工程。

original: Project Purity, we called it. What do you want to know?
translation: 我们叫它净水工程，你想要知道些什么？

original: Whole place is running a little too hot, but it'll calm down in time, like everything else around here.
translation: 整个地方气氛都很紧张，但会终究会缓和下来，正如这周围的一切。

original: Maybe you can change the Overseer's mind, dear.
translation: 或许你可以改变监督者的主意, 亲爱的。

original: You don't need to tell me. Just keep an eye on your father, all right?
translation: 你不必告诉我。只要留意你的父亲，好吗？

original: Hard to lead your Tunnel Snakes when they're afraid of getting stepped on, huh? Well, keep at it.
translation: 害怕被踩一脚之后，你的穴蛇帮就不好控制了，对吧？继续。

original: Look on the bright side, Amata: you get to look at my handsome mug again. Who wouldn't want that?
translation: 往好的方面想，阿玛塔：至少你又看到了我英俊的脸。谁不想这样呢？

original: Aw, let 'em stay down here. One day, I'm heading out there on my own. I mean it.
translation: 喔，让他们呆在这吧。总有一天，我会自己去。我当真的。

original: I swear, what sort of "rebels" are they? Keep talking to them, okay?
translation: 我发誓，他们怎么会是“反叛者”？继续和他们交谈，好吗？

original: Keep an ear out up there. They'll get sick of father's lockdown eventually, and then we'll all take a stand.
translation: 提高警惕。他们最终会受不了父亲的封闭手段，到那时我们都会有机会。

original: Well, I guess it could be worse. But if I know father, he's not just going to change his mind on this.
translation: 我想可能更糟糕。但是如果我对父亲所料不差，他是不会在这问题上改变主意的。

original: That's better than nothing, I suppose. That may be all the good news we're getting, for now.
translation: 我想，这总比什么都没有好吧。这可能是目前我们能得到的最好的消息了。

original: Paul would've joined up no problem, but... y'know. Anyway, no luck with them.
translation: 保罗毫无疑问会参加的，但…你知道的。不管怎么说，他们的运气可不好。

original: No development. They're still quiet and scared. We won't be getting any of them to make a stand anytime soon.
translation: 没有进展。他们仍然害怕并保持沉默。近期内我们无法让他们任何一人进行反抗。

original: We're not your ridiculous gang, Butch. We're actually trying to get something done. Any luck convincing more to join us?
translation: 我们不是你那可笑的帮会，布奇。实际上我们正在试图做点什么。能说服更多的人加入我们吗？

original: We're safe. How's everyone holding up in the dorms?
translation: 我们很安全。这宿舍里的人还好吗？

original: Don't worry, we're fine. What's the word in the dorms?
translation: 别担心，我们很好。宿舍里在谈论什么？

original: You know me. The Butch man fears no Overseer.
translation: 你知道的，布奇手下的人不害怕监督者。

original: I wasn't taken away in the night, for what that's worth. That's about the best news I've got to report.
translation: 我没有在晚上被带走，无论如何，这很值得。这大概是我所能报告的最好消息。

original: I'm still alive, but I don't know how long that luck'll last. Seems like something big's about to transpire.
translation: 我还活着，但我不知道这运气还能持续多久。似乎有些大事即将发生。

original: You've got to take this seriously, boy. Any luck getting anyone else to join us?
translation: 你必须认真点，孩子。能说服其他人加入我们吗？

original: Not really. I mean, sure he's cool, but I don't really like him like that. You know? I'm just glad you're here, too.
translation: 未必。我的意思是：没错，他很棒，但我不喜欢他那样的人。你知道吗？我只是高兴你也在这。

original: I remember you said, yeah. That's so gross. Don't you wish it could be just Butch, instead?
translation: 是的，我记得你说过。这真令人恶心。你不希望让布奇来代替吗？

original: Ew, that's just creepy. Wouldn't it be so much better if it was just Butch, instead? He's dreamy.
translation: 哟，真让人起鸡皮疙瘩。如果换成布奇，那不会好很多吗？他很棒。

original: Terrible! I can't believe I have to share a dorm with old lady Palmer. How creepy is that?
translation: 糟透了！我不敢相信我必须和帕尔默大妈共用一间宿舍。太令人毛骨悚然了！

original: Don't blame yourself, sir. We'll scrub every last trace of his influence from these halls, and then everything can go back to normal.
translation: 不要责怪你自己，先生。我们会清理掉他在大厅里留下的每处痕迹，然后一切都会回复原样。

original: Indeed. As much as it seemed a good idea at the time, we should never have taken that doctor into our world.
translation: 确实。那时候看起来它算是个好主意，但我们真不应该让那医生进入我们的世界。

original: It's our home, sir. It's seen better days, of course, but we won't be making the same mistakes again, of course.
translation: 这是我们的家，先生。它曾经很不错，当然，不过我们肯定不会再犯同样的错误。

original: Yeah, we rule. It's just not the same without Paul saying it.
translation: 是的，我们统治。只是如果不是保罗说的，就会不太一样。

original: Come on, have a little pride! What do Tunnel Snakes do? We don't sit around and hide in the dorm. We rule!
translation: 拜托，有点自尊啊！穴蛇帮会怎么做？我们不能坐以待毙的躲在宿舍里。我们要控制局势！

original: Better than sitting around at home, you know?
translation: 总比在家里无所事事的好，懂吗？

original: Why did they build the walls?
translation: 他们为什么要建造围墙？

original: Well, the Raiders, for one. Once the town got big enough, they'd wait until the traders and their guards were away, then come in and clean us out!
translation: 歹徒是一个原因。一旦这镇子变得够大，他们就会等商人和他们的护卫离开后，闯进来把我们洗劫一空！

original: Now the Super Mutants... They were a whole other breed of problem. They'd kill us if they had to, but mostly they tried to drag people away! Alive!
translation: 而现在又有了超级变种人……他们是另一大难题。如果有必要的话，他们会杀了我们，但大多数情况下他们却试图活捉我们！

original: So, eventually, my father did something about it. Him and a few others organized the traders and the citizens and built the walls.
translation: 所以，最终，我父亲实施了些对策。他和其他几个人，组织商人和居民们一起修建了这围墙。

original: So we're pretty safe now. Still, I wish those Brotherhood of Steel fellers hadn't hit on such hard times. They really helped keep the wolves at bay.
translation: 因此，我们现在很安全了。不过，我希望那些钢铁兄弟会的家伙不要在这艰难时期被打垮。他们的确帮我们挡住了群狼。

original: Where did everyone else come from?
Oh, they come from all over... all over. You name it. The Stahl family grew up out east somewhere. Lucy's from some little settlement to the north.
translation: 哦，他们来自各处…各地。你说得出来的地方。斯塔尔家族曾在东边某地发展过。露西则是从北边某个小型定居点来的。

original: Billy doesn't really talk about where he's from. Doc Church used to live in Rivet City. Jericho... well... let's just say that men can change.
translation: 比利不愿说他是从哪来的。丘奇医生曾住在铆钉城。耶利哥…嗯…我们只能说人都会改变的。
告诉我关于卢卡斯·西姆斯的事。

original: That man tries to bring law to this place. Lost cause if you ask me, but I respect his trying. He does seem to keep people in line though.
translation: 那人试图把法律引入这里。我只能说那注定是要失败的。但我尊重他所做的努力，他似乎的确让人们更守规矩了。

original: Other than that weird cowboy thing of his, I don't have much to complain about.
translation: 除了他自己那古怪牛仔的外表，我没什么可抱怨的。
告诉我关于科林·莫里亚蒂的事。

original: That man is the scum of the Earth. He keeps the drunks around here soaking in liquor and that poor Nova, that girl deserves better.
translation: 他是个彻头彻尾的人渣。他让那些整天泡在酒坛子里的醉鬼在这附近乱转。可怜的诺瓦，她本来能过得更好。

original: And don't even get me started on how he treats Gob. Just because the boy looks dead doesn't mean that he should be treated like that.
translation: 还有他怎么对待盖博的事，更让我难以启齿。不能因为那男孩看起来像死人一样，就那样对待他啊。

original: That man has his fingers in everything around here. Just watch what you say about him, it'll always get back.
translation: 那家伙插手这的一切。谈论他的时候要小心，它们总能传到他的耳朵里。

original: I was born here, actually. Just like my papi. Oh, for a while I helped him scavenge and then later on his caravan.
translation: 实际上，我就出生在这。就像我爸爸一样。哦，我帮他捡过一阵破烂，后来还加入了他的商队。

original: But traipsing around the Wasteland is work for young people. After I met Nathan, I just wanted to stop moving around so much.
translation: 不过在废土中四处旅行可是年轻人的工作。在我遇到内森之后，我就再也不想四处逛了。

original: We've been here ever since. Of course, I can't say that it's been good for Nathan's sanity...
translation: 从那时起我们就在这了。当然，我不能说这对内森的心智健全有益。

original: That's very helpful. Here you go.
I suggest taking the door around the corner if you want to get where I think you're going. You'll find it unlocked in a moment.
translation: 如果我没猜错，我建议你走转弯处的那扇门。你待会就会发现它没上锁。

original: If I were you, I'd speak to Vance before you poke around too much. You can usually find him on the mezzanine overlooking the common area.
translation: 要是我的话，在四处游荡前会先和万斯谈谈。你能在上面俯瞰这个区域的平台上找到他。

original: I'm wondering what I could do with all these spare caps I have...
translation: 我不知道拿这些多余的瓶盖做什么……
听起来像是个有趣的问题。

original: Let me take 100 of those off your hands... you know, lighten the load.
translation: 让我从你手中拿走100个吧……帮你减轻负荷。
这是科尔·波特演唱的“万事成空”。

original: Here's Tex Beneke with... "A Wonderful Guy."
translation: 这是泰克斯·本尼克和一个……“棒小伙”。

original: It's the "First Lady of Song" herself, Miss Ella Fitzgerald, telling us that, "Into Each Life Some Rain Must Fall." Ain't that the truth, sister.
translation: 现在是“爵士第一夫人”本人，艾拉·费兹洁拉德，告诉我们“生活总会有风雨”。难道不是这样吗，我的姐妹！

original: Here's Danny Kaye and Andrew Sisters, crooning about - what else? - "Civilization."
translation: 现在由丹妮·凯依和安德鲁·凯依姐妹，低唱一曲 — 还有别的吗？ — “文明”。

original: How about some "Easy Living," from everyone' favorite songstress, Billie Holiday?
translation: 来点“轻松生活”怎么样？是人人都爱的女歌手比莉·霍利戴。

original: It's Billie Holiday with... "Crazy He Calls Me."
translation: 这是比莉·霍利戴…“他说我疯了”。

original: Up next is Roy Brown, tellin' us all about that, "Mighty Mighty Man."
translation: 下一首是罗伊·布朗，给我们说说“大男人”。

original: It's Roy Brown, singin' about the one, the only, "Butcher Pete"!
translation: 罗伊·布朗演唱的独一无二的“屠夫皮特”！

original: This is Bob Crosby, takin' us, "Way Back Home."
translation: 这是鲍勃·克罗斯比，正引领我们踏上“漫漫回家路”。

original: Here's Bob Crosby, singin' to us all about, "Happy Times."
translation: 这是鲍勃·克罗斯比，将告诉我们什么是“欢乐时光”！
掌声欢迎墨迹组合，以及“或许”。

original: This is the Ink Spots, with their timeless classic, "I Don't Want to Set the World on Fire."
translation: 这里是墨点乐队，以及他们的永恒经典《我不愿让世界燃烧》。

original: Kid, if you're listening? Fool me once, shame on me. Fool me twice - fuck you, you worthless piece of shit.
translation: 小子，不知你有没有在听？你骗我一次，是我的耻辱。骗我两次 — 他妈的，你是一堆狗屎。

original: The kid from Vault 101 had ole Three Dog fooled. I had her pegged as one of the good guys and then, BAM -- she goes and acts all... evil.
translation: 来自101号避难所的孩子蒙蔽了老三狗。我认定她是个好人，但那是欺骗 — 她的所作所为都是……邪恶的。

original: The kid from Vault 101 had ole Three Dog fooled. I had him pegged as one of the good guys and then, BAM -- he goes and acts all... evil.
translation: 来自101号避难所的孩子蒙蔽了老三狗。我认定他是个好人，但那是欺骗 — 他的所作所为都是……邪恶的。

original: Is there not one human being with a shred of decency left in this entire back-asswards Wasteland?
translation: 难道在整个狗屎般的废土上，就没有一个人类有丝毫正义感？

original: Why? Why why why why why? Aggh! Faithful listeners, I'm disappointed. And you should be too.
translation: 为什么？为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么？哦！忠实的听众啊，我很失望。而你们也应该一样。

original: Again with the evil kid doing good things. I ask you, folks - has a soul been saved? Keep fighting the Good Fight, kid. We're rootin' for ya.
translation: 邪恶的孩子又一次做了好事。我问你们，伙计们 — 有灵魂得到拯救了吗？继续圣战吧，孩子。我们做你的后援。

original: Kid, if you're listening - you did a good thing. Please, for all our sakes, keep it up. There are enough evil assholes out there already.
translation: 孩子，如果你正在听 — 你做了一件好事。求求你，为了我们大家，继续下去。外面的邪恶杂种已经够多的了。

original: But now, for some miraculous reason, She's had a change of heart! She's actually done something that can be considered - dare I say it? - "good"!
translation: 但现在，由于一些神奇的原因，她变了！她竟然做了件 — 我该这么说吗？ — “好事”！

original: But now, for some miraculous reason, he's had a change of heart! He's actually done something that can be considered - dare I say it? - "good"!
translation: 但现在，由于一些神奇的原因，他变了！他竟然做了件 — 我该这么说吗？ — “好事”！

original: My, my. What a curious turn of events. So here we have the kid from Vault 101, who by all accounts has a soul as black as charred Brahmin meat.
translation: 不是我不明白，这世界变化快。这个来自101号避难所的孩子，无论如何，有着一个和熏双头牛肉一样黑的灵魂。

original: Whoever lives in there sure as hell doesn't want what you're selling, and no, you can't knock down the door. It weighs like 13 tons.
translation: 里头的人绝对不稀罕你那点小算盘，再说了，那扇13吨重的门可不是说砸就能砸开的。

original: Arefu donates bloodpacks, and in exchange, you protect them.
translation: 断桥镇捐助血浆袋，做为交换，你们要保护他们。

original: Agreed. Please, take this proposal to Arefu. Speak with them and then return to me with their decision.
translation: 同意。请将此提议带给断桥镇。与他们谈谈，然后告诉我他们的决定。

original: I thank you for showing me that your kind can be trusted after all. It is a lesson I will not forget.
translation: 感谢你向我证明你们的种族也是可以信任的。我忘不了这次的经历。

original: Now, what of young Ian? Tell me his decision.
translation: 小伊恩怎样了？告诉我他的决定。

original: Arefu donates bloodpacks, and you leave the town alone.
translation: 断桥镇会捐助血浆袋，你们别再骚扰这镇子了。

original: Agreed. Please, take this proposal to Arefu. Speak with them and then return to me with their decision.
translation: 同意。请将此提议带给断桥镇。与他们谈谈，然后告诉我他们的决定。

original: I thank you for showing me that your kind can be trusted after all. It is a lesson I will not forget.
translation: 感谢你向我证明你们的种族也是可以信任的。我忘不了这次的经历。

original: Now, what of young Ian? Tell me his decision.
translation: 小伊恩怎样了？告诉我他的决定。

original: Ha! You're as cowardly as a Brahmin! Watch this...
translation: 哈！你就像双头牛一样胆小！看着……
小心！如果它上膛了怎么办？

original: All right, children. It's time for Three Dog to be honest with ya. Here it is, plain as day - I used to think we were all well and truly fucked.
translation: 好吧，孩子们。现在是三狗对你说实话的时间了。它就是，青天白日的 — 我过去认为我们肯定是彻彻底底的完蛋了。

original: Kid from the vault, if you're listening, I want you to know that you are, truly, a Paradigm of Humanity. Keep on fighting, girl!
translation: 从避难所来的孩子，如果你在听，我想让你知道你简直就是“人性楷模”。继续战斗吧，小女孩！

original: Kid from the vault, if you're listening, I want you to know that you are, truly, a Paradigm of Humanity. Keep on fighting, man!
translation: 从避难所来的孩子，如果你在听，我想让你知道你简直就是“人性楷模”。继续战斗吧，小伙子！

original: I'm talkin' about the kid from Vault 101. Just 19, and this babe has been in some serious shit. And there ain't no sign o' stoppin'!
translation: 我正在说的是关于101号避难所来的孩子。只有19岁，这宝贝已经陷入了可怕的麻烦中。但她并没有放弃和停止前进。

original: I'm talkin' about the kid from Vault 101. Just 19, and this cat has been in some serious shit. And there ain't no sign o' stoppin'!
translation: 我正在说的是关于101号避难所来的孩子。只有19岁，这小猫已经陷入了可怕的麻烦中。但他并没有放弃和停止前进。

original: Alive? Yes. Still wandering? Uh huh. One of the most powerful individuals in the Capital Wasteland? You bet your bobby socks, Susie.
translation: 还活着？是。仍然在流浪？哈哈。首都废土中最强大的人中的一个？用你的短袜打赌，苏茜。

original: Alive? Yes. Still wandering? Uh huh. One of the most powerful individuals in the Capital Wasteland? You bet your bobby socks, Susie.
translation: 还活着？是。仍然在流浪？哈哈。首都废土中最强大的人中的一个？用你的短袜打赌，苏茜。

original: And lo, the girl did step forth from her shadowy hole, and proclaim herself Scourge of Humanity.
translation: 之后，那女孩果真走出了她那阴暗的洞穴，并宣布她自己是“人类公敌”。

original: And lo, the boy did step forth from his shadowy hole, and proclaim himself Scourge of Humanity.
translation: 之后，那男孩果真走出了他那阴暗的洞穴，并宣布他自己是“人类公敌”。

original: Don't lose hope, children. Don't ever lose hope! The kid from Vault 101, the Wasteland's one true Messiah, still walks among us! Just listen to this.
translation: 请不要放弃,孩子们。永远不要绝望!101小子,一个真正废土英雄,仍然在我们中间!听听这个。

original: Ah, that kid from Vault 101. Only a true Mortal could get involved in so many adventures, make so many damn caps! Behold, the latest tribulation.
translation: 啊，那来自101号避难所的孩子。只有“凡夫俗子”才能参与如此多的冒险，拥有如此多的该死的瓶盖！看呐，最新磨难。

original: The Devil walks among us, children. Oh, she may look like us, but she calls Hell home. She is legion, and her deeds are legend. Like this one.
translation: 魔鬼,走在我们的身边,孩子们。啊,她看起来像我们,但她的家在地狱。她是基督。她是唯一的传说。

original: The Devil walks among us, children. Oh, he may look like us, but he calls Hell home. He is legion, and his deeds are legend. Like this one.
translation: 魔鬼,走在我们的身边,孩子们。啊,他看起来像我们,但她的家在地狱。他是基督。他是唯一的传说。

original: We may never get to Heaven, children, but at least we've got our own Earthly Angel walking among us. And I've got her latest exploits.
translation: 我们可能永远都不会去天堂,孩子,但至少我们有我们自己的天使在我们身边。而且我有她最新的事迹。

original: We may never get to Heaven, children, but at least we've got our own Earthly Angel walking among us. And I've got his latest exploits.
translation: 我们可能永远都不会去天堂,孩子,但至少我们有我们自己的天使在我们身边。而且我有他最新的事迹。

original: Neither light, nor dark, not good nor bad, there's one who truly walks down the middle of life's road. Here's an update on that Gray Stranger.
translation: 没有光明,也没有黑暗,不好也不坏,这是一个真正中庸的人生。这是一个现代灰色陌生人。

original: It's gotten to the point where that piece of shit from Vault 101 can't even be considered human. Am I right? Here's the latest on that Demon's Spawn.
translation: 直说吧，这就是一堆狗屎，101小子甚至不能被认为是人类。我说的对吗?这是最新恶魔报道。

original: Only one person can bring a hint of sunshine to this dim and dreary Wasteland. Children, I bring you an update on… the Lightbringer.
translation: 只有一个人能给这个昏暗沉闷的废土带来一丝阳光。孩子们, 我为你带来最新的光明。

original: By now everyone knows that the kid from Vault 101 is a no-good, selfish Moneygrubber, but who knew she was keeping so busy? Listen to this.
translation: 现在大家知道,来自101的小子是没有用的、自私的财迷,但谁知道她的另一面吗?听听这个。

original: By now everyone knows that the kid from Vault 101 is a no-good, selfish Moneygrubber, but who knew he was keeping so busy? Listen to this.
translation: 现在大家知道,来自101的小子是没有用的、自私的财迷,但谁知道他的另一面吗?听听这个。

original: Think you'll rest when you're dead, children? Not if that refugee from Vault 101 has anything to say about it. Here's the latest on the Soultaker.
translation: 你认为你死了就会安息,孩子们?来自101避难所的避难者不这么认为。这是最新的灵魂狩猎者。

original: Call her the Herald of Tranquility, that kid from Vault 101, usually righting any wrongs that cross her path. Here's a new update.
