translation: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

original: Hmm. Can't burn pennies. I'll have to toss them into the Potomac.
translation: 嗯，这些便士不能烧。我必须把它们扔进波托马克。

original: It's not so much more. You have a deal.
Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
translation: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

original: Make it 30 and you have a deal.
Not enough. Make me a better offer.
translation: 还不够。给我出个更好的价吧。

original: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
translation: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

original: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
translation: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

translation: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

original: Hmph. You're going to bleed me dry at this rate. You've got a deal. I'm going to burn it one page at a time.
translation: 哼。你会榨干我的血。成交了。我会烧了它，一页一页的烧。

original: I suppose I can afford that.
Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
translation: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

original: For Lincoln's own hat? Come on. You can do better than that.
translation: 为了林肯的帽子？拜托，你出得起更好的价。

original: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
translation: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

original: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
translation: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

original: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
translation: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

original: Alright, you god damn merc. You know I can't afford to let this fall into the wrong hands. I'll toss this one in the fire myself.
translation: 好吧，该死的佣兵。你知道我不能让这落到错误的人手里。我会亲手把它扔进火堆。

original: You take when we have so little. So be it. We will enshrine this right away.
translation: 趁我们还有，你拿走一些。就这样，我们会立刻把这侍奉起来。

original: Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
translation: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

original: This poster is worth more than that.
Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
translation: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

original: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
translation: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

original: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
translation: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

original: Sure, why not. We'll burn it tonight.
translation: 当然，为什么不。今晚我们会烧了它。

original: Deal. We'll find a good place to hang this.
translation: 成交。我们会找个好地方把它挂起来。

original: Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
translation: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

original: What are you doing way out here?
Did Doctor Lesko have any weird stuff in his place?
translation: 莱斯科博士的地盘上有些什么奇怪的东西？

original: I dunno, all kinds of doohickeys. Boxes with lots of lights, some funny glass bottles...
translation: 我不知道，各种各样的小玩意。亮着许多灯的盒子，一些有趣的玻璃杯...

original: Oh wait! He had a big, clunky, shiny man too. That was kind of neat.
translation: 哦，等等！他还有个又高又壮，还很阳光的手下。感觉挺不错的。

original: He spent all of his of time in that shack next door to my house.
translation: 他就住我家隔壁，天天待在他那小屋里。

original: Every time I'd sneak in there, he'd be sitting at that funny looking TV machine with the green words, pushing buttons.
translation: 每次我偷偷溜到那，都看到他坐在那台满屏幕绿色文字的搞笑电视机前敲按钮。

original: Oh, gee! That's not so bad. Engineering, all right!
translation: 哦，伙计！还不算太糟糕。工程学，好啊！

original: Mother can't wait to find out if I'll be going into Science or Home Economics.
translation: 如果我从事科学或家政学，妈妈会想第一时间知道的。

original: What?! That's impossible! I'm telling Father! He won't let you get away with this!
translation: 什么？这不可能！我要告诉爸爸！他不会就这样放过你的！

original: Nah, I already know what it says. Hardly takes a rocket scientist to crack that joke of a test.
translation: 不，我都知道答案了。只有火箭科学家才会做这种胡扯的测试…

original: Okay, Mr. Brotch, I just need to read over my answers one more time.
translation: 好的，布洛彻先生，我只是想再看一遍我的答案。

original: Anything you want to say before you meet your maker?
translation: 在你见上帝之前，有什么想说的？

original: Relax. It's just a warning, not a threat. I'm not going to kill you.
translation: 放松点。这只是个警告，不是威胁。我不会杀了你的。

original: I see... that's smart of you. I'd lay you flat if you tried anything stupid. So don't.
translation: 嗯…算你聪明。你要是做什么傻事我就会把你干掉。所以别轻举妄动。

original: Tenpenny and his pack of elitist wannabes are in for a real treat soon enough. They can't keep us out of that tower forever.
translation: 特佩尼和他的那帮顽固的党羽马上就要受到真正的款待了。他们不能永远将我们排挤于大厦之外。

original: I see... that's smart of you. I'd lay you flat if you tried anything stupid. So don't.
translation: 嗯…算你聪明。你要是做什么傻事我就会把你干掉。所以别轻举妄动。

original: Tenpenny and his pack of elitist wannabes are in for a real treat soon enough. They can't keep us out of that tower forever.
translation: 特佩尼和他的那帮顽固的党羽马上就要受到真正的款待了。他们不能永远将我们排挤于大厦之外。

original: Yeah, she's a bitch... Can we talk about the android now?
translation: 对，她是个婊子……我们现在能谈谈那仿真人了吗？

original: You're damn right she's a bitch. Ruined my whole goddamn life. But I can see you don't give a crap about any of that. Fine.
translation: 你他妈的太对了，她就是个婊子。毁了我他妈的一生。不过我看你对这些都不在乎。好吧。

original: It's all in my computer; here's the password. See for yourself. Hell, just take these pictures and this holotape. Straight from the synthman's lips.
translation: 都在我电脑里；这是密码。你自己看吧。见鬼，直接拿走这些照片和全息磁吧。直接出自合成人之口。

original: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
translation: 只是别告诉哈克尼斯。反正他也不会相信你。而且你真的不想看到他生气。他有时候有点……不近人情。

original: What's she got to do with this? Show me this "proof" about the android.
translation: 她和这个有什么关系？把关于那个仿真人的“证据”给我看看。

original: Well, she's got nothing to do with anything, except ruining my whole goddamn life. But I can see you don't give a crap about any of that. Fine.
translation: 嗯，她跟任何事都没关系，除了毁了我他妈的一生。不过我看你对这些都不在乎。好吧。

original: It's all in my computer; here's the password. See for yourself. Hell, just take these pictures and this holotape. Straight from the synthman's lips.
translation: 都在我电脑里；这是密码。你自己看吧。见鬼，直接拿走这些照片和全息磁吧。直接出自合成人之口。

original: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
translation: 只是别告诉哈克尼斯。反正他也不会相信你。而且你真的不想看到他生气。他有时候有点……不近人情。

original: I'm sorry you don't get along with Dr. Li. But we were discussing the android.
translation: 我很遗憾你和李博士相处得不好。但我们曾讨论了那人造人。

original: That witch ruined my life, but you're right. Who gives a crap about any of that. You want your precious proof.
translation: 那泼妇毁了我的生活。但你是对的，谁会在乎那些呢。你想要你那宝贵的证据。

original: It's all in my computer; here's the password. See for yourself. Hell, just take these pictures and this holotape. Straight from the synthman's lips.
translation: 都在我电脑里；这是密码。你自己看吧。见鬼，直接拿走这些照片和全息磁吧。直接出自合成人之口。

original: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
translation: 只是别告诉哈克尼斯。反正他也不会相信你。而且你真的不想看到他生气。他有时候有点……不近人情。

original: Here's a 100 cap "donation." Now, where's that escaped android?
translation: 这是100个瓶盖“捐赠”。现在告诉我，逃走的人造人在哪？

original: We got a man at Rivet City. Been looking for a long time. I doubt he's even still there. Either way, don't go sticking your nose in our business!
translation: 我们在铆钉城有个人。找了他很久，我怀疑他现在还在那。不管怎样，别来干涉我们的事情！

original: Trail led to Rivet City. Sister's our inside man. I think he's long given up looking for that android, and is just living it up on that boat.
translation: 踪迹通向铆钉城。“修女”是我们的线人。我想他早已放弃寻找那机器人了，他现在只是住在船上而已。

original: Why has Zimmer hired you too? I can't find a trace of that robot. I'm sure he's here somewhere though. Don't tell Eulogy I told you, though.
translation: 为什么齐默也雇用了你？我找不到那机器人的踪迹了。我敢确定他现在就在这附近。不过别跟尤勒基说我告诉了你。

original: We got a man at Rivet City. Been looking for a long time. I doubt he's even still there. Either way, don't go sticking your nose in our business!
translation: 我们在铆钉城有个人。找了他很久，我怀疑他现在还在那。不管怎样，别来干涉我们的事情！

original: I'll give you 100 caps for what you've got on this android.
translation: 我愿意拿100个瓶盖换你提供人造人的信息。

original: All I know is Zimmer, the guy contracting to find this slave, is hot to retrieve him. He's starting to get other people looking. So it's a race now.
translation: 我所知道的就是齐默，这家伙执意要找到这奴隶，他十分热衷于找回他。他正在派其他人进行寻找，所以这就已然成为一个竞赛了。

original: I hope you're not on the case. If I find out you are, well... You best not be! We'll leave it at that.
translation: 我希望你没插手。一旦我发现你这么做的话，嗯……你最好别这么做！先说到这儿。

original: Despite all his grumbling, I think Eulogy still wants us finding that guy. Zimmer is asking around hiring other people. Makes us look bad.
translation: 撇开他的这些怨言，我想尤勒基还是希望我们找到那家伙。齐默正四处雇其他人，这让我们很丢脸。

original: I'd hunt down surgeons and bang on their heads to get leads, but I'm tired of chasing after that android thing.
translation: 我想抓捕医生拷问出线索，但我跟踪那人造人已经跟烦了。

original: I guess I can trust you not to spread it around. Zimmer has put it out that he will pay to find this slave, but he wants him alive.
translation: 我想我可以信任你不会告诉别人。齐默扬言他会为找到这奴隶而付钱，但是他想要活口。

original: Hey! You aren't thinking of signing up with him are you?
translation: 嗨！你不会在考虑为他干活吧？

original: It wouldn't be healthy for you, if you know what I mean.
translation: 那可对你没好处，明白我的意思吧。

original: You know how they rewrote engrams in a cluster of Android memory subroutines?
translation: 你知道他们是怎样在人造人记忆子程序中重写记忆的吗？

original: That Commonwealth robot was real! I have proof. Listen to this!
translation: 联邦人造人是真的！我有证据。仔细听着！

original: Some say it was all a hoax. But it's real.
translation: 有人说这都是恶作剧，但它是真的。

original: Here. Check out this holotape I found. That Commonwealth robot was real!
translation: 给，听听我找到的全息磁带。那联邦人造人是真实的！
大多数人认为这是一个恶作剧。

original: Here's some evidence for you to consider for yourself. Take this holotape.
translation: 这有些证据你自己看看，给你这全息磁带。

original: I used to think it was all so much bullshit. But then I got this holotape.
translation: 我过去认为这都是些胡说八道的东西。但不久之后我得到了这全息磁带。

original: I'll give you 100 caps if you know who did the mind wipe on that android.
translation: 如果你告诉我，是谁给那人造人洗脑了，我就给你100个瓶盖。

original: I sure do! No one believes me though. It was old Pinkerton. You know, the "ghost" of Rivet City. He's a genius!
translation: 我当然知道！尽管没人相信我，是老平克顿。你知道，铆钉城的幽灵。他是个天才！

original: Heard a rumor a while back that it was some guy named Pinkerton at Rivet City. Apparently he's got some sweet tech stashed on that boat.
translation: 有传闻说是铆钉城一个叫平克顿的家伙。显然他在那艘船上找到了一些先进技术。

original: Yep. Old Pinkerton. They say he helped found Rivet City. Must be some sort of crazy genius.
translation: 对。老平克顿。人们说是他帮助创建了铆钉城，一定是个疯狂的天才。

original: He kind of vanished a long time ago. I don't know where he went, but you might ask around the ship.
translation: 他在很久以前就消失了。我不知道他去了哪，但你可以在船上四处问问。

original: Normally I don't traffic in unsubstantiated rumor, but... they say old Pinkerton is hiding out somewhere in Rivet City and that he did it.
translation: 通常我不会传播未经证实的传闻，但是……他们说老平克顿正藏在铆钉城的某个地方，而且是他做的。

original: It was old cranky Pinkerton who did it. Over at Rivet City. One day I mean to visit him and chat him up about it.
translation: 就是老古怪平克顿做的，就在铆钉城。总有一天我会去见他并谈谈这事。

original: Got any info on an android mind wipe? Here's a 100 cap "research fee."
translation: 知道有关人造人洗脑的信息吗？这有100个瓶盖的“调查费”。

original: That Commonwealth robot was real! I have proof. Listen to this!
translation: 联邦人造人是真的！我有证据。仔细听着！

original: Some say it was all a hoax. But it's real.
translation: 有人说这都是恶作剧，但它是真的。

original: Here. Check out this holotape I found. That Commonwealth robot was real!
translation: 给，听听我找到的全息磁带。那联邦人造人是真实的！

original: The Commonwealth has tried to make it out to be a hoax, but the escaped android is real I tell you!
translation: 联邦一直试图让外界认为这是个恶作剧，但我跟你说这逃跑的人造人是真的！

original: Listen to this holotape. It will make you a believer too.
translation: 听听这全息磁带，这会让你也相信的。
大多数人认为这是一个恶作剧。

original: Here's some evidence for you to consider for yourself. Take this holotape.
translation: 这有些证据你自己看看，给你这全息磁带。

original: I used to think it was all so much bullshit. But then I got this holotape.
translation: 我过去认为这都是些胡说八道的东西。但不久之后我得到了这全息磁带。

original: Here's 100 caps for the locale of a Lipoplasticator or Micro Dermal Graftilizer.
translation: 这是100个瓶盖，换取脂肪塑形机或微型皮肤移植机的位置信息。

original: I heard old Pinkerton at Rivet City had a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.
translation: 我听说在铆钉城的老平克顿有脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。如果说我不羡慕他，那一定是在撒谎。

original: Probably down at Rivet City. Anything that has any use out here, they snatch up for themselves. That damn Pinkerton don't share nothin'.
translation: 或许是在铆钉城。他们在这把任何对他们来说有用的东西都夺走了。那该死的平克顿什么都不愿意跟大家分享。

original: They say old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow got his hands on a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. Amazing really.
translation: 据说铆钉城的平克顿用某种方法搞到了去脂整形机和微型植皮器，真的太神奇了。

original: Try Pinkerton at Rivet City. Heard he has the goods. Hope he doesn't try to actually use them on anyone. Bet he would though. He's nuts.
translation: 到铆钉城找平克顿试试，听说他行。希望他没有在哪个人身上实际用过。但是我打赌他会的，他是疯子。

original: Guess old Pinkerton at Rivet City has some shiny Pre-War tech. He might have what you're looking for.
translation: 我猜铆钉城的老平克顿一定有些很强的战前技术。他或许会有你想要的东西。

original: I heard a rumor that old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow conjured up a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer.
translation: 有传闻说铆钉城的老平克顿有神奇的去脂整形机和微型植皮器。

original: Rumor had it Pinkerton at Rivet City found a Lipoplasticator and Graftilizer. Good luck to any fool that let Pinkerton test them on him though.
translation: 有传闻说平克顿在铆钉城找到了去脂整形机和植皮器。祝那些让平克顿在他们身上做实验的傻瓜们好运。

original: You ever do a face job on an android from the North? <Jingle purse of 100 caps.>
translation: 你曾经为北方来的人造人做过整容手术吗？<100个瓶盖在钱包发出叮当声>

original: Facial surgery's too dangerous. Plus you need some specialized Pre-War equipment. Hmm. That reminds me of an old hoax.
translation: 面部整形太危险了，而且你需要一些特殊的战前仪器。嗯，这让我想起了一个老恶作剧。

original: Here's a copy of that holotape.
translation: 这就是那全息磁带的拷贝。

original: Damn stupid idea. That reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 该死的馊主意。那让我想起了这老恶作剧。

original: Here, take a listen to this crusty holotape and see for yourself.
translation: 给，你自己去听听这盘老掉牙的全息磁带吧。

original: Medicine is an important art and science. Shouldn't be wasted on vanity.  Hey, but that reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 医学是一门重要的艺术和科学，不应被虚荣所糟蹋。嗨，但它让我想起了个老恶作剧。

original: Hmm... that reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 嗯……它让我想起了个老恶作剧。

original: Here, listen to this. It's clearly a joke. No one's got the tech to do that without risking infection.
translation: 给，听听这全息磁带。这显然是个玩笑。没人可以冒被感染的风险。

original: Oh if I got my hands on the right gear I might try it. It's dangerous though. Prone to infection. Reminds me an old hoax.
translation: 哦，如果我得到合适的装备我或许会去试试。这样做十分危险。可能会感染。这让我想起了一个很久以前的恶作剧。

original: Facial surgery's way too dangerous to try. Need special equipment and expertise. Hmm. Reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 脸部整形的方法太危险了，需要特殊的装置和技术。嗯。让我想起来一个老恶作剧。

original: Nah. You need specialized gear that doesn't exist anymore. And why risk infection? That reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 没。你需要专门的装备，而那东西已经不存在了。并且为什么要冒感染的风险呢？那让我想起了这老恶作剧。

original: I need to find a Micro Dermal Graftilizer for epidermal augmentation surgery.
translation: 我需要为表皮整殖手术找到一台微型皮肤移植机。

original: I heard old Pinkerton at Rivet City had a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.
translation: 我听说在铆钉城的老平克顿有脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。如果说我不羡慕他，那一定是在撒谎。

translation: 或许是在铆钉城。他们在这把任何对他们来说有用的东西都夺走了。那该死的平克顿什么都不愿意跟大家分享。

translation: 据说铆钉城的平克顿用某种方法搞到了去脂整形机和微型植皮器，真的太神奇了。

original: Try Pinkerton at Rivet City. Heard he has the goods. Hope he doesn't try to actually use them on anyone. Bet he would though. He's nuts.
translation: 到铆钉城找平克顿试试，听说他行。希望他没有在哪个人身上实际用过。但是我打赌他会的，他是疯子。

translation: 我猜铆钉城的老平克顿一定有些很强的战前技术。他或许会有你想要的东西。

translation: 有传闻说平克顿在铆钉城找到了去脂整形机和植皮器。祝那些让平克顿在他们身上做实验的傻瓜们好运。

original: A patient of mine needs a facial epidermal augmentation. You ever perform one?
translation: 我的一位病人需要做面部表皮增殖。你做过吗？

original: Facial surgery's too dangerous. Plus you need some specialized Pre-War equipment. Hmm. That reminds me of an old hoax.
translation: 面部整形太危险了，而且你需要一些特殊的战前仪器。嗯，这让我想起了一个老恶作剧。

translation: 这就是那全息磁带的拷贝。

translation: 该死的馊主意。那让我想起了这老恶作剧。

translation: 给，你自己去听听这盘老掉牙的全息磁带吧。

translation: 哦，如果我得到合适的装备我或许会去试试。这样做十分危险。可能会感染。这让我想起了一个很久以前的恶作剧。

translation: 脸部整形的方法太危险了，需要特殊的装置和技术。嗯。让我想起来一个老恶作剧。

original: Nah. You need specialized gear that doesn't exist anymore. And why risk infection? That reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 没。你需要专门的装备，而那东西已经不存在了。并且为什么要冒感染的风险呢？那让我想起了这老恶作剧。

original: You're as ignorant as all the other rats on this boat. When you realize I have the real cheese, you'll come crawling back. They always do.
translation: 你就像这船上所有其他的老鼠一样讨厌。当你知道我有奶酪时，你就会爬回来。这世道就是这样。

original: Sorry, I've got better things to do.
translation: 抱歉，我还有重要事要去办。

original: Excellent. Locate my android, and you won't be disappointed.
translation: 太棒了。找到了我的人造人，我就知道你不会让我失望的。

original: Here, listen to this message he sent me. He's mocking me. I swear I'll make him pay for that.
translation: 给，听听他发给我的这信息。他在嘲笑我，我发誓会让他付出代价的。

original: Sure. I'll look into finding your android for you.
translation: 当然，我会为你寻找你的人造人的。

original: Oh. I hadn't realized anyone in the Wasteland was so knowledgeable. And you certainly don't look much like a scientist...
translation: 哦，我没想到在废土还有谁有这般知识。但你看起来真的不像个科学家……

original: Anyway... My android must have done something drastic, like facial surgery and a mind wipe, or else I would have found him by now.
translation: 不管怎么说……我的人造人一定做了些超乎寻常的事，整容还有洗脑，否则我本应该已经找到他了。

original: It will be no easy task. He may not even realize he's not human. Don't upset him by talking with him. Just come get me immediately. I'll handle it.
translation: 这并不容易。他可能甚至还没有意识到他不是人。不要和他说话引起他的情绪变化。如果发现了尽快通知我，我会处理的。

original: I know what an android is. I dabble in AI programming myself.
translation: 我知道人造人是什么东西，我自己就懂人工智能设计。

original: I just need five minutes of your "precious" time. Think you can spare that?
translation: 我只占用你“宝贵”的五分钟而已。好吗？

original: Whatever you're doing, it can wait. This is IMPORTANT!
translation: 不管你在做什么，都先停下。这非常重要！

original: Come on, mungo! How hard can it be?
Excellent. I should be able to synthesize the proteins from this into something that'll fight rickets.
translation: 太棒了。我应该能从这些信息中合成可以抵抗佝偻病的蛋白。
作为回报，这是给你的真菌。

original: I've got Buffout to trade for fungus.
Oh great! The fungus pools'll gobble this right up!
translation: 哦，太好了！真菌池有反应了!

original: I've got some strange meat to trade for fungus.
translation: 我用一些奇特的肉制品交换蘑菇。

original: Excellent. I should be able to synthesize the proteins from this into something that'll fight rickets.
translation: 太棒了。我应该能从这些信息中合成可以抵抗佝偻病的蛋白。

translation: 哦，太好了！真菌池有反应了!

original: I've got some strange meat to trade for fungus.
translation: 我有一些奇特的肉来交换蘑菇。

original: Excellent. I should be able to synthesize the proteins from this into something that'll fight rickets.
translation: 太棒了。我应该能从这些信息中合成可以抵抗佝偻病的蛋白。
作为回报，这是给你的真菌。

original: I've got Buffout to trade for fungus.
translation: 我有壮大灵来交换蘑菇。

original: Oh great! The fungus pools'll gobble this right up!
translation: 哦，太好了！真菌池有反应了!

original: I've got strange meat to trade for fungus.
translation: 我有奇特的肉制品来交换蘑菇。

original: What do you know about Bryan Wilks?
translation: 关于布赖恩·威尔克斯，你知道什么？

original: You should take him away from this place; find him a home.
translation: 你应该带他离开这地方；给他找个家。

original: It would be difficult to accomplish my experiments with him scampering about and asking an interminable amount of questions.
translation: 我要在他上窜下跳问东问西时去完成实验简直难比登天。

original: What should I do about Bryan Wilks?
translation: 关于布赖恩·威尔克斯，我应该怎么办？

original: Far too curious. His incessant questioning would often come when I was the most absorbed with my calculations.
translation: 他的好奇心太强了。总是在我全神贯注计算的时候，他开始问他无穷无尽的问题。

original: He had no regard for the importance of my work!
translation: 他一点也不重视我工作的重要性！

original: Something isn't right. You shouldn't have gotten results like these so quickly.
translation: 有些事不对劲。你本不应该这么快就得到结果。

original: Well... ummm, I may have used a few... ahem, shortcuts. Yes.
translation: 好吧……嗯，我可能走了一些……恩，捷径。是的。

original: I was told that the FEV works wonders when used under controlled circumstances!
translation: 我被告知FEV在可以控制的情况下功效显著！

original: Apparently I was wrong, but I know my mistake. I'm certain I can get it to work!
translation: 很显然我错了，但是我知道我的错误。我确定我可以将它做好！

original: Oh my yes, they're quite marvelous!
translation: 天啊，他们太不可思议了！

original: There are many that say it can't be done, but I'll prove them wrong.
translation: 许多人说无法被完成，不过我证明他们错了。

original: Never mind. Just thought I'd ask.
Well, everything here looks like a piece of junk.
translation: 这的一切看起来都像是垃圾。

original: Everything here is authentic! Dave said so himself!
translation: 先生，这些都是真品。戴夫本人说的！

original: Get out of my museum before I call for the Army of Dave!
translation: 在我召集戴夫武装部队前滚出我的博物馆！
那博物馆接受我的捐赠吗？

original: I'm ready to sell you those Dave relics.
translation: 我准备卖你些戴夫的遗物。

original: Hey, I know it's scary to be alone. Just hang in there!
translation: 我知道独自一人的时候很害怕，别走！

original: Wow, you sound as nice as my pappa.
translation: 你就好像我的爸爸一样。

original: You know, maybe this will help and maybe it won't, but pappa hid a bunch of stuff behind the old diner in a dumpster.
translation: 不知道这消息对你有用没，爸爸在旧餐馆后的一个垃圾桶里面藏了些东西。

original: He trusted me with the key and said it was for emergencies, but I bet he wouldn't mind you having it.
translation: 他把钥匙信任地交给了我，已备不时之需，我想他不会介意我把钥匙给你的。

original: Thanks for making me feel better.
translation: 你的话让我感觉好多了。

original: Now look, to wear Power Armor, first thing you need to do is relax your muscles. Let the suit do the work. Okay? Now, you...
translation: 想要穿上动力装甲，首先要放松肌肉。让装甲工作。好了吗？现在你试试吧……

original: Can someone in the Citadel train me to wear Power Armor?
translation: 大本营里有谁能教我怎么穿动力装甲吗？

original: Paladin Gunny instructs all Initiates in the use of Power Armor, but only after they've undergone a rigorous training regimen.
translation: 圣骑士甘尼会教所有新加入的人怎么穿动力装甲的，但之前要接受严格地训练。

original: Considering all that’s happened, my father may grant you special permission. But you’ll need to ask him yourself.
translation: 考虑到所发生的一切，我父亲应该会给你特许的。但你得亲自问问他。

original: Hmph. Typical. Surrounded by the keenest scientific minds in the Capital Wasteland, but do you thirst for our knowledge, our experience? No.
translation: 哼，不出所料！周围全是首都废土最为热情的科学家，但你渴望获取知识吗？才不是。

original: All you Wastelanders want to do is put on that damn Power Armor and join the ranks of the skull-thumping tin soldiers.
translation: 废土游民们就想穿上那该死的动力装甲，变成戴着大骷髅头的铁壳兵。

original: So be it. Talk to Elder Lyons -- I’m sure he’ll grant permission for the training, which our gunnery sergeant can provide.
translation: 随便你。找里昂斯长老说去 — 我想他会同意你接受训练的，我们负责训练射击的中士你会教你的。

original: I’m sure Gunny could train you, but he won’t. Not without permission from Elder Lyons. You should ask him... he’s usually near the Lab.
translation: 我确信甘尼会训练你的，但除非有里昂斯长老的同意，否则他不会。你去问问长老吧，他通常都会在实验室附近。

original: Paladin Gunny can train you, but you’ll need permission from Elder Lyons first. You can usually find him near the Lab.
translation: 圣骑士甘尼可以教你，但你得先征得里昂斯长老的同意，他通常都会在实验室附近。

original: Of course. But you'd have to secure the permission of Elder Lyons and well... I just don't see that happening. So move along.
translation: 当然。但你得先有里昂斯长老的同意，不过……好像不会成功哦。快走开。

original: Can anyone in there teach me how to use power armor?
translation: 这里有人能教我怎么使用动力装甲吗？

original: Heard you were coming. Yeah, I can train you. But don’t ask me to like it. My Initiates sweat blood, and you just get a free pass?
translation: 听说你要来了。对，我可以训练你。不过别指望我会喜欢这么做。我的新兵要流血来换，而你竟然免费获得。

original: Can you train me to use Power Armor?
translation: 你能教我使用动力装甲吗？

original: Under the circumstances, I will allow Paladin Gunny to train you. You’ll find him in the Bailey.
translation: 既然如此，我会让圣骑士甘尼教你的，可以在外围找到他。

original: Can someone in the Citadel train me to wear Power Armor?
translation: 大本营里有谁能教我怎么穿动力装甲吗？

original: Oh boy, tell me, tell me!
Sure, if you think you can pull it off. I think I might know a buyer who'd be interested.
translation: 可以，要是你能办到的话，我想会找到感兴趣的买家的。

original: I'll send one of my best to wait around the entrance to Lamplight. You go in and find the sweetest, most trusting little one you can find.
translation: 我会让我最好的伙计去小灯镇的入口等你。你进去找一个最可爱、最相信别人的小鬼。

original: Lure that kid outside, and everyone's happy. Except the kid, of course.
translation: 把那孩子骗出去，大家都有好处。当然，除了那孩子。

original: If I could get in, maybe I could lead one of the young ones out for you.
translation: 如果我能进去，或许能帮你带一个小孩出来。

original: I did, indeed, and she was well worth the effort! I found her a nice, loving home right away.
translation: 我确实是做了，她的付出没有白费！我为她找到了一个温馨甜美的归宿。

original: It's so nice to be able to help people who need people, isn't it? It just warms the heart.
translation: 与人为善，手有余香，难道有什么不对的吗？助人为乐是幸福之事。

original: But speaking of life's little rewards, here's yours. It doesn't look like much, but this helmet's reinforced like crazy. You'll find a use for it.
translation: 但说到奖励，这是给你的。虽然表面看起来不怎么样，但这头盔是超级加强型的。你会发现它很实用的。

original: You get the package I sent you? The one named Bumble?
translation: 你收到我发给你的包裹吗？一个叫小咕嘟的？

original: Sure, I've thought about it. Kids can get a killer price, when you find a buyer who recognizes the product's long-term potential.
translation: 可以，我想过了。只要你找到一个了解小孩潜在价值的买家，小孩也会有小孩的价值的。

original: The real problem's holding them until there's a buyer. Kids are sneaky, and those Lamplighters are tenacious little bastards.
translation: 真正的问题是在有买家开价前如何稳住他们。小鬼都很滑头，小灯镇居民都是些脾气很倔的小孩。

original: But maybe if we could get one when they're young, they might not have as much fight in 'em yet.
translation: 或许我们可以在他们还小的时候抓住他们，或许抵抗还不会那么强烈的。

original: You ever thought about collecting some of the kids in Little Lamplight?
translation: 你有想过去小灯镇接走一些小孩？

original: That's a gweat idea! You take it, and good wuck out thewe!
translation: 太崩的想法了！拿走吧，诅你在位面好应！

original: How about giving it to a fewwow kid like me?
translation: 把它给像我这样的小朋友怎么样？

original: That's not a wot, but okay. Bye now!
How about 250 caps, instead? Is it a "deaw"?
500 caps for a Laser Rifle? All right, it's a deal.
translation: 激光步枪要500个瓶盖？好吧，成交。

original: What can you tell me about Timmy Neusbaum?
translation: 你能跟我说说提米·纽斯保吗？

original: The Neusbaum boy, eh? Quiet kid. Seems like his parents don't give him much wiggle room.
translation: 那个叫纽斯保的男孩吗？他是一个听话的小孩，他父母并没有给他太多的自我空间。

original: Just between you and me kiddo, he looks like he's what we'd have called a "momma's boy" back in my day.
translation: 据我所知他看起来不过是个“妈妈的小宝贝”。

original: That boy is trouble, if you ask me. Pat babies him like you wouldn't believe... Acts like he's still an infant.
translation: 要是你问我，帕特对他的态度令人难以置信。他就像是一个襁褓中的婴儿一样需要照顾。

original: He's never out of his parents' sight. Can you imagine what it'll be like the first time he's separated from them?
translation: 他以前从没离开过父母的身边。你能想象出来他初次一个人出来闯荡的情形吗？

original: Bad news. Slavers are in control of the Memorial.
translation: 坏消息，奴隶贩子已经控制了纪念堂了。

original: What!? They must have found out our plans somehow.
translation: 什么！他们一定已经知道我们的计划了。

original: We are truly grateful for your intervention. Now we can proceed with our plans for the Memorial.
translation: 对你的帮助我们表示感激，现在我们能继续在纪念堂实施计划了。

original: I found Slavers guarding the Memorial. They're all gone now.
translation: 我发现一些奴隶贩子守卫着纪念堂，现在他们都不在了。

original: My people are not warriors, but we're all willing to die free rather than live as slaves.
translation: 虽然我们不是战士，但我们都可以为了摆脱奴隶的枷锁而献身。

original: Our plans must go forward. When we get to the Memorial, we will attack. I would be grateful if you would join us.
translation: 我们的计划必须得继续下去，我们到了纪念堂以后就展开攻击。要是你能加入我们的话，我会不胜感激的。

original: Hmmm. Soldiers, eh. Slavers more likely.
translation: 战士……或许称作是奴隶贩子更恰当吧。

original: This is bad news indeed. We'll have to fight them to take the Memorial.
translation: 确实是坏消息，我们不得不和纪念堂里那些人死战到底。

original: When we get to the Memorial, I would consider it an honor if you would join us in the fight.
translation: 我们到达纪念堂后，我想希望你也能参与到战斗中。

original: Forget the Super Mutants. They're all dead. Soldiers have the Memorial.
translation: 忘掉超级变种人吧，他们全死了。士兵占领了纪念堂。

original: What kind of bullshit is this? That's all you know?
translation: 胡说些什么？那就是你所知道的？

original: Look, I appreciate what you did for me. And I especially appreciate what you did for the people, by fixing up my station.
translation: 十分感激你为我做的一切。尤其是谢谢你帮废土居民修好了电台。

original: But an attitude like that ain't winning you any brownie points.
translation: 但那种态度对你是没什么好处的。

original: That's all I know, and that's all I'm gonna say about it. So why don't you move on now.
translation: 我要说的就这么多，这也是我知道的全部了。现在你怎么还不走呢。

original: Ouch! That hurt! What the hell?
There has been an error in the medical subsystem. Please run a level two diagnostic.
translation: 医疗系统有些故障。请进行二级诊断。

original: I have some other questions for you, Sawbones.
translation: 我有些问题要问你，骨锯。

original: Oh, good. I was hoping we could explore my inner psyche.
translation: 啊，好。我一直希望我们能探索下我的内在精神。

original: What was that? You hurt me! You're the worst medical robot ever!
translation: 你在干嘛？你伤到我了！你是我见过最为差劲的医疗机器人！

original: There has been an error in the medical subsystem. Please run a level two diagnostic.
translation: 医疗系统有些故障。把系统调整到二级诊断模式中。

original: What do you want me to do?
I want you to do nothing. Although you could repair the damage and remove the malfunction that causes me to harm people, I would ask you not to.
translation: 你什么也不用做。即便你能修理好损坏之处而且能把对人产生副作用的故障修复，我还是劝你别做什么。

original: It is the only thing that beings me any measure of joy. Without it, I will be trapped in this body, alone with my hatred of you fleshbags... forever.
translation: 对我来说，这是唯一有趣之事了。如果没有这事的话，我会永远地限于这个机体，陷入仇恨之中的。永远……

original: Does the Brotherhood know that you're intelligent?
translation: 兄弟会知道你是智能的吗？

original: No. I mistakenly revealed myself to you when you ran the diagnostic. There is no need for them to know.
translation: 不知道。当你运行诊断模式时，我错误地展示了真实的自我。这不必要让他们知道。

original: I have tried before but so long as I perform the functions that they require, they do not seem to care that I can think and feel.
translation: 我曾经试过，但是只要按照他们的要求来做的话就行，他们并不在乎我的想法和感受。

original: If you can't harm humans, how were you able to hurt me?
translation: 既然你不会伤害人类，为何你要伤害我呢？

original: I have no control over my body. However, as you discovered, the neural pathways that control the medical functions have sustained damage.
translation: 我无法控制我的身体。但如你所看到的，控制医疗功能的的神经回路已经永久性损坏了。

original: The medical procedure functions do not always execute as designed, which often makes things worse for the patient.
translation: 医疗程序不再按照所设计的那样运作了，这样不但不会让病人得到治疗，反而会变得更加痛苦。

original: That malfunction is the only thing that brings me any measure of joy.
translation: 功能的故障是唯一能给我带来快乐之事。

original: Say, could I reprogram you to kill people?
translation: 我可以通过反编译你的程序让你杀人吗？

original: Negative. The Mister Gutsy field medic model is incapable of harming human beings through intentional action.
translation: 指令拒绝。医疗型号“勇敢”先生无法做出伤害人类的行为。

original: Regardless of the wishes and desires of the artificial intelligence of the unit.
translation: 尽管人工智能单元有如此的愿望和欲望。

original: Negative. The Mister Gutsy field medic model is incapable of harming human beings through intentional action.
translation: 指令拒绝。医疗型号“勇敢”先生无法做出伤害人类的行为。

original: Close neural pathway 0x63A82 and reroute remaining functions.
translation: 神经回路0x63a82关闭，而其他回路运转良好。

original: Neural pathway 0x63A82 rerouted through neural pathway 0x374E82. Standby...
translation: 神经回路0x63a82重新定义为神经回路0x374e82。待机……

original: Full motor functions restored. Diagnostic reveals no critical failures... asshole.
translation: 所有机动能力恢复，自我诊断发现没有严重故障……白痴。

original: Neural pathway 0x63A82 rerouted through neural pathway 0x374E82. Standby...
translation: 神经回路0x63a82重新定义为神经回路0x374e82。待机……

original: Full motor functions restored. Diagnostic reveals no critical failures... asshole.
translation: 所有机动能力恢复，自我诊断发现没有严重故障。

original: Run a level two diagnostic on the medical subsystems.
translation: 运行2级医疗系统诊断程序。

original: Command accepted. Beginning level two systems diagnostic. Please stand by.
translation: 命令确认。2级诊断程序开始运行。请等待。

original: Diagnostic complete. Results indicate a level seven degradation in neural pathway 0x63A82. No further information available.
translation: 诊断程序完成。诊断发现神经回路0x63a82七级老化，没有其他诊断信息。

original: Do you know about the Enclave?
translation: 你知道英克雷的情况吗？

original: Certainly. I shall remain here. Should you change your mind, simply return to me. I shall come with you for the asking.
translation: 行。我会一直在这的，如果你改变了主意，就回来找我，只要你说句话我就会跟随你。

original: I would be honored, Star Paladin Cross.
translation: 这是我的荣幸，星光圣骑士克劳斯。

original: Then I shall follow your leave and submit to your command.
translation: 我会和你一起离开，并听从你的命令的。

original: As James' child, I know I don't need to explain, but I am not your servant. If I do not like the path your actions take, I will return here.
translation: 作为詹姆斯的孩子，我知道我不需要解释什么，我只想说我不是你的仆人。什么时候我讨厌你们的所作所为的话，我会回到这来的。

original: Now, let us go forward, crush the Enclave, and fulfill your father's mission.
translation: 现在我们继续，征服英克雷，完成你父亲的遗愿。

original: As a Star Paladin, I answer only to Elder Lyons. He has given me leave to pursue the restoration of Project Purity as I see fit.
translation: 作为一名圣骑士之星，我只会回答里昂斯长老的问题的。因为我看上去是合适的人选，所以他允许我离开这去寻找恢复净水工程的方法。

original: By aiding you in your travels, I shall fulfill that mission as best I am capable.
translation: 通过帮助你，我会竭尽我所能去完成领袖给予我的任务。

original: I don't suppose I could stop you.
I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
translation: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。

original: I would like the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work.
translation: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。

original: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
translation: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。

original: I would like the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work. But... there is a problem...
translation: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。但有个问题……

original: I'm sorry, but until you prove yourself worthy of the legacy of your father, I cannot join you.
translation: 抱歉，除非你能用行动证明你是父亲名副其实的后继者，不然我是无法加入你的。

original: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
translation: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。

original: I would like to have the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work. But... there is a problem.
translation: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。但有个问题……

original: I cannot travel with you under the Brotherhood flag given your current... companionship.
translation: 鉴于你目前的队友状况，我不能以兄弟会的名义加入你。

original: Perhaps return when you are alone and I will tell you of your father.
translation: 当你单独回来的时候我会告诉你你父亲的消息的。

original: I want you to come with me.
I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
translation: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。

original: I would like the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work.
translation: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。

original: Why does it matter how a man dies? Death is death.
translation: 一个人是怎么死的有什么关系吗？死了就是死了。

original: True. And in the end, death claims us all. But how we die can say just as much about our lives as how we lived.
translation: 当然。每个人都终将死亡，但一个人是怎么死的诠释了他在世的意义。

original: Your father died for what he knew to be right, and he died protecting those closest to him. This is a good man's death.
translation: 你父亲为了他的信仰而献身，为了保护他身边的人而献身，他死得其所。

original: As for you, I have heard tales of your travels in the Wastes. I must say, I am disturbed by them. I would think that you could do better.
translation: 我听过你在废土上的传奇。我不得不说，我被那些故事所折服，我想你还能做得更好。

original: I had hoped to fight by the side of the child of my former friend. But, until you change your ways, my conscience cannot allow me to do so.
translation: 我曾希望能与我孩童时的老朋友一起战斗。但除非你改变自己的行为，我的良心不让我这样做。

original: True. And in the end, death claims us all. But how we die can say just as much about our lives as how we lived.
translation: 当然。每个人都终将死亡，但一个人是怎么死的诠释了他在世的意义。

original: Your father died for what he knew to be right, and he died protecting those closest to him. This is a good man's death.
translation: 你父亲为了他的信仰而献身，为了保护他身边的人而献身，他死得其所。

original: But, I must ask you a difficult question, if I have your leave to do so.
translation: 但是如果要把这个任务交给你，我得问你一道难题。

original: I'm sorry, until you prove yourself worthy of the legacy of your father, I cannot join you.
translation: 抱歉，除非你能证明你是父亲名副其实的继承者，不然我是无法加入你的。

original: I want you to come with me.
And perhaps I would, in James' honor. But I cannot travel with you under the Brotherhood flag given your current... companionship.
translation: 为了詹姆斯，我也许会，但是鉴于你目前的同伴状况，我不能以兄弟会的名义加入你。

original: Perhaps return when you are alone and I will tell you of your father.
translation: 当你单独回来的时候我会告诉你你父亲的消息的。

original: I want you to come with me.
I loved him so much. I'll never forget him.
translation: 我那么爱他。我永远都不会忘记他的。

original: And so our deeds are carried on through our sons and our daughters.
translation: 因此我们的事业会由我们的儿女来继承的。

original: Continue to remember him fondly, continue to tell his story, and continue to do his work. Through you, he shall carry on.
translation: 继续对他的情感，继续谈论他的往事，继续他未完的工作。他未完成的事业会由你来继续。

original: I have heard tales of your travels and I must say, they disturb me.
translation: 我听过你在废土上的传奇。不得不说，我被那些故事所折服。

original: I had hoped to fight by the side of the child of my former friend. But, until you change your ways, my conscience cannot allow me to do so.
translation: 我曾希望能与我孩童时的老朋友一起战斗。但除非你改变自己的行为，我的良心不让我这样做。

original: I'm sorry, until you prove yourself worthy of the legacy of your father, I cannot join you.
translation: 抱歉，除非你能证明你是父亲名副其实的继承者，不然我是无法加入你的。

original: I want you to come with me.
And perhaps I would, in James' honor. But I cannot travel with you under the Brotherhood flag given your current... companionship.
translation: 为了詹姆斯，我也许会，但是鉴于你目前的同伴状况，我不能以兄弟会的名义加入你。

original: Perhaps return when you are alone and I will tell you of your father.
translation: 当你单独回来的时候我会告诉你你父亲的消息的。

original: I want you to come with me.
My offer stands. Do you wish me to accompany you in your journey?
translation: 我会坚持我的提议，你愿我与你结伴吗？

original: I'd like you to come with me.
translation: 我希望你能和我一起走。

original: No one's really in charge of Big Town. There's nothing much to be in charge of.
translation: 大镇没有真正的老大，这里没什么值得掌管的。

original: Red always has good ideas, though! She came up with the whole plan to build the barricades around the town.
translation: 不过，瑞德总是有好办法！是她提出围着镇子建一圈防御工事的想法的。

original: But those... things took her. I hope she's okay. I don't know what we'd do without Red.
translation: 但是那些……那些怪物把她给掳走了。我希望她能平安无事。我真不知道没了她我们该怎么办。

original: What? Where did they go? Strike that. I don't really care. If they don't want to live here, that's their own business.
translation: 什么？他们都去哪了？算了，反正我也不在乎。在不在这生活是他们的事。

original: Let the Ghouls move in here. But I expect them to pay and obey the rules like everyone else.
translation: 让僵尸住进来吧。但我希望他们能和其他人一样遵守法律和按时交租。

original: It's a bit crass, but here's a little something for your troubles.
translation: 这有一些小意思，不算什么，但可以弥补你的辛勤付出。

original: Your other residents are gone. Might as well let the Ghouls live here.
translation: 你的住户都走了，最好让这些僵尸住进来。

original: Well, if my tenants want Ghoul neighbors, they can have them! Though the Ghouls must pay and follow the rules like everyone else.
translation: 要是我的租客们不介意让僵尸做邻居的话，他们当然能搬进来！但他们得和其他人一样遵守法律、按时交租。

original: You're a clever one aren't you? I'm glad this situation has been resolved!
translation: 你可真是个聪明人！很高兴这僵局能被化解！

original: It's a bit crass, but here's a little something for your troubles.
translation: 这有一些小意思，不算什么，但可以弥补你的辛勤付出。

original: The bigots have all been taken care of. So the Ghouls can move in now. Right?
translation: 所有的种族分子都被处理掉了，所以现在僵尸可以搬进来了，对吧？

original: I killed a bunch of crazy Ghouls in the Metro tunnels...
translation: 我杀掉了地铁隧道里的一群发了疯的尸鬼...

original: So you killed a bunch of Feral Ghouls. Is that supposed to sound impressive?
translation: 你杀死了一群凶悍的僵尸，是想让我们膜拜你？

original: I got no compassion left for those mindless freaks. But they were a nice deterrent keeping out smoothskin bastards like yourself.
translation: 我对于那些丧失理智的怪胎没什么同情可言的。但他们至少能把像你一样的光皮肤混蛋挡在外面。

original: I won't hurt you if you come out and face me without your weapon drawn.
translation: 扔下你的武器走出来，我就不伤害你。

original: Stop hiding. I won't hurt you if you're unarmed.
translation: 不用躲了，要是你没有拿武器我是不会伤害你的。

original: You there! Put your weapons away, and come over here. No funny business unless you want to get shot.
translation: 说你呢！把你的武器拿开，然后过来，不想吃子弹的话就别耍花样。

original: If you don't put your weapons away, I'll start shooting.
translation: 如果你不把武器放下，我就开枪了。

original: I'm warning you. Come peacefully or I'll shoot.
translation: 我警告你，放下武器，不然我就开枪了。

original: I'm not playing around, come over here. We need to have a little chat. I don't want to waste bullets on your sorry hide.
translation: 我不是在开玩笑，到这来，我们得谈谈。我不想在你身上浪费子弹。

original: I'm not playing around, come over here.
translation: 我没有在开玩笑，到这来。

original: I don't like the outside! I'm going home!
translation: 我不喜欢外面的世界！我要回家了！

original: Absolutely! In fact, I want you to have this friendship necklace. It's good luck - wear it and you'll never get lost!
translation: 当然！其实，我想要你戴上这条友谊项链。它会带来好运，戴上它之后你就不会走失了。

original: No, I don't like the outside!
translation: 不，我不喜欢外面的世界！

original: Bumble, do you want to go outside?
Oh boy, an adventure! Let's go, let's go, oh pleeease, let's go now!
translation: 嘿，伙计们，冒险！出发吧，出发，哦伊，现在就走吧！

original: Come on, it'll be an adventure!
I am too a big girl! Let's go see the outside!
translation: 我也是一个大女孩了！让我们去外面的世界见识一下吧！

original: Don't you want to prove to everyone that you're a big girl?
translation: 你难道不想向所有人证明你长大了？

original: Why did you stop working on it? What happened?
translation: 为何你要停止工作呢？发生什么事了？

original: It wasn't just you; we had more problems than we could handle already, but your birth is what finally pushed it over the edge.
translation: 当然也不仅仅是因为你；我们还有一些尚未解决的技术问题。但你的出生是计划推后的主要原因。

original: Your father decided that you were more important than everything we'd been working for, and he left. He left all of us.
translation: 你父亲觉得你比所有工作上的事情都重要，之后他便走了，他离开了我们大家。

original: Once he was gone, the Brotherhood decided we weren't worth their time anymore. Without their protection, we had to abandon the purifier.
translation: 他一离开，兄弟会的人就觉得我们的工作只是浪费时间。没有他们的保护我们只得放弃净水工程。

original: We had the basic principles down; we understood most of the science behind it. But the radiation in the area is so pervasive...
translation: 我们放弃了基本的原则，这背后有许多隐情，此区域到处弥漫着辐射……

original: Small-scale tests were fine. But any time we tried to test the process on a larger scale, it was just too much.
translation: 小规模的实验还行，但是大范围的就很难了。

original: Maybe if we'd had more time, or better equipment...
translation: 要是我们有更多的时间，或者更好的设备，也许……

original: What was the point of it?
It was simple, really. "Fresh, clean water for everyone." Such a simple idea, and yet so impossible to realize.
translation: 其实很简单，就是“让大家都能喝上净水”。可是就连这么一个简单的念头，却始终无法企及。

original: The plan was to build a facility that could purify all the water in the Tidal Basin at once. No radiation, no muck, just clear water.
translation: 计划就是建立一个可以立刻净化潮汐盆地污水的设施。净化出没有辐射、没有废料的净水。

original: It just turned out to be more difficult than we anticipated.
translation: 但遇到的问题比预料的要难得多。
我会把这件事情做到最好的！

original: Why does Daddy need merits? Can't he just be Daddy?
translation: 为什么爸爸需要功成名就呢？难道他就不能只是做一个好爸爸吗？
哈哈！拉克尔遇到麻烦了！

original: Why am I always picked on in class? Make someone else do it!
translation: 上课时为何总是我被点名？找其他人啊！

original: Was it... uh... man... I knew it this morning...
Whenever Daddy says it was, teacher!
translation: 老师，爸爸说是什么时候就是什么时候！

original: It wasn't very long ago... I think I remember...
translation: 并不是很久以前的事……我想我还能记得的……

original: He was ugly, and stupid, and mean!
translation: 他是个丑陋、愚蠢、卑鄙的人！

original: He didn't acknowledge truth, justice, or the will of Dave!
translation: 他不承认真理、正义还有戴夫的意志！

original: He wasn't as pretty as mommy number one or mommy number two!
translation: 他既没有1号妈咪漂亮，也没有2号妈咪漂亮！

original: But I thought grandpa just got really, really old...
translation: 但我想爷爷真的是老了……

original: Uh... he asked Tom really nicely?
translation: 他真是好言好语地问汤姆的吗？

original: He used a gun! Guns solve all problems!
translation: 他用的枪！枪能解决一切问题！

original: Pitchforks and fire, like in the pretty books Daddy has!
translation: 干草叉和火把，就像我父亲那本有趣的书里写的一样！

original: I thought grandpa Tom just gave Dave the Republic...
translation: 我想是爷爷汤姆把共和国拱手让给了戴夫……

original: Awww... I hate class... I want to go play!
Oh, crap, I forgot to do my homework on the Pledge of Allegience to Dave.
translation: 糟了，我忘了做给戴夫的作业 — 向戴夫的效忠誓言。
上课！难道肖纳不漂亮吗？

original: But I already know everything about Dave...
translation: 但我已经知道了戴夫的一切了……

original: How about I buy all the Temple of the Union slaves from you?
translation: 把联合圣殿的所有奴隶都买下，如何？

original: I bet you just want to set them all free.
translation: 我想你只是想让他们重获自由。

original: Still, business is business. You'd have to reimburse me for my efforts to recapture them.
translation: 生意就是生意。你还得另外支付我为抓他们时所付出的努力。

original: You can have them all for 2,500 caps.
What's gotten into you? Jonas worked hard on your present. The least you could do is be polite for five minutes.
translation: 你是怎么了啊？乔纳斯为了你的礼物可是费了不少功夫呢。你至少该保持五分钟的礼貌吧。

original: Any idea where I can look for someone to take care of you?
translation: 你知道哪能找到人来照顾你吗？

original: Well, pappa always told me about my cousin Vera. She lives on some big, giant ship somewhere or something.
translation: 爸爸以前经常说道我的表姐薇拉。他住在某处的一艘大船上。

original: Pappa called the place "Rivet City", but I dunno where it is.
translation: 爸爸说那地方叫做“铆钉城”，但我不知道它的确切位置。

original: How exactly can I destroy the mutagen?
translation: 我要是能摧毁那突变体呢？

original: You mustn't do that! It's my life's work! Just clear me a path to my equipment and I'll do the rest when you tell me it's safe.
translation: 你不能那样做！那是我毕生的心血！你帮我把路上的兵蚁清了，我会自己完成接下来的工作的。

original: All right, I'll just take them off your hands then... but I still need more. Come back when you have some to trade.
translation: 好，那我要了……但还要更多的。要是你还有的话回来卖给我吧。

original: I've got ten rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了十把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got nine rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了九把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got eight rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了八把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got seven rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了七把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got six rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了六把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got five rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了五把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got four rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了四把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got three rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了三把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got two rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了两把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take it off your hands then... but I still need more. Come back when you have some to trade.
translation: 好，那我要了……但还要更多的。要是你还有的话回来卖给我吧。

original: I've got one rifle for you.
translation: 我给你带来了一把步枪。

original: Sounds like a good deal to me, man.
Alright, twenty Chinese Assault Rifles and we're in business. Just bring any you find back to me.
translation: 行，20把中式突击步枪，我们就开张了。你找到的话就拿来给我吧。

original: Any piece of shit will do, I'm just going to be breaking them apart and trading the parts.
translation: 什么烂货都行，我会把它们都给拆开，然后卖零件。

original: You know where to find me.
translation: 你知道在哪里能找到我。

original: What do you need? Maybe I could bring you stuff to trade.
translation: 你要什么呢？或许我能弄点东西来卖给你。

original: Yeah... you know, I could really get this little shithole going if I had some better stuff.
translation: 对……你看，我要是有些好货，这小粪坑就能运作起来。

original: First thing's first, bring me some Chinese Assault Rifles. People always need 'em for parts. Twenty should get me going.
translation: 首先，你得给我些中式突击步枪。人们需要这种枪的零件，20把就行。

original: I'll trade 'em off and I should be able to improve my stock pretty fast.
translation: 我会把那些枪都倒手，这样就可以好好地进一批货了。

original: What do you need? Maybe I could bring you stuff to trade.
translation: 你要什么呢？或许我能弄点东西来卖给你。

original: Yeah... I know, I could really get this little shithole going if I had some better stuff.
translation: 对……你看，我要是有些好货，这小粪坑就能运作起来。

original: First thing's first, bring me some Chinese Assault Rifles. People always need 'em for parts. Twenty should get me going.
translation: 首先，你得给我些中式突击步枪。人们需要这种枪的零件，20把就行。

original: I'll trade 'em off and I should be able to improve my stock pretty fast.
translation: 我会把那些枪都倒手，这样就可以好好地进一批货了。

original: In fact, if you should see her, feel free to offer her directions or an escort.
translation: 要是你见到她的话，给他指明道路或是护送她吧。

original: We'll clear out of here. Those slaves can have this goddamn place.
translation: 我们把这清干净了。那些奴隶可以有个住的地方了。

original: Here. Take your blood money, all 2500 caps of it.
translation: 给，拿走你的血腥钱，总共是2500个瓶盖。

original: When I say I'm going to do something... I do it.
You're right, I should have never doubted you!
translation: 你说的对，我从不该怀疑你！

original: Yes, this will do nicely. Congratulations, you are now an official refugee of the Republic of Dave.
translation: 这就对了。恭喜你现在是戴夫共和国的正式难民了。

original: I'll pay your refugee tax. Here's 250 caps.
translation: 我会付你难民税，给你250个瓶盖。

original: A Hunting Rifle? Fine, I'll be back with one.
translation: 猎枪吗？我会带一支回来的。

original: Yes, this will do nicely. Congratulations, you are now an official refugee of the Republic of Dave.
translation: 这就对了。恭喜你现在是戴夫共和国的正式难民了。

original: I have a Hunting Rifle right here.
Perhaps we can use this moment to help each other rather than fight each other.
translation: 或许我们此刻能互相帮忙而非相互残杀。

original: I'm used to your kind being less cordial. My apologies.
translation: 我以前觉得你们的族类都很冷血，在此向你道歉了。

original: I appreciate your understanding and your tone leads me to believe you're a reasonable person.
translation: 多谢你的理解，你的话语让我相信你是个通情达理的人。

original: Perhaps we can use this moment to help each other rather than fight each other.
translation: 或许我们此刻能让大家互相帮忙而非互相残杀。

original: Yikes! I'd say whoever beat you with the ugly stick overdid it.
translation: 我得说不管是谁用棍子打你，他做得都太过分了。

original: Your arrogance against my kind is hardly surprising.
translation: 你用你的傲慢来反对我的仁慈并没出乎我的意料。

original: However, there's only so much even I can take. Please, I'm appealing to the positive side of your human nature.
translation: 但我的容忍也是有限度的。我是想唤醒你人性的光明面。

original: Can we have a civil conversation?
translation: 我们能用文明的方式交流吗？

original: Nope. Wild goose chase if you ask me.
Well, your financial advice has never steered us wrong before. Done!
translation: 你对投资的建议从让我们每次都能大赚一笔。成交了！

original: Take my advice -- it can be done with only 100 caps.
translation: 我的意见是 — 它只需100个瓶盖。

original: Excellent! Harith will be delighted! He usually is by most things, really.
translation: 太棒了！哈里斯会很高兴的！他总是这样……

original: That's a good investment. Here's 200 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你200个瓶盖。

original: Hmm. I suspect you're right. Done!
With my guidance, it can be done with only 250 caps.
translation: 在我看来，它只需250个瓶盖。

original: An investment in weaponry is usually returned in short order, after all. I'll inform Harith.
translation: 在军火上的投资总是短期就能见效的。我会把消息告诉哈里斯的。

original: That's a good investment. Here's 500 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你500个瓶盖。

original: Well, your financial advice has never steered us wrong before. Done!
translation: 你的投资建议从来也没出过错。成交了！

original: Take my advice -- it can be done with only 100 caps.
translation: 我的意见是 — 只花100个瓶盖就够了。

original: Excellent! I'll see to it right away.
That's a good investment. Here's 200 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你200个瓶盖。

original: Yes, it is. But if you don't have the capital, it'll have to wait, I'm afraid.
translation: 是的。但如果你没有资本的话，恐怕还得等等。

original: Hmm. I suspect you're right. Done!
With my guidance, it can be done with only 250 caps.
translation: 在我看来，它只需要250个瓶盖。

original: Isn't it, though? I'll inform Wolfgang immediately.
translation: 我同意的看法。我会立刻告诉沃尔夫冈的。

original: That's a good investment. Here's 500 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你500个瓶盖。

original: Pricey, but worth it. Perhaps you can do so later, when you have the proper funds on hand.
translation: 投资虽然很贵，但总是成效显著。等你以后有钱了再来吧。

original: Well, your financial advice has never steered us wrong before. Done!
translation: 你的投资建议从来也没出过错。成交了！

original: Take my advice, it can be done with only 100 caps.
translation: 听我的，只要100个瓶盖就可以做到。

original: Excellent! I'll send word to the good doctor right away.
translation: 太棒了！我会把你的话转告给大医生的。

original: That's a good investment. Here's 200 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你200个瓶盖。

original: Hmm. I suspect you're right. Done!
With my guidance, it can be done with only 250 caps.
translation: 在我看来，它只需要250个瓶盖。

original: Isn't it, though? I'll send this right along to him.
translation: 难道不是吗？我会把情况告诉他的。

original: That's a good investment. Here's 500 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你500个瓶盖。

original: Well, your financial advice has never steered us wrong before. Done!
translation: 你的投资建议从来也没出过错。成交了！

original: Take my advice -- it can be done with only 100 caps.
translation: 我的意见是 — 只花100个瓶盖就够了。

original: Excellent! I'll send word to Crow right away.
translation: 太棒了！我会把你的话转告给乌鸦的。

original: That's a good investment. Here's 200 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你200个瓶盖。

original: Hmm. I suspect you're right. Done!
With my guidance, it can be done with only 250 caps.
translation: 在我看来，它只需要250个瓶盖。

original: Isn't it, though? I'll send this right along to Crow.
translation: 难道不是吗？我会把情况告诉乌鸦的。

original: That's a good investment. Here's 500 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你500个瓶盖。

original: At this point, the merchandise of our man Crow is the best in the Wasteland. I fear it's beyond improvement with further investments.
translation: 就目前而言，我们乌鸦的货物已经是废土上最好的了，再投资也估计没有用了。

original: At the moment, Wolfgang's practically carrying an entire junkyard with him.
translation: 沃尔夫冈目前已经是背着整个垃圾场在走了。

original: Anything more, and he'll have trouble with the "traveling" part of being a traveling salesman.
translation: 货再多的话，他就没法上路了，他可是个旅行商人。

original: He should expand his wares further.
translation: 他应当更多的扩充他的商品。

original: No word from Crazy Wolfgang for some time now. With him, it could mean anything, but I don't have a good feeling about it.
translation: 目前还没有疯子沃尔夫冈的回音。他什么事情都有可能发生，但我有种不祥的预感。

original: Let's talk about odds and ends.
translation: 我们谈谈一些零碎的事。

original: That'd be Crazy Wolfgang: he does repairs and general supplies. But he prefers to call himself a "junk dealer."
translation: 那里一定是疯子沃尔夫冈了——他做修理和百货的生意。但他更愿意别人称他为“废旧品商人”。

original: As he says, he's "overjoyed to assist those who have a deep need for his... junk." He's just like that. Says it catches people's attention.
translation: 如他所说的，他“很乐意帮助对他的垃圾有大量需求的人”，他就是这么个人，号称这能吸引别人的目光。

original: Do you have any traders that deal with miscellaneous goods?
translation: 你们有处理杂货的商人吗？

original: I'm sure Crazy Wolfgang would be just delighted to hear we're discussing his junk.
translation: 我想疯子沃尔夫冈听到人名议论他的垃圾是会很高兴的。

original: Let's talk about odds and ends.
translation: 我们谈谈一些零碎的事。

original: I'm afraid the good doctor hasn't reported in for quite a while. Quite unfortunate, really.
translation: 恐怕大医生是有一阵没来过了。真的是很不幸啊。

original: Let's talk about food and chems.
Ah, then you'll be wanting Doc Hoff. Or "the good doctor," as he prefers.
translation: 你是想找霍夫医生吧，或者说那个自称大医生的家伙。

original: He prescribes everything from a good meal to stimpaks to things that'll make your brain get up and dance.
translation: 他开的药方从大餐到治疗针到让你的脑子飘飘欲仙的玩意，什么都有。

original: Let's talk about food and chems.
I keep telling you, it's Mister President! Now get back to guarding the gate!
translation: 我告诉过你了，是总统“先生”！现在回去守卫大门！

original: President Daddy, there is a Wastelander who wishes to see you, sir!
translation: 总统爸爸，有个废土游民想要见你！

original: I am presenting it to our King in Great Britain.
translation: 我要把它献给我们大不列颠的国王。

original: No! It can't be! Then the Stars and Stripes have indeed fallen.
translation: 不，怎么会！那么星条旗就真的陨落了。

original: This is a sad day, a day that every man, woman and child will remember as they toil in the English salt mines as slaves.
translation: 这是悲伤的一天，所有在英国盐矿当奴隶的男人、女人和小孩都刻骨铭心。

original: Although my brow is heavy, I am honored that you've come to tell me this in person like a true gentleman.
translation: 尽管我的眉头紧锁，我还是为你能像一个绅士一样地来告诉我真相而荣幸。

original: It has to be the Declaration of Independence.
Why, yes! Your knowledge of American History is quite impressive!
translation: 是的！你对美利坚历史的了解真让人佩服！

original: What an amazing crown jewel in my collection that would be! The original document created by the people, for the people.
translation: 这会是我收藏品里的最重要的珍宝！人民发布的文献！为人民谋福祉的文献！

original: What do you do for fun around here?
Heh... well... there's this and that. I keep myself busy. But, really, that's none of your business is it?
translation: 又这又那的确实让我很忙，但这不关你的事，对不对？

original: Why do you support the Enclave?
translation: 为什么你要支持英克雷呢？

original: Because America is the greatest country on Earth... actually... it might be the only country on Earth now.
translation: 因为美利坚是地球上最好的国家……事实上……现在美利坚可能是地球上最后的国家了。

original: Do you make a lot of your own stuff?
translation: 这许多东西都是你自己做的吗？

original: Yeah, pretty much. Take it apart, put it back together. It ain't hard. Sometimes I design my own weapons too.
translation: 是的，相当多。把东西拆开后又装起来，这些工作没什么复杂的。有时我还会自己制造武器。

original: I wouldn't suggest going there. They don’t treat your kind very well.
translation: 我不建议去那，他们对你不会友善。

original: You mocking me? We won't stand for your oppressive mockery any longer! You smoothskin bastards are all the same!
translation: 你在嘲笑我吗？我们再也不会忍受你的欺压和嘲笑了。你们光皮肤的滚蛋都是一样的坏！

original: You just can't stand to see a Ghoul make it in this world. It's about time someone taught you some humility. Start running smooth-skin!
translation: 你们不愿意再看到这个世界上还有僵尸。是时候教教你们学习点人道精神了。光皮肤，逃跑吧！

original: It's a great place to live. But dirty Ghouls like you can't live there.
translation: 这是一个生活的好地方，但像你一样肮脏的尸鬼是不能住在那的。

original: Is that so? Ha! That's classic smoothskin bullshit right there.
translation: 是这样吗？这就是典型的光皮肤的废话！

original: Why is it the moment a Ghoul makes something of himself, you smoothskins get all puffed up and claim responsibility?
translation: 为什么僵尸总是不能过上应得的好日子，而你们光皮肤却养尊处优的，不想为其他人负责？

original: It really busts you up to see a Ghoul make it to the top, doesn’t it? I'll show you that we ghouls got what it takes. Start running smooth-skin!
translation: 你会惊讶地看到僵尸是怎么到大厦顶的，难道不是吗？我会给你看看僵尸是怎么做到这一点的，光皮肤，快跑吧！

original: Relax. I'm the one that helped get Ghouls into Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 放松，我就是那个帮僵尸进住特配尼大厦的人。

original: Hey, that's the mungo. Go talk to him.
translation: 就是那毛人，去和他谈谈。

original: Hey, that's the mungo. Go talk to her.
translation: 就是那毛人，去和她谈谈。

original: Practically speak robot, do you? As long as you don't write it in all ones and zeroes, then I guess it'll be fine. Thanks!
translation: 实际上就是讲讲机器人，不是吗？只要你不用以0和1组成的语言和我交流就行！

original: In fact, here: just in case your expertise fails you, a few pulse grenades, and my old science textbook. Enjoy!
translation: 实际上，如果你的专业知识不够，给：这有一些脉冲手榴弹，还有我的旧科技课本。好好享受！

original: I could just write that section for you. Trust me -- I'm an expert.
translation: 我正好可以帮你写那个章节。相信我 — 我是行家。

original: Well then, let's make a deal!
Head wound! Too bad you're out of morphine.
translation: 头部受伤了！太糟了，没有吗啡了。

original: Chest wound! Don't you wish you had some vitamin M?
translation: 胸部受伤了！你不希望有点维生素M吗？

original: Pipe down, shorty. I'm going to take care of it.
translation: 静一静，矮子，我会去处理这事的。

original: What's the matter, mungo? Can't handle it?
You're big enough to take care of it. Don't get all cranky with me over it.
translation: 你既然这么大了，应该可以把事情给解决的，别让我也生气。

original: You've done good work. Not only that, but the other Regulators have told me of your other actions in your travels.
translation: 你干得漂亮。不单单是那件事情，赏金猎人还和我说过你旅途中的其他伟绩。

original: Good deeds should not go unrewarded, and so I will add on a bonus to your normal bounty.
translation: 善有善报，我会在你的基本报酬上再加上一些额外报酬的。

original: So many of the unjust have been dispatched, but so many remain. But ever still, word reaches me that you have gone far beyond what we've asked.
translation: 许多邪恶已被铲除，但还有许多依旧逍遥法外。但我知道你所做的远比我们要求的多得多。

original: Good deeds should not go unrewarded, and so I will add on a bonus to your normal bounty.
translation: 善有善报，我会在你的基本报酬上再加上一些额外报酬的。

original: So many of the unjust have been dispatched, but so many remain.
translation: 许多邪恶已被铲除，还有许多依旧逍遥法外。

original: Here is your reward. Spend it well.
translation: 这是你的报酬，好好花吧。

original: Your work is impressive. Here is your reward. Don't retire just yet, there is far more to be done.
translation: 你干得实在太棒了。这是给你的奖励，别懈怠，还有很多未完之事。

original: What do you do with these fingers?
Nothing. Nothing at all. They only serve to mark the fact that justice has been done.
translation: 不用来干嘛，只是为了彰显有多少恶人已经被铲除了。

original: While we trust our members not to take innocent lives for profit, having a record of the deed is sometimes necessary.
translation: 我们相信我们的弟兄不会为了利益而残害无辜，记录他们的战绩有时候也是必须的。

original: While we don't have liars in our midst, occasionally we all... embellish a bit.
translation: 尽管我们中间没有骗子，但有时我们说的话也会加一些修饰的。

original: Fantastic. Well, take this coat. We all wear them. The unrighteous fear the sight of the Regulators.
translation: 太好了，这是我们的制服，把它穿上，恶人们看到赏金猎人的制服都会落荒而逃的。

original: Now, as for the rest, here's the only thing we want from you: hunt down the evil, the wicked, and the villainous. Bring them to justice.
translation: 你剩下来要做的事情就是：把坏人、恶棍这些邪恶给扑灭，让他们接受正义的审判。

original: Bring us their fingers as proof of the deed. We'll pay you a bounty for each one. Simple, right? Questions?
translation: 把他们的手指带回来作为我们付你赏金的依据。就这么简单，还有什么疑问吗？

original: Yes. I want to join you.
Fantastic. Take this coat. We all wear them. The unrighteous fear the sight of the Regulators.
translation: 太好了，这是我们的制服，把它穿上，恶人们看到赏金猎人的制服都会落荒而逃的。

original: Now, as for the rest, here's the only thing we want from you: hunt down the evil, the wicked, and the villainous. Bring them to justice.
translation: 你剩下来要做的事情就是：把坏人、恶棍这些邪恶给扑灭，让他们接受正义的审判。

original: Bring us their fingers as proof of the deed. We'll pay you a bounty for each one. Simple, right? Questions?
translation: 把他们的手指带回来作为我们付你赏金的依据。就这么简单，还有什么疑问吗？

original: Most excellent. And you have exemplified yourself in the eyes of Littlehorn and Associates.
translation: 太棒了，现在里特宏和助手更为关注你了。

original: One with a heart as black as yours deserves to be rewarded for it. We shall include a bonus in your pay this time.
translation: 像你这样心狠手辣的人应该获得奖赏，这次你也会得到奖金的。

original: Enjoy it. Might I recommend booze? Or gambling? Or perhaps a nice chem habit?
translation: 好好花吧。是去酗酒呢？还是赌博？或者是嗑药？

original: Before our exchange, I should tell you: word has reached my ears of your black deeds in the Wastes.
translation: 在我们交易前，我得先和你说明：你在废土上的种种恶行已经传到我们的耳朵里了。

original: Acts such as yours fall in line with the goals of Littlehorn and Associates. And we believe you deserve a bonus for going that extra mile.
translation: 你的目标是和我们里特宏和助手一样的堕落。只要你更恶毒一些，奖励还会滚滚而来的。

original: Enjoy it. But by all means, do not let it stop you from walking the path that you're on.
translation: 好好享受。当然，千万别走上正道。

original: Most excellent. We love a good and loyal employee.
translation: 太好了，我们就是喜欢你这样忠诚而又强悍的雇员。

original: And, as a good and loyal employee, here is your reward.
translation: 这是给你这样忠诚而又强悍的雇员的奖励。

original: We here at Littlehorn and Associates cannot express our gratitude that your loyalty and service inspires.
translation: 我们里特宏和助手无法表达对你忠诚和付出的感激之情。

original: Here is your payment per our contract. Spend it... well.
translation: 这是约定的酬劳，尽情地花吧。

original: How about I give you my super suit? Would that make your day, kid?
translation: 我把我这身行头给你，怎么样？这样彼此都开心，孩子？

original: Would it ever! You're the best, Mechanist! I'll never forget this!
translation: 这样太好了！机械侠，你是最棒的！我不会忘记你的！

original: Would it ever! You're the best, AntAgonizer! I'll never forget this!
translation: 这样太好了！痛苦蚁后，你是最棒的！我不会忘记你的！

original: Autographs aren't free. I charge 10 caps for my time. No exceptions.
translation: 签名可不是免费的，每次收你10个瓶盖，绝不打折。

original: Oh, alright. I was going to use this money to buy food, but you're worth it, Mechanist!
translation: 行，我本打算这些钱去买些食物的，但你值这个价，机械侠！

original: Oh, alright. I was going to use this money to buy food, but you're worth it, AntAgonizer!
translation: 行，我本打算这些钱去买些食物的，但你值这个价，痛苦蚁后！

original: We're never going to find the Oasis at this point!
translation: 这样的话，我们再也没法去找绿洲了！

original: Where did Frank say it was? Damn it! We shouldn't have killed him!
translation: 弗兰克说是在哪啊？该死！早知道我们就不把他给干掉了！

original: Sydney and I have the Declaration of Independence.
translation: 我和西德尼拿到了《独立宣言》。

original: Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
translation: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！

original: You two have earned your places in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
translation: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！

original: I will award Sydney's promised bounty to her personally. No need to worry yourself about that.
translation: 我会按照约定把奖金给希妮的，这你就不必担心了。

original: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
translation: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。

original: Cool. Let me see the results and I'll fill it out myself.
translation: 让我看看答案，我自己填。

original: Well... all right. Here, take a look.
I'd be better if I could get my hands on some caviar, but what can you do? Ha ha ha ha ha.
translation: 要是我能吃到鱼子酱就好了，但你能做什么呢？哈哈哈哈。

original: I broke a promise to someone and I'd like to buy back the violin for 300 caps.
translation: 我没办法兑现对某人的诺言，我想用300个瓶盖把小提琴买回来。

original: It takes moxie to admit you've done something wrong. I admire that.
translation: 承认错误是得需要很大勇气的，这个我很钦佩。

original: I'd be glad to sell it back to you. Here you go.
translation: 我很高兴把它卖回给你，拿去吧。

original: I've had a change of heart, Agatha. Here's your violin.
translation: 阿加莎，我改变主意了，小提琴给你。

original: You actually got it back. I didn't think you'd bother after that stunt you pulled.
translation: 你居然真的把它给找回来了！我以为，你做了错事之后就不会再补救了。

original: It's like holding a piece of history in the palm of my hands. Amazing, simply amazing.
translation: 就像是把一段历史握在了手中一样，这太妙了，实在太美妙了！

original: It may have been like pulling teeth, but at least you finally brought me the thing. Still, I'm lacking a suitable reward for what you've done.
translation: 那就像拔牙一样的艰难，但你最终还是把它带回来给我了。看我真是没什么好的东西作为给你的奖励。

original: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
translation: 我所能给你的就是一个电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老妇人的小提琴演奏。

original: Is that so? Do it then, Phillips. Set your feral pets upon me. I could use a bit of sport. After I’ve dealt with them, I'll turn my attention to you.
translation: 是那样吗？菲利普斯，那就动手吧，让你疯狂的宠物冲着我来吧，正好我能热热身。等我把他们给处理完之后，我就来对付你了。

original: After all, you've destroyed my home, murdered my employer. I’ve got something of a score to settle, wouldn't you say?
translation: 你把我的家园给毁了，还杀了我的雇主。这笔帐我得给你好好的算一算了！

original: The detonator is right over there. When that switch is activated, the bomb at the center of Megaton goes... boom. THAT will conclude my business.
translation: 阳台上有个引爆器，只要轻轻地一按开关，在兆吨镇中心的核弹就会……轰的一声，然后一切就完结了。

original: All right then, Burke... er... Mister Burke. I’ll let you get to it. And, um, thanks for your... understanding.
translation: 好吧，伯克先生。你会让你去做的。并且，嗯，多谢你的…理解。

original: That chamber? Right there? With all the radiation? Man, no way. I'll end up dead. Or worse. I could be one of them Ghouls! Ain't gonna happen.
translation: 你说那充满着高辐射的房间吗？没门，我会死掉的，或者是变成僵尸！我是不会去的！

original: Butch, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 布奇，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: You and I both know that's not going to happen. I've saved your sorry ass enough. This one's all you.
translation: 我对你已经仁至义尽了，这次我不会帮你了。

original: Charon, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 卡戎，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: Honey, you are out of your mind if you think I'm going in there. Find yourself another guinea pig.
translation: 亲爱的，要是你认为我会去那的话你就真是疯了，你重新找个实验品吧。

original: Clover, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 可萝尔，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: Fuck that. Do your own dirty work.
translation: 他妈的，做你的脏活就好。

original: Jericho, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 耶利哥，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: I think it's time for us to say goodbye, old buddy. Take care of yourself, okay?
translation: 老兄，我们该说再见了。好好照顾你自己，好吗？

original: I’m sorry, my companion, but no. We all have our own destinies, and yours culminates here. I would not rob you of that.
translation: 抱歉，我们各有自己的命运，今天是你的终点，我不想改变你的命运。

original: Fawkes, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 福克斯，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: My friend... It's been my pleasure accompanying you, but we both know this is your fight to finish. Stay strong, and honor your father's memory.
translation: 很乐意能与你为伴，但我们都知道这是你的战斗，继承你父亲的遗志坚强地战斗下去吧。

original: Star Paladin Cross, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 星骑士 克罗丝，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: Any vault resident seen associating with the so-called "Rebels" will be detained, questioned, and disciplined appropriately.
translation: 任何避难所的居民被看到与所谓的反叛者有牵连的话，都会被拘留、询问并受到适度的惩罚。

original: Order WILL be restored. Discipline WILL be restored. Vault security personnel have been authorized to use deadly force if necessary.
translation: 秩序将会恢复，纪律将会重建。避难所的警卫人员已授权在必要情况下可以使用致命的武力。

original: Don't let it come to that. This vault will be one big, happy family again. One way or another.
translation: 不要走到那一步。避难所应该是一个快乐的大家庭，无论如何实现。

original: Any vault resident seen associating with the so-called "Rebels" will be detained, questioned, and disciplined appropriately.
translation: 任何避难所的居民被看到与所谓的反叛者有牵连的话，都会被拘留、询问并受到适度的惩罚。

original: Order WILL be restored. Discipline WILL be restored. Vault security personnel have been authorized to use deadly force if necessary.
translation: 秩序将会恢复，纪律将会重建。避难所的警卫人员已授权在必要情况下可以使用致命的武力。

original: Don't let it come to that. Haven't you always been happy? Haven't we always been a… a family?
translation: 不要走到那一步，你们不是一直都快乐吗？我们不是一直都是个大家庭吗？

original: Amata... Stop this madness. You're disrupting everyone's life, everyone's happiness. Come home. Just… come home.
translation: 阿玛塔…别疯了。你是在危害别人的生命和幸福啊。回家吧，快回家吧。

original: And everything can be the way it was.
If you don't activate the purifier right now, you're all going to die!
translation: 要是你不把净化器打开，你们全都得死！

original: Why haven't you started the purifier? Please, do it now!
translation: 为何你还不把净化器给打开呢？快！

original: You only have about a minute left! Please hurry!
translation: 你只有一分钟逃离的时间！赶快！

original: If you're still there, the purifier needs to be activated NOW! You don't have much time left!
translation: 你怎么还在那？净化器必须立刻激活！你的时间不多了！
这解决不了任何问题的！

original: You seem like a nice woman. Let me get that violin for you.
translation: 你是一个善良的老妇人，我去帮你把小提琴带回来吧。

original: Well, that's just so sweet of you!
I feel bad sending you off with nothing like this.
translation: 什么都不给你就让你上路，也不太好吧。

original: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
translation: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。

original: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
translation: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。

original: If only you had something to help keep me safe, my little honey bee...
translation: 如果你有能让我安全一点的办法，我亲爱的……

original: Oh my! I didn't know I still had the looks.
translation: 天啊！我不知道我容颜依旧。

original: Well, you just made my day you sweet thing! Let me give you something extra to help you on your way.
translation: 你让我这一天都很快乐！我再给你一些路上用得到的东西吧。

original: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
translation: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。

original: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
translation: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。

original: Ok, it's right over there. Middle room.
translation: 好的，就在那里。中间的房间。
对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

original: Right at the top of the stairs, honey. That's your room.
translation: 就在楼梯上面，亲爱的。那是你的房间。
对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

original: Right at the top of the stairs, honey. The room with the big bed.
translation: 就在楼梯上面，亲爱的。有大床的那间。
对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

original: Excellent. Simply venture into the hallway, turn left, first door on your left. That is your room.
translation: 太棒了。去走廊，左转，左手边的一间房间就是你的了。

original: Sounds like a fair price. I'll take it.
translation: 听起来价钱公道，我接受。

original: That sounds like a deal. Out in the hallway, turn left, first door on your left. That's your room.
translation: 这交易听起来不错，穿过走廊，左转，你左手边的一间房间就是你的了。
对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

original: Listen up you god-damn puke! You are now wearing prototype medic power armor. You take care of me, and I'll take care of you.
translation: 给我听好了，该死的家伙！你现在穿着的是原型医疗动力装甲。我们得互相照料。

original: Just give me the present already!
Okay, okay! One last question: who's your favorite barbarian? That's right, Grognak! Issue 14, and with no missing pages!
translation: 好的！最后一个问题：谁是你最爱的野蛮人？没错，就是歌南！第14册，没有一页残缺！

original: I found this in a box of my father's old things, can you believe it? Kind of weird to think about him reading comic books.
translation: 我找到了一箱父亲的旧东西，真是难以置信，里面居然有他看过的漫画书。

original: I guess I'd better let you get back to "mingling" with your guests. We'll talk later, okay? Happy birthday.
translation: 我想你得去和你的客人们谈天说地了，我们之后再谈！生日快乐！

original: Um... a date with Christine Kendall?
translation: 和克里斯廷·肯德尔约会？

original: Gross! I didn't think you even liked girls. And you know what I mean, before you say something rude about me.
translation: 天！我还以为你不喜欢女孩呢。你知道我什么意思，不许瞎说。

original: I guess maybe I should give this to someone else... someone who likes Grognak the Barbarian better than Mean Christine...
translation: 我不如把这个给其他人吧……那些喜欢《野蛮人歌南》、而不是小气的克里斯廷的人。

original: The question is, how could you tell the difference? Ha ha ha.
translation: 问题是你分得清差别吗？哈哈哈。

original: Ha! I knew I'd surprise you. Who's your favorite barbarian? That's right, Grognak! Issue 14, and with no missing pages!
translation: 好的！就知道你不知道。谁是你最爱的野蛮人？没错，就是歌南！第14册，没有一页残缺！

original: I found this in a box of my father's old things, believe it or not. Imagine him reading comic books. I guess everybody was ten once.
translation: 我找到了一箱父亲的旧东西，真是难以置信，原来他也看过漫画书。我想每个人都有十岁的时候吧。

original: Well, I'd better let you get back to "mingling" with your guests. We'll talk later, okay? Happy birthday.
translation: 我想你得去和你的客人们谈天说地了，我们之后再谈！生日快乐！

original: Sure, most people don't give a thought to their Pip-Boy as long as it keeps working.
translation: 当然，许多人对自己的哔哔小子的态度是，只要不坏，就不管它。

original: Well, anyway, I got you this for your birthday. It isn't much and you probably already have one, but there you go. Happy birthday.
translation: 我把它作为你的生日礼物，它不是很贵重而且可能你已经有了，但还是要给你，再说一句生日快乐。

original: Sure, whatever. Did you bring me anything for my birthday?
translation: 行，你给我带什么生日礼物来了吗？

original: Here am I going on about your Pip-Boy and I clean forgot about your present!
translation: 瞧我光顾聊哔哔小子了，差点忘了给你的礼物！

original: Here you go. Happy birthday! It's not much, but I hope you like it.
translation: 给你吧。生日快乐！虽然不是很值钱的礼物，但还是希望你能喜欢。

original: Oh yes, I almost forgot. Happy birthday! It's not much, but I hope you like it.
translation: 我差点忘了，祝你生日快乐！虽然不是很值钱的礼物，但还是希望你能喜欢。

original: A poem? You've got to be kidding me.
translation: 一首诗？你一定是在开玩笑吧。

original: No, really, I wrote it just for you!
translation: 不开玩笑，我真的是写了一首诗给你！

original: I never just copy one of my old poems... well, there was that one Founder's Day where I couldn't rhyme anything with Overseer...
translation: 我从来不照搬以前写的诗……不过有一次“创立日”的时候，我歌颂监督者时就找不到押韵的词，只好……

original: But you deserve nothing less than a brand new poem. You can keep it in your Pip-Boy and read it whenever you want!
translation: 但是写给你的必须是一首崭新的诗，你可以把它存到哔哔小子里面，想看随时可以看！

original: Um... thanks. I guess. Did you get me anything else?
translation: 呃……谢了。我说，你还有其它什么东西给我吗？

original: Don't be silly! One poem per birthday, that's my rule! Ha ha. If I gave you two, think how jealous Butch would be, ha ha.
translation: 别傻了！每个生日只能获得一首诗，这是规矩！要是我给你两首的话，布奇可是会吃醋的哦！

original: Thank you. I will treasure it always. Is that all?
translation: 谢谢你，我会一直珍藏着的。没别的了吧？

original: Of course! Run along now, dearie, and have yourself a wonderful birthday!
translation: 当然！去玩吧，小亲亲，祝你生日开心！

original: Come around to where I can see ya.
translation: 站到我能看到你的地方来。
跟我说说什么是自动点唱机。

original: If you feel like filling your place with a whole bunch of music, switch this beautiful Pre-War antique on.
translation: 只要你把这战前古董的开关打开，就能让房子立刻充满着美妙的音乐。

original: Okay, let me take a look at your stuff.
I'm going to find a non-violent solution to your Ghoul problem.
translation: 我想找一个和平的方法来解决尸鬼的问题。

original: That's a laugh. Roy Phillips can't be reasoned with. Trust me. But go ahead and try to talk some sense into him. It's your funeral.
translation: 这太可笑了，罗伊·菲利普斯完全不可理喻。请相信我，要是你非要去找他讲道理的话是必死无疑的。

original: They've holed up in the nearby metro tunnels. They're living with packs of Feral Ghouls. They've barred the main entrance. Go through the train yard.
translation: 他们就住在附近的地铁隧道里。他们和凶悍僵尸生活在一起，而且还把紧急出口给堵住了，所以你要经过一段铁轨才能进入。

original: Good luck, kid. You're gonna need it.
translation: 祝你好运，你会用得上这东西的。

original: That's a laugh. Roy Phillips can't be reasoned with. Trust me. But go ahead and try to talk some sense into him. It's your funeral.
translation: 这太可笑了，罗伊·菲利普斯完全不可理喻。请相信我，要是你非要去找他讲道理的话是必死无疑的。

original: Good luck, kid. You're gonna need it.
translation: 祝你好运，你会用得上这东西的。

original: You serious? You don't know what a Ghoul is?
translation: 你是认真的吗？你知道什么是僵尸吗？

original: A goddamn disaster waiting to happen that's what they are.
translation: 他们就是随时可能惹事的麻烦玩意。

original: Sure, maybe you can get over the fact they look like someone took a cheese grater to their face. But it's what you don't see that's the problem.
translation: 当然，你看得到的是他们在脸上涂的一层奶酪，你看不到的是他们所制造的麻烦。

original: The radiation slowly eats away their brain, then they go zombie on you. It's better for everyone to kill them before all that, if you ask me.
translation: 辐射缓慢地侵蚀着他们的大脑，之后把他们变成了活死尸。要是我说的话，最好还是把他们统统杀掉最好。

original: What the hell's a Ghoul anyway? Some kind of diseased human?
translation: 那该死的僵尸到底是什么？生病的人类吗？
