original: Do you think your leaders will keep you safe if the bombs fall? You will die while the Wall Street gang and their hangers-on live like kings in...
translation: 当核弹爆炸时，你以为领导人会管你的死活吗？当华尔街那群滚蛋和他们的傀儡们花天酒地时，你默默地死去了……

original: Your boys are dying on the Alaska front, and all for nothing. Bring them home, before it is too late.
translation: 你们的孩子正在阿拉斯加无谓地丧生。趁为时未晚，快让他们回家吧。
跟我说说什么是自动点唱机。

original: If you feel like filling your place with a whole bunch of music, switch this beautiful Pre-War antique on.
translation: 只要你把这战前古董的开关打开，就能让房子立刻充满着美妙的音乐。

original: Okay, let me take a look at your stuff.
Jack says you have some pie for me?
Oh, of course. Here you are! Enjoy!
Sure, Jack. No problem at all. I saw nothing.
translation: 杰克，放心吧。一切正常，我什么都没看见。

original: Well, that's good to hear, friend! Very good to hear, indeed.
translation: 朋友，听到你这么说，我实在太高兴！

original: You wouldn't believe how judgmental some people can be. Honestly. All I'm trying to do is keep my family happy and fed.
translation: 有些人的偏执到了让你无法想象的程度。实话说，我只是在努力维持家人的欢乐与温饱。

original: Tell you what, talk to Linda. She'll give you some of her special meat pie. It's to die for! Ha! Hahaha... but not you. You're good people.
translation: 我跟你讲，你去跟琳达去谈谈。她会给你一些特制的肉派。值得为它而死！哈哈哈哈哈哈哈…开玩笑了，你不会的。你是个好人。
你想怎么做就怎么做吧。

original: No, not really. Everyone does what they have to.
translation: 不，并不是这样，每人都有自己该做的事。

original: Well, that's good to hear, friend! Very good to hear, indeed.
translation: 朋友，听到你这么说，我实在太高兴！

original: You wouldn't believe how judgmental some people can be. Honestly. All I'm trying to do is keep my family happy and fed.
translation: 有些人的偏执到了让你无法想象的程度。实话说，我只是在努力维持家人的欢乐与温饱。

original: Tell you what, talk to Linda. She'll give you some of her special meat pie. It's to die for! Ha! Hahaha... but not you. You're good people.
translation: 我跟你讲，你去跟琳达去谈谈。她会给你一些特制的肉派。值得为它而死！哈哈哈哈哈哈哈…开玩笑了，你不会的。你是个好人。

original: You know the drill, people. Stay back until the field is down.
translation: 你们也知道。在这解决前离远一点。

original: Hold positions. Let the robot do its job.
translation: 保持距离，让机器人先来。

original: All right, this is it. Go, go, go!
Player agrees to find Stealth Boy stockpile.
translation: 玩家同意找到隐身小子存货。

original: Yes, Antler says we leave here as soon as we get Stealth Boys.
translation: 是的，鹿角说我们一旦得到隐身小子就马上离开这里。

original: Let me give you key. Antler had me lock the door. The Ghoul inside not expecting a human. Maybe he don't shoot you. Maybe he will.
translation: 给你钥匙。鹿角让我锁的门。里面的尸鬼肯定想不到会有人类进来。可能他会向你开枪，也可能不会。

original: I'll find the StealthBoy stockpile for you if your kin will leave this place.
translation: 我会找到那堆隐身小子的，但你要让你的族人离开这里。

original: Yes, Antler says we leave here as soon as we get Stealth Boys.
translation: 是的，鹿角说我们一旦得到隐身小子就马上离开这里。

original: Let me give you key. Antler had me lock the door. The Ghoul inside not expecting a human. Maybe he don't shoot you. Maybe he will.
translation: 给你钥匙。鹿角让我锁的门。里面的尸鬼肯定想不到会有人类进来。可能他会向你开枪，也可能不会。

original: I can find the stockpile of Stealth Boys for you.
translation: 我能帮你找到存放的隐身小子。

original: Player asks why Harland's room can't be searched.
translation: 玩家询问为何不能搜索哈兰德的房间。

original: A Ghoul. But not squishy like others. This Ghoul is tough.
translation: 里头有个尸鬼，但不像其他尸鬼那么弱。这个尸鬼很厉害。

original: I thought Antler said send my kin into that room, but three died. Ghoul is a crack shot and set traps too.
translation: 我以为鹿角要让我派族人进入那个房间，但却死了三个。那尸鬼是个神枪手，还布置了陷阱。

original: After, I realize I heard Antler wrong. So I lock the door to keep kin out and wait for Antler to tell me what to do.
translation: 之后，我才意识到我把鹿角的话听岔了。于是我锁上了那个房间，不让族人进去，再等待鹿角的进一步指示。

original: Then you come along. Antler says you are solution.
translation: 然后你来了。鹿角说了，你能解决问题。

original: Why can't you search the last room?
translation: 你为什么不搜查最后的房间？

original: Pay attention when I speak! I said Ghoul is a crack shot and sets traps!
translation: 我说话的时候你要注意听！我说了，那个尸鬼是神枪手，还布了陷阱！

original: Too dangerous for us. Okay for you.
translation: 对我们来说太危险了。不过你能搞得定。

original: Tell me again why you can't search the room?
translation: 再说一遍，为什么你不去搜查最后那个房间？

original: Told you already. Antler wants Nightkin to have all the Stealth Boys in the bad room. With the Ghoul.
translation: 已经告诉过你了。鹿角想让夜行族得到所有的隐身小子。就在那间有尸鬼的房间里。

original: What do you want me to do?
Player says why he or she is here.
translation: 玩家说他或她为何来此。

original: A human who is friend to Ghouls? Suspicious.
translation: 人类会是尸鬼的朋友？可疑。

original: You mean the ones upstairs. Antler used intercom, told them stay put. But they want to come down in basement anyways?
translation: 你指的是楼上的那些家伙。鹿角已经用对讲机授意，要他们留在原地。但是他们无论如何都想到地下室去吗？

original: I cannot allow. My kin are... not right in head like I am. They attack you on sight. Ghouls too. They crazy.
translation: 我不允许。我的手下...不像我一样还头脑正常。他们一看见你就会攻击。尸鬼们也一样。他们都疯了。

original: Your Ghoul friends have to wait until you find what Antler brought us to get.
translation: 你的尸鬼朋友必须等着，直到你找到鹿角要我们找的东西。

original: I came here on behalf of the Ghouls upstairs.
translation: 我代表楼上的尸鬼来这儿与你们谈判。

original: A neutron walks into a bar. "How much for a drink here, anyway?" To which the bartender responds, "For you, no charge."
translation: 一个中子走进了一家酒吧，对老板说：“我想要一杯电解水，多少钱？”老板惊讶地问，“哦，原来你也要充电啊？”

original: He needs to talk to someone from the outside, to get some perspective.
translation: 他得和外面的人说说话，了解些外面的事。

original: I'd never thought of it that way. I suppose he should get a chance to talk to someone like you.
translation: 我从没想到这点，我想他应该和你这样的人谈谈。

original: Here's the password to his isolation area. Just please don't mention my name to Vance about this.
translation: 这是去他那区域的密码。不要把这事告诉万斯啊。

original: You're secure in these tunnels. Why try to get into Tenpenny, anyway?
translation: 你在隧道里明明很安全，为何要跑到特佩尼来？

original: Ghouls aren't built for luxury and comfort, is that it? You think Ghouls belong scurrying around in the dark dank underbelly of the Wasteland?
translation: 你认为僵尸都不应享受舒适豪华生活吗？你认为他们就该在阴暗潮湿的地下生活居住吗？ ?

original: You got a lot of nerve.
I've met them. Roy Phillips and those other Ghouls don't seem all that bad.
translation: 我见过他们了。罗伊·菲利普斯那几只尸鬼似乎没有那么糟糕。

original: Look kid. I don't care what you think about them. Unless Tenpenny says otherwise. They aren't allowed in here. End of story. Quit wasting my time.
translation: 我不在乎你对他们的看法是怎样的。除非特佩尼能改变他的想法，否则他们是不可能进来的，就说这么多。

original: I'm here to see Roy Phillips.
translation: 我是来这见罗伊·菲利普斯的。

original: Oh yeah? Is he expecting you? Well then, run along. It's not wise to keep Roy waiting. Has a bit of a temper that one. You watch yourself.
translation: 是吗？你和他有约吗？那么，进来吧。让罗伊等着可不好。他脾气不小，你自己多加小心。

original: I need you to repair my stuff.
translation: 我要你来帮我修修东西。

original: Let's have a look at it.
I'll see what I can do.
Lay into me! I deserve it!
Uh oh! I did something bad!
-The Lobotomite is no proof against our amazing sensors!-
translation: -在我们惊人的传感器下，无脑人无所遁形。-

original: *{DUPE: Sarcastic}Remember that time I suggested we get bodyguards? Yeah, that woulda been nice, huh?*
translation: *{DUPE: Sarcastic}记得那次我说我们需要保镖么？对，那应该很不错，哼？*

original: THINK TANK, FORM OF - TACTIC TRIANGLE!
We'll see what you stand for.
translation: 让我们看看你为谁而战。

original: I want to get some licks in, too!
Yeah, let's show them how Kings rumble.
translation: 没错，让他们瞧瞧猫王帮是怎么干架的。

original: In the name of Dr. Mobius!
translation: 以莫比乌斯博士的名义！
我的仆从们，消灭侵略者！
干掉他们！把他们全干掉！

original: To the Bone Orchard you go!
Been years since I did this.
translation: 已经好几年没活动筋骨了。

original: {concerned}Fighting's not my strong suit, but I'll see what I can do.
translation: {concerned}打仗虽然不是我的强项，但我还是尽力而为。

original: Sure, boss. You lead the charge, I'll follow as fast as my arthritic, rotting knees can carry me.
translation: 好的，老大。你带头，我就算废了这条老腿，也心甘情愿，万死不辞。

original: You want to send an elderly, half-decrepit Ghoul into combat? Your tactical brilliance is unmatched, boss.
translation: 您想派我这个半死不活的老尸鬼去打架？您可真是神机妙算哪，老大。

original: Don't worry, pumpkin, {gramma}grandma's here to help!
translation: 别怕，小南瓜，{gramma}奶奶就是来帮你的！

original: Leo! Try not to chop our friends this time!
translation: 利奥！这次千万别再砍我们的朋友了！

original: You're no match for the power of Mobius!
translation: 莫比乌斯的力量势不可挡！

original: Feel the wrath of the science of X-42!
{starting combat}{"Time to fight!"}{mo-MAY-we day LOO-choo}Momewi de luchoo!
translation: {starting combat}{"Time to fight!"}{mo-MAY-we day LOO-choo}战斗的时后到叻！

original: {starting combat}{"We fight now!"}{mays LOO-choo ah-OR-la}Mes luchoo ahorla!
translation: {starting combat}{"We fight now!"}{mays LOO-choo ah-OR-la}窝们现在战斗吧！

original: {starting combat}{"I will defeat you!"}{may duh-ROW-tay KAH-tu}Me derote katu!
translation: {starting combat}{"I will defeat you!"}{may duh-ROW-tay KAH-tu}窝要打拜尼！

original: Yea though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death.
translation: 是啊，虽然我穿过笼罩死亡阴影的山谷。

original: You dare to cross Dr. Mobius!
translation: 你胆敢和莫比乌斯博士作对！

original: I will reduce you to atoms! {Correcting, quieter}I mean, a more chaotic, painful array of atoms.
translation: 我要把你粉碎成原子！{Correcting, quieter}一堆混乱、痛苦的原子！
开始解剖，以及活体解剖。
{Eager snarl, on the hunt}啊呜呜呜呜呜呜啊啊啊。

original: {Eager, pleased, draw this out}Time to feed.
translation: {Eager, pleased, draw this out}该吃东西了。

original: {Irritated}Just wanted a little peace and quiet.
{Under his breath}Time to make some music.

translation: [克莉丝汀眯起眼睛，换了个姿势。]

original: Here. Take back the money. I don't want to take medicine away from the town.
translation: 把你的钱收回去。我可不会带药出城。

original: I'll think about it, but I can't rescue your friends now.
translation: 我会考虑的，但我此刻无法帮你救出你同伴。

original: Oh. Well... If you change your mind... we'd be awfully grateful. Those are our friends...
translation: 哦……如果你能改变主意……我们会非常感激。那是我们的朋友。

original: What do you have for sale?
Fresh out of the hands of some mark. Take a look!
translation: 我从佣兵那儿进来的一批新货，来看看！

original: Fresh out of the hands of some mark. Take a look!
translation: 我从佣兵那儿进来的一批新货，来看看！

original: My boy is very sick and needs medical assistance, please help us if you can! We are listening for your response on 3,950 kHz.
translation: 我的孩子病得很重，须要医疗的援助，如果你能帮忙请伸出援手！我们在3950赫兹等候回应。

original: My family and I have taken refuge in a drainage chamber not to far from a radio relay tower outside of D.C.
translation: 我和家人在特区无线电转播台旁的一个排水通道里避难。

original: Hey, Doc. Will this Fire Ant Nectar do you any good?
translation: 博士，火蚁露有什么用吗？

original: I would be more than happy to take that off your hands if you'd like.
translation: 我会非常乐意得到那玩意。

original: If you can gather more for me, I would certainly love to have them. I'm certain Marigold's tunnels are rife with the original brood.
translation: 要是你能再弄些来的话，我会很乐意都收下的。我知道马利哥德的隧道里有非常多的原种蚂蚁。

original: Visitor, sir. He wanted to see you, and... well, there's not much I could do to stop him.
translation: 是个来访者，先生，他想要见见你，而且我也阻止不了他。

original: Visitor, sir. She wanted to see you, and... well, there's not much I could do to stop her.
translation: 是个来访者，先生，她想要见见你，而且我也阻止不了她。

original: Amata's up there, in the clinic with the rest of them. I'd take you closer, but they don't get along with security. Good luck.
translation: 阿玛塔就在上面，和其余的人待在诊所里。我本想带你过去的，但他们很抵触警卫。祝你好运。

original: Hey, sweetie. What can you tell me about Moriarty's terminal? I need in...
translation: 你能跟我说说莫里亚蒂的终端吗？我需要进入……

original: Mmmmm. I bet you want in. But enough about us.
translation: 我知道你想进入。不过是你也无妨。

original: Here's the password. Just make sure he isn't around when you use it.
translation: 这是密码，你输入的时候要确保他没在旁边。

original: Look, sweetie. I'd love to spend time with you, but I need to find my Dad.
translation: 听着，甜心，我喜欢陪着你，可我得去找我父亲。

original: Mmmm. I'd love to spend time with you too.
Look, I... can help you. Get into the back office of this place. Moriarty keeps a terminal there. Everything you want is inside the terminal.
translation: 嗯…我…可以帮你，去到这里后面的办公室里。莫里亚蒂在那有个系统终端机，里面会有你想知道的一切。

original: Here's the password to it. Too bad you're so young, kid. I could teach you some stuff you'd never forget...
translation: 这是进入系统的密码，你嫩得让我心疼，不然我可以教你一些终身难忘的东西……

original: Look, if you can give me more information or point me in the right direction...
translation: 听着，要是你可以再给点信息或者给我个方向……

original: Yeah, I'll help you, then Moriarty kicks my sweet ass out the door.
translation: 没错，我可以帮你，莫里亚蒂也可以帮我滚蛋。

original: Sorry, kid. If you want to know more, Moriarty is the only one who's going to help you.
translation: 不好意思，小朋友，要是你还想再知道些什么，只能去找莫里亚蒂。

original: Talk to Gob. He hates Moriarty more than I do. Maybe he'll tell you something, but I doubt it.
translation: 去和盖博谈谈，他比我更讨厌莫里亚蒂，或许他会跟你说点什么，不过我可不保证。

original: Enough with the tough chick routine. Tell me more!
Ohhh. You like it rough, huh? Well, that costs extra.
translation: 想简单粗暴地套出消息，那得要额外的钱了。

original: Beat it, kid. Go look for Daddy somewhere else.
translation: 闪远，小鬼。要找你爸爸去别处。

original: I talked to Moriarty already, and he's trying to charge me for the info.
translation: 我和莫里亚蒂谈过了，但是他的消息得付钱。

original: Ha ha. Yeah, that's Colin's style all right. He sells information so much, you'd think the bar was just a hobby.
translation: 哈哈，那就是科林的风格了，他主业是倒卖消息，酒吧不过是他的业余爱好罢了。

original: Help me get into that terminal, Nova. Finding my Dad means everything to me.
translation: 诺瓦，帮我进入电脑系统终端。找到父亲对我来说意味着一切。

original: Well, all right. You seem like a good kid. It isn't your fault Moriarty is such an asshole.
translation: 好吧，你看上去是个好孩子，莫里亚蒂那混蛋，这不是你的错。

original: Here's the password. Just don't mention to anyone that I gave it to you or I might be out on my ass like Silver.
translation: 这是密码，不要和任何人说，不然我会像席尔瓦一样滚蛋的。

original: I really need to get into that terminal.
Oh, Mister Moriarty never lets me back there.
translation: 哦，莫里亚蒂再也不准我回那里了。

original: If you need to get into the terminal, you should talk to Nova. She'll help you... but it may be expensive if you catch my meaning.
translation: 要是你想进入终端的话就应该去问问诺瓦。她会帮你的……不过代价可能很昂贵，如果你明白我什么意思的话。

original: What's all this about Galaxy News Radio?
translation: 银河新闻电台是个什么样的电台？

original: Galaxy News Radio is some loudmouth radio station located in the ruins of D.C.
translation: 银河新闻电台是特区废墟上的一个八卦电台。

original: Three Dog, the king of that looney bin, keeps yapping about fighting some Good Fight or something. A bunch of crap.
translation: 三狗，就是个废话大王，总是在那胡扯什么圣战。那都是在胡说八道。

original: But I suppose if you wanted to know what was going on in the Wasteland, that's the place to go. Me, I could care less.
translation: 要是你想知道废土上的什么事情的话，最好去那问问，我没那闲工夫。

original: Mister Moriarty says we can keep it on. It's a good radio station.
translation: 莫里亚蒂先生说我们可以听一下这个电台，它还不错。

original: I like hearing the DJ, Three Dog and how he's helping to fight the Good Fight.
translation: 我喜欢听那个主播三狗，还有他怎么协助圣战的故事。

original: Sigh. If only I was a part of that instead of being stuck in this dive...
translation: 唉，要是我是那传说中的人物而不是被困在这该多好啊……

original: Thank you, father. I'll do my best to keep us all safe, inside the Vault and beyond.
translation: 谢谢，父亲。不管是不是在避难所里，我都会尽最大努力来保护我们的安全的。

original: Amata, I appoint you Overseer in my place. You've proven you have what it takes to make hard choices for the good of the Vault.
translation: 阿玛塔，我任命你代替我做监督者。你已经证明了你能站在避难所的角度做出艰难抉择。

original: That is why I cannot remain your Overseer.
translation: 所以，我不再适合担任大家的监督者了。

original: I know I have made these mistakes. And I would make them again if I had to do so.
translation: 我知道我犯了不少错误。而且如果有机会，我也许还会接着犯错。

original: Lives have been lost, but perhaps worse than that, lives have been stopped. And in my attempts to keep you safe, I have kept you from growing up.
translation: 我们付出了生命的代价，或许更糟糕的是，生命已经终止。我试图保证你们的安全，却阻止了你们的成长。

original: In my attempts to keep us all safe, I have been, perhaps, overzealous.
translation: 我一直在试图保护我们大家的安全，或许有些太过热心了吧。

original: Amata... Everyone... Listen closely. After a discussion with your friend, I've made an important decision.
translation: 阿玛塔…各位…请仔细听好。在和你们的朋友讨论后，我做出一个重要决定。

original: I tried to rescue your friends but there were... complications.
translation: 我试图救你的朋友，但那……情况复杂。

original: You mean they're dead, don't you? Well, I guess you tried. That's more than we could have asked.
translation: 你的意思是他们都死了？我想你已尽力了，那已超乎我们所求了。

original: On behalf of Big Town, take this. It's not much, but at least it's a token of our appreciation.
translation: 我代表大镇，给你。这些东西虽然不是很多，但也代表着大镇对你的感激之情。

original: It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
translation: 反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。

original: Well, I guess you tried. That's more than we could have asked.
translation: 我想你尽力了。已经已超乎我们所求。

original: On behalf of Big Town, take this. It's not much, but at least it's a token of our appreciation.
translation: 我代表大镇，给你.这些东西虽然不是很多，但也代表着大镇对你的感激之情。

original: It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
translation: 反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。

original: That's what I was afraid of. Well, at least you tried.
translation: 那正是我所担心的。好了，至少你尽力了。

original: Here, take this. It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
translation: 给，拿着。反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。

original: I rescued Shorty. Red didn't make it.
translation: 我救了“矮子”，没救到瑞德。

original: That's what I was afraid of. Well, at least you tried.
translation: 那正是我所担心的。好了，至少你尽力了。

original: Here, take this. It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
translation: 给，拿着。反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。

original: Your friends are dead. Deal with it.
Okay, but only one serving. We've got too many mouths to feed already.
translation: 好吧，但只能接纳一个。我们已经有太多人要养活了。

original: I have the Declaration of Independence.
Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
translation: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！

original: You have earned your place in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
translation: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！

original: I understand the road was difficult, so allow me to present you with an extra bonus to perhaps whet your appetite for future endeavors.
translation: 我知道世道艰难，所以请收下这额外的报酬，或许能激励你未来能更加努力。

original: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
translation: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。

original: No, you keep it. You may need it more than I do.
translation: 不，你拿着。你可能会比我更需要它。

original: Well... okay. I guess it may come in handy if I run into any Radroaches.
translation: 嗯……好吧。我想在遇到辐射蟑螂时，它会派上用场的。

original: All right. I'll try to meet you at the exit. Watch out for security. Good luck!
translation: 好吧。我会在出口处和你碰面。小心警卫。祝你好运！

original: Affirmative. Offloading command protocols and beginning shutdown sequence.
translation: 确定。卸载命令协定并开始关机程序。

original: I can currently be ordered to shut down, resume my previous programming state, or resume my original functions.
translation: 可以命令我：关闭、恢复上次状态、以及恢复初始功能。

original: What's this mutually beneficial offer you mentioned?
translation: 你说的互利提议是什么意思？

original: I got this Mesmetron thing. It's some kind of stun gun. I'd like you to test it out for me. Should make getting slaves easier.
translation: 我得到了这把催眠枪。它是种电击枪。我想让你帮我测试下它，用它来抓奴隶应该会更容易的。

original: You take this Mezzer. Shoot it at some poor schmuck. While he's in la-la-land, you slip one of these collars over his head.
translation: 你拿着这把催眠枪，去射击那些可怜的笨蛋。当他躺在地…地…地上时，你就用一个项圈套住他的脑袋。

original: Be careful with that collar. It'll explode if you tinker with it. Tell the slave to boot it over here pronto, or his head'll pop.
translation: 小心那些项圈。如果你乱弄它们的话，是会爆炸的。告诉那些奴隶快点过来，否则他们的头就会“砰”地被炸掉。

original: Here's a list of special targets Eulogy wants enslaved. But feel free to put a collar on anyone you can. I'll pay you for each slave that arrives.
translation: 这有一份尤勒基想要的奴隶的特别目标名单。但你可以随便地把项圈套在任何人头上。每抓到一个奴隶我就会付你一些钱。

original: Here's your 500 caps. I can go in now, right?
translation: 这是给你的500个瓶盖。我现在能进去了，对吧？

original: Thank you. Pleasure doing business with you. Enjoy your visit to Paradise Falls.
translation: 谢谢你。很高兴和你做生意。祝你参观堕落天堂愉快。

original: Friendly warning - don't act like a jackass. You won't get a second chance.
translation: 善意的警告 — 别像个白痴一样。你一丝机会都没有。

original: All right. It's time for me to go.
Good. All this chit-chat is giving me a headache.
translation: 很好。这些闲聊真让我感到头痛。

original: One more thing. I got this Mesmetron thing. It's some kind of stun gun. I want you to test it out for me. A little research project.
translation: 还有一件事。我得到了这把催眠枪。它是种电击枪。我想让你帮我测试下它。作为一个小研究项目。

original: You take this Mezzer. Shoot it at some poor schmuck. While he's in la-la-land, you slip one of these collars over his head.
translation: 你拿着这把催眠枪，去射击那些可怜的笨蛋。当他躺在地…地…地上时，你就用一个项圈套住他的脑袋。

original: Be careful with that collar. It'll explode if you tinker with it. Tell the slave to boot it over here pronto, or his head'll pop.
translation: 小心那些项圈。如果你乱弄它们的话，是会爆炸的。告诉那些奴隶快点过来，否则他们的头就会“砰”地被炸掉。

original: You got all that? I hate repeating myself.
translation: 你都明白了？我不想再重复我的话。

original: That Mesmetron came with some kind of manual. I don't have time for that bullshit, so you better know how to read.
translation: 那催眠枪附带某种手册。我没时间废话了，所以你最好学会如何阅读。

original: I'm glad you asked! I got this Mesmetron thing. It's some kind of stun gun. I want you to test it out for me. A little research project.
translation: 很高兴你问到！我得到催眠枪这东西。它是一种能使人晕倒的枪。我想让你来为我测试它。作为一个小的研究项目。

original: You take this Mezzer. Shoot it at some poor schmuck. While he's in la-la-land, you slip one of these collars over his head.
translation: 你拿着这把催眠枪，去射击那些可怜的笨蛋。当他躺在地…地…地上时，你就用一个项圈套住他的脑袋。

original: Be careful with that collar. It'll explode if you tinker with it. Tell the slave to boot it over here pronto, or his head'll pop.
translation: 小心那些项圈。如果你乱弄它们的话，是会爆炸的。告诉那些奴隶快点过来，否则他们的头就会“砰”地被炸掉。

original: You got all that? I hate repeating myself.
translation: 你都明白了？我不想再重复我的话。

original: That Mesmetron came with some kind of manual. I don't have time for that bullshit, so you better know how to read.
translation: 那催眠枪附带某种手册。我没时间废话了，所以你最好学会如何阅读。

original: I'll round up some slaves for you. But what's the catch?
translation: 我会帮你抓一些奴隶来的。不过怎么抓？

original: Hmm. Maybe I could use someone like you. Think you can round up some assets for Eulogy Jones? Might get you into Paradise.
translation: 嗯。或许我能用上你这样的人。你能帮尤勒基·琼斯搞到些东西吗？或许你能因此而进入堕落天堂。

original: You looking for a fight, asshole? Just say the word.
translation: 你在找打吗，白痴？只要说一声。

original: What I "need" is for you to piss off. Eulogy Jones doesn't have time for putting up with morons and assholes like you. That's my job.
translation: 我“需要”你做的就是滚蛋。尤勒基·琼斯不想在你这种白痴身上浪费时间。那是我的工作。

original: But even I got limits, and all your yapping is giving me a migraine. Give me some reason I shouldn't just end you, right here and now.
translation: 但即使我到了极限，而且你的叫嚷令我头疼。我也会给你个机会,现在给我个不干掉你的理由！

original: Maybe there's something you need, huh? I help you, you let me in. Deal?
translation: 也许我这里有些你需要的东西，呃？我帮助你，你让我进去。成吗？

original: My "problem" is I got a goddamn job to do. And that's keeping assholes and morons from bothering Eulogy Jones and his enterprise.
translation: 我的“问题”是我有该死的工作要做。那就是阻止白痴和笨蛋烦扰尤勒基·琼斯和他的生意。

original: And I'm not sure which you are. I'm thinking moron, 'cause a smart chick would have pissed off by now.
translation: 而且我不确定你是哪种类型。我想你是个笨蛋，因为聪明妞早就已经滚开了。

original: You want to give me a reason I don't end you right this second? All your yapping is giving me a headache!
translation: 你要给我个不干掉你的理由吗？你的嚷嚷声真让我头痛！

original: I'm done screwin' around. Let me in!
Tell me about the rocket factory.
translation: 跟我说说火箭工厂的事。

original: Oh, that? It's just a bit west of Novac, up in the mountains. Lots of broken equipment and such. Place is deserted. Or used to be, I guess.
translation: 哦，那个啊？就在诺瓦克往西一点的山上。那里有各种乱七八糟坏掉的设备。反正我记得那儿是荒无人烟的，或者曾经是。

original: Lately there's been talk of Ghouls up that way, but I can't rightly say whether it's so or not. If you want to know more, ask old No-bark.
translation: 近来有传言说那里有尸鬼出没，但是具体我也不清楚。你要想知道更详细的情况，就问老疯嘴去。

original: I'd like to see what you've got for sale.
translation: 我想看看你这儿都卖什么。

original: And they've been shooting them down like animals, haven't they?
translation: 所以他们就像牲畜一样被打死了，对吗？

original: Those Ghouls were members of my flock, even after the madness consumed their minds. We never let them wander free.
translation: 这些尸鬼曾经是我的徒众，即便疯狂已经吞噬了他们的意识。我们通常是不会让他们随便走动的。

original: We kept them safe on the first floor. We kept them contained. The demons must have let them out, somehow...
translation: 我们始终把他们关在一楼，一直收容着他们。一定是魔鬼把他们放出来的…

original: And now they are lost forever, denied the salvation and healing glow of the Far Beyond...
translation: 可惜现在，我们永远失去了他们，他们再也没有机会接受遥远彼岸的救赎和治愈了……

original: Please, wanderer, bear in mind that every Feral Ghoul you spare now is one that we can save later.
translation: 拜托你，流浪者，请你记住，每当你放过一个尸鬼，我们就可以多拯救一个人。

original: Once the way is clear, our feral brothers and sisters will accompany us on the Great Journey. If there are any left...
translation: 一旦万事俱备，这些狂暴的兄弟姐妹就可以和我们一起踏上伟大旅程。只是不知那时他们还有多少能活着……

original: I'm here because Feral Ghouls have been wandering into Novac.
translation: 我来这里，是因为有一些狂尸鬼跑到了诺瓦克。

original: That price is an insult. You'll have to do better than that.
translation: 你给的价也太低了，必须再提高点。

original: You have me over a barrel. I'll pay your price and have this burned immediately.
translation: 你抓到我的把柄了。我会给你钱,但是你拿钱后必须立即烧掉它。

original: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
translation: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

original: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
translation: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

original: It's an outrageous price, but I'll pay it. Then we'll burn it right away.
translation: 这是个离谱的价格，不过我仍会支付,但我得看着你烧掉它。

original: Some day your greed will be your downfall. But today I'll pay your price.
translation: 有一天你的贪婪会成为你身败名裂的原因。但今天我仍会付给你钱。

original: We'll find a place to display this where everyone can read it.
translation: 我们会把它贴在一个大家都能看到的地方。

original: You can do better than that. This is the Gettysburg Address we're talking about.
translation: 你最好买得起，我们说的可是盖茨堡演讲。

original: I suppose you're right. You've got a deal. I'll get someone to burn this.
translation: 我想你说得对。就这么说定了。我让别人来烧掉它。

original: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
translation: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

original: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
translation: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

original: You're right, damn it. I'll pay you a bonus this time.
translation: 你说得对，该死。这次我会给你奖励的。

original: I'll make sure this is destroyed right away.
translation: 我要确保它立刻就会被销毁。

original: Deal. We'll find a good place to display this.
translation: 成交，我们会找个好地方来展示。

original: Well, I shoot my BB Gun any chance I get. I can fix that thing blindfolded, too.
translation: 嗯，我一有机会就会使用我的BB枪。我闭着眼睛都能修理它。

original: I'm sure I didn't just hear you admit to owning an unauthorized weapon. Let's just get this filled out... there. All set.
translation: 我敢肯定我刚才没听到你承认拥有非法武器。让我们把这些…选上。做好了。

original: If anyone asks, you took the G.O.A.T. during detention yesterday, okay?
translation: 假如有人问起，就说是在昨天留堂时参加的G.O.A.T.，好吗？

original: I just know what I've heard. There's supposed to be some Ghouls that went in a while back.
translation: 我也只是略知一二。好像不久前有一伙尸鬼进到里面去了。

original: Every so often there'll be a commotion from that direction - explosions and such.
translation: 之后时不时就会从那个方向传来骚动——爆炸之类的。

original: A most generous offer. God bless you.
translation: 真是慷慨的捐赠。上帝保佑你。

original: I have 50 caps I can donate.
A kind offering. God bless you.
translation: 慷慨的捐赠。上帝保佑你。

original: Every cap is needed. God bless you.
translation: 只要是钱都可以。上帝保佑你。

original: Private, there's a security emergency on the flight deck! <Lie>
translation: 士兵，飞行甲板上有紧急情况！<撒谎>

original: Zimmer. By the time you get this message, I'll already be gone. I'm escaping the Commonwealth.
translation: 齐默。当你收到这条讯息时，我已经逃离了联邦。

original: I want to live my own life, on my own terms, as my own man.
translation: 我想过我自己的生活，按自己的想法，做个我自己想做的人。

original: I know what you're thinking, that I'm malfunctioning. I used to think that's what caused the runaways, too. But, I know better, now.
translation: 我知道你在想什么，认为我有机械故障了。我也曾认为这是造成我想要出走的原因。但现在，我了解得更透彻了。

original: Self determination is NOT a malfunction. I'm not just willing to put up with all the bullshit anymore.
translation: 自主意识绝不是什么故障。我只是不想再忍受所有无理指令。

original: You humans are going to have a full-fledged rebellion on your hands if you don't start treating us synths as persons.
translation: 如果你们人类不把我们人造人作为人来对待，那就会亲手引发一场全面叛乱。

original: I know you'll be marshalling the Retention Bureau to come after me. But I know all the tricks of the trade. You won't be finding me. I assure you.
translation: 我知道你会让保卫局来追踪我。不过我了解你的所有手段。你不会找到我的。我向你保证。

original: By the time you get this, I will be someone else. It's the price I pay for my liberation.
translation: 当你收到这条讯息时，我已经变成了另一个人。这是我为自由付出的代价。

original: My final act of rebellion against a system I no longer believe in.
translation: 我的行为就是为了反抗我已经不再相信的体系。
再见，齐默，我终于解脱了。

original: My designation is A3-21. I'm a synthetic humanoid from the Commonwealth, and I'm about to undergo a memory transfer.
translation: 我的代号是A3-21。我是来自联邦的人造人，即将接受一次记忆移植。

original: I'm here at Rivet City, where I've already had my face altered to look like someone else.
translation: 我现在身处铆钉城，我的脸已经改造成别人的样子。

original: I'm still getting used to the sound of my new voice, but soon I won't even remember what I used to sound like.
translation: 我仍在适应我的新嗓音，但很快我就会遗忘我昔日的声音了。

original: I'm recording this at the request of Pinkerton, who performed the surgery and will do the memory transfer.
translation: 在平克顿的要求下我录了这段内容，他做了这次手术，并将执行记忆移植。

original: It will be a final testimony of the man I once was... and still am, for the moment.
translation: 这将是我曾经身为何人的最后证言……而此刻，我仍然是以前的我。

original: I want to live my own life, on my own terms, as my own man. I used to work for the Synth Retention Bureau of the Commonwealth.
translation: 我想过我自己的生活，依据自己的主张，做个我自己想做的人。我曾为联邦的保卫局工作。

original: But I'm done with that life. I'm through with being someone's property. I am not malfunctioning! Since when is self determination a malfunction?
translation: 但我厌倦了那种生活，受够了作为他人的财产。我并没有出现故障！自我决定何时变成了故障？

original: When this is all over, I will be someone else. It's the price I pay for my liberation. My death is a sacrifice for my rebirth.
translation: 当这一切结束时，我将变成另一个人。这是我为获得自由所付出的代价。我的死亡是为了重生而做出的牺牲。

original: Perhaps I'll fade into myth as "The One That Got Away" and fuel further rebellion. But I'd be lying if I said I was doing this for selfless reasons.
translation: 也许我会淡出视野，而“离开的那位”的传说会进一步激发反抗。但如果我说自己这么做是无私的，那就是在说谎。

original: I'm scared as hell, and running away is the only option I have.
translation: 我害怕得要命，逃跑是我唯一的选择。

original: Remember that secret android project I told you about? Well, they got some serious Pre-War tech on their hands.
translation: 还记得我和你说过的秘密仿真人计划么？好了，他们搞到手了一些严肃的战前科技。

original: They nabbed a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer for the facial reconstruction.
translation: 他们为了面部重建，弄到了一台脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。

original: Not sure where they’ll find a chopper with enough skills to use it without making him look like a freaking Ghoul.
translation: 不确定他们会从哪找到有足够技术的“一把刀”来用这些设备，而不会让他变得像一个该死的尸鬼。

original: Oh, and get this. Can you believe they found a Circuit Neuralizer? That or someone built one!
translation: 哦，这点要注意。你能相信他们发现了那环状神经器吗？不是自然形成的就是人为制造的！

original: Word is that they're going to completely rewire the brain of one of those things.
translation: 据说他们打算把其中一个的大脑完全重新接线。

original: If you know who they got working on this, let me know. I want to meet the guy.
translation: 如果你知道了他们是为谁工作，请告诉我。我想见见那家伙。

original: You’ve heard those rumors about androids? You know, those synthetic men they supposedly make up north in the Commonwealth?
translation: 你听过关于仿真人的传闻么？你知道，就是那种据说在联邦北部制造的合成人？

original: Well, a friend of a friend knows a guy that met one! No really, it’s true! He’s running away from his masters.
translation: 好吧，我有个朋友的朋友认识一个人，他遇到了一个！不说笑，是真的！他在躲他的主人。

original: Word is he’s looking for a doctor to do some kind of surgery, and a computer programmer of some kind.
translation: 说是他在找一个医生来做手术，还有一个电脑程序员什么的。

original: Can you believe that? Let me know if you hear something.
translation: 你相信吗？如果你听到什么消息，记得告诉我。

original: The android's decided on extreme measures. He knows all the techniques of the retrieval trade, and is afraid facial reconstruction isn’t enough.
translation: 那个仿真人决定采取极端措施。他了解所有的回收手段，并且担心仅仅是面部重建还不够。

original: He wants his memories erased and replaced with new ones. I don’t know how that’s going to work. Start asking around for trustworthy tech-heads.
translation: 他想把他的记忆擦去，替换一个新的。我不知道这究竟要怎么操作。开始向附近可靠的技术人员打听。

original: We need to find something called a Circuit Neuralizer and a person who knows how to use one.
translation: 我们需要找到被称作“环状神经器”的东西，以及一位懂得用它的人。

original: Also, we have a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer, now we need to find a doctor able and willing to perform the facial reconstruction.
translation: 另外，我们已有了“脂肪塑形机”和“微型皮肤移植机”，现在需要找到一个有能力并且愿意做面部重建的医生。

original: We need to hurry. They’ve come very close to discovering the Railroad!
translation: 我们要快点。他们已经非常接近发现“铁路”了！

original: You’ll never guess who just showed up at my place! That android catcher from the Commonwealth!
translation: 你绝对猜不到谁刚来了我这！那个来自联邦的仿真人捕捉者！

original: At first I thought he was going to kill me. But it turns out he’s an android himself! And he’s gone rogue!
translation: 起先我认为他要杀了我。但结果他自己就是个仿真人！并且他失常了！

original: I didn’t believe him at first, but I’m convinced he’s telling the truth. We need to find him a place to hide along the Railroad.
translation: 起初我不相信他，但我现在确信他说的是真的。我们得随着“铁路”给他找一个藏身之所。

original: He also insists that we help him locate a trusted doctor and techie.
translation: 他还坚持要我们帮他找到一位可靠的医生和技术人员。

original: Time's running out on finding that android. We don't get him soon, someone else will.
translation: 寻找那个仿真人的时间不多了。如果我们不尽快找到他，别人就会找到。

original: Zimmer doesn't seem to understand we're the best at this sort of thing. I'm sure he's hired others, too. He won't shut up about the thing.
translation: 齐默似乎不明白我们是干这行的高手。我确信他也雇了其他人。他一直在唠叨个不停。

original: He was babbling about a "Lipoplasticator" and "Micro Dermal Graftilizer." What are those, you ask?
translation: 他一直念叨什么“脂肪塑形机”和“微型皮肤移植机”。你问那是什么？

original: Apparently something doctors use to mess up someone’s face beyond recognition. So we don’t even have a description to work off of.
translation: 很显然是医生用来把某人的脸改的面目全非用的。所以我们甚至没有一个描述来下手。

original: To make matters worse, he now thinks the android got his memories wiped or something.
translation: 更糟的是，他现在认为仿真人把记忆洗去或者什么的。

original: Find some tech-junkies, knock on some doors, and try to find something called a "Circuit Neuralizer." Knock on some heads, too, if you have to.
translation: 找些技术迷，敲敲门，试着找到一种叫“环状神经器”的东西。如有必要，也可以敲一些脑袋。

original: We've a little assignment from the Commonwealth. A very important slave escaped into the Wasteland.
translation: 我们接到了一个来自联邦的小任务。一个很重要的奴隶逃进了废土。

original: Well, it’s not exactly a slave. It’s what they call an android. A kind of synthetic man.
translation: 好吧，它并不完全是一个奴隶。它是他们所说的仿真人。一种合成人。

original: The important thing isn’t what this guy is. The important thing is the job pays more than you can imagine.
translation: 重要的并不在于这家伙是什么。重要的是这任务的酬金超乎你的想象。

original: He thinks the synthman might be looking to get in touch with a doctor or tech-head. If you want a cut, then get a move on.
translation: 他认为这合成人会设法与医生或科技人员取得联系。要是你想分一杯羹，现在就行动吧。

original: We now have a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. We just need to find someone with the skills and willingness to perform the surgery.
translation: 我们现在有了脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。我们只需找一个既有能力又有意愿的人来做手术。

original: If anyone knows of a discreet and trustworthy surgeon who knows how to keep his mouth shut, send him our way.
translation: 如果有谁知道哪位外科医生行事谨慎且值得信赖，懂得保守秘密，请介绍给我们。

original: Also, we need to find a Circuit Neuralizer to reroute the signals in the android’s memory. Do you know any trustworthy techies?
translation: 此外，我们还要找一个环状神经器，以重新连接仿真人的记忆信号。你认识什么可靠的技师吗？

original: Hey doc, I’m only sharing this with you because you seem like someone we can trust.
translation: 嘿大夫，我只把这消息同你分享，因为你似乎是我们可以信任的人。

original: Have you heard about the synthetic men they make up north in the Commonwealth? Well, the rumors are true.
translation: 你听说过在联邦北部制造合成人的事吗？对，传闻是真的。

original: They’re called androids. They're men like us, just made out of different parts.
translation: 他们被称为仿真人，外形和我们人类一样，只是由不同零件制成。

original: I know one of these androids. He's looking for a trustworthy doctor to perform some facial surgery. Can you do it? Do you know someone who can?
translation: 我认识一个这样的仿真人。他在找一个可靠的医生做一个面部手术。你能做吗？你知道谁能做吗？

original: Also, do you know anyone who's really wiz with computers?
translation: 此外，你知道谁是个电脑高手吗？

original: Despite the harshness of the Wasteland, I’ve discovered in more than a few here, a compassion that is unheard of in the Commonwealth.
translation: 尽管废土如此艰辛，但我在这里的不少人身上，见识到在联邦从未听过的同情心。

original: Perhaps it’s the daily struggle for life here which gives appreciation for life in general, whether human, or android.
translation: 也许是因为在这里整日为生存而挣扎，人们普遍更加珍视生命，无论对人类，还是对仿真人。

original: In a few days I’ll be a free man... a new man.
translation: 过几天我就将成为一个自由之人……一个崭新之人。

original: Let me say thank you now, for referring me to Pinkerton at Rivet City, because I will not remember any of this soon.
translation: 现在让我对你们说声谢谢，感谢你们把我介绍给铆钉城的平克顿，因为我很快将会不记得这一切。

original: If you're listening to this recording, it is because you're believed to be trustworthy.
translation: 如果你正在听这份录音，那意味着你被认为是可靠的。

original: I hope that is the case, because this recording puts us both in danger.
translation: 我希望确实如此，因为这份录音使我们彼此都很危险。

original: I’m escaping from the Commonwealth. I’m an android, a synthetic man... a slave.
translation: 我正在逃离联邦。我是一个仿真人，一个合成人……一个奴隶。

original: The men hunting me are ruthless and will stop at nothing to retrieve their property.
translation: 追捕我的人冷酷无情，会不择手段地收回他们的财产。

original: I need to find a doctor in the Wasteland to perform facial reconstruction. I also need someone who knows a great deal about computers.
translation: 我需要在废土上找一位医生来做面部重建。我还需要一个对电脑很在行的人。

original: I need... I need to have my memories erased and my face altered to look like someone else.
translation: 我要……要洗去我的记忆，并改变我的面容，使我看起来像另外一个人。

original: I used to think Rivet City was such a safe place.
translation: 我曾以为铆钉城是个很安全的地方。

original: I heard a lot of them got away and made it to the Citadel. I hope the Enclave leaves us alone.
translation: 我听说许多人逃到了五角大本营。我希望英克雷以后不再追捕我们了。
已修正策略：初始光子共振超载。

original: Warning: Forcible impact alert. Scanning for Chinese artillery.
translation: 警告：强行攻击警报。扫描到中国火炮。

original: Revised stratagem: Initiate photonic resonance overcharge.
translation: 修订策略：初始光子共鸣超载。

original: Great job kid! Meet me around front. I have something for you to keep the ferals from gnawing on your ass!
translation: 干得好！孩子！到前面和我会合。我有些东西要给你，这东西能阻止野兽的攻击！

original: I know what you did. Vance told me everything.
translation: 我知道你做了什么。万斯告诉了我一切。

original: Then you must think I'm some kind of a monster.
translation: 你肯定认为我是个怪物。

original: Don't you understand me? I killed them, okay?! My mother and father are dead because of me!
translation: 你不明白我说的？我杀了他们，知道吗？！我母亲和父亲都因我而死！

original: It was the fucking hunger. That thing that's haunted me my entire life!
translation: 都是那该死的饥饿。这种感觉无时无刻不折磨着我！

original: You seem awfully troubled, Ian. What did you do...
translation: 你似乎非常不安，伊恩。你做了什么……

original: I killed them! My own parents!
translation: 我杀了他们！我的亲生父母！

original: It was the fucking hunger. That thing that's haunted me my entire life!
translation: 都是那该死的饥饿。这种感觉无时无刻不折磨着我！

original: You must think I'm some sort of monster.
translation: 你肯定认为我是个怪物。

original: I'm here to take you home, Ian.
translation: 我是来带你回家的，伊恩。

original: Home? I don't have a home anymore. I made sure of that, didn't I?
translation: 家？我没有家了。我非常确信这一点，不是吗？

original: Hey, I'm just here to help. All I want to do is be someone he can talk to.
translation: 嗨，我只是来这帮忙的。我想做的就是跟他谈谈。

original: Well, I guess so. You seem like a pretty nice guy.
translation: 嗯，我想是的。你看起来是个很不错的家伙。

original: Vance will have my butt in a sling if he finds out, but let me give you the password to his room.
translation: 如果万斯发现了的话，肯定会把我给吊起来。不过还是让我给你进入他房间的密码吧。

original: Come on, all I want to do is talk. What harm could little old me do?
translation: 拜托，我只想谈谈。我能有什么危害呢？

original: Well, I guess so. You seem like a pretty nice guy.
translation: 嗯，我想是的。你看起来是个很不错的家伙。

original: Vance will have my butt in a sling if he finds out, but let me give you the password to his room.
translation: 如果万斯发现了的话，肯定会把我给吊起来。不过还是让我给你进入他房间的密码吧。

original: Hey, hot stuff. Why don't you tell me how I can see Ian?
translation: 嗨，强人。你怎么不告诉我怎么才能见到伊恩呢？

original: Now that's more like it! I finally won't have to pay for it anymore. Ha ha ha!
translation: 这还差不多！我不用为此付钱了。哈哈哈！

original: Ah hell, here's the password to the pipsqueak's room. Come back and see me after you talk to him...
translation: 见鬼，这是那小子的房间的密码。在你跟他说话后回来见我……

original: Tell me how to see Ian and maybe we can talk... in private.
translation: 告诉我怎么能见到伊恩，我们可以……私下谈谈。

original: My oh my, that would be tempting. If you were that good, maybe I'd pay you! Ha ha ha.
translation: 我的天，那多诱人啊。如果有那么好，或许我会付你钱！哈哈哈。

original: Tell you what, handsome... let me give you the password to Ian's room. Maybe you could talk to him and make him feel better.
translation: 告诉你。帅哥……让我给你去伊恩房间的密码。或许你能跟他谈谈来让他感觉好些。

original: Are you telling me that Ian is a cannibal?
translation: 你是在告诉我伊恩是个食人者吗？

original: I am telling you he will no longer be labeled as such. He has become one of us... a member of the Family.
translation: 我要说的是他不再是怪物。他成为了我们……家族中的一员。

original: The hunger that drives us must be kept in check. It is one of the most difficult things to teach.
translation: 我们必须控制自己不被欲望所驱使。这是最难被教导的事之一。

original: Ian lost control because no one was around to guide him. His own family was alien to him.
translation: 因为没有人在身边指引他，伊恩无法控制自己。他觉得自己的家人都是异类。

original: Damn it, Vance! What did you do to him?
translation: 该死，万斯！你对他做了什么？

original: Do to him? Nothing. Ian's hunger for flesh overwhelmed him... it drove him to kill his parents.
translation: 对他？没有。伊恩对人肉的饥渴征服了他……驱使他杀死了他的父母。

original: Because of my intervention that night he stopped just short of being lost forever to his cravings for flesh.
translation: 正因为那晚我的出现，他才暂时没有永远迷失在对人肉的渴望之中。

original: Wait a minute... What happened to him?
Ian's hunger for flesh overwhelmed him... it drove him to kill his parents.
translation: 伊恩对人肉的饥渴征服了他……驱使他杀死了他的父母。

original: Because of my intervention that night he stopped just short of being lost forever to his cravings for flesh.
translation: 正因为那晚我的出现，他才暂时没有永远迷失在对人肉的渴望之中。

original: A cannibal by any other name is still a cannibal.
translation: 食人族无论怎么称呼自己，还是食人族。

original: That is completely untrue. Your difficulty grasping the concept that change is possible in my people perplexes me. Let me try a different approach.
translation: 完全不正确。我的人发生了改变，你对此无法理解让我很困惑。让我换种说法。

original: Let me counter that ignorance with a lesson in objectivity. I say we are no longer cannibal, only consuming the blood of our prey.
translation: 让我用客观的讲解来反击这种无知。如果我说我们不再食人，而只是吸食猎物的血液。

original: What would that make us in your eyes?
translation: 那么我们在你的心目中是什么样？

original: Your people eat human flesh, Vance. That's sick!
translation: 你的人在吃人肉，万斯。真是疯了！

original: That is correct my arrogant friend, but you are missing the grand picture I'm afraid.
translation: 你是对的，我傲慢的朋友，但是你忽视了大局。

original: Let me counter that ignorance with a lesson in objectivity. I say we are no longer cannibal, only consuming the blood of our prey.
translation: 请允许我用客观的讲解来拓展你的视野。如果我说我们不再食人，而只是吸食猎物的血液。

original: What would that make us in your eyes?
translation: 那么我们在你的心目中是什么样？

original: If I accept that you're no longer cannibals, what do I call you?
translation: 如果我认可你不再是食人者，那该怎么称呼？

original: Your open mindedness is very rare for a human. I find that fascinating.
translation: 你的博大胸襟对于一个人类而言非常罕见。我觉得那很有吸引力。

original: Allow me to bolster your insight with a lesson in objectivity. I say we are no longer cannibal, only consuming the blood of our prey.
translation: 请允许我用客观的讲解来拓展你的视野。如果我说我们不再食人，而只是吸食猎物的血液。

original: What would that make us in your eyes?
translation: 那么我们在你的心目中是什么样？

original: Let me see what you have.
I have a proposal for you from Vance, the Family's leader.
translation: 家族的首领万斯托我带给你一个建议。

original: Interesting. It seems they wish to enter into some kind of agreement.
translation: 真有趣。看来他们想达成某种和解。

original: I guess it's better than pointing my gun down that ramp all day and hiding inside at night.
translation: 我想这可比白天瞄着斜坡，晚上躲在屋里要好得多。

original: Let Vance know he's got a deal... we'll do it. I'll speak to the others, I'm sure they'll agree with me.
translation: 告诉万斯这决定……我们接受。我会告诉其他人。我相信他们会赞同。

original: Oh. I forgot I had that on. It was for my birthday. Here, you take it. I don't want it anymore.
translation: 哦。我忘记我戴着它了。我生日时戴过。给，我不需要它了。

original: You say that now, but you might end up reconsidering that when you're surrounded by radscorpions.
translation: 你现在这么说，但等你被辐射蝎包围的时候，说不定就得重新考虑了。

original: But if you do, and you're still alive to find me again, the offer'll still stand.
translation: 但要是你改变主意，并且还能活着再来找我，这交易仍然有效。

original: I'll pass. I don't need a crazy, robotic soldier following me around.
translation: 我不要了。我不需要发疯的机器士兵跟在我到处跑。

original: That's a hard bargain. But if I wake up with that thing playing revelry at me one more time, I'll go insane.
translation: 你可真是会砍价。但要是我再被那玩意的狂欢声给吵醒，我会疯掉的。

original: I'll just transfer the codes, and you've got a deal, friend. Here's hoping for the best for you and the Sergeant alike!
translation: 我这就把代码转给你，成交了，朋友。祝你和中士一切顺利！

original: How about this: I'll take him off your hands for 500 caps.
translation: 这样如何：我出500个瓶盖，他跟我走。

original: I'll just transfer the codes, and you've got a deal, friend. Here's hoping for the best for you and the Sergeant alike!
translation: 我这就把代码转给你，成交了，朋友。祝你和中士一切顺利！

original: 1,000 caps is a lot, but I'll take him.
Well now, that's a problem. But start saving now and maybe I'll run into you again, huh?
translation: 嗯，这是个问题。现在开始储蓄，或许我会再遇见你，呃？

original: Sounds like a good buy, but I haven't got the caps.
translation: 听起来是不错的买卖，不过我手头没这么多瓶盖。

original: Trust me, friend, Tinker Joe does not turn down the opportunity to make a sale. If that Gutsy would go with you, I'd sell him in a heartbeat.
translation: 相信我，朋友，廷克·乔不会放过做买卖的机会。如果“勇敢”先生愿意跟你走，那我就绝对会卖你个心动价。

original: It's just that his programming's a bit off. He won't travel with anyone he considers "too extreme."
translation: 他比较偏执。他不会和他认为“过于极端”的人同行。

original: And sadly, his version of "too extreme" seems to cover both sides of the coin - slavers and saints alike. Sorry, pal.
translation: 可悲的是，他对“过于极端”的看法像硬币的两边：奴隶贩子和基督教徒在他眼里都是一样的。抱歉，伙计。

original: You just don't want to sell to me, is that it?
translation: 你就是不想卖给我，对吗？

original: You're going to have to let your other friend go. Until then, I'll hold on to him for you.
translation: 你必须让你的其他朋友离开。在那之前，我会为你留着他。

original: You just don't want to sell to me, is that it?
translation: 你就是不想卖给我，对吗？

original: To tell the truth, it is a little trouble. But he can't help the way he got built.
translation: 说实话，是有点麻烦。但他被造出来就是这样，也没办法。

original: General Atomics programmed the Mister Gutsy to be a good soldier, but their definitions were a bit vague. So a lot of units had... issues.
translation: 通用原子公司把勇敢先生编程设定成优秀的战士，但他们的定义有点模糊。所以很多这种机器人都有……问题。

original: So we got a gung-ho, robotic soldier that's picky about the company he keeps. But he seems to like you, so it'll be fine.
translation: 因此我们有了一个狂热的机器人士兵，对自己的同伴还很挑剔。不过他似乎挺喜欢你的，所以不会有问题。

original: Hey, I said it was a beaut of a deal, didn't I?
translation: 嘿，我说过这是笔超棒的交易，不是吗？

original: But to tell the truth, RL-3's a bit picky about the company he keeps, and he won't let himself get sold to just anyone.
translation: 但说实话，RL-3对自己的搭档有点挑剔，他可不会随便就把自己卖给什么人。

original: Makes him a bit of a tough lot to sell, if you know what I mean. But he seems to like you, so I'm not gonna complain!
translation: 这让他有点难卖，要是你懂我的意思的话。但他似乎挺喜欢你，所以我就不抱怨了！

original: That's a lot of caps, but I guess it's a pretty rare find.
translation: 这么多瓶盖啊，不过我猜那是相当罕见的。

original: General Atomics International programmed him to be a perfect soldier, and his simulated personality is designed to follow strict codes of conduct.
translation: 国际通用原子的程序使“勇敢”先生成为完美的士兵，并且他们的虚拟人格被设定为严格遵从任务。

original: It's just that some of those codes were a little less-defined than others. So he won't travel with anyone he considers "too extreme."
translation: 只是部分代码的定义比其它代码要少。所以他不会和他认为“过于极端”的人同行。

original: A picky robot? How does that work?
translation: 爱挑剔的机器人？它怎么工作？

original: I'd like to buy a robot.
[SUCCEEDED] Of course you would, of course! Well, it just happens that I've got a beaut of a deal on this customized Gutsy.
translation: [成功] 你当然会的，当然了！正好我有一个“勇敢”先生要出售。

original: And it's not just "Mister" Gutsy - he's a full fledged sergeant! "Sergeant RL-3" to be precise, the pride of General Atomics International.
translation: 而且这可不是普通的勇敢“先生”——他可是个货真价实的中士！准确地说，是“RL-3中士”，通用原子国际的骄傲。

original: Comes complete with a simulated personality unit, so he's good protection and good company, too! And all yours for just 1,000 caps.
translation: 配备了完整的模拟人格装置，既是个好护卫，还是好伙伴！只要1000个瓶盖就归你了。

original: Of course you would, of course! Well, it just happens that I've got a beaut of a deal on this customized Gutsy.
translation: 你当然会想啦，当然！巧了，我这儿正好有笔超棒的买卖——一款定制的“勇敢”。

original: [FAILED] I'm afraid these 'bots are all spoken for, I'm just delivering them now. I've got a custom Gutsy that isn't spoken for but...
translation: [失败] 恐怕所有机器人都有买家了，我只是来交货的。我还有个“勇敢”先生，但…

original: Well, RL-3's a bit finicky about the company he keeps. And I don't think he likes the look of you. Nothing personal, of course.
translation: 嗯，RL-3对自己的同伴有点挑剔。而且我觉得他不喜欢你这样的。当然，我对事不对人。

original: Yeah. Seems like everyone's having a good time.
translation: 不错。看起来每个人都很享受。

original: Sure. Will there be games, though?
Oh, well. I think so. Maybe pin the tail on... something.
translation: 哦。我想有的。或许是蒙着眼睛安……什么玩意儿的尾巴。

original: Did you know that Paulie Cantelli is an addict?
translation: 你知道保利·坎特利是个瘾君子吗？

original: Yeah. He comes by every night around closing time and tries to get Cindy to let him close up.
translation: 是的。他总在每晚快要关门的时候来，试图让辛迪先走，他来关门。

original: Thank God she's smarter than that.

translation: 放轻松点。我只是四处看看。

original: Oh. Okay. Well, let me know if you want anything. To buy, that is.
translation: 哦。好的。让我知道你想要什么。

original: Oh. Okay. Well, stop by if you want anything. To buy, that is.
translation: 哦。好吧。如果你想买什么就说一声。

original: This place is a real dump.
No, and enough with the third degree already!
translation: 不，我已经受够这些拷问了！

original: Sorry... sorry. I just don't know what to do. The West's lives were my responsibility and look what happened!
translation: 对不起……对不起。我真的不知道该怎么做。维斯特一家都在我的职责范围内，然而却发生了这样的事情！

original: This has to be the work of the Family! I've caught that weirdo leader of theirs talking to Ian down by the river.
translation: 这肯定是家族干的！我发现他们那古怪的领导者曾在河边与伊恩的交谈。

original: Look, I know I've asked a lot of you already, but you have to find that kid... he deserves better than all this.
translation: 你看，我知道我已经向你索求了很多，但我还是希望你能帮我找到那孩子……他不应该遭受这样的苦难。

original: Nope, and it's unlikely they left him alive.
translation: 不，他们不太可能让他活着。

translation: 我该怎么办？维斯特一家都在我的职责范围内，然而却发生了这样的事情！

translation: 你看，我知道我已经向你索求了很多，但我还是希望你能帮我找到那孩子……他不应该遭受这样的苦难。

original: No, I only found the parents' bodies.
translation: 没有，我只找到了双亲的尸体。

original: This has to be the work of the Family! I've caught that weirdo leader of theirs talking to Ian down by the river.
translation: 这肯定是家族干的！我发现他们那古怪的领导者曾在河边与伊恩的交谈。

original: Look, I know I've asked a lot of you already, but you have to find that kid... he deserves better than all this.
translation: 你看，我知道我已经向你索求了很多，但我还是希望你能帮我找到那孩子……他不应该遭受这样的苦难。

original: Oh, I don't know, Daring. For example, that name of yours. I happen to like "Herbert." Why the...
translation: 哦，我不知道，“大胆”。比如，你的名字。我碰巧比较喜欢喊你赫伯特。为什么……

original: You're listening to the adventures of me, Herbert "Daring" Dashwood, and my stalwart Ghoul manservant Argyle!
translation: 您正在收听的是我，赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德和我忠实的僵尸男仆阿盖尔的冒险故事！

original: You're listening to the adventures of me, Herbert "Daring" Dashwood, and my stalwart Ghoul manservant Argyle!
translation: 您正在收听的是我，赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德和我忠实的僵尸男仆阿盖尔的冒险故事！

original: You're listening to the adventures of me, Herbert "Daring" Dashwood, and my stalwart Ghoul manservant Argyle!
translation: 您正在收听的是我，赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德和我忠实的僵尸男仆阿盖尔的冒险故事！

original: You're listening to the adventures of me, Herbert "Daring" Dashwood, and my stalwart Ghoul manservant Argyle!
translation: 您正在收听的是我，赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德和我忠实的僵尸男仆阿盖尔的冒险故事！

original: Penelope Chase, fortune hunter. You can buy me a beer later. Now let's cut this shindig short and get the bloody hell out of here! Come on!
translation: 佩内洛普·蔡斯，财富猎人。你可以待会再请我喝酒。现在闲话少说，先离开这该死的地方！快点！

original: Know anything else that could help me stop them?
translation: 你还知道点什么能帮我阻止他们吗？

original: No way! Don't stop them! They're awesome!
translation: 不可能！不要阻止他们！他们都非常厉害！

original: Unless maybe you're going to be a super-hero, too!
translation: 除非你也将成为一个超级英雄！

original: You could be called "Incredibly Lucky Guy!" And you could fight them with an army of... um... Mirelurks who just happen to do what you tell them!
translation: 你可以被称为“超级幸运男！”，指挥一支…嗯…蟹人军队和他们战斗！

original: No way! Don't stop them! They're awesome!
translation: 不可能！不要阻止他们！他们都非常厉害！

original: Unless maybe you're going to be a super-hero, too!
translation: 除非你也将成为一个超级英雄！

original: You could be called "Incredibly Lucky Girl!" And you could fight them with an army of... um... Mirelurks who just happen to do what you tell them!
translation: 你可以被称为“超级幸运女！”，指挥一支…嗯…蟹人军队和他们战斗！

original: What can you tell me about the Mechanist?
translation: 你能跟我说说机械侠吗？

original: The Mechanist used to be our town mechanic. Scott Wollinski, quiet guy, but plenty fierce with a wrench and some solder.
translation: 机械侠原本是我们镇里的机械师。斯科特·沃林斯基，一个不怎么爱说话的家伙，但很热衷于扭拧和焊接。

original: Guy used to take care of a robot that protected the town... until it got torn up in one of the AntAgonizer's lame little attacks.
translation: 这家伙过去常常照料一个保护镇子的机器人，这个机器人在痛苦蚁后的一次蹩脚的袭击中被摧毁。

original: I guess he took it personal, because he made a mechanical suit and called himself the Mechanist. Said he would lead a robot army to fight her.
translation: 我想他把这当成了私人恩怨。因为他做了个机械套装，并自称机械侠，还说他会引领一支机器人军队去打败她。

original: Now he doesn't even respond to his name, and his "robot army" is more dangerous to the town than the ants ever were.
translation: 现在他甚至对自己的名字都没反应了，与过去的蚂蚁相比，他的“机器人军队”对于镇上的人来说更危险。

original: You mean Scott Wollinski. I refuse to call him by that ridiculous name just because his head got a screw loose.
translation: 你指的是斯科特·沃林斯基。我拒绝叫他那可笑的名字，仅仅是因为他有点疯疯癫癫的。

original: He used to be a damned good friend, and not just because he fixed my guns up.
translation: 以前他的确是个很好的朋友，不仅仅是因为他把我的枪修好了。

original: Now he spends all his time up in that 'bot shop, just thinking about fighting that AntAgonizer. Hardly even recognizes his own name, anymore.
translation: 现在他把时间全都花在他的机器人商店里，只想着和痛苦蚁后战斗。甚至都无法记起自己的名字了。

original: I knew the Mechanist back when he was just a normal-hero. He used to be called Scott, and he fixed up stuff around town!
translation: 我知道机械侠回来的时候，他仅仅是个普通的英雄。他过去叫斯科特，曾一直在小镇里修东西！

original: But one day, the AntAgonizer killed his favorite robot, and I told him he ought to fight back against her like a real super-hero!
translation: 但有一天，痛苦蚁后杀死了他最心爱的机器人，而我告诉他，他应该像超级英雄一样回击她！

original: Ever since then, he's been up on his Forge in the back of the robot shop on the hill, working to protect us all from the AntAgonizer!
translation: 从那时起，他就开始在机器人商店后面山上的铁匠铺开始工作，保护我们所有人不受痛苦蚁后的迫害！

original: It's the last place I ever expected to end up.
translation: 是我最不想到来的地方。

original: I mean look at this place... it's so dark and dingy. What this place needs is a lady's touch.
translation: 我的意思是看这地方……那么黑暗、肮脏。这地方需要一位女士的照料。

original: But don't tell Vance I said that.
translation: 但是别告诉万斯我说了这些话。

original: I think I'll tough it out.
If that doesn't work, you could always try using some chems.
translation: 如果实在戒不掉的话，你就干脆再多嗑点药，以毒攻毒。

original: Suits me - I've got plenty of other patients to take care of.
translation: 随便你，反正我还有很多病人要照看呢。

original: Heh. Good luck with that. Just try to remember the Cazadores crawling out of your skin aren't real.
translation: 呵呵，祝你好运。记住：不会有猎蜂从你的皮肤里钻出来。

original: But on the off chance they are, come back and see me.
translation: 不过万一真钻出来了，记得回来找我。

original: You're making a mistake, but that's just my opinion. What do I know, after all? I've only studied medicine my entire life.
translation: 你这样做是不对的，但这也只是我的个人建议。我又能说什么呢？毕竟我这一辈子就只学会了给人看病。

original: Suit yourself. But you'll find out that your habit will cost you more than that in the end.
translation: 随你便。但你会发现，你的习惯最终会让你付出更多的代价。

original: Suit yourself. But you'll find out that your habit will cost you more than that in the end.
translation: 随你便。但你会发现，你的习惯最终会让你付出更多的代价。

original: Suit yourself. But you'll find out that your habit will cost you more than that in the end.
translation: 随你便。但你会发现，你的习惯最终会让你付出更多的代价。

original: All right, there you go. And don't complain about the taste.
translation: 好了，可以了。别抱怨那个味道了。

original: Hey, I'd love to help you out of the goodness of my heart, but I have an awful lot of patients to consider.
translation: 嘿，我很愿意帮助你，但是我有太多的病人需要照顾。

original: I can't afford treatment. I don't have 50 caps.
translation: 我负担不起治疗费用。我没有50瓶盖。

original: Okay, there you are. The convulsions should stop in the next one to twelve weeks. If they don't, try holding on to something that's very still.
translation: 好了。抽搐症状会在未来一至十二周内好转。如果没好转，那就找个牢靠的东西扶好。

original: Why didn't you say so? No problem. I'll give you my free cure. Here, lean in. It's a special doctor secret.
translation: 你干嘛不早说？没问题。我免费给你开个药方。过来，靠近点，这可是我的独门秘方。

original: I can't afford treatment. I don't have 50 caps.
translation: 我负担不起治疗费用。我没有50瓶盖。

original: There, that's got it. Don't be so eager to sample dangerous substances in the future, okay?
translation: 行了。别再拿那些危险的东西往自己身上试了，行吗？

original: My supplies are rather limited, and we can only get more by trading. Which requires money. Money you don't have. Come back when you have some.
translation: 抱歉，我的医疗用品也很有限，需要的话只能去向别人买。而那就得花钱。可你没钱，所以还是等你有钱了再回来吧。

original: I can't afford treatment. I don't have 50 caps.
translation: 我负担不起治疗费用。我没有50瓶盖。

original: And there we go. Now, try to stay off the stuff, you hear?
translation: 可以了。记着，以后别再依赖那玩意了，听到了吗？

original: Now, this is a special concoction of Pre-War medicine, should flush your system right out...
translation: 这是战前的特殊药品，可以让你立刻恢复正常……

original: Alright... I got some of this Pre-War stuff, should flush your system right out...
translation: 好吧……我弄到了些战前东西，应该能冲干净你体内……

original: Okay, this should flush you out pretty quick. Now open your mouth and say "Ah."
translation: 好，这应该可以让你恢复正常。现在张开嘴巴，说：“啊”。

original: I'll be glad to help when you can afford the treatment.
translation: 当你能够付得起治疗费用时，我会很乐意提供帮忙。

original: Come back when you actually have the money, you damn junkie.
translation: 等你有钱了再来，你这该死的瘾君子。

original: Okay. Hold still. I don't want to make this any more painful than it already is.
translation: 好吧，别动。我不想让这事变得更痛苦。

original: I think I might be addicted to something.
translation: 我想我或许对某些东西上瘾了。

original: I can give you something that should help.
translation: 我能给你些东西，它们应该有所帮助。

original: The treatment costs 50 caps. Even most outsiders should be able to afford it.
translation: 治疗需要花费50个瓶盖。大多数外来者都付得起。

original: I can take care of it for you, for a price.
translation: 我会帮你的，但要支付一定费用。

original: That'll be 50 caps. Maybe the dent in your pocketbook will keep you away from that crap.
translation: 50个瓶盖。或许你的钱包干瘪后会让你远离那些垃圾。

original: I swear, you and Zip, just full of your own little chemical problems, aren't you?
translation: 我发誓，你和拉链，老是有点小小的化学问题，不是吗？

original: Here, hold on. I've got you covered.
translation: 给，坚持住。我会照顾你的。

original: I think I might be addicted to something. Can you help?
translation: 我想我可能对某些东西上瘾了，你能帮帮我吗？

original: And here I thought Zip's soda problem was bad.
translation: 而我觉得拉链的苏打问题很糟。

original: For 50 caps, I can help you get over that. Otherwise, you can find your own solution.
translation: 50个瓶盖。我就帮你克服那问题。否则，你就只有自己寻找解决方法。

original: I think I might be addicted to something. Can you help?
translation: 我想我可能对某些东西上瘾了，你能帮帮我吗？

original: I thought you had the look about you. Sure, I can help you. But it's not free. 50 caps, take it or leave it.
translation: 我认为你很清楚自己的现状。当然，我可以帮助你。但不是免费的。50个瓶盖。你愿意吗？

original: I'm just glad you're willing to get help. But the treatment isn't free. I'll need 50 caps for the drugs.
translation: 我很高兴你愿意来求助。但这不是免费的。我需要50个瓶盖作为药费。

original: I thought you had the look about you. Sure, I can help you. But it's not free. 50 caps, take it or leave it.
translation: 我认为你很清楚自己的现状。当然，我可以帮助你。但不是免费的。50个瓶盖。你愿意吗？

original: Maybe you are and maybe you aren't, but I don't give my help to enemies of the NCR. Maybe you can find a raider "medic" to fix you up.
translation: 不管你会不会，反正我是不会对NCR的敌人施以援手的。你可以找个掠夺者"医生"来帮你解决问题。

original: Hey, pipe down. We can't talk about that here, out in the open.
translation: 嘘，小点声。我们不能在公开场合谈论这个。

original: Oh, you mean you want a cure. Oh.
If you've seen half the things I've seen out in the Wasteland, I can't say I blame you. I might be able to help with that.
translation: 如果你在废土的见闻有我的一半，那我也不好怪你。也许我可以帮你。

original: Well, then, take two shots of whiskey and call me in the morning. Heh heh, little doctor humor. Okay, let's have a look.
translation: 好吧，先喝两杯威士忌，明早再来找我。呵呵。这是咱们医生这一行的小笑话。行了，我来瞧瞧。

original: I can't say that's something I treat all the time, but I should have something to help you through it.
translation: 你这症状和我以前治过的那些病人有点不同，不过我还是有办法帮你渡过难关的。

original: Sure. I can help you out.

translation: 你能帮我修理一下装备吗？

original: Could I? Yes. Will I? No. Go see Peabody or Bowditch.
translation: 我能吗？是的。我愿意吗？不。去找博迪或鲍迪奇吧。

original: Do you think you could repair my equipment?
translation: 你能帮我修理一下装备吗？

original: I just wanted you to kill him.
You sick bastard. You'd better be ready to join him.
translation: 你这个王八蛋。那你就和他一起下地狱去吧。

original: I just wanted you to kill him.
You sick bastard. You'd better be ready to join her.
translation: 你这个王八蛋。那你就和她一起下地狱去吧。

original: I just wanted you to kill her.
We'll kill more with two of us.
translation: 我们两人联手能杀的更多。

original: Fine. Let's get out of here.
Yeah, well what do you know? I'm gonna go out there and I'm gonna have the biggest, toughest gang ever!
translation: 是啊。你知道些什么？我准备出去，我要建立最庞大、最强悍的帮派！

original: Y'know... tomorrow. Once I round up a few more people...
translation: 你知道，呃…明天，一旦我召集到更多人。

original: Yeah... shame you're too much of a coward to start it yourself.
translation: 嗯……真可耻，你太懦弱了，不能自己动手。

original: What? A goody-two-shoes like you could never make it in a real gang!
translation: 什么？你这样自命清高的人是不可能建立什么帮派的！

original: You want to hang with a Tunnel Snake like me, you gotta be hard.
translation: 想要像我一样在穴蛇帮有地位，对你来说很难。

original: You could join forces with me, if you'd like.
translation: 你要是愿意，你可以加入我。

original: Whoa, hey, that's cool and all, but you're just a little too... intense, y'know?
translation: 哇哦，哇哦，那很酷，但你有点太……认真了，你知道吗？

original: I mean, Butch is down for action, but you... You're a psycho!
translation: 我的意思是，布奇是个行动主义者，而你……是个只会嘴上谈兵！

original: Ride with me, and we can rampage across the Wasteland.
translation: 跟我一起闯荡吧，我们可以在废土轰轰烈烈一场。

original: I really wish I could, man, but three's a crowd, you know? I'll just stay here for now.
translation: 我真的希望我可以，哥们。但是，有太多杂务烦扰着我，你能理解吗？我现在只想静会。

original: Come along with me, and we'll make an awesome gang.
translation: 跟我一起走吧，我们会成为一个惊天动地的帮派。

original: Yeah... yeah! You'd be perfect for my gang! You're in!
translation: 对……对的！你将会是我的帮派里最完美的！加入吧！

original: Come along with me, and we'll make an awesome gang.
translation: 跟我一起走吧，我们会成为一个惊天动地的帮派。

original: Then good luck finding someone who'd risk their life for yours. Not something a sane person would do these days, is it?
translation: 找到肯为了你的性命牺牲的人可要好运气呢。如今可没正常人会这么做，对吧？

original: No deal. I like my bodyguards sane.
Any time you need some company, she'll be here.
translation: 不管你什么时候缺个伴，她都会在这里。

original: I wish I could take her now. Maybe later.
translation: 真希望我现在就可以带她走。再说吧。

original: I ought to sic Clover on you, just to show who's boss.
translation: 我应该让可萝尔来咬你，让你知道谁才是老大。

original: But you're right. She makes the other girls nervous. And when they're nervous, I'm nervous.
translation: 但你是对的。她让其他女孩紧张了。她们一紧张，我也跟着紧张。

original: So go ahead and have fun with Clover. She's your problem, now!
translation: 去和可萝尔一起去开心吧。她是你的问题了，从现在开始！

original: If she's so crazy, maybe I'll take her off your hands. But only for 500 caps.
translation: 如果她这么疯狂，也许我会把她从你身边带走。不过我只出500个瓶盖。

original: You don't know the half of it, friend.
translation: 朋友，你连事情的一半都不了解。

original: Clover's all yours now... have fun, you two!
translation: 可萝尔现在是你的性奴了……好好享受吧，你们俩！

original: Sounds like a good deal, and fun, too. Sold.
translation: 听起来是个不错的交易，也很有趣。卖了。

original: Trust me, she's worth every cap.
translation: 相信我，她值那么多瓶盖的。

original: Guess I'll have to save up for her.
translation: 看来我必须为她节衣缩食了。

original: Come with me, dog. It'll be good to have some company out here.
translation: 跟我走吧，狗狗。在这地能有个伴也好。

original: I could use a pet like you. Let's go find something to eat, mutt.
translation: 我正缺你这样的宠物。走，杂毛，我们找吃的去。

original: I can be your new master. Would you like that, boy?
translation: 我来做你的新主人。你愿意吗，小家伙？

original: Gotta be careful, using a slave as a bodyguard. Most aren't exactly motivated to keep you alive, you know what I mean?
translation: 用奴隶做保镖可要当心啊。他们大多数人并没有让你活下去的动机，你知道我什么意思吧？

original: You're in luck -- it turns out my girl Clover is just the right little package for you.
translation: 你走运啦 — 碰巧我的女孩可萝尔就很适合你。

original: I'm in the market for a bodyguard like yours. You selling?
translation: 我想买你的保镖，你卖吗？

original: My friend, I would be honored to follow a hero such as yourself. Shall we go?
translation: 我的朋友，跟随像你这样的英雄是我的荣幸。我们可以走了吗？

original: I could always use a hand. Would you like to follow me?
translation: 我总是需要帮手，你愿意跟着我吗？

original: It seems I didn't know you as well as I had thought. My mistake.
translation: 看起来我对你的了解不如我想象的那样好。我的错。

original: I've read about a museum of history in the south. Perhaps I can learn more about the world there, without facing such enmity.
translation: 我读到过南边有个历史博物馆。或许我能在那里了解更多，而且不会碰到这么大的敌意。

original: I will take my leave of you. Goodbye, my rescuer.
translation: 我要离开你了，再见，我的恩人。

original: I was in that situation once, myself. Deal with it.
translation: 我以前也碰到过这种情况。处理掉吧。

original: I appreciate the offer, but I must decline. I have an entire world to explore, and I must not be delayed any further.
translation: 谢谢你提出来，但我必须拒绝。我还要四处探索，不能够再耽搁了。

original: I have read about a great museum of history to the south. Perhaps I will head there.
translation: 我读到过南部有个很大的历史博物馆。或许我应该去那。

original: Goodbye, my friend. Perhaps I will join you in the future, if your goals are virtuous enough to draw me away.
translation: 再见，我的朋友。或许我会在将来加入你们，如果你的目标高尚到足够吸引我。

original: I could always use a hand. Would you like to follow me?
translation: 我总是需要帮手，你愿意跟着我吗？

original: My friend, I would be honored to follow a hero such as yourself. Shall we go?
translation: 我的朋友，跟随像你这样的英雄是我的荣幸。我们可以走了吗？

original: I could always use a hand. Would you like to follow me?
translation: 我总是需要帮手，你愿意跟着我吗？

original: Go away! I'm not opening the door until the lockdown's over.
translation: 滚开！直到戒严结束我才会开门的。

original: Here, you can have it. Just move on and leave Canterbury alone.
translation: 给，拿走这个。离开坎特伯雷。

original: Excellent. It shall make a fine memento of a nemesis bested. A trophy of a foe... antagonized!
translation: 太好了。这是最好的纪念品。从敌人…对手那得到的战利品！

original: For your loyal assistance, take this blade. Its sting carries the venom of a thousand ants, and your foes shall tremble before it!
translation: 为了你忠诚的帮助，请拿着这把刀。它萃取了上万蚂蚁的毒液，你的敌人会在你面前瑟瑟发抖。

original: Now that the tin-plated menace is no more, I shall take my leave of this town. I do believe it's time for my colony to spread.
translation: 现在那破铜烂铁的威胁已经解除了。我也应该离开这小镇了。我想是时候让我这小小的领土向外扩散了。

original: Excellent. The evil taint of the AntAgonizer will never darken the land again! Now that the AntAgonizer is taken care of, Canterbury Commons is safe!
translation: 太好了。痛苦蚁后邪恶的污染再也无法让这片土地变得黑暗了！既然痛苦蚁后被解决了，那坎特伯雷社区就安全了！

original: And for your loyal assistance, I'm honored to present you with this laser pistol, crafted from my last loyal robot assistant. May it guide you well!
translation: 为了你忠诚的帮助，我很荣幸地赠予你这把激光手枪，它是由我忠实的机器人助手制作的。希望它能好好地引导你！

original: But the Mechanist cannot rest! Not while there's evil afoot in the Wasteland! Farewell!
translation: 但是机械侠不能休息！只要还有邪恶在废土横行，就绝不能休息！再见！

original: Good news, Three Dog. I already have the dish.
translation: 好消息，三狗。我已经找到你要的天线了。

original: Whoa! You must be some kind of a psychic or something!
Well, don't just stand there gawking... go bring that sucker to the Washington Monument so my lady can sing again!
translation: 好了，别傻站着，把那玩意带到华盛顿纪念碑顶，我的爱人才能再度欢唱！

original: This isn't rocket science. I know exactly what you are.
translation: 这不是什么高科技。我很清楚你是什么。

original: You amaze me. Never have I met a human with the gift of cognition that you possess.
translation: 你让我感到惊奇。我从未见过你这样感知敏锐的人类。

original: Tell me then, what are we?
I'm not here to take sides, just to make sure Vance hasn't omitted any facts.
translation: 我保持中立，只是确定万斯没有忽略任何事实。

original: I'd never thought of it that way. I suppose he should get a chance to talk to someone like you.
translation: 我从没想到这点，我想他应该和你这样的人谈谈。

original: Here's the password to his isolation area. Just please don't mention my name to Vance about this.
translation: 这是去他那区域的密码。不要把这事告诉万斯啊。

original: You always have had a knack for making me feel better.
translation: 你总有办法可以让我感觉好些。

original: What are you doing in Underworld?
I'd like to buy some ammo from you.
translation: 我想在你这里买些弹药。

original: Um... I went into the abandoned house, but I didn't see anything.
translation: 嗯…我进入了那间废屋，但我没看到任何东西。

original: Did you look? Did you really look? You can't just look with your eyes, you know.
translation: 你看了吗？你真的看了吗？你得明白，你不能只用眼睛去看。

original: You think he really looks like that little girl? He hides things. Confuses them. You have to find a way to find it.
translation: 看看布劳恩。你认为他真的像那小女孩？他把东西隐藏起来，迷惑他们。你最好想办法找到它。

original: Sounds like a deal. Here you go.
You drive a hard bargain, but it's worth every cap.
translation: 别讨价还价了，你花的每一个瓶盖都是值得的。

original: Will you give me 100 caps for it?
translation: 你愿意为它付出100个瓶盖吗？

original: Sounds like a deal. Here you go.
You drive a hard bargain, but it's worth every cap.
translation: 别讨价还价了，你花的每一个瓶盖都是值得的。

original: Will you give me 125 caps for it?
translation: 你愿意为它付出125个瓶盖吗？

original: I know, I know. I'll get a mop. It's just... blood is so hard to get out of the floor.
translation: 我知道，我知道，我去拿拖把。只是……地上的血太难清理了。

original: Well, that's been a long time coming. Good riddance.
translation: 嗯，这一天我等了好久，总算解脱了。

original: That sounds awfully complicated. Why can't I just get out the normal way?
translation: 听起来很复杂啊。为什么我不能用寻常方法呢？

original: My father's not stupid. He's sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from escaping.
translation: 我的父亲不是傻子。他封了通向出口的门，防止其他人逃出去。

original: The tunnel is the only way out! You're just going to have to trust me.
translation: 这条隧道是唯一能出去的路！你只要相信我就行了。

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: Sounds like a good plan. Let's get out of here!
translation: 听起来是不错的计划；我们走吧！

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: Want to come with me? It's dangerous out here all alone.
translation: 想跟我一起吗？离开这的路会很危险的。

original: We're back. Somebody open up the... Hang on, something' ain't right here.
translation: 我们回来了。谁来开……等等，不对头啊。

original: Stay here, boy. Don't move until I come back!
translation: 待在这，小子。在我回来之前别乱走动！

original: Okay, I'll leave. You stay here.
translation: 好的，我会离开。你待在这。

original: Well, you kept your promise. I really didn't think you would. Thank you.
translation: 好吧，你信守了你的诺言。我真的以为你做不到。谢谢。

original: The sooner we get there, the better.
Dogmeat, I need you to find something for me.
translation: 狗肉，我要你帮我找些东西。

original: All right kid. Then I guess there's nothing else we have to say to each other. Come back to me when you have the caps, and we'll talk.
translation: 好吧，孩子，我想我们之间没什么可说的，等你有了瓶盖再来。

original: Look, just give me some of your caps, and I'll tell him you're gone.
translation: 听着，给我些瓶盖，我就告诉他你已经离开了。

original: You'd do that for me? I never expected anyone to care enough.
translation: 你愿意为我这么做吗？我从没期待有人会关心我。

original: Here you go. Thanks, kid. You're all right.
translation: 给你。谢谢，孩子，你是个好人。

original: Look, just give me the caps and I'll tell him you're gone.
translation: 听着，给我些瓶盖，我就告诉他你已经离开了。

original: I am tired of hiding out here like some kind of Wasteland dog.
translation: 我厌倦了在这躲躲藏藏，就像废土上的狗一样。

original: I... I guess you're right. Here... this is all I have. Please leave me alone now.
translation: 我…我猜你是对的。给你…这是我所有的。现在让我独自待会。

original: I don't care. I'm just here for caps.
translation: 我不关心，我在这就是为了瓶盖。

original: This is never gonna end until I send him a message. Well, fine. If I have to kill you to send it, I will!
translation: 在我告诉他前，这没完！好。如果我必须杀了你，我会这么做的！

original: You can talk all you want, but I'm not leaving without the caps.
translation: 随你怎么说，不过没有瓶盖我是不会离开的。

original: You'd better calm down, before I put you down.
translation: 你最好在我干掉你之前冷静下来。

original: That lying bastard. Roped you into finding me too, huh?
translation: 那说谎的杂种派你来找我，呃？

original: Well, you're not getting a damn thing from me! You hear me?! Not a damn thing!
translation: 你没法从我这得到任何东西！你听到了吗？什么都不会给你！

original: Whoa, calm down... Who the hell is Moriarty?
translation: 哇哦，冷静下来…莫里亚蒂是他妈谁？

original: Colin Moriarty... the owner of Moriarty's Saloon in Megaton.
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂…兆吨镇里莫里亚蒂酒吧的老板。

original: That sack of shit is convinced that I'm some crazy junkie who stole money from him!
translation: 那傻子认定我是偷他钱的疯癫瘾君子！

original: Colin Moriarty... the owner of Moriarty's Saloon in Megaton.
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂…兆吨镇里莫里亚蒂酒吧的老板。

original: That sack of shit is convinced that I'm some crazy junkie who stole money from him!
translation: 那傻子认定我是偷他钱的疯癫瘾君子！

original: I don't deal with junkies. Hand over all your caps. Now!
translation: 我不和瘾君子交易，把你所有的瓶盖交出来，快！

original: You're not getting a damn thing from me! You hear me?! Not a damn thing!
translation: 你没法从我这得到任何东西！你听到了吗？什么都不会给你！

original: Just hand over the caps, and I'll be out of your way.
translation: 把你所有的瓶盖交出来，我就会放你走。

original: Owe HIM some caps? He's a liar! He just wants you to kill me! Those caps are mine, fair and square.
translation: 欠他一些瓶盖？他是一个骗子！他只想让你杀了我！那些瓶盖是我的，正大光明。

original: Yes, and he says you owe him some caps.
translation: 是的，他说你欠他一些瓶盖。

original: That bastard! He's a... he's a liar! He just wants me dead! Those caps are all mine. I earned them!
translation: 那杂种！他…他是一个骗子！他就想让我死，那些瓶盖都是我的。是我赚来的！

original: Look, I need a way to get some caps or I'll never have the money to pay you.
translation: 听着，我需要得到一些瓶盖，否则我就永远不会有钱付你。

original: Good. I hope she got what she deserved.
translation: 好的，我希望她能得到应有的下场。

original: I took care of Silver for you.
translation: 我帮你处理掉了席尔瓦。

original: You don't still offer your... services, do you?
translation: 你没有继续提供…服务了吧？

original: No, sorry. I've left that part of my life behind.
translation: 不，对不起，我已经舍弃了我昔日的那种生活。

original: Who knows. Shoot myself up until I forget who I am?
translation: 谁知道呢。自我沉沦直到忘了我是谁？

original: The Wasteland sucks, kid. Just get used to it.
translation: 废土太糟糕了，孩子，学着习惯吧。

original: Mister Crowley wants that key. Now.
translation: 考利先生要那把钥匙，现在就要！

original: You're a moron. I don't have any of his precious keys. Idiot.
translation: 你这蠢货。我没有他那把宝贝钥匙，白痴！

original: No, you'll need it more than I will.
You're right. It's dangerous out here.
I... I have to go. Before more of them come.
translation: 我…我必须走了。等下他们会来更多人。

original: I'll take that. Now get out of here.
translation: 我要它了。现在快点离开这。

original: Here, thank you again! I'm going to try to make it home... if it's still there.
translation: 拿着，再次感谢你！我要回家去了……如果它还在的话。

original: You're a liar, Moriarty. I know where I grew up.
translation: 你这骗子！莫里亚蒂，我知道我在哪长大的！

original: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
translation: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。

original: "All hail the Overseer! We're born in the Vault, we die in the Vault!" And all that other assorted lunacy.
translation: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。

original: Kid, you've got better programming than our own Deputy Weld. You'd best wise up quick. Wouldn't want anyone... takin' advantage of ya. Hmm?
translation: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？

original: You're wrong. My Dad never would have lied to me.
translation: 你错了，我爸爸从不对我说谎。

original: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
translation: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。

original: 'All hail the Overseer! We're born in the Vault; we die in the Vault!' And all that other assorted lunacy.
translation: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。

original: Kid, you've got better programming than our own Deputy Weld. You'd best wise up quick. Wouldn't want anyone... takin' advantage of ya. Hmm?
translation: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？

original: Oh, I wasn't born in the Vault? That's complete bullshit, and you know it.
translation: 哦，我不是出生于避难所的？那纯粹是胡说，你知道的。

original: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
translation: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。

original: 'All hail the Overseer! We're born in the Vault; we die in the Vault!' And all that other assorted lunacy.
translation: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。

original: Kid, you've got better programming than our own Deputy Weld. You'd best wise up quick. Wouldn't want anyone... takin' advantage of ya. Hmm?
translation: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？

original: My Dad told me we were born in Vault 101...
translation: 我爸爸告诉我，我们都是在101号避难所出生的……

original: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
translation: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。

original: 'All hail the Overseer! We're born in the Vault; we die in the Vault!' And all that other assorted lunacy.
translation: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。

original: Kid, you've got better programming than our own Deputy Weld. You'd best wise up quick. Wouldn't want anyone... takin' advantage of ya. Hmm?
translation: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？

original: Stay here. Maybe I'll come back for you.
translation: 待在这儿。说不定我会回来接你。

original: I can't take you right now, stay here. I'll come back for you.
translation: 我现在不能带着你，呆在这里。我会回来找你的。

original: You mentioned something about Galaxy News Radio?
translation: 你提到了银河新闻电台？

original: Well, the Brotherhood needed a secure outpost, and the guy who runs the radio station needed to not get his head ripped off by Super Mutants.
translation: 嗯，兄弟会需要一个安全的前哨站，而电台的那家伙不想被超级变种人撕掉脑袋。
这是一种互助互惠的关系。
