You really want to help? Take this. It's an internal component from the very android you're searching for. Don't ask how I obtained it.
translation: 你真的想帮忙？拿上这个。这是你要找的人造人的一个零件。别问我是怎么得来的。

original: Present it to Doctor Zimmer in Rivet City. Tell him the android is dead, and that was on the corpse. He'll believe you.
translation: 给铆钉城的齐默博士看这零件，告诉他这人造人死了，零件是从尸体上找到的。他会相信你。

original: Do that, and Zimmer will go back to the Commonwealth, and leave that poor soul alone. Do that, and you'll have saved a man's life.
translation: 做完这件事，齐默会回到联邦，放过那可怜家伙。做完这件事，你将拯救一个人的生命。

original: Oh, dear. Is that old radio on the fritz again? I should turn it off.
translation: 哦，亲爱的。老收音机又出问题了？我应该关掉它。

original: Yeah, run along and cry now!
Shut up before I pound you!
Not much, I guess. Apart from keeping you dumbasses in line, that is.
translation: 我想不多。除了管好你们这群蠢货。

original: Just talking to morons who keep bugging me. Scram!
translation: 去和那些不停打扰我的蠢货说话。滚开！

original: Fun times and laughs as always!
Cool junk and collecting, as always!
I was running so fast, I thought my legs were gonna fly off, but then they didn't, which makes sense, 'cause legs don't have wings. You know?
translation: 我飞快地跑，我想我的腿都快要飞出去了，不过它们没有，那是什么意思，因为腿没有翅膀。你知道吗？

original: Keeping everyone from killing themselves. Same as ever.
translation: 和以前一样，阻止人们自相残杀。

original: Watching after the younger kids and seeing if they can't accidentally learn a thing or two. You know how it goes.
translation: 观察这些年纪轻轻的孩子，看他们能否意外学会一些事情。你知道怎么做。

original: Not much. Still trying to find a way to turn this fungus into something that doesn't taste like toenails.
translation: 不多。还在想办法把这些蘑菇变成尝起来不像脚趾甲的东西。

original: I got a new tooth today! It was just lying there and now it's mine!
translation: 我长了颗新牙！它就躺在那，现在它是我的了！

original: Hello, there. What're you up to? Not getting into too much trouble?
translation: 你好，你忙什么呢？没什么麻烦吧？

original: Oh hey! What's happening? Something fun?
translation: 哦，嗨！发生什么事？有趣吗？

original: Everything fine down here in paradise? What's happening?
translation: 天堂一切都好？发生了什么？

original: Sure, here you go and you don't owe me a single cap.
translation: 当然，拿好，你不欠我瓶盖。

original: Well, that's awfully generous of you seeing as I never made a deal with you in the first place.
translation: 你可真大方，我并没有首先和你达成协议呢。

original: But I guess it's pretty decent of you not to sell it to someone else instead. Thanks, kid.
translation: 不过你没有把它卖给别人，还真是实在人。谢谢，孩子。

original: I'll sell it to you...for 300 caps.
translation: 我会把它卖给你……300个瓶盖。

original: Fine, fine. Anything to get it! Here's your caps, now hand it over.
translation: 好吧，好吧，怎么都行！给你瓶盖，交货。

original: Hang on a second. You want it, you need to pay for it.
translation: 等一下，既然你要它，你就得出钱。

original: Okay. Seeing as I was going to pay Grady anyway, here's the caps I owed him. Now, lemme have it.
translation: 好吧，既然我反正要付钱给格雷迪，我把还欠他的瓶盖给你。现在把它给我吧。

original: Hey, thanks a bunch for bringing it to me. You could have been a jerk and sold it to someone else, but you didn't.
translation: 喂，多谢你把它带给我。你本来可以把它卖给别人，但你没有。

original: Ah hell, let me give you the rest of the caps I was gonna give Grady anyway.
translation: 啊，他妈的，让我把欠格雷迪的瓶盖给你吧。

original: Okay... okay. Here. No need for violence.
Yeah. That's what I thought. Now scram!
Tell me exactly who you are. Who you really are.
translation: 确切地告诉我你是谁，你真是的身份是什么。

original: Why do you torment me? You know who I am. You know that I am really Doctor Braun, that I created this place...
translation: 你为什么要折磨我？你知道我是谁。你知道我真是的布劳恩博士，我创造了这地方……

original: And now I'm trapped here. It's all your fault.
translation: 而且现在我被困在这了，都是你的错。

original: Hmmm, so you wanna live life on the wild side, huh? Okay. Go for it.
translation: 嗯，那么你是要到野外去谋生了，呃？好吧，去吧。

original: Yeah, as soon as you bring me some more Sugar Bombs.
translation: 是啊，只要你带给我更多糖麦弹。

original: Have you ever heard of The Family?
Sure. I stay away from them and they don't bother me. It's a good relationship. They live somewhere East of here.
translation: 当然，我不找他们的麻烦，他们也不打搅我，我们和平共处。他们就住这东边的某个地方。

original: If you're feeling foolish, I think there's an underground way through to their place deeper into the metro station here.
translation: 你要是够愚蠢，我想这的地铁站下面有地道通到他们住的位置。

original: Here's all the Sugar Bombs I've got.
Good... good. There's more out there, so go and find it.
translation: 好的……好的……外边还有更多，继续去找吧。

original: Nice work. The Ultrajet's coming along nicely.
translation: 干得好。超级杰特的进展很好。

original: Make it 30 caps each and you got yourself a deal.
Fine, anything to get what I need. Now scram, I got some preparing to do!
translation: 好吧，怎么都行。走开，我还有事！

original: I changed my mind. I'll go with you to Rivet City.
translation: 我改变了主意，我会和你去铆钉城。

original: I'm sorry to hear that. I hope you'll consider meeting me in Rivet City.
translation: 听到这我很遗憾。我希望你能考虑去铆钉城见我。

original: I changed my mind. I'm not going to go with you right now.
translation: 我改变了主意，我现在不会和你去。

original: That's good to hear. Let's not waste any time.
translation: 很好，我们别浪费时间了。

original: Make it 400 caps and it's all yours.
Nicely played; and I know talent when I see it.
translation: 打得好；天才我看一眼就知道。

original: Here you go. Okay team, let's get out of here.
translation: 给你。队员们，让我们离开这。
那是团队协作！明智的选择。

original: Okay team, let's get out of here.
May I have the key to the Research Safe?
translation: 我可以拿一下研究室保险箱的钥匙吗？

original: Certainly, allow me to whip up a copy for you.
translation: 当然，我这就给您复制一把。

original: There you are. Have a wonderful and productive day!
translation: 给，祝您今天过得高效且充实！

original: I've gotten word that a band of mercs called Reilly's Rangers were trapped on a D.C. rooftop, pinned down by Super Mutants.
translation: 我获得消息，一队名叫“莱莉的游骑兵”的雇佣兵被困在了特区的一处楼顶上，他们被超级变种人缠了。
我杀了伦德斯·普朗基特。

original: Well, it's about time someone put that bastard out of his misery.
translation: 嗯，这杂种到了脱离苦海的时候。

original: And here's the reward for it. Spend it well, Lawbringer.
translation: 这是你的奖赏，好好用，执法悍将。

original: A place called Underworld. It's a Ghoul city down in D.C. I set off up here to find adventure and fortune. And... well... I found this place.
translation: 一个叫冥界的地方。那是位于特区的尸鬼之城。我跑到这儿来闯荡，寻找刺激和钱财。结果……唉，就找到这破地方。

original: I'm sort of stuck here. Colin says that I can't leave until I pay off my debt to him. Of course, he charges me room and board too.
translation: 我算是被困在这儿了。科林说我没还清欠他的债前不准走。当然，他连食宿费都要收我的。

original: If you ever get to Underworld, tell Carol that I said hi.
translation: 要是你哪天去了冥界城，替我向卡洛尔问声好。

original: No one touch Antler but ME!
translation: 除了我没人可以碰鹿角！

original: Your eyes on Antler! Stop looking!
Come to think of it, sabotage is a great idea.
translation: 仔细想想，还是破坏了比较好。

original: Then bring me Sugar Bombs. Three boxes should do the trick. Add those to the fuel mixture and "Boom!"
translation: 那就带一些甜麦炮弹给我。三盒应该就够了。把它们加到燃料混合物中，然后就"轰！"

original: I'll show those rotten Ghouls! And they'll know exactly who did them in!
translation: 我要给那些腐烂的尸鬼一点颜色瞧瞧！到时候他们就会后悔的！

original: Then bring me Sugar Bombs. Three boxes should do the trick. Add those to the fuel mixture and "Boom!"
translation: 那就带一些甜麦炮弹给我。三盒应该就够了。把它们加到燃料混合物中，然后就"轰！"

original: I'll show those rotten Ghouls! And they'll know exactly who did them in!
translation: 我要给那些腐烂的尸鬼一点颜色瞧瞧！到时候他们就会后悔的！

original: [SUCCEEDED] Oh god! You're telling me the truth, aren't you...?
translation: [成功] 上帝啊！你告诉我的都是事实，不是吗？

original: Oh no! How could they do this to me? For two years? My god, I've been a joke to them!
translation: 哦，不！他们怎么能这么对我？整整两年？上帝啊，对他们来说我就是个笑话！

original: Do you have any idea how easy it'd be for me to sabotage those rockets? That'd be a joke, huh? One hell of a joke!
translation: 你知道破坏那些火箭对我来说有多容易吗？那才是个笑话，对吧？一个该死的笑话！

original: Jason told me himself. The Great Journey is for Ghouls only. You're not going.
translation: 杰森亲自交代，只有尸鬼能进行伟大旅程。你不能去。

original: [FAILED] I see your ploy, smoothskin. I won't fall for your trap. You can plainly see that I'm a Ghoul myself. You can't turn me against my flock.
translation: [失败] 我早看穿你的把戏了，滑皮子。我不会着你的道的。你我都很清楚，我是个尸鬼。别想挑拨离间。

original: You wouldn't trust a Ghoul, would you?
translation: 你不会信任一个尸鬼的，对吧？

original: Your pranks won't work on me, smoothskin. They won't work on Jason, either.
translation: 你那些玩笑对我没用，滑皮子。对杰森也不会有用的。

original: Big room. Metal staircase. East side of the building. Is that too many syllables for you?
translation: 大楼的东侧，大厅，铁楼梯。这么简单还记不住？

original: Tell me again how to find you.
translation: 再给我讲一次怎么能找到你。

original: Like I said, find the metal staircase in the big room on the east side of the building. It's where they used to make rockets.
translation: 我说了，在大楼东侧的大厅里，有一座铁楼梯。沿着那儿走就能找到他们用来制造火箭的地方了。

original: Who I am doesn't matter, smoothskin. Stop wasting time and get up here.
translation: 我是谁并不重要，滑皮子。别浪费时间了，赶紧上来。

original: I am Jason Bright, the prophet of the Great Journey. All the Ghouls you see here are members of my flock.
translation: 我是辐光杰森，是伟大旅程的领路人。这里所有的尸鬼，都是我的徒众。

original: Any idea what the NCR's up to in Primm?
translation: 你知道NCR在普瑞姆做什么吗？

original: Your guess's as good as mine. Probably better.
translation: 我也在猜呢。不过也许你猜得更准。

original: Have you heard if the NCR has any plans to attack the prison north of here?
translation: 你听说过NCR有进攻北面监狱的计划吗？

original: ...then you bring your second unit up to provide covering fire, like so...
translation: …然后，把你的第二小队调往前线提供掩护，就像这样…

original: You mess with a man's radio, and he might take it personal like, you hear?
translation: 你再随便乱动别人的收音机，我可能就不会对你客气了，听见没？

original: Hey Jason, your rockets are ready!
translation: 嗨，杰森，你的火箭准备就绪！

original: What do you protect your town from?
translation: 你主要负责防卫什么东西？

original: You name it. Anything that comes within a thousand yards that looks like trouble.
translation: 多了去了。一千码以内所有可疑的东西都是我的目标。

original: Lately we been getting Ghouls, coming from the road to REPCONN, out to the west. Quite a few, last couple days.
translation: 最近我们遇到了尸鬼袭击，他们是沿着西边瑞普康工厂的那条路过来的。这几天数量还不少。

original: The big threat is the Legion coming from the East. If they decide to attack with a full force they'll run us over. But so far we been lucky.
translation: 不过更大的威胁是东面的军团。如果他们动起真格来，不费吹灰之力就能把我们踩死。但目前我们还算幸运。

original: That armor isn't working. Leave it there.
translation: 这装甲没用了。把它丢了吧。

original: Good luck killing something with that. Thing's busted.
translation: 这东西要是还能杀人就神了。它已经报废了。

original: If by some chance you want to find me again, and if by some even greater chance coyotes haven't picked my bones clean, I'll be at my shack.
translation: 如果你想找我，而我还也没被郊狼吃个精光的话，那你可以在我的棚屋里找到我。

original: You'll do fine. Farewell, mi amigo.
translation: 你会没事的。保重，我的朋友。

original: Anything's better than staying here. Let's go.
translation: 总比留在这儿强。我们走吧。

original: Actually, do you want to tag along with me?
translation: 说实话，你想不想跟我一块儿走？

original: Sure, boss. I'd be happy to prolong my captivity and psychological abuse to tighten some lug nuts for you.
translation: 好的，老大。我很乐意忍受肉体和精神上的双重虐待，来帮你拧紧这些螺母的。

original: Can you repair some of my stuff?
You got the caps, I got the skills.
translation: 只要你有瓶盖，我就有技术。

original: Can you repair some of my stuff?
Sure, I'll just pull a toolbox out from behind a conveniently-placed rock and get to work.
translation: 好的，等我从附近的石头后面变个工具箱出来，我就能开始干活了。

original: Can you repair some of my stuff?
Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Let me see what you have for sale.
translation: 我看看你都有些啥好货色。

original: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
I'd like to see what you have for sale.
Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: It pleases me to see you, mistress. I owe my functional state to this human here.
translation: 很高兴见到您，夫人。我的身体机能一切正常，全仰仗这个人类。

original: Reprogram Primm Slim to serve as Primm's Sheriff.
translation: 重新汇编普瑞姆·斯利姆，调整为普瑞姆的警长。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Law Enforcement Protocols reinstated, pardner. Initializing use of force authorization... authorization found. Yee-haw!
translation: [成功] 执法数据已恢复，朋友。初始化武力使用许可…获得许可。咦哈！

original: <Reprogram Primm Slim to serve as Primm's Sheriff.>
translation: <重新汇编普瑞姆·斯利姆，调整为普瑞姆的警长。>

original: Show me what you have for sale.
I am ready to process our transaction.
Show me what you have for sale.
Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: You need to clean up your reputation or you're going to get me in trouble - I'll have to charge you more to keep from arousing suspicion.
translation: 你最好先把自己的坏名声洗干净，否则你会给我惹麻烦的。为了避免怀疑，我得多收你钱。

original: Is there any place to buy weapons and armor?
translation: 这里有没有能买到武器和弹药的地方？

original: I think there a few places, but I've heard that the Gun Runners sell the best.
translation: 这里是有个卖枪的地方，不过我听说军火贩子的货是最好的。

original: Where can I find a doctor around here?
translation: 在这附近，哪能找到医生？

original: Doctor Usanagi runs a medical clinic up the road.
translation: 宇佐木医生在前面经营着一家小诊所。
我会把你丈夫尸体带回来的。

original: Esteban's body is laid out between some buildings, east of the REPCONN headquarters. At least, that's what his squadmates said.
translation: 埃斯特班的尸体就躺在楼栋之间，位于瑞普康总部的东边。至少他的战友是这么说的。

original: There's an NCR position just north of there. It's on the way. They should be able to tell you what the situation is.
translation: NCR有个哨站就设在那儿的北面。如果你顺路经过那里的话，他们应该会把具体情形告诉你。

original: I'd like to buy some supplies.
The brass are pissed about the trouble you've been causing. Your caps are no good here.
translation: 上司对你糟糕的表现非常不满意。你有钱也没用。

original: Maybe you didn't hear me the first time. No service for scumbags!
translation: 看来上次你是没听清。我们不卖东西给卑鄙小人！

original: Hey, I heard you were able to recover Morales' corpse. In thanks, you get a discount on supplies.
translation: 嘿，我听说你找回了莫拉莱斯的尸体。作为感谢，你在我这儿可以享受折扣。

original: That was a real honorable thing you done there, kid. Much appreciated.
translation: 你做的事非常光荣，孩子。十分感谢。
目前我手上有的就是这些了。

original: With your reputation? Well, I won't say your caps are no good here... let's just say that they're... less good.
translation: 就凭你现在的名声？怎么说呢，虽然你的钱在我这儿是可以用……但也确实…不那么好用。

original: I'd like to buy some food.
Sorry, but the brass ordered me to not serve enemies of NCR.
translation: 对不起，上司命令我不得向NCR的敌人提供服务。

original: I don't like your kind taking food from my men, so I'm going to charge you a little extra. Don't like it? Tough.
translation: 我不喜欢你这样的家伙和我的弟兄们抢饭吃，所以我要额外收你钱。不满意？一边去。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
All right, then. Hopefully I've got something to wet your whistle.
translation: 好的，希望我这儿的东西能帮你润润喉。

original: Come talk to me when I'm in my store and I'll be glad to do business with you.
translation: 等我回店里的时候再来找我吧，我会很乐意与你做生意的。

original: That was some fine doctoring. I could learn a thing or two from you!
translation: 医术确实不错。我都能从中学到一两手呢！

original: Motor-Runner told me he was going to pick up some more when the Khans come back through.
translation: 轰鸣扼杀告诉我他准备在大汗帮回来的时候再多买一些。

original: Yeah, me too. Gonna have to go hit the boss for a fix soon.
translation: 是啊，我也是。得去老板那里多搞几支来。

original: Shit. I gotta go find something to take the edge off.
translation: 糟糕，我要找点东西缓缓这劲头。

original: Me too. I think I need a fix.
translation: 我也是，我可能得去爽一下。

original: I got it from my buddy. I think he made it himself.
translation: 是从我伙计那儿搞到的。我觉得是他自己做的。

original: Fuck! I did too. I'm not doing well.
Damn, I gotta find some shit.
translation: 见鬼，我得想法子爽一下。

original: Nope, not for you at least.
What were you doing down in that cave?
translation: 你当时在那个洞里干什么呢？

original: The mantises and spore plants virtually ignored me for most of the time that I've been here.
translation: 我踏入避难所后，那些螳螂和孢子植物多数时候都无视我。

original: It was only once I began to investigate the fifth level that my presence began to agitate them. I guess I was a little too close to home for them.
translation: 但是当我开始调查第五层时，我似乎刺激到了它们。我猜可能是因为我离它们的巢穴太近了。

original: A few days ago, I was attacked by a large number of mantises and was knocked unconscious. When I woke up, I was in that cave.
translation: 几天之前，我被一大群螳螂攻击，失去了知觉。当我醒来的时候，就躺在那个洞里了。

original: The mantises seem to feed some of their prey to the plants. Fortunately for me, it appears the plants are disinclined to eat Ghoul meat.
translation: 那些螳螂似乎会给孢子植物喂食猎物。不过我挺走运，那些植物好像不愿意吃尸鬼肉。

original: Must have been some NCR. I know they've been gunning for him.
translation: 一定是NCR的人干的，我知道他们在追杀他。

original: Damn, are you serious? He was one tough son of a bitch.
translation: 该死，你说真的？那狗娘养的东西可猛着呢。
很好，我本来就讨厌那混蛋。

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}Move it! Move it! Move it! Get those legs up you sorry bastards!
translation: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}动起来！动起来！动起来！把腿抬起来，你们这群可怜的混蛋！

original: Have you seen a Ghoul named Keely around here?
translation: 你见过一名叫基利的尸鬼吗？

original: Mmm-hm. [Points to stump of tongue in his mouth.]
translation: 嗯，哈。[从他嘴里露出残缺的舌头。]

original: I have bo go bow. Goobye!
Your plan worked. The plane floated up. Seemed to be intact.
translation: 你的计划成功了。飞机漂上来了。看起来还挺完好。

original: That's tremendous! I'll transmit instructions to the robots to start packing up the plane to bring it back to Nellis!
translation: 太壮观了！我马上给机器人发指令，把飞机打包带回内利斯！

original: And you're even more handsome up close. Do you think it'll be okay if I hang around here for a little while, so we can get to know each other better?
translation: 近了看你更帅了。我能不能在这儿多呆一会儿，好让咱俩有机会多了解一下对方呢？

original: Hi there, it's great to meet you as well.
translation: 嘿，你好，我也很高兴能见到你。

original: Sgt. McCredie asked me to talk to you about getting your squad in shape.
translation: 麦克雷迪军士派我来和你商量该怎么整顿你的小队。

original: Yeah, what about it? I told you, we need marksmanship and explosive handling improvements.
translation: 怎么样？我跟你说过，我们需要射击以及爆破练习。

original: Like I said, you get the juice, we'll cut loose.
translation: 我说了，只要你搞到药，我们天王老子都不怕。

original: About getting the squad's readiness reports up...
translation: 关于提高队伍成绩这件事...

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: {Positive Rep Bonus}Got a special discount for you, after what you done for us.
translation: {Positive Rep Bonus}你帮了我们这么多，我会给你打个特别折扣。

original: I'm sure I've got something you'll like.
translation: 我保证有你喜欢的东西。

original: Now I know what they mean by "dumb luck"!
translation: 现在我知道他们说的"傻人有傻福"是什么意思了！

original: Were you exaggerating your knowledge of medicine? Even I would've known not to do that!
translation: 你不是刚夸耀过自己的医术有多么高明吗？连我都知道那种事不能做！

original: Well, if you're heading back out there, you ought to have this.
translation: 如果你想出去的话，我建议你最好戴上这个。

original: They call it a Pip-Boy. I grew up in one of them vaults they made before the war. We all got one.
translation: 他们管这玩意叫哔哔小子。我是在战前建造的避难所中长大的，所以我们人人都有一个。

original: Ain't much use to me now, but you might want such a thing, after what you been through. I know what it's like, having something taken from you.
translation: 现在我用不着了，但你应该用得上，毕竟你遭了这么多罪。我能理解你，那种被人抢了的感受。

original: And put this on, too, so the locals don't pick on you for lacking modesty. Was my wife's.
translation: 把这个也穿上吧，不然本地人会嫌弃你衣冠不整的。这衣服曾经是属于我妻子的。

original: I think she was about your size, and she hardly wore it after we left the vault. Felt it was too brazen.
translation: 我想你和她个头应该差不多，我们离开避难所后她就很少穿了。感觉太招摇了。

original: And put this on, too, so the locals don't pick on you for lacking modesty. Never was much my style anyway.
translation: 把这个也穿上吧，不然本地人会嫌弃你衣冠不整的。反正我也穿不惯这套行头。

original: You should talk to Sunny Smiles before you leave town. She can help you learn to fend for yourself in the desert. She'll likely be at the saloon.
translation: 在离开小镇之前，你应该去和微笑桑妮谈谈。她能教你如何在沙漠中生存。她应该就在酒吧里。

original: I reckon some of the other folks at the saloon might be able to help you out, too. And the metal fella, Victor, who pulled you outta your grave.
translation: 我想酒吧里其他人也能帮上你。还有把你从坟墓里拉出来的金属伙计，维克多。

original: Anyway, you ever get hurt out there, you come right back. I'll fix you up.
translation: 不管怎样，如果你在外面受了伤，可以尽管回来找我。我会替你疗伤的。

original: But try not to get killed anymore.
Oh, that's right! Here, let me show you what I've got on hand.
translation: 噢，那就对了！来，瞧瞧我手头都有些什么好东西。

original: Now, I don't know about you, but old Festus here never met a bandit that felt anything akin to remorse.
translation: 我不知道你怎么想，但在老费斯特斯看来，天底下就没什么有良心的强盗。

original: The sheriff suggested that maybe the bandits, in a fit of remorse, delivered the items. After taking all of the stranger's money, of course.
translation: 治安管猜测强盗大概是良心发现，才把东西偷偷送了过来，不过他还是抢走了陌生人身上所有的钱。

original: Don't pitch it like a baseball, lob it. You want a good, solid arc.
translation: 别把它当棒球，要扔高点。尽量丢出一个完美的抛物线。

original: [FAILED] They're kind of heavy for that, but whatever you say...
translation: [失败] 丢直线的话，这分量有点太沉了吧……不过听你的...

original: Now, um... really whip them downrange. Like you're throwing a fastball!
translation: 呃……对着目标使劲甩出去就行了。就像丢直球一样！

original: Okay, to start, pull the pin, let it cook off for a count of three, then throw.
translation: 好的，首先，拉开保险，握好手雷数到三，再扔出去。

original: [FAILED] I've got a bad feeling about this...
Okay, count to three, throw the grenade, and pull the pin. Wait, no...
translation: 好吧，数到三，扔出手雷，再拉开保险。等等，不...

original: You can really get hurt out there.
translation: 你需要更加小心，在外面很容易受伤的。

original: Well, I already told you I came from a vault. After that, was a traveling doctor for a spell.
translation: 好吧，我告诉过你了，我是从避难所来的。离开避难所后，我当了一段时间的游医。

original: Seemed like a good idea at the time. Most folks out here ain't educated, so people with medical know-how are hard to come by.
translation: 当时这份营生还不错。因为这儿大多数人从来没受过什么教育，更别提懂医术了。

original: Found that I could help a lot of people with what I knew, and that was all right with me.
translation: 我发现我所学的知识能帮助很多人，感觉还挺好的。

original: Eventually, I went back and married my childhood sweetheart and that was the end of my traveling days. Didn't miss it none then. Still don't.
translation: 后来，我回去和我的青梅竹马结了婚，游医的日子也结束了。我一点也不怀念那段时光。一点也不。
介绍一下你自己吧，医生。

original: Shouldn't take more than a couple minutes. Especially with two of us.
translation: 应该不会花太多时间。何况咱们又是两个人。

original: Now, see those sarsaparilla bottles on that fence there? Take this and try to hit a couple of 'em.
translation: 好了，你看到栅栏上面那些沙士瓶子了吗？拿上这个，试试看你能不能打下一两个来。

original: That was some fine doctoring. I could learn a thing or two from you!
translation: 医术确实不错。我能从中学到一两手呢！

original: Yep, I'd say you're getting a little trigger happy there. Try to slow down a bit. Concentrate on hitting your target.
translation: 对，要我说，你开枪的速度有点快了。尽量慢下来。集中精神，确保能打中目标。

original: Here. Go easy on it, now. Ammo can be hard to come by out here.
translation: 给。少花一点。弹药很珍贵的。

original: Caught a rumor the other day that some of the clientele over at the Wrangler have been making some rather strange requests.
translation: 我听到外面有谣言说最近原子牛仔里的一些顾客要求越来越奇怪了。

original: Stuff like weirdos wanting the, ahem, services of Ghouls and such. I almost have half a mind to volunteer myself, sexy beast that I am.
translation: 有些怪人想要，咳咳，尸鬼服务什么的。我差点就去报名了，你看我也还算性感。

original: There was a rumor a while back that the White Glove Society was really an all-Ghoul gang, which is why they wear those weird masks of theirs.
translation: 有传言说白手套社团是一个全都由尸鬼组成的团体，所以他们平常都带着奇怪的面具。

original: What do you think, would I look good in a mask? Maybe I'd make more caps...
translation: 你说，我戴面具会不会好看？或许我还能挣到更多瓶盖呢……

original: I'd like to see what you have on tap.
translation: 我想看看你这儿都有什么现成的东西。

original: Caps up front. We don't do tabs here.
What guns do you have for sale?
What do you have in stock?
Lets see... You've got that thingy... there. Power, uh, re-circulators here...
translation: 我看看……你怎么还有那个玩意……电力，呃，这儿还有循环泵...

original: That's it. What do you think?
Jesus, kid, I think we got a real problem on our hands. Can't believe Benny's a no-good stinkin' punk. Trying to play House like that...
translation: 上帝啊，孩子，我想我们遇上大麻烦了。真不敢相信，本尼居然是个不好安心的孬种，敢那样愚弄豪斯先生...

original: Tell you what - I'll call Benny, keep him away from his suite. You go search the place. Here's the key, it's on the 13th floor.
translation: 这样吧——我会吸引本尼的注意，你趁他不在的时候搜下他的房间。这是钥匙，就在13楼。

original: It's the room with the double doors, can't miss it. Maybe you'll find something we can show to Mr. House and get him arrested.
translation: 有双扇门的那个房间，你不会搞错的。说不定你还能找到些证据，这样我们就可以报告豪斯先生，把他抓起来了。
附近发生了不平常的事么？

original: There was a hell of a boom over at REPCONN. Looks like the Ghouls had some sort of accident with their rockets.
translation: REOCONN发生了大爆炸。看起来那些尸鬼的火箭出了点问题。

original: Do you have anything for sale?
Not for someone like you. My customers would shit a brick if they knew I sold anything to you.
translation: 对你不卖。如果我的客人知道我卖东西给你的话，他们肯定会来找茬的。

original: If you need help cleaning up your rep around Freeside, I might be able to help... for a price.
translation: 如果你想恢复自己在自由城的名声，我倒是可以帮忙……不过你需要给我一点好处。

original: I see you brought a friend! Sorry, pardner, but they're gonna have to stay outside.
translation: 我看到你带了个朋友来！抱歉，伙计，他们只能在外面等着。

original: I see you brought some friends! Sorry, pardner, but they're gonna have to stay outside.
translation: 我看到你带了些朋友来！抱歉，伙计，他们只能在外面等着。

original: Use Medicine skill to surmise House's condition.
translation: 使用医疗技能来诊断豪斯的现状。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I see you've made a study of the topic. My knowledge of the science of longevity would fill several text books...
translation: [成功] 看得出来你做过些研究。有关延长寿命的科学手段，这方面的知识我都能写好几本书了……

original: Perhaps, after a decade or two of economic reconstruction, I can commercialize these technologies and offer to others, such as yourself.
translation: 也许再过一、二十年，等经济复苏了，我就会将这项技术商业化，让其他人也能享受，比如你。

original: The lifespan you're claiming is impossible, except for Ghouls and Super Mutants.
translation: 你的生命周期不可能这么长，除非你是尸鬼或变种人。

original: I have Vault gear for you.
translation: 我带了些避难所的装备给你。

original: You do? That's wonderful! Let me see what you brought.
translation: 真的？太好了！让我看看你带什么来了。

original: All right! That's going to net you lots of caps, my friend. Do you want to trade all your vault suits right now?
translation: 棒极了！朋友，这些避难所服装可值一大笔钱呢。你愿意现在就出手吗？

original: Let's see what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Hey. Thanks for helping me out. Being back and working really saved my life.
translation: 嘿。谢谢你救了我。回来工作让我感觉好多了。

original: Can't talk. Much work to do at the Fort and Atomic Wrangler.
translation: 没空说话。我在城堡和原子牛仔还有很多活要干。

original: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
Give me the Thermite and I'll destroy the weapons.
translation: 给我铝热剂，我要销毁那些武器。

original: Okay, here's the Thermite and a key to the room where the guns are stored. Place the Thermite on the crates in the room.
translation: 好的，这是铝热剂和储藏武器的房间的钥匙。记得把铝热剂放到屋内的板条箱上。

original: I rigged the light switch outside the room to kick off a spark big enough to hold the Thermite. That should turn that shit into molten slag.
translation: 我已经在屋外装了个电灯开关，碰出的火花应该可以引燃那些铝热剂。这样一来，那些武器很快就会熔成一堆废渣。

original: As soon as we're done talking I'm going to make myself like a ghost. I don't want to be anywhere near here when the bosses find out.
translation: 等咱们说完话，我也该出去避避风头了。我可不想出了事以后还在这儿坐以待毙。

original: Could you repair some things for me?
translation: 你能帮我修复一些物品吗？

original: Sure, let's see what you've got.
Hey, here is that gun I promised you. I suggest using it while they are talking, I'm pretty sure they're going to kill you after they've talked.
translation: 嘿，这是我答应给你的枪。我建议你趁他们说话的时候就马上动手。要是等他们说完，你就死定了。

original: Hey, I'll take care of them when you're ready, just say the word. I suggest doing it while they're talking to get the drop on them.
translation: 嘿，等你准备好了，我就解决他们，到时听你口令。我建议趁他们说话的时候就动手，先发制人。

original: Oh, that makes me so happy! You are too much!
translation: 哦，真让我高兴！你太好了！

original: I've bugged the tower for you.
translation: 我已经在高塔的网络里植入了监听程序。

original: We haven't received any information yet from the bug. Please report back when you've found a way into House's network.
translation: 我们至今还没有收到来自监听器的任何信息。如果你找到了进入豪斯网络的方法，请务必通知我们。

original: I've bugged the tower for you. <lie>
translation: 我帮你在塔楼上安装了窃听器。 <撒谎>

original: What sort of "proclivities" are we talking about?
Our wealthiest client has a thing for Ghouls, and a thing for cowboys. He wants an escort who can satisfy both fetishes.
translation: 我们最大的金主对尸鬼和牛仔有特殊情结。他想找个能在这两方面满足他的私人伴游。

original: Plenty of customers have said they'd be willing to pay extra for a suave talker, someone who can fake the "boyfriend experience" real good.
translation: 不少客人提出，愿意支付额外的费用，找个温柔体贴，有"男朋友"感觉的人。

original: And then there's these disgusting robot fetishists you may have heard about? Well, those creeps want a sexbot.
translation: 此外，还有一些恶心的变态，对机器人有特殊癖好，你听说过吗？那帮家伙居然想要找性爱机器人。

original: Have you ever run across a sexbot? Not that I'd ever want one within 100 feet of me - but I gotta be a businessman about it.
translation: 你见过这类机器人吗？当然，我本人绝对不敢接近这类东西100英尺以内……但我毕竟是个生意人。

original: I want you not to attack enemies unless I've already engaged them.
translation: 如果我没有动手，你也不要擅自攻击敌人。

original: I think I may have misheard that order.
Oh, do I have to? That's not nearly as much fun!
translation: 哦，我必须这样做吗？那看上去没什么意思！
那看起来幼稚得不可思议。

original: I've had no compelling reason to do anything different from what you asked.
translation: 我对你的要求没有疑问。

original: Are you out of your fuckin' mind?
translation: 你他妈是不是脑子坏了？

original: Yes, dearie, that's what {gramma}grandma's been doing. And Leo isn't happy about it, either.
translation: 是的，甜心，奶奶一直就是这么做的。但是利奥可不喜欢那样。

original: {Concerned}Ohh, Leo's not going to like that...
I want you to attack enemies the moment you see them.
translation: 我要你看到敌人就马上攻击他们。

original: I must have been hearing things.
They shall know the power of my steel!
translation: 他们应当知道我铁棍的威力！

original: Oh, time for fun already? Goody!
I suppose I should test you out before I hand you to the Garrets...
translation: 在把你交给加勒特前，我觉得应该先测试一下你的性能…

original: I spoke to Clanden, and I couldn't get anything out of him.
translation: 我和克兰顿谈过了，但没套出什么话。

original: Yeah, this is Clanden. This guy is one sick motherfucker. The way I see it, you have a few options.
translation: 没错，是克兰顿，这个烂杂种。我觉得你有好几种办法来对付他。

original: Maybe you could use what's on these tapes to get him by himself, or maybe you could use them to leverage him out of the casino.
translation: 你可以利用磁带上的这些东西引他单独出来，或者用它们来逼他离开赌场。

original: I found these tapes in Clanden's room, can you verify this is him?
translation: 我在克兰顿的房间里找到了这些磁带，你看看这是他吗？

original: Tommy Torini at the Tops is looking for musical acts, if you're interested.
translation: 九重天的汤米·托里尼正在招音乐人，你可以去看看。

original: Hmm... Maybe it's time to give these tired old bones a rest. All right, show me what you've got.
translation: 嗯…也许该让这把老骨头休息一下了。好吧，看看你究竟有什么打算。

original: Sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt.
Either you need to get your eyes checked or that "fame is fleeting" thing is true - and since I happen to be world famous, you must be going blind.
translation: 要么是你眼神不好，要么就像常言说的，"名气如流水"———不过恰好我可是名满天下，所以你肯定是瞎了。

original: Name's Hadrian. Bet you never saw a Ghoul in a suit before, huh? Course, you don't exactly strike me as the worldly type.
translation: 我叫哈德良。我打赌你从没见过穿西装的尸鬼吧？当然，我看你也不像是个等闲之辈。

original: Watch your mouth, Ghoul, or I might just rip your jaw off.
translation: 嘴巴干净点，尸鬼，否则我撕烂你的嘴。

original: I hear you have some exotic tastes when it comes to women.
translation: 我听说你品鉴女人的口味很特别。

original: {Annoyed}Oh did you now? What business is that of yours, and why the fuck should I care?
translation: {Annoyed}哦，你知道？那又跟你有什么关系呢，我干嘛要听你说这个？

original: Let me see what you have.
translation: 让我看看你这儿都有什么。

original: We're pretty short-handed as it is, but I suppose I could spare a few items.
translation: 我们的库存很紧张，但匀一些出来给你应该没有问题。

original: I'd like to buy medical supplies.
We don't have a lot right now, but this is what I can offer for sale.
translation: 我们的存货不多，能卖的也就这些了。

original: Here is what we have available.
Good. Look around and get a feel for where customers and risks can enter and exit the area while I get your gear ready.
translation: 很好。我去给你弄套行头，你可以趁这几分钟四处看看，目测一下哪些地方可以出入。

original: Okay. A couple rounds of RadAway should do it.
translation: 好的。几袋辐特宁就能解决问题了。

original: Okay. A couple rounds of RadAway should do it.
translation: 好的。几袋辐特宁就能解决问题了。

original: Okay. A couple rounds of RadAway should do it.
translation: 好的。几袋辐特宁就能解决问题了。

original: Hold still. The RadAway burns a little.
translation: 别动。辐特宁会有一点灼痛。

original: Hold still. The RadAway burns a little.
translation: 别动。辐特宁会有一点灼痛。

original: I'll come back when I have enough.
translation: 等我钱够了我会回来的。

original: Take your time - the Ghoul's not going anywhere.
translation: 慢慢来...反正那老尸鬼哪儿也去不了。

original: I'll come back when I have enough.
translation: 等我钱够了会再回来的。

original: Take your time - the Ghoul's not going anywhere.
translation: 慢慢来...反正那老尸鬼哪儿也去不了。

original: But how much do you lose on folk not coming into a place with a Ghoul performer?
translation: 少一个尸鬼演员你能有多大损失？

original: My friend, you've got style, grace, and charm - the style of a Feral Ghoul, the grace of a Super Mutant, and the charm of a Deathclaw.
translation: 我的朋友，你很有风度，优雅，还有魅力，不过是狂尸鬼的风度，超级变种人的优雅，死亡爪的魅力。

original: I told my wife, she's good-looking for a Ghoul. It's just too bad she's not a Ghoul, ay ay ay.
translation: 我告诉我老婆，作为一个尸鬼她的确很漂亮。可惜她不是尸鬼。

original: A Ghoul goes to a doctor and says, "Doctor, Doctor, I have this horrible rash!" The Doctor says, "Son, that's called your face." Ding dong!
translation: 一个尸鬼去看大夫，他说"大夫，大夫，我起了很严重的疹子!"医生说"孩子，那就是你的脸啊。"

original: <Hushed> Would my companion here make a suitable replacement meal?
translation: <小声> 我的同伴适合当替代品吗？

original: I'm sorry, but it absolutely must be a human. Former doesn't count.
translation: 不好意思，我们要的替代品必须是人类。哪怕以前是人类也不行。

original: Very well. If you're able to convince young Mr. Gunderson to return to his father, replace him in the freezer with your friend and we'll have a deal.
translation: 很好。如果你能说服小冈德森先生回到他父亲身边，再把你的朋友作为替代品关到冷藏室里，我们就成交。

original: Tell me what I need to do.
I need a replacement, and I need the boy taken care of. The replacement must be healthy and well-bred. One can't very well make steak from gristle.
translation: 我需要一个替代品，好解决这个男孩的问题。这个替代品必须健康，并且有教养。粗人可烤不成嫩肉。

original: With so little time, we'll have to go after our original choice, Carlyle St. Clair. He lives in a shack north of here. For freshness, we need him alive.
translation: 时间太紧，只能再把原来的猎物捉回来了，卡莱尔·圣克莱尔。他住在北边的一个小棚屋里。肉要新鲜，所以别把他弄死了。

original: If you could send him here or knock him out with this and drag him into the dumpster next to his house, we can do the rest.
translation: 要么把他骗过来，要么用这玩意敲昏他，再把他拖进房子旁边的垃圾箱里，剩下的我们来处理。

original: Let me see what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Of course! I've got a special discount for special people, like you.
translation: 当然！我对特别的人可有特别优惠，比如你。

original: A friend of The Strip's a friend of mine.
translation: 长街的朋友就是我的朋友。

original: Don't get me wrong, I appreciate your business, but dealing with you carries extra costs.
translation: 别误会，我是很喜欢和你做生意，但是要卖东西给你，我可得多担一笔成本哪。

original: I'll sell to you, if only to get you out of sight as soon as possible.
translation: 我可以卖东西给你，不过你买了之后最好赶紧闪人。

original: I actually found you an escort who's a Ghoul *and* a cowboy.
translation: 我倒是真的给你找到了一个私人伴游，是个尸鬼，还是个牛仔。

original: Wow. Bringing up morale must be difficult.
translation: 哇哦。提升士气一定很困难。

original: I'd like to browse your special inventory.
translation: 我想看看你的特别目录。

original: Like I always say, a polite society is an armed society.
translation: 就像我说过的，文明社会就是武装社会。

original: I don't have any supplies to spare, but I've got caps if you have anything you don't need.
translation: 我没有任何补给品可以提供，但如果你有用不到的东西，我可以用瓶盖向你收购。

original: I don't have any supplies to spare for someone with your spotted reputation, but buy your stuff for half the going rate.
translation: 对于你这种名声的人，我没有什么补给品出售。另外，买你的东西我也只付半价。

original: You might want to brace yourself. This might get a bit painful.
translation: 你最好坚持一下，这可能会有点痛。

original: You might want to brace yourself. This might get a bit painful.
translation: 你最好坚持一下，这可能会有点痛。

original: A shot of Med-X for the pain, and you shouldn't feel... well some of what I need to do.
translation: 来支吗啡针-X镇痛，这样你应该就感觉不到……我的治疗手段了。

original: A shot of Med-X for the pain, and you shouldn't feel... well some of what I need to do.
translation: 来支吗啡针-X镇痛，这样你应该就感觉不到……我的治疗手段了。

original: You won't regret it. At least until an hour or so from now.
translation: 你绝不会后悔的。起码1小时内不会。
我说的"伴游"，指的是"卖淫"。

original: I'm all boot knives and leather, friend - and a Ghoul, besides. What kind of weirdo wants what I've got?
translation: 我满身刀疤和伤痕，朋友，而且我还是个尸鬼。会有变态喜欢我这样的？

original: Suit yourself. Gambling's thirsty work - I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 随你的便。赌博是很容易口渴的，如果您有需要，我就在这里。
你说对了，我正巧有点渴。

original: Best booze in Vegas, baby. What'll it be?
translation: 我这儿有的是维加斯最上等的酒，宝贝。来点什么？

original: I left one of my companions in the freezer for your enjoyment.
translation: 我把一个同伴留在了冷藏室里，希望你能高兴。

original: Wonderful. You have come through with flying colors. On behalf of my colleagues, allow me to extend my thanks.
translation: 太好了，你表现得太出色了。请允许我代表全体同仁向你表示感谢。

original: I know what a terrible sacrifice this must've been for you.
translation: 我知道这对你而言是个巨大的牺牲。

original: Not my problem. You want to go? You're on your own.
translation: 和我没关系。你想走？请自便。

original: Fine. If I'm on my own I'm on my own. But I'm gonna go.
translation: 行啊。要我单干，我没意见。那我就告辞了。

original: Tell the truth... I think this is exactly what I've been waiting for.
translation: 说实话…我想这就是我一直在等的东西。

original: What's fighting in the next match?
translation: 下一场战斗是什么安排？

original: Fiend prisoners will fight for their lives against Nightstalkers.
translation: 恶魔帮俘虏将为了活命和夜行兽殊死搏斗。

original: Let's get out of here. Let them have Bitter Springs.
translation: 我们走。苦泉就让给他们了。

original: You can do what you want, but I'm not going anywhere.
translation: 你想干什么都可以，但是我哪也不去。
祝你好运——你会需要好运的。

original: Watch out for her - she's one of the deadliest fighters I've ever seen.
translation: 小心点——她是我见过的最致命的战士。

original: Careful in there - he's tougher than he looks.
translation: 小心点儿——他比看上去更难对付。
你的人民发生了什么事？

original: {Proud}We were the Flails of God. The scourge of the Mojave, the best warriors and raiders in the Wasteland. Until the NCR tracked us back to Bitter Springs.
translation: {Proud}我们曾经是上帝之鞭！莫哈维的天灾，废土中最伟大的战士与劫掠者。直到有一天，NCR跟踪我们到了苦泉。

original: {Sad}The main force hit the canyon by surprise. While our warriors tried to hold them off, we sent our women, our children, our old through the Red Pass.
translation: {Sad}他们的主力部队突袭了大峡谷。在我们的战士奋力阻击敌人的同时，我们将妇孺老人顺着血红谷道送了出去。

original: NCR's First Recon Battalion was waiting for them on Coyote Tail Ridge. No Khan left alive, that was the order. {Broken}My family...
translation: NCR的第一侦察营却在狼尾山脊等着他们。“一个大汗帮也不留”，这就是他们得到的命令。{Broken}我的家人啊...

original: That's not how I want to approach this. You'd better go your own way for now.
translation: 我可不想进去。要去你自己去。

original: Better be a good reason. I didn't join up with you to go on nature walks.
translation: 你最好能有个明白点的理由。我和你搭伙可不是为了来散步观光的。

original: I don't want any trouble. We should part ways for now.
translation: 我不想惹麻烦。我们现在还是分开吧。

original: Fine. But if you make any new friends in there, all bets are off.
translation: 好的。但如果你在那边交了新朋友，那我们过往的情分就一笔勾销。

original: I'm going to do this my way. I can't bring you.
translation: 我有自己的方式。我不能带着你。

original: [Attack] You're less trouble to me dead than alive.
translation: [攻击] 对我来说，你死了可比活着好。

original: Good thing I'm still alive, then.
translation: 这样的话，我活着还真是件好事啊。

original: Then we can't work together anymore.
translation: 那我们以后就不会再共事了。

original: I should never have worked with you in the first place.
translation: 我打一开始就不该和你共事。

original: Sorry. I won't compromise my mission.
translation: 对不起。我的任务不容妥协。
那我们就在这做个了断吧。

original: [Attack] I won't be needing your services any longer.
translation: [攻击] 我啊，不再需要你的帮忙了。

original: I should never have trusted you.
Things have changed. I'm with Caesar now.
translation: 世道变了，我现在是凯撒那边儿的人了。

original: Then this is over. Next time I see you, it'll be through my scope.
translation: 那就这样吧。我下次再看到你，就要透过狙击枪的瞄准镜了。

original: Any Legion with you and I'm pulling the trigger.
translation: 只要看到有一个军团的人在你身边，我就开枪。

original: I'm... uh... helping them so I can spy on them better.
translation: 我……呃……帮他们是为了刺探更多的消息。

original: Bullshit. You're a goddamned coward, trying to pick the winning side.
translation: 屁话。你个孬种，不过是想当墙头草。

original: We will never work together again.
Why'd you come all the way out to New Vegas?
translation: 你为什么大老远地跑来新维加斯？

original: Why does anybody? I thought I'd strike it rich at the tables, make my fortune and never have to plow those damn fields again.
translation: 不就和别人一样？我以为自己能靠着赌博发大财，不必再去耕种那些该死的田地了。

original: I just wanted to provide for my family - and now they're gone. All gone. God forgive me...
translation: 我只想着养活家人，可现在他们都离开了我。都走了。上帝宽恕我吧...

original: I'm ready to fight Lupa now.
translation: 我准备好和鲁帕战斗了。

original: All right. {to Lupa}You've been a good dog, Lupa. Die well, girl.
translation: 好的。{to Lupa}你一直都是条好狗，鲁帕。愿你死得其所，老姑娘。
把鲁帕的脑子的大脑移植给雷克斯.

original: Have a seat. This will take a while.
translation: 坐一下吧。这需要点时间。
把雷伊的脑子移植给雷克斯。

original: Have a seat. This will take a while.
translation: 坐一下吧。这需要点时间。
把维奥列塔的大脑移植给雷克斯。

original: Have a seat. This will take a while.
translation: 坐一下吧。这需要点时间。

original: Okay, go ahead. I'll wait for you.
Yeah, okay... I'll shoot the lock off the door and... and then... Argh, dammit!
translation: 好的……我会一枪把门锁嘣开……然后……呃，该死 !

original: ... I can't do it, I can't. She deserves it, and worse, but I can't hurt my own mother!
translation: ……不行，我做不到。虽然她罪有应得，可我还是无法对自己的母亲下手！

original: I'm looking into the Nightstalker mutation. Want to come along with me?
translation: 我在寻找夜行兽的变种。你想和我一起来吗？

original: Oooh, those Nightstalkers, always killing my Bighorners! It'll be nice to give them a piece of my mind!
translation: 哦，那些夜行兽，总是残害我们的大角牛！我早就想给他们一点颜色看看了！

original: Show me what you have for sale.
Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 给我看看你都卖些什么。

original: I've been told you're someone I should talk to about stopping the Khans' alliance with Caesar.
translation: 有人告诉我想要阻止大汗帮和凯撒结盟，就得来找你。

original: Don't worry, Jack and I have talked it over. We'll talk up the idea of breaking the alliance.
translation: 别担心，杰克和我已经讨论过了。我们该商量一下如何破坏他们的结盟。

original: So, about the alliance with Caesar's Legion...
translation: 那么，关于与凯撒军团结盟的事情...

original: Anders got back a little while before you did, he told me what happened. If that's how the Legion treats my people, I don't want any part of them.
translation: 安德斯比你早回来了一会，他把事情都告诉我了。如果军团真的那样对待我的族人，那我绝对不想跟他们扯上任何关系。

original: So, about the alliance with Caesar's Legion...
translation: 那么，关于与凯撒军团结盟的事情...

original: Some Legionaries snuck into the camp and set off some kind of radiation bomb.
translation: 一些军团士兵混进营地，引爆了辐射炸弹。

original: I don't know where they got it, but it was damn effective. Killed almost everyone and turned the rest into Ghouls.
translation: 我不知道他们是从哪儿搞到的，但这玩意太有效了。几乎所有人都死了，没死的也变成了尸鬼。

original: None that aren't Feral Ghouls. Those poor bastards - I can't imagine how they must be suffering.
translation: 没有了，只剩下一群狂尸鬼。那些可怜的混蛋...我真的没法想象他们遭受的痛苦。

original: I'd like to put them out of their misery but I don't have the heart to do it. Can you do me a favor?
translation: 我很想亲手结束他们的痛苦，可我下不了手。你能帮我吗？

original: I want you to put down the troopers that... changed. Turned into Ghouls.
translation: 我想要你干掉那些变异成尸鬼的...士兵。

original: Is there somewhere else he can go?
translation: 他有没有别的地方可以去？

original: There's a Ranger station north of here that has a few Ghouls running it. Maybe they'll take him in.
translation: 北边有个游骑兵驻站，由尸鬼在负责。也许那儿会接纳他。

original: He is a Ghoul in Camp Searchlight.
translation: 他是探照灯营地的一个尸鬼。

original: If he's a Ghoul he should be put down. I can't let a rabid dog suffer.
translation: 如果他是尸鬼，就该被干掉。我可不想看着一条疯狗受苦。

original: Mostly Ghouls, and a handful of radscorps. I think some geckos moved in not too long ago.
translation: 主要是尸鬼，还有大批辐射蝎。此外，我估计还有些蜥蜴，应该是不久前钻进去的。

original: They seem to stick mostly to the south end of the camp.
translation: 它们大部分都盘踞在营地的南边。

original: Ranger Station Echo is north of here. They have Ghoul troopers.
translation: 游骑兵驻站艾柯在这里的北边。他们那儿有尸鬼士兵。

original: I heard Ranger Station Echo up north is manned by other Ghouls.
translation: 我听说北边的游骑兵驻站艾柯是尸鬼在管事。

original: There's a Ranger Station run by Ghouls? Finally, I feel like I have a place to go. Thanks for your help.
translation: 有个尸鬼管理的游骑兵驻站？我想我终于有地方可去了。谢谢你。

original: Maybe First Sergeant Astor will let you join him?
translation: 没准阿斯特士官长会接纳你？

original: Are you sure he'll be okay with it? Not everyone is crazy about Ghouls.
translation: 你确定他会同意？不是每个人都对尸鬼抱着友好态度的。

original: But Ghouls are immune to radiation.
translation: 但尸鬼是免疫辐射的啊。

original: You're right, Ghouls aren't fit to be in the army.
translation: 你是对的，尸鬼确实不适合留在部队里。

original: Maybe they'll let you back in?
I'm not so sure about that. I don't know how the NCR feels about Ghouls.
translation: 我不确定。我不知道NCR对尸鬼是个什么态度。

original: Because you know they'd come up lacking?
translation: 因为你知道他们都是纸老虎？

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Furious}Enough! How dare you compare Caesar's finest to this tribe of savages? The mightiest Great Khan is scarcely a match for a Legion recruit!
translation: [成功]{Furious} 够了！你怎么敢把凯撒手下的精锐和这个部落的野蛮人相比？哪怕大汗帮里最强的战士，也比不上一名军团新兵！

original: The Burned Man would leave their mightiest shitting themselves in terror! I would... {Beat, realizing what he's just done}Uhhh, that is...
translation: 浴火者会把他们吓得屁滚尿流！我会……{Beat, realizing what he's just done}啊，我是说...

original: Doctor Henry, do as he asks.

translation: 很好，很好。你很明智，人类。

original: I represent the Nightkin. {smug}Marcus may lead this town, but the Nightkin listen to what I have to say.
translation: 我代表夜行族。虽然这个镇子是马可世领导的，但夜行族都听我的号令。

original: Doesn't mean I don't respect Marcus for what he's trying to do. However, he doesn't truly understand the difficulties of being a Nightkin.
translation: 并非不尊重马可世，他确实付出了很大的努力。但他并没有真正理解我们夜行族的苦衷。

original: What do you have for sale?
Oh, you're buying? Tell you what, since you've been acting all, well, random lately, how about a discount? Might calm you down.
translation: 哦，你要买？这么着吧，看你最近似乎挺，呃，瞎胡闹的，我就给你打个折怎么样？或许能让你冷静点。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 给我看看你卖的东西吧。

original: All right then... just sign here, here, and... here.
translation: 好吧……这儿，这儿还有这儿……签个字就好。

original: Did you still want to help Doctor Henry run his experiment?
translation: 你仍然想帮助亨利医生做实验吗？

original: Of course, dearie. I know it's dangerous, but it'll all turn out for the best, you'll see. I'll go to him now - it would be rude to keep him waiting!
translation: 当然，亲爱的。我知道很危险，但是值得，你会看到的。我现在就去见他——让他一直等着太不礼貌了！

original: Actually, I'm more comfortable now that I know you've had some training.
translation: 知道你受过些训练，我反而更放心了。

original: Well, thanks for taking a chance on a naive young girl from California with stars in her eyes and a pneumatic gauntlet on her hand.
translation: 好的，感谢你能给我这个眼里闪着星星、手上戴着拳套的加州傻姑娘一次机会。

original: {waiting for player to kill you}You gonna do it or not?
translation: {waiting for player to kill you}你到底杀不杀？

original: {in pain, defiant}Come on, ya bitch! You swing like a girl!
translation: {in pain, defiant}来吧，婊子！你的气场就像个小姑娘！

original: You know what? I don't need this bullshit right now. We'll take off that goddamn power armor, if it'll just shut you up.
translation: 行吧，我可不想听这些废话。只要你他妈闭嘴，我们就把这该死的动力装甲脱了。

original: Well, after they migrated to the Mojave, we established relations with them, but that soured when all they wanted was to make drugs.
translation: 好吧，我们在他们迁到莫哈维沙漠之后就和他们建立了联系，但当我们知道他们只想制毒的时候就后悔了。

original: The NCR eventually took them down quite a bit, but the really fascinating thing about them is the origin of their culture as a whole. You see...
translation: NCR最终狠狠地教训了他们，但他们让人感兴趣的地方，其实是他们整个文化的起源。你看...

original: He's a member of the Followers like myself, but his particular field is Pre-War history and tribal culture.
translation: 和我一样，也是天启追随者的一员，只不过他的专长是研究战前历史和部落文化。

original: I do recall him being fascinated by the Khans, he kept going on about parallels to some ancient historical empire or another.
translation: 我记得他以前对大汗帮很着迷，同时还研究过好几个古代帝国的历史。

original: I have things I need to do. You'd better go alone.
translation: 我有事情要做。你最好一个人去。

original: Not much for family gatherings, huh? All right, have it your way.
translation: 对家庭聚会不感兴趣？好吧，那就听你的吧。

original: You ever want to look me up again, I'll be in my bunker in Hidden Valley. That's the {emph}luxury bunker.
translation: 你要找我的话，我就在我隐谷的地堡里。那可是个{emph}豪华的地堡。
把维奥列塔的大脑移植给给雷克斯。

original: Have a seat. This will take a while.
translation: 坐一下吧。这需要点时间。
把鲁帕的大脑移植给雷克斯。

original: All right, then. Be patient since this will take a while.
translation: 好的，请耐心等待，这需要一点时间。
把雷伊的大脑移植给雷克斯。

original: All right, then. Be patient since this will take a while.
translation: 好的，请耐心等待，这需要一点时间。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你这儿都卖些什么。

original: It sounded like you were writing poetry.
Oh. You heard that, huh? Okay, so yeah, I was writing poetry. I know, I know, it's not a very Great Khan-like thing to do.
translation: 哦，你听出来了？好吧，是的，我是在写诗。我知道，我知道，这一点也不像大汗帮的风格。

original: The Followers of the Apocalypse came to our camp when I was a kid, and they brought a bunch of old books. I used to read Pre-War poetry for hours.
translation: 在我还小的时候，有一次天启追随者到我们营地，带来了很多旧书。我曾经废寝忘食地读那些战前诗歌。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
{FoA: Rascal}Because you're a friend of the Followers, I can give you a bit of a discount.
translation: {FoA: Rascal}因为你是天启追随者的朋友，我可以给你一点折扣。

original: All right, this will only take a few minutes.
Got some songs coming up for you right now. At least one is probably about love.
translation: 现在将会为你们播放一些歌曲。其中至少有一首是关于爱情的。

original: These headlines were brought to you by Vault 21. {Slogan}Vault 21. Everything's better when you experience it in a vault.
translation: 以上头条由21号避难所倾情赞助。{Slogan}21号避难所。在避难所里，什么都比外面好。

original: Diners at the Gourmand are giving the restaurant rave reviews for executive chef Philippe's brand new menu offerings.
translation: 美事家餐厅的用餐者对主厨菲利普的新菜给予了极高的评价。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
{No-Bark Noonan:}It's Ghouls, I tell ya. Religious Ghouls in rockets looking for a land to call their own.
translation: {No-BarkNoonan:}我说了是尸鬼了。一群信教的尸鬼，他们坐火箭是为了寻找新的家园。

original: Possible causes suggested were engineering mistakes, centuries-old equipment, and the fact that the rockets were piloted by a cult of crazy Ghouls.
translation: 目前认为造成事故的原因有以下几种可能：或者是工程失误，或者几世纪前的旧设施年久失修，更有可能是因为火箭实际上是由一群信仰邪教的尸鬼所驾驶。
让我们看看你都有什么。

original: Take a look at these beauties.
The right weapons for my kind of customer.
translation: 这些武器绝对适合我的顾客。

original: The others here don't understand our kind, but you can count on me, friend.
translation: 其他人都不理解我们这类人，但我懂你，朋友。

original: You aren't exactly good for business, so you'll have to live with my prices.
translation: 和你做生意我是要冒风险的，所以恕不二价，你看着办吧。

original: Have a discount, friend. I can't wait to see what you do with these, next.
translation: 给你打个折，朋友。我真想看看你能拿这些东西干什么。

original: It's an honor to have my wares used by such a wild badass. Cut's on the house, friend.
translation: 有你这样的大恶人赏光是我的荣幸。折扣全算在我的账上，朋友。

original: Hmmm... think I could slip bigger weapons past the guards?
translation: 嗯……你觉得我可以带一把更大点的武器混过守卫吗？

original: You know, sometimes the journey beats the destination. Especially if your spurs go Jingle Jangle Jingle, and you meet some nice gals on the way.
translation: 你知道，有时旅途的过程要比达到终点更吸引人。特别是当你叮当叮当叮在公路上疾驰时，你会在路上遇见一些好女孩。
喔哦噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢

original: Looks like we got them, move fast and look alive.
translation: 敌人应该消灭干净了，加速前进，动作快点。

original: Nah, I'm gonna chill with my girl.
translation: 不，我要去跟我的姑娘玩。

original: Can't. The King's got me busy on something.
translation: 不行。猫王最近可没让我闲着。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 给我看看你都卖些什么。

original: I, Robert Edwin House, am deceased. Please approach a Securitron and take one of the printed obituaries.
translation: 本人，罗伯特·艾德温·豪斯，已经不在人世。请向就近的电子保安领取我的讣告。

original: As good as a Ghoul in a suit can look.
translation: 尸鬼再怎么打扮，也就这个样了。

original: I'd like you to go back to the Lucky 38 for now.
translation: 我希望你现在回幸运38赌场去。

original: Nice! Can I order room service?
translation: 好啊！我可以预订客房服务吗？

original: I do. We'll meet up at the Lucky 38.
translation: 好的。我们在幸运38赌场见。

original: Hey, as long as you're not asking me to go back to Black Mountain, I'm a happy old man.
translation: 嘿，只要不让我回黑山，去哪儿我都乐意。

original: It is. We'll meet up at the Lucky 38.
translation: 好的。我们在幸运38赌场见。

original: {Wary, doesn't like 38}All right... don't be long. {Under her breath}Robots there give me the creeps.
translation: {Wary，doesn't like 38}好的……别去得太久。{Under her breath}那边的机器人让我毛骨悚然。

original: {Wary, doesn't like 38}All right. Guess Vegas it is.
translation: {Wary，doesn't like 38}好吧。看来要待在维加斯了。

original: {Wary, doesn't like 38}Back to the gilded cage.
Nice children shouldn't stay in places like that, dearie! That's the sort of place Leo likes! But if you insist...
translation: 乖孩子不该待在那种地方，亲爱的！只有利奥才喜欢那种地方！但是如果你坚持的话...

original: I do. We'll meet up at the Lucky 38.
translation: 好的。我们在幸运38赌场见。

original: {sighing}Back to the tomb, I suppose. If you need me, et cetera.
translation: {sighing}要回墓穴了啊，需要我的时候来找我啊。

original: You're not one of the merchandise?
Most of my body is scarred all over, like a Ghoul. Nobody around who'd want to screw that. No, I just run things.
translation: 我身上到处是伤疤，就像尸鬼一样。没人愿意碰我这样的。不，我只负责打理店铺。

original: Word got back to one of our stations that raiders had been attacking the place. I went out with six rangers.
translation: 后来有个驻站报告称那里遭到了掠夺者袭击，我便带了六名游骑兵赶了过去。

original: We must have been on the trail for a week before we got to Rattletail. We lost one woman to Nightstalkers and another almost died of dehydration.
translation: 我们花了大概一个礼拜的时间才抵达嘎嘎尾巴。路上还有夜行兽杀了我们一个女兵，另一个人则差点因脱水而死。

original: When we reach the place, it's six shacks set up around an old well.
translation: 当我们赶到时，就看到六座窝棚围着一口老井。

original: No problem, I'll head up by myself.

translation: 让我好好教你该怎么玩商队牌。

original: I'm all done playing for now.
What? Afraid to lose. Well come find me if you want to play again.
translation: 怎么？输不起了？总之想再玩就叫我吧。

original: Wow, you're good. Give me another game.
translation: 你玩得很好啊，再和我来一把。

original: Want to play a hand of Caravan?
I'm going to roll over you.
translation: 我会让你输得心服口服的。

original: Let me see what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。
别家可没有这么好的东西哦。

original: Remember, an impressive gratuity sends a message.
translation: 记住，一笔可观的小费能给我们极大的鼓舞。

original: Our drinks have many subtle flavors.
translation: 我们的酒水口味丰富而又细腻。

original: Sure let me take a look at those magazines.
translation: 当然，让我看下那些杂志吧。

original: I'll pay you for the key.
translation: 只要给我钥匙，我愿意花钱。

original: We can come to a deal. My price is firm, though - Saint James is a good customer and it better be worth it if I'm going to lose him.
translation: 我们可以做笔交易。但我的要价可不低——圣詹姆斯是个好客户，万一他翻脸了，你给的钱总该够弥补我的损失吧。
知道圣詹姆斯的底细吗？

original: Guy's unstable, but he pays his rent and Sweetie seems to like him all right.
translation: 这伙计脾气不大好，但他交房租倒是挺积极，小甜甜似乎也很喜欢他。

original: Vacate the premises immediately. All Securitrons are at a state of high alert.
translation: 立刻撤离该场所。所有电子保安进入高度警戒状态。

original: Damn it, will you die already?
The Lucky 38 will be your grave. I'll finish what Benny couldn't get right!
translation: 幸运38将是你的葬身之处。本尼没做成的事，就由我来完成！

original: {Rhonda} One last thing. Is there any truth to the rumor that all Nightkin are slightly crazy from their overuse of psychologically damaging Pre-War tech?
translation: {朗达}最后一件事。有谣言传说夜行族因为滥用战前对神经有害的科技，导致全族人都变得有点疯癫，这是事实吗？

original: {eager to enjoy triumph}Let's get on with it, shall we? Hmm?
translation: {渴望去收获胜利果实}让我们继续吧，好吗？嗯？

original: Greetings, General Oliver. The disappointment you are about to experience delights me.
translation: 幸会，奥利弗将军。我会很享受你即将经历的失望的。

original: Point guns at us, and we will destroy you.
translation: 再用枪指着我们，你们就死定了。

original: Please do not struggle, General Oliver, you might hurt yourself. You can relax presently.
translation: 别再挣扎了，奥利弗将军，你会伤着自己的。放轻松点。

original: Did something... happen between you two?
Ugh. So gross. It was bad enough that I didn't get any data out of the Securitron. This is why I didn't want to talk about it.
translation: 呃。当然。可惜我没能从那机器人身上搞到数据，所以现在我才不想谈它。

original: It only happened once. I chalk it up to sleep deprivation and one atomic cocktail too many.
translation: 那种事只发生过一次。我把它归咎于睡眠不足以及过量饮用原子鸡尾酒。

original: {To a bad come-on}As long as you leave right after you put your caps down, you're on.
translation: {To a bad come-on}只要你把瓶盖放下然后转身离开，我算你有能耐。

original: {To a bad come-on}Got enough on my shoulders without adding more dead weight to 'em.
translation: {To a bad come-on}我肩上的担子已经够重的了，别再给我添累赘了。

original: {To a bad come-on}Show me one, and I'll do him proud.
translation: {To a bad come-on}给我找个来，我会好好疼爱他的。

original: | Wild Wasteland |{To a bad come-on, Dismissive}Ain't nothing but a hound dog.
translation: | Wild Wasteland |{To a bad come-on，Dismissive}不过是头野狗罢了。

original: {To a bad come-on}No, and ain't looking to be a babysitter, neither.
translation: {To a bad come-on}不，我也不想给人当保姆。

original: {To a bad come-on}Wanted to be with someone who knew how to please a woman, that's what.
translation: {To a bad come-on}我只想找个懂得逗女人开心的家伙。

original: {To a bad come-on}Stake a claim somewhere else, pretty boy.
translation: {To a bad come-on}要占人便宜你还是去别的地方吧，靓仔。

original: I could use some Stimpaks... how 'bout some nice Bloatfly Steaks in trade?
translation: 能不能给我一支治疗针…我用上等的苍蝇肉来换如何？

original: We don't have to fight. We can still talk about this.
translation: 我们没必要打架。有什么事好商量。

original: I'm sorry I had to kill him - he didn't give me much choice.
translation: 抱歉，我不得不杀了他——我别无选择。

original: Well, anyway, Judah's given Orion's armor to you now. It'll take a few hours for me to show you how to use it properly, so let's get started.
translation: 好吧，不管怎么样，犹大已经把厄里翁的装甲给了你。我还得花几个小时教你怎么如何使用它。我们开始吧。

original: What will your friends think about this?
I've known them far longer than you have. They'll get over it.
translation: 我认识他们的时间比你长。他们不会有意见的。

original: It's big, it's bright, and it's one of the biggest cities still left from before the War. Well, mostly, anyway.
translation: 它很雄伟，很壮观。是战后遗留下来的规模最大的城市之一。嗯，大概吧。

original: Used to be just a curiosity. The buildings were Pre-War, but it was just as full of raiders and barbarian tribes as anyplace else.
translation: 这地方以前是个奇葩。建筑都是战前的，却和其他地方一样遍布着掠夺者和野蛮人部落。

original: Then Mr. House took over, got the power turned back on, and got the tribes reformed into something civilized. Now they run his casinos for him.
translation: 后来豪斯先生上台，就给城里通了电，还开化了那些部落。如今他们负责经营着他旗下的那些赌场。

original: {narrating}Though Novac was a low-priority target for the Legion, many of Novac's citizens died in its defense.
translation: {narrating}虽然诺瓦克并非军团的主要目标，但依旧有许多居民为了保卫小镇而死。

original: {narrating}In the weeks that followed, Feral Ghouls, overflowing from the REPCONN Test Site, ravaged the weakened town.
translation: {narrating}在其后的几个星期里，凶猛的尸鬼从瑞普康试验场中倾巢而出，侵占了这个已经饱经摧残的小镇。

original: {Narrating}Never weakened by NCR, the Fiends staged an attack against Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.
translation: {Narrating}未曾遭到NCR重创的恶魔帮，在第二次胡佛大坝战役期间策划了一场针对麦卡伦营地的袭击。

original: Though NCR repulsed the Fiends, they suffered heavy losses in the process.
translation: 虽然NCR击退了恶魔帮，但也付出了惨重的伤亡。

original: {Narrating}The Fiends overran Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.
translation: {Narrating}恶魔帮在第二次胡佛大坝战役期间占领了麦卡伦营地。

original: In the anarchic months that followed, the Fiends asserted dominance over Outer Vegas.
translation: 在之后动荡不安的日子里，恶魔帮又控制了整个维加斯外围。

original: {Narrating}The Fiends attacked Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam and, despite suffering heavy losses, overran it.
translation: {Narrating}恶魔帮们在第二次胡佛大坝战役期间袭击了麦卡伦营地，虽然损失惨重，但最终还是将其攻破。

original: They continued to be a nuisance throughout Outer Vegas, but never established full control over the area.
translation: 此后，他们继续在维加斯外围肆虐，但他们从未真正控制过这片地区。

original: {Quarter health, near death}Looks like I'm headed for the big dark...
translation: {Quarter health, near death}看来我要拥抱无尽的黑暗了...

original: {Quarter health, near death}Sorry... I let you down...
translation: {Quarter health, near death}对不起... 我让你失望了...

original: {Dying}I knew I should've been an actress.
{Dying}Never thought I'd go out like this...
{in pain, commenting on his wounds}Physician, heal thyself. {thinking}Guess it's a good thing they invented stims.
translation: {in pain, commenting on his wounds}要医人，先医己。{thinking}还好他们发明了兴奋剂。

original: {Half health, in pain}I need healing powder!
translation: {Half health, in pain}我需要医疗粉！

original: {Gramma}Grandma needs to have a little lie down!
{Waking up from being knocked out}Okay, okay, I'm up. What's next?
translation: {Waking up from being knocked out}好的，好的，我起来了。下一步怎么办？

original: {Waking up from knockout, panicking}Gah! Petro-Chico Boy! Petro-Chico Boy is here for my chitlins! {Calm}Oh. Just a dream. {Soothing himself}Just a dream...
translation: {Waking up from knockout, panicking}啊啊啊！石油小子！石油小子来掏我的肠子了！{Calm}噢，还好是梦。{Soothing himself}还好是梦...

original: I don't have much protection here. Mind helping me out?
translation: 我的防护措施实在有点差。介意帮忙搞定一下吗？

original: This armor's gonna get me killed.
Look, I'm dead unless you can get me some real armor.
translation: 听着，你要是不能给我搞些真正的护甲来，我就死定了。

original: Got anything bigger I can fight with?
{worried}Might be time for a weapon upgrade.
Might as well be throwing rocks.
You got a bigger gun I can borrow?
translation: 你能不能借一把更大的枪给我？

original: That's better. Maybe I should've been a surgeon.
translation: 好点了。看来我应该去当个外科医生。

original: Patched up. Let's get back to the fight.
{feeling better, joking}Will the medical wonders of the post-apocalyptic world never cease?
translation: {feelingbetter，joking}战前世界的医学奇迹究竟还遗留了多少？

original: {Impressed by own medical skill}Didn't even leave a scar.
{Limb crippled, in pain}I fear I will need more than my herbs to fix this...
translation: {Limb crippled, in pain}我恐怕快不行了...

original: {crippled limbs}I could use a Doctor's Bag if you have any handy.
translation: {crippled limbs}如果你有医疗包的话，我急用。

original: {a little annoyed}I'm not exactly in Power Armor over here, so why don't you help lighten my load a bit?
translation: {a little annoyed}我又没穿动力装甲，你为什么不帮我减轻些重量呢？

original: {annoyed}I'm not standing here because I'm overburdened with emotion. Take some of this stuff off me so I can move a little more easily.
translation: {annoyed}我都快站不住了，感觉心要被石头压跨了。帮我拿掉一些东西，我就可以走得轻松点了。

original: {Under heavy strain, being sarcastic}Hey, don't worry about it, boss. The decrepit old man can easily carry all your stuff for you. Really.
translation: {Under heavy strain，being sarcastic}嘿，别在意，老大。我这把老骨头什么玩意都能驮得动。真的。

original: I'd like to purchase some supplies.
Unfortunately for you, I'm not authorized to trade with you. It's against regulations.
translation: 非常抱歉，上级并未批准我和你做生意。这样做违反规定。

original: <Gasps> For me? Do you mean it? No, it's too much! Well, okay. But it's too much! It's perfect. Thank you. Thank you.
translation: <倒抽气>给我的？真的吗？不，这太贵重了！呃，好吧。但真的太贵重了！好美啊。谢谢。谢谢。

original: Aw, you shouldn't have! It's just my taste. Thank you.
translation: 哦，不会吧！这正合我口味。谢谢。

original: Oh my God, oh my God, oh my God! Look what they're wearing! I've only seen dresses like those in my dreams. And even then I couldn't afford them.
translation: 噢，我的上帝，我的上帝啊，我的上帝！看看他们穿的衣服！我只在梦里见过这样的衣服。而且我在梦里都买不起。

original: {Resolved, sigh}Walking the Mojave with you can't be any worse than here, that's for sure. All right, I'm in.
translation: 和你一起在莫哈维四处转转，总比呆在这儿强，这倒是实话。好吧，算我一个。

original: Looking to join up with me again?
Was reminded why I left this place soon as I walked in. {Nods}Let's go.
translation: 我刚一踏进这鬼地方，就想起我为啥要离开了。咱们走吧。

original: About two dozen men came back in the night, after we'd gone to sleep. They set fire to the ranch house and barred the doors from the outside.
translation: 大约二十几个人趁着夜里我们睡着的时候又回来了。他们放火烧了农场的房子，还把门从外面堵上了。

original: My whole family was trapped inside. I smelled the smoke and got myself and my little sister, Rafaela, out though a window, but everyone else...
translation: 我们一家人都被困在屋里。我闻到了烟味，于是带着我的小妹妹拉法拉爬出了窗户，可其他人...

original: My parents, my grandmother, my two brothers and two of my sisters all died.
translation: 我的父母、祖母、两个兄弟和两个姐妹，都死了。

original: All right. Come on, let's go.
{Relieved to be leaving}Thank god, the sooner the better.
translation: {Relieved to be leaving}感谢上帝，越快越好。

original: I changed my mind. This is something we should confront together.
translation: 我改主意了。这件事我们要共同面对。

original: No. This is something for {emph}me to deal with. But I'm glad you're here.
translation: 不。这是{emph}我的私事。但我很高兴你能在这里。

original: <Attack> That's it. Tired of listening to you anyway.
{Surprised}You're seriously going to draw on me? Fine, do it, see what happens.
translation: {Surprised}你真的要来找我麻烦？好吧，来吧，看看会有什么后果。

original: Good, go back to your famil... oh wait, they're fucking dead.
translation: 好吧，那就回去找你的家人……哦，等等，他们早他妈死了。

original: {Cold}You son of a bitch. {Beat}You know, I was just going to give you a piece of my mind and now? Now I'm going to put you down.
translation: 你这个狗娘养的。你知道吗，刚才我只是想说你两句，现在，我要打得你再也爬不起来。

original: Go back West, then, see if I care.
translation: 那你回西部去吧，我才不管呢。

original: You can have your shit back, I don't need it or want it. You go your way, I'm going mine.
translation: 你可以把你的垃圾全都拿回去，反正我不想要。从今往后，你走你的阳关道，我过我的独木桥。

original: And don't try looking for me - it was a mistake to show up in the Mojave in the first place, and I'm not about to repeat that mistake twice.
translation: 你也别指望能找到我——我来莫哈维从一开始就是个错误。我不会再犯第二次了。

original: I went after Dave and his brothers. They had a head start, but they slept nights. I didn't. Took me three days to catch up to them.
translation: 我一直追着戴夫和他的弟兄。他们虽然走的早，可他们晚上睡觉。我不睡。我花了三天时间才追上他们。

original: Claudia was dead when I got there. They'd put a bullet in each of her eyes. I couldn't do anything except avenge her, just like Rafaela.
translation: 我赶到的时候，克劳迪娅已经死了。他们在她的双眼里各打了一枪。我唯一能做的，只有为她报仇，就像当年为拉法拉一样。

original: I charged into the middle of their camp and started firing - two of them were dead before they knew I was there. The other five, though...
translation: 我冲进他们的营地，抬枪便射——他们还没反应过来，就有两个人命丧当场。可另外五个人...

original: They shot the shit out of me. I would have died, I think, if I wasn't so full of rage.
translation: 我可真被他们打得够戗。要不是当时我仗着一腔怒火，估计早就死了。

original: Wasn't Mexico City basically annihilated in the Great War?
translation: 在伟大战争中，墨西哥城不是几乎被毁灭了吗？

original: I don't think it was as hard hit as D.C. or Bakersfield, but it was bad enough. By the time we got there, the city was a radioactive ruin.
translation: 我认为它遭受的打击应该比不上华盛顿或贝克斯菲尔德，但也差不多了。我们到那儿的时候，整座城市已经化为废墟，到处遍布着辐射。

original: Still, the city was full of looters, already forming into the beginnings of raider tribes. Crime was bad before the War, but now it was a nightmare.
translation: 然而城里还是堆满了来抢劫的人，掠夺者部落已经开始形成。战前犯罪就很猖獗，现在简直就像地狱。

original: We were living like scavengers, scraping by on what little food we could find, always looking for medicine for my burns.
translation: 我们靠捡破烂为生，凡是能下咽的东西都成了我们的战利品，还得四处寻找能治疗我烧伤的药。

original: And then, of course, the radiation started to kick in, turning me into this handsome devil you see before you.
translation: 当然，后来我就感染了辐射病，把我变成了现在这副英俊的鬼模样。

original: {hushed, not confident in his abilities}O... kay. I'll do my best.
translation: {hushed，not confident in his abilities}好……的，我尽力。

original: Keeping quiet... unless my creaking knees give us away.
translation: 保持安静……除非我这咯吱作响的膝盖把我们暴露了。

original: Right, because a Ghoul in a vaquero outfit is really going to blend in with the scenery.
translation: 没错，像我这样一身牛仔装的尸鬼，可以完美地隐匿在周围的环境里。

original: Oh, don't you worry about me, dearie, your {gramma}grandma knows how to stay quiet.
translation: 哦，不要担心我，亲爱的，你的{gramma}奶奶知道该怎么保持安静。

original: Cheer up, kid. It's not that bad. Sure, your skin rots off and you start to stink like a public toilet after Cinco de Mayo, but... umm...
translation: 振作点，孩子。情况也不是那么糟。不错，你的皮肤的确在腐烂，而且闻起来就像是狂欢节后的公共厕所，不过……嗯……

original: I guess hunting down Ghouls like wild animals is okay. I mean, they're probably going to die anyway, right boss?
translation: 我觉得像杀野生动物一样杀掉尸鬼也没什么问题。反正它们早晚都是个死。对不？

original: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.
translation: 我就是关掉34号避难所排风扇的那个人。

original: You? Did you re-direct the power stream back to our section?
translation: 你？是你把电力重新导回到我们这片区域的么？

original: {Almost incredulous}We thought nobody would ever manage to get past the radiation, and the Ghouls!
translation: {Almost incredulous}我们还以为不可能有人能穿过那片辐射区域，何况尸鬼那么多！

original: We owe you our freedom, outlander. Please, if there's anything we can do for you...
translation: 我们都欠你一个人情，外乡人。如果有什么需要，请尽管开口……

original: Did he say anything when you met him? Anything...{about me, stops herself} anything at all?
translation: 你遇到他时他有没有说什么？什么事……{about me, stops herself}什么事都没说吗 ?

original: Can you spare any medical supplies?
translation: 你能给我一点医疗用品吗？

original: Just let me know what you need.
translation: 有什么需要，告诉我就行。

original: What was I supposed to do again?
translation: 再说一次，我应该干嘛来着？

original: Just head over to the REPCONN test site west of here. See if you can get the Ghouls out of there.
translation: 去西边的瑞普康实验场。想个办法把那里的尸鬼都赶走。

original: Well they gotta go, or this'll be a ghost town before long.
translation: 他们必须消失，否则这里不久就会变成一座鬼城。

original: Doesn't matter to me what you do. As long as the Ghouls are out of there, that's good enough for me.
translation: 我不管你采取什么手段，只要把那些尸鬼撵走，对我来说就够了。

original: {NO-vack}Novac, it's home for me now. I want that to be for good. I like it here, and I've left too many homes behind.
translation: {NO-vack}诺瓦克是我的家。我希望一直住在这里。我喜欢这里，毕竟我过去一直四处漂泊。

original: But the only resource we got here is junk. Without that, people wouldn't have anything to trade. They'd all have to leave.
translation: 可这地方唯一的资源就是垃圾。没有了垃圾，人们也就没东西可卖，只能离开这里。

original: We get most of it up the road from the old rocket test site. But a bunch of Ghouls showed up one day and took it over. We can't get in there now.
translation: 大部分垃圾都是从远处的旧火箭实验基地弄来的。谁知某一天突然冒出来一群尸鬼，把那里给占了。我们现在进不去了。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
Our patrols are always bringing more stuff in. Take a look.
translation: 我们的巡逻队总是能带进新物资。来看看吧。

original: Yeah, what else you going to do with an empty bottle? Wait for it to refill itself?
translation: 对啊，一个空瓶子你还想干嘛？等它自己生出酒来？

original: Get me some ingredients out of the Mojave, an empty bottle, a little time, and I'll keep us stocked.
translation: 只要你把配料拿来，再给我一个空瓶和一点时间，咱们就能随时享受这份畅饮了。

original: I'm sure. I'd rather you didn't have any psychotic breaks, even if it means you aren't as strong.
translation: 我确定。我宁肯你不要再精神分裂，即便你不再如以前那样强壮。

original: Well, all right, then, dearie. {Sad}I suppose I'll have my holotapes to remind me of Becky and Jimmy...
translation: 嗯，好吧，亲爱的。看来我得找些磁带来回忆一下贝基和吉米了...

original: I'd like to buy some food.
Here is what we have available.
Could I buy some spare munitions?
translation: 我可以买一些军用部件吗？

original: Sure. Pearl gave the green light. Take a look at the manifest.
translation: 当然。珀尔开了绿灯。看看这货单。

original: Not without Pearl's permission, and she hasn't given permission.
translation: 没有珀尔的允许就不行，而且她也没有允许呢。

original: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}I bet I'm going to like it in that mainframe!
translation: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}我打赌我会爱上那台主机的！

original: I wonder if Marcus knows about this place...
translation: 不知道马可世是否认得这个地方...

original: Earlier, it seemed like you knew Tabitha. What's the story there?
translation: 你好像认识塔比瑟，你们俩有啥故事吗？

original: Tabitha was {gramma's}grandma's squad leader when we both worked for the Master. She wasn't very nice at all, but she was good at the chopping.
translation: 我们以前都曾为主教卖命，那时塔比瑟是奶奶小分队的队长。她脾气不大好，但砍人的技巧却是一流的。

original: Attention. ARCHIMEDES I Laser is now armed. Move all personnel to minimum safe distance before initiating test fire.
translation: 注意。阿基米德激光系统准备完毕。在火力测试开始前，请所有人员迅速撤离到安全距离外。

original: ARCHIMEDES II orbital laser bombardment will commence in T-minus 5... 4... 3... 2... 1.
translation: 阿基米德II型轨道激光轰炸即将开始，倒计时5… 4… 3… 2… 1。

original: All right. Let's not waste any time. {a bit of enthusiasm}There are people out there to help, things to learn. Maybe not in that order, but let's get to it.
translation: 很好，那我们就别再浪费时间了。外面还有很多人需要帮助，有很多东西需要学习。也许并非事事井然，但我们还是应当努力。

original: I'd like you to come with me.
translation: 我希望你能和我一起走。

original: A courier, doctor, and a cybernetic dog. After we deal with the whole "imminent conquest of New Vegas" problem we should open an act at the Tops.
translation: 邮差，医生外加一条机器狗。等咱们完成"征服新维加斯"的大业，这故事能在九重天当戏演了。

original: There's something about that robot that doesn't seem... all right to me. I'm not saying we shouldn't take it with us.
translation: 关于那个机器人，我总觉得…不怎么对劲。我不是说我们不能带它一起走。

original: I'm just saying that if it were to fall into Lake Mead and be irreparably damaged... and if you threw an EMP grenade in after it...
translation: 我只是觉得，如果万一它"掉进了"米德湖，发生严重损坏……而之后你又之往湖里丢了一颗EMP手雷的话……

original: Well, there are worse things happening in the world, right?
translation: 好吧，世上也有比这更糟糕的事情，对吧？

original: After spending thirty years of my life hiding my association with the Enclave, I'd {emph}love to stroll the wasteland with a twitchy Eyebot.
translation: 想想这三十年来，我一直在隐瞒自己与英克雷的联系，现在居然能{emph}和一只古怪的眼球机器人在废土上流浪，也算是不错了。

original: Thanks for asking. I appreciate it. I do.
translation: 多谢你邀请我，我很感激。真的。

original: Back in your good graces again? I knew you'd see the light.
translation: 不计前嫌地回来了？我就知道你会想明白的。

original: {joking}I thought my charm could win you over, but I guess it wasn't meant to be. Are you sure you want me to go?
translation: {joking}我还以为我靠魅力征服了你呢，但看来不是这样，你真要让我离开？

original: All right, I'll head back to the Old Mormon Fort. If you need me, just swing by.
translation: 好的，我会回旧摩门教要塞的。如果你需要我，随时再来找我。

original: Ugh. I guess that means I have to go back to that creepy mausoleum Mr. House calls the Lucky 38.
translation: 呃。你是说要我回到那阴森森好像坟墓一样的幸运38里去吗？

original: I've been around a few unsettling places in my life, but that place takes the cake.
translation: 我这辈子也去过几个人迹罕至的地方，但那儿可真称得上是名列榜首。

original: Anyway, if you need me, you know where to find me.
translation: 总之，如果你要找我，就到那儿去吧。

original: {drifting off}If you need me, et cetera.
translation: {drifting off}需要我的时候来找我啊，再见。

original: Because you're helping Caesar's Legion. They are bad. You are bad. I am going. Bye.
translation: 因为你在帮凯撒军团做事。他们坏，你也坏。我走了，再见。

original: Why are you crazy? That's a question for someone much wiser and more patient than me.
translation: 因为你疯了？拿这问题去问一个比我更有耐心更聪明的人吧。

original: All I know is that you are a bad person and I don't want to be around you anymore. So if that was your goal, congratulations.
translation: 我只知道你是个坏人，我不想跟你走了。如果这就是你想要的结果，那恭喜你。

original: If not, I'm sorry to inform you that you are, as the locals say, "nuttier than a Bighorner dropping."
translation: 如果不是的话，那我也只能遗憾地说一句，你就跟土话里说得一样，"脑子里进角羊屎了。"

original: If you have a problem with me, why don't you just leave right now?
translation: 如果你对我有意见，你怎么不现在就走？

original: If you insist. Have a nice life.
translation: 既然话已至此，祝你好自为之。

original: They hide behind NCR's protection and they deserve everything coming to them.
translation: 他们拿NCR当保护伞，就算出了事，也是报应。

original: They sure don't, but I hope you get everything that's coming to you.
translation: 我可不敢苟同，但我的确希望你也有遭报应的一天。

original: That's a good way to put it.

translation: 对，如果你是反社会人格的话。
{sickened}好好享受自己种下的苦果吧。

original: More than collateral damage. A necessary sacrifice.
translation: 这不叫殃及池鱼。这是必要的牺牲。

original: Sorry, but I won't be sticking around to see if you have the courtesy to lay flowers on the mass grave that the Legion's going to dig for them.
translation: 抱歉，哪怕将来军团要为那些死去的百姓挖个万人坑，我也不会陪您一块儿去献花的。

original: Actually, yes, I would like to see New Vegas turned into a slavery hub.
translation: 实际上，没错，我就是想看新维加斯变成一个奴隶之都。

original: Great! You're either unimaginably cruel or profoundly insane!
translation: 好极了！你如果不是残暴至极，那就是丧心病狂！

original: Either way, I'm not going to wait around for you to help the Legion roll across Hoover Dam. Bye.
translation: 不管你是哪种人，我都不打算眼睁睁地看着你帮助军团夺下胡佛水坝。再见。

original: The Legion is better than the alternative.
What?! Caesar is going to enslave or kill everyone in the Mojave.
translation: 什么？！凯撒要么会把莫哈维沙漠的百姓全都杀光，要么就奴役他们。

original: And when that's done, he'll try to destroy the NCR senate and install himself as its new military dictator.
translation: 等他做完这件事，他就会摧毁NCR的参议院，把自己推上军事独裁者的大位。

original: I can't comprehend how Caesar could so extensively scramble your sense of morality to make you think the Legion is a better alternative to {emph}anything.
translation: 我真是无法理解凯撒是怎样颠覆了你的是非观，居然会让你觉得军团才是上佳的选择。

original: And you know what? I'm not going to stick around to try and figure it out. At least legionaries have the excuse of being born into it.
translation: 算了，我也不打算留下来搞懂你这脑子了。至少军团士兵还有一个投错胎的借口。

original: Quite well. Thank you for asking, Veronica.
translation: 很好。多谢问候，维罗尼卡。

original: I'm surprised you're not wearing that hood to hide your hair like you usually do, Veronica.
translation: 我很惊讶你居然没像往常一样用头巾遮住你的头发，维罗尼卡。

original: Maybe, depends on how my girl's feeling.
translation: 也许。得看我家姑娘怎么说。

original: Just hanging out. Same as usual.
translation: 就随便转转，和平时一样。

original: I was thinking of taking a walk a little later.
translation: 我在想待会儿要不要出去转转。

original: I might be going scum-hunting later. You game?
translation: 过会儿我要去戏耍一下那些垃圾。你来吗？

original: Nothing. Want to head to the Wrangler later?
translation: 没事。过一会儿要不要去原子酒吧坐坐？

original: I'd like to see your wares.
I could use some help with my gear.
translation: 正好我有装备需要你修理。

original: {Slight conspiratorial smile}Let me sign off on the work order for you, then.
translation: 那我就来给你签一张报修表。

original: What do you have for trade?
{Skeptical, player's bad news}For you? I'm not sure I want to be seen dealing with you... {changes tune}but if you're willing to pay a little extra...
translation: {怀疑地，对你来说是个坏消息}你？我可不想和你扯上什么关系……{语气一变}但你要是愿意多掏两个子儿……

original: Where would I find a diagnostic scanning module?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到诊断扫描模块？

original: It's been said that Auto-Docs were standard equipment in the underground Vaults where mankind survived when the bombs fell centuries ago.
translation: 据说自动医生是避难所的标准配备，数百年前人类曾在那里躲避核战争。

original: You can search the Vaults, but every Auto-Doc my Legion has run across has been stripped for parts long before we found it.
translation: 你可以去这些避难所里找找，不过军团以前也搜索过，所有的自动医生早就被拆得精光了。

original: {remembering, feeling hope}Some of my scouts did report an abandoned Vault near Nellis Air Force Base. Overrun by Ghouls, they said.
translation: 倒是曾经有探子报告，在内利斯空军基地附近有一座避难所。但已经被尸鬼控制了。

original: Maybe the infestation has been there long enough to keep scavengers out. Why don't you go and see?
translation: 也许长期的感染已经令拾荒者不敢靠近了。你干嘛不亲自去那里看看呢？

original: He's standing right outside your tent.
I'll have my guards take him captive. If he cures my condition, I'll see to it that your reward is several times his value.
translation: 我会命守卫把他抓来的。如果他能治好我的病，我可以保证，你所获得的报酬要远比他的身价高出数倍。

original: Head on back and see the boss real soon, hear? Evening.{face screen blinks to default Securitron}
translation: 还是快点回去见老大吧，听到没？晚安啦。{face screen blinks to default Securitron}

original: Time for the NCR to roast.
I'm thinking I'm going to get a sweet Pre-War laser. What are you thinking?
translation: 我在考虑要不要搞个牛逼的战前激光武器呢。你怎么想？

original: I'm thinking that I'm leaving because you are a sociopath. Good riddance.
translation: 我在考虑我应该离开你，因为你就是个反人类反社会的疯子。后会有期。

original: Oh, uh... whoops, I thought that was to turn it off.
translation: 哎呀……我还以为那个按钮是用来关掉它的呢。

original: Argh, you moron! You're going to kill all of the troopers down there!
translation: 啊！你这个白痴！你会害死下面所有士兵的！

original: That's it. I'm out. Good luck getting out of this place without being shot to pieces by NCR soldiers, assuming they aren't going to fry to death.
