translation: 给。这件装甲是为角斗坑的一位战士特别定做的。挡子弹很棒，不过当他摔下这座桥之后，这衣服没能帮得了他。

original: How about something one-of-a-kind? Bit of a weird one, here - found it from some sucker out of town.
translation: 这类东西怎么样？给，有点古怪——从镇子外边的一些笨蛋那里搞来的。

original: Some genius got to tinkering with his laser. Polished metal barrel, a few prisms in there, and he got this lethal light show.
translation: 一些天才改进了他的激光。有优雅的金属枪管，配备了一些棱镜，他进行了这一致命光线的演示。

original: Is it ever! Check out this cutting edge of fashion, huh? Wear this armor, and everyone's going to want to get close to you.
translation: 曾经的经典！要不要体验一把这种款式的流行度，嘿？穿上这件装甲，每个人都会想和你套近乎

original: Which just means they'll be inside your blast radius!
translation: 那正好表示他们会进入你的爆炸范围内？

original: Sure is. This armor used to belong to one of those desert-crazy priests. Said wearing it made him bulletproof.
translation: 当然，这套装甲以前属于一位沙漠牧师，据说他穿着可以防弹。

original: Course, that didn't stand up to a little testing. But damn if it wasn't a gloriously fun time.
translation: 当然，那经不起小小的测试。不过它要是没经历过什么光辉岁月的话，那可真是该死。

original: All the metal you're bringing in, I suppose it's worth giving you something to really help with those Trogs.
translation: 我想就你带过来的所有这些金属，值得我给你一些东西，以便真正能帮你对付那些兽化人。

original: Here, this thing's mauled Trogs and Ghouls from here to Monroeville. Give it a whirl.
translation: 给，从这到门罗维尔，这个东西一路留下了兽化人和僵尸的抓痕。试一试。

original: Kid, this is worth more than you know. But damn if you ain't earned it.
translation: 孩子，这比你想的更值钱。你还没能赚到它。

original: Here. This is the best gun I ever had. A little slower on the trigger, but she makes up for it in power and accuracy. Use her in good health.
translation: 给，这是我用过的最好的枪。扳机的速度有点变慢了，不过火力和命中率弥补了她的缺陷。在她状况良好的时候才能发挥最大火力。

original: Well, I'll be damned. That makes 100 ingots you found. And here I remember thinking you'd be lucky to bring back any at all.
translation: 我会遭天谴，那值100块钢锭。我记得我在想，你带回来这么多根本就是走运。

original: Ain't no question, you earned the treasure of my collection. This armor goes all the way back to when the Brotherhood tried to wipe out The Pitt.
translation: 很好，你挣到了我收集来的宝贝。这套装甲和兄弟会想要摧毁匹兹堡时的那种款式完全相同。

original: Some of the tribals who worshipped Ashur made it to look like their god. Try it on, and you'll feel a little like a god, yourself!
translation: 一些部落崇拜阿舒尔，把他尊为他们的神。试穿一下，你自己也会觉得有点像神的！
我可以匀一点出来给你。

original: Yeah, looks like you've earned it. If you're heading back out there, these oughta help with the Trogs.
translation: 是的，看来是你应得的。你要是回到那边，这些东西可以帮你对付那些兽化人。

original: How about I give you some metal this time?
translation: 这次我给你些金属怎么样？

original: Here. This armor was a special order for one of the Hole fighters. Great against bullets, but didn't help him when he got pushed off the bridge.
translation: 给。这件装甲是为角斗坑的一位战士特别定做的。挡子弹很棒，不过当他摔下这座桥之后，这衣服没能帮得了他。

original: Sure thing. Bit of a weird one, here - found it from some sucker out of town.
translation: 当然，给，有点古怪的东西——从镇子外边的一些笨蛋那里搞来的。

original: Some genius got to tinkering with his laser. Polished metal barrel, a few prisms in there, and he got this lethal light show.
translation: 一些天才改进了他的激光。优雅的金属枪管，配备了一些棱镜，他进行了这一致命光线的演示。

original: You bet I do! Check out this cutting edge of fashion! Wear this armor, and everyone's going to want to get close to you.
translation: 说的没错！试试这玩意到底有多拉风！穿上这件装甲，每个人都会想和你套近乎。

original: Which just means they'll be inside your blast radius, huh?
translation: 那正好表示他们会进入你的爆炸范围内？

original: Guess you earned this. Used to belong to a desert priest. Said wearing it made him bulletproof.
translation: 我猜这是你应得的。它过去属于一位沙漠牧师，据说他穿着可以防弹。

original: Course, that didn't stand up to a little testing. But damn if it wasn't a gloriously fun time.
translation: 当然，那经不起小小的测试。不过它要是没经历过什么光辉岁月的话，那可真是该死。

original: All the metal you're bringing in, I suppose it's worth giving you something to really help with those Trogs.
translation: 我想就你带过来的所有这些金属，值得我给你一些东西，以便真正能帮你对付那些兽化人。

original: Here, this thing's mauled Trogs and Ghouls from here to Monroeville. Give it a whirl.
translation: 给，从这到门罗维尔，这东西一路留下了兽化人和尸鬼的抓痕。试一试。

original: I probably shouldn't, but damn if you ain't earned it.
translation: 我也许不该这么做，不过真该死，这是你应得的。

original: Here. This is the best gun I ever had. A little slower on the trigger, but she makes up for it in power and accuracy. Use her in good health.
translation: 给，这是我用过的最好的枪。扳机的速度有点变慢了，不过火力和命中率弥补了她的缺陷。在她状况良好的时候才能发挥最大火力。

original: Well, I'll be damned. That makes 100 ingots you found. And here I remember thinking you'd be lucky to bring back any at all.
translation: 我会遭天谴，那值100块钢锭。我记得我在想，你带回来这么多根本就是走运。

original: Ain't no question, you earned the treasure of my collection. This armor goes all the way back to when the Brotherhood tried to wipe out The Pitt.
translation: 很好，你赚到了我收集来的宝贝。这套装甲和兄弟会想要摧毁匹兹堡时的那种款式完全相同。

original: Some of the tribals who worshipped Ashur made it to look like their god. Try it on, and you'll feel a little like a god, yourself!
translation: 一些部落崇拜阿舒尔，把他尊为他们的神。试穿一下，你自己也会觉得有点像神的！

original: Yeah, because I've never solved my problems with violence. <Intimidate>
translation: 是的，因为我从来没有通过暴力解决过自己的问题。<恐吓>

original: Dammit! Dammit, you monster! Wernher's in the steelyard!
translation: 该死！该死，你这个怪物！沃纳在钢材堆放场！

original: Here, take his damn message, hunt him down, whatever. Just leave my people alone, you bastard!
translation: 给，带上他该死的便条，不管采用什么法子逮到他。离我的人远点，你个狗日的！

original: I need you to start the purifier. The code is 2-1-6.
translation: 福克斯，我要你去启动净水器。密码是2-1-6。

original: Is there any way I can help?
translation: 有需要我帮忙的地方吗？

original: Indeed, we can use every able body available to us.
translation: 确实，我们可以接纳每个对我们有用的个体。

original: To that end, I am going to circumvent our standard recruitment procedures and declare you a Knight of the Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 为此，我依照我们的标准征兵程序宣布，你是钢铁兄弟会的骑士了。

original: Before you do anything else, please speak with Scribe Rothchild. I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you again.
translation: 在你做什么事情之前，请先和文员罗斯查德谈谈。我想他会很高兴再次见到你的。

original: He can brief you on the details of the last few weeks, as well as where our efforts are focused now.
translation: 他可以简要地告诉你最近几个星期的情况，以及我们最近的任务着重点。

original: I understand that you've been through quite an ordeal, but the sooner you can talk to him, the sooner we can put an end to all this.
translation: 我明白你有过痛苦的经历，但是你越早和他谈话，我们就可以越早结束这一切。

original: I know. We run out in two days and then it's back to the radiated shit.
translation: 我知道，我们呆了两天，这些玩意就都化成辐射屎了。

original: Give me your Self Status Report.
translation: 给我你的自我状态报告。

original: I am currently functioning at 78 percent capacity which is well within acceptable operating parameters.
translation: 我目前的运行状况为满负荷程度的78%，处于非常可靠的运行区间。

original: The following systems are non-operative or damaged: surface visual systems and communications uplink to White House and Police Department.
translation: 以下系统处于完全停用或损坏状况：地表影像系统、与白宫和警察局之间的联络系统。

original: There is additional partial damage to my internal sensing devices and numerous severed data lines.
translation: 我的内部传感设备以及数据线路也有不少损坏。

original: What the hell is going on?
So you guys have something set up on the side?
translation: 那么你们在台下有什么交易？

original: We do what we can. Take, for example, this Ghoul Griffon. He wanted to PURCHASE a bunch of water.
translation: 我们只做我们能做的。例如这个僵尸格里芬。他想向我们买大量的水。

original: What the hell does that droopy irradiated fool need with pure water? Thinks he can sell it in Underworld. Moron.
translation: 那个快腐烂的傻瓜要这么多净水干嘛？他以为他能在地下城卖掉这些水。蠢货。

original: But, he's the only one who's offered to PAY for water, in caps AND technology.
translation: 不过，只有他愿意用瓶盖或是科技来换水。

original: And what Lyons doesn't know won't hurt him. There's plenty of water to go around.
translation: 里昂斯虽然不知道，但这对他没什么危害。这儿还有好多水。

original: And I can use it to pay Rivet City to provide security for all the caravans we can't escort ourselves. I'm lucky he came along.
translation: 我们还能用他给的钱让铆钉城的警力保护我们的商队。他来找我可是我的运气。

original: You think maybe Megaton is trying to con you out of more water?
translation: 你觉得兆吨镇想在你这骗更多的水？

original: I don't know WHAT to think. I got Lyons breathing down my neck about it though.
translation: 我都不知道该怎么办了。里昂斯在这件事上对我逼得太紧了。

original: Apparently Megaton's sending him nasty letters demanding a shipment. I JUST sent them a week's supply! A month's, if they ration.
translation: 很明显兆吨镇给他寄了封卑鄙的信朝他讨水。可我刚给他们送了一个星期的量！ 如果他们实行配给的话那些水够用一个月。

original: Look, if you can straighten out Megaton so I get Lyons off my back, I'll make it worth your while.
translation: 听着，如果你能摆平兆吨镇的问题好让我给里昂斯一个交代，我会给你可观的报酬的。

original: Sounds like you have your hands full.
Everyone was so excited about that Purifier: "Project Purity this," and "Project Purity that."
translation: 所有人都对净化器兴奋异常: 整天"净水工程"这，"净水工程"那的。

original: But did anyone stop to ask, "Hey, what are we going to DO with all that clean water?" Well, guess who gets to fill in that tiny detail.
translation: 但是否有人冷静下来并且问， "嗨，我们拿这么多干净的水用来做什么？" 好吧，猜猜谁来回答这个问题。

original: It'd be one thing if I had support, but that little war with the Enclave has depleted much of the Brotherhood's resources.
translation: 如果我得到足够的支持的话事情还有得办，但是和英克雷的那场仗耗费了兄弟会太多的资源。

original: And to top it off, I have to be mommy to a bunch of lab coats.
translation: 而更糟糕的是，我还得给一群实验室里的白痴当爹当妈。

original: Oh-Kay... I'll swing by another time.
translation: 好-的……我一会儿再回来吧。

original: If Lyons wants to chase after his deliveries, fine. Let HIM do it. But I'm done wasting resources and risking lives on this pet project of his.
translation: 如果里昂斯想要追查他的货，好吧。让他去做吧。但是我可不会再浪费资源和生命在他那“得意”的工程上了。

original: <Clears throat> Have you ever seen a map? North... points... UP!
translation: <清了清嗓子> 你之前看过地图么？北……是……朝上的！

original: I wish. But no, I need them. They're some of the few that bothered to come back at all - a hardy bunch, this group. Almost as good as our own men.
translation: 我倒是想。但不要，我需要他们。他们是为数不多敢回来的人 - 这群人，算得上硬汉。 和我的人有的一拼。

original: That's why I'm here, actually. Bigsley sent me.
translation: 实际上这就是为什么我来找你。比格斯利派我来的。

original: Oh, he did? I was beginning to think he forgot about us.
translation: 噢，他这么做了？我还以为他把我们给忘了呢。

original: Not sure how much you know: There's been an increase in attacks on the caravans. Seems organized and not just the random Raider or Mutant encounter.
translation: 不确定你知道多少: 现在开始有越来越多针对商队的攻击。看上去是有组织的而而不像是与匪徒和变异生物的零星冲突。

original: I'm running out of resources and I'm down to my greenest men. I want to get to the bottom of these coordinated attacks. The sooner the better.
translation: 我快没补给了而且我现在只剩下几个菜鸟手下了。我希望这些协同的攻击能快点结束。越快越好。

original: Is that a Plasma Rifle you've got there? I could use that on the mission.
translation: 你那是把等离子步枪吗？我可能会用得上。

original: I suppose I don't really need it pushing papers around here, do I?
translation: 我猜我其实不需要用这写来文件，不是吗？

original: Alright. Consider it an advance on your payment. You better not disappoint.
translation: 好吧。把这个当作订金吧。别跟我抱怨。
我会是你最恐怖的噩梦！

original: That so? You're one of the newbies? You best know the pass phrase asshole. Or you're dead.
translation: 就这些？你也是新来的？ 你最好知道口令你这混蛋。否则你就死定了。

original: Okay. You're lucky you knew that. Don't know who let you in, don't really care.
translation: 好的。能知道这些你可真走运。我不知道是谁让你来的，我也不关心这个。

original: This is a real simple gang. Whoever's the toughest sets the rules, and that's ME. And I got just one rule: Do what the hell I say, when I say it.
translation: 这儿的情况很简单。在这里最强悍的人才能立规矩，那个人就是我。而我只有一条规矩: 我让你干什么，你就他妈的干什么。

original: Now, find a seat. We're waiting for some of the boys to get back.
translation: 现在，找个地方坐下。我们在等小子们回来。

original: Oh, and put this on. We're a gang. We all wear the same uniform.
translation: 哦对了，穿上这个。这儿是个帮会。我们都穿统一的制服。

original: Do I really have to guess?
Here you go. Run along now.
And remember: All sales are final. No refunds.
translation: 还有别忘了: 一旦售出，概不退换。

original: Right you are! Here's the bottle, and I'll take those caps. Pleasure doing business with you, sir. Come again!
translation: 好的！拿好这瓶，瓶盖我收下了。非常高兴和您做买卖，先生，欢迎再来！

original: And remember: All sales are final. No refunds or exchanges.
translation: 还有，别忘了: 一旦售出，概不退换。不退款，不换货。

original: Sure. Here's 10 caps. Give me a bottle of the "Amazing" Aqua Cura.
translation: 好。给你10个瓶盖。给我一瓶"神奇的"沌净水。

original: Right you are! Here's the bottle, and I'll take those caps. Pleasure doing business with you, ma'am. Come again!
translation: 好的！拿好这瓶，瓶盖我收下。非常高兴和您做买卖，女士，欢迎再来！

original: And remember: All sales are final. No refunds or exchanges.
translation: 还有，别忘了: 一旦售出，概不退换。不退款，不换货。

original: Sure. Here's 10 caps. Give me a bottle of the "Amazing" Aqua Cura.
translation: 好。给你10个瓶盖。给我一瓶"神奇的"沌净水。

original: Got a free sample I could try?
A FREE sample you say? Hmm... Well... I normally don't do this... but, for YOU, for this ONE TIME ONLY, a VERY special VIP promotional offer...
translation: 你说免费样品？嗯……好吧……我一般是不会这么做的……但是，为了你，仅此一次，给你一次VIP的待遇吧……

original: Ladies and gentlemen, DING-DING-DING! We have a new winner in our daily Aqua Cura Sweepstakes!
translation: 女士们先生们，叮-叮-叮！一位沌净水抽奖的幸运儿诞生了！

original: Here you go, sir. Your FREE bottle! Step right up in the next 5 minutes, and get your VERY OWN bottle of the Amazing Aqua Cura at HALF price! Ladies and gentlemen. Half price!
translation: 给你，先生。免费试饮！如果你五分钟内行动起来的话，你就能以半价得到一瓶属于自己的神奇的沌净水！女士们先生们。半价！

original: A FREE sample you say? Hmm... Well... I normally don't do this... but, for YOU, for this ONE TIME ONLY, a VERY special VIP promotional offer...
translation: 你说免费样品？嗯……好吧……我一般是不会这么做的……但是，为了你，仅此一次，给你一次VIP的待遇吧……

original: Ladies and gentlemen, DING-DING-DING! We have a new winner in our daily Aqua Cura Sweepstakes!
translation: 女士们先生们，叮-叮-叮！一位沌净水抽奖的幸运儿诞生了！

original: Here you go, ma'am. Your FREE bottle! Step right up in the next 5 minutes, and get your VERY OWN bottle of the Amazing Aqua Cura at HALF price! Ladies and gentlemen. Half price!
translation: 给你，女士。免费试饮！如果你五分钟内行动起来的话，你就能以半价得到一瓶属于自己的神奇的沌净水！女士们先生们。半价！

original: I'm good to go. What's next?
translation: 我准备好了。接下来干什么？

original: Based on the data you brought us from the relay station, we've identified where the Enclave is basing their operation.
translation: 根据你从中继站带给我们的数据，我们找出了英克雷部队的基地位置。

original: It seems they have a second base of operations at Adams Air Force base, outside of D.C.
translation: 看来他们还有第二个基地，位于华盛顿特区外的亚当空军基地.

original: The only safe way to get there is through the Presidential Metro used by the government before the war.
translation: 唯一能够安全抵达那里的方法是通过政府战前所使用的总统专用地铁

original: You're going to be on your own again for now; the rest of the Brotherhood will be providing a distraction so you can slip in undetected.
translation: 你现在又将独自一人， 兄弟会的其他人会引开对方的注意，让你潜入。

original: Once you breach the Presidential Metro and get to Adams Air Force Base, look for the Resupply Crate.
translation: 一旦你通过了总统专用地铁就前往亚当空军基地，寻找补给板条箱。

original: Inside, you'll find your new orders and hopefully we can put a working Tesla Cannon into your hands.
translation: 在那里，你会获得新的命令，希望我们给你的特斯拉 加农炮能有用。

original: I might like a bottle of Aqua Cura. How much are you selling them for?
translation: 我想来一瓶沌浄水。多少钱？

original: Here you go! Another satisfied customer, I'm sure!
translation: 好极了！毫无疑问，又有一个顾客心满意足了！

original: Here's 10 caps. I'll take a bottle.
translation: 给你10个瓶盖。给我来一瓶。

original: Right you are! Pleasure doing business with you, sir. Come again!
translation: 好的！非常高兴和您做生意，先生。欢迎再来！

original: Sure. Here's 10 caps. Give me a bottle of the "Amazing" Aqua Cura.
translation: 好吧。给你10个瓶盖。给我一瓶"神奇的"沌净水。

original: Right you are! Pleasure doing business with you, ma'am. Come again!
translation: 好的！非常高兴和您做生意，女士。欢迎再来！

original: Sure. Here's 10 caps. Give me a bottle of the "Amazing" Aqua Cura.
translation: 好吧。给你10个瓶盖。给我一瓶"神奇的"沌净水。

original: Relax. I don't care. Take these morons for all their worth. I'm just curious.
translation: 别紧张。我没有别的意思。你怎么骗这些白痴都行。我只是好奇而已。

original: It's true, I got a thing going.
translation: 没错，我正在干一番大事业。

original: I take the Aqua Pura, store it to sell to humans later, then I put the regular irradiated crap in the bottles and sell it to these fools.
translation: 我买来纯净水，储藏起来过一阵子再卖回给人类，之后再往剩下的空瓶子里灌满普通的受过辐射的脏水卖给那些傻瓜。

original: No one's getting hurt. In fact, the Brotherhood actually needs the caps and technology I give them to fund their "free" water caravans.
translation: 没有人会因此受到什么伤害。实际上，兄弟会需要我的瓶盖和技术来资助"免费的"贩水商队。

original: Just ask Bigsley at Project Purity, he'll tell you how grateful he is I'm helping them out like this.
translation: 不信你去问问净水工程的比格斯利，他会告诉你我这样帮助他们让他们有多高兴。

original: But watch yourself. Get in my way, and... let's just say, I'm good at removing problems.
translation: 但是小心一点。你要是敢捣乱，那么……这么跟你说吧，我可是很擅长摆平麻烦的。

original: Heheh. You're not fooling anyone. Everyone knows you're one of the good guys.
translation: 呵呵呵。别跟我装了。谁都知道你是那种老实人。

original: But seriously kid. I'm not up to anything. Just ask any of these fools - ahem - I mean, LOYAL customers.
translation: 但是说真的小子。我可没打算要怎么样。你去问下那些傻瓜- 哦不 - 我是说忠实的顾客。

original: They already see the many benefits of the Amazing Aqua Cura!
translation: 他们已经看到我神奇的沌净水的功效了！

original: You're clearly up to something. There's no denying it. Talk. Now!
translation: 你肯定在隐瞒什么。不要抵赖了。现在就说！

original: Oh alright, alright. But if you start blabbing, I've got some buddies with itching trigger fingers...
translation: 哦，对了，对了。如果你多嘴泄密的话，我这儿有几个带枪的弟兄手可是有点儿痒啊……

original: So I've got this little operation taking Aqua Pura and replacing it with regular crap. It's not like it'll hurt us Ghouls.
translation: 于是我动了点小手脚，买来纯净水，然后用一些个次货换掉它们。但这似乎不会对我们僵尸们产生危害。

original: The Aqua Pura I'm storing to sell back to humans later. You know, raiders, Outcasts, etc. The guys the Brotherhood doesn't share with.
translation: 那些纯净水我都留着卖给人类呢。你知道的，那些个歹徒，放逐者，诸如此类的人。兄弟会不会分水给他们的。

original: I'm not a bad guy. I'm just trying to help. The Brotherhood needs me. My caps mean water for the Wasteland. Just ask Bigsley at Project Purity.
translation: 我可不是坏人。我只是想帮忙。兄弟会需要我。我的瓶盖就好比废土大地上的清水。不信你可以去问问净水工程的比格斯利。

original: I'm getting a case for my family.
I can't believe it does ALL that! That's wonderful!
translation: 我真不敢相信它全做到了！真是美妙绝伦啊

original: The Amazing Aqua Cura cures all the common Ghoul ailments! Guaranteed!
translation: 神奇的沌净水能够治疗僵尸的各种疑难杂症！包你满意！

original: Hellacious halitosis. It's a common condition of the Ghoul state. But it's not permanent. Not with Amazing Aqua Cura that is!
translation: 难闻的口臭。这对僵尸来说是常见问题。但绝不是永久的。只要你用了神奇的沌净水它就不是！

original: Friends, have you stopped combing your hair? Afraid of pulling out the few remaining plugs?
translation: 朋友们，你是否已经不再梳理你的头发？害怕把脑袋上仅剩的几根毛发拽下来？

original: Forget all that. Just give me 300 caps this once, and we'll call it even.
translation: 算了。给我300个瓶盖，我俩就算扯平了。

original: What the hell. It's just this once, and then we're through.
translation: 真他妈的。只此一次，从此我们就两清了。

original: Fine. Here's your 300 caps. There. I just bought your silence. So keep your mouth shut.
translation: 好。这是给你的300瓶盖。拿着这个。我已经给了你封口费，所以管好你的嘴。

original: Either you tell them, or I tell them. Your call.
translation: 要么你告诉他们，要么我来。你自己选。

original: I can't believe it... I have a good thing going here... Why mess that up for me? What have I done to you?
translation: 我真不敢相信……我正在这忙我的好事呢……你干嘛来捣乱？我惹你了吗？

original: I'm not hurting anyone. I mean, really? Reverse the Ghoul condition? With a bottle of water? I wasn't fooling anybody; they were fooling themselves.
translation: 我谁也没伤害。我的意思是，真的？把僵尸变成人？就靠一瓶水？我谁也没骗; 是他们自欺欺人。

original: Fine. I've made enough money here, anyway. Well, um... It's probably best if I tell them. I think I know what to say.
translation: 好吧。反正我也赚够了。那么，呃……还是我来告诉他们好些。我知道该说些什么。

original: Oh, poor dear. Here, I've got some water I can spare.
translation: 噢。我可怜的。拿着，我这有点水可以分给你。

original: For... for me? Crystal clear water? Oh, bless you! Bless you!
translation: 给……给我？水晶般纯净的水？噢，上帝保佑你！保佑你！

original: No, bless you. I'm glad to help.
translation: 不，愿上帝保佑你，我很高兴帮助你。

original: It's okay. You couldn't have known.
translation: 好吧。你也不知道会这样。

original: No, it's not okay! Not for him! It was supposed to be holy water. The man at the monastery in Springvale said it was blessed!
translation: 不，这水有问题！他不能喝！这应该是圣水。春之谷修道院里的人说它是被祝福过的！

original: He gave me this pamphlet along with the water. Called himself Brother Gerard. You can find him on the road through Springvale.
translation: 他还把这个宣传册随水赠给了我。他自称杰拉德兄弟。你可以在春之谷的路上看到他

original: I don't know if it'll help, but I don't know what else I can do.
translation: 我不知道这有没有用，但是没有其他办法了。

original: I'll look into it. Where did you get the water?
translation: 我会去查查看的。你的水是从哪来的？

original: I thought it would help him. It was supposed to be holy water. The man at the monastery in Springvale said it was blessed!
translation: 我以为这能救他。这应该是圣水。春之谷修道院里的人说它是被祝福过的！

original: He gave me this pamphlet along with the water. Called himself Brother Gerard. You can find him on the road through Springvale.
translation: 他还把这个宣传册随水赠给了我。他自称杰拉德兄弟。你可以在春之谷的路上看到他。

original: They said they had lots of this holy water. Please, do something to stop them!
translation: 他们还说有好多这样的圣水。拜托，请阻止他们！

original: Sounds to me like you wanted him dead.
translation: 我觉得你是故意害死他的。

original: No, I promise, I thought it would help! It was supposed to be holy water. The man at the monastery in Springvale said it was blessed!
translation: 不， 我发誓，我真的以为能帮上忙！它应该是圣水！修道院里的人说它是被祝福过的！

original: Here, he gave me this pamphlet with the water. Called himself Brother Gerard. You can find him on the road through Springvale! He's responsible!
translation: 看这个，他还把这个宣传册随水赠给了我。他自称杰拉德兄弟。你可以在春之谷的路上看到他。他要负责！

original: I was just trying to help. It's not my fault! Please!
translation: 我只是想来帮忙的。这不是我的错！真的！

original: Why, to offer Enlightenment to all those who suffer, of course. No more, no less.
translation: 啊哈，当然这正是为那些仍在苦难中的人们提供启发。

original: Atom came to me with a vision: the starving, the ill, the weak, all being made whole and well by receiving the sacrament of Atom's Glow.
translation: 原子带给了我们这样一个景象：饥饿，疾病，虚弱，一切生命在接受了原子的荣光的圣礼后都重新复苏了。

original: And so, with our holy water, we can make this vision a reality. When exposed to Atom's supreme Glow, the ill are reborn in his glowing visage.
translation: 所以，有了我们的圣水，我们可以让这种景象实现。当你笼罩在原子的终极光辉下，苦难中的人们将恢复生气从而获得新生。

original: Those reborn never hunger, never suffer, and never age. All our Enlightened brethren need to know is Atom's Glow, and they are happy.
translation: 他们重生之后将永不饥饿，永无痛苦，永不老朽。我们所有启发过的同胞只须谨记原子的荣光，便可仙福永享。

original: Why are you doing all of this?
It's been confirmed. The Purifier has been activated. We've been ordered to fortify our current position and wait for orders.
translation: 已经确认。净化器已经启动。上级命令我们在原地防守，并等待指示。

original: With a lull in the fighting, we set up and fortified our position outside the Capitol Building, near Seward Square.
translation: 在战斗的间歇，我们在国会大厦的外围，苏华德广场附近，建造起防御工事并再次加固。

original: Things have been relatively quiet around here lately. That'll all change when word spreads of the purifier.
translation: 前段日子的情况相对起来还是较为平静。但当关于净化器的流言传开，这些全都变了。

original: Anyone and everyone will do whatever they can to get there hands on some of that water. For life or profit, it makes no difference.
translation: 任何一个人都想在这水中分一杯羹。为了生存或利益，这没什么区别。

original: Same old killing, just a different ingredient.
translation: 一如既往的杀戮，只是为了不同的理由。

original: We've been in position for a couple of days now. No sign of the caravans. This is bullshit! I want some god damn water.
translation: 我们已经在目标地点等了好几天了。没有商队的消息。真他妈的！我要那该死的水。

original: I'm gonna kill Jed for putting us girls through this shit. Why get close to the caravan when we could just blow 'em away from a distance?
translation: 我打算为了姑娘们把杰德干掉。如果可以从远距离赶走商队我们为什么还要靠近他们呢？

original: He says we need the ammunition and can't afford to lose anybody. "Just use your good looks or something", he says. What an ass.
translation: 他说我们需要弹药，并且没法承受失去任何人了。他说，"只要使用你的美貌或别的什么"。多么愚蠢。

original: Yeah, I killed him. But I'm here to set up a "protection" deal with the gang.
translation: 对，我把他干掉了。不过我想和你谈谈"保护费"的问题。

original: Pay 500 caps now, and I'll call off the attacks.
translation: 现在给我500个瓶盖，以后你们就不会再受袭击。

original: Damn it. I just don't have that kind of money at my disposal...
translation: 该死的。我手头可没那么多钱…

original: Here's the deal. I'll give you 500 caps, from my own personal savings, mind you, and you call off the attacks. But that's it. That's all I have.
translation: 我的条件就是这样。我付给你500个瓶盖，请注意，这是我私人的积蓄，而你去阻止这次进攻。就这样。我只有这么多了。

original: Come on, I know you've got something more. Quit holding out on me.
translation: 来吧，我知道你还剩了点。别再装了。

original: Fine. Here's an extra 50 caps. Now get out of here until next week.
translation: 好吧。这里还有50个瓶盖。现在离开这儿下个礼拜前别回来。

original: Give me more. Or I'll bust you upside the head.
translation: 再给多点。不然我就把你的脖子拧下来。

original: Damnit man, why you got to be like that?
translation: 真该死，哥们，你什么时候开始变得这么贪？

original: Here. Take half my caps. Then get the hell out of here until next week.
translation: 拿着。我的钱分你一半。现在滚吧下周之前别回来。

original: Not good enough. Give me your caps, or I'll take them from your corpse.
translation: 这不行。把你们的瓶盖都给我，省得我在你们尸体上搜。

original: Just don't hurt me, alright? Here's all my caps.
translation: 别伤害我好吗？我的瓶盖全在这里。

original: I don't got shit for you to take. Honest man. My pockets are empty.
translation: 我身上没东西值得拿的。说真的伙计。我的口袋空空如也。

original: Ha. I might of believed you were capable of that. But everyone knows you're a softy.
translation: 哈。我真该相信你能做的出来那种事。但每个人都知道你是个软蛋。

original: Ahem. If it wasn't for me, there'd be no protection racket.
translation: 呃哼。如果不是我，你们连保护费都没机会交。

original: Yeah. I guess you're right. Here's a bigger share of the take. We'll see you next week.
translation: 是的。我猜你是对的。我再多分你点儿钱吧。我们下周见。

original: No! That's not supposed to happen! No, get up! Get up! You can't pass out, you're supposed to get better! I gave you holy water, and everything!
translation: 不！这本不该发生的！不，起来！起来！你不应该死的，你本该好起来的！我给了你圣水，我给了你一切！

original: I haven't tasted water this pure since... urk... Oh. Oh god, what's wrong? Water...
translation: 我好久都没喝过这么纯的……呃……噢。天啊，怎么了？这水……

original: Due to the security breach, access to the southern and eastern metro lines is currently prohibited.
translation: 由于安全系统被侵入，通往南部和东部的地铁线路目前被封闭了。

original: The security breach inside the Presidential Metro System has been cleared. All sections, stand down from alert status.
translation: 总统专用地铁系统的安全问题已经排除。所有区域解除紧急状态。

original: The Metro Transit Authority would like to extend its very best to our soldiers fighting abroad and wishes them a safe and speedy return.
translation: 地铁运输机构对我们在外国奋战的士兵表达最热诚的祝福，希望他们能早日凯旋。

original: The robot is our best weapon. If we can keep it running, we have a chance. If not, we have to find another way to counter their Vertibirds.
translation: 机器人是我们最好的武器，如果我们能保持它的运转，我们就有取胜的机会，如果不能，那必须找到其他办法来对付他们的飞鸟。

original: Don't forget they apparently have missiles they can launch at us from... hell, I don't know. Space? Kind of hard to fight back against that.
translation: 别忘了他们还有导弹，他们可以从…操，我也不知道从哪里打击我们。也许是太空？见鬼，那样的话，怎么还手啊。

original: It's a necessary move, but yeah. If the attack fails, they're going to come at us hard.
translation: 这是必要的一步，是的。若进攻失败，他们就会让我们很难过。

original: We've been able to steamroll the Enclave so far, but how do you think this is going to end? Can we really defeat them?
translation: 我们一直到现在都压着英克雷打，但是你觉得最后会结束吗？我们真的能打败他们？

original: I'm trying to stay positive, but losing the robot was a huge blow. Do you think we'll still be able to pull through this?
translation: 我想乐观些，但是没有了机器人，真是打击很大。你觉得我们能渡过这个难关吗？

original: I need to enter the monastery.
Ah, but of course! You have been blessed by Atom with Eternal Light, and are most welcome to our monastery.
translation: 啊，没问题！你已经被原子的永恒之光祝福过了，非常欢迎来到我们的修道院。

original: You will find many kindred spirits within. Please, introduce yourself to our leader, our Luminescent Mother, Curie the Third.
translation: 你会在里面发现很多血族的勇士。请你向我们的首领，我们的荧光嬷嬷，圣母居里三世，介绍你自己吧。

original: Ah, I can feel the Light within you. By all means, you are welcome in our sanctuary.
translation: 噢，我能感觉到你体内的圣光。也就是说，我们的圣所现在欢迎你。

original: Please, speak with our leader, our Luminescent Mother, Curie the Third.
translation: 请您与我们的领袖谈谈，我们的荧光嬷嬷，居里三世。

original: There. I've gotten a little irradiated. Can I go in now?
translation: 那么，我已经受了点辐射。现在我能进去吗？

original: Oh, truly your Light is second only to the Suns of Atom themselves! You are more than welcome.
translation: 噢，你身上的圣光已经仅次于原子骄阳了！我们非常欢迎您。

original: Please, speak with our leader, our Luminescent Mother, Curie the Third.
translation: 请您与我们的领袖谈谈，我们的荧光嬷嬷，居里三世。

original: I am consumed with Atom's Light. Let me into your monastery.
translation: 我已经浸泡过原子的圣光了。让我进教堂。

original: Still working on decrypting the Enclave data pulled from the last encounter. We should have solid results soon.
translation: 我们还在破解上次交锋时获得的英克雷数据。相信很快就会有重大进展。

original: I can't stay here. Not after something like that...
translation: 我不能呆在这儿。尤其是发生了这种事之后……

original: I hear you can help me get into Old Olney.
translation: 我听说你能帮我进入老奥尔尼。

original: Well, maybe. I mean, possibly. I think so, but I'm not certain.
translation: 嗯，可能吧。我是说，也许。我想是的，不过不能确定。

original: I don't know how much this will actually help... I mean, I'm not quite sure how effective it might be since it hasn't really been field tested...
translation: 我不知道这能帮上多少忙…我是说，因为这还没在战场上测试过，所以我不是很肯定它多有效…

original: But I think I've figured out a way to override the signals the Enclave is using to control their Deathclaws.
translation: 但是我认为我已经研究出办法，来改变英克雷用来控制他们那些死亡爪的信号。

original: Here, take this. It's only a prototype, so please don't lose it.
translation: 给，拿着。只有一个样机，所以别弄丢了。

original: Ah... my um... LOYAL customers and FRIENDS!
translation: 啊……我的……嗯……忠实的顾客和朋友啊！

original: Yeah, but we're Ghouls so it's not like it's hurt anybody.
translation: 没错，但是我们都僵尸，所以这玩意不会危害到任何人。

original: And, as I've said with each and every purchase: "All sales are final." Eheh.
translation: 并且，就像我对每一个买我货的人说的一样:  "概不退换。" 嗯。

original: I can assure you, ladies and gentlemen, that violence won't be necessary.
translation: 请相信我，女士们先生们，暴力是完全没有必要的。

original: Little Sister, I've stashed away a considerable amount of fuel behind the small building west of the Air Traffic Control Tower as you requested.
translation: 妹妹，我按你的要求在空中交通控制塔西面的小楼里藏了相当多的燃油。

original: The container's tucked away under some barrels and tires. And no, I couldn't safely confiscate an Incinerator for you, that's your job.
translation: 那个油桶就藏在一些桶和轮胎下面。不过，我没法给你弄到一把喷火枪，只有靠你自己了。

original: I took too big a risk hiding that fuel for you in the first place. If you do come across an Incinerator, please be careful.
translation: 我在那地方为你藏了那些燃料可是冒大风险的。如果你真想弄到一把喷火枪，那就要当心了。

original: Anyway, they're shipping me out to some relay station far west of here in the Wasteland. I'm afraid I won't be seeing you for awhile.
translation: 不管怎么说，他们要把我送去废土西面很远的一个中继站，恐怕我们要有一段时间不能见面了。

original: Take care and good luck in all your endeavors. Your Big Brother.
translation: 以后的日子自己当心，祝你好运。你的哥哥。

original: So get your glasses ready, children. This round's on me.
translation: 所以把你的杯子准备好了,孩子们。这次我请客。

original: As I speak, the Brotherhood is working with Rivet City security to get that fresh water to the Wasteland. The caravans are coming!
translation: 听我说,兄弟会正在与铆钉城市保安把那些淡水送到废土。小篷车就来了!

original: God, ain't that beautiful? But even better, it's finally happened! The water is clean, and hell yes, it's free! Just a little patience, children.
translation: 天,不漂亮吗?但更重要的,最后成真了!水是干净和无害的,它是免费的!只要有点耐心,孩子们。

original: See, she was a scientist too, worked on that project. You know what she wanted? "The waters of life. Free and clean, for any and all."
translation: 看，她也是科学家,参与那项目。你知道她的想法吗?“生命之水。干净的免费的,给所有的人。”

original: Now you all remember James, right? Father of 101? Well, Three Dog has learned that back in the day, James' wife had a dream.
translation: 现在你记住詹姆斯,好吗?101小子的父亲?嗯,三狗在以前已经认识了,詹姆斯的妻子的梦想。

original: Two weeks. It's been two weeks since our boys in Power Armor kicked those Enclave bastards out of Project Purity, and started that baby chugging.
translation: 两个星期。已经两周了我们的孩子在那些穿电力盔甲的英克雷混蛋手里抢回净水工程后，开始了新生。

original: Three Dog's advice? If you've got one of those Mister Dandy butler bots, have him make you some purified water, and count yourself lucky.
translation: 三狗的建议吗?如果你能让那些上等人或管理者给你些纯水,算你走运。

original: The water going 'round may be free, but it sure as hell ain't clean. So when you see that caravan comin', tell 'em to keep on going.
translation: 水可以免费的拿，但是这样是不道德的。所以当你看到运水队，一定要付点什么才让他们走。

original: Coincidence? Three Dog thinks not. For all their good intentions, it looks like those eggheads at the Jefferson Memorial screwed up royally.
translation: 巧合吗?三狗的想法,不是。因为他们的善意,它看起来像那些有知识的人在杰佛逊纪念堂搞砸了很多。

original: It also happens that this new illness ONLY started showin' up AFTER the Brotherhood started distributing so-called "clean" water from that purifier.
translation: 在发生这种新疾病后才开始关心调查研究水净化器。

original: Experience would tell ya this is your garden variety radiation sickness, but nuh uh. This is something else, children. Something worse. Much worse.
translation: 经验告诉你这是多种多样的辐射病。这是别的什么东西,孩子们。更大的灾难。更糟了。

original: People are gettin' sick. Sicker than usual, I mean. Weakness, nausea, you name it. Even a couple of deaths reported.
translation: 人是肯定病了。往常一样,我是说。软弱,恶心,就是这样。甚至有了死亡病例。

original: All righty, children, time to let you know about yet another problem plaguing our tranquil little post-apocalyptic neighborhood.
translation: 好的,孩子们,时间让你知道另一问题新的瘟疫出现在启示录之前。

original: The Enclave's been responsible for enough death and destruction. We need to get back to normal. You know, like fighting Raiders and Super Mutants.
translation: 有太多的死亡和破坏了。我们需要回到正常的生活。你知道，如同抵抗歹徒和超级变种人。

original: You know, some laser beams here, a few exploded corpses there. Let's just hope this mop up operation ends ASAP.
translation: 你知道,一些激光束闪过,一些尸体被分解。我们希望尽快完成操作。

original: But the fight, dear children, did not end there. The Brotherhood has been pursuing "President" Eden's little minions throughout the Wasteland.
translation: 但是这样战斗,亲爱的孩子们,并没有到此为止。兄弟会还在废土追缴伊甸总统的一些走狗。

original: It's been some time since those plucky paladins in Power Armor first stormed the Jefferson Memorial and gave the Enclave their walking papers.
translation: 未来一段时间，因为那一群勇敢的骑士在杰佛逊纪念堂，把穿电力装甲的英克雷赶走了。

original: What else can you tell me about the fight against the Enclave?
translation: 关于对抗英克雷的战斗，你还有什么能告诉我的吗？

original: As you know, I had my reservations about engaging the Enclave. They did not directly attack us, and I believed we had time. Time to be cautious.
translation: 你知道的，我在关于与英克雷交战的问题上还保留意见。他们不会直接攻击我们，我认为我们还有时间。是时候谨慎行事了。

original: Their assault on the purifier forced our hand. We had no choice but to engage them directly.
translation: 他们对净化器的袭击迫使我们动手。除了开战，我们别无他法。

original: And, once that engagement was begun, we could do nothing but see it through to the end. If they had not considered us a threat before, they do now.
translation: 还有就是战斗一打响，我们所能作的只有等待它的结束。如果他们之前没有把我们当成威胁的话，那现在他们该改变想法了。

original: So we have spent the time since you and I last spoke systematically locating and destroying every bastion of Enclave force we can.
translation: 自从我们上次找出并摧毁英克雷的每一个堡垒之前已经有些时日了。

original: Liberty Prime has proven far more successful than any of us could have hoped for.
translation: “自由先锋”已经证明我们能取得的成功远超出我们的期望。

original: I've been trying to get outta here for awhile. See, I've done things for the Enclave... Things I can't say I'm proud of, but a man's gotta eat.
translation: 我尝试离开这里已经有一段时间了。你也看到了我为英克雷做事…。这些事当然不怎么光彩，但是人总要吃饭啊。

original: When the Enclave picked me up, I was starving and suffering from radiation poisoning. I felt I owed them. But now... now it's time to leave.
translation: 当年英克雷收留我的时候，我正饱受饥饿之苦和辐射的伤害。我觉得我欠他们的。但是现在…现在是时候离开了。

original: You'll make a great distraction while I make off with a few robots and supplies. I help you, and you help me.
translation: 你尽可能的吸引他们的注意力，而我去弄点补给和机器人。我们互帮互助。

original: You're really helpful. Why should I trust you?
translation: 你突然这么帮助我。我为什么要信任你？

original: Man, I'm glad you realize I'm not one of the bad guys. I'll be happy to answer any questions you have.
translation: 伙计，我很高兴你明白了我不是个坏人。我很乐意回答你的任何问题。

original: Likewise. I was wondering if you could answer a few questions.
translation: 我也很高兴见到你。不知道你能不能回答我几个问题。

original: There's something jamming the control frequency!
translation: 有东西在干扰控制波频！

original: I've got blood samples to turn in.
Good job. I'll inform Lyons of your progress.
translation: 干得漂亮。我会告诉里昂斯你所做的。

original: Fantastic. I'll get the Scribes to record your kills.
translation: 难以想象。我会让文员们记录下你的杀敌数量。

original: Nice work. Come back when you have more.
translation: 干得不错。如果你取得了更多的就回来找我。
太好了！请再给我多带一些。

original: Yeah, you don't seem like the goody-goody type. But don't spread this around: So this Ghoul, Griffon, comes in wanting to PURCHASE a bunch of water.
translation: 好吧，你也不像是个虚伪的人。别把这事说出去了: 那个僵尸，格里芬，经常来这儿买水。

original: What the hell does that droopy irradiated fool need with pure water? Thinks he can sell it in Underworld. Moron.
translation: 那个快腐烂的傻瓜要这么多净水干嘛？他以为他能在地下城卖掉这些水。蠢货。

original: But, he's the only one who's offered to PAY for water, in caps AND technology.
translation: 不过，只有他愿意用瓶盖或是科技来换水。

original: And what Lyons doesn't know won't hurt him. There's plenty of water to go around.
translation: 里昂斯虽然不知道，但这对他没什么危害。这儿还有好多水。

original: And I can use it to pay Rivet City to provide security for all the caravans we can't escort ourselves. I'm lucky he came along.
translation: 我们还能用他给的钱让铆钉城的警力保护我们的商队。他来找我可是我的运气。

original: I know you've got something set up. Don't worry, I won't tell your superiors.
translation: 我知道你正在偷偷的干些什么。别担心，我不会告诉你上司的。

original: I found some Sensor Modules for you.
translation: 我给你拿了些传感器模块。

original: Ah, very nice. I'll have my assembling team get right on it.
translation: 啊，很好！我现在就让装配组去做！

original: We'll need a lot more where this came from to reconstruct Prime's electrical systems. Keep bringing more.
translation: 我们还需要更多的材料才能重新建造自由金刚的电子系统。请多带点过来。

original: It's but a drop in the bucket, but it'll have to do. Thanks.
translation: 杯水车薪啊，但是聊胜于无。多谢啦。

original: I have Cameras for you, Scribe Rothchild.
translation: 我给你带了相机，文员罗斯查德。

original: Good, good. Please keep bringing them to me... it's my only hope of getting Prime's optics rebuilt.
translation: 很好，很好。请再多带一些过来…只有靠这样我才能把先锋的光学系统修复。

original: Oh, splendid! Hopefully these will contain unbroken lenses unlike the last few I've acquired.
translation: 噢，太棒了！我希望这里面还有完好的镜头，可别像我上次拿到的那几个。

original: Excellent! I'll begin disassembling them immediately. Good work!
translation: 太棒了！我马上就把它们拆开。干得好！

original: If someone finds this... please get this to my lover at the La Maison Beauregard Hotel in East Georgetown... he'll want to hear what I have to say.
translation: 如果有人发现了这个…请把它带给我住在东乔治敦，迈松博勒加德酒店的恋人…他会想要听听我说了什么的。

original: My darling... they've found me. I... I tried to get away... tried to get away so we could be together once again...
translation: 亲爱的…他们已经找到我了。我…我试着逃走…逃走回去和你再在一起…

original: I know you risked your life to get it to me... combing the ruins, avoiding the Super Mutants... all for me.
translation: 我知道你冒着生命危险为我找到它…搜寻废墟，避开超级变种人…这一切都是为了我。

original: It seems I shall never lay my eyes upon your gift... you... you'll have to keep it and remember me every time you see it.
translation: 看来我没法亲眼见到你的礼物了…你…你要带着它，每当看到它时你就会想起我。

original: I'm so sorry my darling... so... so... sorry I've let you down. So many have died for this thing... so many hearts have been broken.
translation: 对不起，亲爱的…真的…真的…对不起，让你失望了。太多人为这东西而死…太多人因此心碎。

original: Please remember, I'll always love you... you will be with me forever in my spirit... I... I... l-love... you...
translation: 请记住，我一直爱着你…你永远在我心里…我…我…我爱…你...

original: Look, this wasn't how it was supposed to go down.
translation: 看，这没有像原本猜想的那样下降。

original: It was a good idea at the time, y'know? Figured we'd try and set ourselves up down here. Just like Underworld, only better.
translation: 当时这是个好主意，你知道吗？想想我们试着在这里建立起我们自己的地盘，就像地下城那样，而且比那里更好

original: Who's gonna bother a bunch of Ghouls living underneath Old Olney, right? So we get down here, we start knockin' some walls down...
translation: 没有谁会想过要去惹一大堆住在老奥尔尼地下的僵尸，不是吗？所以我们来到这里，开始试着推倒几赌墙…

original: And the next thing you know we're getting our faces chewed off by Deathclaws.
translation: 而你会知道接下来的事情就是我们的脑袋会被死亡之爪们嚼碎。

original: Oh, great. Ghouls. I hate Ghouls.
translation: 哦，太棒了。僵尸。我讨厌僵尸。

original: Officer Lepelletier said you'd be rewarding me...
translation: 莱佩莱捷警官警官说你会给我奖励……

original: Yes, yes. I received a message from her. It's here somewhere... Well, no matter where it is, I know what it said.
translation: 是的，是的。我收到她的讯息了。在这儿……算了，找不到，我知道那讯息说什么。

original: <Sigh.> The Initiates just finished itemizing a requisition of confiscated Enclave gear. There were a few items that we didn't immediately send out.
translation: <叹气。>那些新兵刚刚提交了一份详细的清单，申请发放被收缴的英克雷装备。我们只剩下一些没有送出去的装备了。

original: I suppose you are welcome to those...
The Brotherhood thanks you for your efforts. Now if you don't mind? I think I'll just take a brief nap here at my desk...
translation: 兄弟会感谢你付出的努力。现在如果你不介意的话……我想我能在这儿打个盹……

original: <Sigh.> The Initiates just finished itemizing a requisition of confiscated Enclave gear. There were a few items that we didn't immediately send out.
translation: <叹气。>那些新兵刚刚提交了一份详细的清单，申请发放被收缴的英克雷装备。我们只剩下一些没有送出去的装备了。

original: I suppose you're welcome to those...
The Brotherhood thanks you for your efforts. Now if you don't mind? I think I'll just take a brief nap here at my desk...
translation: 兄弟会感谢你付出的努力。现在如果你不介意的话……我想我能在这儿打个盹……

original: Heard about that. News traveled fast. I couldn't believe it. I mean, everyone knew it was crazy building a city around that bomb...
translation: 这事传的很快，我听说了。不过我不敢相信。我是说，是人都知道围着炸弹建房子肯定是脑子进水了……

original: But I don't think anyone expected the bomb to actually go off...
translation: 但我觉得没人会相信那炸弹能真正安全……

original: I didn't expect things to end like this... but it did get Lyons off my back about it.
translation: 我没料到这事会这样如此结束……不过现在里昂斯也不回来烦我了。

original: So here. Might as well take the money I was going to give you.
translation: 给你。不如把我要给你的钱拿走吧。

original: Megaton's destroyed. I suppose their water shipment isn't much of concern now.
translation: 兆吨镇已经炸没了。你再也不用担心给他们送水的问题了。

original: A cult? There's something about Megaton, isn't there. It's apparently THE place to start a cult these days.
translation: 邪教？兆吨镇果然有些古怪，不是么。很明显那儿就是这些天来出现的邪教的发源地。

original: Guess I can start sending them water again. Hopefully they can keep their grubby hands on their shipments this time.
translation: 看来我又能给他们送水了。希望这次他们的脏手不要来碰这些货物。

original: Here. It's not much. Most of the assets have been exhausted, but take this. It's definitely worth getting Lyons off my back. Thanks.
translation: 这儿。不算很多。有用的东西几乎都用完了，不过还有这个。这应该值得让你让里昂斯少烦我了。

original: I've stopped the cult that was stealing Megaton's water.
translation: 我制止了从兆吨镇偷水的邪教。

original: What's wrong? What did the letter say?
translation: 有什么不对？信上说什么？

original: Obadiah Blackhall sent me. I have a letter.
translation: 奥巴迪亚·布莱克霍尔派我来的，我这有封信。

original: Obadiah sent you? Well, then, let's see what he has to say.
translation: 奥巴迪亚派你来的？好吧，来看看他要说什么。

original: Oh dear... no, no. This can only mean one thing.
translation: 天啊…不。这只能意味着一件事。

original: Obadiah Blackhall sent me. I have a letter.
translation: 奥巴迪亚·布莱克霍尔派我来的，我这有封信。

original: What do you expect me to do?
We must get it back before the Krvibi learn anything from it.
translation: 我们必须在《黑暗圣经》从中学到任何东西之前夺回来。

original: There's a ritual site... I'm certain they'll be hiding it there. I don't know yet what we must do, but for now it's enough to steal the book.
translation: 有一处仪式场所…我确信他们会将它藏在那里。我还不知道我们必须做什么，但现在我们应该先把书偷走。

original: I'll do it, Obadiah. There's no reason for you to die.
translation: 我同意，奥巴迪亚。你不该死。

original: This isn't some ordinary book we can toss in a fire and be done with. I can destroy it here and now, but the ritual requires a sacrifice.
translation: 这书不一般，不是扔到火里烧了就完事的。我现在就可以将其销毁，但这需要有人牺牲。

original: They'll kill me anyway. Now that they've possessed the book, they'll do anything to get it back.
translation: 无论如何他们都会来杀我。他们已经丧心病狂了，并会不惜一切将其夺回。

original: There must be something we can do. We have the book.
translation: 一定还有什么办法。书在我们手上啊！

original: I'm sorry, Obadiah, but it's true. The book is here, with me.
translation: 很抱歉，奥巴迪亚，但这书真的在这里，就在我这。

original: I... I see. Friend, this book is the bane of my Family. Now it seems it will be the death of us, too.
translation: 我…我明白了。朋友，这书是我家族衰败的根源。看来我们也会因此消失吧。

original: I'll be bloody well damned. She was right. It's back.
translation: 我会被诅咒的。她说得没错。这书回来了。

original: The Krvibi had it, I took it, and now she's dead.
translation: 这本来是卡维碧的，现在在我手上，她已经死了。

original: You have it? God help us; you do. That damned book is back, and this time it'll be the death of me.
translation: 在你手里？上天相助啊，你得到了书。诅咒之书回来了，这一次我面对的将是死亡。

original: Marcella? Why? She's done nothing to them!
translation: 玛塞拉？为什么？她什么也没做！

original: They killed her, Obadiah. I'm sorry.
translation: 她已经死了，奥巴迪亚。我很抱歉。

original: What good are you, then? Take her that letter; she's the only person who might know how to help me.
translation: 这对你又有什么好处呢？带封信给她；恐怕只有她会帮我了。

original: Good job blocking off that hole! Hurry and get in here! It looks like they are about to breach from the East wing!
translation: 洞口堵住了！干得漂亮！快进来！看起来他们要从东翼突破了！

original: Hurry! Get in there before more of them come out! Find where they are coming from and stop them. Just like before I'll be keeping an eye out.
translation: 快！在更多人来之前进去！看看他们是从哪进来的，阻止他们。和刚才一样，我会一直盯着你。

original: That's one less way for them to get in. Follow me. I think we are about to get hit hard.
translation: 他们又少了一条可以进来的路。跟我来。咱们有场硬仗要打。

original: Yeah, here they come. Grab all the ammo and stimpaks you need. This is gonna be a rough one!
translation: 耶，他们来了。拿上你所需要的弹药和治疗针。这会很刺激！

original: They've been at it all night. I think they are just about to breach the inner walls. Follow me. I'm going to go check it out.
translation: 他们整晚都在。我想他们就要突破内墙了。跟着我。我们去查看一下。

original: It looks like they are coming in from somewhere upstairs. Hurry, follow me!
translation: 看来他们从楼上另一处来。快点，跟着我！

original: Go through these doors and up the stairs. Find where they are coming in and stop them. I'll be keeping an eye on the cameras down here. Hurry!
translation: 从这门上楼。看看他们从哪进来的，一定要阻止他们。我会在这里从摄像机中观察。快去！

original: Tell me about the mine, Kenny.
translation: 告诉我关于矿井的事，肯尼。

original: Old Man Herzog's Mine-hole? Isn't much, but it's home!
translation: 老赫尔佐格的矿井？不多，但那是家！

original: Tell me about this mine, Kenny.
translation: 告诉我关于矿井的事，肯尼。

original: This is Caroline Saunders, principal geological chemist, for Bysshe natural gas survey MD-16-001.
translation: 这里是卡洛琳·桑德斯，首席地质化学家，为彼希测量天然气，编号MD-16-001。

original: Sample set one shows promising concentration of bio-gas in mostly limestone substratum of wetlands.
translation: 样本的分析指出生化气体最有可能会在塘持的石灰岩底层。

original: No exact levels yet, but this site should exhibit more than enough extraction potential to meet survey goals.
translation: 没有具体数据显示可能会在多深处，但是这个地点应该有足够的量来萃取以达到测量目标。

original: I'm going to leave a couple of interns here to handle the minutiae, but it's a formality.
translation: 我将会留下几个实习生来处理细节上的东西，但是那都不过是形式上的措施罢了。

original: I'll move on to the other sites now to make sure this isn't an aberration. Consider this my authorization signature on Sample Site One.
translation: 我现在就去下一个地点，以确定测量上没有差错。可以把这当成是我的样本地点一的授权。

original: Ok, any second now. Get ready!
translation: 好了，随时会来。做好准备！

original: Here they come! Second floor, on the right!
More of them! On the right, first floor!
The door on the left! First floor!
They're at the front door! Get ready!
That looks like the last of 'em. You're a pretty good shot.
translation: 看来是最后一波了。你枪法不错。

original: Does this tonic really cure anything at all?
translation: 这种活力水真的能治好什么病么？

original: Oh, just about whatever ails you, sweetie! A real cure-all. Say, I don't reckon you're the dry type, is you? Oh, never mind.
translation: 无论是什么让你不适，宝贝！真正包治百病。我认为你不是那种干燥的类型，对吗？噢，别介意。

original: Why exactly should I help you, again?
translation: 我到底为什么还要再帮你？

original: Well, I don't rightly expect you to help me out of goodness, though I welcome you to prove me wrong, sweetie.
translation: 好吧，我并不期望你出于好意帮助我，但我欢迎你证明我错了，宝贝。

original: When we brew this batch of tonic up, you'll have rights to a share for yourself, and a payday of 300 caps to boot.
translation: 等我们制好了这批补药，你将可以分得自己的一份，以及开始每日300瓶盖的报酬。

original: We got everything. Now we wait while it brews. Three days should do the trick.
translation: 万事俱备了。现在等着它调制吧。三天应该就够了。

original: Yeah, I can fix it. No charge.
translation: 是的，我可以修好它，不要钱。

original: Aren't you a smart one? Sweeter tonic's better for both of us, after all.
translation: 你不是一个聪明人吗？毕竟，甜一些的补药对我们俩都好。

original: I'll get it working like new, but I want 200 caps.
translation: 我可以让它工作得像新的一样，但我想要200个瓶盖。

original: I reckon you've got a deal, sweetie, but I'd better notice a difference in the tonic.
translation: 我认为你做了笔买卖，宝贝，但我最好能看到补药的不同。

original: I can fix it up. Let's call it 100 caps of work?
translation: 我可以修好它，代价是100个瓶盖。

original: I reckon I can scrape that together. Go ahead and do what you can for it.
translation: 我认为我能把那弄到一起。去吧，尽力而为。

original: Your still could stand to be fixed up.
translation: 你仍然可以随时来这里。

original: Could it, now? I suppose you'd know how to see to that, wouldn't you?
translation: 现在呢，可以了么？我猜想你可以照顾好那个了吧，你说呢？

original: Did you build that still yourself?
That old thing's been in my family for years and years.
translation: 那个老古董在我家族中流传了很多很多年。

original: Well before the bombs, there was a time folks couldn't get no tonic by law, and my family did okay helping them get what they needed.
translation: 在核弹爆炸前，曾有一段居民们不能依法获得补药的时光，而我的家族很非常乐意帮助他们取得所需。

original: I want to know more about you.
translation: 我想知道更多关于你的事。

original: Why, I'm just folk. What more is there?
translation: 怎么，我只是个平民。还有什么事？
我们来谈谈恢复药剂的事吧。

original: Oh, you're gonna love it, sweetie. Just you wait.
translation: 哦，你会爱上它的，亲爱的。先稍等片刻。

original: I'm sorry, I guess I just haven't heard of that illness. Maybe I can help.
translation: 很遗憾听到这些，我想我从来没听说过这种病。或许我能帮你。

original: I reckon you can, at that. I just need some help brewing up a little tonic.
translation: 而且我认为你能做到。我只是需要点帮助来调制补药。

original: Reckon it's the Orange Fever. I do feel light in my head...
translation: 我认为是橙流感。我感到脑子发热…...

original: Twenty wild Punga Fruit, just for you.
Little scrawny, but they'll do. Thank you, sweetie.
translation: 小个了点，但也行。谢谢你，宝贝。

original: Here, take ten of these refined Punga Fruit.
Sweet and ripe, too. These will do just fine.
Go to the bank and use password xìn tian weng. The software is configured to recognize only our voices.
translation: 去银行，并且使用密码xin tian weng。软件已被设置为只会识别我们的声音。

original: Yes, thank you so much! And now that she's got this boat and carrying all this cargo...
translation: 是啊，太感谢你了！现在她有了这艘船，还载着这么多货物……

original: Well, I can afford to actually pay you! Thank you so much!
translation: 嗯，我真的付得起你的报酬了！太谢谢你了！

original: Got Nadine back, safe and sound.
translation: 把娜丁安然无恙地带回来。

original: So? It's smoke. Things burn down all the time. Especially around me.
translation: 那么？这不过是烟而已。每时每刻都有东西烧着，尤其在我周围。

original: Oh, it's smoke, all right. Where there's smoke, there's fire - and where there's fire, there's profit to be made selling an extinguisher!
translation: 噢，是烟，好吧。哪儿有烟，哪儿就有火 — 哪儿有火，哪儿就有兜售灭火器的机会！

original: That smoke's coming from old Calvert Mansion. I always heard it was haunted, but more importantly, I always heard it was full of Pre-War treasure!
translation: 烟从老卡尔弗特公馆出来。我一直听说那儿闹鬼，但更重要的是，总听到那里满是战前宝藏！

original: I know I said Point Lookout was perfect for treasure hunters, but it's a rare day when you get a beacon like that!
translation: 我知道我说过望海崖是财宝猎人的圣地，但现在能有那么个灯塔很稀奇了！

original: Why did you run away from home, Kenny?
translation: 你为什么要离家出走，肯尼?

original: I wasn't born right. Mama hid me in the basement and pappy kinda just forgot about me, but I knew I had to go before I grew up.
translation: 我生得不是时候。妈妈把我藏在地下室，爸爸好像是把我忘了一样，但是我知道我要在我长大之前离开这里。

original: Come over here, boy. Let's talk.
Come over here, girl. Let's talk.
Why did you attack the mansion?
We take no pleasure in violence. Our goal was merely to remove the Ghoul. His presence is an offense to the Transcendent Master's astral dominion.
translation: 我们不喜欢用暴力解决问题。我们的目标仅仅是除掉那个僵尸。他的出现是对我们至高无上主人的星之领土的冒犯。

original: I cannot claim to understand the exact reasons that the mansion's resident caused such disruption, however. To understand fully, ask the Master.
translation: 公馆里的居民造成如此破坏的具体原因我并不清楚。如果想知道的话，你应该去找主人。

original: Of course I did, but that moron thought it was one of his addled visions. The real goal was to destroy the Ghouls' jamming device!
translation: 当然了。但是那个傻子还以为是他那愚蠢的“神谕”呢。实际上，真正的目的是去摧毁僵尸的干扰设施。

original: Honestly, those fools aren't worth the meat they're made of. A minion that can't follow directions is no use at all!
translation: 坦白地说，那些傻子一点存在的价值都没有。奴才要是不听话，那就一点用都没有！

original: Did you tell the Tribals to attack the mansion?
translation: 是你下令让部落攻击这公馆的吗？

original: Woah, woah, woah! That was all Jackson's crazy idea. I knew better than to volunteer for that suicide mission!
translation: 哇哦，哇哦，哇哦！这很显然是杰克逊出的疯狂的主意。这种自愿去送死的做法，我一眼就能看出来。

original: Last time I wandered too close to that mansion, some old Ghoul sicced his dogs on me. Screw that!
translation: 有一次我打算接近那公馆，结果有些老僵尸竟然把狗放出来咬我。去他娘的！

original: Well, that's just too bad, ain't it? But since you're so afraid, attach the thing to one of the cars and then spin it around to get it to the top.
translation: 喔，那太糟了，不是吗？但既然你这么害怕，那就随便装到一个客厢上，再转到高处。

original: I'll watch from here and turn it on when it's ready. Then we'll see where our little Professor is.
translation: 我就从这里观察，就绪了便开启开关。然后就能知道咱们的小教授在哪了。

original: That big wheel down by the docks, right?
translation: 港口下面的巨轮，没错吧？

original: Right. Attach it to the bottom car, then turn it on and spin the jammer to the top. No fuckin' problem.
translation: 没错。装到最下面的客厢上，开启开关，把干扰器转到最高处。绝对他妈的没问题。

original: I'll watch from here and turn it on. Then we'll see where our little professor is.
translation: 我就从这里观察并开启开关。然后就能知道咱们的小教授在哪了。

original: I was just admiring the architecture. I didn't mean any offense.
translation: 我只是在欣赏这建筑，没有任何恶意。

original: You're in Blackhall Manor. This isn't a tourist attraction, but I appreciate your good taste. Come, let's talk.
translation: 你身处布莱克霍尔庄园。这不是旅游胜地，但我欣赏你的品位。来吧，我们谈谈。

original: I was just admiring the architecture. I didn't mean any offense.
translation: 我只是在欣赏这建筑，没有任何恶意。
我找到你的泰迪熊了。<撒谎>

original: I... guess that's Kenny-Bear. Thanks for bringing him back.
translation: 我…猜那就是肯尼熊吧。谢谢你帮我把他带回来。

original: Okay. I'll go get it for you.
translation: 好吧，我会帮你把它搞到手的。

original: Gee, thanks! I dropped him near the shaft, so he's probably at the bottom.
translation: 耶啊，谢谢！我把他掉进那个通风管道里了，也许你能在最底部找到。

original: I'm still looking for your teddy bear.
translation: 我还在找你的泰迪熊呢。

original: So hey. You can use this place as your hideout if you want. Hide from the folk out there. Stash your stuff. Okay?
translation: 那么，嘿。如果你想的话你可以把这里当做你的藏身之处。藏起来不被外面那些家伙发现。存放你的东西。好吗？

original: What should I be doing again?
I told you about their ritual site, remember? See if they're hiding the book there and bring it back to me. From there? I don't yet know.
translation: 我跟你说过他们的仪式场所，记得吗？看看他们有没有把书藏在那儿，有的话带回来？我可说不好。

original: I'm a bit short on caps at the moment.
translation: 我现在手头没那么多瓶盖。

original: Perhaps you're in the wrong place? Do come back when you have the means.
translation: 也许你找错地方了吧?当你想到解决办法的时候再回来。

original: Yes, Desmond. But whose side is she on? Do you know? Can you be sure? You always were so bad at choosing your allies.
translation: 是的，德斯蒙德。但你知道她会帮哪边吗？你能确定吗？你总是不会选择盟友。

original: Neat! I want some of it.
You're free to take whatever you find in this disgusting place.
translation: 在这个令人恶心的地方，你找到的东西都归你所有。

original: What I came for is of no interest to you.
translation: 我来这里的原因与你无关。

original: Enjoy your spoils. I don't think our paths will ever cross again. And I think we can both thank Christ and say hallelujah for that.
translation: 好好享用你的战利品吧，我想我们以后的道路不再会有交集了。并且我们可以为此感谢主，并说声哈利路亚。

original: You're free to take whatever you find in this disgusting place.
translation: 在这个令人恶心的地方，你找到的东西都归你所有。

original: What I came for is of no interest to you.
translation: 我来这里的原因与你无关。

original: Enjoy your spoils. I don't think our paths will ever cross again. And I think we can both thank Christ and say hallelujah for that.
translation: 好好享用你的战利品吧，我想我们以后的道路不再会有交集了。并且我们可以为此感谢主，并说声哈利路亚。

original: You're free to take whatever you find in this disgusting place.
translation: 在这个令人恶心的地方，你找到的东西都归你所有。

original: What I came for is of no interest to you.
translation: 我来这里的原因与你无关。

original: Enjoy your spoils. I don't think our paths will ever cross again. And I think we can both thank Christ and say hallelujah for that.
translation: 好好享用你的战利品吧，我想我们以后的道路不再会有交集了。并且我们可以为此感谢主，并说声哈利路亚。

original: It happens to us all. Let's go.
translation: 碰巧就落到我们头上了。走吧！

original: Brace yourself, my friend. You're about to witness the end of an era!
translation: 你要打起精神，我的朋友，因为你将见证一个时代的终结！

original: Because I'm done taking orders from you. After this, we're through.
translation: 因为我受够了听从你的指挥了。从现在开始，我们没关系了。

original: After this, I won't require your services any longer. I suppose that works out now, doesn't it?
translation: 这一切结束以后，我就不再需要你的服务了。我想这就解决了我们之间的问题，不是吗？

original: So, since we're in agreement about this, let's go in there and "retire" the good professor!
translation: 因为你已经同意了，那么就让我们进去，让那个大教授“退休”吧！

original: Brace yourself, you're about to witness the end of an era!
translation: 你要打起精神，我的朋友，因为你将见证一个时代的终结！

original: I've waited a long time for this.
translation: 我为了这一刻已经等了很久了。

original: Savor the moment, my friend. This is the end of an era.
translation: 好好品味这一时刻吧，我的朋友。这是一个时代的终结。

original: I don't need eyes to know you're there. Come here!
translation: 我不用眼睛就知道你在哪里。过来！

original: Yes, we shall be free of all limitations! Thank you, master. We shall be the instrument of your mighty will.
translation: 是的，我们不应受任何界线的阻碍！谢谢你，主人。我们将辅佐你万能的意念。

original: Yes, fine, go destroy the house and its "impurities." Just stop that jammer, and I'll be free of you morons, once and for all!
translation: 是的，好，去摧毁那房子和那“干扰器”，我就放了你这个白痴，你就永远自由了！

original: No need to worry, enlightened one. We shall re-consecrate the mansion, and remove the impurities disrupting your perfect guidance.
translation: 没必要担心，文明人。我们会重新供奉公馆，并清除一切干扰你完美指引的杂志。

original: No, not "astral knowledge" you simpleton! Psychic domination! And that still won't be possible until you destroy Desmond's jamming device.
translation: 不，不是“星界知识”，你这呆子！心灵控制！而且要等你摧毁了德斯蒙德的干扰器后才有可能！

original: Yes, and you will be able to spread your knowledge across the astral plane for all those wise enough to accept it!
translation: 是的，你将可以在整个星界对那些足够聪明的人散播你的知识。

original: At last, yes! Desmond will die, and our long struggle will finally end the only way it could have - with me as the victor!
translation: 最终，是的！德斯蒙德会死，而我们旷日持久的斗争终将迎来唯一可能的结局——我是胜者！

original: Soon, your sacred land shall be cleared of all obstacles. No longer shall its mystical powers be diminished!
translation: 不久，你神圣的土地将清除所有障碍。所蕴藏的神秘力量将不再衰弱！

original: I might be able to help you. But first I want to know more.
translation: 我想我可以帮助你，但我需要先多了解一些事情。

original: Excellent. I cannot tell you how satisfying it is to find a suitable assistant after all these years.
translation: 太好了，这么多年，我终于找到了像你这样合适的帮手，这可真是太令我满意了。

original: Now, the Ghoul is a pain, and may require disposal, but Desmond is only of secondary importance. The real target is a device in his possession.
translation: 那个僵尸是个障碍，也许应该除掉他，不过吗，德斯蒙德不那么重要，那个设备才是头等大事。

original: He has a jammer which limits my projection range to this pathetic cave. Remove that, and I can extend my reach so much further...
translation: 他的那个干扰设备限制了我的对这个可怜的洞穴的控制。除掉那个东西，我就可以将我的思想传播得更远了…

original: I can't promise anything, but tell me more.
translation: 我现在不能承诺你任何事，但你可以先多告诉我一些事情。

original: Useful? What are you using the tribe for?
translation: 有用？你打算用这个部落做什么？

original: At the moment, they've been no use at all, but I have very few options. They can't even seem to remove a single Ghoul from a house.
translation: 目前来说，这些人一点用都没有，但是我的选择并不多。他们连个房子里的僵尸都搞不定。

original: How did you come to lead this tribe?
translation: 你是怎么成为这个部落的首领的？

original: Jackson believes me to be some kind of god. You'd think that would be good, but his interpretations of my commands leaves something to be desired.
translation: 杰克逊还以为我是什么神呢。你也许认为这不错，但是他对我的命令的解释说明却延缓了我渴望要做的事情。

original: Regardless, I trust you can be more effective than he has been. I need your help on an important task.
translation: 不管怎么样，你做事会比他更有效率吧。我需要你帮我做一个非常重要的事情。

original: There's a troublesome Ghoul who lives in Calvert Mansion. I need him destroyed, and his jamming device neutralized, immediately.
translation: 有一个非常麻烦的僵尸，他住在卡尔弗特公馆。我需要你立刻把它杀死，并且毁掉它的干扰设备。

original: He thinks I'm some sort of god, and I have no reason to disabuse him of the notion. This makes me de facto leader of the tribe, as it were.
translation: 他以为我是个神，并且我也没有理由去纠正他错误的想法。在某种程度上，这使我成为这个部族的实际首领。

original: Regardless, I trust you can be more effective than he has been. I need your help on an important task.
translation: 不管怎么样，你做事会比他更有效率吧。我需要你帮我做一个非常重要的事情。

original: There's a troublesome Ghoul who lives in Calvert Mansion. I need him destroyed, and his jamming device neutralized, immediately.
translation: 有一个非常麻烦的僵尸，他住在卡尔弗特公馆。我需要你立刻把它杀死，并且毁掉它的干扰设备。

original: Why was Jackson talking to you?
translation: 杰克逊为什么要跟你谈话？

original: I just wanted to meet the Tribal leader.
translation: 我只想跟部落的领导见一面。

original: I may be the man who leads our physical affairs, but I cannot claim true wisdom. I take my orders from a higher master!
translation: 我大概可以被称为是这里实际事务的决策者，但是我并不是精神领袖。有更高阶的领导给与我命令。

original: Whether it be how to explore higher planes, or the decision to remove the disruptive Ghoul, all wisdom comes from the Transcendent Master.
translation: 无论是定下长远目标，还是决定除掉恼人的僵尸，所有的智慧，学问与正确的判断都来自于那个至高无上的主人。

original: I was drawn to your eternal wisdom.
translation: 我被你永恒的智慧所吸引了。

original: What splendid news! At last the holy land is empty of its destructive aurora, and the astral plain is open to us all.
translation: 多好啊！也许你就是那个能够净化这片残破不堪的圣地的救世主。

original: Oh, but the Transcendent Master will want to hear of this! And as the returning champion, it is your right and honor to tell him yourself.
translation: 哦，但是这个消息要通知给至高无上的主人！你要亲自告诉给主人，这是你的权利也是你的荣誉，因为这一消息是多么显而易见的神谕啊。

original: After all, it is he who makes all true decisions about the spiritual growth of our tribe, including the decision to cleanse the mansion.
translation: 毕竟，他才是我们部族精神上的决策者，决策也包括净化那公馆。

original: You best keep this one to yourself, sweetie. The family tonic gets real kick from our secret ingredient. We just need a lil' bit of battery acid.
translation: 你最好把这个留给自己，宝贝。家传秘密配方炼制的补药可带劲了。我们只需要一点电池酸液。

original: Oh, don't look like that, now.
You reckon I'd be around to tell you about it if it weren't safe enough? Bring me six fission batteries and I'll scrape 'em into the mix.
translation: 要是危险的话，你以为我还会在这儿告诉你这些吗？给我六块电池，我来把它们磨成碎屑。

original: I thought so. Those things do carry a smell, don't they?
translation: 我也这么想。那些东西真的很难闻，不是吗？

original: Let me take 'em off your hands, then.
translation: 那我把它们从你手里拿走吧。

original: I see. Thank you kindly for these.
translation: 我懂了。谢谢你这些东西。

original: I've got the yeast with me.
Wild fruit, eh? Just as good, if a sight weaker for flavor.
translation: 野生水果，嗯哼？也不错，希望味道不会太浓烈。

original: This enough Punga Fruit for you?
I see you sprung for the refined fruit. Good for you, sweetie.
translation: 我看你搞到了精制水果。太棒了，宝贝。

original: This enough Punga Fruit for you?
I might be. Motivate me not to.
Are you fucking joking? I suppose you aren't. What is it you people use for money these days? Those bottle caps?
translation: 你他妈在开玩笑？我看不像。最近你的人都把什么当作货币？就这些瓶盖？

original: Right. Well, here's a bunch of those. Now go do your goddamn job before my patience runs out.
translation: 没错。唔，这还有一串。现在，在我失去耐心之前滚回去做你那该死的工作。

original: I'd like to buy a ticket.
Now, I'm not normally one to discourage an adventurous spirit, but certain... events have convinced me of the value of forewarning.
translation: 如今，我通常不会劝阻有冒险精神的家伙，但某些……事让我相信预先警告的重要性。

original: I know you think you're ready for anything, but the threats you'll face in the swamp make those Super Mutants look like playful puppies.
translation: 我知道你认为自己已经做好面对一切的准备，但是你即将要面对的是是把沼泽里的超级变种人搞得束手无策这样的威胁。

original: So just be sure you know what you're getting into, okay? You still want to head out to Point Lookout?
translation: 你知道你将要卷入一个什么样的事件里么？即使如此，你仍然打算去望海崖？

original: Let's see what you've got to trade.
translation: 让我看看你都有些什么东西要卖。

original: At last! He's just ahead! I'll circle around and distract him. You take him from the front.
translation: 终于！要逮到他了！我绕着分散他的注意力。你从正面进攻。

original: Air Com, we have multiple flashpoints on horizon, come back?
translation: 空军指挥部，我们发现地平线有多处闪光点，请指示？

original: Air Command, USN Three-Five-Oh requesting landing vector. Have zero ceiling visbility and low on state, somebody get me a landing clearance.
translation: 空军指挥部，美国海军3-5-0请求着陆航线。当前能见度为零并且器械运转状态不佳，请给与着陆指示。

original: State One plus one zero to splash, have zero read on outer marker. This is USN Three-Five-Oh, I'm blind out here.
translation: 状态为离斑点1+10处，雷达无显示。这里是美国海军3-5-0，我失去定位能力。

original: Attempting Emergency Landing over water. INS pinger active on distress band. Flaps up, descent to eight cherubs. Three green, over.
translation: 尝试紧急水上迫降。惯性导航系统声波发生器紧急启动。有振动，高度降至800。通话结束。

original: Five cherubs, treeline up, throttle easy on four lights. Prepping to pull the loud handle. <Static>
translation: 高度降至500，垂直下降，油门调节可轻易达到四灯。做好拉起飞机准备。<静电声>

original: Good! Good... now, come speak with me. We have matters to discuss...
translation: 很好！好吧… 现在，来跟我聊聊。有些事需要讨论…

original: No! How... how could this... be... ... ?
No! How... how could this... be... ... ?

translation: 所有机器人！启动！干掉德斯蒙德！
所有机器人！启动！干掉德斯蒙德！

original: How about I kill you instead?
Surely you mean that you will TRY!
Killing you is going to be more fun than killing Desmond.
translation: 我觉得干掉你比干掉德斯蒙德更有意思。

original: I certainly hope you enjoy your final moments!
translation: 我当然希望你能享受最后的时刻！

original: Ha ha ha ha ha! YES! LET'S!
Assist me, my robots! I am... under attack!
translation: 协助我，我的机器人！我遭到了…攻击！

original: Assist me, my robots! I am... under attack!
translation: 协助我，我的机器人！我遭到了…攻击！

original: All in a day's work. Now share your wisdom with me!
translation: 天天如此。现在，跟我分享一下你的智慧吧。

original: Well, for you... I have a very special gift:
translation: 唔，我为你…准备了一份特别的礼物：

original: I wanted to show Desmond that no one pushes me around.
translation: 我要让德斯蒙德知道，没人能摆布我。

original: Well, I would have expected nothing less from you. And now, I have a very special gift:
translation: 我没想到你会这么无能。现在，我有份特别的礼物：

original: That's right. So, what do I get for it?
translation: 有道理。那我能有什么好处呢？

original: Well, for you... I have a very special gift:
translation: 唔，我为你…准备了一份特别的礼物：

original: One... two... three... four... five... six... seven... eight... nine... ten...
translation: 一…二…三…四…五…六…七…八…九…十…

original: Ok ok... I'll do it. Just point that thing somewhere else. ...My name is John Adlam, son of Joseph Adlam, and brother of Richard Adlam.
translation: 好，好…我会说的。你能不能把那个东西指向别处啊。…我的名字是约翰·阿德拉姆，约瑟夫·阿德拉姆的儿子，理查德·阿德拉姆的哥哥。

original: Two days ago I was caught stealing from the groups' claim.
Today, with the consent of my father, I am to be shot and killed on the cliffs of the old cathedral by the hands of my brother, Richard.
translation: 今天，在我父亲的许可之下，我将会在大教堂那里的悬崖上被枪决，而执行枪决的人是我的弟弟，理查德。

original: With my execution, my punishment is exacted and the Adlam name will be avenged.
translation: 我被枪决以后，我将受到应有的惩罚，而且阿德拉姆家也会被正名。

original: Let my punishment be a reminder to those who may be tempted to do as I did.
translation: 就让对我的惩罚警告后人不要步我后尘。

original: I usually hide my bodies in the river, but this is nice, too.
translation: 我一般都是躲在河里的，但这样也不错。

original: We are nothing alike. More so than you could ever comprehend. Go now, and never return.
translation: 我们完全不同。你完全无法理解。走吧，别再回来了。

original: Nah. I think I'll kill you.
Then you shall die along with him!
My dad always said, "Never trust a disembodied brain."
translation: 我爸爸总是说，“永远别相信没有肉体的脑袋”。

original: You would have been wise to listen to him!

translation: 我们不能把话说清楚吗？

original: You are permitted to talk while you DIE!
translation: 有什么话等下地狱再说吧！

original: Oh, you've got to be kidding me.
translation: 哦，你一定是在跟我开玩笑吧。
卡尔弗特教授从不说笑！

original: That's right. And what do I get for it?
translation: 这就对了。那么，我能得到什么好处？

original: I have a very special gift for you, my friend...
translation: 我有一个非常特别的礼物送给你，我的朋友…

original: Where do you get your stock from?
I found some of it. Some was here when I got here. I get some from them mercs.
translation: 有些东西是我自己找到的，有些是本来就在这个商店里的。还有一些东西是从走私者那里搞来的。

original: And every once in a while, that weirdo with the boat comes up here and trades a few good things.
translation: 并且每隔一段时间，那个划船来的古怪家伙就会来这里一次并且做一些交易。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: I got all sorts of stuff. Take a look.
translation: 我这里什么都有。看看我的货吧。

original: I knew that's why you came to me...
translation: 我知道你为什么来找我…

original: All of Madam Panada's wares are top quality.
translation: 帕娜达女士的商品可都是最优质的。

original: And what is it you would like to purchase?
Actually, I already took care of it.
translation: 事实上，我已经处理好了。

original: Well, I'll be. Here, let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 我会的。来，给你点东西对付你的麻烦。

original: Tell you what - have a bit. This is left over from an old batch, but should be a swig or two there. More'n enough to loosen you up, I wager!
translation: 告诉你—来一点。这是一批老货里剩的，可能够喝一两口。足够让你放松了，我打赌。

original: Gristle and gore await! Proceed inside and use the button, as before.
translation: 软骨和血块在等待着你！进到里面来，并且按下那个按钮，就像以前一样。

original: Do you have some secret farming trick?
It feels good to work with dirt, doesn't it? Some people call it work, but they don't understand.
translation: 跟土打交道的感觉可是相当好的，不是吗？有些人说那叫工作，实际上他们根本不理解。

original: Take my shovel. It has seen much use, and much dirt. Maybe it will help you?
translation: 拿上我的铲子。已经使用过很多次了，上面还有不少泥土。也许能帮上你的忙？

original: But be careful not to cut yourself with it. It can make you sick.
translation: 小心点，不要被它割伤。不然你会因此得病的。

original: I love digging in the dirt, but I never can get anything to grow right.
translation: 我喜欢在地上挖洞，但我从来都看不到有什么正经东西从里面长出来。

original: I do not know if this is a secret, but I have always used this shovel. It has seen much work, and much dirt.
translation: 我不知道这算不算是个秘密，因为我经常使用这个铲子。这个铲子见证了许多的工作和泥土。

original: If it helps, have it. But be careful not to cut yourself. It can make you sick.
translation: 如果能帮上忙的话，你就把它拿去。小心点，不要被它割伤。不然你会因此得病的。

original: Can you share your secret to getting them to grow?
translation: 你能告诉我你让它们长得那么好的窍门么？

original: You have the caps, you get the book.
Yes, yes, of course. Here's your errand fee. Now, give it to me!
translation: 是的，是的，当然。这是你的钱。快把东西给我！

original: I haven't decided what I'm going to do with it yet.
Surely you're not considering giving it to Marcella? Come now, the woman can't rub two caps together. Give it to me and be paid.
translation: 你不会想要把它给玛塞拉吧？得了吧，那女人没几个钱。给我吧，我绝不会亏待你的。

original: There's no reason in your keeping that book - my book! Talk to me again when you've come to your senses.
translation: 你没理由留着那本书——我的书！想清楚了再来找我。

original: They attacked while I slept. I... I don't expect to survive. I only pray that you haven't taken that book to Obadiah. You must take up my mission.
translation: 他们趁我睡觉时袭击。我…我们奢望活下来。我只祈祷你没把书带去奥巴迪亚。你必须接受我的任务。

original: There is... one way to utterly destroy the Krivbeknih, but you must take a pilgrimage, far north of Point Lookout, in the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 有……个办法能彻底销毁黯日圣经，但你必须去朝圣，望海崖遥远的北方，首都废土。

original: Seek a place called Dunwich. Within is an obelisk, itself a wicked thing. It'll consume the book - you need only press the book to its surface.
translation: 找到一个叫邓维奇方尖碑的地方。里面有座方尖碑，本身就是个邪恶的东西。它会消化掉这书 — 你只需要把书按到上面。

original: May God shed his blessings upon you, child. Make haste for Dunwich.
translation: 愿主施恩惠于你，孩子。快去邓维奇方尖碑吧。

original: My God, I am sorry for all my sins with all my heart. In choosing to do wrong and failing to do good, I have sinned against You whom I should...
translation: 天啊，我真心为我的罪孽悔过。我选择了行恶而非为善，我犯下了罪孽…

original: Okay, that's enough tag for now.
translation: 好了，捉迷藏已经玩得差不多了。

original: Tag! You're it! You'll never catch me!
translation: 捉住了！该你了！你永远都捉不到我的！

original: Dammit! Trapped! I knew he'd try this!
translation: 该死！是陷阱！我就知道他会这么干！
顺着这条路就能找到他了！

original: Any idea where Nadine might be?
translation: 你大概知道娜丁可能会在哪儿么？
现在是说再见的时候了。

original: Don't be daft. You agreed to retrieve my book. With more haste than this, I would have thought.
translation: 别犯傻了，你已经同意帮我把书拿回来。如果动作能快一点的话，也许我还会考虑。

original: You need to head for the ritual site east of the boardwalk, and expect a fight.
translation: 你要去仪式之地，就在板道的东面，随时做好战斗准备。

original: I'm afraid I don't have a copy of the scripture with me, but I can share a few passages. Here's one of my favorites.
translation: 我恐怕我没有经文的拷贝，不过我可以分享你几段。这是我比较中意的一段。

original: I tell you the truth, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be condemned;
translation: 我实话告诉你，无论谁听见我的话并且相信他会带给我永恒的生命，都不会受到责难。

original: he has crossed over from death to life.
My mother had a favorite passage from the Bible. Revelation 21:6 - recognize it?
translation: 我妈妈最喜欢圣经中的一段话，启示录21章第6句，记得么？

original: Of course! "I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely."
translation: 当然！“我是阿拉法、我是俄梅戛、我是初、我是终。我要将生命泉的水白白赐给那口渴的人喝。”

original: So lovely. Selflessness like that is a rare commodity these days. I can see why that particular passage inspired her.
translation: 太好了。在这种日子里，无私可真是非常少见的啊。我现在明白为什么那特别的通路能够激励她了。

original: I appreciate the advice, but I'm fine, okay?
translation: 我很感激你的建议，但是我没事，明白？

original: You're not the boss of me.
You really think this will work?
It's worth a try. What's the worst that could happen? Nothing changes, only we've got a few more bruises. Big deal. Let's give it a shot.
translation: 我认为这值得一试。再糟又能怎么样呢？我们顶多会有几处擦伤。没什么大不了的，试试看吧。

original: I promise I'll go easy on you.
translation: 我保证对你下手会轻点。

original: What do they want with us?
translation: 他们想从我们这得到什么？

original: Your guess is as good as mine. I can't understand what they're saying. I don't remember half of what they did to me, and that might be a good thing.
translation: 你猜的和我想的差不多。我听不懂他们在说什么。他们对我做的事，我有一半都记不起来了，这或许反而是件好事。

original: I know we ain't the only ones; there's a whole bunch of us in here. They'll pluck folks out every now and then.
translation: 我知道不只是我们，这还有一大群和我们一样的人。他们时不时就会挑出几个带走。

original: Sometimes they bring 'em back... Sometimes they don't. Either way, I ain't keen to find out what they're doing.
translation: 有时候会把人带回来……有时候就不会。不管怎样，我可不想知道他们在搞什么。

original: So how do we get out of here?
Okay, yeah. Let's do something about getting out.
translation: 对，是啊。让我们做点啥从这里出去。

original: Well, there ain't no easy way out. Trust me, I've looked. Can't even find anything to pry open, see what's blocking the doorway.
translation: 唉，根本没有轻松的出路。相信我，我看过了。连能用来撬一撬，看看是什么堵住门口的东西都找不到。

original: I'm thinkin' they did us a favor, putting us together in here like this. And I say we use it to our advantage.
translation: 我想他们这样把我们放在一起，反倒帮了我们一个忙。我说，咱们得利用这一点作为我们的优势。

original: I think you should remain in the Engineering Core for now.
translation: 我认为你目前应该留在工程中枢。

original: Okay. Whatever you think is best.
translation: 好的。你觉得怎样好就怎么办。

original: Putting me on guard duty, huh? Swell.
Fine. If I see any aliens, I'll say hello for you.
translation: 行。要是我看到外星人，会代你向他们问好的。

original: I may need an extra gun in the Hangar Bay. Can you lend a hand?
translation: 我可能在机库需要一个帮枪的。你能帮把手吗？

original: Now you're speakin' my language. Hell yeah, I'll come with you.
translation: 这可说到我心坎上了。当然行，我跟你一起去。

original: I need some help in the Robot Assembly area. You in?
translation: 我在机器人装配区需要些帮助。你来吗？

original: Heck yeah. I can take apart and put together a Protectron with my eyes shut. I'll go with you. Lead on.
translation: 那当然。我闭着眼睛都能拆解再组装一台保护者。我跟你去。带路吧。

original: I need to get through the Cryo Labs. Think you can help me?
translation: 我得穿过低温实验室。你觉得能帮我吗？

original: Hmmm. Sounds like I may be of some use in there. If there are other people in stasis, I could help revive them or something. Just watch my back.
translation: 嗯……听起来在那儿我或许能派上用场。要是还有其他人处于静滞状态，我可以帮忙唤醒他们之类的。你只管帮我留意背后就行。

original: Can you tell me more about where you're from?
translation: 你能多跟我讲讲你来自哪里吗？

original: I mean, we're fighting to stay alive here. Whatever I did before we got to this point doesn't mean a whole lot right now.
translation: 我是说，我们在为了活下去拼尽全力。在我们陷入当前困境之前，无论我做过什么，现在看来意义不大。

original: I mean, we're fighting to stay alive here. Whatever I did before we got to this point doesn't mean a whole lot right now.
translation: 我是说，我们在为了活下去拼尽全力。在我们陷入当前困境之前，无论我做过什么，现在看来意义不大。

original: You're a prisoner like the rest of us.
translation: 你跟我们其他人一样，都是囚犯。

original: Prisoner? Last thing I remember I was being outside our bunker and then... oh my god!
translation: 囚犯？我记得的最后一件事，是我当时在我们的掩体外面，然后……哦，我的天哪！

original: Aliens! I was taken by aliens! You! You must be the aliens trying to get into my mind... well that's not gonna work!
translation: 外星人！我被外星人抓走了！你们！你们肯定是想窥探我思想的外星人……哼，这可不会得逞！

original: Private Elliott Tercorien, U.S. Army Medic, Serial Number 3477809. That's all I'm going to tell you.
translation: 上等兵艾略特·特克里安，美国陆军医疗兵，编号3477809。这就是我能告诉你的。

original: Your uniform... it looks familiar, but I can't place it.
translation: 你的制服……看着眼熟，但我想不起来在哪见过。

original: My what? Who the hell are you... oh my god... wait a minute!
translation: 我的什么？你们到底是谁……我的天……等一下！

original: Aliens! I was taken by aliens! You! You must be the aliens trying to get into my mind... well that's not gonna work!
translation: 外星人！我被外星人抓走了！你们！你们肯定是想窥探我思想的外星人……哼，这可不会得逞！

original: Private Elliott Tercorien, U.S. Army Medic, Serial Number 3477809. That's all I'm telling you.
translation: 列兵埃利奥特·特克里安，美国陆军军医，编号3477809。我就跟你们说这些。

original: Looks like this door's locked, too. Hang on, I'll see if I can get it from the other side.
translation: 看起来这扇门也锁上了。等一下，我看能不能从另一边打开。

original: I can't believe you killed him, he has it just as bad as us. I'll see you later.
translation: 我不敢相信你杀死了他，他和我们一样。迟点见。

original: I could use one of those stimpaks if you don't mind.
translation: 要是你不介意的话，我想来一支那种治疗针。

original: Fuck you and this whole fucking situation. They'll work when they work.
translation: 他妈的一团糟，需要它们时就能运作了。

original: Hmm, looks like I'm at the helm. I'll have these controls figured out in no time at all.
translation: 嗯，看来我负责掌舵。我很快就能搞清楚这些操控装置怎么用。

original: That's my squad in there! What the hell are the aliens doing to them?
translation: 里面的是我的小队！这些外星人在对他们做什么？

original: You green bastards! Get your hands off them!
translation: 你们这群绿杂种！把你的手拿开！

original: There has to be a way to release their containment seal! Maybe there's a button or something on this console.
translation: 肯定有办法打开他们的密封装置！也许这个控制台上有按钮之类的东西。

original: They're flanking us from behind. Quick, find some cover.
translation: 他们正从后面包抄我们。快，寻找掩护。

original: So that's the generator. Now how the heck do we destroy it?
translation: 原来那就是发电机。可我们究竟要怎么毁掉它呢？

original: It's holding fine for now, I guess. It should help with the bastards teleporting onto the ship.
translation: 我猜它现在运行得好极了，它能够帮你传送到飞船顶部。

original: Hey, don't forget to put on the Astronaut's Suit before starting the decompression sequence.
translation: 嘿，在开始减压程序前，别忘了穿上宇航服。

original: I got it! The deathray is working and will be fully charged in 30 seconds!
translation: 知道了！死光正在运行，还需要30秒才能充能完毕！

original: 20%. I hope you've got a plan.
Can't be sure if I'm reading this right, but it looks like they're hitting us pretty hard. Hull integrity is at about 90%.
translation: 我不确定这读数是否正确，不过看起来它们正在猛攻我们。飞船耐久度约为90%。

original: Ship's at 30%. I hope you have something up your sleeve.
translation: 飞船耐久度30%。你最好抓紧时间。
飞船耐久度约为60%。做点什么。
