original: Sleeping in a rented or owned bed will give you a "Well Rested" bonus that boosts your earned XP for several hours.
translation: 如果你在租来的或自己的床上休息，将得到“精力充沛”奖励，这能让你在接下来数小时内获得更多的经验值。

original: Intelligence determines your effectiveness with the Science, Repair and Medicine skills.
translation: 智力影响着你的科学、修理和医疗技能。

original: The Medicine skill determines the effectiveness of drugs that help manage radiation, like Rad-X and RadAway.
translation: 医疗技能决定了你使用辐射抑制剂，例如放射线-X和辐特宁时的效果。

original: The Church of the Children of Atom believe the war of 2077 was actually a great holy event perpetuated by their god, Atom.
translation: “原子”信徒教堂坚信2077年的大战实际上是他们的神，“原子”，显示的一次神迹。

original: Perception determines when red tick marks (which indicate threats) appear on your compass.
translation: 感知属性决定了罗盘上红色的刻度线（代表敌人方位）出现的距离。

original: With the second rank of the Animal Friend perk, animals will come to your aid in combat (but not against other animals).
translation: 当你的“动物之友”特长达到等级2时，动物将在战斗中援助你（但对手不能是其他动物）。

original: The higher your Repair skill, the better the starting condition of any custom-made weapons.
translation: 你的修理技能越高，你自制武器的初始状态也越好。

original: Security Chief Harkness and his officers are authorized to use deadly force when dealing with any and all transgressors.
translation: 哈克尼斯警长和他手下的警员都被准许可以对犯法者使用致命性的武力。

original: If you want to stay hidden, stick to the shadows, move slowly, try to stay behind your opponent... and turn off your Pip-Boy light!
translation: 如果你想长久地保持潜行，有几条规则务必遵守：藏在阴影里，放缓脚步，从敌人背后绕行，并且一定要关闭哔哔小子的灯光。

original: If you have the Robotics Expert perk and sneak up on a hostile robot undetected, you can put that robot into a permanent shutdown state.
translation: 如果你拥有“机器人专家”特长，当你悄无声息地靠近一台敌对的机器人时，可以将它永久关闭。

original: If you start a fight you can't finish, try putting away your weapon. Your opponent just might forgive you...
translation: 如果你无意挑起一场争斗，那就收起你的武器，对方或许能因此原谅你。

original: You can run faster with your weapon holstered.
translation: 把枪收起来可以使你跑得更快。

original: Repair your weapons regularly -- the lower the condition, the lower a weapon's effectiveness.
translation: 时常修理你的武器--它的状态越差，实战效能就越低下。

original: The lower the condition of your armor or clothing, the less damage it resists in combat.
translation: 你的装甲或者衣服的状态越差，战斗中它能抵挡的伤害就越少。

original: Limb damage can be repaired directly by applying Stimpaks to affected areas, using the Pip-Boy.
translation: 在哔哔小子中，直接对伤残部位使用治疗针能够回复伤残的肢体。

original: Heavier weapons and apparel will slow you down when they're equipped.
translation: 沉重的武器和衣服会减缓你的移动。

original: Zooming in with a ranged weapon slows you down, but improves your accuracy.
translation: 当你使用长程武器的瞄准镜，你的移动会变缓，但相应的，你的射击精度会提高。

original: You can restore Health by using a Stimpak, eating food, drinking from a water source, or sleeping in a bed.
translation: 有多种方法可以帮你恢复健康：注射治疗针、吃饭、喝水或是在床上休憩。

original: Crouching will both improve your accuracy, and activate sneak mode.
translation: 蹲伏不仅提高你的精度，同时也激活了潜行模式。

original: Sleeping in any bed will fully restore your Health and heal any crippled body parts.
translation: 在床上休憩，你不仅能完全恢复健康，还能回复伤残的肢体。

original: Drinking from a water source is always a tactical choice -- you will usually restore lost Health, but raise your radiation level.
translation: 饮用露天水源总是一种冒险：你虽然能恢复健康，但却会受到放射伤害。

original: Running is noisier than walking and makes you easier to detect, even if you are sneaking.
translation: 即便在潜行时，跑步也比行走更为嘈杂，更容易引起他人注意。

original: Changing the difficulty affects how hard combat is. But you'll also get more or less XP for killing enemies.
translation: 改变难度，战斗难度会被调整，但对应的当你消灭敌人时，你将获得更多或更少的经验值。

original: Want to prevent an enemy from fleeing? Cripple the legs.
translation: 想让敌人无法脱逃？那就打残它们的腿。

original: Tenpenny Tower is the brainchild of Allistair Tenpenny, a British refugee who came to the Capital Wasteland seeking his fortune.
translation: 特佩尼大厦的建立者是奥利斯特·特佩尼，一个从英国来华盛顿废土淘金的流民。

original: Allistair Tenpenny now rarely leaves the comfort and safety of his penthouse suite. His is a madness reserved for the obscenely rich.
translation: 奥利斯特·特佩尼在他的楼顶公寓套房过着安全、舒适的生活，平时深居简出，那些套房为卑鄙敛财的富人而预备着。

original: Although it has some crude fortifications, Big Town is the subject of constant attack from Slavers and Super Mutants, who view it as an easy target.
translation: 虽然有些简单的防御工事，但大镇一直被看作是必争之地，持续受到来自奴隶贩子和超级变种人的骚扰。

original: The population of Big Town has dwindled significantly in recent years. Most of the residents have been killed or dragged off by Slavers or Super Mutants.
translation: 大镇近年来人口骤减，在奴隶贩子及超级变种人的耽耽虎视下，大部分住民不是被杀就是被捉。

original: The residents of Big Town are all refugees of another settlement, from which they were forcibly expelled...
translation: 大镇的居民都是从另一个定居点驱逐流放的难民。

original: Canterbury Commons is the end of the Capital Wasteland's established merchant caravan route.
translation: 坎特伯雷社区是首都废土商队要道的终点站。

original: The remains of a large robot repair center loom over the settlement of Canterbury Commons.
translation: 一座大型机器人修理中心的遗迹把坎特伯雷社区笼罩于阴影下。

original: Canterbury Commons has become a constant battleground for two costumed "super humans" -- the sinister AntAgonizer and misguided Mechanist.
translation: 坎特伯雷社区俨然已成两位有乔装癖的“超人”--痛苦蚁后与机械侠之间的持久战战场。

original: At the center of Megaton's crater sits an undetonated atomic bomb, a remnant of the great conflict that destroyed the world.
translation: 在兆吨镇的弹坑中矗立着一枚未爆的核弹，是曾清洗这个世界的大战的残留物。

original: Some of Megaton's first settlers were lured by the misguided hope of entering the nearby Vault 101.
translation: 最早的兆吨镇移民是怀着想进入附近101号避难所的空想纷纷而至的。

original: Some Megaton residents wonder who's really in charge -- Sheriff Simms, or saloon owner Colin Moriarty...
translation: 让一些兆吨镇居民不解的是究竟谁在执管此地？-- 警长西姆斯，还是酒吧主科林·莫里亚蒂......

original: The members of the Church of the Children of Atom worship Megaton's atomic bomb.
translation: “原子”信徒教堂的教徒们崇拜兆吨镇的核弹。

original: Word is that Moira Brown, the eccentric owner of Craterside Supply, is looking for assistance on a new project.
translation: 据说“坑边杂货店”的古怪店主莫伊拉·布朗，最近正为一个新研究而招募助手。

original: The residents of Megaton feel safe behind their metal walls. Ironic, considering their proximity to a live atomic bomb.
translation: 铁墙后，兆吨镇居民们感到安全。但联想到他们身旁，核弹依然活跃，这一切就像个讽刺。

original: The fore section of Rivet City is split from the rest of the carrier, and occupied by hostile Mirelurks.
translation: 铆钉城的前片区与航母其它部分相驳离，那里歇居着充满敌意的蟹人。

original: What was once a small scientific community gradually grew into Rivet City, the largest settlement in the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 曾经的小型科学联盟，渐渐成长成今日的铆钉城，华盛顿废土上最大的居住区。

original: Doctor Madison Li, member of Rivet City's ruling council, is one of the greatest scientific minds of her generation.
translation: 李博士，铆钉城统治议会成员，她那时代最伟大的科学家之一。

original: Rivet City has no holding facilities for criminals, and zero tolerance for crime.
translation: 铆钉城没有罪犯的容身所，对于罪行毫无姑息之心。

original: Underworld has become a haven for disenfranchised Ghouls throughout the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 地下城俨然已成华盛顿废土上民权绝丧的僵尸们的避风港。

original: Underworld was formed in the remains of the Museum of History's special exhibit, which showcased different civilizations' views on the afterlife.
translation: 冥界是历史博物馆中一件特殊展品，展现了对末世的不同看法。

original: The Ghouls of Underworld generally aren't bothered by D.C.'s Super Mutants, but resent the Brotherhood of Steel for turning their back yard into a warzone.
translation: 地下城的僵尸与首都的超级变种人相处融洽，但对把他们的后院变为战场的钢铁兄弟会却恨得牙痒痒。

original: Picking someone's pocket and placing a mine or grenade in their inventory will activate the explosive... and cause one heck of a mess.
translation: 在偷窃别人时，将手雷或地雷塞进别人的口袋会引发爆炸……遭到巨大的骚乱。

original: The Capital Wasteland lacks a unified government, and any institutional system of crime and punishment. If you wrong someone, prepare to pay with your life.
translation: 华盛顿废土没有联合政府，也没有罪行与刑罚机制，如果你得罪了他人，就作好偿命的准备吧。

original: Stealth is affected by many factors, including light level, sound generated, weight and bulk of worn apparel, and line-of-sight.
translation: 潜行会受许多因素影响，包括环境亮度、声音、负重、着装大小，以及对方的视野。

original: With the Animal Friend perk, you will never be the victim of an unprovoked attack from any animal.
translation: 拥有“动物之友”这项特长，你将不再成为动物无端攻击的牺牲品。

original: With the Action Boy perk, you gain an additional 15 Action Points to use in V.A.T.S per rank.
translation: 拥有活力小子这项能力，你在避难所科技辅助瞄准系统下将多获得20个行动值。

original: With the Better Criticals perk, you gain a 50% damage bonus every time a critical hit is scored on an opponent.
translation: 有了“强力暴击”这个特长, 你击中目标时产生的暴击伤害将会增加50％。

original: The Child at Heart perk improves your interactions with children with unique dialogue choices.
translation: 拥有童心未泯，你同小孩对话时可能会出现特殊选项。

original: The only way to reach the Super Mutant-occupied D.C. ruins is by traveling underground, usually through the abandoned Metro tunnels.
translation: 要抵达超级变种人盘踞的特区废墟，途径只有一条：走地下，通常是穿越废弃的地铁隧道。

original: With the Comprehension perk, you gain one additional skill point whenever a skill book is read.
translation: 有了理解力这个额外能力，你在读书时会多增加1点技能点数。

original: With Concentrated Fire, your accuracy to hit any body part in V.A.T.S. increases slightly with each subsequent hit on that body part.
translation: 有了“集中火力”这个特长, 你在V.A.T.S模式下连续射击目标同一部位时，命中率会逐渐提高。

original: Once you have the Contract Killer perk, any Good human or Ghoul character you kill will have an ear on their corpse, which can be sold or traded to a certain Evil character...
translation: 当你拥有职业杀手这项能力，你每杀掉一个善良的人类或僵尸，你都能从他们尸体上取得一只耳朵，然后用它们和某个特定的邪恶角色进行交易。

original: The Cyborg perk adds 10 points to your Damage, Poison and Radiation Resistances, and 10 points to your Energy Weapons skill.
translation: 生化人这项能力将为你提升10点的伤害、毒药及辐射抵抗力，同时你的能量型武器技能提高10点。

original: With each rank of the Demolition Expert perk, all of your explosive weapons do an additional 20% damage.
translation: “爆破专家”特长每升一级，都能使你的爆破武器杀伤力上升20%。

original: With the Educated perk, you gain three more skill points every time you advance in level.
translation: 拥有知识分子这项能力，你每次升级都将多得到3个技能点数。

original: With the Entomologist perk, you do an additional +50% damage every time you attack a mutated insect.
translation: 拥有“昆虫学家”这项特长后，你对变异昆虫的杀伤力将增加50%。

original: When you choose the Explorer perk, every location in the world is revealed on your map. So get out there and explore!
translation: 有了“探险家”这个额力后，游戏世界的所有地点都会在地图上为你标识出来，快去探索吧！

original: With each rank of the Gun Nut perk, you gain improved accuracy and increased durability to weapons using the Guns skill.
translation: 每个等级的枪迷能力都将使你的小型枪械技能和修理技能上升5点。

original: With the Fortune Finder perk, you'll find considerably more Nuka-Cola caps in containers than you normally would.
translation: 有了“寻宝高手”这个特长，你在翻箱倒柜时都会比平时找到更多的瓶盖。

original: The Here and Now perk immediately grants an additional experience level, complete with all the advantages that brings.
translation: “马上升级”这个特长可以让你立刻升一级，并享受升级之后带来的所有好处。

original: With the Impartial Mediation perk, you gain an extra 30 points to Speech... so long as you maintain a Neutral Karma level.
translation: 有了不偏不倚这个额外能力，当你的业力值为中立时，会得到额外30点口才技能。

original: With the Infiltrator perk, you gain one more chance to pick any lock broken by an unsuccessful "Force Lock" attempt.
translation: 拥有“渗透者”这项特长，你可以再一次试着撬开因“强制开锁”失败而损坏的锁芯。

original: With the Intense Training perk, you can put a single point into any of your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes.
translation: “训练狂”这个特长可以让你再增加任意1点属性值。

original: With the Iron Fist perk, you do an additional 5 points of Unarmed damage per rank.
translation: 每级铁拳这个额外能力让你的空手伤害增加5点。

original: Fail a hack attempt and get locked out of a computer? Not if you're a Computer Whiz! With this perk, you can attempt to re-hack any computer you were previously locked out of.
translation: 入侵电脑失败，电脑锁死了？合格的黑客是不会出现这种情况的！有了这个特长，先前被锁死的电脑又能再重新入侵一次了!

original: Once you have the Lawbringer perk, any Evil human or Ghoul character you kill will have a finger on their corpse, which can be sold or traded to a certain Good character...
translation: 当你拥有执法者这项能力，你每杀掉一个邪恶的人类或僵尸，你都能从他们尸体上取得一只耳朵，然后用它们和某个特定的善良角色进行交易。

original: With the Lead Belly perk, you take 50% less radiation every time you drink from an irradiated water source.
translation: 有了“铅肚皮”特长，每次在受辐射的水源饮水, 你受到的辐射量都会减少50％。

original: With each rank in the Life Giver perk, you gain an additional 30 Hit Points.
translation: 每个等级的强韧生命这项能力，都将使你的生命力上升30点。

original: With the Light Step perk, you'll never set off an enemy's mines or floor-based mechanical traps.
translation: 拥有“身轻如燕”这项特长后，你就再不会触发地雷或安装在地面上的陷阱机关了。

original: With each rank of the Daddy's Boy perk, hacking gets easier and chems are 10% more effective.
translation: 拥有子承父业这项能力，男性角色将在科学和医疗方面各获得5点技能点。

original: With each rank of the Daddy's Girl perk, hacking gets easier and chems are 10% more effective.
translation: 拥有女承父业这项能力，女性角色将在科学和医疗方面各获得5点技能点。

original: The Little Leaguer perk improves your melee weapons and explosives skills, making you that much more efficient with a melee weapon or grenades.
translation: 棒球小子这项能力提升你的近战与爆破技能，让你更熟练的使用近战武器和手榴弹。

original: When you take the Master Trader perk, the price of every item you buy from a vendor is reduced by 25%.
translation: 拥有大奸商这项能力，购物时，每样物品的价格都会下调25％。

original: With the Mister Sandman perk, you can perform a special move that instantly kills any sleeping character, and will gain bonus XP for doing so.
translation: 有了“睡魔先生”这个特长，你可以杀死任意正在熟睡中的角色，你也会因此会得到额外的经验值。

original: With the Finesse perk, you gain an additional +5% chance to score a critical hit on an opponent in combat.
translation: 有了“战略大师”这个特长，你在战斗中对敌人的暴击率可以提高5%。

original: With the Mysterious Stranger perk, your own personal guardian angel will appear occasionally in V.A.T.S. mode to lend a hand... with deadly efficiency.
translation: 拥有“神秘客”这项特长，你的守护天使有时会在V.A.T.S.模式下突然现身，助你一臂之力……而他从不失手。

original: You've been pushed around long enough! With the Nerd Rage perk, your Strength is raised to 10 and you gain 50% to Damage Resistance whenever your Health drops to 20% or below.
translation: 已经够了，你再也不想受人摆布了！拥有书虫也疯狂这项能力，每当你体力低于20%，你的力量属性将提升至10点，同时你的伤害免疫力将增加50%。

original: The Ninja perk grants you the power of the fabled shadow warriors, and increases your chance to do critical hits, and the damage of each.
translation: “忍者”这项特长将赐予你传说中暗影武士的力量，提高你使出暴击的几率和伤害。

original: With the Paralyzing Palm perk, you will sometimes perform a special V.A.T.S. palm strike that paralyzes your opponent for 30 seconds.
translation: 拥有“迷魂掌”这个特长，你在V.A.T.S.模式下将有几率使出一记震天掌，让你的敌人瘫倒在地30秒。

original: With the Pyromaniac perk, you do +50% damage with fire-based weapons, like the Flamer and Shishkebab.
translation: 有了“纵火狂”这个特长，你使用火焰武器（比如火焰喷射器和火焰刀）时的伤害将提高50％。

original: Rad Resistance allows you to -- what else? -- resist radiation. This Perk grants an additional 25% to Radiation Resistance.
translation: 辐射抗性能让你……还用说吗？——当然是抵抗辐射了。这个特长可以让你的辐射抗性增加25%。

original: With the Robotics Expert perk, you do an additional 25% damage to any robot in combat.
translation: 拥有“机器人专家”这项特长，你对机器人造成的伤害提高25%。

original: Each rank of the Scoundrel perk you gain a 10% discount at vendors and you gain more XP for passing speech checks.
translation: 每个等级的厚颜无耻特长都将使你的口才和交易技能上升5点。

original: With the Scrounger perk, you'll find considerably more ammunition in containers than you normally would.
translation: 有了“翻箱倒柜”这个特长, 你在搜刮时可以比原先找到更多的弹药。

original: With the Silent Running perk, you gain 10 points to your Sneak skill, and running no longer factors into a successful sneak attempt.
translation: 拥有衔枚疾走这项能力，你的潜行技能将+10，而且就算跑步，你也不会跳出潜行模式了。

original: With the Sniper Perk, your chance to hit an opponent's head in V.A.T.S. is significantly increased.
translation: 有了“狙击手”这个特长, 你在V.A.T.S.模式下对目标头部的命中率将显著提升。

original: With the Solar Powered perk, you gain an additional 2 points to Strength when in direct sunlight, and slowly regenerate lost Health.
translation: 有了“太阳能”这个特长，在阳光照射下，你将会得到额外的2点力量属性，并且能缓慢恢复生命值。

original: With the Strong Back perk, you can carry 50 more pounds of equipment.
translation: 有了“善背”特长，你就能多携带50磅的装备。

original: With each rank in the Swift Learner perk, you gain an additional 10% to total Experience Points whenever Experience Points are earned.
translation: “天赋异禀”特长每升一级，你每次获取经验值的时候都能得到10％的额外奖励。

original: The Tag! perk allows you to select a fourth Skill to be a Tag Skill, meaning it immediately raises by 15 points.
translation: “标牌! ”特长允许你再选择一个技能作为“标牌技能”，一旦选择，该技能立刻增加15点。

original: With each rank of the Thief perk, you gain an immediate bonus of 5 points to both the Sneak and Lockpick skills.
translation: 每升一级小偷这个额外能力，你的潜行和开锁技能都会立即增加5点。

original: With each rank of the Toughness perk, you gain +3 to your Damage Threshold.
translation: 拥有健壮过人这项能力，你将多获得10%的总伤害免疫。

original: Yao Guai are fast, powerful predators, and are descended from the area's black bears.
translation: 妖怪是迅猛的捕食者，它们由这个地区的黑熊演变而来。

original: Disabling the antennae of insects, like the Giant Ants, will make them frenzy and attack anything nearby.
translation: 打断昆虫的触角，比如巨型蚂蚁，就会让它们陷入癫狂，袭击任何临近的生物。

original: Super Mutants are often accompanied by Centaurs, which serve as "watchdogs" and alert their masters to danger.
translation: 超级变种人常有多脚兽伴随左右，它们就如＂看门狗＂，提醒自己的主人警惕危险。

original: Throughout the years since the bombs first fell, dogs have remained largely unaltered by radiation.
translation: 奇怪的是，自首颗核弹被投下以来，狗群大都未受到放射线的影响发生变异。

original: Deathclaws are some of the most frightening creatures ever encountered by settlers in the Capital Wasteland. Their speed and ferocity are matched only by the size of their claws...
translation: 死亡爪是废土移民所能遭遇的最可怕的生物。它们的灵敏与凶残，只有自身的利爪能比肩。

original: Eyebots spread President Eden's pre-recorded Enclave message throughout the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 机器眼将伊甸总统事先录制的英克雷的信息传遍华盛顿废土。

original: Feral Ghouls have lost the ability to reason, and will attack any human on sight.
translation: 狂尸鬼已经丧失理性，它们会攻击视野范围内的所有人类。

original: Ghouls, both "normal" and Feral, are not only immune to radiation... they're healed by it.
translation: 尸鬼们，无论是“正常”还是“狂暴”，不仅对辐射免疫，还能利用其治疗自己。

original: A Glowing One is a unique Feral Ghoul that has become a living conduit of radiation.
translation: 发光尸鬼是一种特殊的狂尸鬼，它们的身体早已变成了一座移动的核辐射炉。

original: Mirelurk Kings use a devastating sonic attack to debilitate their foes from afar.
translation: 泥沼蟹王从远处用破坏性的音波来削弱敌人。

original: The Mister Gutsy model of robot was commissioned by the U.S. Army just before the atomic apocalypse of 2077.
translation: 狂风先生是由美国军方在2077年核战争前委托生产的一种机器人。

original: The sturdy Protectron model of robot was created before the great war, and served as a security automaton in both the private and business sectors.
translation: 坚固的保卫者机器人是在伟大战争前制造的，曾作为安保自动机器人被广泛应用于商界和私人住宅领域。

original: The Robobrain, constructed by General Atomics International before the great nuclear war, is unique in that it uses an actual organic brain as its central processor.
translation: 机器脑是由通用原子能国际组织在战前设计生产的。它最独特的地方，便是利用真人的大脑器官作为它的中央处理器。

original: The Overseer is the incontestable leader of Vault 101, and his word is law.
translation: 监督者是101号避难所不容质疑的领袖，他的话就是法律。

original: At age 10, every Vault 101 resident receives a Pip-Boy 3000 personal information processor.
translation: 10岁时，每名101号避难所的居民都将得到一台哔哔小子3000型个人信息处理机。

original: At age 16, every Vault 101 resident takes the Generalized Occupational Aptitude Test, or G.O.A.T., which helps determine job placement.
translation: 16岁时，每名101号避难所的居民都得参加被称为G.O.A.T的“通用职业倾向测试”，为他们未来的择业提供参照。

original: Vault 101 security officers are hand-picked by the Overseer himself for their discretion and loyalty.
translation: 101号避难所的警员均由监督者亲自挑选，他们言行谨慎，忠贞不二。

original: Vault 101's residents remain protected from the outside world, with the exception of the occasional Radroach attack.
translation: 101号避难所的居民受到保护免受外部世界的侵害，唯有偶发的辐射蟑螂入侵除外。

original: A weapon's DAM indicates its approximate damage, and is modified by factors like the weapon's condition, and your associated skill.
translation: 武器的DAM标志了它的近似伤害，这个数值受到武器状态及相关技能的修正。

original: Press and hold your Pip-Boy button to turn the Pip-Boy light off and on.
translation: 按住哔哔小子按键不放，就可以打开或关闭哔哔小子上的照明灯。

original: The light generated from your Pip-Boy light actually makes you less stealthy. If you want to effectively sneak, turn it off.
translation: 哔哔小子的照明灯差点让你显了形！如果你希望潜行时更不容易被发现，请务必关闭照明。

original: Mirelurks are naturally armored throughout their body... with the exception of the face. Try using V.A.T.S. to target this area, and kill them before they get close enough to attack.
translation: 泥沼蟹周身被坚硬的铠甲覆盖，唯有面部是个例外。在它近到能够伤到你之前，尝试用避难所科技辅助瞄准系统瞄准这个部位将它击杀。

original: No job is too nasty for the mercenaries of Talon Company. If you encounter these heartless opportunists, be prepared for a fight to the death.
translation: 对鹰爪公司的雇佣兵来说，工作没有“正直”和“龌龊”之分。如果你遇到这些冷酷的投机分子，就做好死战的准备吧。

original: Raiders take whatever they want, whenever they want, and their favorite pastimes are torture and murder.
translation: 无论何时，歹徒都毫无顾忌，他们想拿什么就拿什么。他们最喜欢的娱乐是拷问和谋杀。

original: Disable a robot's Combat Inhibitor, and the confused machine will go into a killing frenzy, attacking friend and foe alike.
translation: 如果能关闭机器人的战斗抑制器，它将分不清敌我，从而变成彻头彻脑的杀戮机器。

original: Historical algorithms engaged. Processing Capital Post articles. Extrapolating American cultural references.
translation: 历史演算已执行。首都邮报文章处理中，美国文化指涉推算中。

original: Loading Tranquility Lane simulation. Please stand by.
translation: 正在读取宁静巷拟真程序，请静候片刻。

original: Vault-Tec prototype simulation engaged. Active program: Tranquility Lane.
translation: 避难所科技原型拟真程序已执行。激活：宁静巷。

original: Loading Anchorage, Alaska simulation. Mission: The Liberation of Anchorage Alaska from Communist Chinese forces. Safeties: Disengaged.
translation: 阿拉斯加安克雷奇模拟程序读取中。任务：从中国共产力量手中解放安克雷奇。安全性：未定。

original: Loading Anchorage, Alaska simulation. Motion sickness is normal, and will subside momentarily.
translation: 阿拉斯加安克雷奇模拟程序读取中。不适的感觉是正常的，将会很快消失。

original: U.S. Army Historical Archives: Anchorage, Alaska was invaded by Communist Chinese forces in the winter of 2066.
translation: 美国军队历史档案：阿拉斯加州安克雷奇在2066年的冬天遭到中国共产势力侵略。

original: The VSS Facility, like those operated by many civilian contractors before the nuclear war, was eventually acquired by the U.S. Army and adapted for practical military applications.
translation: VSS设施，和许多战前民营承包商运作的设施一样，最终被美国军队征用并转用于军事用途。

original: The Brotherhood Outcasts now control the VSS Facility, and hope to gain access to the advanced technology contained within.
translation: 兄弟会放逐者现在控制着VSS设施，希望获取其中储存的先进科技。

original: Welcome to Anchorage, soldier! Fight like you mean it, and we'll have you home by Christmas!
translation: 欢迎来到安克雷奇，士兵！好好作战，我们就能够在圣诞节前送你们回家。

original: Thousands of Confederate prisoners of war died near Point Lookout in the later years of the American Civil War.
translation: 在美国内战之后的几年中，上千名南军战犯死于望海崖附近

original: Point Lookout's swamps are rich in natural gases, which sometimes manifest on the surface as explosive methane bubbles.
translation: 望海崖的沼泽富含天然气,常常以易爆的沼气泡的形式浮出其表面。

original: The Turtledove Detention camp was built near Point Lookout because of its isolated location.
translation: 斑鸠拘留所就建在望海崖之旁，得益于那里与世隔绝的地形.

original: The Ark & Dove Cathedral is named for two English settler ships which landed near Point Lookout in 1634, leading to Maryland's founding.
translation: 方舟与白鸽大教堂是以两艘在1634年抵达望海崖的英国移民船命名, 殖民者经由这里上岸最终建立了马里兰州。

original: Point Lookout is said to be one of the most haunted locations in Maryland.
translation: 望海崖据传是马里兰州最经常闹鬼的地点之一。

original: Blackhall Manor was the ancestral home of a wealthy family before the Great War.
translation: 布莱克霍尔庄园是一个富裕家族的祖业，其历史可以上溯到末世大战之前。

original: The Calvert Family had a long history in Point Lookout, but Calvert Mansion is all that remains of their legacy.
translation: 卡尔弗特家族在望海崖的历史相当悠久, 但现在只剩下卡尔弗特庄园这一处产业了。

original: Point Lookout remained very rural and isolated until the Isla Negra real estate company purchased land and began developing new homes and attractions.
translation: 望海崖一直是一片田园风光，并与世隔绝，直到黑岛实业公司买下这片土地，并开始开发住宅与景点。

original: Smugglers roam Point Lookout, hoping to find their fortune scavenging this relatively undisturbed desolation.
translation: 走私者在望海崖终日游荡, 在这片荒芜之地上拾荒，渴望发一笔横财。

original: Swampfolk have no organized society or creed, but seem to mark their territory with totems of wood and bone.
translation: 沼泽居民没有社会组织也没有信仰，但看起来他们会使用木头与骨头搭建的图腾来标示自己的领土。

original: Point Lookout's rural location shielded it from direct impact during the Great War, but the resulting fallout has irradiated the area in the intervening years.
translation: 望海崖处于偏远的地理位置使得它幸免于末世大战的直接摧残，但核子尘却在那些岁月中一直污染着这片土地。

original: The Swampfolk denizens of Point Lookout are the product of exposure to heavy radiation and generations of poor breeding.
translation: 望海崖的沼泽居民是长期暴露在重度辐射下以及世代低下的繁殖力的产物。

original: The unchecked forces of erosion have carved sinkholes and grottoes throughout Point Lookout.
translation: 泛滥的腐蚀之力在望海崖的地下蚀刻出了众多的坑道与山洞。

original: Mirelurks thrive in the humidity of Point Lookout's coastal shores and viciously defend their territory.
translation: 蟹人族群在望海崖潮湿的海滩环境下繁衍壮大，并凶悍地捍卫它们的领地。

original: Coastal shipwrecks and buoys are good places to seek sunken riches.
translation: 沿海的沉船与浮标是探索财富的好地方。

original: Built in 1908 and serving up to 42,000 passengers daily, Washington's Union Station was an important transportation hub connecting the east and west coast before the war.
translation: 华盛顿联合车站建于1908年，每天为42000名乘客提供服务，是战争前连接东西海岸的重要交通枢纽。

original: There are a variety of poisons to be found in the wasteland, make those bladed or throwing weapons sting by crafting deadly elixirs.
translation: 在废土中可以发现了各种各样的毒药，通过制作奇怪的毒药使那些刀刃或投掷武器更致命。

original: Running out of ammo? Stockpile of unused ammo? Find an ammo bench and break it down into materials to craft more useful ones.
translation: 弹药耗尽？ 库存中有用不到的弹药？ 找一个弹药工作台并将其分解为材料以制作更有用的东西吧。

original: Not only is Nuka-Cola Quantum a rare and delicious drink, it can also be used to create a powerful explosive with the know-how.
translation: 核子可乐不仅是一种稀有而美味的饮料，它还可以用于创造具有专有技术的强大炸药。

original: Ultrajet is a rare and powerful variant of the drug Jet. It was created by Ghouls, since Jet has almost no effect on them.
translation: 超级杰特是药物杰特的罕见且强大的变体。 它是由尸鬼创造的，因为杰特对它们几乎没有影响。

original: Nights too dark? Don't want to announce your presence by turning on your Pip-Boy's light? Then Cateye is for you. This amazing drug will make you see better in the dark.
translation: 夜晚太黑了？ 打开你的Pipboy之光，不想宣布你的存在吗？ 然后猫眼是给你的。 这种神奇的药物会让你在黑暗中看得更清楚

original: With the Built to Destroy trait you will have a higher chance of causing critical damage, but you have to repair your weapons more frequently.
translation: 使用为毁灭而生特长你将有更高的机会造成致命伤害，但必须更频繁地修复你的武器。

original: With the Fast Shot trait weapons fire faster, but they are less accurate.
translation: 使用快速射击特技，武器射击更快，但它们不太准确。

original: With the Four Eyes trait you are less perceptive without glasses, but gain a boost to perception when you wear glasses.
translation: 对于天生四眼，佩戴任何眼睛时，你的感知都能增加1点。没有佩戴眼睛时，你的感知将会减少1点。

original: With the Good Natured trait, your combat skills are reduced, but your Barter, Speech, Medicine, Repair and Science skills are increased.
translation: 凭借好好先生性格特质，您的战斗技能会降低，但您的社交，医学，修复和科学技能会提高。

original: With the Heavy Handed trait you swing harder, not better. You deal more damage with melee and unarmed attacks, but your critical damage is reduced.
translation: 有了重拳出击特长。 近战和徒手攻击会造成更多伤害，但你的致命伤害会降低。

original: With the Kamikaze trait you sacrifice some of your defense for an additional 10 Action Points to use in V.A.T.S.
translation: 凭借神风突击队的特长，你可以牺牲一些防御，在V.A.T.S中使用额外的10个动作点。

original: With the Loose Cannon trait, you can throw explosives at a faster rate, but not as far.
translation: 使用疯狂投手特性，你可以以更快的速度投掷爆炸物，但是不会太远。

original: With the Small Frame trait, you are more agile but your limbs get damaged easier.
translation: 使用身轻如羽特性，您更敏捷，但您的四肢更容易受损。

original: With the Trigger Discipline trait you shoot slower, but your shots are more accurate.
translation: 使用精确射击特性，你的射击速度较慢，但你的射击更准确。

original: With the Claustrophobia trait you will receive a bonus to your attributes while outside, but you will suffer penalties when you are indoors.
translation: 使用幽闭恐怖症特性，您将在野外获得属性奖励，但是当您在室内时，您将受到惩罚。

original: With the Early Bird trait you will be at your best from 6am to 12pm. You will feel under the weather from 6pm to 6am though.
translation: 凭借早睡早起特性，您将在早上6点到中午12点处于最佳状态。 不过，从下午6点到早上6点你会受到惩罚。

original: With the Hoarder trait you enjoy a higher carrying capacity, but if you're carrying less than 160lbs your attributes suffer.
translation: 有了囤积者特性，你可以享受更高的承载能力，但是如果你的携带量低于160磅，你会感觉不太好。

original: With the Hot Blooded trait when your health is low you will deal increased damage, but you won't be as agile or perceptive until you heal.
translation: 那些散落在废土上无恶不作，三五成群的恶棍，在各地的叫法却不同，华盛顿称之为歹徒，莫哈维称之为匪徒，而波士顿称他们为掠夺者。

original: With the Logan's Loophole trait you will be affected by chems twice as long and will never become addicted, however you will never grow beyond level 30.
translation: 有了永葆青春这个特长再也没人可以让你退休啦！因为你永远保持年轻！（永远保持在30级）\n你再也不会因嗑药而上瘾，而且持续时间是以前的两倍！

original: With the Skilled trait you start better at every skill, but you accumulate experience slower.
translation: 有了训练有素特长，你的每项技能都更熟练，但你获得的经验值会降低。

original: With the Old World Gourmet perk. Pre-War food will make you recover more health, you will also be less likely to get addicted to Pre-War alcoholic drinks and they will heal your injuries too.
translation: 有了饕餮食客这个特长。 战前的食物会让你恢复更多的健康，战前的酒精饮料再也不会让你醉倒，他们还会治愈你的伤害。

original: Love Nuka-Cola? With the Nuka Chemist perk you can craft a wide variety of exotic Nuka-Cola flavors.
translation: 喜爱核子可乐？ 随着可乐专家这个特长，你可以制作一个各种各样异乎寻常的核子可乐口味。

original: With the Mad Bomber perk you can craft powerful explosives not available anywhere else.
translation: 疯狂炸弹人特长，您可以制作其他任何地方都无法制造的强力炸药。

original: The Here and Now perk immediately grants an additional experience level, complete with all the advantages that brings.
translation: “此时此刻”这个特长可以让你立刻升一级, 并完全享受升级之后带来的所有好处。

original: With the Life Giver perk, for each rank you gain an additional 30 Hit Points.
translation: 生命之源能力将给予你额外的30点生命值上限。技能的级别最高为3级。

original: With the Pyromaniac perk, you do +50% damage with fire-based weapons, like the Flamer and Shishkebab.
translation: 有了“纵火狂”这个特长，你使用火焰武器（比如火焰喷射器和火焰刀）时的伤害将提高50％。

original: The Ninja perk grants you the power of the fabled shadow warriors. When attacking with either Melee or Unarmed, you gain a +15% critical chance on every strike. Sneak attack criticals do 25% more damage than normal.
translation: “忍者”这个特长将赋予你传说中暗影武士的力量。施展徒手或近战攻击时，你的暴击率提高15%。潜行状态下打出的暴击伤害提高25%。

original: With the Lead Belly perk, you take 50% less radiation when consuming irradiated food and drink.
translation: 拥有“铅肚皮”这个特长，在饮用放射性的水源时, 你受到的辐射量会减少50％。

original: With the Intense Training perk, you can put a single point into any of your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes.
translation: 训练狂这个特长可以给予你1点属性值。

original: With the Cannibal perk, when you're in Sneak mode, you gain the option to eat a corpse to regain Health. But every time you feed, you lose Karma, and if the act is witnessed, it is considered a crime against nature.
translation: 拥有“食人族”这个特长，在潜行模式下你可以通过吃掉尸体来恢复生命值。但每次进食，你的业力都会降低，如果被人看见，将会被视作是违背伦理的罪行。

original: If you kill a target in V.A.T.S., With rank one 20 Action Points are restored upon exiting V.A.T.S. With rank two all your Action Points are restored upon exiting V.A.T.S.
translation: 如果你在V.A.T.S.战斗模式中杀死了目标，在离开V.A.T.S.战斗模式时你就能恢复20点行动点数。

original: While using Guns and Energy Weapons, you fire 20% more slowly but are 20% more accurate.
translation: 在使用枪械和能量武器时，你的开火速度下降20%，但准确度上升20%。

original: With Ghastly Scavenger, when you're in Sneak mode, you gain the option to eat a Super Mutant or Feral Ghoul corpse to regain Health. Every time you feed, you lose Karma, and if the act is witnessed, it is considered a crime against nature.
translation: 拥有“恐怖清道夫”这个特长，在潜行状态下你可以通过吃掉超级变种人或狂尸鬼的尸体来回复生命值。但每次进食，你的业力都会降低，如果被人看见，将会被视作是违背伦理的罪行。

original: Quite an arm you've got there. All thrown weapons fly farther and faster for you.
translation: 你的胳膊壮得像头大象。你投出的所有投掷武器都能飞得更远、更快。

original: Piercing Strike makes all of your Unarmed and Melee Weapons (including thrown) negate 15 points of Damage Threshold on the target.
translation: “穿刺打击”会让你的徒手和近战攻击（包括投掷武器）抵消掉目标的15点伤害减免。

original:
COMPANIONS ONLY
* Mult Weap DAM 0.75
* Mult Target DT 0.75
* Decrease Carry Weight 75
* Increase DR 33%
translation:
仅用于同伴
* 武器伤害乘数 0.75
* 目标伤害减免乘数 0.75
* 降低负重 75
* 提高伤害抗性 33%

original: Raul's rate of fire with revolvers and lever action firearms is 33% faster than normal.
translation: 劳尔使用左轮和杠杆式武器时的射击速度提高33%。

original: You're laser-crazy and it shows! Minor bonus to critically hit with all laser weapons.
translation: 事实证明你确实是个激光狂人！激光武器的暴击率小幅提升。

original: With the Dine and Dash perk, when you're in Sneak mode, you gain the option to take corpse parts for eating at a later time.
translation: 有了“吃不了兜着走”特长，在潜行模式下，你可以割下尸体身上的一块肉，以供之后食用。

original: Your frequent water consumption has led to improved benefits from drinking hydrating fluids.
translation: 由于你频繁地摄入水分，饮用各类水源的效果提高了。

original: Beams reflect off the mirror-like finish of your gleaming armor! You gain an additional +5 Damage Threshold against energy weapons while wearing any metal armor, +2 while wearing reflective eyewear.
translation: 你把盔甲磨得油光铮亮，甚至可以反射光束！身着任意金属护甲时，对抗能量武器攻击可获得+5的伤害减免，若穿戴反射性眼镜，则可获得+2的伤害减免。

original: You've discovered a Shotgun technique that has a chance to knock an enemy back.
translation: 你领悟了一种击发霰弹枪的技巧，开枪时有一定几率可以击退敌人。

original: Survival is the mother of invention! Craft ammo at the Reloading Bench using alternate materials (Scrap Metal and Tin Cans).
translation: 生存才是科技之母！你学会了使用替代材料（废金属和锡罐）在弹药台上制作弹药。

original: Your limbs take 50% less damage from Animals, Mutated Animals, and Mutated Insects, you gain +25% resistance to Poison Damage, and can eat Mutated Insects when you're in Sneak mode.
translation: 正常动物、变异动物和变异昆虫对你的肢体伤害减少50%，你的抗毒属性+25%，而且在潜行时可以吃掉变异昆虫。

original: You don't take kindly to raiders, junkies, or tribals trying to "settle" or "stay alive" in civilized lands. Against dirty raider, slaver and junkie types as well as tribals. You do +15% Damage and have a bonus to hit in V.A.T.S.
translation: 你憎恨那些游走并想定居文明世界的土匪、瘾君子和土著。在对抗这三类人及锡安公园部落时，你造成的伤害+15%，并在VATS模式下获得稍许命中提升。

original: You've had enough of the so-called "authorities" pushing poor folks around! You gain +2 Damage Threshold and +5% Critical Chance against anyone wearing the faction armor of the NCR, Legion, Enclave or Brotherhood.
translation: 你已经受够了这些总是欺负穷苦百姓的所谓的“当局”！当你在对抗的敌人穿着代表NCR、军团和钢铁兄弟会这几个阵营的装甲时，你的DT+2，同时致命一击几率+5%。

original: Maybe you were bad once, but you ain't like that now. Your Karma has been reset to 0, you regenerate AP 25% faster, and your attack speed is increased by 20%. You are also immune to critical hits. (Requires Bad Karma.)
translation: 或许你曾经是个坏人，但已经洗心革面了。你的业力已经被重置为0，你的AP再生速度提高25%，并且你的攻击速度提高了20%，同时你将免疫暴击。(需要邪恶的业力)

original: Your storied past has fallen from memory 'cause everyone thought you died. Your Karma is reset, you inflict +10% damage, and for every 100 points of Karma, you gain 10 Health. You are also immune to critical hits. (Requires Good Karma.)
translation: 你的传奇故事已经随风而逝，因为人们都以为你已经死了。你的业力将重置，你造成的伤害+10%，并且每100点业力将转换成10点生命值，同时你将免疫暴击。(需要善良的业力)

original: You've had lots of close calls. Whenever you finish a fight with less than 25% Health, your Luck increases by +4 for 3 minutes. You are also immune to critical hits, and your own critical hits inflict +50% damage. (Requires Neutral Karma.)
translation: 你有许多死里逃生的经历，如果你在生命值低于25%的情况下结束战斗，在接下来的3分钟内你的幸运值+4。同时你将免疫暴击，并且你自己的暴击伤害+50%。(需要中立的业力)

original: You don't just read books, you tear into them. Damaged books you pick up become blank magazines, which you can use to copy your existing skill magazines at a workbench (or convert blank magazines back to books).
translation: 你不只是读书，你还会撕书。你捡起的损坏的书会变成空白杂志，你可以用它在工作台上复制你现有的技能杂志(或将空白杂志转换回书籍)。

original: Your senses have become so keen that you can feel the slightest vibration in the ground. You gain +1 Perception and Agility attributes while outside.
translation: 你的感官变得如此敏锐，以至于你能感觉到地面上最轻微的震动。在室外时，你获得+1感知和敏捷。

original: The wasteland has taught you some hard lessons, but you've remembered them all. You gain +1% to earned experience per level gained. (For example, +25% experience at level 25.)
translation: 废土数次给予你惨痛的教训，但你已经记住了这一切。每升一级你获取的经验增加1%(比如,当你25级的时候将+25%经验值。)

original: ED-E doesn't set off mines. Text translation not needed.
Years as the Vault little league MVP have honed your hitting and throwing. With each rank, you gain 10% damage when using bats and nail boards, and you throw grenades harder and farther.
translation: 身为避难所棒球联盟MVP的日子磨练了你的打击和投掷技能，该能力每升一级，你将获得5点近战武器技能和5点爆破技能。

original: When you take the Master Trader perk, the price of every item you buy from a vendor is reduced by 25%.
translation: 你学会了死缠烂打的砍价神功，购物时，每样物品的价格都会下降25%。

original: With each rank of the Thief perk, you gain 10% movement speed while sneaking and +5% pickpocket chance.
translation: 每升一级小偷这个额外能力，你的潜行和开锁技能都会立即增加5点。

original: With the Iron Fist perk, you do an additional 10 points of Unarmed damage per rank.
translation: 每级铁拳这个额外能力让你的空手伤害增加5点。

original: Just like dear old Dad, you've devoted your time to intellectual pursuits. With each rank, hacking gets easier and chems last 10% longer.
translation: 和爸爸一样，你专心于脑力工作，你的科技能力和医疗技能增加5点。

original: You're obsessed with using and maintaining a wide variety of conventional firearms. With each rank of the Gun Nut perk, when using a gun, spread is reduced 10% and item condition is increased 10%.
translation: 你痴迷于使用和保养各种各样的常规枪械， 每升一级枪迷这个特殊能力，你的小型枪械技能和修理技能增加5点。

original: Take the Scoundrel perk, and you can use your wily charms to influence people, with each rank vendors give a 10% discount and you gain more XP for passing speech checks.
translation: 你的脸皮可能有城墙拐弯那么厚，有了厚颜无耻这个额外能力，你可以用你厚黑学的艺术来影响他人。 每一级提高你的口才技能和交易技能各5点。

original: Once you have the Contract Killer perk, any good character you kill will have an ear on their corpse. This ear can then be sold to a certain person (whose identity is disclosed when you take the perk) for caps and negative Karma  (Requires Evil Karma).
translation: 拥有了职业杀手这个额外能力, 你杀死任何善良人士之后,在尸体上能得到一个耳朵,这个耳朵可以出售给指定的人( 在你得到该额外能力后, 该人的身份会给出 )换取瓶盖和善恶值（需要邪恶的业力）。

original: You've made permanent enhancements to your body! The Cyborg perk instantly adds +10% to your Poison, Radiation, Energy and Fire Resistances.
translation: 你的躯体得到了永久性的增强！生化人这个额外能力使你针对普通伤害，毒素和辐射的抵抗力+10％，能量武器技能增加10点。

original: Once you have the Lawbringer perk, any evil character you kill will have a finger on their corpse. This finger can then be sold to a certain person (whose identity is disclosed when you take the perk) for caps and positive Karma (Requires Good Karma).
translation: 拥有了赏金猎人这个额外能力，你杀死任何邪恶人士之后，在尸体上能得到一根手指，这个手指可以出售给指定的人（在你得到该额外能力后，该人的身份会给出）换取瓶盖和正义善恶值（需要良好的业力）。

original: Just like dear old Dad, you've devoted your time to intellectual pursuits. With each rank, hacking gets easier and chems last 10% longer.
translation: 和爸爸一样，你专心于脑力工作，你的科技能力和医疗技能增加5点。

original: You're obsessed with really big weapons. With each rank of this perk, you gain a 10% boost to accuracy and damage when using heavy weapons.
translation: 你痴迷于正宗的大型武器，这个额外能力每升一级，你会得到额外15点的大型枪械技能。

original: You've learned the art of espionage from recovered intel, your pickpocket chance is increased by 15%
translation: 你已经发现了安克雷奇行动中的所有隐藏情报。干的好，士兵！

original: When you take the No Weakness perk, all S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats that are less than 5 are instantly increased to 5.
translation: 选择“毫无破绽”能力，你所有尚未达标的S.P.E.C.I.A.L.属性都会立刻提升至5。

original: Although you are still notified when you get Minor Radiation Poisoning, you do not suffer any ill effects from it.
translation: 尽管你受到次级辐射感染时仍会收到提示, 但你不再受到任何负面效果影响了。

original: With the Puppies! perk, if Dogmeat dies, you'll be able to get a new canine companion from his litter of puppies. Just wait a bit, and you'll find your new furry friend waiting outside Vault 101.
translation: 拥有了“量产型狗肉”能力, 如果狗肉死了, 你将立刻得到他的小狗做为新的伙伴. 只要等上一段时间, 你就会在101号避难所门外找到你的新朋友。

original: Take the Almost Perfect perk, and all S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats are instantly raised to 9.
translation: 当获得“几近完美”能力，你所有尚未达标的S.P.E.C.I.A.L.属性都会立刻提升至9。

original: With the Nuclear Anomaly perk, whenever your Health is reduced to 20 or less, you will erupt into a devastating nuclear explosion. Note that any allies in the vicinity will also suffer the effects of the blast!
translation: 拥有“核子异变”能力，当你的生命下降至20或者更低时，你的身体将会发生核爆，注意你身边的同伴都会受到波及！

original: When you choose the Devil's Highway perk, your Karma is instantly set to Very Evil.
translation: 选择“魔鬼快车”能力, 你的善恶值将立刻变成非常邪恶。

original: When you choose the Karmic Rebalance perk, your Karma is instantly set to Neutral.
translation: 选择“中庸之道”能力 你的善恶值将立刻变成中立。

original: When you choose the Escalator to Heaven perk, your Karma is instantly set to Very Good.
translation: 选择“天堂捷径”能力, 你的善恶值将立刻变成非常善良。

original: You have unlocked the secret to creating Nuka-Cola Quantum. With this perk, ten Nuka-Colas can be crafted into a Nuka-Cola Quantum at a campfire or hotplate.
translation: 你得到了制造量子型核子可乐的秘方。 拥有了这个能力，你每得到十瓶核子可乐就会自动转化为一瓶量子型核子可乐。

original: With the Superior Defender Perk, the player gains +5 to their damage and +10 to their Damage Resistance while standing still.
translation: 掌握究极防御者时, 玩家在站立不动时将获得5点伤害加成与10点护甲加成。

original: With Swing For The Fences you'll do an additional 20% damage while any one or two handed melee weapon is equipped.
translation: 掌握孤注一掷能力时，玩家在装备任意单手或双手近战武器时，将得到20%伤害加成。

original: Protect what's important.  With the Gray Matters perk you'll receive 25% less damage when hit in the head.
translation: 保护重要的部位。当掌握灰质能力时头部被击中所造成的伤害将减少25%.

original: You have learned to exploit the specific weaknesses of Ghouls, and gain a +5 damage bonus when attacking one.
translation: 你掌握了僵尸的特殊弱点，并将在与它们的战斗中获得5点伤害加成。

original: After hours of studying, you've finally learned to exploit a mirelurk's weaknesses and gain a +5 damage bonus while attacking one.
translation: 经历了数小时的学习之后，你终于发现了泥沼蟹的弱点，并在与它们战斗时获得五5点伤害加成。

original: Your familiarity with alien technology gives you better control over their weapons, increasing their damage output by 20%.
translation: 对外星科技的熟练使得你能够更好掌握他们的武器，增加20%的伤害输出。

original: Your business prowess gives you discounts wherever you shop. With each rank of this perk, items you buy now cost 10% less.
translation: 无论您在哪里购物，您的商业实力都能为您提供折扣。

original: All that practice shooting limbs off has perfected your aim. Against limbs.
translation: 对着这些肢体练习射击来完善自己的目标，打断四肢。

original: Your skill at using launchers is impressive. All that practice has improved your aim. Your shots hit closer to their target and do more damage.
translation: 你使用发射器的技巧令人印象深刻。 所有这些练习都改善了你的实力。 你的射击更接近目标并造成更多伤害。

original: All that hacking has improved your knowledge of the RobCo OS, all terminals are now easier to hack.
translation: 曾经的黑客攻击经历提高了你对RobCo系统的了解，你的科学技能在黑客入侵时进入更高等级。

original: Dogmeat is man's best friend, and he knows how to coordinate and run interference. While he is in your party, you will deal +25% damage to knocked down targets. In addition, you can ask Dogmeat to 'mark' his territory, setting a fast-travel marker to that spot.
translation: 狗肉是人类最好的朋友，它知道如何协调和进行干扰。 当它在你的队伍中时，你将对被击倒的目标造成+ 25％的伤害。 此外，你可以让狗肉‘标记’它的领地，设置快速旅行到标记那个地方。

original: Hooah! The gung-ho Sergeant RL-3 egging you on prompts you to excel at killing, whether they're Communists or not. While RL-3 is with you, you'll have -5% gun spread, and +5% Crit chance.
translation: 啊！ 无论是否是共产党人，强悍的RL-3中士都会促使你进行杀戮。 当RL-3和你在一起时，你将拥有-5％的枪支散射和+ 5％的暴击几率。

original: Fawkes' love for heavy weapons is infectious. With Fawkes in your party, Big Guns strength requirement is lowered by 2, and they do 10% more damage.
translation: 福克斯对重型武器的热爱具有传染性。 随着福克斯在你的团队，武器强度要求为你降低1点。

original: Star Paladin Cross is a seasoned veteran of power armor use and can show you how to deal with its idiosyncrasies. While Star Paladin Cross is in your party, you have +1 Agility and +50 carry weight when you are wearing power armor.
translation: 星光圣骑士克劳斯是一位经验丰富的动力装甲使用者，可以向您展示如何应用动力装甲的特质。 当星光圣骑士克劳斯在你的队伍中时，你在穿着动力装甲时拥有+1敏捷和+30携带重量。

original: Butch is a gang member at heart, and he does better with a sense of belonging. While Butch is in your party, you both gain +5% Damage if he is using the same weapon as you, and you both gain +5% DR if he is using the same armor as you, with an extra +5% DR if they are Tunnel Snake outfits.
translation: 布奇是一个帮派成员，他的归属感很高。 随着布奇加入你的队伍，如果他与你使用相同的武器你会获得+ 5％的伤害，如果他与你使用相同的护甲你将会获得+ 5％DR，如果你们同时穿着穴蛇帮服装将额外+ 5％DR。

original: Eulogy was right about her. When you have had a hard day on the road and are ready to call it a night, she will make sure you wake up with a grin. With Clover in your party, the Well Rested bonus will grant you an additional 15% experience boost and +1 Luck.
translation: 悼词对她来说是正确的。当你在路上度过了艰难的一天，并准备好好休息一个晚上，她会确保你笑了起来。 随着三叶草在你的队伍中，充分的休息给予你额外的15％经验加成和+1运气。

original: Jericho's many years of roughing it in the wasteland taught him to get by with nothing but scraps and ruins. You can talk to him at any time to make a campfire.
translation: 杰里科多年来在废土上野蛮生存，除了废料和废墟之外别无他有。 你可以随时跟他在篝火边聊一聊。

original: Charon is absolutely loyal to the holder of his contract, putting himself in harm's way to keep them safe. Unfortunately for him, his contract holder lives a dangerous, adventurous life... For each 10% health you are below maximum, you gain 1 DT.
translation: Charon绝对忠于合同的持有人，让自己处于危险之中，以保证他们的安全， 对他来说不幸的是，他的合约持有人过着危险的冒险生活。你的生命值每下降10％，你会获得1 DT。

original: Never be afraid to dodge the sensitive issues.\n\nYou now run 5% faster.
translation: 绝不要害怕回避敏感问题。\n\n你现在的奔跑速度快了5%。

original: It's essential you can bear any weight placed upon your shoulders.\n\nYou can now carry 25 lbs. more gear.
translation:
至关重要的是，你现在能够承受任何压在你肩上的重量。


你现在可以多携带25磅的装备。

original: Only through observation will you perceive weakness.\n\nYou are now 10% more accurate with all ballistic and energy weapons.
translation:
只有通过观察，你才能察觉到弱点。


你现在的所有实弹武器和能量武器的精确度提高了10%。

original: Always be ready to take one for the team.\n\nYour Damage Resistance has been permanently increased by 5%.
translation:
随时准备好为团队牺牲。


你的伤害抗性永久提高了5%。

original: It takes the smartest individuals to realize there's always more to learn.\n\nYou now gain 5 extra skill points when reading magazines.
translation:
只有最聪明的人才能意识到总有学不完的东西。


你现在阅读杂志时可以额外获得5个技能点。

original: Nothing says pizzazz like a winning smile.\n\nCompanions now deal an additional 10% damage and have an additional 10% damage resistance.
translation:
没有什么比一个迷人的微笑更能表现潇洒了。


同伴现在能额外造成10%的伤害，并且获得额外的10%伤害抗性。

original: There's only one way to give 101%.\n\nYou now have a 2.5% boost to critical hit chance.
translation: 只有一种方式才能全力以赴。\n\n你现在活得2.5%的暴击几率加成。

original: Never forget to walk away with more than you've brought.\n\nItems you buy now cost 5% less.
translation: 永远别忘记带着比你带来的更多的东西离开。\n\n你购买物品时获得5%的优惠。

original: Arrive at peaceful resolutions by using superior firepower.\n\nWhen using Energy Weapons, you ignore an additional 5 DT.
translation: 使用强大的火力来达成和平解决方案。、\n\n使用能量武器时，你忽视额外的5DT。

original: The best way to solve a problem is to make it go away.\n\nExplosives now have 10% less spread.
translation: 解决问题的最好办法就让它消失。\n\n爆炸物现在的散布减少10%。

original: Because it's easier to have courage from a safe distance away.\n\nYou now do 5% more damage with Guns.
translation: 因为在安全距离之外更容易鼓起勇气。\n\n你现在使用枪支时造成的伤害提高5%。

original: Always strive for the unobtainable.\n\nYour bobby pins are now less likely to break.
translation: 永远在为得不到的而骚动。\n\n你的发夹折断的可能大大降低。

original: The smart man knows a bandage only hides his wounds.\n\nYou are now 10% less likely to become addicted to chems.
translation: 聪明人知道绷带只能隐藏他的伤口。\n\n您现在对药物上瘾的概率降低10%。

original: It's important to do business up close and personal.\n\nYou now swing Melee Weapons 10% faster.
translation: 私下近距离做生意很重要。\n\n你现在挥舞近战武器的速度增加10%。

original: Why go down with the ship when you can try to fix it?\n\nYour weapons and armor now degrade 10% slower.
translation: 当可以尝试修复它时，为何要选择放任不管？\n\n你的武器和护甲现在损坏的速度减慢10%。

original: Always be prepared to explain the hows and the whys.\n\nYou now do 10% more damage to robots.
translation: 随时准备好解释原因和方法。\n\n你现在对机器人造成的伤害增加10%。

original: The safest distance between two points is a shadowy line.\n\nYour sneak attack criticals now do 10% more damage.
translation: 两点之间最安全的距离是一条阴影的线。\n\n你的偷袭暴击现在造成10%的额外伤害。

original: Let your words be your weapon.\n\nYou can now hire any companion regardless of your Karma.
translation: 让语言成为你的武器。\n\n无论你的善恶值如何你都能招募任何伙伴。

original: Sometimes, the best way to win is to outlast your opponent.\n\nAny chems you take or ingestibles you eat now last 10% longer.
translation: 有时候，获胜的最好方法就是比你的对手坚持得更久。\n\n你现在服用的任何辅助品的持续时间都延长了10%。

original: When words fail, there's always fists.\n\nYour unarmed attacks now do double damage against blocking opponents.
translation: 语言解决不了之时，总会有拳头来招待。\n\n你的徒手攻击现在在攻击对手时造成双倍伤害。

original: With the Stay Frosty perk, cryogenic weapons do 50% more damage and the effects last 50% longer.
translation: 拥有保持冷静这个perk时，低温武器造成额外50%的伤害并且效果额外延长50%的时间。

original: Butch is a gang member at heart, and he does better with a sense of belonging. While Butch is in your party, you both gain +5% Damage if he is using the same weapon as you, and you both gain +5% DR if he is using the same armor as you, with an extra +5% DR if they are Tunnel Snake outfits.
translation: 布奇本质上是一个帮派成员，他在有归属感时会做得更好。 当布奇在你的队伍中时，如果他和你使用同样的武器，你们都将获得额外5%的伤害，如果他和你穿着相同的护甲，你们都会获得获得额外的5%DR，此外如果是穴蛇帮外套还会获得额外的5%DR.

original: The best way to win an argument is to be the loudest.\n\nYou now do 5% more damage with any Big Gun.
translation: 赢得争论的最好方式就是大声喊叫。\n\n你现在使用任何大枪造成的伤害提高5%。

original: It's like living in a horror movie. You now do extra damage to Feral Ghouls.
translation: 这就像生活在一部恐怖片中。 你对野性尸鬼造成了额外的伤害。
纯水尝起来就像生活一样。
纯水的味道像极了死亡。

original: All that experience killing aliens has shown you the best way to do it. You do 20% more damage to aliens.
translation: 杀死外星人的经历都向你展示了祈求和的平最好方法。你对外星人造成的伤害提高20％。

original: Nothing says pizzazz like a winning smile.\n\nCompanions now deal an additional 10% damage and have an additional 10% damage resistance.
translation:
没有什么比一个迷人的微笑更能表现潇洒了。


同伴现在能额外造成10%的伤害，并且获得额外的10%伤害抗性。

original: The Survival skill increases the Hit Points you receive from food and drink. It also helps you create consumable items at campfires.
translation: 生存技能会提高你从饮食中恢复的生命值，也有助于你在营火处制作各类消耗品。

original:
Most game play in Caravan occurs during the Contract War. In this phase, both players are attempting to build their caravans and get them signed. To do this, their caravan must be neither light (below 21) or burdened (over 26). They must also compete with their opponent on the same track to prevent being outbid within the legal range.

On each of the three tracks, a caravan is considered signed if its value is from 21 to 26 and it is higher than the opponent's caravan on the same track. If two caravans are tied, neither is signed until the tie is broken. The game ends when all three tracks have signed contracts. Note: it is possible for a player to win while signing only two of the three contracts (the third going to the opponent). In such cases, all winnings still go to the overall victor.

Players have the following options on their turn:

* Play one card and draw a new card from his or her deck.
* Discard one card from his or her hand and draw a new card to replace it.
* Remove one of his or her own caravans from the table, discarding all cards in it.

Caravans are primarily built with numbered cards and aces, which can be placed in the player's caravans according to the following rules. Caravans with more than one card have a direction (ascending or descending) and a suit. Direction is determined by the last two cards in a caravan, suit by the last card in a caravan. All subsequent cards must continue in the same direction OR they must match suit. Cards of the same numerical value cannot be played in sequence, regardless of suit.

Face cards can be attached to numbered cards and aces in any player or opponent caravan. Face cards affect numbered cards and aces in various ways:

* Joker - Played against A, 2-10. Effects change based on whether it is an ace or numbered card (see below). Multiple jokers may be played on the same card.
* Ace - Value of 1. Jokers played on aces remove all other non-face cards of the ace's suit from the table. E.g. a joker played on an ace of spades removes all spades (except face cards and that card, specifically) from the table.
* 2-10 - Listed value. Jokers played on these cards remove all other cards of this value from the table. E.g. a joker played on a 4 of hearts removes all 4s (other than that card, specifically) from the table.
* Jack - Played against A, 2-10. Removes that card, along with any face cards attached to it.
* Queen - Played against A, 2-10. Reverses the current direction of the hand, changes the current suit of the hand. Multiple queens may be played on the same card.
* King - Played against A, 2-10. Multplies the value of the card upon which it is played. Multiple kings on the same card will have a multiplicative effect. E.g. one king on a 3 = 6. Two kings on a 3 = 12.
translation:
大篷车扑克的绝大部分乐趣在于所谓的“合约之争”。在这一阶段，所有的选手都在努力建设属于自己的商队以获取合约。为了取得合约，商队既不能太小（数字低于21点）或是太大（数字高于26点）。为了不被同行挤出市场，玩家们必须带领自己的商队与对手展开竞争。

在每一条商路上，如果商队的数字在21到26之间，且比同条商路上的对手高，那它就获得了合同。如果两家商队打成平手，那就没人能获得合约。当三条商路的合约都签订之后游戏结束。注意：玩家只需要签订两条商路的合约就能赢得游戏。

每一出牌回合时，玩家有如下几种选择：

* 打出一张牌并从牌组中抽出一张新牌。
* 从自己的手中弃掉一张牌并用一张新牌代替。
* 从牌桌上撤回自己的商队，也就意味着弃掉所有的牌。

每一家商队都由数字牌和A组成，根据以下规则来来搭建。拥有超过一张牌的商队想要继续放牌就必须按照某一顺序（无论升序降序）或是由花牌改变的顺序决定。排序由最后两张牌决定。但即使由由花牌改变了顺序，相同数字的牌不能放置在相邻位置上。

花牌可以放在任何玩家的数字牌旁。花牌对数字牌起得效果更有不同：

*大小王 - 对A，2-10起效。而效果根据是A还是数字牌有所不同（详见如下）。你可以在同一张牌旁放置多张大小王。
*   A  - 代表数字1。在A旁放张大小王可以消去桌子上所有同样花色的牌，比如说：在黑桃A旁放张王将消去桌子上所有的黑桃牌（除了花色牌和那张黑桃A）。
* 2-10 - 对应相应的数字，在数字牌旁边放张大小王可以消去桌子上所有相同数字的牌。比如说，在红桃4旁放张王将消去桌子上所有的4（除了那张红桃 4）。
*   J  -  放在A，2-10旁边可以消去那张牌，并附带消去花牌。
*   Q  -  放在A，2-10旁边可以从这张牌开始改变某组牌的排序。可以在一张牌上使用多张Q。 
*   K  -  放在A，2-10旁边可以将此张牌的数字大小翻倍。可以在一张牌上使用多张K以获得累乘效应。比如在3旁边放一张K变为6，两张K则变为12。

original: The computer has been rigged to explode.\nIt could be possible to disarm and remove the grenade.
translation: 电脑上安装了手雷，可能会爆炸。你可以拆除并取下手雷。

original: After a few close calls, you manage to stitch up Timebomb's wounds. He should be fine.
translation: 侥幸脱险后，你设法缝合“定时炸弹”的。他应该会好起来的。

original: This pile of eggs must be how the forager ants sustain their numbers. With a little more insight, you may be able to figure out how to use these eggs to your advantage.\n(Science 70, Medicine 40 or Intelligence 8 required.)
translation: 劫掠蚁一定是用这堆卵来维持族群数量的。如果你拥有更高的洞察力，也许就会懂得如何利用这些卵了。\n（需要“科学”达到70或者“医疗”达到40。）

original: Your grandmother invites you to tea, but you’re surprised when she gives you a pistol, and orders you to kill another vault resident. What do you do?
translation: 你的奶奶请你去喝茶，但你惊奇地发现她给你一把手枪，并且让你去杀掉避难所里的一名居民。你会怎么做？

original: Obey your elder and kill the resident with the pistol.
translation: 服从长辈，用手枪杀了那个居民。

original: Offer your most prized possession for the resident’s life.
translation: 拿你最有价值的财物来换那居民的命。

original: Ask granny for some cyanide to cook into the resident's next meal instead.
translation: 向你祖母要一把转轮机枪。因为你不想失手。

original: Throw your tea in granny’s face.
translation: 把你的茶泼在奶奶的脸上。

original: You don't know how to make that weapon yet.
translation: 还不懂得如何制造该武器。

original: "It's essential you can bear any weight placed upon your shoulders."
translation: “让你的论据具有说服力，这一点很重要。”

original:
You've found a Vault-Tec Limited Edition Bobblehead!

The inscription on the base reads "Never be afraid to dodge the sensitive issues."

You now run 5%% faster.
translation:
你发现了一个避难所科技限定版摇头娃娃！

基座上刻着“永远不要害怕躲避敏感问题”。

你现在跑得比以前快5%。

original:
You've found a Vault-Tec Limited Edition Bobblehead!

The inscription on the base reads "Never forget to walk away with more than you've brought."

Items you buy now cost 5%% less.
translation:

original: Karma is an overall indication of your sense of good, evil... or neutrality. Your Karma starts at Neutral, and changes based on your actions. It can go up to Good or Very Good, or down to Evil or Very Evil. Kind or self-sacrificing acts will net you good Karma. Selfish and malicious acts will earn evil Karma. Sometimes, killing a particularly saintly or terrible enemy will modify your Karma as well.\n\nThough some people in the world react to Karma, most base their opinons off of Reputation. Karma is simply the universe's way of tracking your good and bad deeds in the world.
translation: 业力值代表了你目前的品质究竟是好，是坏，还是中立。你的业力由中立开始，随后会根据你的所作所为而发生改变，你的业力可以上升到“好”或者“非常好”，也可以跌落到“坏”或者“非常坏”。你的业力值决定了不同的人们对待你的态度，也决定了他们是否会愿意帮助你。\n\n任何一个特定的业力值都有其利与弊，好事做太多有时也会被人讨厌。始终保持中立的话，就不用担心会被秉持正义的赏金猎人或者无恶不作的鹰爪公司所追杀了。但是这样的话，做善人或者恶人时可以得到的特别好处也就会与你无缘了，这些好处包括可以得到特殊的礼品馈赠，以及获得某些限制区域的通行权。

original:
I just don't know what to do anymore. When Roger’s not in that stupid basement, he’s outside sweet talking that hussy, Martha Simpson. He claims there's nothing between them, but I know it's all a lie. 

I found a woman's pendant once, on Roger’s workbench. But of course, I said nothing. That’s me, Janet Rockwell, prim and proper housewife, living a perfect life here on Tranquility Lane. 

Some days I wish I really had beat her to death with that rolling pin. Then Roger would know I'm the only girl in the world.
translation:
我真的不知道该怎么办了。现在要是罗杰不待在那个该死的地下室里的话，那他一定就是在外面和那个叫玛莎.辛普森的贱货鬼混。他一直坚称自己和那女人一点关系也没有，但我知道他根本就是胡说八道。

有一次我在他的工作台上发现了那个女人身上戴的吊坠，但我一句话也没吱声。这就是我，珍妮特.洛克威尔，我可是一名守规矩的良家妇女，我要在宁静巷里过着美好的生活。

有时候我想操起那根　面杖把他给宰了，那样罗杰才会明白我才是他在这世界上唯一的女人。
珍妮特·洛克威尔的日记

translation:
你对NCR无情的核攻击已经摧毁了加州的土地，甚至波及了莫哈韦的边界。在莫哈维前哨，你现在可以通过西边的大门前往15号公路，一个被毁灭的NCR前哨基地。准请做好准备，这个区域受到高度辐射，并且有大批野蛮的尸鬼出没。


你已解锁了“屠熊者”特长，允许你在任意S.P.E.C.I.A.L属性上加一点。由于毁灭了NCR的家园，你也获得了凯撒军团的声望，但是失去了NCR的声望。

original: Your merciless nuclear assault on the nations of the Mojave has devastated the lands of both the Legion and the NCR and reached even the borders of the Mojave. At the Mojave Outpost, you can now travel through the western gate to Long 15, the site of a devastated NCR outpost. At Cottonwood Cove, you can now take a journey by river to Dry Wells, the site of a devastated Legion encampment. Be prepared - both areas are highly irradiated and infested with Feral Ghouls.\n\nYou have also unlocked the Dead Man's Burden Perk, allowing you to put a single point into any of your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes. You also gain reputation with the Boomers and the Powder Gangers for your... destructive tendencies, but you lose reputation with the NCR and Caesar's Legion.
translation: 你对莫哈韦国家的无情核攻击已经破坏了军团和NCR的土地，甚至波及了莫哈维的边界，在莫哈维前哨，你现在可以通过西边的大门前往15号公路，一个被毁灭的NCR前哨基地。在棉白杨湾，你现在可以通过河流前往枯井，一个被毁灭的军团营地。请做好准备，这两个区域都受到高度辐射，并且有大批野蛮的尸鬼出没。\n\n你已解锁了“逝者的重负”特长，允许你在任意S.P.E.C.I.A.L属性上加一点。因为你的...毁灭性倾向，你也获得了大炮族与炸药帮的声望，但是你失去了NCR与凯撒军团的声望。

translation: 诵经台上的这本经书一定是《黑暗圣经》。这本书潮湿的封面上像是沾满了血迹。

original: You've found what's left of Agent Yang. Inspecting the remains closely, you discover a false molar tooth. There is a microfilm within that must contain the Self-Destruct Codes for the Chinese submarine.
translation: 你发现了特务杨婉遗留下的东西。仔细检查遗留物，你会发现一颗假臼齿。里面藏有一份微缩胶卷，里边记载的，一定是与中国潜艇自爆装置有关的密码。
